She's pretty good at lecturing. They are recorded so i didnt attend class much. She sings a lot, but its not too bad. It's "expected" that you read the textbook before coming to class but its not that serious fr. I had studyedge and so that helped. I recommend doing the homework problems, tho its not required. Office hours helped A LOT.

Dr. Hale is a good professor. She is a good lecturer but very bubbly and enthusiastic. She sings in class regularly. Discussion attendance is mandatory and there are multiple homework assignments per lecture (they are not difficult). Exams are fair. Pay attention in lecture and do the homework and you can get an A.

Do NOT take Dr. Hale. There is a reason chem 2 is an 85+ is an A. Her lectures are useless and the tests are hard! She writes questions purposefully to trick students. Take it with Dr. Benjamin instead. Exams and in person quizzes are 93% of your grade, so if you mess up one you're cooked. Study edge was a lifesaver and is why I got an A-.

She sings during lectures, which is distracting. Her lectures don't cover everything on the exam. Do lots of practice problems. You MUST read the textbook and do the hw to do well in the class. The quizzes are very difficult and are free response. The exams are hard as well, but they're MCQ. 75% of your grade is exams, 18% quizzes, 7% discussions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She was super fun in lectures. Super engaging, loved her as a person. Just a super difficult class in general and the exams had no curve and were more difficult than what she prepared you for.

Would not recommend although she is nice grading is terrible. The canvas grades were wrong the whole semester leading me to think I had a low B and last minute dropped me to a C after the drop deadline. Did not prepare us for the final and somehow ended with a D+ which has destroyed my gpa. Grade dropped full letter grades in the last two weeks.

She's very nice, but I didn't learn much from her.  I am hoping to pass this class (I have a C right now) and am waiting for the final exam to come out, and it was extremely difficult.  She didn't prepare us for it well at all.  I just need a 60% to pass the class and don't think I'm going to get it unfortunately :( stay on top of things!
prof. hale was super enthusiastic and ready to teach for lectures. while hard, the class is fair

Lectures are very rushed and always went over time. The canvas grading system was false and changed the week before classes ended and dropped my and others grade by 6% which really hurt my grade, which when asked about she said I was supposed to be calculating my own grade by the syllabus.

Hale ain't that bad but I was tired of her singing after the first few weeks and just got Study Edge. She goes really fast in an attempt to cover everything and still doesn't always make it. The very last time I dropped in she became comically vexed after the projector wasn't working.

Also the Canvas grading scale was wrong. Hope I pass. :)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hale is the best gen chem professor, but it's not a high bar. Her lectures aren't bad because she keeps the energy up. The grading is a joke, the grade in canvas the entire semester was a lie, and it only changed until withdrawal ended. Most people's grades dropped 6%. The reviews before the exam aren't useful. Get Study Edge, and dont fall behind!

I failed the class without even knowing till after the add/drop date. The whole semester, the grade on canvas was a lie and she expected us to calculate our own grades but it doesn't say anywhere that we had to do that. She never finishes lectures on time+If you have a sickness or cannot come to class, she makes it difficult for you to get excused.

She's very kind and tries to make the class fun, but her lectures are extremely confusing and do not help on exams. She will go off on tangents or over explain a lesson for no reason when its not even on the test, which makes it more confusing. The only thing graded is tests and quizzes and those are very hard. GET STUDY EDGE.

She's very kind and tries to make the class fun, but her lectures are extremely hard to understand and are not useful for the test. She'll go off on tangents or over explain certain lessons that we do not need to know for exams only to confuse you more. Her exams and quizzes are extremely hard, no homework assigned. GET STUDY EDGE.

Hale incessantly sings and goes on tangents from the main discussion. It's incredibly distracting and probably added up to about one whole lecture worth of meaningless babble over the semester. Further, her lectures are pretty poor representations of the exam content. The only way to succeed is to spam textbook questions (in-chapter and EOC).

80% of your Chem I grade is determined by exams, so it is a pretty tough class to do well in if you're not prepared or have bad test anxiety. I didn't particularly enjoy Prof. Hale's lectures, but she's very passionate about the subject and cares for her students. All in all, probably one of the better professors for a well-known weed out class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT take chem 1 with her, she is very enthusiastic but she doesnt know how to teach. She goes over modules VERY fast not explaining thoroughly, spends a good part of the class singing instead of teaching. Her lack of explanation doesnt allow students to understand the topic to be able to formulate  questions. Her class always ends 5 minutes late

I'm in orgo but had Hale for chem 1 and 2. She is BY FARRR the best gen chem professor. I can't say enough good things about her. Go to her office hours to get any questions answered. She is helpful and kind. She is so charismatic and intelligent. She prepared me best for orgo. She is passionate about chem, and I never dreaded class, even at 8am.

AVOID HER. Lectures are useless. Sings the whole time and it's so distracting. You need study edge to actually learn. The only grades are discussion grades, quizzes, and exams. Exams are made to trick you. Other professors teaching this don't have in-person quizzes and have easier exams.

Dr. Hale was very fun & involved! Attendance was mandatory for participation grades on discussion group days (splitting up into groups to talk abt questions), and the lectures were interesting. Labs were a bit of a slog but still cool. The class encourages participation and individuality in certain assignments (presentations were fun)! No exam :]

I've just started this course and I can easily see that Hale is a 3/10 teacher at best. She's rude and her singing, while funny during the first week, gets quickly annoying as time goes on. She does more singing than teaching. I truly feel like the people who have complained about the other professors haven't taken Hale yet. I wouldn't recommend.

Was a good lecturer until she got behind from hurricanes, then was always rushing and wouldn't allow questions. Would add lots of unnecessary info SHE found interesting. Seems like time could've been better managed. Overall decent and class was pretty easy, just rubbed me the wrong way sometimes.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I wish i loved her teaching as much as i loved all the singing and the taylor swift references. she definitely knows how to make a class entertaining but unfortunately i did not learn much during the lectures. the tests can be hard but if you put in the work its definitely possible. i was kind of surprised i ended with an a (did not need study edge

She's a good professor but she can be really distracting sometimes. She sings during her lectures and makes concepts sound like a Taylor Swift song and sometimes it can be tough to concentrate on the content. Otherwise, doing the practice exams can be really helpful and can help you get an A.

She was clearly very passionate about the class and made lectures engaging. It was a lot of reading/writing and there was a bi-weekly lab but it was a decent quest class and the professor is very understanding and flexible!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Dr. Hales's class. She was so enthusiastic, and you can tell she really cares about this course. I do believe the exams were much harder than they needed to be, especially the final. Overall, I did love her as a professor, but I am a little shocked with my final grade, considering the time I spent studying for her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof sings a lot in class, which is distracting. She's both nice and rude as other comments suggest. I got a good grade but that's only due to having taken AP chem in high school. If you have background class isn't bad but you still have to study a good amount. Study edge helps a lot because they go over things prof barely went over in class.

Dr. Hale is very enthusiastic about chemistry and Taylor Swift. Class grade is based on three quizzes, three exams, and discussion attendance. Lectures are fast-paced and exam material is often taught up until the exam itself. Textbook readings, practice problems, and previous exams help immensely. Lectures recordings are posted on canvas.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Highlighting the "bubbly and rude" quote from the review below - this is an accurate way of describing Dr. Hale! I felt bad for her grad TAs when they would mess up demos and she would tease them. Quizzes felt unfair at times (one average was in the 70s) and slides were often disorganized. Only redeemable quality was that she recorded her lectures!
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I've never had a professor who was both so bubbly and rude. Lectures were not helpful at all, and I would leave frustrated most of the time. If you take this class, I would highly recommend using Study Edge and studying for at least a week for an exam. Good luck!

Dr. Hale's class was not easy but she was enthusiastic and made it easier to digest. Your grade is almost solely based on Quizzes and Exams. If you study HARD, use Study Edge, and redo past quizzes/exams, and occasionally attend office hours, you will succeed. Exams are time consuming to study for but will see positive results if put in the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Hale seems like a nice person but she does not meet the needs to her students. Each discussion has a quiz but they are graded for attendance. The tests are extremely difficult make sure you practice over and over again. I needed Study Edge to barely pass this class. You have to commit so much time to this class.

For a quest class, this was a lot of work, however Dr. Hale is amazing to be around and talk to, and you can clearly see her passion for teaching, even just for a Quest class. Labs were an absolute chore though and took forever to do, and lab reports were just busy work.

Dr. Hale is sweet, but her approach to teaching was not effective for me. Most of the content on exams/quizzes are taught on the day before, and her lectures are not very concise (ex: talking about albums or going to concerts). She's also a big singer, which was fun at first but grew distracting for me, and I've heard peers complain about this too.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: BEWARE OF DISCUSSION QUIZZES! they are completely free response and TAs are instructed to take credit off instead of award points. Class is made very difficult when it does not need to be. I found her lectures pointless as she often would go off on distracting tangents not relevant to the course material. She also made the final very difficult!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took General Chemistry 1 in Fall 2023. The course material wasn't difficult and an A felt achievable. Dr. Hale is very enthusiastic and is very knowledgeable about chemistry. My only complaint is that Dr. Hale often sang in class that I found it distracting and off-topic. However, some students may prefer this light-hearted teaching style.

Quest Course (Secrets of Alchemy) Hale is an incredible and kind person, but goes on tangents often in lecture. The papers and lab reports are graded super lightly. Labs can take a little while, and are often a slog, but Hale's bubbly personality tends to make it a bit more bearable. I would take another less time consuming course though.

Dr. Hale is amazing. Inorganic chem is such a difficult class at UF, but she does her best to be as resourceful to the students as possible. She's also SUPER approachable, she literally sings in class. I won't sugarcoat it, you have to go to office hours if you want to succeed. But, if you put the work in, you'll get the grade you want. My fav prof

Dr. Hale puts a lot of thought and passion in her lecture material. I enjoy her creative ways of making lectures more fun and engaging. I found quizzes to be a bit hard. I liked that you only needed an 85% to receive an A in her course. I recommend Study Edge since they breakdown concepts better. As well as having additional practice.

I would take any other professor, Hales exams and quizzes were insanely hard. Exams were designed to be tricky and the quizzes were graded nit picky. Harris or Sumner are way better options and don't skim over information for exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I think Hale is a decent lecturer. However, she is very rushed to finish content and we will do half a chapter the day before the exam. Definitely need to put effort in for the exams, even if you do well in the other categories you need to consistently do decent on the exams. They are weighted heavily and made to trick you.

Dr. Hale was very nice and enthusiastic about the class. The only problem I can say is that in almost every class she wastes so much time going on tangents not even related to chemistry that she never really finishes a lecture. The class itself is relatively easy and vert duable as long as you do the hw and kind of study for the tests.

Dr. Hale did not outline the things that needed to be done. I have now finished Gen chem 2 with an A+ having another professor. Dr hale does not lecture well. None of it makes sense because she skims over everything. You pretty much need study edge or have taken AP chem to do well in her class. A nice person but TAYLOR SWIFT ISNT ON THE EXAM BABE.

Tests are designed to trick you, study well in advance for this class and do not get behind. Canvas could have been more condensed to navigate better. Graded mostly by exams and quizzes that are given during discussion periods. I wish I had taken Chemistry 2 with a different professor. Dr. Hale has a very bubbly personality and sings every lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures were usually never finished within class time period. Would often rush through PowerPoint slides up until the very last minute of class. Dr. Hale does have office hours and answers questions, though she can be quite passive aggressive in her replies. She sings a lot during each lecture which can be extremely distracting. TAs are helpful!

I thought Chemistry was really hard, but Professor Hale was fantastic. I enjoyed going to all her lectures. The only grades in the class are quizzes and tests but you should do the optional homework anyway. She loves to sing in class.

I love Dr. Hale! She is very cheery and bright. If you prefer a professor who ONLY gets down to business, steer clear of her! She demonstrates a very clear understanding of the material; her slideshows are pristine. My only grievance with the class was the discussion quizzes: partial credit was like justification to take away points, not give them.

great professor. good at explaining. very energetic and keeps everyone engaged (she loves to sing). the class is graded only on tests and quizzes but if you do lots of outside practice you should be fine. make sure you understand the concept well for exams and do the ALEKS practice problems for the quizzes.

Dr. Hale is genuinely one of the worst professors I have ever encountered. Her lectures are very disjointed and I found it more helpful to skip lecture than to listen to her convolute the content. She also refused to admit to any mistakes in exams/quizzes (of which there were MANY) and insisted that everyone didn't "study hard enough." 0/10.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Hale is very energetic and cares deeply about chemistry, so that helps. A lot of the time it's very difficult to tell what material from the lectures is tested on the exam. Be warned that quizzes are all free-response and are graded stringently. Overall, seemingly the best of the CHM professors: very nice and also not *as* pointlessly hard.

Dr. Ashlyn Hale was a good professor for CHM2045. She always seemed to have energy to keep you entertained during lecture, even at 8:30. Where she reads her PowerPoint, goes through a number of examples, does some demos or sings. However, this class is very test heavy with 57% of your grade being determined by exam scores.

Dr. Hale was overall a great professor, and she was super energetic. The class itself was difficult as it was very test and quiz-heavy as those were the only grades except discussion attendance. But overall all the exams were pretty fair and only the quizzes had some unfair content but they curved it when the average was super low.

Although her energy and passion is there, she doesn't really teach what is on the exam. The worksheets and the previous semester's exams are what really help prepare you for the exams. Although Iclickers are only 1% they certainly do make a difference in grades when you are on the edge of a letter. PLEASE GO TO DISCUSSION AND SIGN YOUR NAME!!!!!

Lectures aren't great. She doesn't talk about any of the content that ends up on the quizzes or exams. No grades to act as a buffer if you do bad on quizzes or exams. Had to do a lot of practice outside of class to keep up with all the people who had study edge. Did well (not because of Hale), but the class felt way harder than it should've been.

BEWARE OF THE DISCUSSION QUIZZES! They are fully free response and nothing like the past quizzes she posts. They are graded insanely harshly and are written to trick you. Exams are also very tricky, it is very difficult to complete this class with an A without study edge.

Professor Hale is a very energetic and passionate person, which at first comes across as exciting and fun. However it is very difficult to do well in this class using just the resources they provide. The quizzes are written with the intent to trick you, and they are graded very harshly. I was not a fan of her teaching style.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had her at 8:30am and always liked class. She's a great lecturer and sings while teaching. She's a big Taylor Swift fan. Don't listen to ppl saying it's annoying, she keeps it fun/engaging. I understood content well. She cares about students. There is a good amount of assignments, but it's manageable. The course is hard regardless of the prof

My section met at 7:25 in the morning and without fail, Dr. Hale was chipper, often singing, and excited to teach chemistry. Be prepared to listen to Dr. Hale sing Taylor Swift. The course on the other hand is just awful. No matter what professor you get there will be an infinite amount of homework that you will never have time to stop doing.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Dr. Hale is very energetic, but her lectures are bad. She doesn't cover the material that you need for exams, and it's kind of just a free for all when you get to quizzes. We had an average of 53% on a quiz and she only curved it to 60%. She doesn't even do average replace, she just takes half of your lowest test score.

Dr. Hale sometimes randomly sings in class, which is weird but she's just a very passionate person. She explains chemistry concepts very well too. Some people complain that she gives a lot of homework but that's not her fault, it's the department. I'd recommend reading the textbook before lecture and going to office hours if you're struggling.
Very condescending. Makes it difficult to reach out with questions.

Dr. Hale is FANTASTIC! She made me want to be a chemist. There is a lot of work, but that comes with the territory of the course. Some students complain just to complain, and I don't know why some people didn't like her. I enjoyed going to every 8:30 Monday double block. Don't listen to the people saying she sings too much. It keeps the class fun.

From Chem 1 to Chem 2, Dr. Hale completely changed the format of the class. Very quiz and exam-heavy, so be warned. Exams are designed to "trick" you to test your knowledge. Her lectures are not super helpful and she does not do a lot of practice problems in class. She is although very bubbly and has a lot of character which makes the class upbeat.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took CHM2045 this fall semester. Dr. Hale does a lot of dancing and singing and rarely did we get through an entire lecture within the 50 minutes. She is very upbeat and enthusiastic as a person, but as a professor, she skims over important material and dives deeper into topics we are not even tested on.
This is my first time taking hale and she is by far the best chem teacher at uf. she keeps her students engaged and has helpful lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Hale is a wonderful professor and in my opinion is the best option for gen chem. The class isn't terribly difficult, but is a lot of work regardless of professor. However, Dr. Hale consistently had less work than other chem profs. She gets distracted in lecture, but obviously cares about what she is teaching. Take her if you can.

If you don't like nerdy/theatre kid energy, get out. A lot of homework through ALEKS, not useful for exam. It does lead you to the harder stuff tho, but can be annoying.. Her lectures are not great but entertaining. She uses the book, so if you read it no point showing up (besides iClicker). She always runs out of time to finish her lessons.

Enthusiastic and engaging, but rarely finished the lecture in the 50-minute time frame. This is probably because she sings ALOT (which I kinda like) and goes off topic sometimes. She really cares about her students and has plenty of office hours outside of class. This is her first year as a professor, and she's doing well. Chose her again for Chm 2

The lectures are engaging because she sings and makes jokes, The main lectures weren't helpful because she spent a lot of time covering concepts at the beginning and then didn't have time to do all the problems at the end of the ppt. Highly recommend going to office hours/using Study Edge for better explanations. need to study a lot to do well

I had Hale for CHM2045 and LOVED her. Hands down the best chem 1 prof, and I made a point to try and get her for chem 2 next semester. She genuinely cares about all her students and making learning chem fun. She really knows how to simplify things and make classes fun. Chem is hard but she is the best prof to have for chem 1. iclicker ?s each class

Excited to teach but not very capable. A lot of class time is wasted on "performances" and not learning. She is responsive but passive-aggressive.

reviews.comment: Dr. Hale was a great professor and was passionate about helping students. She kept students engaged during lectures and was very entertaining. Highly suggest Study Edge to help

Taking Chem 1 can be a very difficult jump as a course. That being said, Professor Hale didn't really know how to tackle Exam 1, and set up her lectures not directly with the exams. There is a lot of homework that also doesn't line up with the exams. Although she is very reachable and enthusiastic, she glazes over material during lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Hale is one of the BEST professors I've ever had. She's so much fun, always has a ton of energy, and is so far the best at engaging the class (even a whole lecture hall) out of any professor I've had. I hate chem as a subject but she made this class actually tolerable. I'm not taking anymore chem but I almost wish I were because of Dr. Hale.

Dr. Hale is so enthusiastic about her class and very approachable. This class does come with a lot of homework, but the homework was my way of studying for the exams. I HIGHLY recommend Dr. Hale. She makes chemistry fun :)
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Hale brings a lot of energy to her lectures and clearly cares very deeply about her chosen subject. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: i don't really understand why everyone likes her so much. sure she's upbeat, but she gives an insane amount of work and it's so hard and takes forever too. EVERYTHING is graded for accuracy, and this class will consume your entire life. though i had a B, i had to drop the class for mental health and the stress it caused me. get out while you can!

The class is a lot of work because it is a weed out class. However, Dr.Hale is super nice she is very relatable and always in a cheery mood and singing songs. However, she fails to use lecture time as effectively as she could on some topics which tended to annoy me. Overall, definitely better than some of the other chem 1 professors.

Dr. Hale makes large lectures seem small. She brings a lot of energy every class with her singing and jokes. After hearing horror stories about professors in the other chm2045 sections, I am assuming that Dr. Hale is the best professor for the class. She also gave us two attempts on homework quizzes which the other professors do not do.

Dr. Hale is an amazing lecturer and truly cares about the subject. She does give a good amount of homework but it's good practice for the tests. I recommend also getting Study Edge to help learn the material better, especially if chemistry isn't your strongest subject. Overall, she was a great professor and super helpful during office hours.

This class is extremely easy, probably one of the easiest UF offers. If you are not a science student this class is also mundanely boring, but for how easy it is its worth the free 3 credits. Odabasi is not the best lecturer at all but you honestly don't need her that much for the course.

This class was incredibly easy. 4 open-note multiple choice exams, a weekly open-note quiz, 3 assignments throughout the semester, and short weekly readings on Perusall that were very interesting. Nearly all of the answers to exam questions are in the notes. You will probably spend an hour or less per week on this class. Would highly recommend.

This is the easiest biological science credit class. All the exams are open note. There are 3 big assignments that are graded somewhat toughly, but still very easy. There is some reading, but they are short through Perusall, but content from them do end up on exams. Some weeks have a lot of assignments, but they don't take more than 5 minutes.

Very easy class. You get 4 open-note exams, and you have access to the slides during exams. There are only 3 real assignments that require a little extra effort, but at that point, that amount of effort is still less than what you'd apply for a core class. A few textbook readings that you have to annotate, but again, super easy class.
Easy class but she just doesn't care and the grading is unclear.
Good intro class. Had 4 open-note exams and lots of little reading and video assignments. A couple of easy discussion posts that helped apply the material to real life. Easy and low-effort elective

Dr. Odabasi's class has been by far my easiest at UF. Online lectures, 3 assignments, quizzes (not honor lock), & 4 exams (open note, proctored by honor lock, lowest dropped). You can easily find quizlets for the content of her quizzes & exams that help a ton - highly recommend taking this class if you need an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Dr. Odabasi made this class rather clear cut forward and easy. There are 4 exams, and 10 quizzes (lowest quiz and exam grade dropped, and open note). There are also 3 assignments. The lectures are not too long. Only downside is honorlock, but then again, the exams are open note so.

Took for Summer A. 4 exams, 10 quizzes, and 3 assignments. The grading criteria on assignments is clear. Lowest exam and quiz grade dropped. Exams were honorlock but open note, meaning that the modules were open on canvas for access during the exam or you could print out your own notes to use during the exam. Take good notes and it'll be an easy A!

This was a very easy A. Exams are honor locked, but you have access to the canvas page and/or printed notes. The lowest exam grade is also dropped. 2 attempts for quizzes, which are the only weekly assignments, and then 3 assignments which are very easy as long as you follow the rubric.

If you're looking for an easy A class, this is it.  The exams are proctored, but the entire Canvas page is available to you during the exam.  Most of the content is dry and common sense, but some of it is interesting.  Dr. Odabasi is super understanding and will provide extensions if needed.

One of my favorite classes that I took this semester. 10 quizzes and 4 exams, open note and lowest dropped, plus 3 assignments. You always know what to expect for any given week, and exams/quizzes/assignments are usually open from Mon-Fri for you to take whenever.

Amazing prof!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Interesting lectures/reading material. Well paced, time for other classes. 10 quizzes (5 questions each, 2 tries) + 4 exams (30 questions mostly compiled from weekly quizzes) *Lowest quiz & exam score dropped! 3 easy assignments; follow rubic, don't wait till last minute! Honorlocked exams/paper notes permitted so maintain good lecture & quiz notes

I took this class Summer A and it was one of the most enjoyable courses I have taken at UF. Professor Odabasi knows how to navigate an online course well; her lectures were clear and concise, and her slideshows were easy to follow and super helpful when it came test time. Would 100% recommend this course for a GPA booster, that has great content.

Super easy class. The lectures are not that long and they are easy to follow. The exams are open note, so the exams are super easy. There are only a few assignments and could be finished early. 10/10 would recommend.

This class was extremely easy with Prof Odabasi. You only have 4 exams, weekly quizzes, and 3 easy assignments. The quizzes and exams are open note and open lecture. I took it for a gen ed bio credit and its a level 3000 course with no prereqs. I would highly recommend taking this course especially with Prof Odabasi, the content is also very easy.

reviews.comment: Take this class!! The lectures are very interesting and there are a few assignments that are not difficult. Dr Odabasi is very understanding and gave me a long extension when I needed it.

reviews.comment: Take this class if you want a GPA boost. Super easy and watching the lectures are not necessary. Take good notes before the exams because you can use them for the exams. That was all I did for this class and got an A.

If you need a science requirement filled take this. It's one quiz a week, 4 exams (lowest dropped), and 3 assignments that are not too hard. Professor Odabasi gives clear lectures, and there's also a ton of help online if you get lost in a topic. Exams are open lecture open note. It's a great class and you learn a lot.

Some of her lecture slides were lacking material on the exams, but all the content for the exams were in her lectures. There were 4 exams, 10 quizzes, and 3 assignments total with the lowest exam and quiz scores dropped. Her rubrics are a little unclear, but she responds super fast to emails and cares a lot about her students! Highly recommend!
She was awesome! This is an easy elective class: open note/book exams & quizzes, easy discussions. Hard to not get an A. Take. This. Class.

Never watched lectures and still managed to get an A on tests. Assignments are very easy (can be done quickly) and are graded easily as well. The tests are open notes and are pretty much straight from notes provided in the class. I also recommend using Smoking Notes for studying.

SumA: Easy if you watch lectures and print slides for exam. 4 open note exams, 3 quizzes a week, lowest exam and lowest quiz dropped. Had tech troubles and she kept reaching out to see if I was able to resolve them.Very nice woman, very manageable workload, interesting class, would recommend

Her lectures and readings are not needed, you can pretty much find everything online. I recommend watching the lectures at least once because it helps the exams go by faster. I didn't read any readings and ended with an A. You're graded on 10 quizzes, 3 assignments, and 4 exams. Her lectures are hard to understand but it's an easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Quiz every week but they are pretty straight-forward. Her exams are the same they are not meant to trick you. Her lectures on meat, fish, and poultry are lowkey interesting. Take this class for the bio credit.
This professor is amazing and this class is an easy A if you just participate and pay attention. 10/10

This class is an easy A. The books are not necessary and neither are the lectures really. All the information is either common sense or easy to google. All information is on quizlet. There are 10 quizzes that are 5 questions each, not monitored. And 4 exams that are 30 questions that are monitored by honorlock. Just review the quizlets. Took online

Dr Odabasi genuinely cares about food science and is a great professor that doesnt overcomplicate this introductory level class. her assignments can seem a little overbearing but considering exams are open note, everything she assigns seems pretty fair. good class to take if you need to fulfill this credit and have other more difficult classes

The tests were open-note and easy. Print out the powerpoint slide notes and write on them while watching the lectures. Print out assigned reading, too. I was confused a little about one of the projects, so I visited the professor at office hours. She explained it clearly to me and was great help.

Course consists of four exams, three assignments, and a weekly quiz. She drops your lowest exam grade, assignment grade, and quiz grade. Exams were open note and I had to dedicate less than an hour per week to this class. Would definitely take again.

Listen the PPT's on 1.5x speed as they are very long and tedious. Your grade rests on a quiz due each week, it is very easy to just read the transcript and do well. Several exams were open book and open notes, despite using Honorlock which seems weird. A longer video assignment requires explaining a nutrition label to a friend, all very doable.

She is really sweet and will help you if you need, but the lectures are long and you can tell shes reading from a script (speed it up to 1.5x) to get through it quicker the PPT helps w the exams. Just watch the lectures and do the readings she asks and youll be good

This professor was not what I expected. Her grading standards were all over the place. She never was clear about anything. Most of her lectures are actually taught by another professor. Tests were open notes but she gave so little time that it made them impossible. Get ready for the weird video project about food labels. Did not enjoy class at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

She doesnt show concern about students individual needs. Quizzes and Exams are too hard!!! Im not a science major so I shouldnt have to be treated like one! Dont take this lady! This is a warning!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I took FOS 3042 SUMA '19 and it was a great class! Was open note/book. Time limits are relatively strict but youll have time to look things up if youre efficient. Exams are taken w/Lockdown Browser. Exams and quizzes were based on the lecture material and you get to drop 1 of each. There are also easy 3 assignments that had really clear rubrics.
She was a good professor. The quizzes were extremely easy and was on Quizlet most of the time. Easiest A so far.
You NEED to pay attention to the lectures. The quizzes and exams dont give you enough time to look up the answers on the internet. You have to take good notes to do well.

Test and quizzes straight from lectures and the small readings which are posted online, and they are open-note but strictly timed. However, a lot of the answers are on Quizlet so if you take notes on the lectures/posted readings and have a Google tab open you will be fine. I see lots of bad reviews for FOS2001, but she's great for FOS3042.

DO NOT TAKE THIS COURSE IF YOU JUST NEED AN ELECTIVE. The assignments are ridiculously hard and unnecessarily confusing. And she never. replies. to. my. emails. The quizzes are clsoed book and you have three minutes to do them. The exams are nothing like the study guide.

FOS2001 isn't too difficult, but she definitely went out of her way to make it harder. Exams are Proctor U and they're not like the study guide. Quizzes are only 3(!) minutes long and are supposed to be closed-book. There's enough E.C. that getting an A isn't impossible and it doesn't take up too much time, exams and quizzes are just annoying.

Don't take FOS2001 if its just an elective. Quizzes have 3 questions with answers based on a few sentences within your 40 plus page chapter. You're provided a "study guide" for exams that lists words like "iron" without knowing what concepts you need to know. Took it out of interest in nutrition and wish I didn't. Can't believe its 2000 level.

AVOID FOS2001. It had a reputation as an easy elective, but was reformulated into something else entirely . Frustratingly complicated assignments with confusing instructions. Weekly quizzes with a very short time limit, and the exams are administered with ProctorU, an invasive proctoring program. Do NOT take as an elective, you have been warned!

The lectures done by Dr. Adabasi for this course are very easy to understand and very relevant to the tests and quizs. The problem is that not all the lectures are done by Dr. Abasi. Still, this class is pretty easy and very interesting. Most of the grade is just easy quizs and tests. I would just say that you need a chemistry background.

Great professor! She cares a lot about the students and will always respond to emails. Easy A if when you just read the lectures and do well on exams and quizzes. Only quizzes and exams for the online version and the lowest of each dropped.

The class is all lectures with quizzes and exams, plus one 300 word assignment, like 11 assignments in all. Plus it's an easy A as long as you watch the videos. Seriously,  Dr. Odabasi is wonderful! The class content wasn't enthralling  but it's also not my major.

reviews.comment: She is very passionate about dynamics and makes it pretty easy to understand, similar to physics 1. Exams, quizzes, and hws are all very reasonable. Attendance not mandatory and she posts the notes but there is a QR code for extra credit if you go to class

I took Dr Allen for Dynamics, and she made the class very simple and built the curriculum very well. She did QR codes in class that you could scan as your attendance to earn extra credit. Her homeworks were somewhat difficult at times, but never over the top.

Professor Allen has a very poor understanding of the content in the Dynamics course and consistently makes mistakes in class. This great and wise professor was an integral part of the learning experience; lectures aren't recorded so show up and you'll benefit as she is a great teacher who makes the class very learnable; no textbook and exams reflect the content well so make sure you actually understand it before; would recommend Oh great teacher the wise to anyone

She is so knowledgeable and wise Oh great teacher the wise was instrumental to my learning in this class and every day I had to enter the room was a great day the exams were fair and she made the material very fun to learn attendance is optional but she does not post recorded lectures and the notes are not the best if you do not have the context.

Dr. Allen was an amazing professor for dynamics. She taught the subject very well, making the concepts understandable and engaging. I would very highly recommend taking her. Attendance was optional but was an opportunity for extra credit. She also makes the exams manageable, i.e. if exam 1 was too hard, exam 2 will be made easier.

She is very nice and helpful in & outside of class, but only take this course if you enjoy long readings (~20 pages per class/~60 pages per week) on philosophy-heavy material. Amazing. Best humanities professor I've ever had. Halo is precise and clear with feedback, exacting in group discussions but always open and approachable. This is a good class if you want to improve your reading, speaking and analytical skills. All the readings are valuable and carefully selected. No time is wasted. Challenging but rewarding.

reviews.comment: Honestly I loved Dr. Cahill. Just watch the lecture videos and you will be fine. He was very enthusiatic, and clearly loves what he teaches. He is very helpful during office hours as well. Drops lowest exam grade and lowest discussion grade. The assignments are fun as well. Would take another class with him again.

Such a funny and understanding guy. He will even give you his personal phone number so you can ask questions whenever you have them. Writing project is time consuming but not hard as long as everyone in your group does their part. Tests are a bit difficult personally.

3 non cumulative exams 40% MC and 60% FR, 6 H.W assignments, SONA, and huge group research project. You pick your group on first day. Very little direction and grading was unclear for the huge research project worth 180/600 points. Class requires a ton of outside groupwork for project and studying to succeed on exams. Average grade in class was 82%
Ext\, but the professor is very helpful in office hours, responsive to emails, offers exam reviews, and some extra credit

The lectures are clear and align with exam content, with several extra credit opportunities. Exams are difficult due to the 50 minute time limit, so attending exam reviews is very important. Grading for the open-ended questions can be unclear, but an A is possible with effort. The group research paper is time consuming, so choose a committed group.

Although online, the lectures were interactive and fun to watch. Dr. Cahill is really funny, responsive to students, and encouraging! Office hours are super helpful and fascinating. His exams are tough, but reading the textbook and really understanding the content will take you far. Overall, a very interesting class and helpful professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Cahill is a super sweet guy, but is definitely more cordial over email/Canvas vs. when you see him in person. His class is really tough in that his exams will ruin your grade if you bomb one of them. Open ended questions are so vague, and multiple choice can have multiple arguable answers. Take advantage of any extra credit. Not an easy A with him.

His tests have very oddly worded questions. I personally struggled with that, especially since his online Cognitive Psychology class is so test heavy, making up about 70% of the total grade. He's very good with office hours and a passionate lecturer so he's very helpful if you have questions. Not lenient with grading though.

Unnecessarily difficult for an introductory class. 3 non-cumulative exams, 1 research paper. Instructions  contradictory and unclear for most assignments. Prepare to figure out the writing and the statistical data by yourself. No communication between prof and TAs. Shout out to Eli (only help there). Avg grade: not an A -prof

Cahill is caring I suppose but is often quite sarcastic and blunt during office hours but more welcoming over email. Attending office hours is great if he understands and doesn't go off on a tangent. Grades and exams are fair. Take advantage of extra credit. Trying to build a relationship with him doesn't matter if he just doesn't like you.

I am grateful for Dr. Cahill's teaching and the impact his course has had on my learning experience. His lectures were consistently engaging, thought-provoking, and well-structured, making even the most complex material accessible and interesting. Dr. Cahill has a unique ability to spark curiosity and encourage active participation.

This class almost took me out fr, but he was kind and responded to emails asap, and the lectures were funny. But there is a lot of reading and most of it is not on quizzes, so it was stressful to know what's on the exams or not. Would take it again in a longer semester; my classmates carried me fr. Collaborate with your peers bro, TRUST.

reviews.comment: I've never rated my professor before but i had to hop and here and rate professor Cahill. He is amazing! As a Psychology major, I appreciated his enthusiasm and clarity. Get ready to study but his lectures are informative and helpful.

Getting an A in this class is possible, but very rare, as average grades are in the 70s and 80s on every assignment/exam. Would not take unless a pre-law psychology student.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Cahill seems like a genuine guy, but his grading is very harsh for an elective. The exams are doable if you apply yourself, but the three assignments throughout the semester are graded very strictly, and the directions are hardly clear. This class did have some interesting lessons, but the rest is a snooze. Good luck!

Cahill is kind and funny, and you can see how passionate he is about his field in his teaching. While he is great, the class is difficult, assignments are graded harshly, and you need to study a lot for exams. To be honest, I would not recommend taking this if you're just pre-law, only if you're VERY interested in legal psych or a psych major.

so i can't speak much on the profs ability because he had various personal hurdles that took him away from class. however the TAs? Unless you have to take his class, I would avoid it. Ignore what other reviews say, this professor is on a power trip. REALLY not leinient in any way, even with good reason. reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I would highly recommend taking this online class, just make sure to watch lectures and complete the readings! You cannot use any outside materials on exams, but his study guides and materials help prepare you well!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment:
Majority of success comes from engaging with the textbook. You must ACTIVELY process the material over spaced intervals.
(so none of that last minute cramming! stay consistent)
for discussions: being thorough = how you get your points.  
Professor is kind.
class is a lot less intimidating than many think if you put in the effort.

Really unfair grader.
Cahill hosts hours and offers help but exams were terrible and he was not fair at all.

Dr. Cahill is so sweet and he is very engaging, but the tests for this class are ridiculous. If you think you can just watch the lectures and not read the book, you're so wrong. The questions are worded vaguely and there are 2+ correct answers. There are things he never addresses and somehow they're on the exam which is like 70% of your grade.

This is specifically for the Graduate TAs(I love Cahill this is nothing against him). They were absolutely horrible grading discussions. Criteria was unclear. I would get points removed and got feedback like "I wish you said XYZ". I know this is psych but I don't read minds. Discussions can take away your A, be careful with that!

Cahill was pretty funny in lectures and provided great examples for concepts and still kept it like an IRL psych class with interactive Qs and activities. 
Tests were always fair and not as detailed as the book, but reading the book is the only way you can succeed with details of this class! Study guide are provided but make your own, I liked Anki!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Attendance only mandatory on lab days and even then you can miss one or two and be okay. Just communicate with your group. The class is based around a group paper with very clear instructions and great communication from the professor and TAs. 3 exams non cumulative with open ended and multiple choice sections. Do the work, and ask good questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Cahill is a great professor! The class is a bit difficult but if you stay on top of the material, you should be fine. The recorded lectures are sometimes long but he provides really detailed info that clarifies concepts. He also tries to keep his students engaged by including interactive games/videos in his lectures which is nice.

The content of the class was great. I learned a lot. I would take the class again with a different professor. I ended up dropping the class right nov 22 so I didn't have a fail. I had fine grades for the whole class except the exams (which are worth 69% of grade). For the questions you have to choose the best answer out of 4 correct answers. 2/10
Professor Cahill keeps the class engaging with his humor. The coursework is manageable - just focus on the textbook and lectures. Unstuckstudy was a lifesaver for exam prep.

I took Cognitive psych but couldn't find the code above. He is very smart and knowledgeable about the material. His lectures are really good and informative. His test are sort of difficult but you can figure them out. Some of the assignments were fun, like the discussions. Reachable outside of class.

I've seen a lot of bad reviews for this prof so I was nervous but he was great. His lectures were interesting and his grading was fair. The exams didn't blindside me at all because he taught everything on it. He seems to care about his students. If you're really interesting in psych, this class should be relatively easy and interesting!
Awesome teacher very accommodating and caring of his students. Easy to pass the class if you put in the work of studying and taking good notes.

He is awesome, he makes tons of jokes, and is very caring. His class consists of watching lectures and taking notes, reading textbook, and answering discussions and quizzes. He has 4 exams but drops the lowest exam score at the end of the semester. I am about to delivery my baby and he was very accommodating to my condition. Loved this class. 10/10

AVOID Tests are extremely hard, heavily weighted w/ so much material to cover Extremely vague in rubrics, will fail your assignments if you didn't do exactly what he was looking for, no matter how much work you put in it, he doesn't care Expects you to be an expert even though learning Implies youre a bad student if you don't have an A in his class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The lectures are somewhat interesting. The discussion posts are beyond picky- sometimes they will say "Great work on this part!!" then take two points off of it- CRYING. Exams are redundant on questions but so hard for no reason- the study guide is not even helpful. no practice work at all even tho he tells us practice is a great way to learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Be prepared to study heavy in this class, these exams humble you. I studied day n night for these exams and it is basically luck in the end. The discussions board are graded strictly so even if you wrote the best paragraph ever, you can still get a lower grade. Nice professor but not a course of easy A. Don't take If you want to save your GPA.

Dr. Cahill is an amazing professor. He cares about his students and acknowledges hard work. His lectures are very entertaining, and he does a lot of demonstrations to help us understand the concepts. There are 4 exams, and he drops the lowest grade. I would definitely recommend taking cognitive psychology with Dr. Cahill.

180 points go towards your research paper, and you pick your group to write the paper with on the first day of class. He has belittled students in front of the class and if you want to talk to him during office hours, be prepared to wait. His exams are extremely difficult, yet he will blame the entire class for doing poorly instead of himself.

Do NOT take him for lab methods! Worst class I've taken. Lacks organization, clear grading criteria, assignment intructions and communication. 3 Exams, big research project and couple hws. You rlly cant afford to make mistakes. Contradicted himself constantly when teaching, was especially misleading in how we should prepare for the last exam.

Focus on the textbook. Some answers will be  from the textbook verbatim but it'll be the most obscure thing possible. His lectures are important. The exams are hard but also I took this class freshman year and had no clue how to study. He def cares that you do well, but won't offer EC. Discussions are graded so harshly, write loads
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This course contains some assignments, several grades for a research paper with a group, and exams. I struggled most with the paper for the group. The TAs graded each submission and it felt like they were purposefully being nit-picky, and would dock points off for things that weren't in the rubric which was frustrating.

Overall grade determined largely on exam scores (about 80%). Clear lectures but had a tendency to be absent sometimes (about 4-5 times in summer b.) reviews.comment: Bleh. Your standard boring online psych class. He doesn't write a single piece of content for his courses (lectures aren't even him) yet has an attitude with students. I've taken a couple classes with him and they're pretty easy if you stay on top of it but if you need help or an extension, expect a condescending email response and no real help.

I loved this professor. His lectures were engaging and very helpful. I also thought the textbook was interesting and connected to course material. Exams were really the only thing we were graded on, and they were pretty difficult. Everything came from the textbook and his lectures, but the information is complicated. Be prepared to study!
Great professor. Easy to navigate course. Very passionate. 10/10 would most definitely take again! 4 proctored exams through honorlock, drops the lowest score.

Conflicted about this class. On one hand, I think the material was very interesting and Cahill does a good job of presenting it in the lectures and being available for office hours. But if you need a good GPA, don't take this class. Exams are HARD. I'm an A student and barely got a B. The average grade in this class before the final was an 83%.

This class is very hard and you need to study and read the textbook if you want to pass, but Dr. Cahill is awesome and is very engaging and funny in his lectures, and he is a very nice guy and really cares about the class and his students.

Professor is kinda funny, and makes an effort to include students in the discussion and lectures so he ensures we remember the information better. Definitely recommend taking him if you have an in-person class. Lots of reading and you NEED to study to pass the class, but he provides extra credit opportunities and he drops lowest quiz and exam grade

Cahill was not bad, I thought he was going to be worse based off the reviews. The class has work, but it's a 3000 level class so that makes sense. There a weekly quiz, 10 Q in 10 min. There is a discussion post for every other chapter, which isn't hard. Tests aren't bad. He drops your lowest score for every category (tests, quizzes, discussions)

Did Cahill make this course easy? Absolutely not. Did he do a great job making engaging lectures and getting me genuinely interested in legal psychology? Absolutely yes. I think this guy's awesome. Study hard - REALLY hard - and you'll do great.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: great professor, super engaging lectures!! the only thing is that you definitely have to study or at least read the textbook to get a good grade. also he has these 5 minutes ten question quizzes thatt are open note, but usually you dont have enough time to use notes - if you know what your doing they arent too bad though.

I would not recommend Dr. Cahill. He presents as a cool teacher, but is not helpful when you're sick, and will make rude remarks to students. Hard to succeed.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!! If you need to, take with a different professor. There is extra credit but this class is NOT worth the stress and anxiety you will have. Simple information in lectures are made WAY to difficult on the exam. Exams which are half written response make it hard to do well. AVOID!!!

The class material wasn't even as difficult as he made the tests. He made the questions difficult for no reason a times. The discussions, I assume weren't graded by him, were also toughly graded. He does not curve a single exam, so even though I got 70s and 80s I still couldn't reach a B even though I had all 4.5 and 4/5 on all quizzes.

This class was awful and chaotic. As others have said, the relatable professor thing is a farce. Prepare yourself for constant deadline/scope shifting, poor project instructions, ludicrous grading style (synonyms known from outside of class not acceptable). 

Office hours typically have ~15 sad and confused students waiting 2 hours in the hallway.

Only 5 minutes for 10 questions which can sometimes have paragraphs as the question. Exam is textbook driven and involves trick questions. Don't recommend.

AVOID IF YOU CAN!!! I do not recommend taking Dr. Cahill for ANY course. Outrageously difficult class. Never. Again.

Took this class summer A so it was based solely on exams and quizzes, which are 10 questions and 5 mins but fair if you go over content. really great professor who is super passionate about the material. his quizzes and exams can be a bit tough as they are very specific and his quizzes have a 5 minute time line but as long as you put in the effort you should be fine!

Dr. Cahill wants his students to succeed, but he will definitely make you work for a good grade. The course is not easy but as long as you read the textbook and watch his lectures, you will be fine. Great guy. But it's not him teaching you the material; you gotta fend for yourself in this class. Exams aren't reflective of how he teaches. Great lecturer! Was super easy to understand material and do well on the exams. Professor Cahill is my favorite professor to date. Exams weren't a cake walk, but as long as you watch the lectures, you will do great! He makes it interesting with lots of demonstrations and being a great guy.

reviews.comment: Dr. Cahill is a great professor and lecturer of psychology, and he is very passionate about the subject. He's very engaging and is always willing to make himself available to answer questions. He definitely makes you earn your grade so make sure to go to office hours and ask questions. He was also very considerate of us when we went online

Prof. Cahill is a great lecturer and by the look of the calendar, you will think the class is manageable; however, his grading criteria and the specificity of the questions by which he grades will tear you apart. It may seem as though it is not a lot of work until you actually get to see the extension of the lectures, videos, and readings.

Cahill is passionate about the subject material, gives great lectures, and you will learn. I should have known better and not taken this professor again. His Cognitive Psychology wasn't as insane in terms of grading though. Avoid yourself a headache and tanking your GPA; avoid like the plague. His good rate here because he is knowledgeable and kinda funny guy, but his standards of grading aren't commensurate with any other class.

Dr. Cahill is a very nice professor that does really seem to care about his students. However, his exams for legal psych were completely unfair and asked the most minuscule and irrelevant details. reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Tough grader
