DO THE EXTRA CREDITS! (Can save your grade!)

Comparatively, the toughest grader I have ever had. Quizzes allow 30 seconds per question. Grading on discussions is always in the 55-60% class mean range. Exams are proctored, difficult, and prepare to learn names and years like multiplication tables. First time getting a C in my entire career and last time taking a class with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Amazing professor with great lectures that are enjoyable. Very open-minded & says he is middle-grounded on politics, which is hard to find in a professor. Weekly quizzes that are difficult because of the time you have (30 sec per question). Make sure you watch lectures/read book before taking them. 4 exams (one dropped) and discussion posts.

This was the most difficult class I have taken. I would not recommend. He often came off as thinking he was smarter and better than his students. He often made me feel like I was stupid when I asked questions.

He replies to messages very fast and is very sweet, he is always sending out messages of encouragement. His exams are pretty hard, though. He releases study guides and even if I do the entire thing (10-14 pages), it doesn't help much on the exam. This is the only time I've had a C in a class in my entire life, because exams are 71% of the grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Cahill is great. His legal psych class consists of a few lectures every chapter, with a 10 question quiz each week, 5 discussion posts, and 4 tests. He gives a study guide that helps a lot for the tests and as long as you watch the lectures and read the chapters, you'll do great. He's super helpful and cares a lot about his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Cahill is a great professor. I struggled the first few weeks, but also did not try hard enough. Watch his lectures, they are important for tests, and really help with the material. Quizzes are 5 minutes for 10 questions but it is possible to pass them!! 4 proctored exams, no resources. They are tough, so just make sure you study!

Dr. Cahill is by far the nicest professor I have ever had! He definitely does not just hand out A's; you have to read the textbook, watch the lectures, and study to do well. Despite that though, he WANTS you to succeed. He sent out individual messages to students if you significantly improved your exam grades congratulating you for it! Amazing prof

Dr. Cahill is super nice & intelligent but I did not like how the online class was structured. The lectures are so long and sometimes he will ramble about things that aren't relevant to the chapter content. The quizzes you only have 5 minutes on for 10 questions and some of them are oddly specific. Don't take this class if you don't have to.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Amazing prof. Very passionate about the legal system and his lectures were great. Clicker questions in class, 4 exams and a group project. The exams got easier throughout the semester imo, they arent too difficult but def need to study. He teaches to the book so its a useful study tool. Dont slack on the group project. Cool guy 10/10

Dr. Cahill does a really good job at teaching the material and makes it interactive so you are not bored. This class is tough however, so don't expect an easy A because you need to watch the lectures, read the book, make flashcards, and DO HIS STUDY GUIDES! But all in all, a really interesting class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Cahill is one of the best professors I've ever had. I also had him for EXP3604 last spring and his exams in both classes are tough, so you really need to know the material as well as how to apply it to real-life situations in order to do well, but his lectures are awesome and he is very clear about what you need to know. 10/10 would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He is an incredible professor. He helps you out a lot throughout the semester. He is tough, but his tough teaching methods help you learn more. I learned a huge amount of information from him, and he definitely earned my respect as a professor. I am grateful that I had him this semester.

He made his class more difficult than it needed to be. The way he grades your exams is unfair and extremely tough. One exam I had all of the correct information written down, but didn't use words he would so I failed it. Didn't pass one exam and I went to every class and studied my butt off. The group paper is graded by the TA, no communication.

I struggled in this class at first, but after I went to office hours and he gave me tips for how to approach the class, I excelled. Although he can come across as rude, he truly cares for his students and wants them to succeed. Attend class, follow his study guides, communicate with him, work hard on your group project. It's difficult but doable.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The class overall was nicely structured. Beware! You HAVE TO go to class. The idea of one group paper was much more relieving than the other teachers' solo essays. The problem I had with him was his attitude. He is very blunt and sometimes crass towards his students, which doesn't make very many students want to go see him after class. :(
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Took his sensory psychology class to fulfill my psychology outside concentration and the class itself wasn't that bad--long and extremely scientific lectures, easy quizzes, simple discussions--but the exams? Hands down some of the most difficult exams I've ever taken. I would've had an A+ had it not been for those four nightmare exams.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Took online legal psychology over the summer, taking cognitive in the fall. Very reasonable professor, tests are appropriately structured.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Amazing. I love him. he is so passionate & makes you feel like you matter as a person. He offers help outside of class, and despite all of the extra credit opportunities I still MAY NOT pass the class. Hardest class of my life, no doubt. Incredibly difficult tests. As a person, Dr. Cahill rocks and I look forward to another easier class with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Super easy class with clear grading. Easy A. Sometimes lectures can be boring but interesting material.

Dr. C is so awesome! Ive taken 2 classes with him and done well in each. Super nice, funny, knowledgeable, and encouraging of students. Hes very direct and can be blunt, but I appreciate how upfront about everything he is. His class is well structured/straightforward and he is a fair grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Prof. Cahill is an amazing professor who is super passionate about Legal Psychology. I have learned a lot from his class and furthermore he really cares about his students. I definitely recommend taking Legal Psychology with him because it's a super easy and enjoyable class! Make sure to read the textbook before exams and watch the lectures.

Dr. Cahill is great. My class was hard but I learned a lot. Yes, you have to study but you should be grateful to come out of his class having learned something and being a better writer. He gives good feedback and can be tough with his grading but it's always been fair, plus there's always an opportunity for improvement. Also, he's pretty funny!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Great professor, amazing class. Honestly, its a lot of work and it can be dull at times but Dr. Cahill was funny and made it entertaining. If research is not your passion, then you dont have to worry about getting and amazing grade in this class, but if you want to be a better writer, this professor will take the time to give you feedback always.

Dr. Cahill was one of the most amazing and inspirational professors Ive had at UF. Hes dedicated and knows how to challenge his students. This class was difficult but it was worth it. I would recommend this professor if youre serious and out learning and want a mentor for grad school. He is also a very interesting and caring person. Take him!

The most caring and inspirational professor I have ever had. He is so passionate and it is contagious. If you like law and order then you will love this class! Always makes time for you outside of class and cares about each and every student.

He is very difficult but he makes sure you learn in this class. He cares for every student and will do whatever he can to help you learn. He held reviews for us outside of class and stayed for hours to make sure we knew the material. I have never known a professor who cares so much. Thanks Cahill!

This is a completely honest review: If you want a professor that is unhelpful, rude, inconsiderate, and who seems like he wants that reputation, then take this class. He also makes really bad jokes. This class is harder than it needs to be and he seems to like that.

An amazing professor! He pushed me harder than any other professor I have taken but he is always there to help and explains topics clearly. His greatest ability is explaining tough concepts in terms you can understand. On top of that he is very nice, caring, and hilarious! Definitely take him if you want to learn!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Cahill is one of the most accessible professors at UF. Sometimes his explanations are unclear and he seems to talk in circles, but he puts a lot of effort into utilizing real world examples for concepts. This class is not difficult, especially if you read the textbook ahead of time- his lectures follow it closely. There's a ton of extra credit
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Cog Psych was a very interesting class. However, Dr. Cahill grades the exams and papers to the point where you are lucky to get a B on them. Lectures are very long and a good majority of the exam content is stuff you have to listen for and decipher for yourself. I studied the powerpoints and study guides and still got a low grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Cahill is an awesome professor and a man of integrity. His class was impossible, though. I never did well on the tests even though I KNEW the study guide back and fourth, and his TAs grade so strictly that it is hard to do well. Spend time in office hours and try to get as much help and feedback as possible. Pay attention to grading rubrics.

Quizzes are to point and cover what was just learned, study the powerpoints for exams, and go to office hours for the Psych. Consumer Assignment (If you fail this assignment, you will not pass the class!) He gives lots of extra credit, but he will not curve your grade. Overall, very caring and kind, he will go the extra-mile for you in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Go to every lecture, and you're sure to get at least a B, depending on how much effort you put in.  Don't buy the textbook -- 99% of exam questions come from powerpoints (he uploads to Canvas). Exams are half MC, half short response. Hilarious, knowledgeable, easy-going, makes self available. 10/10 recommend. Fav prof. at UF (had him twice)!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great class that opened me up to a new area of psychology. Really knowledgeable, fun lectures, and interesting class. Easy A!

I am so happy my friend told me to take Dr. Cahill. I have never had to work so hard for a class but it was very rewarding. If you need help he was always available. Responds to emails instantly. Really funny lectures too! I have already started using my knowledge gained from Dr. Cahill in my lab that I am an RA in. Take him if you want to learn!!!

This was the most difficult psychology class I've ever taken. He is nice outside of class and seems to care for you, but really doesn't do much to help you. Grading criteria is very unclear and the class was very disorganized (him and TA's would say different things). You only did well if you were lucky and good at assuming what he wanted.

Great professor and person. Always willing to meet you outside of class and work with you through difficulties you may have. Tough class but if you listen well and make you understand the material before the exams you will be fine.

I usually don't like online classes so avoid if possible but he was amazing!! The best class I have taken in my college career. I left each Mariel wanting to change our legal system. He is so passionate and it's contagious. Really funny during lectures and loved watching making a murderer. Take this class!

Really makes you work for your grade but is very understanding and guides you along the way. Continuously enthusiastic about his field of work and always has a spiffy jacket on. Definitely recommend taking his class if you have a passion for psychology!

He is the most caring professor I've ever had. He is definitely a tough love kind of guy but he will bend over backwards to help you. Has little patience for slackers though. Love you professor Cahill!!

I've never had a professor care so much for their students. He really wants you to do well and will do whatever he needs to help you. Very good at explaining concepts. Test are really hard but nothing he doesn't cover. Love him and the class!

Professor Cahill is  nice and makes lectures enjoyable. He gives great examples that help you remember the concepts, and his exams are straightforward with only a few trick questions. Don't read the book before lectures though, since you will realize that quite literally everything he says and the demonstrations he does are copied directly from it.

Dr. Cahill wants you to succeed, but he's not really going to hand out A's like candy. He can come of as callous, but I think that he's just more into tough love than into coddling his students. He's willing to work with you and is very easy to approach, will make an effort to help people who are failing if it's a big problem.

I enjoyed having professor Cahill as my professor for social psych. Tests are straightforward as long as you read the book and attend lectures. Pop quizzes aren't too bad but it's hard to do well if you don't prepare. There is one essay assignment which isn't too bad but he graded it pretty harshly. Overall the class was fair.

Professor Cahill really cared about his students and the course material. He includes lots of examples and past experiments. He is always willing to meet with you outside of class, which you should do with the one paper he assigns. Exams are very easy if you study. There are 4 pop quizzes throughout the semester that are easy  if you pay attention.

I loved Dr. Cahill! His lectures were entertaining and very informative. PowerPoints cover virtually everything on his exams, and he uploads them to Canvas. There is only one assignment, and it is a bit difficult, but he is readily available if you need help. I did not buy the textbook, but I did just fine with his lectures and exam reviews.

Entertaining lectures but difficult tests and quizzes. Quizzes in class pop quizzes with no makeups which also cover material not yet covered in class which makes them difficult. 1 short essay that is graded quite hard. Exams not too bad as long as you read the textbook and relate that with the lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: His ability to break down complex material so you can understand it  is unparalleled. Not only is he brilliant but he also genuinely cares about his students and is just absolutely hilarious.

Amazing professor. His lectures are interesting and you can tell he cares for his students. He presents controversial material in an objective manner based on the scientific literature. He had mandatory participation and four fair exams to make up the grades. I would highly recommend him.
Really good professor he seems a bit cold at first but he really cares about his students!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Best professor at UF! Clicker is used to poll every day so you get a point for each lecture you attend. He often gives extra credit probably because your grade relies on test grades and one writing assignment. Only thing i didn't like was the pop quizzes as i generally did bad. But great lecturer and overall great man!
Best professor I've had at UF! His lectures are amazing and he really cares about his students. Really engaging, funny, and he is really smart.

Really awesome professor! Would definitely take again if I could. He made attendance mandatory with clicker q's but gave 5 passes to miss class and still get an A. His tests are based off his lectures but the book helps (only 4, and puts up study guide for each), he gives a few 5 question pop quizzes, and only gave one other actual assignment.

He cared about attendance this semester because he was new to UF but we had clicker questions that helped us on the exams that were our participation points. He is a funny teacher who wants to make the class as easy for students as possible and cares about the material that he's teaching. I would recommend taking any class he teaches.

He is a great professor.  I went to his office hours and emailed him with questions and we goes above and beyond to help you understand.  You should study hard for his exams and read the book.  I enjoyed the class and he really wants you to succeed if you put in the effort.  Attendance is a must and he posts lectures which are very helpful.

Dr. Cahill is awesome! He is the one of the only professors I've had that really cares about his students and wants them to do well. The tests are challenging, but as long as you pay attention in class and review the slides you should be good to go. His lectures are really fun and interesting! He makes the material relatable and easy to understand!

Algorithms Abstractions and Design (COP4533) is probably the hardest course I have taken at UF for my CS degree. However, the class is very fair, and I think despite probably not getting an A in the class, it was one of the most valuable classes I have taken at this school. Don't be discouraged by the 1 stars and just study; you will be fine.

The teacher was very tough. We weren't allowed to talk to each other for help or anything, and the lack of cooperation that was usually present in other classes screwed me over here. I couldn't get an A, unfortunate class to take.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The class material is lowkey hard but her lectures are clear as day. Watch them and hard assignments become easy. START EARLYYYYY. Because these assignments can't be done well in 2 days. You're given two weeks for a reason. Also you can tell she really cares about her students
I like how Dr. Boucher structures her classes. I found the semester-long project a great way to learn more about algorithms research and build the skills needed to give a graduate-level presentation.

Dr. Boucher's class rewards effort with valuable learning. Online recorded lectures and engaging activities support success, but shortcuts don't work—as proven by classmates who used ChatGPT and failed because they missed key instructions given in class. Attend lectures, watch videos, read the textbook, and you'll do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Boucher emphasizes consistent practice, ensuring we master the content and improve our proof-writing and problem-solving skills. This class would be complex with any professor, but she makes it really easy to understand. For any topic we struggled with, she provided additional practice problems until we felt confident in our skills.

I took Dr. Boucher for 5405 and it was a great class. I loved the design of the course with in person problem sessions and lectures at home.  This gave us plenty of in class time to work through problems and clear up misconceptions. Dr. Boucher was very knowledgeable and engaging.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The course was pretty hard because I am not good in math but it was worthwhile in the end because i learned a lot.  The TA was really helpful too.

Christina Boucher made the class feel hostile. Instead of encouraging learning, she shuts students down and penalizes teamwork. She rarely acknowledges correct answers and has a cold, dismissive attitude that makes it hard to succeed.

Christina Boucher treats students with blatant disrespect. She mocks, belittles, and penalizes those who work together. Instead of guiding us, she only highlights mistakes. Her lack of professionalism shows in every interaction.
Dr. Boucher is super helpful and really knows her stuff! Her lectures are clear, and she actually makes the material interesting. Definitely take her if you get the chance!

I really enjoyed her class. She didn't assume prior experience with proofs and took the time to explain everything clearly. The practice problems and exams were very helpful in preparing for the actual assignments.

this class helped me with my job interviews because I finally understood dynamic programming.  It is tougher than the other classes in CS but I got a lot out of it. hardly anyone shows up so a lot of people did sucky because of it.  if you show up she tells you what is going to be on the test.
Class was pretty easy.  There is a practice exam before the exam which is super close to the exam.  You just have to do the practice exam.

Algorithms class without programming removes all the fun out of computer science
Avoid taking her class at all cost.
She was the only prof that recognized how hard COVID and online was to us students. The hybrid format was great and really organized. The assignments were pretty easy if you followed along.

I took a bioinformatics class with her, which is actually what she works in and the lectures were always interesting and the work itself was not that difficult but of course demanded your time and focus. She was always ready to help out and gave good tips and information about the assignments and she knows her stuff.

Class was straightforward. One midterm, one final and one presentation. The final was straight out of the slides. There are a lot of non-CS majors in the class that struggled because they didn't know algorithms/math is part of CS. As a CS major I can say algorithms couldn't have been made easier.
This class was super easy. One midterm done in groups and one final exam. If you do you work you will easily get an A. She was helpful in office hours.
Only read PPT in class written by other professors. No curve. Do not like her class.
Class is hard. Professor was good

I have taken a graduate level Bioinformatics course from professor Boucher when I was a student in Colorado. I would highly recommend taking this course from her since she is both knowledgeable and passionate about bioinformatics and has the same passion teaching it to seasoned bioinformatics students and newbies interested in the subject alike.

Professor Boucher gives interesting lectures. Attendance is not mandatory and all lecture videos are available online. No homework during the whole course. Grade is based on one informal presentation, one group project and one final. For the final, all questions are directly related to the slides and the group project.

I took a graduate introduction to bioinformatics course from Dr. Boucher and while I had 0 experience with bioinformatics before the course, I walked away with a good understanding of basic topics. She definitely cared about her students and took extra time to make sure that I understood the material and helped other students who were struggling.

Bioinformatics was a great course. There were only three paired projects and no exams. Dr. Boucher was really accommodating to our pace and would make sure we were following. She's clearly passionate about bioinformatics and an amazing resource. She was always really open to talking to me. Im doing a bioinformatics summer program thanks to her.

Boucher did a good job adjusting to a new university and subject to teach Discrete Structures, and by the end of the semester made sure that the class finished in a way that was best for her students.
She reads off the slides in class so there's no point in lecture. For this class you really just gotta memorize all the slides right before the test.

I found Boucher to be an OK professor. You will need to study a lot to understand this material. People complain that they were graded unfairly in her class but if you understood the material then you should receive an A. These concepts are fundamental to Computer Science and it will be very difficult to find a job without understanding them.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is an awesome professor with a passion to share her knowledge with students. Yes her tests can be hard but that was exactly what pushed me to study harder. Indeed I learned so much from her and isn't that the point of education? She may seem harsh but I loved her teaching style. Great teacher recommended for anyone who actually wants to learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Her class was NOT impossible whatsoever. She covers material in the textbook during lecture. Read the textbook!! It is so helpful, she has one to supplement the course for a reason. No she is not evil, and many of the test questions were right from the slides. If you are actually passionate about computer science, this class is rewarding!

The class is extremely major specific (CS) and right now is killing me, the first exam was not the same format as any of the remaining exams. 3/4 exams were free response on specific slide in her powerpoints, which are verbatim from the textbook and read from in lectures that offer no additional information. Read the book and practice all problems
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Incredibly difficult, hard grading scale given only 4 tests and a final (with one test, not the final, being dropped).
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Professor Boucher's course is in dire need of a more engaging approach. The lecture slides are pretty much read verbatim while she blankly stares at the class asking questions from the slides. All of this combines with the fact that exams are your only grade, with the final being 40% of it. With no guidance or suggested material to boot!

Class ends tomorrow and my average is a 52%. But it might be an 81%. I don't know. She doesn't either. What is this class. The tests are so hard that it's impossible to differentiate students who studied from those who didn't. Everyone fails anyway. Also we made a funny, unrelated movie that boosted my grade by 10 points. Dunno how/why that works.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: One of the exams covered 4 chapters - a total of 184 slides from the PowerPoints. Two of these chapters discussed matrices and how they apply to sets and graphs. The homework contained many problems about matrices. On the test, not a single problem about matrices. Yet, we were tested on a theorem that was only discussed on 1 slide with no examples.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Prof Boucher is vague with her answers to student questions (if not downright snarky), gives misleading hints about what will be on the exams, brushes over material that is on the exams, and is genuinely the least caring teacher I have ever had. I'm normally a straight-A student but I am aiming for a B- in this class. 0/10, would not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She just reads off the slides. She had her TA teach the class more than 8 times throughout the semester because she was absent. Tests are very difficult as they are all free response and no specifics are given on what they will be about.

Contrary to most, I believe she has the potential to be a good lecturer. Seeing as it was her first semester teaching the course, the format was rough and it was a hard class to prepare for. If she was consistent with test format and provided practice tests/problems, it wouldn't be such a bad class. If nothing changes though, just study the slides.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Even though the class is super interesting for math nerds, she just butchered it. She basically reads from the slides and that is it. Honestly, she does not seem to be prepared to give lectures at all. Exams are not the worst. However, you should review her slides.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Just the worst teacher ever

She doesn't seem prepared for lectures at all and makes up confusing explanations on the spot. She also complained that there were too many people in the class so she made the entire grade based on 4 tests, which were largely unrelated to what we supposedly learned in lectures.

One of the worst teachers Ive ever had the misfortune of having. Reads slides like an audiobook. Tests cover two or more chapters every two weeks. Lets us assume that everything will be on the test when half isnt. Cant trust what she says is important to know. Furthermore, shes unaccommodating to students and doesnt try to pretend to care.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: RUN!! I picked this course because I thought the course material was going to be interesting enough to warrant the hard work I was warned about. NO! Class is not interesting, and coursework is very extensive. Don't do what I did and ignore the reviews.

I'm currently taking this class and it's being treated more as a writing class than a Quest class. Both the professor and TA are hard graders, every assignment I've submitted has had numerous comments on it, and I've very rarely gotten a 100% on anything. It's taken way too seriously for what it is. Just take a different class.

Exams were easy and open note. The lectures weren't really interesting. The writing assignments were quite doable. Just make sure to start on the last 3000-word final paper a week before it's due. The discussions were fun and you didn't have to prepare a lot for them.

I took this without the WR, so I can't speak on that. The lectures were engaging and she knows what she's talking about - I came to respect her a lot. The tests are ridiculously easy, and I barely remember the homework, so insignificant. The TA section was also a lot of fun, but my TA was a hilarious grad student who barely cared, so that helped.

Fun and SUPER EASY course. I spent minimal time on this course and easily got an A. Exams are open note, but very specific to the lectures. Watch lectures (super short) and take notes on a computer. There is 2 kinda big projects that have clear instructions and don't take too long. She offers EC zoom sessions where you can ask questions.

ant2301 (human sexuality and culture) was such an interesting class. only 2 exams (including final) both online & open note. lectures were very interesting. easily my favorite class of the semester. would absolutely recommend to fulfill university/word count requirements.

Wasn't a fan of the content, but that's personal preference. Pretty simple course, but she was surprisingly a harsher grader than I expected for the methodology assignments. I recommend it for those trying to fill elective credits.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Super easy and fun course. She has 3 Zoom meetings for a grade, where she tells you how to do an assignment. It's a fun little field-trip kind of write up. You just have to watch animals and follow the outline. She uses Perusall, but it's honestly pretty easy. Would definitely take any of her courses.

Dr. Bogart is super sweet and a great lecturer. Her class is heavily based on sex-education and there are only 2 big writing assignments that are not hard at all. I highly recommend this class if you are looking for words.

I'd definitely recommend Primate Behavior! The class is easy as long pay attention to lecture. Only annoying part could be getting to the Zoo if you don't have a ride, I'd arrange one ASAP. If you're interested in primatology def ask her abt it, she's like the primate encyclopedia + of the few anthro. profs who reply quickly to emails lol
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Super chill class on primates, all exams are open note and not proctored. extremely easy A highly recommend. I barely put any effort into this class at all definitely recommend.

Super sweet and kind, not a lot of work at all. Mainly just one big research paper which is hard when your topic isn't great (can't have duplicate topics so be sure to choose an easy one EARLY) TAs grade everything for the most part. Easier A, not much work. Took with Orgo 2 and was able to get an A! All exams are open note and no honor lock :)

Dr. Bogart is one of my favorite professors ever! Her lectures are super interesting and actually very funny . Even though sexuality is a really taboo and sometimes uncomfortable topic, she really makes the environment relaxed/judge-free. I cannot recommend this class enough! Not much HW other than papers if you are in the writing section.
These lecture got me to go to class at 9 am so that is saying something. The class was very easy but also very engaging. Not much homework but a few papers, but certainly worth the 6000 words.

Quest class: Sexual Controversies 
Extremely tough for no reason & TA (caitlin field)is a ridiculous grader. I finished with an A but the TA took points off for every assignment. Treated like an English class with points taken off for grammar and it is not even for words. I would suggest another Quest 2 class or this one if there is a different TA.

This class was beyond easy and I put very little effort into getting an A. Lectures are important for taking exam. My TA was a bit of a harsh grader compared to everyone else's (Tony), but he always made our TA hours entertaining and enjoyable. In regards to the large paper you have to write, it's like everyone else says: annoying but doable.

ANTH3555 ACTUALLY! Bogart is AMAZING and clearly loves her passion! She is very chill & provides realistic expectations towards assignments. Her online platform required little daily work but being attentive to due dates is extremely crucial to your grade. Her schedule is very lax & works around the full-time working lifestyle. Would recommend!

Prof Bogart is a great lecturer and the TAs for the class are always very open and available! The final paper research paper is irritating but doable. All exams are open note and discussion session attendance is mandatory but extremely fun with the right TA.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class is fun. Bogart is okay. It's annoying that she got upset that no one was showing up to zooms when she waited until the first week of class to move lectures online. There's an irritating discussion post each week that takes under an hour. The research paper is painful. Lots of extra credit opportunities though and exams are open note.

Great class that gives credit for lots of things. Take the writing section for sure, it's more work but not too bad for 6000 words. Final paper is really the only annoying paper. Prof. Bogart is passionate about this class and is very informational in her lectures, which most people don't take advantage of. Lots of extra credit as well.

Great professor and very caring. I took the class over the summer where the paper was much shorter and the class didn't have the word requirement. Recorded lectures were entertaining. The only downside is the fact that you have to submit some work through the online textbook so you actually have to buy it.

Dr. Bogart is a great teacher. She makes this class really interesting. The writing class is a little more work heavy because its writing but overall a really enjoyable class that Id take again. Staying on top of assignments is key. The TAs are great as well. I would recommend this class and teacher to everyone.

An overall solid choice for a social & behavioral sciences class and professor. Sweet, easy grader, and consciously works at being more inclusive. I thought the class human sexuality and culture was going to be a study of how sexuality is viewed across cultures, but its just sex ed. Still an interesting class and wont take up too much time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Interesting topics assignments are not difficult and overall a great class

Stephanie is a great Professor for this course and makes the class easy to pass with a high grade. However, the only reason I docked a couple of points from my review was because she did not provide a study guide for exams. Also some exam questions were oddly designed like asking a statistic from 2010, or something unrelated to ANT 2301.

I love Dr. Bogart. Lots of extra credit, 2-5 lectures and a 3-5 question quiz for each. A non-formal essay that I wrote in 2 hours and got full credit for. She makes anthropology super interesting, if you like sociology, you'll like her class. Be sure to actually listen to the lectures, though.

The class is weekly video lectures, lecture quizzes and exams. The exams are longer and not super easy but they are open book so with the lecture transcripts youll be good. Lectures are a little time consuming each week but not horrible. I didnt do the section with words though.

Prof. Bogart is really sweet. I took her online Human Sexuality and Culture course and it was a really interesting class, so I wasn't too mad about reading chapters or watching her lectures. There's a discussion each week and a couple chapter and lecture quizzes, two exams and one project. But overall super easy and interesting class.

Dr. Bogart is literally one of my favorite professors that I've ever taken- she really helped through the transition to online and made the material both fun and accessible, even for those who didn't have any background in primate studies. I literally signed up for another class just cause she's teaching it.

This is Dr. Bogart's first time teaching the summer online section, but her class is amazing! It was still manageable for Summer A; just a few lectures a week, the exams are open note, and there is one informal paper. You have to really try to not get an A. She also quickly responds to emails.

Shes nice but I did not watch lectures or read the book (skim the transcript and you'll be fine). Discussion sections were pointless and you are mainly graded on two papers that are pretty long. If you do the survey for the final paper it will basically write itself. Super easy class, if you don't need words then skip the writing section.

Lectures are interesting and she is passionate about it. Material isn't difficult and there are weekly online quizzes and readings based on the textbook. I really did not like my TA but other than that it was fine. If you're in the writing section, there was not guidance on the final/only paper (2,000 words) so if you don't need words, don't take.
Enthusiastic about her material. If you try youll get an a

Definitely take the non-writing section of this class, it's so easy. Grades came from weekly online quizzes and an online midterm and final, all of which were open note. For non-writing sections there is just a group project in addition. Lectures are optional but most of the midterm/final material comes from them, so go if you can.

I took the non writing portion of this class so it was easier but this would still be an easy class to get your writing credit out of the way. The class is very informational and interesting. There is also soo much extra credit given in this class. Lectures are not mandatory.

Dr. Bogart is amazing and my favorite professor ever. I would take her over and over again. For this class, the grades mostly come from weekly quizzes, writing assignments, and the exams. The grades depend on the TA, but mostly everyone has a good grade as far as I know. Exams were online and open-note, so it's so easy to get an A/B.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Bogart is one of my favorite professors at UF thus far. You can tell that she truly cares! Attendance is not mandatory, but she gives extra credit if you go. The exams are also a little tricky, but if you do your readings and take notes in lectures, there's no reason why you wouldn't get an A/B.

This is a great course to take for words, its super easy to get an A in this class. Attendance for the lectures is not mandatory but she adds 3% extra credit to your final grade if you answer the clicker questions at the lecture. Both the midterm and the final are on canvas and not proctored.

Took Dr. Bogart for Human Sex, which I always heard was an "Easy A". I would still say this class is an easy A, if you go to class for the clicker/notes, work on your paper in advance, at least skim the weekly discussion readings, and open up all the lectures on your computer during the midterm and final (bc they're on canvas). Great for 4k words
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Bogart is a super chill, funny lady. She is super passionate about what she teaches so her lectures are worth it to go to. Clicker points for extra credit. Weekly journal is super easy. Weekly quiz is literally impossible to not get a 100 on. The 8-10 pg research paper is honestly not bad since it is spread over the semester. Totally recommend

It's pretty hard to get consistently good grades on the tests. You can study everything think you know the material like the back of your hand, but the tests are just so vague and nothing like the practice tests so you will most get a C or low B. SO MUCH reading and lectures suck so choose which to endure. Smoking Notes help. Overall very tedious.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I don't understand how the exams are made because you can do all the practice exams and watch every lecture and still have roughly 25 percent of the exam questions being stuff that was never mentioned. At A- right now and I'm hoping I can get lucky enough on the final exam to get an A with the help of extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Exams are not like the practice exams or homework at all. Seems intentionally difficult. I've gotten high A's in every class and dedicated myself to studying after reading these reviews, I did all of her practice exams, read the textbook and even used smokin notes. I got A's on all practice exams, but got a low C on the exam.

She obviously does not care about the class. I will not think of what "management theories" I will be using when leading a team. The exams are abysmal because they're all multiple choice so there's no justifying your answers when about 30-50% of the questions leave you having to guess which answer is right. Good luck soldier
honestly just doing this review to give her a one, the other reviews are perfectly accurate.

If you have any other options, please use them. She grades her exams heavy with tricky questions with multiple right answers but only one of them counts, you have to pick the "most" right answer. Exam questions barely make any sense. Think twice before enrolling
I did not watch any of her lectures and did not read the textbook. I only used Smokin notes and got an A in the class with the help of extra credit. Just get Smokin notes and you will be fine.

The textbook will be your best friend for this class; her lectures are just confusing and not the best. The practice tests do not emulate the actual tests. Test questions do not make sense and are hard for no reason. Just read and memorize the terms/charts in the textbook, and you will be good. I did not use Smokin Notes.

Very easy class. However, the professor demonstrates a subpar lecturing ability and treats students with a lack of interest. This professor does not seek to resolve issues with understanding, only what's more convenient for themself.

Print out the syllabus and have it with you at all times. If you do not follow her syllabus, you will completely fail. If you are late for an exam, she'll take away two entire letter grades. Make sure to complete all of the extra credit! I emailed her, and she never replied.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This is a flashcard class. Nothing you 'learn' in this class is really all that practical if you're just an ordinary business major. Just write down the terms and definitions, review them, and you'll be fine. I personally did Smokin' Notes because it was easier but wouldn't say its necessary. She offers practice exam (1 per exam) and extra credit.

For the poor souls that have to suffer through this class. I feel your pain. I learned nothing in this class. The exams are awful. Smokin' Notes saved me some time, and the lectures are not worth sitting through in this class. I'm not sure if there is a right way to teach management in college, but this is surely the wrong way.

I'm surprised this class has such low ratings compared to MAR3023. The class is much more manageable and reasonable when it came to the workload. Exams are also better and not as ambiguous in my opinion. It also is much easier to earn a higher grade in given the point system and extra credit. If you struggled in this class, good luck with MAR3023.

I did not watch a single lecture and somehow pulled out an A in this class. The exams are super content heavy, so the only way to do well on them is to memorize every single piece of material from the book. This class is a lot like marketing except with a less useful professor.

I think this professor is very knowledgeable about the topic, but her lectures do not encompass all the material needed to succeed on exams. Make sure to read the textbook, to learn some of the smaller details and definitions not reviewed in lectures. Smokin' Notes was a lifesaver when it came to studying for the exams!

actually awful. i stopped watching lectures and just took notes on the textbook. exams are the entire grade and I understood the material but the exam questions were just soooo weird. like the questions didn't make sense on purpose. she's nice but she just yapped all of class and wasn't helpful.

The professor knows the info and articulates it well, the actual examined content is ridiculous. I did hybrid and completed all homework, all extra credit, and used office hours. Got a 90%-100% on all homework. However, the practice exams and reading the textbook solidified my knowledge just to be bombarded by poorly worded exams. Good luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She's not a great professor, schedules HW on the same day of tests and is not super easy to talk to. Unfortunately, this is the only professor we have for this class.

Honestly this class shouldn't even have a teacher... all you have to do is read the textbook and study the terms in the textbook. Archambeau provided NO value to this class at all. Everything is done by Mcgraw, I genuinely feel like the professor quit literally did nothing besides use the AI assignments and exams that Mcgraw creates. Have fun :))
lectures are useless, exams have nothing to do with the practice exams or what she talks about, and she is extremely rude. joke that this is required for credit, she needs to be fired.

Awful professor. No matter how well I know the content for the exam each question has multiple answers that can be correct. The practice exams are 100 times easier than the real exams so you never really know what you're going to get no matter how much you practice. Used smokin notes and still couldn't manage an A.

This class is all AI Slop. Literally just McGraw Hill quizzes and "role plays". You dont even need to hear her voice for an A. Pathetic this is even considered a 3000 level course, so take it in stride because zero effort is put in by her, so zero effort is needed from you.

Professor Archamebau's exams are horrible, she offers practice exams that are way easier and topic based than the actual exam which has horribly worded questions meant to trick you and choose the wrong answer. Because everything is "choose the best answer" she makes the answer choices extremely vague for the question so there isn't a clear answer.

Awful experience! I'm in UF Online and this professor forces four exams at fixed times with only one hour each, no flexibility. I missed an exam they allowed no retakes. I'm in Europe and had to take them at 2 AM. I know the material well but the setup is unfair and inconsiderate. The worst class and professor I've had at UF. Worst professor ever!
Worst teacher ever! The four exams are only open for ONE HOUR on only one day. I cannot take the exams now because I missed the ONE HOUR TIME SLOT!!!!!
mid overall. she hatess kale

I took this summer A so it was super fast but the exam questions were not well written. I used smokin notes and did everything I could, but couldn't manage to average an A on them. No matter if I knew the content inside and out, it always felt like the questions had multiple correct answers.

Took this w/ 3 other classes in Summer A and no smoking notes and still survived. Don't bother watching the lectures, just read the book and look at her exam review lecture to see what content outside the book is tested. It is a memorization class to put it bluntly. Do all the extra credit opportunities!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Truly didn't learn anything meaningful. Dr. Archambeau's lectures were thorough, but I think I would've received the same level of info reading out of the book. Tough grader who doesn't provide much direction on assignments. If you need an elective that's straightforward, it's not a horrible option, but don't go out of your way to take it.
Read the textbook, do the extra credit, and watch lectures at 2x speed. I Used Smokin' Notes mainly for practice questions. Interesting content, but the class is straight memorization.
Exams have a few random questions from out of nowhere- tiny details that were never covered.

Hey, you—yeah, you, reading this—I am so sorry that you will have to take Archambeau. You have no choice. If you did, she would not be employed. Here's my advice: her lectures are worthless, do not depend on Smokin' Notes, and READ. THE. TEXTBOOK. If you do ANYTHING, study the textbook. I PROMISE. Do the extra credit too. Godspeed, soldier.

reviews.comment: I wish she wasnt the only professor for this course,
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She's okay, her in-class activities are fun. All the content is very straightforward but her exams are nothing like the practice exams/textbook. Her questions are written poorly and u must goto office hours to see any questions missed (even though this is literally an online class). Didn't need Smokin notes but I was scared for my grade for a while
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Awful professor and the exams are very hard.  DO NOT TAKE !

Don't take this class lightly. Principles of Management doesn't initially sound like a difficult class and the material makes it seem that way, but her question-writing makes exams way harder than expected. Her practice exams do not mirror the actual exams, I'd recommend smoking notes to get access to more questions. Avoid if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr Archambeau is an OK professor. She is funny but her exams are terribly written and insanely ambiguous. Definitely get Smokin Notes as they will help. Read the book, Smokin Notes, and 2x her lectures and you can get an A.

The professor was very nice, but many of the exam questions are very vague with no appeals process, which was very frustrating. The homework questions are not comparable to the exam questions at all. There are 4 exams on 4 chapter each, with the material being much more condensed later in the year. The class was basically all memorization.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Management is an easy class, Archambeau is not a good prof. Lectures are absolutely a waste of time as she rambles on and hardly knows what she's talking about. Doable class, read the textbook, take notes, study on your own terms. 20 points of extra credit (2% grade inc). Practice exams do not correlate to real exam and the real exams are ambiguous
The absolute worst. Homework all easy vocab stuff and then exams long word problems with multiple correct answers.

Her lectures are pretty poor, and she yaps about pretty much nothing the whole time. It is basically a learn yourself course. Her exams are poorly written, and most of the questions make zero sense. It is lowk nothing like the practice test she gives you. I mean thus class is fine, because she doesn't grade anything its just homework and exams.

This is not the way to teach management, I wish the class was more interactive and there should be a project element involved. Instead, it is just an exam dominated class that requires you to memorize hundreds of vocabulary words and apply them to poorly written questions.

Overall, class was easy and content was easy to understand. However, Professor Archambeau was a terrible professor as she didn't take a personal matter of mine that was very serious into consideration. She doesn't care what is going on in your personal life at all, even for health emergencies. One of the most non-sympathetic professors ever.

i liked attending the in person lectures but her content is very vast and a lot of memorizing. i don't recommend cramming and def get smokin notes. her test questions are weird sometimes so read rly carefully
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: While the course material is easy to comprehend, her exams are often choose best fit. I would fully recommend reading the textbook as it is what most prepares you for the exams.

I found the lectures useless and shallow. If you study based on lectures you will not pass the class because the exams rely on the textbook (there is 1 concept in exam 3 that the lectures cover, but the book doesn't & she just shows a table). She expects you to know 150+ definitions from the book when she herself messes them up during lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This class is a joke. Mainly common sense on homeworks. Exam questions can be tricky but it's not difficult to do well on them.

This course was not the best. Her lectures are useless and are not worth the watch at all. Exams are very difficult with most questions being subjective with multiple correct answers. Purchase smokin notes as it will help you.
I was better using SmokinNotes for the class. Even then, her tests were ambigious and the homework assignments were nothing in comparison.

I don't think I have ever come out of a class and thought that I GENUINELY learned nothing. Lectures taught absolutely nothing, textbook is not a helpful way to learn management. Cool topic ruined by a terrible class structure. Exams are probably the worse ive ever taken in all of UF. Written terribly, completely useless class don't take if you can

She is scatterbrained which hinders her ability to lecture. Her quizzes are pure busywork and do not help out with the exams. Her exams are ambiguous and there can be multiple correct answers. You are better off not watching her lectures and purchasing Smokin Notes

Wasted opportunity to introduce students to the field of management. Turns dynamic subject matter into stale, uninspired regurgitation of textbook terms and definitions. Multiple choice exams are a terrible method of evaluation for this material. This entire course should be restructured. I genuinely feel that I have gained nothing from this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I loved her lectures! She is funny and uses video clips from popular shows to explain different points. Lots of reading, but if you watch the lectures, read the chapters, and do all the assignments, you can easily get an A. She also offers 20 points of extra credit, so do that too! It's a great buffer if you're on the edge of a letter grade!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Her tests are bs unless u get lucky with the random assigned questions. She screwed up my 4.0.

I took this class because I had to for my major. The text is McGraw Hill so be prepared for hours upon hours of worthless and mind numbing readings. The exams are extremely tricky for no reason at all. All these management theories are useless in real life. The professor clearly just regurgitates the textbook that was provided to her. Run.

Dr. Archambeau is knowledgeable in the material and has clear grading criteria, which makes the course expectations straightforward. However, her response time to emails is quite slow, which can be challenging when taking the class online. While the class has strong content, much of the experience felt independent and lacked her active involvement.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Archambeau was an entertaining professor and plays movie clips to help the students understand the lesson. The class is mainly graded by exams and smokin notes was useful for extrta help with studying!

Professor Archambeau is a very passionate and caring teacher. Her lectures are important to watch because she gives a lot of great examples and videos to help students understand content. Her exams are mostly application of concepts and she only provides one practice exam, so Smokin Notes is super beneficial for extra practice and examples!

Professor Archambeau is charismatic; it made watching her lectures fun. I'd recommend watching the class lectures and taking good notes as well as getting smokin notes and reading and take notes on the packets while watching her exam review videos to understand what to study. Doing both of these things made me always feel prepared for exams.

she wants you to fail. exams are meant to confuse you. she writes her own exams but doesn't know what complete sentences are. management course that is supposed to teach how to manage for success, well the teacher manages for student failure.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Worst teacher I had in my 4 years with the University, get her out of here! Especially considering she teaches a class that is a prerequisite for so many others, for her to be as rude and non caring as she is, is beyond me
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hilarious is the only way to describe wording for her tests. All questions are multiple choice, with the correct answer sharing 4/5 words of the sentence with another answer. Test is designed for the student to get tired looking for detail and do poorly. Closes homework assignments so you cant check what you did good and what you didnt. hilarious.

Thought this class would be a lot worse based on reviews. Class is test based so Smokin Notes is recommended. She doesn't play much of a role besides emails. Connect assignments are super easy and dont take long.

The class content can be manageable if you stay engaged, but the exams are tricky due to the wording. I found Smokin Notes and unstuck study helpful for study prep. Attendance is mandatory, so stay consistent. Overall, it's a course you can get through with diligence.
The exam questions were super specific things from the textbook. Smokin notes was useful to an extent but the exams were unpredictable. Would not recommend taking during the summer term.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Overall, the class isn't the worst if you do your readings, watch lectures, and do practice questions. I recommend Smokin Notes for this class, explanations on SN are easier to understand. I never went in person, but I liked how she applied real-world examples to our content. Exams seemed sort of difficult because of the wording she may use.

Professor is useless, TA's are more useless, exam's are worded in a way where you're meant to get it wrong. I spent a week studying for the last exam and I ended up with a C- on it somehow and a B overall when I am an A+ student. No matter how much studying I did it didn't matter bc the exam had questions phrased so bizarrely. I hate this professor

Lectures just summarize the chapters. Do yourself a favor and just read the book to limit any confusion you might experience watching the lectures. Tough grader on the discussion boards and group papers, use a lot of key concepts. Using just one won't be enough and will dock you points.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Basically all lecutres were summaries of the textbook, so I just stopped watching them and felt better about the exams, she also rambles on about random things during lectures. Material isn't difficult but exam questions are 'choose best fit' so you might be right but will get it wrong if it isn't the best answer.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures were not helpful and the assignments and quizzes were nothing like the exams. She gives a practice exam but the questions are wordy, confusing, and repetitive. Use smokin notes and read the textbook, do not know why this class even has a professor as everything is through connect, she only is concerned about peope cheating, not learning.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: All she does is basically repeat the textbook. Her lectures are completely useless and the material is not helpful at all. She gives you a 0 if you arrive more than 15 min late on a test. She basically accuses half the class of cheating and is very strict overall.

Quiz and exam questions mostly have multiple answers and questions are unclear. Exams are on Canvas, while the rest of assignments are on Connect. Professor isn't clear on that and doesn't post it on the calendar, so it was an easy zero on the first exam. Prof is extremely strict and hard grader. Connect assignments are easy except for quizzes.

This class is overly stressful for no reason, with the exams having some questions with multiple right answers. What should be a fun, hands-on learning experience in the world of management is bogged down by nonstop proctored quizzes/exams and a copious amount of textbook reading. Archambeau will give a 0 if you show up to an exam 1 second late.

A class that should not be hard turned incredibly difficult by horrible exam questions that are almost all subjective. It's wild to me that professors can get paid well for literally just using Connect which we have to pay for in addition to tuition. The most dull class it had me questioning my major at times. Just get Smokin Notes and do the EC.

Material in the class was useless. The exams were subjective, poorly worded and did not make sense. The proctored chapter quizzes weren't much better. I didn't have any problems with the professor specifically, but this was the worse class I've had in years. Moderate effort and still got A. It is worth getting smokin notes

Crazy how a professor can get paid 130k + and just use connect. Her office hours and test times are super weird and she gives you a 0 on test if you are late by 10 min. Very hard to get ahold of. She needs to be removed from business school and can tell she is over educated with no experience in real world. These kind of people do not need to teach

Sucks that they make you take this professor for business majors. Exam questions are basically opinions, and every question is arguable. The definition of someone who is over-educated and didn't do anything with her life.
Easy A

Awful experience, got an A in the class but she sent me to the dean accusing me of cheating. I was never once notified, nor did I cheat. They ruled in her favor, so I am currently retaking the class. Awful at answering emails & very inconsiderate to personal issues. Will give u a 0 if you're late to the test and enjoys accusing students of cheating

continuation part 3: This is not only very irresponsible but inconsiderate to anyone slow to troubleshoot computer problems, or those with any genuine excuse. With all of these in mind, I believe Archambeau should be removed from the business college and is no longer fit to be a professor.

continuation post: Furthermore, before the second exam, she released an announcement regarding honorlock troubleshooting because of many recent problems surrounding the exam proctoring service. Not only did none of the troubleshooting tips work, but she said even if honorlock was not working correctly, a late entrance to an exam would be a zero.

Professor Archambeau has interesting, yet almost useless lectures. Along with this, her exams contain questions that are worded horribly and are often misleading. This counterintuitive aspect makes a class that is not very difficult in material very frustrating.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Hilarious email following the first exam each semester where she accuses half the class of cheating. It appears to be identical to the previous semesters emails, I almost think it is scheduled yearly. Exams differ from the assignments as the questions are her own from long long time ago. Many nuances to the questions. Find a good quizlet to study.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
One of the worst professors UF has to offer.  Doesn't teach anything really, kinda just repeats the text book. 
 Her entire job is done better by the smokin notes packets for the class.  Extremely unfair to her students as well.  Accused more than half of class of cheating last year

Not particularly the best professor is known for accusing a ridiculous amount of the class for cheating. Entering her exams late is an automatic 0 regardless of the reason. Class is easy but very uninteresting and the professor does not make it particularly interesting either.
Terrible professor, also accused 1/3 of the class for cheating...

Class does not encourage learning whatsoever. The answers to each test and quiz are hidden so you are left guessing what you got wrong and unable to appeal. Professor also does not proofread which leads to incorrect answers and unnecessary information on quizzes (which are created by McGraw-Hill). Overall, a very frustrating class and professor.

Many negative reviews are heavily overstated. This class is like a glorified high school psychology course with some business. If you give minimal effort can easily pass this class. She gives credit back for her exam mistakes. Smokin' notes is not necessary for this class. Homework is the easiest homework you will have for any class at UF.

She def was not my favorite professor. The class was not the hardest, I took about 3 days to study for each exam and I never invested in Smoken Notes. You can earn 30 pts EC, which you'll need.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: Hated this class. She does not teach well and makes the tests tricky on purpose. Does have extra credit but it barely makes a difference. If you can avoid taking this class, do.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Easy class for anyone who pays attention. Some oddly worded test questions, but once you understand her style it is easy to understand what answers are correct. I personally enjoyed her conversational lecture style. Highly recommend!

A great subject with a a lot of interesting material. Too bad it is taught by this teacher. Her lectures are horrible, she says "right" at the end of every sentence and what makes it worse is they don't help on the tests, which are supposed to be "application questions", but the questions are so out in left field that it is frustrating.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: Her class is easy, you do not need smokin notes and her exams are fair. a lot of information, but i loved this course. just stay up to date with lectures and the practice exams.

Not sure how she gets so many negative reviews. This class is EASY EASY EASY. Grab the Smokin Notes, do the practice tests, and watch the test review lectures... that's it. Easiest class I've had so far in the business school.

This class is not a difficult class. However, lecture does not cover the amount of things that are tested for. At least 70% of grade is based on 3 big tests, the remainder is divided between easy open book assignments, and case application assignments. Case application assignment questions are very ambiguous and confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Archambeau is great. I have no clue how she gets such bad ratings on here. The tests are easy if you watch the lectures and you read the chapters or Smokin Notes. This has to be the easiest A there is in the Business School.

I actually enjoy the subject matter, which is a shame because these tests & assignments are very confusing. I agree, it's like she's setting you up to fail. Do not take this professor. She takes an interesting class and ruins it with trick questions . I've never received below an A in a class and I currently have a C.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Just took her Exam 1. Like other's before me her exam's are worded TERRIBLY. It feels like she wants you to fail. Choose another professor, her lectures are boring and cover nothing that is on the exam. Use smokin notes if you want a decent grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class covers 16 chapters. Do the extra credit learn smarts and EC Discussions. There are 4 group projects. Suggest doing them early in case your group members don't have great participation. Take good notes and use power points as well as textbook for 3 exams. Lot's of real world application questions. Clear expectations. Great class.

This class was very demanding, so it was really hard to balance with my other 3 classes. The material itself wasn't hard, and I got good grades on all the assignments, but the tests were hard in my opinion!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: The material is interesting and she seems like a nice enough professor but her exams are ridiculous. Her lectures don't cover the questions in the exam, it's just her talking about movies and food. Your grade is heavily weighted toward your exams and the exams are basically 60 trick questions. Smokin Notes is critical to get a decent grade.

I took this class as an engineering elective, and it frustrated me. Lectures were boring, she poorly communicated the group assignment format, and there was lots of ambiguity in the exams. The material isnt hard, but it seems like the useful material from the entire class could be condensed to the front and back of a sheet of paper. Not good.

Exams are not horrible, buys smoking notes a week before the test and read them once a day. Group projects are easy if your group is good. Homeworks are also easy. I never read the textbook. Never watched the lectures either. If you study enough for the exam you will do fine, extra credit can help if you don't do well on those though.

People are just mad they actually have to study for a college course. Her lectures are great, she explains everything well and includes tons of examples. Assignments are easy and she gives extra credit opportunities. smokin notes are not necessary if you watch the lecture. Exams are hard but if you actually study you'll do fine.

Class is straightforward and I think the professor gets a bad rap in some of these posts. Content is laid out in the syllabus. There are 4 group projects and 3 tests. The class is divided up into 3 segments and there are 5 chapters in each segment. If you reread the chapters 1-2x and watch the exam review then you'll be fine. Lecture not mand.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: Hated this class, the assignments were easy as pie. The exams were HARD. Hardly anyone managed to get over a C. I went from being an A student to having a D after the first exam. Never recovered even though I got A's on every assignment and did all the extra credit. Prof never replies to questions. Exams were BRUTAL and determined your grade.

Really nice lady that is extremely knowledgable on the information. Tests are difficult but study the smokin notes and you will get at least a C. Do well on assignments/extra credit and you will be fine. Overall, not very difficult but stay on top of it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: class isn't too bad if u study a lot before exams. don't watch lectures just study smokin notes hard. group assignments are annoying (3-5 page papers, three of them) but doable. she allows 30 points of extra credit so make sure to do as much as you can bc it makes a huge difference. not a bad class overall just know the material well for exams.

such a hilarious women that makes me enjoy attending the optional lectures! lots of extra credit is available. Tests are somehow super tricky so be very familiar with the concepts from the exam review. Smoking notes are a must

It does not matter if you read the whole book or watch all of her lectures, you will do badly on the exams because they are very, very poorly worded and are extremely confusing. Do the EC, group assignments and the other assignments are easy 100s, but do not expect to do well if you don't use something like Smokin'Notes.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: extra credit bumped me from a 91.5 to a 94.6 it will be your savior. tests aren't that hard, i only watched her exam review lectures and used smokin notes and got two As and a B on the exams

Lectures are long but not too boring...I've had much worse! I only watched the lectures right before the exams while I studied, with the exam review next to me and that worked well. Lots of extra credit which is great. Group projects are a bit of a pain but not hard work at all, if you get a good group.

The professor is great and the movie examples help make a point during lecture. I love business and this is possibly the best class I have ever taken. If you plan to go into the business/corporate world, this course is absolutely crucial to your career. Exams are hard but as long as you study the chapters well, you will be fine.

Not too hard to do well in if you study before the tests, but all of the material is just so, so boring. Group projects tend to be easy points if you put the work in. Also, she loves to spoil movies for some reason, so that's no fun.

The exams are quite hard, but use Smokin'Notes! I didn't watch 1 lecture and managed to pass the class. However, I could have done better in the class if I had planned my studying better. Also, extra credit is a must, DO IT! do not let it pass!!! Group projects are a bit annoying.

Overall a useless class. Tests are tricky and there are a lot of typos, so your grade will suffer. Her lectures are useless. Do the extra credit as a grade buffer. I wish I didn't have to take this class--it's a waste

Lots of opportunity for extra credit. Tests can be worded pretty hard even if you know the info. Helpful professor who is good about answering any questions. Your grade is deff what you put into it/how much you study for tests. Group assignments that are annoying but you can pick your group. Graded on more things than usual in this type of class

I know a lot of people here in the reviews didn't really enjoy this class, but I honestly enjoyed it a lot. The lectures are all online, but I opted to go to the recordings instead, which, if possible, I highly recommend that you do. You can tell that Dr. Archambeau is really knowledgeable about the subject. All in all a good class though!

She is a good teacher, but be prepared to work because this class requires a lot of time. There are a handful of group projects that are a good chunk of your grade. The tests are ridiculously hard. I made a B on one and felt like I won the lottery. I ended up with a B+ in the class, but I definitely gave 100%! She's a great teacher and very fair.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: I used Smokin' Notes; the lectures didn't give a whole lot of new information. DEFINITELY do the extra credit!!
Good professor, long lectures but an achievable A or A-

This teacher, as well as her class, is a heaping pile of useless garbage. Students would be better off reading a few books on management than attempting to "learn" anything from the prepackaged load of crap in MAN3025. Sorry that this is a required course with a minimum of C for upstream courses. Just get through this and know none of it is useful.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: beware of group assignment. Final grade went from a 93% to a 88% becasue my team member decided to plagiarize.  Easy A overall.

Very nice and knowledgeable lady. Watch lectures online and read the chapters, read the key terms at the end, read practice questions, and do all the learnsmarts and do them over and over again.
