Don't think this class is easy.  It is a complex class with so many different words and topics to be learned in a short time.  Tests contain many chapters.

Pretty much useless to go to class and watch lectures. Get the smoking notes, it has everything from the lecture, a week before the exam. Cram, and you will pass exams. The exams are poorly worded, confusing for no reason, missing the meat of the material. Easy to get 100s on her side assignments and group assignments. Do EC.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: 3 tests are where the majority of your grade comes from, make sure to buy smokin notes and take the practice exam on CONNECT before the tests as those questions were very similar to what you see on the exam. also there is some EC available if you really want that A+ just make sure to do the game learning study one on gatormanagement, very easy

My rating is solely based on poorly worded exam questions, designed to trick and confuse students. This is a deplorable way of evaluating our knowledge.  I don't know if the professor wrote the exams (I doubt it), but she is certainly responsible for proofreading them. Students deserve better.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: One of the worst professors at UF. Tests are confusing and nothing like the practice tests.

I want to preface this by saying I do not like ambiguity. Ok, that being said, if you are wanting to get an 'A' in this course, that is largely contingent upon how well you do on the exams. In my opinion, her exams are riddled with ambiguity. This felt more like a psychology course than a Business course.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: One of the worst professors I've had and I'm only a month into her course. The exam questions are so confusing for no reason, not cohesive to the practice questions. And her lectures are horrible, impossible to follow. And her VOICE, it makes me want to throw my laptop across the room. Don't watch her lectures, they're useless. Just read the text

Class is easy, watched lectures only up until first exam then never watched a lecture again. If you purchase Smokin Notes and STUDY the notes, you will do fine on the tests. I ended up with an A- only .8% away from an A because of stupid mistakes along the way. Make sure you do well on all of the assignments, not hard to get 100 on everything.

Pretty chill teacher, just make sure you get the Smokin Notes or you wont pass. Also be aware that you really need to read her textbook on top of that. I tried very hard and ended up with a B, and if I tried harder probably would have gotten an A. Also do the extra credit!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: This class wasn't horrible but it also was not my favorite! The group projects were annoying to deal with but were easy assignments, and your grade is only based on a few quizzes, the group projects, and your tests. There are opportunities for extra credit. Def a smokin notes class!
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Pretty easy, I got an A. There were 3 exams, a group project, and a few other HW assignments. I used the smoking notes for the exams and used the learnsmart module questions to hammer home the concepts. Group assignments were a 3 page analysis of a business case study. Didn't watch the lectures. Felt like a psychology class geared to business.

Professor Archambeau tries very hard to be cool, as said in other comments. She cracks jokes that are not funny and her lectures are not helpful. The lectures are boring and she basically reads off of the slides. I highly recommend smokin notes for this class and doing the learn smarts and her practice exam!

This professor tries too hard to be cool and act tough, which is off-putting. The exams are comprehensive and require studying but otherwise not a difficult course. Just stay on top of your assignments and studies and you should earn an A or B.

I don't understand why Dr. A is rated so poorly on this site. She's very quick witted and intelligent. This class is definitely not an easy A, but it's interesting and contains valuable information for anyone looking to work and become a manager. Honest,y, if you do all the work she asks of you and don't slack off, you'll do perfectly fine.

Long lectures so I only watched the ones where I needed clarity on the reading material.  Her tests are tricky.  I really didn't do well on the tests, but did the learn smart modules and a couple of gator management studies for some extra credit and ended the semester with a high B.  Learned a lot from this class.  Thought she was a good prof!

The course is a bit disorganized with assignments all over the place, but if you stay on top of everything and turn in assessments and discussions when they are due, you will succeed.  Put forth the effort and tests will be easy.  I watched every lecture, read the text, kept on top of assignments, did the extra credit, and got an A in this class.

I wish her successful CEO sister taught this class. She is very unclear on so many course mechanics and she is all over the place. Would've gotten an A if I didn't forget about one of the online assessments (50+ points). Do the extra credit online studies, get Smokin' Notes a few days before exams, skip lectures entirely -- you'll be happy you did.
Those saying her tests were easy and they received an A, were we in the same class? I'm lucky if I made a C. Tests do not compare to the practice exams or quizzes.
This class wasn't "hard" per se, but definitely one of the most boring classes I've taken at UF.

If you do all of the assignments, get all 40 points of extra credit, and get the smokin notes for the exams, there is no reason you shouldn't be able to get an A. Even if you never watch a single lecture all semester.
The test questions are extremely poorly worded, with answers put in to trick you. The lectures are dry and uninteresting. Her voice alone makes me want to jump off Heavener.

I would take any class she is offering.  Her life experience as well as college experience gives you a crystal clear example of what to expect in the real world.  She is very welcoming and wants to see you succeed.  Its an easy class if you do the work and put in the time.

Worst professor and class ever. Meant to be easy and makes it difficult to get a decent grade. No structure to her class and is not clear on anything. Her discussions are useless. Mind as well not even watch lecture because 90% of the things on the exam were all textbook. Got an A in finance but struggling to get a A here.

Dr. Archambeau's lectures are really long but they're pretty helpful. Reading the textbook and doing the learnsmarts are very useful (I didn't use the smokin' notes because it was still a lot to read). The exams are very fair (just read). Overall, the class is very easy if you read and do the 40 points extra credit.

As this is an online course, the lectures are online. I didn't watch a single one as they're too long. Use Smokin' Note and you'll at least get a B. Be careful with assignments! They're not all listed in Canvas as she uses an online book for assessments. Extra credit is easy to get and will buffer a bad exam grade. Exams are on campus at night.

I am surprised with all of these bad reviews. To be successful in the class you should read the textbook and take detailed notes. Her lectures don't always include everything in the textbook, but you will definitely still be tested on it. A lot of the stuff is common sense. Her tests aren't always easy and there's always some confusing questions.

I need to write a post to defend professor A. Those people who complained so much probably did not do the required work (should watch lecture & read smokin notes) . 50% of the material was repetitive from marketing class and common sense, the rest is new material. You should pay attention to definitions. She tells you EXACTLY what's on the exam.

Yes, the tests are very tough but it seems to me she wants to make sure you learn the material.  She is very nice and there to help you via office hours, during class if you go, answering emails, TA's always available, and even offers 40 pts extra credit.   I am grateful she taught the class because I learned incredible amount of valuable info.

All the other reviews are right. Her tests are 10x harder than the practice exams. Questions are very tricky, especially on the final. I don't know where she even comes up with these questions. I had an A- in the class until I took that awful final exam and ended with a B, ruining my GPA. (
Tests were tough. Felt like they were far different from what was talked about in class or in the book. Definitely do any extra credit available. You'll need every point you can get.

Her lectures are a carbon copy of the information given to you in the textbook, making watching them a huge waste of time because the textbook gives you the information in a much more concise and easy to understand format. Her saving grace is the generous amount of extra credit she offers. Get the max amount of extra credit and you're golden.
very hard tests and the material showed in class is very ambiguous with the material tested on the exams. I will not recommended this class if you're doing online classes.

- Tests are extremely hard and do not follow the booklectures. Expect to be tricked. Her goal is to have an 80% median on tests, so at least half of the students receive a C or lower on the tests. - Lectures were hard to follow and incoherent. Expect to hear a lot of "um", "ah" and general breaks in her speech pattern.  Avoid if possible!

Not too hard of a class. The grade is made up of three tests and three online quizzes which you can take twice and keep your highest score. Need a 93% (930 out of 1000 points) for an A and there's  a chance to get up to 40 extra credit points.
Very unhelpful. Lectures were not coherent. Very unorganized. The MH connect portion of the class was confusing. Not a good professor.

Exams are very hard for no reason. Group assignments were a nightmare especially since the people in my group did not want to do the work.  The people in my group were hard to get in contact with and did not meet the deadlines.  There were 5 group assignments all with the same group of people.  It was a very stressful and horrible experience.

Many students don't like this class because it's not an easy A like it used to be with the old professors. In all honesty, though, the class challenges you to think like a manager. The class is book-heavy. Buy it and read it and you'll know the definitions. Prof. A is funny and kept me interested. People just don't like not having a free A.

Her exams are SO hard for no reason. Assignments are scattered all over the place. Very unorganized. Pretty much have to memorize everything for exams & definitions are all similar to each other which makes it so much harder. I hate this class with a passion. The exam questions are so tricky. I wish another prof. taught this course

Class is way harder than it needs to be. The class is not streamlined at all and isn't organized very well. There are materials due on two different websites which makes keeping track of them difficult.
She makes this course way more difficult than it needs to be, quizzes through mcgraw hill suck and lectures are just straight definitions that all overlap. Dont buy book, im glad i didnt

Very nice, funny and kept me interested but her tests were unnecessarily hard. It's pretty much straight memorization. To make matters worse, most terms you memorize have similar meanings which just made it tricky and annoying if you ask me.

This class was unnecessarily more difficult than it needed to be. The material is so straight forward, but her texts and quizzes were extremely ambiguous, and tricky.  I would have learned much more had she not worked so hard to trip us up.

Favorite art professor I've had at UF, pushes you and helps you develop your skills and creative thinking but also supports your individual ideas and passions. Super knowledgeable and always offers great suggestions and feedback and genuinely cares about students. Attendance and effort is super important!
the goat Take her quest course

The least I can say about this professor is that she was amazing. She genuinely cared about her students and their interests, wants to inspire students about art, and her course for Quest 1 (Art and the Global Citizen) was easy to follow and easy to do well in. Attendance is mandatory, but it's a great class to take if you're interested in art.
She was amazing. So lenient and understanding. All you have to do is try. Her class was so fun and interesting! Her work was easy yet good brain food because it made you think and create art.

alright, future warp student reading this. bethany was easily the best professor out of the three, and that's really saying something. she's nice, she gives good criticism, and she's more organized than the other two in my opinion. warp is a weed out so you can't expect to have a great time, but if you're in bethany's crit group, you'll be okay.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I feel as though this class seemed very disorderly and had a very hard time keeping up with the assignments. It felt as though assignments would come up out of the blue and there would be a new one everyday. The syllabus was not followed strictly which was bothersome. We often started assignments and simply forgot about then until they were due.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I took a graduate seminar with Bethany.  She is very knowledgeable and will provide an insightful critique of your artwork.  Students who are diligent and hard-working will have a valuable class experience. She keeps class interesting and introduces many relevant contemporary artists.

Get on her good side right away. She can be particularly critical in critiques (duh), more so than Sean, but if you do manage to get on her good side then her bias will tend towards a more lenient critique and better overall experience. The class requires a lot of time and effort to get a good grade, get ready.

When she's not being interrupted by Sean, Bethany has smart things to say. WARP is irrelevant to your art education, it's more of a Lets-get-rid-of-all-these-slackers class than an art class. Stand out, get her to notice you. If you don't do this, you will be ignored the entire semester. Black v-neck ftw.

Bethany is by far the best teacher i have ever had in my entire life.  I went through WARP twice (yes, twice) and was fortunate to have her both times.  She's there for you, and cares about each and every one of her students.  Warp is demanding so GO TO CLASS & finish that warpbook! Don't limit yourself! It was a great experience, both times!

Enthusiastic and engaging with a very strong motherly quality. She is easy to approach gives great feedback. Bethany is an ideal art professor, just get ready to work and care about the class. You'll get out whatever you put in.

She is very nice. Lectures are Half interesting b/c information you learn about modern art is odd & inspiring. Grades are based on tests (each require apx 100 pages of reading about modern artists) & essays. If you study hard you will definitely get a good grade so no worries! Also, they throw in ?'s about things mentioned in studio so watch out!
Favors art that is in her taste, but that's hard not to do. Pretty fair grader and very understanding of your art and how to resolve it.

Overall not to bad. The class is more demanding than the professors. Bethany is somewhat helpful, but leaves it openeded for you to make your own decisions, ideas, etc., which can be fustrating at times.
Really helpful, a little pushy at times though. Awesome advice and very knowledgable

Easy enough class, but not a super nice guy. He mistakenly tried to tell me I could not add his class during the drop/add period. Responds fast to emails, but not nicely. I get the feeling that he is interested in his research and teaching takes a backseat. Then again, students regularly showed up late to his lectures, so can't blame him.

Overall Dr/ Butler is a great professor and taught a great class. The course covered a wide range of materials but he was always ready to answer questions. I'll say the grading was a bit slow but, as I understand, no TAs were found for the course so it was understandable.Overall it was an engaging and interesting course with an expert in the field.

Extremely slow when it comes to grading. I submitted assignments back in late March that are still not graded, which has now caused me to receive an I* on my transcripts and not receive credit for the course. Communication with him is 50/50, sometimes he will respond within the hour and sometimes you'll never hear him. Class was manageable though.

His lectures are fun and engaging! He also prepares you well for the exam; there's extra credit as well as practice tests and study guides. The material itself is pretty difficult, but he does a pretty good job explaining everything.

Best bio professor I've had! lectures were easy to understand, specific examples, made heard topics easy to understand. He gave a 2 hour long review lecture, study guide to go along with each lecture, a practice exam, and extra credit for exam prep. He engages well in class, is passionate, approachable, would take this course with him again

material was dense and more loaded than i had expected however his slides are animated and labeled very clearly which helped explain harder concepts. he provided learning objectives for each lesson (super helpful to cut down textbook reading), learning catalytics during class helped point out key topics. overall a really sweet professor!

Great lecturer! Beware LOT of information on exam so more studying than you thought. I got 100 on his exam and made a 300 card quizlet with all definitions on all slides (might've been a little overboard but went well so decide how to take that)!! He's very engaging during lectures and always seems excited to teach!

He was a really engaging professor. Going to his lectures was really helpful and reviewing the learning catalytics and practice exam was beneficial for the exams. Smokin Notes was a great addition for extra review and practice problems to help me prepare.

Great lecturer! His exam covers more content than might expect so be prepared to study hard!! I got 100 on his exam and made a 300 card Quizlet with every term on the slides (might've went overboard but did well so take that as you will).

Bob was super interesting and enthusiastic. His lecture slides were easy to read and understand. Practice and use his practice exam when studying. The exam was a little tricky, in my opinion, but everything was found in the slides. You do not need Smokin Notes so save your money, I have it and didn't use it at all for his unit.
Honestly 10/10 makes difficult topics easy and is super caring and helpful

Great lecturer and has very intuitive slides that made learning genetics easier. Explains things in class very well and can tell he is passionate about teaching and biology. Has a fair exam but you still need to study on your own to do well.

Thought genetics which can be very complicated but he explained things in a way that is easy to understand but very fast, made things interesting and interacted with students for feedback, gave practice exam and gave plenty of detail explaining the answers for the key, very good

I had him as my lab TA and I was able to understand something that took me 10 lectures to understand with 30 minutes of his lectures. Loved how he made a lab fun and approachable. Recommend him to anybody!

Bob was great. His lectures were engaging and very detailed. You could easily do well on the exam by just looking at the powerpoints. I rarely had to read the textbook, unless I needed some clarification on a certain topic, but for the most part the lectures were enough. Bob is very funny and makes class interesting, I would his class again.

He's so friendly and down to earth, he likes to make sure the class is entertaining. Slides are fun to look at and easy to understand. Test is based on content, not learning catalytics, but if you put some effort in you will definitely pass. He can be seen playing pokemon go!

Bob is bar far one of the best professors I have ever had. His lectures for the lab were not only useful for his class but also for the main course. His lab was EXTREMELY organized and he was very fair about his quizzes and practicals. He's funny and kind and I really enjoyed being in his lab. I learned so much! I highly recommend him as a prof!

By far one of the best professors in the entire world. He is very knowledgeable, funny, and relatable. His exam was straight from his PowerPoints and fairly easy. He provided study guides which were super helpful. He actually explains the material rather than just reading off the slides. I will remember him forever.

I love Bob so much, it urks my soul knowing I will never have him as a professor again :( Bob is a caring, sweet, kind, omnipresent individual and I pray he becomes a permanent addition to the university's teaching staff. His exam was fair and extremely straight forward, as he said it would be. Follow is study guide and his pokemon go
Bob is the best! He makes his lectures so clear and interesting and he always tries to relate information to real world examples. His exam was very straight forward and straight from his PowerPoints.

This is my favorite biology professor thus far. His lectures were amazing, he was so enthusiastic. He is very straightforward with the practice exam and the real exam. There are no trick questions and he teaches you everything you need to know! TAKE HIM!!!! I miss him.
Clearly very smart and passionate, would be better in a smaller class environment but generally goated
Intelligent professor that clearly communicates expectations and presents information well. No reason you should be failing this class.

The class was very interesting and he gave a bunch of fun examples to better explain harder concepts. There were 2 exams (a midterm and final) that were both FRQs. Class was simple and can't see how anyone get less than an A.
Easy class, professor has interesting lectures
isnt it interesting how this guy thinks he can take HIS MISTAKES out on my grade?
Brucat's P-Chem class is no joke, but his lectures make it engaging. Utilize unstuck ai and practice exams to ace this course.

Dr. Brucat expects his students to use Python to do their homework in CHM4412 when we have never taken a coding class. His initial demonstration on using Python is mediocre but expects you to write complex codes afterward, especially for the HW. He doesn't care. Going to the TA for help is more helpful than having him explain the class material.

Dr. Brucat taught CHM4412 & he was an awful instructor. His lectures were hard to understand, & he all does  was read off his packet of wordy notes. His graphs & equations in the notes are unhelpful. If you ask for clarification, he makes you feel dumb. He expects you to know everything & teaches at the graduate level. AVOID at all cost! Run away!

Dr. Brucat is a funny guy, but his CHM4411L class is difficult. He expects you to know the intricacies of Python and grades assignments very harshly. He will write on students' reports things like "Poor conclusions supported by even worse data." The way he talks down to students can make them feel inferior and not eager to ask questions.

Dr. Brucat is extremely intelligent, very approachable, and a phenomenal lecturer. That being said, the lab that he runs is a complete mess. The TAs are consistently giving instructions and advice that differ from each other, the technology used in the lab is constantly faulty and/or not calibrated, and the overall content is painfully dry.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Worst professor. Teaches at grad school level and speaks to you as if you've taken the other classes that he's taught, which no one has because he's awful. Looking for useful feedback on lab assignments? You won't get it. However, you will get mocked and told your data is hilarious, when he's the one providing barely-working equipment.

Dr. Brucat is a freakishly smart guy. He's rarely (if ever) wrong, and he knows it. I struggled, but I feel like I've improved my analytical skills 100 fold. Be ready to work but you will get out of it what you put in.
Really awesome nice helpful teacher, but still definitely couldn't have done well in the class without study edge
He's a decent teacher if you have prior knowledge... I didn't know anything but still managed to get an A... and I still don't know anything about .chem
I think he's awesome! Had him for Chem 2 Honors. It was rather stressful during the semester, but in the end, turned out unexpectedly well. He's pretty funny too.. Not to mention that he's a genius!

I'm quite perplexed by all the total hate for the guy, he is the absolute best alternative at UF to get a chem credit, his class is honestly pretty easy because he curves everything to death, is he the greatest professor? No. But he is the much better alternative to Gen Chem which is almost a guaranteed B or lower,just make sure you can self-teach

AVOID HIM IF YOU CAN. Awful professor. He thinks that he teaching graduate students in his chem 1 class. He is the only prof for chem for engineers and he has no business teaching undergrad. If you ask a question during class he makes you feel like an idiot and embarrasses you, and you have to teach yourself online through a faulty program.

I'm currently in Chem 1 for engineers and the only thing I like about the class is the fact that an 80+ is an A. The lectures are worthless- I only go for the clicker questions. I struggled with the tests even though I understand the concepts perfectly-got a 5 on AP Chem and refresh by reading the textbook. I recommend not taking him.

Do not take a class with him if you can help it, especially Chem for Engineers!  Extremely hard to follow in lecture.  All he does is talk and rarely writes on the board to show how to do problems.  Also, you better just shut up in lecture and not ask any questions or he will bash you for it and be extremely rude.  He does not care if you fail.

He has no idea how to teach a gen chem course. The guy is insanely smart but has no idea how to explain anything on a level where students with no prior knowledge can understand. He tries to make you feel as stupid as possible if you ask a question in class. His tests are nothing like what he goes over and doesnt show you how to do any of the math.
He doesn't teach and then expects you to know all of these chemistry concepts. And then oh yea his tests are impossible to pass.

Brucat is very knowledgeable, but your success on this class depends more on the TAs. When they tell you to write everything in your journal, they're not kidding, you'll need it during the practical. The class is hard, but not as bad as 46L. Take time before the labs to learn the material, and you'll be find. Grading scale is really fair.
I love Dr. Brucat.  P-chem is hard, but he is a great teacher.  I would take him again every chance I got.

Dr. Brucat might be the smartest guy I've ever met. His lectures are entertaining even though they're somewhat fast-paced and hard to follow. It's ok, though, because you don't really need a clear understanding of the concepts as long as you can do the old/practice exams. You can get an A with these as your sole resource.

Miscellaneous Chemistry would have been a better name for this course. What you learn in one chapter is irrelevant in the next one. Dr. Brucat WILL teach you the concepts well, but his exams require plugging-n-chugging instead. I stopped going to class when I realized all we were being graded on was how well our formula sheets were made.
Dr. Brucat makes P Chem really interesting and relevant. We had a big class, but Brucat and the TAs always made themselves available to answer questions. Great class and professor.

Pretty good teacher. Pchem is the most difficult class I have ever taken, but with that said, Brucat makes it very passable. Lectures were all powerpoint and textbook was terrible; however, he reviewed the material before each exam and gave nearly identical practice tests. Very generous with extra credit was a big plus.

Tests are difficult for some, but he provides practice tests which are almost exactly the same as the exams.  He also allows you to use notes and your book on the exam.  Very easy to get an A in this course.  Brucat explains concepts well and is really funny.  Do the homework and online quizzes, study previous exams, and you'll do fine.

So Dr. Brucat is a decent instructor (especially when you consider the other options for P.Chem professors). He gives alot of E.C. on tests (although no real partial credit given), but they are challenging and sometimes arent reflected in difficulty by the practice ones. I didn't like that he acted like we were all engineers (ie were great at math)

Phil is a smart person, and I am sure he is a clever, innovative researcher. However, he is a profoundly bad instructor. He bulldozes through material via slides sans actually deriving material. His tests are more like IQ tests then Pchem tests, and more like general chemistry then pchem. I think he underestimates the difficulty of the material.

hhmi lab. he's a genius - crazy smart - but he gave his TA's too much control over the course and yes, he taught it like it was p-chem lab.  we didn't have a clue what was going on most of the time. took a lot of time for only 2 credit hours.  would be completely different w/ different TA's but brucat's great.  knows his stuff and wants to help.

CHM2054L - HHMI Undergraduate Core Lab. He teaches this class likes it's P-CHEM. Even uses audio from his p-chem lectures for us to listen prior to attending lab. When he talks you want to shoot yourself because the sentence never ends, and he uses such abstract words that really aren't necessary. Grading scale makes it IMPOSSIBLE not to get an A.
clicker points are a must (write down the qu's- they often pop up on exams). Exams aren't that bad. he's a bit impersonal, but its worth it to take chm 1 w/ him.

Experience was been great. He knows what he is talking about, his lectures tend to be very interesting and sometimes entertaining, except for some long derivations. If you visit him during office hours, he will help you. The tests were very  fair bordering on easy.  My only complaint was the textbook by Engel/Reid was horrible!Hope to take 4412 too

Dr. Brucat is a really great teacher, material is a little boring at times, but he tries to make it as painless as possible. Overall, just go to class and do his sample tests and your good for an A. Oh yea and go to office hours and he'll just explain what you dont understand so much better without making you work for it.

PJ Brucat is the most worthless teacher I have ever had.  He is the least helpful person I could imagine.  On test days, his dishelved self will NOT say a word... he types up stuff on the computer and makes the computer talk to the class.  AVOID AT ALL COSTS
Good teacher, lectures were often yawn-worthy,(and often not tooo important for the test) but still good.  Prepares you very well for the tests, and a pretty sweet grading scale.

Professor Brucat is an amazing teacher for P-Chem. His lectures can be a bit intense, but he prepares you for his tests. His grading policy is fair and his homeworks and quizezs are a great help for one's overall grade. Plus, if the class as a whole does well, the final is not cumulative.

I enjoyed his still of teaching. He explains things clearly and goes straight to the point. Tests are definetely manageable if you put some effort into studying his notes. Clicker questions really help and most of those questions show up on the test so make sure to go to class.
Excellent teacher, pretty funny as well.
Physical chemistry was hard, but Brucat explains the concepts fairly well and his tests are fair. Although he is a nerd, he's an awesome guy and if you can get him for CHM4411, you should.
Recommended for Quantum

Explained confusing material in lecture so well! Posts lecture notes online, w/ pictures and links. Clicker questions help for exams. Nice and funny, by far best demonstrations in class compared to other chm2045 profs. Wish I had had him for 2046.

Dr. Brucat is really great.  I went to get help a lot in office hours, and he was really good and stayed late. One time he helped me when I just randomly ran into him, and he didn't have office hours.  Go to class.  Clicker questions are helpful for test.  Lecture is interesting.  Stay on top of the reading and you will be set during lecture.

The class was very boring despite the occasional joke or explosion...which was cool. OWL and his clicker questions helped on tests. He also put up practice quizzes before each test that were helpful. His TAs sometimes went over the quizzes b4hand  It is very possible to get an A if u study hard. I got a B and i didnt even work to my full potential.

Brucat is an overall interesting guy. Honestly his lectures were confusing and not helpful in da least. I honestly got my A from reading the text, and feverishly copying his clicker question which are often replicated on exams. Therefore for that reason you should attend lectures .. so do what I said and you'll get a B+ da least.

PJ is the man.  His lectures can be a little confusing sometimes if you don't pay attention, but they are usually pretty good and he is a funny guy if you catch his jokes.  His clicker questions really help for the tests.  He blew stuff up in class several times, which was sweet.  The dude's brilliant!  Take his class, it's not bad at all.
he's boring

i love brucat! his lectures are interesting and he practically gives you the test questions through clicker questions. and anyone who complains about the final didn't listen to what he had been saying all year: the final questions were old test questions with different numbers. easy A if you don't get behind.

I thought he was nice at first, just really difficult to understand if you arent a genius when it comes to chem. When finals came around, he was such a condescending ass to my questions that it just showed me if you arent nice when someone asks questions, you arent a good professor.

He is a great teacher. His tests are easy. Make sure you keep up with your owl and dicussion quizzes b/c those things can hurt you but then again there is no reason not to get an A unless you are stoned 24/7

PJP is one of the most interesting professors I have had.  He is extremely helpful and knows what he is talking about.  His lectures are enttertaining and informative.  If you have to take chem I would recommend taking it with Brucat.

Took Brucat for gen chem and then for quantum mechanics as a senior.  I got A's in both classes, and I also have no idea how anyone could not have done so.  His classes are easy,  and he's very smart, funny, and made his lectures interesting.  Would recommend him regardless of the bad reviews by all of these morons.

if you dont get an A in this class, youre retarded. its one thing if you dont like the way he teaches, but how hard is it to copy the homework from the solutions manual and memorize how to solve the clicker questions that he puts on his exams? it doesnt matter if you dont learn anything in this class because its all irrelevant once youre in orgo.
Too Technical and unclear lecture style

It's true, he is very unclear and his lectures do not reflect the book material. However his test are EXACTLY like his clicker questions which he posts a week before the test. I dont know how some people can get a D. I got an A and I studied three days before every test. I never even read the chapters, it's useless. His last test was very hard.

worst teacher at UF...get out of this class if you can. he gives a lot of extra credit but he makes u stress out so bad during the year. very unclear. his tests do not reflect his lectures or the book.

My efforts to study were pointless. memorize, memorize, memorize. you learn nothing, and don't bother doing the hw, he ends up giving everyone the points anyway, which sucks because I actually wasted my time doing it...retook class w/ keaffaber, and got an A vs. my D with brucat. BRUCAT IS AWFULLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLL

this guy is horrible!!!! i have never hated a professor more in my life. He does not teach a thing u have to teach urself and read the book every single night..if ur into that kinda thing, i guess u can get an A.Its weird tho i ended up with a B+ with like all D's on my tests. Everyone says his tests r like the hitt questions,umm NO they are 10xs h

While Chemistry is usually pretty hard, this class wasn't too bad.  Brucat is a nice guy and the tests are identical to the remote control quetions and homework.  He does cool little demonstrations in class and is clear in his explanations.
this guy thinks its fun to teach 2045 and 2046 in a single semester... beware.

Tests are EXACTLY like the HITT questions, so the tests are not confusing, but you don't learn a single thing in this class, except memorizing how to do his HITT problems. Easy A, but you don't really learn much.

This guy practically throws points in your face.  His tests are exactly the same as his clicker/homework problems.  Anyone who didn't get an A in this class was a slacker and wouldn't get an A in anyone's class.  Take this professor.

amazing man, you are going to learn chemistry, and it is a hard subject.  but go to lecture, and read the book.  its very easy to get an A if you learn the material.  know his clicker questions for the tests, and you will do fine.  and know the concepts from the book, cause he tests those a lot, too
Horrible man. He lies and he is an ****. dont take him, get Amaral or Zienteck. In fact, anyone but him would be better.

It is very easy to get an A. He really loves Chemistry, but his lectures are dull. He has online homework and quizzes, which are EXTREMELY EASY to get full credit for and the tests are based on the clicker questions. Read the book. It helps. Don't be lazy and whine about your bad grade.
has absolutely no regard for his students and only cares about stroking his ego, he likes to be hard for the sake of being hard
He sucked ass, his questions often seemed impossible until u asked for help (then he make u feel like an idiot). Avoid at all costs.
He likes what he teaches he just has a hard time conveying them to the student.

Absolutely LOVED him! yes his lectures could be a little boring but you can see how much he loves the subject and he isn't one of those teachers that cares much about grading, so you have ample chances to get your grade up....his grading scale is great too!

I do not at all recomend taking this class. He rambles on and on and he doesn't explain anything clearly. I basically had to reteach everything to myself after each class. And don't even get me started on the tests.
Wow, I definitely had no idea what he was talking about during class. So much busy work, too!! And his tests are HARD!! Good luck with this one..try to get Amaral, she rocks!
Do not take his class! He rambles, his notes aren't helpful, and he is a sucky teacher. Try to get Amaral.
too much work, horribly boring lectures

He uses math a lot which is probably why people don't like him, but he's a good teacher and is willing to help. The semester I took him, we saw a lot of the test questions in class as quiz questions. If you show up and do the work, you can get a decent grade.
If run-on sentences with little or no meaning were strawberries, Brucat would make a lot of smoothies.
he sucked

A very difficult professor...you walk out of class not knowing what has just been discussed, although it is possible to do decent in his class because of his grading scale (anything about an 80 is an A). but if you want to learn find someone else.
One of the worst teachers you can have for a class as important as 2045. He covers too much material doesn't write notes and you come out knowing not much in a general sense.
this guy sucksssssssssssssssssssss.  please, spare you're self.
Test questions are HITT but when you see a zillion hard questions you don't know how to do it doesn't help you to learn Chem. Don't make the mistake I did look for another professor!!!

he sucks seriously so much.. i usually am very good and anal about my studies but i cant do well in his class because he doesnt teach.. ya his tests are the clicker questions but no one never knows how to do the damn things ... its a lot of time that is unneccessary in this class .. shoot for anothe
THIS GUY BLOWS, dont take him... he goes through almost twice as much material in than any other 2045 teacher. i suggest gettin' someone different.
Goes through material very fast and does not explain concepts well.
vague note giving.
His lectures were vague in regards to the work assigned and problems seen on the quizes/tests.

The weekly quizzes, clicker questions during class, and home CSBs are great.  They help your exam grades so much.  His exams come straight out of the clicker questions.  Sometimes he puts the same exact questions, if not he will just change a number or two.
His tests are just like the clicker questions.  It's easy to get an A because of the grading scale.  Try to get him for this class.  It'll make your life easier.
Decieving grading scale. The HITT questions are ridiculously hard. I recommend against him. Also, he looks real cool riding his bike around campus.

The class is hard but Brucat's grading scale makes up for it. His tests are a lot like his clicker questions *hint hint* I studied mostly those and got an A. He's funny and tries to make class interesting... as someone else said, he blows up things :-D
No Comments
Guy is a jerk.  Don't bother asking him questions, he'll just blow you off.  Smart man that tries to make everyone feel dumb.  Easy grading scale, tough class.  Pay attention to HITT questions.

He is a funny, cool professor. He wears the coolest shirts too. Anyways, with the help of my TA the weekly quizzes do get better and as long as you study those HITT clickers and understand how to do them, you should be good to go! Good grading scale!
Grading scale is really good; don't bother asking questions it will be a total waste of your time; tests are pretty easy, study HITT questions!
No Comments

I thought he was hard at first, but TAs help you with weekly quizzes. It may help to print some online notes and bring them to class.  He funny, keeps it interesting, and has an awesome grading scale.  I recommend him.  Hes great.Tests just like Hitt Ques

He is not a bad guy. In fact, he blew up stuff which was fun. However while other teachers (CHEM 1) did Ch. 1-9 we did 1-18 we finished the whole book = to chem1 and 2. so it was HARD but hey 2046 should be cake.
boring

Smart guy, good teacher, hard class.... good luck and take advantage of his sample tests.  All of his tests were exactly like his practice test except for the last one and everyone failed.  I got a 60% on the final and it was curved to an A.
No Comments
Good teacher - funny and engaging.

Dr. Butcher has been top 3 professors I have had at UF. The lab was awesome in the fact that there was lots of continuity where we took a DNA sample and conducted multiple experiments to create a transformed plasmid that was used to express the protein and measure function. Super accessible outside of class, willing to give honest feedback
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Would not recommend. Extremely uncaring and not receptive to life issues outside of the classroom. Grading is extremely confusing and messy. TA's grade so how much partial credit you get depends on the student who is grading your exam. Very slow, boring lectures. Often doesn't get through all material. Ignores emails. Not helpful.

Professor Butcher structures biochem in a very fair way. I would say that she doesn't lecture very well, however for a class as content heavy as biochem, most of the learning in this class is done through studying anyway. Adapting to this class was hard, but once you have a group to study with, it is very clear what you need to do to pass.
great prof, very clear and fair with grading. def one of the better profs for this course since she splits up the manuscript/report into two different halves. overall would take again
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Relatively slow going through lectures and quickly gets behind on material. Doing problem sets is important and practice exams are fairly similar to the real thing. Despite multiple efforts to reach out to her regarding difficulties in the class and taking the exams, she offered very little help which was a bit disheartening and disencouraging.

her lectures were a bit messy and confusing i preferred to skip lectures and read PowerPoint myself since the exams were based on them. A combination of powerpoint learning + doing/ learning the problem sets and the "additional practice" which is like a practice test she gives allowed me to get As on most exams, i just did bad on one which i drop.

Exams are directly from the problem sets and lectures. Extremely fair exams and great professor with objective and clear lectures. Very kind professor and would 1000% take her again. Great prof for this course.
Her quizzes were on very minute details and didn't facilitate learning the bigger picture.
Take Stewart
She really seemed like she could care less about this class.. I'd recommend taking it with ANYONE else.

The course was pretty interesting but some of the experiments didn't work well. Professor Butcher helped everyone during the labs to try to make things work and was available for help outside of class.
Very bad.

Professor Butcher knows the material very well and can answer any questions you might have. There are only three requirements for passing this class: Take notes on EVERY LECTURE, do every practice problem and practice test she gives you, memorize your notes from class. She tests only on stuff covered in lecture, and the TA's do not grade generously
Lectures are very clear.  She is really helpful in office hours and explains things in detail.

Made countless errors in class (errors in arrow pushing, double bond placement, and atom placement in molecules) which was detrimental to learning. Made comments like "I would give students candy to catch my mistakes in lecture." Extremely unprofessional and useless. Doesn't post lecture notes online unless asked and there are limited resources.
Tests come directly from lecture and practice problems posted. Dr. Butcher is an OKAY lecturer. Just go to class, do the practice problems and you'll be fine.

Just go to class. I studied her tests a day or two beforehand, and always got a B or higher on the tests. Tests directly on lecture. If you passed the orgos (assuming you did), you can pass this class unless you're thumbing your phone during every lecture. It is not a walk in the park or anything, but it could be worse.

Dr. Butcher teaches well and is easy. Her tests revolve around whatever she writes on the board; there are no surprises. She is helpful in office hours. Her only downfall is that she is extremely slow during lecture and does not finish what is proposed on the syllabus, which is unfortunate if you need the information for MCAT or another exam.

Definitely make sure you come to class because everything in the test will be from the notes. Also make sure to get the old tests and practice problems ASAP and start working on them because the tests are pretty similar. She posts the answers to the practice set 2 days before the test so you have to find a way to get them sooner. No need for text.

She focuses on memorization more than knowing/understanding concepts.  I didn't do well because I do better with concept focused courses. Did not give enough time for memorization, so ask at start of class what needs to be memorized for whole course, otherwise you only get a week at best. Doesn't explain in detail why things happen, they just do.

Great teacher. Very clear. Must attend every class and take her chalkboard notes because everything on tests come from here. Extremely hard tests. Memorize each and every detail of her notes and do her practice tests.

Great class, and very well taught. She's extremely knowledgeable about the field, makes major concepts easy to understand, and is very helpful during office hours. A lot of time is devoted to studying the literature and learning about key advances in the field. If you have a serious interest in chemical biology, this class is a must take.

Dave is very enthusiastic and knowledgeable, BUT the quizzes (4 x 100 points throughout the semester) are very difficult if you have little prior knowledge. They are on small details from the notes, and lots of what he says (so it's hard to skip lecutres). Lots of EC too (like growing plants)
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS! Overall, the professor was nice. There are only 4 quizzes, and they are very difficult and do not follow the lecture at all. I took it for fun, but ended up dropping it after 2 quizzes because they were so hard no matter how much I studied. He will put random information on there that he never said in the lectures.

DON'T TAKE THIS CLASS. The professor himself was very nice, but the quizzes are hard even if you pay attention and study. It's a 1-credit class that I took for fun, but I ended up dropping it after taking two quizzes because I was failing. There is so much information in the lectures, and if you don't write down every word he says...good luck.

While attendance isn't mandatory you should definitely go because the quizzes are from his presentations as well as the things that he says during class. If you don't do well on the quizzes there are lots of extra credit opportunities. He is very enthusiastic about plants and will give out a lot plants.

Very harsh grader not many assignments based on 4 difficult quizzes. Quizzes supposed to be based on the lectures but are not accurate, making studying impossible. Claimed effort mattered most but despite trying best studying, going to class, taking notes, that didn't matter in the end. Very upset, took this class for fun, but my GPA paid for it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I did better in orgo 2 and physics 2 then I did in this class. The average for this class was an 82 even after all the extra credit. The quizzes are way too hard for no reason, but he is a cool guy, and the class is interesting. Not an easy A class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I came into this class excited to learn, but the constant rushing in labs, the extremely difficult quizzes, and the lack of extra credit despite what the syllabus said made the class feel overwhelming and emotionally draining. Although the TAs were supportive, my experience with the instructor was so negative that I would not take this class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I love the man, great class. Lectures are fun. Quizzes are so much harder than they should be but study and you won't get a B like me. Lots of FUN extra credit opportunities and free plants. I recommend this class to anyone but heed my warning and study for the quizzes.

Such a passionate professor, it's admirable. His lectures were extremely informative but his tests are way too hard for a one credit class. I studied a lot and still got B's on exams. He gives a lot of extra credit and they were all easy, but I only got an A because of the extra credit. Free plants btw!

Loved the professor and his passion for the class, but the tests were incredibly hard even if you study a lot. The free plants were great, but the extra credit is NECESSARY to get a good grade in the class. I would take the class again if the exams weren't so bad. The exams were the most intricate details for a one-credit class.

Dr. Clark was amazing! He makes the class entertaining and loves to give away plants. The tests are a little hard but if you do the extra credit it will make up for it. Overall, a very enjoyable class. Definitely do all the extra credit!
A nice guy but the class is overrated in my opinion. The quizzes are unnecessarily hard and questions are all memorization instead of application. Extra credit will be your best friend.

Not at all an easy A, and the quizzes he gives are very hard and extremely random. Pros: you get free plants about every other class and there is no assignments (besides one and extra credit). Cons: quizes and final exam make up most of your grade and are very hard.
Professor Clark is very passionate about this course and his lectures are engaging. However, the quizzes and final are quite difficult. Definitely need to study to do well.

Dr Clark is very passionate about plants and gardening, and it shows in his lectures. The exams are very difficult and ask questions about tiny detail included in the lectures, so studying for them is recommended. The extra credit was really easy, so definitely do it, and you'll finish the class with an A.

Attendance is not mandatory but you better show up and write down every single word. His tests/quizzes contradict with his words and his powerpoints. But its okay cause the extra credit makes you have an A anyways. Really nice guy and funny but please write your exams better

The lectures are kind of cool and prof Clark is nice, but dear god the exams are pretty hard. They are not very googleable and feel like I am being tested on minutiae from class. I graduated with a 4.0 in CS/Stat double major, and I dropped this class because I will be damned if plants, gardening, and you broke my 4.0 gpa in my last semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Clark is amazing! His lectures were always interesting and I agree with him that the class has changed the way I view many random things lol. However, the quizzes and tests are extremely hard and have content that was not covered in class. Do all the extra credit offered if you want an A and take good notes
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor was great in lectures, he was very passionate about the subject. Every 2 weeks you can get free plants and there's extra credit. However, the exams are HARD, and there are only 4 assignments, 3 of them are quizzes/exams. Take good notes or know the material VERY well for the tests. He curved the exam this semester but don't expect it.

David Clark is a great professor and you can tell that he is very passionate about the topic he's teaching. The lectures were fun and interesting, and it was a great class to take with friends. However, the tests in this class are INCREDIBLY difficult, and the reason this class dropped instead of raised my GPA.

took plants, gardening, and you thinking it would be an easy A and it was not. The test and quiz questions are hard. I went to every lecture and I can confidently say that they don't adequately prepare you for the final or the quizzes. There is opportunity for extra credit and the final project is a breeze and free plants just be prepared to study

My favorite class this semester. He is enthusiastic and funny for in-class lectures, which are pretty interesting. I've never gardened before in my life and I plan on pursuing this hobby after this class. You have to take him once during your UF career. Quizzes are open note so it shouldn't be hard but they do test on very specific lecture info

The Coleus King taught this class so well, I'm honestly considering taking other plant classes because of him even though I wouldn't need them for my degree. His lectures are fun, point to good sources for research, and are applicable to anyone who likes gardening. I'll come to him about any plant concerns and I can def say-- he knows his stuff.

A great human who cares about what he's teaching and wants you to succeed in life. There's only one real assignment and it's pretty easy. The other grades are from quizzes which are difficult compared to the way he talks in class. Just pay attention in class and take open note quizzes to your advantage.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Loved this class! Wish I could take it again. You have to pay attention and take notes to pass the quizzes and final, but Dave is the best. He makes his class interesting and engaging. Didn't get the best final grade, but no complaints, I learned a lot and enjoyed my time there. Plus who doesn't love free plants :)

Class is easy, but he has 0 care we r all stuck in this online hole. power was out during the quiz. I emailed him before the quiz saying hey I dont have power... he made me send proof before he would open it for me. And yet he wouldnt give me above an 80 because I had extra time to study. No one even studies for this class anyway?????

It was online so I had notes, but material can be a lot to remember, just pay attention! 2-3 projects that took less than 30 mins, but no chance if you are late by just a minute - I missed one and got a 0, ending in a B+ despite almost perfect scores on all exams. If I hadn't would be easy A! Also free plants and seeds.

I really enjoyed this class, professor Clark is very knowledgeable and his lectures are SO interesting. Also you get free plants and seeds so you cant go wrong! I would recommend this class to everyone and if I could I would take professor Clark again.

so much work! getting free plants is cool but quizzes and exam is impossible!! in class he is like "plants are important because they are pretty" and then the quiz asks how many cells what kind of plant has, what week # they germinate, etc & I struggled and worked so hard for an A! I would take a different 1 credit class if I were you.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Super funny and nice. Free plants every class. Lectures are very interesting and made me consider switching my major. Exams are hard but lots of extra credit options. No textbook. Need to take notes in class to do well on exams(not much info on actual slides). 1/3 of grade comes from just showing up to class. Very easy final project and no hw.

attendance is like a third of the grade and there's a ton of extra credit available you get a plant every class! quizzes/final are actually hard and you do have to study/pay attention in class for them tbh what I'm going to do next semester is show up without actually taking the class; that way I get plants but I don't actually have to study
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Don't take the class. It's not worth it. You can believe the positive reviews if you want, but I'm telling you, the class is pretty hard to get an A in. The final is worth is so much and is ridiculously hard. Professor is very kind, and passionate!! But don't take it if you mind getting a B+. Take something else.

Most amazing professor Ive had in a while. Very caring, hilarious, great lectures & if you show up to class (which is mandatory for a grade) you get a free plant each week. If you have a lot of hard classes and need one extra credit definitely take this class, its the class I look forward to in my week. Wish he taught more classes.

At the beginning of the term, Prof. Clark told us this would be an easy class. Lectures are interesting, but the 3 quizzes and the final exam (60% of your grade) are not easy. No homework is a plus. Take good notes and find a friend who also takes good notes. The main thing to worry about here are the quizzes and exam, they are not easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He's a pretty good professor and free plants is awesome! It sucks that he does NOT post the lectures online especially since that is the only material you need to know for the really hard quizzes and final exam. Pretty difficult for a one credit class because of that :/ Only grades are attendance and quizzes and exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Don't be fooled... this is not an easy A. (Although 80% of class gets A, B+, or B) Quizzes and final exam are pretty challenging. Definitely do the extra credit. He's a great professor and super funny.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Who doesn't want a plant every time they go to class?!? Prof Clark is basically a comedian and is passionate about his work with plants. The notes are essential to passing his quizzes and final, but you can take pictures of the powerpoints. Just make sure to know the material for the quizzes and final, or you wont pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I took this class thinking I wouldn't gain that much from it, but I was wrong. His lectures are very engaging and will keep you interested, whether you like plants or not. This class is extremely easy, but you need to study for the quizzes They are pretty specific and may include things that he only covered in lecture. Do the extra credit. Easy A.

Great guy and loves plants. As long as you go to lecture (because its an attendance grade) its super easy. Exams/Quizzes can be a bit tricky, but the amount of extra credit available is enough to keep an A. Super awesome, and FREE PLANTS?! Yes.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This is an amazing class! I got a free plant every time I went to class, and I had so many plants I had to give them away to friends! You can tell Dr. Clark really enjoys teaching. Just be sure to study for the quizzes!! However, I got a 65 on every quiz and an 88 on the final and I still had an A in the class from all the extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Really cool guy he is teaching by choice because he wants to.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This class is all about plants, and you get to take a plant home every week which is fun. The quizzes are tough but fair, and he gives you many different opportunities to get extra credit. He is very nice and genuinely cares about getting to know you if you talk to him and will meet with you by appointment outside of class.

Gardening is definitely harder than you would think. He doesn't post lectures online, so show up and take notes. Study for the quizzes before the morning of or trust me you will regret it. Hilarious, interesting lectures; Dave is amazing.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Super cool class! You get a different plant every week, and you can pretty much just show up and take pictures of all his slides (he doesn't post them, which sucks). Quizzes can be a little tricky, but he gives a bunch of extra credit throughout the semester, and he's pretty friendly.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Dave is one of the best teachers I have ever had! He makes the class so interesting. I am considering changing my major to plant science after this class. Quizzes are difficult and you have to take notes and study. He also gives TONS of extra credit so you should make an A. You also get a free plant every class and he is just great!

I love the concept of this class. The plants that you get every week really cheer me up for the rest of the day and the stuff that is taught is actually super helpful for the inspired gardener! Only thing is DONT MISS A QUIZ. You will have to go to his office that is far away and it is just difficult in general to make it up.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Respected--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Clark is awesome. I really enjoyed this class. The material was very interesting. The lectures kept me engaged and covered important information that everyone should know.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I took this class for fun and I really enjoyed having professor Clark! He's a great lecturer and we get free plants every class period. Quizzes can be a bit difficult but as long as you study your notes and pay attention in class you should be fine. He offers  a lot of extra credit so be sure to attempt them, it really helps your overall grade.

I loved this class but if you don't go to lecture you won't pass. He doesn't post his powerpoints online and there isn't a textbook. You get a plant every week which I loved. Only three quizzes, an easy project, and then the final, but there's three chances for extra credit. Easy A to boost GPA, especially since it's only a one credit course.
Great 1 credit course to take as an escape from harder classes

Lectures aren't particularly interesting or entertaining. Quizzes are largely obscure random facts. Not easy at all for a 1 credit class , if you're thinking of taking it for an easy credit stay away.

I took this class because others have told me how amazing the professor is and how the class is interesting with work but not overwhelming. Well, unfortunately it wasn't like my expectations. While lectures seemed fun and not too difficult, quizzes were another story. They were ridiculously hard! And he doesn't put powerpoints online anymore.

I absolutely loved this class! Dr. Clark kept topics interesting and the class was engaged during the lectures. Work load was minimal, but you do have to study a bit for the quizzes. It's a very fun class overall that you actually can enjoy studying for!

Great professor, easy class! You get a plant every week and tons of extra credit. But you do have to study for the quizzes (only 3) and final. Overall, if you need a 1 credit class, this is definitely the one to take!
Nice guy, you get a free plant every class and there is a guest speaker. Study Slides for quizzes (3), no exams. TONS of easy/fun extra credit. But for the final you do need to study for it.

Fun and EASY class! I actually looked forward to going every week. Just watch out for the quizzes, you actually have to study a little. But he gives so much extra credit that it usually works out in the end. Great one credit class, free plants, but its not a "guaranteed" A. You actually have to do some studying, about 1 hour per quiz.

Really fun, REALLY EASY, one-credit class. Clark is hilarious and offers so much extra credit that you could probably bomb every quiz or exam and still get a C or something. Gives out free plants every class. I'd definitely recommend him. Take notes though! It's an easy class, but it's also easy to put it off since it's just 1 credit.

This is a reasonable interpretation of the class. It is is easy, but you have to put some kind of effort into it. It's college. You have to go to class its like 30% of your grade. The quizzes you have to review, they are not obvious. The class was interesting at best, boring at times. Overall, Clark is awesome. Free plants is awesome. Take it :-)

found the class to be boring and you dont learn much about planting or gardening. He tells you not to take notes becuase he'll put the powerpoints online, but never does so you're screwed and you get a B in retarded 1 credit gardening class and med/grad/law schools will think you're an idiot

Plants, Gardens, and You was the most fun class I've ever taken! The material is interesting, easy, and fun, and you get free plants every time you go to class. I always looked forward to this class and I wish I could take it again!

Plants, Gardens and You is fun and a very easy 1 credit class. Each lecture is a guest speaker and the TA gives out plants to anyone and their mother. Three quizzes that are semi difficult but you can bring a friend in to get 100 on one. Quizzes from lecture notes which you have to write (he will send out pp) A paper on why plants relate to you.
Loved this class! i recommend it to everyone it is awesome and so easy.

Great class to take. The professor is pretty funny and the material is easy to understand. You also get free plants! If you take it with a group of friends (which is what I did) it's even more fun. Definitely recommend it if you're looking for an easy, fun class to take.
Loved this class! Really easy, mostly attendance based, a few quizzes, one simple project, free plants at every lecture! Really loves his topic and wants you to have fun and enjoy the class.
This class is so much fun and Dr. Clark is awesome! You get a plant almost every class! Not hard or time consuming at all, so it's a fun one credit elective.

This Prof. is the best! Plants Gardens, and You was my favorite class this year!!! He's very cheerful, nice and interesting, and you get free plants just for answering questions to the lectures. No boring topics :)
This class is so fun!! And Dr. Clark is hilarious!
He is an awesome teacher and makes class very fun!

Very easy lab but still helpful. Just put in effort, do your best, and don't miss lab & you are guaranteed an A. Actual useful information taught that could help you understand the lecture. TA was amazing & would walk you through anything you didn't understand. The physics lab department is trying to undo the evils of the physics department.
You don't even talk to this professor, you only really talk to TAs. The class and final itself is really easy just follow along the instructions.

This lab was the easiest compared to organic chemistry or biology lab. Ask the TAs if you are stuck on a question. They'll walk you through it and explain. Make sure to write units for everything. As long as you put in some effort, you'll get at least a 19/20.
Absolutely a massive waste of my time. The entire physics department at UF are all obsolete and terrible at their jobs
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This teacher cares about you unlike other physics professors. He actually understands that we are pre-whatever and our GPA matters. He doesn't try to undermine our capabilities, but he gets us to our potential. Trust me, he is the best professor out there for physics. He is so caring
Labs are very easy, and are pretty much participation.

HES THE BEST PROFESSOR EVER! Tore my ACL at the beginning of my last semester and prof. Parks went above and beyond to make sure I didnt quit. Hes dedicated to his students and ACTUALLY wants you to succeed. He might seem intimidating@1st but put in the time and ask questions. Hes the most loving and caring prof. Ive had. Def worth taking.

One of the best professors I've ever had. Failed the first exam because I didn't know what to expect. Learned to do the homework, actually work through it & make note of the difficult ones, same goes for old practice exams and managed to get an A in the class. His grading scale and breakdown is extremely fair and he awards 5% bonus for clickers.

Mr. Parks really cares about his students. I've never had a professor who is available all day every day. You can just walk into his office and he will be happy to help you solve a problem. With that said his class does require a lot of practice to do well. Class is mainly just for clickers. His exams are hw/past exams so not to difficult.

Ive never seen a college professor go so above and beyond to aid student learning. He held review sessions on his days off and welcomed a question even if it was outside of normal office hours. Youd get a good grade as long as you did the practice exams and hw. Overall you learn a lot with a professor that cares, and what to study is clear cut.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He is the best professor I've ever had. He is very willing to help students and his exams actually test you on what you learned. He is also a very nice guy. He should be the one teaching in the Fall and Spring. Take him!

Although class is technically not madatory, it is super worth it to come so that you can get clicker points. Also, while Parks isn't the best teacher, he is very approachable in his office hours. I started to do a lot better when I went to office hours and started doing practice problems from the book. You don't even have to read the chapters...
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: I dont even know what to say about Dr. Parks. I'm not exactly sure what the point of his lectures are, as he mostly just talks about how hard physics is. For some reason, the lectures always go by really quickly but at the end I look back and can't think of one thing I learned. If you get a good TA the quizzes the class isn't bad.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He is in charge of makeup labs. He wouldnt let you make up missed labs unless you have a valid reason. His words are harsh and seem to not care about his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: THE BEST TEACHER IVE EVER HAD. He is the most caring man and really wants everyone to succeed. He is a true depiction of a caring teacher and I have the most respect for him. His tests are hard, even with study edge. Do all the HW and old test questions and put them on formula sheets. It's a tough class but he makes it worth it. Favorite teacher.

Okay, Mr Parks is a great and understanding man who really cares for the students but he can not teach at all and he wastes so much time in class with videos and useless information. He should do examples and work it step by step but no he sings instead. I made an A+ in this class through hard work and outside sources such as Study edge. Bad Prof

Mr. Parks is the best professor I've had at UF. He goes way beyond what's required of him. He will do almost anything to help you succeed. Even though he's a great professor, physics still isn't easy. Do as many practice problems as possible,  go to his office hours and study halls. You'll do okay.

Parks made Physucks an actually-quite-tolerable experience. Very fair in his execution of the material, exams, and grades overall. Uses class time to focus on teaching you more general concepts of Physics (bolstered by numerous short demos performed mid-lecture); either use the practice problems he provides or StudyEdge to get a grip on the details

Best Physics professor at UF. Knows his material very well, but does problems the hard way so you definitely need to use study edge to find the quick and easier way to do problems. Gives topic breakdowns for each exam which makes studying very easy. Definitely do the old exams, I always did well on the exams if I did the old exams.

Parks is a fair professor. His teaching style is more concept based and not as focused on how to solve problems. Just going to class will NOT help you learn physics. I would go to class to get an introduction of the material and then watched Study Edge reviews (where I really learned the material), did the hw and practice exams and did well.
As long as you understand calculus, can interpret the lab manuel, and get to class on time you will almost certainly get an A

He is the most helpful professor!  He would hold study sessions many nights a week. He gives lots of extra assignments to help your grade and clicker questions. Does lots of experiments during lecture!

I'm sure for a physics class he's the best one to take BUT this class is not easy at all. The quizzes are so much harder than what they should be. The key to this class really is practice problems.. old exams. Textbook problems sometimes pop up on exams.. do any problem to survive and do well. You really need to put the time into this class.

TAKE HIM!!!!!!  He is the BEST professor I have ever had at UF and I hate physics and science and received an A without having to take the final.  He cares so deeply for every single one of  his students.  He even dedicated 3 nights a week to people who wanted to come and answer any question we had and would stay as late as we needed.

Perhaps THE best professor at UF. He truly loves what he is doing and loves teaching. He is the nicest professor I've ever had. There are 3 exams, The lowest 2 are out of 15 and the highest score is out of 20. If you have a B average on all of the exams, you are exempt from the final. Overall, he was pretty easy, and very helpful. TAKE HIM!
This class was definitely difficult like most Physics classes. Study Edge is the only thing that helped me pass this class!

Fairly easy. If you want to get good grade/education, he's your guy. First exam was rough but he made the next three exams fairly easy so I ended up with A-. He curves under given circumstances. During lecture, he uses demo to help you understand physics better or at least i personally thought it was so helpful.
Best instructor I've ever had in University.  Seriously.

Mr. Parks is a very kind and genuinely cares for his students! He wants you to really dig deep and learn physics! Mr. Parks is very witty and makes classes bearable in a not so interesting topic.. Overall, one of the best teachers I've had at UF so far!
I loved physics because of Mr. Parks. He is one of the only people at the university that genuinely wants to help you succeed. He is also great to talk to. :-)

Mr. Parks is one of the most helpful people I have ever known. In fact, I probably would not have survived physics and the labs without him! He is hilarious and fun to talk to and       definitely knows his physics. A+++
He is passionate and cares about heaing student thoughts and opinions. Grading and assignments are very straightforward and fosters a good community in general.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The class is straightforward and you won't be surprised, not too much work and tests and grading is very straightforward. I would definitely take again.

Extremely good lecturer and always ready to listen to any point any student brings up. Even with potentially controversial topics manages to navigate them with respect and level-headedness. Requires lots of writing but none of it particularly difficult for the average college student. Highly recommend taking any of his classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Suarez is the best lecturer at UF. His passion for the class & for fostering discussion shines daily.
