reviews.comment: There are only 5 assignments that are worth 75% of your grade. Criteria is vague. The TA was unhelpful and they require all of these vague and unnecessary little things in the assignments. The assignments are time consuming and tough to understand, especially since the professor does not explain ANY of it. This class should be easy but is a pain.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Class could be so much easier if he wasn't so vague on instructions for assignments. He tells you to follow the rubric for assignments over and over and the only way to ask for help is through posting in discussion boards that give you participation points. This class is supposed to be easy but he makes it stressful and annoying.

Absolute JOKE of a class, he is impossible to reach and even if he does see your message, there's a 96% chance he'll say something along the lines of "its in the rubric" which is utterly unhelpful. Instructions for assignments are so impossibly vague that you cant understand what he wants, even though he requires very detailed information.

This was the worst class I have ever taken in my life. I have never seen more vague assignment instructions in my entire life. Unnecessarily difficult, and there is no way to ask questions as the teacher doesn't take the time to actually answer the questions that he is being asked. I got absolutely nothing out of this course.

A true waste of credits and time. Assignments are unbelievably nit-picky and ridiculously annoying to find material for. What could have actually been a meaningful class turned into a flat out annoying ordeal. Sad that a required class is taught so poorly.
awful teacher very vague but expects very detailed stuff

So useless. Online class so the only way to ask him questions is through a discussion board which literally has hundreds of posts. 90% of the time he will tell you he answered a "similar" question already (plot twist: he didn't). He literally said "I could answer your question but you're doing such a great job almost answering"

If you can take Dr. Kerr for developmental psych, do it! Lectures are not mandatory but she gives lots of good examples. She also gives you a study guide that specifically lists everything you need to know for the exam. She is very caring and wants you to learn but not be overwhelmed :)
She is a very kind professor and is clearly passionate about what she teaches. Assignments and quizzes are easy for the most part. Exams are a little iffy, but if you study it will be fine.

This class is definitely very easy, as quizzes and tests are open note/book. However, almost all info comes from the book and each chapter is very long. While it is very easy to score high, taking notes is extremely time consuming. Also, Dr. Kerr is very hard to reach and created multiple confusing assignments (the TA's are very lenient, though).

Made the class so easy, there's only a few quizzes and no final exam, just a project (which is easy). There are small quizzes and/or a discussion post almost each week, but they're online, and she cancels class so you can take them. She is also so kind and understanding, take this class!

I think Dr. Kerr was a great professor! She was entertaining and engaging throughout all the lectures I attended, and this class was truly the least stressful one on my schedule. The content is very interesting and applicable to the real world. She made this class easy to understand and homework was very minimal and manageable!

Dr. Kerr was a great professor! You can tell she really cares about the topic and her personal connections and stories to the material covered in class really helped me understand it more. Very minimal workload and fair tests

The way this class was set up, there was almost no interaction between students and Professor Kerr. The class, on the other hand, was okay. The quizzes and papers are pretty simple. The exams were a little more difficult. The textbook is helpful if you read it, but the exam questions are worded kind of weird, so it can be hard even if you study.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Barely interacted with the professor as this was 100% online "go at your own pace" style. Class was super easy as everything was open note and open textbook. Impossible to fail unless you get caught cheating or something.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Take this online. Everything is open note so while there are a lot of quizzes & 1 page application papers, you should be fine. The exams were a bit rushed so you really need to read the textbook chapters beforehand instead of just ctrl+F during. Very little to no interaction with Kerr herself--just 1 short lecture video per unit. TAs gave As
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--So many papers

reviews.comment: I LOVED Dr. Kerr. She is very knowledgeable and it is clear she cared about us as students. There are 3 exams, 1 group project, and a final paper. There are a few short writing assignments and discussions, but they are really easy. She gives study guides with the exact questions on the exams, and is super accessible through email. Take this class!!

I had an overall good experience with this class. The exams are a little difficult (even though they are open book) and the chapters are pretty long so I don't recommend the studying the night before. Everything else is very manageable! She also replied back very quickly when I reached out.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Kerr is very knowledgable. Class is simple, do the work and you'll pass. Exams and Quizzes are open book/note. She basically wants you to pass and I wouldn't stress just complete everything on time.

Dr. Kerr is very knowledgable. Class was simple, do the work and you'll pass. Quizzes and Exams are open book/open note. She offers extra credit as well and wants you to pass. Assignments and Papers are simple as well.

Took this professor for Spring semester of 2024, and she was alright. I did have to reach out a few times because some of the TAs weren't grading my work. She takes a while to respond. Exams were pretty hard but as long as you study the material it should be okay. Did require web cam when taking exam but it was also open book so I wouldn't stress.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment:
Dr. Kerr is a good speaker, but she mostly just read off the powerpoints. The anecdotes she gave as a supplement to the materials were nice to hear! 

The problem I had with this class was that the tests had questions with multiple answers and materials not covered previously. Final paper graded very harshly, and teacher didn't respond to my emails

I loved Dr. Kerr. She is very knowledgeable and inspiring. There are 3 exams for this class, but they are only weighted 11% of the grade. There is one group project, and a final paper. There are a few short writing assignments and discussions, but they are VERY easy if you do well in the class. Study for exams with the study guide! Great class!

Open note quizzes/tests. Tests can be tricky, but reading the textbook and taking notes help. She seemed very sweet and accommodating, although I never actually contacted her because her course is very well organized. If you have to take this course, online is the way to go.

Seems alright if you don't have to message her about anything. Gets easily frustrated at simple questions, probably because she has too many students. Class has a few hundred people, so there's not really much connection. You might have to reach out a few times to actually get what you need done. Maybe she's more accessible in person.

if u need to take psych and get it over with, take this online. i put in basically 30 mins per week and ended with a 95% but i wouldn't really say i learned anything. very easy grader and you take quizzes (which make up most of ur grade) as many times as u need to. she genuinely just wants everyone to past. best way to go for getting psych over w/.
Quizzes and exams (all open note) were perfectly difficult, and all of the material comes directly from the textbook. 10/10 best professor.
Easiest class I've ever taken in my life and Dr. Kerr is a sweetheart. 100/10 recommend.

Dr. Kerr was always helpful and supportive, usually giving extension when most students missed the deadlines. She always responded within 48 hours. The text book is long, and the chapters take a while to read, though you can skip the reading and still pass. 1 page maximum for papers can be tricky, as they still want clear definitions and examples.

Very sweet professor! She was very clear in the instructions for assignments, quizzes, and exams. Overall, if you follow along with the schedule and pay close attention to the textbook/resources in the modules, you'll do great. Would recommend!

she's alright. slow grader, minimal to no feedback. you'll get perfect scores on discussion posts and quizzes. the real tragedies are the final exam and the final paper. she gives a comprehensive study guide for the final but the average was still in the 70s. she grades HARSH on the final paper and that's what determines your final letter grade
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Kerr is very sweet, and I will say I did not go to most of the lectures because class was at 8 am, I still found the class very manageable and interesting. The quizzes are super easy and the exams aren't too bad either. Make sure you keep up with assignments and your research credits (online) as well as your research paper.

I don't have much to say about this professor, but if you can go to her lectures I do recommend going. She gives good lectures and is engaging. There's just a quiz each week and some discussion posts. One final exam and one final research paper.

Really great and entertaining professor. She often related topics to her own personal experiences and made jokes throughout lecture. Quizzes and discussion posts are beyond easy. Final exam was difficult and there's also a final paper, both of which tanked my grade after a whole semester of having a 100. Don't let your guard down lol

Great teacher. Lectures are interesting but not mandatory. Make sure to read each textbook chapter for weekly quizes (13 quizes, 10 count). There's also short weekly discussion posts. Go to the test review for best details on final (only test). There's a paper that's as difficult as you make it, roughly 6 pages. 20 Sona research hours

Professor Kerr gives amazing and engaging lectures. Lecture attendance is not mandatory. Each week there is a log and a quiz with a final paper and exam at the end of the course. She is an amazing professor, and I would recommend her course!

Dr. Kerr was a fantastic professor! Her lectures were entertaining and often made me reflect on real life! I genuinely learned a lot during this class. There were weekly quizzes and discussions, but this class was easy to maintain an 'A' in! 10/10
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: She's awesome, no exams except for final exam. Quizzes are weekly and online but are really easy. Attendance is not mandatory but lectures are very interesting. She allows you to participate during lectures and say your opinion on certain topics. Final paper at the end of course. Would take again
Really helpful with any concerns or needs, grades fairly, easy assignments weekly, would take again :)

Dr. Kerr's class was a breath of fresh air, aside from that Dr. Kerr is one of the most understanding professors I've had. You can tell she wants the best for her students, and even though it is a lecture class she makes it a point to try and get to know her students. I took her 8:30am class over a better timed PSY 2012 course and I'd do it again!

Dr. Kerr knows what she is talking about, and class is very easy to do well in. I didn't attend that many lectures, but instead followed along with the powerpoints online and was still able to succeed. Just keep up with assignments and it is a very doable class.

such a good prof. Never went to lectures, just read the textbook and did the quizzes. One easy paper, and an out of class assignment, but over all so easy to get an A if you go to lecture or read the text book.

She's a great professor! Assignments are really easy as long as you look at the material. Didn't have class on Fridays, only online quizzes. Gives you free access to textbook, and lectures are available online. Exam was really easy as well, her review was exactly what was on it.
Dr. Kerr was an amazing PSY2012 prof! Her lectures are very interesting and she genuinely cares about her students. If you read the textbook, you will have no issues passing with an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: She's a great professor and cares about her students! She gives you weekly quizzes on the chapter covered throughout the week, a project, and a final. An easy course to take if you do enough of the work.

Best PSY2012 professor ever. I HIGHLY recommend you take her if you have the option. I barely went to class and the weekly quizzes/ discussion posts were easy to BS. she told us exactly what was on the final. BEST PROFESSOR AND PERSON EVER

Professor Kerr is an amazing professor, she is very caring towards her students. Her lectures are very interesting, but make sure to go to class and read PowerPoints. Her weekly assignments are easy. There was a final essay and final exam, but no midterm. She is a fair grader and a really interesting person to talk to. 100% recommend.

Definitely a good professor!! She's a really sweet teacher and is really passionate about psychology. Definitely enjoy going to her class! She has assignments due every Friday and I just read the textbook and do the quizzes and everything is good (: definitely recommend!!!

Dr. Kerr is a great lecturer. Her lectures are always super interesting and funny. There are no exams or midterms (other than a final), just weekly quizzes based on the chapter. There is a textbook, but you get free access to it and you can get away with not reading it and only going off her powerpoints. Attendance is not mandatory. Def recommend!
You can read the lecture powerpoints and do fine in the class. Dr. Kerr is very straightforward with this course, its overall doable and material isn't too hard.

Very easy to obtain n A in this class. Dr. Kerr is hilarious, intelligent, and well respected. One of the best psychology teachers at UF. We had weekly quizzes that aligned with each chapter it was proctored but very easy. Her powerpoints make it clear to understand. Loved this class. we had one final exam no midterm and a fun project to do.
Dr. Kerr is amazing! she is really accommodating, understanding, and grades fairly. the material comes easy if you watch the lectures and make sure to study the powerpoints.

She is a good professor. Clearly describes the topics and if you attend lecture will give you a question or two that is on the quiz. She is also understanding. Quizzes are on Honorlock and closed note. Really don't need the textbook if you just watch her lectures.

I personally did not enjoy her teaching style. The lectures were dense and were confusing. Reading the textbook was the only thing to prepare me for the weekly quizzes. There was only one exam-the final-and she provided a very comprehensive study guide. There was a final presentation that is an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Kerr is amazing. Although her lectures tend to be quite long, she tends to finish fast and lets class end early. There are a lot of quizzes but they come straight out of her powerpoints. Her powerpoints are the most important part of the class and are super helpful. Professor Kerr is extremely understanding and reliable.

Professor Knudson is a great guy, caring and funny in his lectures. Most of the course material can be learned by watching his videos, although some topics are better learned from somewhere else. Easy assignments, not too much effort.

after calc 1 nightmare, this was a breeeeze! all exams are exactly like the practices so really easy to do well on it. around 5 assignments a week and 4 exams but one exam get dropped. pre recorded lectures arent bad at all but i do rec studyedge if you struggle with calc as a whole. overall a good class and def passable

Good professor. Don't let "calc 2" dissuade you from doing finance or accounting; this class is more straightforward than it seems. The exams are 95% similar to the practice he gives. Exam 2 is the hardest, but still doable. He understands other business class coursework and doesn't overload your schedule. Lectures are eh, watch practice problems.

I thought the content was very straightforward. I only watched his lecture videos, not the "additional problems" lectures and I did very well. He is very refreshing after the hell of Calc 1 with Williamson. Also, I like his name. It is funny.

He is a terrible lecturer and does not explain concepts well. I had to learn from other resources. Exams were very similar to practice exams, which is the only reason I was able to pull an A in this class.

Super nice guy and extremely accommodating. I wish UF had more professors like him. I'm not a math guy, but comfortably got through this class. Practice exams are basically the real exams with different numbers. Would highly recommend office hours as he's a super chill guy and will go out of his way to help you out. He's also super funny!

LOVE HIM. TBH, I didn't put in any effort into this class (didn't watch lectures, barely understood any of the content, no studyedge), but I did just the exam reviews and scored enough to pass. I was supposed to end with a B+, but he added a bonus quiz, reopened the HW, and rounded our grade, so I ended with an A. Super easy and caring professor.

Professor Knudson is a caring professor who sends out clear guidelines via email, which is much appreciated for an online class. He drops the lowest exam grade and the lowest 3-5 quiz grades. His lectures go very in-depth, so study edge is very helpful to learn the concepts in a concise manner and for extra practice problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Knudson was a great professor and made sure to communicate guidelines via email, which is much appreciated for an online class. He dropped the lowest exam and the lowest 3 quizzes, which is very helpful. He goes very in-depth in his lectures, so study edge is very helpful for learning the concepts and for extra practice.

Super manageable class and easy to get an A. Few short lecture videos, quizzes, and one homework assignment every week. It was not very time consuming. Content can be tough, so I used study edge for it which I liked better than his lectures. He drops your lowest quizzes, homeworks, and one exam grade, which is good because exam 2 is rough.

Not really a hard class, exams are very similar to practice exams. You could very easily get an A in the class with a bit of effort. I had study edge and that helped a lot I thought is was better then his lectures.
The lectures that you could listen to were so vague it was difficult to grasp the concept when he adds in new terms so nonchalantly and doesn't explain.

Do the practice exams! They are literally identical to the real exam just with the numbers switched up. If you know how to do the practice exams, this class should be an easy A. HW assignments are tedious and borderline useless, but they can be the difference between a B and A, so do them.

Horrible lectures. Could not understand anything he taught. Watched all the study edge videos and understood what to do instantly. The practice exams are exactly like the real one so do those multiple times. Study edge has everything you need to prepare. With study edge this class is INSANELY easy for a Calc 2 course.

overall really easy. I watched studyedge over his lectures and made sure I could do the practice exams, which are basically identical to the actual ones. He drops one exam; let that be exam 2 which is the hardest. The exams in order of difficulty are: 2,1,3,4. Easy class if you are willing to grind practice problems the 3 or 4 days before the exam.

I took this course during summer C and was hard to understand all the material from lecture videos. The most frustrating part of the course was definitely the Xronos. Would definitely recommend study edge as it was super useful for a lot of topics I struggled with.

Very well-laid out class, I recommend him if you need credit for MAC2234. The exams are just like the practice exams so do those and you will get a good grade in the class. Lectures are straight-forward and explain what you need for the homework and quizzes. StudyEdge is helpful but honestly just doing the practice exams will get you a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: A handsome man and very intelligent, but his teaching style is awfully handwavy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Overall Knudson's class was a great experience. He was very thorough in the lectures, beware that everything is online though.

Dr. K is great. He really understands the concepts and tries to give relevant examples to improve our learning. MAC2234 is very well laid out. The only frustrating thing can be Xronos. It also can be challenging at times, but Dr. K is very gracious with grading (i.e.- dropping low scores), so as long as you do the work, you should be fine.
Actually love this man!

Technically, I had this course under another professor, but the lectures (and I think most of the framework) were done by Knudson. I really liked how he would sometimes make dorky jokes, it shows how passionate he is about the subject and how he manages to just keep it lighthearted. The HW and quizzes really helped cement everything, too.

If you are good at math, this course can be a guaranteed 4.0 A if done correctly. His teaching can be a hit or miss depending on the lesson and your understanding of the concept. If you are bad at math, god help you. LOTS of work like quizzes and HW but it cements understanding. Tests are pretty easy, just study and do practices.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Professor Knudson is an absolutely amazing professor! Calc 2 isn't an easy class but he works through lots of examples which really helps. The exams are so fair; they're the exact same as the practice exam just with different numbers. He drops some quizzes and one exam, so you'll have no issue in this class, as long as you take it with Knudson!!

His lectures can be confusing, I would highly recommend StudyEdge.  The exams are identical to the exam reviews only different numbers.  Definitely a time consuming class, but he allows you to retake quizzes and drops a lot of grades so I ended up with a 99.8%.  I would recommend taking this professor if you need survey of calc 2.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I had Knudson for Survey of Calculus 2. He seems like a nice guy in his lectures but he does not do a good job of explaining how to do math. I learned this class mostly through Youtube because he was so bad at explaining his thought process. The tests are very short and extremely similar to the practice exams. About 3 quizzes a week + xronos.

I'm sure he is very accomplished in mathematical academia but he is atrocious at teaching. Usually I don't mind bad teachers but he is way below average. He skips many steps in his explanations and examples. Anything is better than his lectures. The material is easy, you just have to put in more work than you need to.

The class had A LOT of lectures and homework.The assignments were due on Sunday of every week.He drops one exam, which was great cause I absolutely failed the 2nd one.This math class was pretty difficult.Each exam 2, 3, & 4 have 8, 6, & 4 questions, respectively.Also make sure you understand the lecture examples so you grasp each concept.
His lectures are way too short so you will be teaching yourself a lot of the material. However, his tests are fair and possible to do well on

Dr. Knudson was a great teacher! Assignments for his class were due every Sunday night and he was very generous in giving extensions if it was exam season. If you just watch his lectures, take notes, and do all of the assignments, this class is an easy A.

Though his teaching style wasnt my favorite as he states rather than explains the concepts, he is very fair when it comes to grades. His practice exams are so similar to his actual exams which I wish professors did. I didnt need study edge but I did have to watch YouTube videos and teach myself some things. Very fair and nice teacher though.

Early on you notice his lectures don't really help much at all as he skips over way too many steps. I recommend getting Study Edge for the class, that's how I learned. But the class is very easy. He posts practice exams which are basically identical to the real exams. He also drops the lowest exam, and the last two exams are extremely easy.

Took survey of calc 2. He posts exams reviews before the exams which literally are just the exams with different numbers. Struggled for a B in survey of calc 2 and an easy A in his class. He also drops a ton of assignments and is just an understanding and cool guy who moves back assignments if a lot of the class has another exam.

His lectures dont actually explain anything and just show his work which is simply him displaying his mathematical ability. He teaches the course as if hes giving a seminar to a bunch of mathematics majors. Unless you are passionate about Calculus, youre going to have to use other videos and tools to learn. His exams are also very difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Was a great guy and made the class understandable. Highly recommend

This professor wasn't instrumental to my grade. His lectures are behind a PowerPoint presentation. He has supplementary lectures, but they didnt help much for homework and quizzes. His practice exams were very helpful for exams, just a little more work for exams. This class is very doable, just keep up with EVERYTHING.

Lots of work but that's expected with calculus. All recorded lectures and some were very long but you have to watch them in order to understand how to do the work. He makes it easy and drops lots of quizzes and 1 exam.

He was not the best lecturer, but he was a very fair professor. The course structure is ideal and he sets you up to succeed if you put effort into the class. He is the one math professor at UF that I would be comfortable taking again.

Dr. Knudson was my favorite professor at UF so far. He's great at teaching and super fair when it comes to the exams - doesn't make u study unnecessary material. Also very generous with dropping HWs, Quizzes, Tests. In this class there's no bs, you put in some work and you'll get a good grade. 10/10

Unbiased review part 2: Gave him a 5 now so that both reviews 4.5 Watch all the lectures and do the hw and you'll be fine. He is very understanding. Ex: I rounded down on a question because it was unclear on the quiz, sent him an email and he immediately gave me credit admitting the instructions were unclear. Read previous review for more info.

A super easy calc class. Watch his lectures and do the lecture quizzes and weekly quiz and homework. He drops so many things, so as long as you do good on most, you will do absolutely fine. Exams are easy as long as you do the study guide. Easy A

Although Professor Knudson's lectures can be pretty dry and a little difficult to understand at times ( I ended up using Study Edge instead) you can tell he tries his best to help his students and wants them to succeed. My best advice would be to do the his exam reviews as they are VERY SIMILAR to the actual exams.

Unbiased Review: I took MAC2234 my 1st semester after taking AP Calc AB in high school. If you did fine in AP calc, you should be more than fine. The 1st lectures are basically reviews of AP Calc. His lectures are concise so that you do not spend hours on them. He answers emails almost immediately at any hour. He is very understanding & reasonable

I dont know why Professor Knutson has bad reviews. His lectures are short and sometimes you have to go outside for help, but generally the topics are easy to get. The practice exam is exactly like the real exam, so youll pass everyone if you know how to do the practice. He had some technical difficulties, but in response he gave a lot of free As
Get peoples snaps for a group chat, dont let the lectures pile up try to do them early and go to office hours. Do all these things and you should be fine

reviews.comment: Taking Calc 1 online and all of the lecture videos are only his and they are god awful. He is very smart but horrible at teaching, he speeds through the lectures and gives minuscule information that helps, all of the homework and tests have about 2 of the 20 questions relate what is taught in the lectures, the rest is all teaching yourself online

reviews.comment: His lectures are hard to understand. He expects you to know what he is talking about and skips steps, leaving us confused as to whats going on. I have no idea what I am learning.
He assumed that everyone already understood what he was teaching, but we didnt which is why we were taking that class.

Dr. Knudson is a smart man but because of that, his online lectures are very difficult to keep up with. He tends to over complicate easy topics and expects you to have a lot of prior knowledge. Lecture videos range between 15-30 minutes but I end up spending over an hour because I have to rewind and slow it down to understand what is going on.

reviews.comment: Worst professor I have had at UF thus far. He doesn't explain anything and teaches like he expects everyone to already know the content. He does not work through problems and rushes through content. DO NOT take any class with him. I have friends in different classes who had him and also did not like him.
He's a smart guy but he doesn't know how to teach. He speaks super fast in his lectures and skips a bunch of steps expecting you to already have previous knowledge.

He is awful. If you're not a mathematics major/minor, I would not recommend taking him. His online lectures are incoherent and downright terrible. They don't even match up with the online homework, quizzes, or tests. It's like trying to do calculus with a blindfold and your hands tied behind your back. Embarrassingly bad.

Avoid him at all cost if you are not a mathematics major. I understand he is probably better at teaching higher level classes, but don't take him for calc 1. His lectures are so awful, I had him for calc 1, had to drop the class, then took it online the next semester over the summer and found out they use his lectures, he is the worst professor.

Dr. Knudson is a really great professor to take if you are a Mathematics major, his excitement and interest in complex variables makes the class interested in actually learning. The only thing that sucks is in order to get an A you need a 93 and he doesn't give minus grades ( which could be good or bad depending on your views).
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I knew I'd love Knudson when he played Total Eclipse of the Heart on the first day of class, which was the day of the solar eclipse. He's a great professor, and there were lots of opportunities for extra credit. I really enjoyed his lectures. Althoug, MAC2311 is a popular class at UF so the class size was ridiculously large.

His lectures are nothing like the exam or quizzes. Exams are only 10 questions online not multiple choice so there's not really any room for screw ups. 100% would recommend taking this in person instead of online.

I took this class last fall with professor Knudson. It started to get difficult toward the end when clicker points become harder to find. Class for clicker points is optional after you hit his baseline requirement. I used study edge when taking this course and it was a breeze. I would take professor Knudson again.

Knudson is a great professor, but his lecture videos could be long and very confusing. I used Study Edge to learn all the material in 1/4 of the time and pass his lecture quizzes. This class became significantly easier to keep up with after using Study Edge and it saved my grade, so I would definitely recommend it!

Knudson was a great professor. I took calc AB in high school and failed the exam, but coming into UF and having him was great and I learned everything I needed to. He gives extra credit on his tests which is great as well. I was balancing a few other tough classes and managed to get an A here. Totally recommend this guy.

Loved the professor both as a person and as a teacher. His philosophy is that homework should not be punitive, as such he makes the homework as digestible for the students and his lectures, if you have done the pre-lecture work, are easy to understand. Unlike other professors who merely repeat recorded material he adds value to his lectures.

Dr. Knudson is a great guy in general. You can tell he has a lot of passion for math. He kind of talks fast and he teaches expecting you to have prior knowledge to what he's teaching, so be prepared. There is a little amount of homework but do more practice questions on your own because tests are very different from homework!

He's a good guy who is very passionate about his subject, and always gives proofs to make sure you understand the concept before anything else. He'd be great for upper level math, but taking calc 1 from him is like Van Gogh trying to explain colors to a blind person. It's hard to see what he sees without some base knowledge and an interest in math.
Best professor I have ever had!

Knudson spends the majority of class doing problems that have very little relevance to the material you are suppose to be learning. The exams are completely opposite of the all of the practice examples he does or practice exams he provides. Engineering section is made signicantly harder compared to other calculus sections.

Dr. Knudson is an awesome person. Very funny. That said, I have never taken Calc 1 before, and he teaches with the assumption that you have gotten a 5 on the AP exam in high school. He gives out very little extra credit, and his exams test your pre-rec knowledge more than actual calculus. Don't take him if this is your first Calc class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Do well on the exams and you'll get an A. Key to getting an A on the exam, use study edge!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: With Prof. Knudson as your instructor, getting an A does not seem hard. The points are well divided and lots of Extra Credit.

Prof Knudson is very smart and a decent lecturer. I took this class online so the exams are ProctorU, 10 questions, free-response with no partial credit, in WebAssign... which means they suck. Beware if you are not great in math. Try and get into the live section if you can.

Professor Knudson is a difficult professor who definitely makes you work for your grade. This is a class that in the past was much easier, but now the curriculum has changed and it is much harder. There are tons of quizzes along with homework, which makes this class pretty time consuming. If you take this class, be prepared to put in the time.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: LOVE HIM!!! Such a good professor, cares about his students, and wants everyone to succeed. Take him and you won't regret it. Really nice and cool guy and funny.

Dr. K is a very smart guy, but this does not translate to him being a great professor or lecturer. I had him for an online class and all the lectures were pre-recorded. He talks very fast and is difficult to follow because he uses powerpoint for the bulk of his lectures. His tests were all short answer so no room to make even one simple mistake.

Dr. K is a pretty funny guy and is definitely intelligent. But, he often lacks the ability to level with the students on issues they may be having due to his intelligence. It may become difficult throughout the year to get help from him due to this.

Professor K is a pretty funny guy and most of the classmates that I talked to said that they liked him. The course is definitely not easy, as it should for Calc 2. He brought us donuts while wearing a Krispy Kreme hat on Donut Day so I thought that was pretty cool.
His class was interesting to be in. I enjoyed going to his Calc class. He is also pretty lenient in grading.

Dr. Knudson's lectures are nothing but slides with narration. He does not show you how to work through problems. He did not work through a single problem with pencil and paper. This might not be a problem for you, but I know I cannot learn something as in depth as calculus without seeing a problem done at least once.

Knudson was funny, a guy I would have a beer with, but he a pathetic professor at this level. Every class was him showing us how good at math he was, and he showed no regard for the students. Made fun of questions asked. I earned my excellent grade through many hours of studying in spite of him.
Arrogant professor who often does not teach half of the lectures. Made the class significantly more hard than it needed to be just to prove that he knew calculus. Horrible professor.

Absolutely loved having Dr. Knudson as a calculus professor!! I took calculus in high school and this class was a bit challenging for me at times. As long as you go to class and actually do the homework you'll be fine! Do not wait till last minute to study for exams. Old exams and reviews from the teaching center were very useful!

Calc 1 at UF is not the same after Knudson started teaching calc 1. His input to the tests has made them significantly harder than previous semesters. I've taken both Calc AB and BC and received 5s on both. I thought the test were hard. On the upside, however, there are 6 extra credit points per test and there is a lenient drop policy. Study hard!

Great Calculus teacher! But even if you took Calculus before you will need to study a lot before the test and do all the homework, both online and from the book, in order to pass the class. Do as much practice problems before the exam and ask for help if you need it. Do not wait until the last test/exam to start studying.
Pretty cool teacher, cracks a lot of jokes. He is pretty clear, but don't ask him questions he will just suggest you to a TA.

Hard class, but that's just how it is at UF. Always real, pretty funny, and explains math really well. By the way, don't listen to that girl under me. She sits near me in class and never stops complaining about how much she wants to punch him. Also quite funny because all she does is look at underwear on a shopping website during class

Literally want to punch him in the face. He is a pompous little professor who doesn't even teach half of the lecture. He just likes to rub in our face that he understands calculus more than we do. For the engineering section he does not provide proper materials to study. The practice test are 200x easier than the real test and he gives 0 cares.

Dr. Knudson is great, one of my favorite professors. Very clear, knows what he's doing, is always willing to answer questions and help, and he makes his class enjoyable by giving us all a laugh every now and then. I went to his office hours once and he was very helpful. I definitely think he's one of the best calculus professors at UF!!
This professor is awesome. His lectures keep you focused by being interesting and funny. Really outstanding! Going to try to find more classes he teaches!

Outstanding professor. Clear, organized, humorous, and doesn't try to trick students on tests. He proved practically everything in class, which made this way better than normal Calc II. Oh yeah, and Krispy Kreme donuts on the day of the final. It's a travesty that the math department won't offer the honors sequence anymore.  Take him for anything!

He is very helpful and laid back. He will do any example problems and go over material over and over again til it is understood. his tests aren't too hard you just have to study. there is no mandatory homework which is nice. We got to know him too. he told us stories about when he met his wife. he is very funny which makes class more interesting.

A really nice, interesting guy. Really laid back and flexible about turning in papers. He creates some good discussions and it generally just a really cool guy. His 1 credit honors classes are really nice ways to spend an hour, and you get to read good books.

I took a 1 credit, Honors reading course with him. He barely gave any work and was an extremely easy grader. The class was like a book club really - we'd read a chapter then discuss it. He is really interesting, funny, nice, and attractive.
Very good professor; fair, funny and teaches clearly. Highly recommended.
Relatable and interesting professor. Engages in interesting conversation and makes going to class not so bad.
Cool guy, interesting conversations

Professor Knight gives great lectures. It's better to watch them on 1.5x speed as he extensively elaborates sometimes. But if economics is logical to you then it should be no problem. He clearly outlines course expectations and is very fair in exam questions. Do practice exams!

Dr. Knight is funny and knowledgeable. However, grade is mostly based on a few exams. I never did the readings, and some exams had confusing questions that reading may have helped with. Exam 2 was the hardest and 3 the easiest. Keep up with the lectures and look at past exams to study.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I hated macro the subject, but I loved Thomas Knight. His lectures were great and super informational, and his tests were reasonable. I am not great at econ type stuff but if I studied well and just did the practice exams, I would normally get a B on them. Highly recommend.
Great professor with very organized lectures and notes. Naturally, the class is exam-heavy, but the studying is made very straightforward.

Professor Knight is genuinely passionate about macroeconomics, and it shows in every lecture. Classes are engaging, entertaining, and cover topics thoroughly. The lectures are extremely helpful for exams and make complex concepts easy to understand.

This class is based completely on the lectures, the textbook isn't much help after a while. Exams are all honor lock and are 75% of your grade and theres only 3, so if you dont do good on one exam, your done. No assignments just exam/quiz. The lectures are basic concepts that don't really help on the exams, he's nice but I wouldn't take online.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His lectures were incredibly informative, especially compared to the textbook which felt impossible at times. He clearly knows what he is talking about and is happy to answer questions in class. His practice exams were definitely indicative of the exam content, so take his advice when he says that they are worth your time investment.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Knight was hilarious but the Pearson quizzes and study material do not align with the actual tests. He only gives 3 example tests to use as practice which makes it difficult to find resources for studying

If you don't have time to study for this class get SE. I took Bfi at the same time and I had no time to watch lectures. SE exam reviews summarize everything for each exam, 3 days prior. But grading scale is kinda cooked because even if you get 100s on all the quizzes you can still only afford to lose 12 questions over all 3 exams to get an A.

The greatest professor of all time (it's only my first semester but still). I loved this class so much and I learned a ton of things that I can apply to my daily life in terms of understanding lots of what I hear about on the news and how the world works. The lectures are so much fun (especially in person) and I was always excited for class.
Professor Knight is such a kind and funny person, as well as a great lecturer who listens to questions and is very knowledgeable about the material.
Terrible experience with the professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I LOVE THOMAS KNIGHT. He makes these concepts so interesting and fun to learn by using examples from the live audience. This is the inly business class I have to take and I enjoyed it! i didn't put much effort in or stay consistent and got a B. 1 quiz a week and 3 non cumulative exams.

Professor Knight is the GOAT. Watch the lectures on 1.5x speed, no need to ever read the textbook. I liked using StudyEdge to reinforce content and get extra practice in, but probably not needed. Exams felt easier than the weekly quizzes personally.

Professor Knight's short lectures are incredibly helpful. He doesn't cover everything, but you'll only need to skim through the textbook for the remaining concepts. Tests make up your entire grade, and the concepts become more challenging as the semester goes on. I strongly recommend studying previous exams if you want to pass this class.

Professor Knight is an exceptional teacher and makes difficult concepts easier to understand, even if the lectures can become too lengthy. The exams heavily weighted, but are manageable by the notecard permitted with each test, the practice material available, and the review options. It can be difficult at times, but was an enjoyable class.

Exam grades are the only thing that matters. Be ready to load your note card up which is very useful. Take this class, he is awesome and take the past exams as practice tests, they are a great indicator.

Professor Knight is amazing. You have three exams (final is not cumulative) and one quiz a week, so the class is not work heavy. It is relatively easy content, and Professor Knight is great at explaining the material. There is a textbook, but you can usually get by without reading it.

This class was hybrid, so it was lectures online (and he had an in-person option, but I just never went). But this class was extremely lecture-heavy and test-heavy. He's a great, funny guy, but he doesn't really care about students. There's no extra credit, and tests count for 75% of your grade, and 12 quizzes count 25% of your grade.

Class is very test heavy, with no extra credit offered. Two lowest quiz scores dropped but in reality they hardly change your gradebook unless you get a 0. The grading scheme syllabus is just ridiculous, the lowest test score I got was an 80 and then got 95's on the last two exams and I still have an A- and he won't budge.
Test heavy. Does not care about students, no extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Test HEAVY. Econ has never been my strong suit; however, had a graduate econ major tutoring me and scratching his head at some of the wording of practice test questions. Studied the previous exams as noted in reviews and was confused on exam day. Nice enough professor, hate how test heavy this class is.

This class is not hard as long as you make sure to watch the lectures. Lectures are posted online and all that is required weekly is a fairly easy quiz. 75% of your grade is based on three exams so make sure to take good notes and do the practice tests. Knight is a good teacher but sometimes entertains stupid/irrelevant questions for too long.
I think that the course is difficult if these are new concepts for you but also he is a very good professors but pay attention to the lectures and study hard for the tests.

Really good lectures, but the way the class is set up sucks. Exams and quizzes can sometimes be super content-dense and lecture-specific. Professor Knight is clear on his grading policies, so no round-ups or extra credit whatsoever. Besides that, if you actually try, you should be fine.
He's my goat

Such a passionate professor who truly cares about the success of his students. Just know there are only weekly quizzes as grades besides for the exams, so your grade can easily take a hit if you slip up.

Dr Knight is a great prof, but just note that because his rmp is good doesn't mean the class is easy. Lots of stuff on quizzes isnt always discussed in class, and the content is sometimes difficult to grasp. His lectures are entertaining and easy to follow, but the textbook isn't. just please know that this is NOT an easy A you do need to earn it!!
Dr. Knight was absolutely fabulous. Great lecturer!

I loved his lectures! Overall, a really easy class with limited work. The grading scale is mainly exams, so it's hard to recover your grade. He offers lots of resources to succeed, and all exams are multiple choice.  He knows what he's talking about and I enjoyed this class.

Professor Knight is very fluent in his field, so most of the time the content was clear and understandable. However, exams take up 75% of your grade. Even if you do lots of practice questions it is still not guaranteed to get higher than a 60%. I definitely recommend using all the resources he provides to make sure you are able to pass the class.

Best professor I've ever had. There are assigned textbook readings but I never did them and still did great on the exams because Professor Knight was such an amazing lecturer. He makes class enjoyable and interactive and I would highly recommend going to in-person lectures if your are able. Only 1 short quiz a week and 3 exams
The subject was quite hard for me but the teaching was above average.
Economics has not been an easy subject for me, but he made it interesting enough to motivate me to get engaged.
I love this professor. He taught really well and took his time.

Professor Knight is the best. He really tries to make sure everyone thoroughly understands the content and is so helpful and open to questions. He definitely yaps a lot, but he explains things really well, and I loved having him as a teacher. You can tell he's super passionate about it.

Professor Knight has been amazing. He is very enthusiastic during his lectures so energy stays high and I don't feel like taking a nap. He is very responsive to questions, and sends out consistent emails notifying of upcoming tests or quizzes. The tests aren't too hard so long as you take advantage of all available resources. Would highly recommend
His lectures were clear and he always makes sure you understand the material, specially if you go to his live lectures.

Professor Knight is a really great professor. His lectures are very good and organized. He provides lots of practice problems for each test and you are allowed to write notes on an index card for the exam. Very easy to get an A if you just do the old tests before the exam and watch the lectures.

Professor Knight does not only want students to pass, but to excel in macroeconomics. He prepares you well by providing past exam questions and answers. He is additionally very generous in scheduling makeup exams when needed, responding emails within hours. His lectures are easy to understand and his weekly quizzes are very managable.

Such a great professor; he makes learning easy. His lectures are clear and helpful. I personally didn't read the textbook and just watched the lectures + did practice exams. I didn't struggle to understand any of the material.

For online students: He has nicely worded lectures that can either be watched in short video forms that are in the modules section or he has the option to watch his in class lectures which are very helpful as student feedback is given. There are no assignments, only quizzes. He is a great teacher and is very fast to respond to emails.

Super kind, fair professor! Definitely went on a lot of tangents in lectures, but explained material super well besides that. Tests are identical to practice exams, do those and make your notecard and you should be good! He always made himself available to help

Dr Knight is great and cares about what he teaches. He loves economics and really sets you up for success. If you want to do well on exams DO THE PRACTICE EXAMS HE POSTS. They're actually so so helpful and all the exams compared to the practice ones are relatively the same amount of difficulty. Also he probably won't like this but use study edge.

Professor Knight is a wonderful instructor. His lectures were easy to understand and went into depth on the concepts. Weekly quizzes and 3 exams. Past exams are the best way to prepare for exams since each count for 25% of your grade. He really cares about students.

Professor Knight is a wonderful instructor. His lectures were clear and easy to understand. Practice exams help a LOT when it comes down to tests since each exam is 25% of your grade. Wonderful professor who cares about students.
Good lectures! Loved his personality. Do practice exams and you will be fine.
A bit of a yapper but super knowledgeable and kind. I really enjoyed this class, and he makes the concepts super easy to understand.

Professor Knight is hands down the best instructor I have had at UF, he genuinely cares about his students and wants them to succeed. His lectures are straightforward and informative. His exams are simply if you study the material and watch his lectures. I would take this course again!

Professor Knight had the best lectures I've ever seen. He is extremely knowledgeable in economics and knows how to teach the content in a way that is approachable. He responds to emails and questions within like 5 minutes and is super caring. Take him if you can!

Honestly such an amazing professor. Super engaging and makes some of the denser economics material very interesting and fun to learn. He provides ample material to study for exams and is always happy to answer questions and help outside of class.
He is an excellent professor and made things really easy to understand. I'm not a business major but watching his lectures were interesting.

Easily the best professor I had at UF so far. Knowledgeable, funny, engaging, always open to answer questions, and very clear with the requirements and objectives of the class. The practice exams were an amazing way to prepare for the actual exam, and the textbook covers all the material.

I looked forward to his lectures, he tells funny jokes and stories from his own life. Economics is a boring topic to me but he made it interesting. Weekly textbook quizzes, three exams. He posts the previous exams and answer keys to help practice. Do the practice exams!! He recycles questions with the numbers changed. Happy to answer questions.

I actually loved taking this class. Dr. Knight is an engaging lecturer with relevant explanations of concepts. He gives many tips on studying and preparing for the tests. Listen to the lectures and do the practice problems, and this class is understandable and enjoyable.

Professor Knight is an amazing lecturer. I took macro online and actually looked forward to watching the lectures just because of how interesting they were. Very easy to understand the content and not a very difficult class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
Dr. Knight is an amazing educator.  I took his online class and it was extremely well organized.  His lectures are amazing.  Every big concept is broken down into smaller and smaller pieces, then plugged back into the larger concept.

He is strict with grading though, but that won't matter if you just listen to his lectures.

Prof. Knight is one of the best professors I have ever had, he gives all of the resources needed to get an A, and as long as you utilize everything he gives you you'll do fine. His lectures are great, but I would still recommend getting study edge as there are some things he doesn't explain well. Overall a great and engaging teacher!!

I really liked Professor Knight. This class was good, I struggled in it mainly because I didn't know how to study for the exams. They are hard, but he gives you what you need to prepare for the mostly. His lectures were good and in depth, and he overall just seemed like a great guy. For what I think is naturally a hard class, this was pretty good.

Do not fall behind on the work. It's easy just will take a minute to understand if youve never taken an economics course. Only quizzes and tests. I fell behind one week and got a C on two quizzes and my grade stayed at a C. Quizzes are simple just pay attention and you will do fine. Lectures are very thorough and many examples which is good
This guy's lectures are INCOMPREHENSIBLE avoid at all costs. Teaches nothing that you will have to know on the impossibly difficult exams. Only reason to go to lecture is the required Iclicker.

Dr. Kodikara was a good lecturer who was more understandable than Dr. Takano. Exams were 20 questions each and worth 25%. There is IClicker in this course, worth a possible 5% extra credit on top of the grade. This was an extremely difficult course. The average for all exams when I took it was 12/20, which speaks volumes. Utilize office hours!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: 1/3 professors I had for phy2 w/calc, he was the best. Extremely to-the-point lectures with some student interaction alongside a thorough commitment to understanding. The 3 exams in this class are extremely difficult and worth 25% of your grade each. Hours studying left me with slightly above avg results, despite my pretty strong understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: 100% recommend. Attendance isn't mandatory but your grade consists of in class assignments and a few exams. In class assignments are done with your table group and graded on participation as we go over the answers in class. Everything you need to know for exams will be gone over the class before the exam (just study!) and there's no surprises.
If you need a science credit, take this class. It is great.

Professor Kenney is a great prof!!! He has very clear lectures and outlines for the exams, so its hard to get anything below an A. There's usually an easy group assignment every week based on a short reading he will give, but its overall a very chill class and would recommend.

Easy A. He goes over the entire exam on review day, so even if you don't pay attention the entire unit, you can still score very high. He's a great professor and person; genuinely wants you to do well and is passionate about the class. The assignments are easy; you work with your group for all of them and require little effort from each member.

Took for a gen ed credit. SO KIND and wholesome. If you show up to most classes, you will get an A. Tests are based off lectures and he gives a review with basically everything you need to know. Sweetest soul ever! Thank you Dr. Kenney
Most assignments are done in-class and with a group, so attendance matters. Exams are clearly outlined and grading is straightforward. Just don't miss the review periods!

Professor Kenney clearly cares very much about his students and the material. As an environmental engineering major this class was not mandatory for me, but i found it very interesting and informative. He loves when people participate, and is very kind. He prepares you very well for exams(of which there are 4), and expectations are always clear.
Very kind guy. Always does reviews before exams that outline exactly what you need to know. He really wants us all to succeed and does what he can to help you out.

This class is perfect to take if you need a physical science credit. Professor Kenney is a really great guy and he basically outlines the tests during exam review so you know exactly what to study. Grade based off of 4 exams and some group work on Fridays. Definitely take him!

He's super nice :) and makes all the concepts pretty easy to understand. Your grade is based off of simple class assignments that you do with your group and 4 exams. The exams aren't hard if you pay attention in lectures and go to the exam review lectures; his exams are basically the exam reviews.

Really nice professor, class is really good for non-stem majors that need credit. Work in class, but if you show up you'll get full credit. Test review days are essential to go to class for, the test is based off of them. Easy science grade, would definitely take again :)

100% recommend this class. He is a great professor and makes everything easy to understand. If you put in the effort to learn what he teaches you, you will do great in this class. He's very caring and understanding and willing to work with you, if you are confused about something.

Professor Kenney is really kind and empathetic toward his students. He is very thoughtful toward the needs of students and really wants everyone to do well. He works really hard to make sure that everyone is adequately prepared for the tests. It is a fair amount of material but he is very direct with what you need to know and open to questions.
SUPER NICE and so helpful and you can tell he's passionate! Lectures can sometimes get boring but so worth it
Professor really knows what he is talking about. The class grade relies heavily on the exams; however, he has a review day and gives you all the material to study!

Professor Kenney is a very sweet man that cares more about students learning that grading. He will go out of his way to help you get the best possible grade in the class. Overall, this is a very easy and interesting class. Recommended if you struggle with science and want an A.

Dr. Kenney is honestly one of the sweetest, most understanding professors at UF. I don't even know how to put into words how much I appreciate him and his class. He makes the class really easy to follow for non-science major students, but he's more than willing to spend extra time with students who want to learn more. (taken synchronous-online)

Dr. Kenney is a great Professor and is extremely knowledgeable on the subjects he teaches on. He also brings in a lot of guest speakers which keeps the class entertaining and diverse. The course is basically graded on 3 exams and the final. All the exams follow the review directly and are very easy if you just watched the lectures even vaguely.

The tests were easy if you paid attention in class and took notes, also read the review powerpoints he gives. Good professor, sometimes boring but he is very nice and engaging, brought in some guest speakers - one of them talked about climate change and changed my life.

Cares about his students and always willing to do anything to help. Class is little to no work every week but very interesting/relevant subject matter, I learned so much. Grade based on 3 easy exams and a group project. He cares so much about his students actually learning and won't try to give you a hard time! Take if you need easy gen-ed!!!

He is a sweetheart. He is so, so caring for his students and their success in the class, and outside of it-- he is concerned that the material he is teaching is relevant and useful to us, "out in the real world." Lectures are interesting. He is always available to answer any questions with the utmost patience. Take him!

there is nothing else i can say about this man that hasnt already been said; jason portmess is a malicious man that intentionally designs this class in the most confusing and unfair way to ensure the failure of the entire class as he bases the majority of your grade off of nigh-impossible exams and gives objectively incorrect directions for labs.

Do not waste your time with this professor, if you need this class go take it at a community college and transfer the credit I am so serious the majority of the grade is based on the midterm and the final his questions on these are nonsensical he puts non lab content on the exams you cannot go back on questions in exam i would write more but limit

Should not be a professor. I have a 99% in lecture but a C in his class. I use all materials, yet exams cover random content. He's rude to everyone. It's frustrating to work hard for a GPA just to have it lowered bc he hates his life. Switch to a chem major to take a different lab, you'll be better off since it's nearly impossible to do well.
physics 2 with calc was easier than this

Not instrumental to learning. Sends long paragraphs on a weekly basis. Instructions are very difficult to comprehend. Very limited amount of review materials given, and the exams were NOT similar to the review materials. You have to take him because he's the only one teaching this section. However, easy to pass the class, just NOT with an A.

Prior to this class I had a 4.0. While I am still taking this course, I have never felt more scared for my grade ever. The midterm exam had ZERO study prep, just a practice exam that didn't cover much if any random content on the midterm. I probably got a 50(with others). I tried to read all the experiments, safety procedures, and more. Do not take

His emails are usually passive aggressive and demeaning, and exams include content that wasn't part of lecture or lab notes. The lab is harder than the main lecture. He constantly blames TA mistakes and students who "game the system" in announcements.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Exams on are random stuff you can't prep for and are the majority of ur grade (now on how u do in the actual lab). Demeaning emails. Everyone gets way worse grades in lab than in lecture but students are blamed.

The assessments and final are impossible to prepare for. Try to do well on the lab practical and hope thats good enough to pass after the curve. Avoid if possible.

Dr. Portmess's grading methods are inscrutably bizarre in ways that seem to have no purpose beside frustrating, frightening, and stressing students. dr portmess is the WORST professor i've ever had. I had him for orgo 1 and 2 and the orgo 2 lab and all three were horrible. he is unkind to his students and sends passive aggressive annoucements out

Barely got an A by the hair on my chinny chin chin. I truly do not think that he could have made this class any harder than it was. The final exam average was so bad he had to curve everyone's entire percentage by nearly 9% (for a lab btw), if that is an indicator as to how bad this class is...

The assessments are what made this class miserable. He makes it so that the knowledge checks and the lab final are rather difficult. The knowledge checks were very specific and challenging and the lab final was very different from the practice exam provided. It tested us on non-lab based content and everyone failed. He curved the class about 8.5%.

portmess is genuinely out to ruin ur life. under no circumstances should u take him. bro thinks 25 yrs of teaching experience justifies him quite literally tanking everyone's grade over a sorry lab final that lacked ANY relevance to lab instruction. a 35% average on a lab exam is inexcusable and someone needs to reevaluate this man's tenure.

i failed this man is evil. none of the horrible reviews on here are lying i promise you guys im a grinder but this class ruined me and i couldnt pass it with all my effort. i poured blood sweat and tears yet still count pass. the final was utterly ridiculous and nobody passed it. harder than lab and unnecessarily difficult. try to avoid him

this is the only professor that i felt was out to get me in my entire education career. dont let his rating being over 1 fool you, hes gotten exponentially evil over the years especially since summer 25'. the final avg was in the 30s. if you have to take his class consider picking up a religion first so you dont end it all.

Never have I ever questioned my time at UF more than when I had this class. My lab group would walk into class knowing it was our personal purgatory. He as well as the person who thought hiring him should be fired immediately.  I would drop stem rather than have another class with him.

awful. hes absolutely desipcable. this class made me severely depressed, and took a toll on my mental health. portmess is sent by the devil himself. i went from being a straight A student to this sorry C-. i barely passed btw. 100x harder than lecture, he has no regard for his students and idek why hes teaching lab if he wanna make it so hard.

Before I entered this class, I was a happy individual. I had friends. By the end, I had become a bitter shell of my former myself. I lost 15 lbs, stopped working out, quit most ECs. I had no friends. I spent everyday in the library as I studied for this class. By the end I got an A, but I never want to see chemistry gain. Nice guy tho.

DO NOT TAKE PORTMESS UNLESS YOU HAVE TO. Terrible professor that made taking orgo lab my worst nightmare. Everyone failed the final and he had to curve the class 6.9%. Never hated a class more and it was singlehandedly his fault.

I had Portmess for orgo lab, a class that is meant for gaining on hands experience of the concepts learned in orgo lecture. So tell me why this lab was so much harder than the lecture. The difficulty of the exams isn't properly accounted for until after everyone fails. Professor Portmess has a clear disregard for students and teaching us (wants you to know chem on an expert level), makes exams and knowledge checks extremely difficult. This lab is harder than the actual class. The knowledge checks and final have nothing to do with what we learn in class or lab. Most difficult lab teacher by far. There is no way to know what will be on any knowledge check or exam. I'm convinced he gets a little too much joy from watching us struggle. If you're into traumatic bonding experiences with your lab partners, I'd highly recommend.

I received an A, yet this was still easily the most abysmal course I have taken at UF. I am currently taking Organic II and Physics II, and this was much more difficult than both. Genuinely the worst class I've ever taken at UF. Portmess tests on such odd unimportant concepts and seems to like that people are doing poorly in this class. If you have the opportunity, choose another professor. He has frequent knowledge checks, and the majority of the questions are unreasonable (time included). This is for orgo 2 LAB. All orgo 2 lab kids got stuck with Portmess. His knowledge checks test lecture material he doesn't teach. Only allows notebooks, not our $50 manual. Locks grades on Canvas. Treats 2-credit lab like full lecture class. Half the questions aren't about actual labs. Pick another prof.

Just when I thought I would never pass this course.. Dr. J came through! He makes this god awful subject easier to get through with clear explanations and real world examples. Not the professor you want if you want to understand the material clearly and be confident in yourself. His exams are so hard that it is impossible to fail which makes him easier than the other organic teachers. Would recommend.

There are playposit lectures, which are unhelpful and ungraded. He releases assignments that correlate to in person lectures with a set time after class ends that are also ungraded. I recommend taking it literally anywhere else if you're an online student. He makes it easy for you to pass, but you may not learn anything.
This class took a good 5 years off my life, but was completely manageable tbh. YOU NEED STUDY EDGE. Use it as a supplement ON TOP of the lectures. Just do the extra assignments for practice and pray.

reviews.comment: I had him for orgo 1 and orgo 2 and got a b both semesters and he makes passing the class very achievable but class is flipped so make sure to stay ahead of the pacing guide he provides you so that at the end of the semester you dont run out of time.

Sure was a class! He is a menace to all UF chem students, but if you put in the work and time required for a class like orgo 2, you should perform okay. I accredit my success to a strong orgo 1 background (didnt take with Portmess) and learning his question style to mentally prepare yourself for the atrocity of every pacing assessment and exam.

He has an interesting way of organizing things, but gives material useful for exams, like practice problems that make you think outside of the box. Attendance not mandatory but you should make it so. Must watch his recorded lectures. Be ready to dedicate a lot of your time. He's hard but teaches in a way that makes you actually understand

I don't usually leave reviews, but I feel like future students deserve a heads-up. This class was one of the most challenging I've taken, not just because of the content but because of the way it's taught. The lectures and course materials didn't help me understand the material, so I had to seek help from an outside tutor just to keep up. BEWARE

People say portmess is hard because orgo 2 is hard and that's not true. It was entirely his style of teaching that was hard to keep up with. provides a lot of resources, but hard to get that A. I prefer a in-person lecture style, and he does it flipped and it took me TIME to adject. I didn't learn much orgo 2, i learned more about stewies tho

Makes you read a long, condescending manifesto. You have to use a forum outside Canvas to get help with homework, but if no one comes up with the right answer, he won't help. Great professor. Don't listen to people who did poorly in his class because they were too lazy to put in the work needed. it's organic, it's going to be hard, but you NEED to put in the work to be successful. Portmess will give you more than enough tools and practice to be successful in his class. Stay on pace and practice.

reviews.comment: I could say a lot about this class, but most of it has been said in other reviews. This was by far the worst class and professor I have ever had. You will not learn, and the entire grading scale is based on competetion. I dropped this course and am taking it with a much better professor from whom I am actually learning. Don't take this guy's class.

Portmess is not that bad. He provides all the information we need, just need us to work hard after class. Orgo1 is no easy task, but as long as you're on pace, you'll be perfectly fine. Makes it easy to pass but virtually impossible to get an A due to only giving top percentage the A as opposed to normal grading scale. Incredibly difficult exams with 40% averages. Goodluck if you have him!

The end of his last name "mess" describes this class. Students are pinned against one another to earn points and very little learning is done. Instead of fueling competition, the teacher should focus on teaching the material.

The way the class is set up put everyone against each other. Study groups can't be a thing because you hurt and help the other persons grade depending on how you do. The exams are online and not representative of what is given in class. There are a lot of practice materials and I did it all but still was drowning.

Unfortunately, I echo the same sentiments as the others. I think the course focuses too much on a mystery grading scale and stressing out students. Lectures and materials are dense and complicated to finish.

Dr. J's class is a competition between your peers. Students are more focused on chasing points to receive a letter grade than learning the material. How is this setting up students for future classes and success on exams like the MCAT and DAT? I've had a B all year, and after the absurd final exam, I will be finishing with the bare minimum. Buy

Dr. J intentionally pins students against each other turning an already difficult class into a competition. My grade was an A throughout and the final was so hard it plummeted. If you have him I wouldn't even bother studying because the questions have nothing to do with Organic chemistry. You cannot go back after answering the previous question.

reviews.comment:
If you aren't sure if you should take him: it is very demoralizing. it is NOT about learning. He fosters a toxic classroom environment. Intentionally delivers info confusingly. Apparently, everyone passes?
If you already have him: do you best to stay on pace or ahead. Try to do well on LTPs, he might give extra points at the end. You will be okay!

Dr J is one of the worst professors I have ever had. his class is a giant mind game. he makes the class a big competition, almost exclusively asks trick questions, and has extremely unrealistic expectations on exam timing and difficulty.  Every test has a failing grade as the average. you can do everything he says and more and still not do well.

If you care about your GPA or getting A's, do not take orgo 1 with him. His exams and ltp quizzes are wonky and written weirdly. He uses all these abbreviations and expects you to memorize a ton of molecules. His exams are nothing like his ltp questions or even the textbook problem. Take his class if you just want to barely pass with a C.

Dr. J is a great teacher. He provides an insane amount of practice work and is readily available in discussion boards to answer your questions. PAY ATTENTION IN CLASS! This is so useful for his exams, which yes, are very difficult. My only critique is I'm not a fan of the competitive environment because your grade is dependent on everyone else's.

reviews.comment: Dr. J's class worked well with my learning style because all the material that you learn is readily accessible online as videos (this was updated in recent semesters) and the amount of (optional) supplementary materials was very useful to help you really understand the material. He also responds quickly to forum posts should you need clarification.
Dr. J's class is challenging but rewarding. Stay focused, use study aids like unstuckstudy AI, and you'll learn a ton. His teaching style takes adjusting, but TA sessions are super helpful.

This class was made to be extremely difficult and Dr. J does not help that. He runs a flipped classroom and you basically have to learn all the material yourself. I don't mind hard work but this was extra and unnecessary. His tests are impossible and make you feel stupid. You will pass but you will walk out of every exam feeling so bad.
