Lectures are pretty good and comprehensive of what you can expect on the exam, but some out of class learning is needed. Exams 1 and 2 are very easy but Exams 3 and 4 become more difficult with the content. If you do all of the easy extra credit assignments she will add 3% to you final grade which is very helpful.

Ms. Shabazz is incredible. She took this insanely difficult subject and made it as understandable as possible. I am a chem major but I will say everyone else in the class seems to be either engineering or comp sci and they had a much easier time with understanding. I have never been good at math but I think I might be able to pass this class.

The video lectures (which aren't hers, and that's ok I guess) are terrible and do not reflect what is on the exam. Half of the time you spend studying is spent trying to find out wtf to study before you realize that you need to stop looking at the lectures entirely and just study the LQs using youtube.

Not the greatest lecturer, the way she goes through the lecture is pretty confusing. She is very helpful during office hours, but the exams felt harder than the ones we had from previous years. She writes the exams and I feel like she could have gone a little easier. Lots of homework assignments.

The lectures were super great and made the material as easy to understand as possible; however the class is super super hard. I got study edge after the first exam and it was a great study tool that helped me and was the only reason I passed the class!

Coming from AP Calc BC, I was so nervous to take Calc 3. Yet, I think she was a great professor, she taught pretty well but I used study edge for backup if I didn't get something. Tests are very fair, HW is hard but she knows and will help you out. She wants you to do well! Many chances to bring ur grade up!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Shabazz was the best! She was really nice and even cracked a few jokes here and there to lighten the mood. She had a clear and structured teaching style and did not mind answering questions in class at all. She gave plenty of extra credit!

Shabazz makes it clear how to do well and how to get help if you want it. She wants you to succeed and I enjoyed taking calculus 3 with her. It's hard work, but it always felt worthwhile and there was support whenever I needed it.

Dr. Shabazz was an incredible professor and made the concepts and problems covered in the class easy to understand with the large amounts of practice problems! While she did make some mistakes during lectures, her humor and character made them enjoyable. Take advantage of the extra credit offered, it makes a significant impact on your final grade.

Took Calc BC in HS and this class my freshman fall. Shabazz is a fun and engaging lecturer but sometimes made mistakes and didn't properly explain topics, especially towards the end of the class. Tests/topics get increasingly difficult. Don't underestimate quizzes, as they add up. Make sure to do the HW, EC, and practice exams.

Don't go to lectures, she makes too many mistakes while going over content that it's not worth it. Watch Ian Manly's lectures instead, if you understand the concepts at a conceptual level or have already taken physics this class is pretty easy

While Shabazz may make a good bit of mistakes in her lectures, her sense of humor and attitude can make up for it. She gives a fair bit of extra credit opportunities and you'll enjoy her class if you somewhat enjoy calculus as a subject. The mistakes she makes are small, but they can be numerous, so stay on top of the material and you'll be fine.
Shabazz gives A LOT of extra credit opportunities which is really helpful. Her lecturer are good but I recommend using study edge for chapter and exam reviews

Dr. Shabazz was amazing and her rating should be higher! I was scared coming in from high school calc and jumping to calc 3 but she made the course very doable if you put the time and effort into it. She gives TONS of extra credit, so as long as you stay on top of the material and go to her office hours for questions you will get a good grade.

Prof Shabazz was the best prof I have ever had at UF! I don't know how she has such a low rating! Her lectures are clear and she goes slow enough that you have time to comprehend the information. Her exams are straightforward and she gives a lot of extra credit. This was my 3rd attempt at calc 3. My advice: watch lectures, do the HW, & work hard!

Shabazz was a really fun teacher. She makes lectures interesting and easy to follow. She goes through the material somewhat fast, but when someone asked for help she immediately went into further detail to explain it better. Overall a good professor. She gives tons of EC opportunities.

I loved Shabazz, she's a pretty good lecturer and is easy to understand. Plus she's kind and has a fun personality! Yes she makes small mistakes but she corrects herself quickly. It's difficult but not nearly as bad as Calc 2. Very easy to get an A in this class if you do all the HW and extra credit.
Professor Shabazz does a great job explaining the difficult content. You can tell she cares about us as students and if we do well. I would love to take her again.

I have no idea what I paid a couple grand to take this course for. I didn't see a single lecture, video, review session, or notes of her own posted the entire semester. She uses notes and lectures from other professors, takes a month to respond to discussion board questions, and the exams and homework don't line up at all with the lecture material.

Lectures go quick but she posts them after for you to watch again. Makes exams very comparable to what we learned. Offers extra office hours around exams and communicates with students well. She is the most involved I have seen a Calc Prof and it shows.
Professor Shabazz gives extra office hours before exams to help us prepare and is always willing to help.  Lectures are solid.  Gives a fair amount of extra credit.
Quality lectures but a good amount of homework.
Dr. Shabazz is good at lecturing and gives lots of extra credit. She is funny in class and gives good notes.

Dr. Shabazz is a great professor! She really explains the notes and always asks for questions during lectures. There are tons of office hours between all the TAs and professors. If you put in the work for the class it should be easy to get a good grade. Her lectures are also recorded so you can watch them later. She also gives a lot of extra credit
I would not have passed this class without using study edge. She did not explain answers, just did the questions and moved on. Study edge helped me to actually learn the material.
She is really helpful during office hours before exams and she really cares if we do well.

This was the hardest class I have taken! I took AP Calc in high school & even that didn't prepare me for the difficulty of the exams in the class. She makes the class way harder than it needs to be. Her lectures are useless because she makes so many mistakes while teaching.The only way I passed was using Study Edge and memorizing her exam problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I really like Dr. Shabazz.  Her lectures are great. I'm actually in another profs class but I attend her lectures because they're that good. There's a lot of homework but it's like that with all math classes. She provides a lot of study material and extra credit. Try to get her for lectures.

I love Dr. Shabazz! Out of all the Calc 3 professors at UF she is by far the best. She lectures at a manageable pace and is willing to accept feedback/questions from students. She brightens my day by making jokes and conversation during lecture. Every Calc 3 teacher has the same load of homework, exams, and extra credit.

Worst class I have ever taken. Lectures and homework take hours to do and are only worth 1 or 2 points. Meanwhile her tests are worth almost 90 points with near impossible questions. She posts lectures from other professors which hardly ever line up with the difficulty of the homework, lecture quizzes, or tests. Too much content, too little time
This professor gave good lectures.  I watched them again on video. Take her!

The absolute worst calculus teacher I have experienced so far in my academic career. I did not know it was possible to be so terrible at lecturing a class. She constantly makes mistakes and does not explain what she is doing. If she is an option for a class run as far away as you possibly can. Never again.

the lectures were fast but she gave a lot of opportunities to ask questions and she seemed very accessible and liked. The study reviews helped a lot and she told you exactly what would be on exams. there's also extra credit available. Math is hard so you're going to have to put in some effort to pass but it was just an average class to me

Prof Shabazz is NOT as bad as people make her out to be. The lectures can be fast, but it's because whenever she stops for questions, no one participates. There are unlimited tries on homework, a lot of extra credit, and tests are tough but fair with plenty of review material. If you're hopeless at math, it might be tough, but that's not her fault.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I actually enjoyed attending class. Tests are tough but she provides a lot of review materials.
Go to office hours she explains topics a lot better there. Chill prof. In person and online are same but in person gets extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She lectures at an incredibly fast rate, and skips over a lot of essential math knowledge because she assumes that you know it already. Tests are overly complicated and hard. The questions on the tests are far more rigorous than the in class questions. The homework is also very hard and takes a long time.
I had already had Calculus in HS but the lectures were clear and understandable. Lots of extra credit opportunities.

Old practice exams and reviews are a great resource for studying because they had questions structured very similar to the real thing. She did tend to go by quickly in lecture and sometimes made mistakes, so at times I would end up learning the material from the homework. Do the extra credit, since that can add up to 3 percent to your grade.
I really enjoyed Dr. Shabazz's class. She taught with a lot of energy and was able to keep my attention. Test's aren't easy but she provides a lot of resources to help prepare.
This class requires a lot of studying but you can do well if you attend lectures and stay on top of homework. Dr. Shabazz is laid back and a good lecturer.
Lectures are really helpful. There is a lot of homework but if you keep up the class isn’t that bad. There is extra credit too.

In our class, she made the clicker questions extra credit. The class was difficult with understanding the concepts but the lectures were very helpful as long as you paid attention and took notes. I highly recommend doing the reviews for exams because they help a lot.

Prof Shabazz does a good job explaining the material and her review materials are helpful for reviewing for exams. Her review materials are much better than Study edge as the old exams are similar to the exams.
Lectures were sometimes hard to follow or professor would go through information too quickly. Used Study Edge which definitely saved my grade in this class.
If I didn't have Study Edge for this class there is no way I would have gotten a good grade. Study Edge has a lot of helpful materials to implement the concepts and get you prepared for the exams!
The only reason I passed this class was because of study edge. They really broke down the modules and explained everything in depth that helped me pass the class

This class should not have been as tedious as it was. I believe this was because of the professor's teaching style. She would speed through lectures just to get them done, even if more than half the class didn't understand. I used Study Edge for this class, which helped me pass. They broke down material a lot better and took the time to teach it.
Missy Shabazz runs this class at an impossible pace. She also loves to put questions on the test that are not reviewed in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: A lot of people complain about her but she's not really all that bad if you already took some calc in high school, I thought the material was pretty easy but as the semester went on I found her lectures to be useless and a waste of time tbh. If you want to work smarter and not harder just get study edge and do her practice tests

The way Pr. Shabazz explains the material is very confusing. It certainly is possible to get an A in this class, but be prepared to learn everything on your own. Study guides are somewhat helpful, but don't solely rely on them. Go to class and do the EC questions on TopHat because EC is 3%! If you have to take the class, you'll survive.
Use MML for all homework and quizzes. Exams are 10x harder than anything she teaches or we do in MML. Only reason I got an A is because of study edge. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITHOUT STUDY EDGE.

Professor was extremely disconnected with her students. Homework took ages to complete and didnt reflect any of the material on the exams. Quizzes were never gone over and little help was given in any context. Would NEVER take with this professor again.

Shabazz may be the worst lecturer I've ever had. If I hadn't already taken Calculus in high school this class would be impossible. Her exams are tough and the weekly quizzes and homeworks do not reflect material seen on exams. On the bright side, she offers a ton of extra credit. (However, this is only because she knows without it majority fail.)
Not a good teacher. Most people were always confused during lecture. Dont take.

The content of the class itself is hard but I honestly didn't think Prof. Shabazz was too bad. She makes occasional mistakes during lectures but is always willing to answer questions and further explain concepts if someone is confused. Exams can be tough, but her grading scale is generous and there is a lot of EC! I recommend studyedge as well!

Shes just a really bad lecturer and often messes up her own math during these. The online quizzes dont reflect whats on the exam at all. Unfortunately shes the only person who teaches this class. Did well because of studyedge.

The class isnt that bad if you do all the homework and buy her printed notes. Then go to every in person lecture and pay attention. The homework isnt that similar to the tests but if you do all the work an A is definitely attainable. It also helps if you took Calc in high school. Be prepared to teach yourself some stuff but overall not that bad.

USE STUDY EDGE. She is a nice woman, but she didn't teach very well. The homework and quizzes arent anything like the Exams, which makes no sense. I took AP Calc AB last year and I had a strong foundation. I also took every bit of notes possible and STILL couldnt succeed. The pace of the class was very fast and not much of it made sense. Study Edge
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I ended up teaching myself the class through study edge, and I recommend anyone who has to take this course use study edge to get good grades. She would put questions on the test that we never went over in homework that unit even though the unit exams were non cumulative.

This Professor does not teach, She doesn't teach you the concepts in class but excepts you to know how to use them on the test. The homework and quizzes on my math lab doesn't help one bit because it's too easy and nowhere near the intensity of the test. worst experience I've had with a professor and I really enjoy math.

Sweet woman, I understand her lectures (sometimes) but her tests will be on everything you did not learn/practice. Hardest and most confusing tests. I suggest organic chem tutor because without him I got Ds on the first few exams with taking calc in high school.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is incredibly difficult, and I really like math...

This is the hardest math class I have ever taken and the professor does not help one bit. You practically go to class just to learn everything yourself at home. There is an immense amount of homework that is so much harder than what she goes over in class. The exams are impossible too.

The class itself is very easy. lectures are useless. She provides her lectures notes in canvas. STUDY OFF OF THOSE. Homework is very easy, quizzes are not timed. Tests are horrendous. Covers almost nothing covered in class. Her reviews are posted by students who have messy handwriting. LEARN EVERYTHING YOURSELF. be warned.

Missy Shabazz... Where do I begin? If you're looking for a professor that will recycle lectures and not host meetings for her own class, teach in the most complicated and incoherent ways possible, and fail to effectively assist students in comprehending the course material, then she's the one for you chief. Do NOT take this course online.

Class was doable but only because I used Study Edge. Very difficult and lectures do not really explain material very well. Everything (Test, Homework, and Quizzes) are all on Pearson so its very difficult because her lectures do not reflect that.

Dr. Shabazz's class isn't a walk in the park by any means, so you have to put in the time and work. Everything in this class is consolidated into each other within MML (i.e. Homeworks into Quizzes, Reviews into Exams, etc.). The key to this class is MML, so do ALL of the work on there and you'll be fine. Also, take asynchronous, it's less work.
The class is very disorganized. Also, the majority of grades come from exams. The only good thing is she offers extra credit that is 5% added to your overall grade.

Shabazz is a decent lecturer and explains everything clear during the lecture. She made some really simple mistakes during the lectures, but it is still acceptable. However, her HWs and Exams are quite challenging. Shabazz is a nice lady, but honestly, this is the toughest math class I've ever had. Gotta put effort into it to get an A.

Toughest math class I've ever taken. For a 3 credit course, Shabazz has numerous opportunities to make the class more simple for her students which she simply does not choose to take. The lectures cover a couple examples which the MML HW, reviews, and tests take to a much higher level than necessary. Be ready to learn all material on your own time.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The class really isn't that difficult, so i was able to teach myself most of it through the homeworks and extra credit reviews. The reviews boost your grade and are relevant. Her lectures, however, are not useful. She is a nice lady, but she did not help me succeed in this class.

The class is do-able if you are a hard worker but don't expect a good grade if you are a bad test taker. Gives many assignments due all in a row ex. a quiz on Good Friday, incredibly hard 20 question hw due night of easter, 50 question exam review due the monday after easter & a test starting at 5pm same day. Do not expect any free time. good luck

Dr Shabazz's MAC2233 was the hardest and most unorganized math class I've ever taken. Half the questions on the MML hw and exams are 100 times harder than the ones she teaches in lectures and I've spent many nights crying over not being able to do my homework. I can't understand why some of the recent reviews think she's so great. WORST CLASS EVER
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Despite the critiques by some below, Professor Shabazz is excellent. Many students were rude and only didnt do well because they didnt study. She was organized and wanted everyone to succeed. She gave extra effort during the pandemic and most of us really appreciated it.

Shabazz took questions from students during lectures and reviewed everyones MML exams for errors. Class was full of cheating & stupid idiots which made the class kinda suck. The group work wasnt useful, because it was over zoom, so basically everyone did one problem and hoped everyone did theirs correctly. No difeqs or trig, which made it easier.

Shabazz is a good professor that gives MML unit reviews before every exam AND makes videos of most missed questions on each midterm for students to prepare for the final. There is EC that can raise your final grade by 5% (do them all). Sometimes she would not finish lectures because students come in late and ask the same question many times.

gives a LOT of extra credit opportunities and is very helpful. She is also very accessible. She treats her students like adults and wants the best out of them. Her lectures were often slow and we did get behind a few lessons, but that was because of the students. Overall, she wants her students to feel comfortable. Worksuccess

As this is a class mostly taken by freshmen, I am not surprised they complain so much. Believe me, I am sophomore and this was such an accessible and overall easy class if you put the work into it. It is true, there is a lot of homework every week but exams are exactly as the reviews she provides and she gives a 5% Extra Credit towards final grade

Get ready to learn the material outside the classroom. Personally didn't like her teaching style because I learned absolutely nothing from her. However, she is a nice lady. Do all the extra credit opportunities she gives because it'll add 5% to your final grade. Ended up with a 97 without StudyEdge by reviewing past homework.

Shabazz took questions from students during lectures and reviewed everyones MML exams for errors. Class was full of cheating & stupid idiots which made the class kinda suck. The group work wasnt useful, because it was over zoom, so basically everyone did one problem and hoped everyone did theirs correctly. No difeqs or trig, which made it easier.

For the class, make sure you do the extra credit and all of the homework assignments. These points will be crucial for when you fail the impossible exams. Shabazz on the other hand is super rude. Has zero consideration for students' personal issues, does not answer emails, and overall does not seem to care.

Shabazz does not know how to teach. You have to go to the lectures, but trust me you will learn nothing. She does not respond to emails, she is rude to students on zoom, she ignores mental health concerns, and if you have COVID, you will get 0s for everything you missed (no making up assignments or quizzes). Get study edge. Worst professor ever.

I couldn't even begin to explain how horrifying she is at teaching. I don't understand why she thinks answering 2 questions during a lecture is even considered teaching. Literally, sell your life to study edge and start praying that's your only option. Does give EC but doesn't do that much. Avoid taking the class with her if possible.

I took calculus in high school and still can barely pass this class. worst teacher Ive ever had. Never gets through an entire lecture and then will post an hour lecture of what she didnt get through. Ended up watching 6 hours of class for a 3 hour class. Sucks because she is the only teacher, if you can take this at your local community college

Please get study edge if you're taking this class. Because it was in an online format it was so much harder than it needed to be because of my math lab. I would do great on her old exams when I took them for practice and then fail the real ones. Horrible professor, never got through the lectures, honestly just mute her and watch the other prof.

Dr. Shabazz is one of the worst math teachers I have ever had. She barely knows what she's teaching and is just horrible all around. I only passed this class because of Study Edge and I highly recommend investing in it if you haven't already. You might not have a choice but to take her class so definitely get study edge if you aren't good at calc.

Freshman who took AP Calc senior year of high school, this class was incredibly difficult. Can't believe Shabazz was this bad. Overall a good person at heart but horrible teacher. Barely gets through lectures so we have to self teach about 95% of the material. Thank god I took AP calc in high school or I would be absolutely failing. Take in-person.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: might have been one of the worst math teachers i have had. she gets to maybe 2 pages out of at least 10 of each lecture in class and then you have to teach yourself the rest and more by the time the next class comes. homework load is also so much and at first it was easy you just click the show an example thing on math lab but SHE TOOK IT AWAY

Worst I've had at UF. Polite when face to face, but has no desire to teach or respond to emails, and shows no leniency for any issues outside of class. Exams are incredibly hard and not at all related to HW, quizzes, or practice exams. If you have to take her, take every tutoring apt you can, do ALL of the extra credit and hope for the best.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I have never had to put so much time into a class until I took this one. Highly reccomemd getting Study Edge and doing all the extra credits in order to get a good grade. She is a horrible teacher.

I am really not sure where to start with her. She makes some of the hws unnecessarily long, but luckily they are NOTHING like the exams. You are basically on your own for this class. Odds are shes your only option, so you just gotta deal with it, but luckily she has extra credit. This will help you A LOT. Useless lectures-your TA does a better job

Dr Shabazz is overall a nice person, but the worst teacher. There's homework due every day which can take hours to complete, and had nothing to do with the exams. It was a major struggle for me. The only reason I pulled off a decent grade was because of the extra credit. If you want to do well, get study edge, because the class will be a nightmare.

Trust me, she is the easiest professor you can get for a calculus class. Although the amount of homework may be an overkill, her lectures are very informative and necessary in order to succeed. She gave a heap load of extra credit on top of adding giving 10 free points on each exam. Look over the criticisms of others, trust me, it isn't that bad.

This class was definitely challenging, but I know that for some it was not. There is lots of HW, probably about an average of 4-6 MyMathLab assignments per week. Along with group quizzes and group-work assignments during lab time. Those weren't so bad though. She is funny sometimes.

Tons of homework online, but definitely doable if you stay on top of it. If you get study edge for the course you'll be completely fine, she also gives 7% extra credit on top of your final grade at the end of the semester if you have done all of the extra credit throughout the course.
don't do it it's impossible you will spend hours of every night being tutored at the tutoring center and still do bad on the exams i did not have study edge and it was almost impossible

Overall, horrible teacher. Class is 3 times a week but she still manages to always be behind. In the 50 minutes period she covers 3 examples at most. Extremely impersonal. Length and difficulty of homework should be illegal. Each hw assignment takes about 4 hours and at least 4 of them are assigned a week. She is the reason I switched my major.

I was able to do well in this course because Im naturally good at math. The only reason I was able to understand the material was because of the TA discussion classes. Shabazz is a horrible lecturer and rushes through the material. She makes up for her inability to teach by offering extra credit. practice eximas are accurate to the exams.

How to teach calc by Melissa: 1. Do only the first page of notes for the lecture 2. Assign hard homework 3. Ignore all emails 4. Give students ONE practice test 4. Make a test that's completely different from the practice test. 5. Repeat. Use Study Edge for this class and you will do good.

Friendly but hardly responds to emails, rushes through multiple lectures in one class period, none of the practice exams correlate to the actual exams, homework due every night that have little to do with what we learn in class. Unless you are ready and able to successfully teach yourself calculus with hardly any guidance, DO NOT take this class.

Having little experience with calculus, I was expecting to work hard but to also have a thorough teacher. Lectures were clear and homework was sometimes easy but often with harder problems in it. Exams were nothing like lectures and sometimes not even like the study guide. I was lost throughout the course.
Super engaging and funny in class. Tests arent easy but if you study theyre doable. Take her.

I never took any form of Calculus in high school. Before entering this class be sure to understand the concepts of Calculus, because the professor isn't the best at teaching it. Almost failed the class, but Study Edge was clutch in getting my A. Honestly, best of luck. Nothing comes easy in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very unorganized and her tests can range from being very easy to super hard. We were often behind schedule and she would tell us what was on quizzes the day before. If you have never taken Calculus before, this class will be time consuming but it's not hard to get a good grade because of the lenient scale. Avoid this teacher and use study edge.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Worst test writer ever. Makes tests impossible for students that have never been exposed to the material. Horrible lecturer. Worst teacher I've ever had. Highly impersonal. Only cares about the color purple (weird, but true). Avoid this professor at all costs. I only came out with an A because of previous experience. Save yourselves and run away
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Never finishes a lecture, makes exams so hard that past exams and review sheets can't even help you prepare for it, is confused about everything else going on in class, only cares about the color purple.

Literally doesn't even teach during the lectures. She expects you to know how to doe everything on your own. Worst professor I've had yet, especially for a math professor. Provides no explanation for each problem she solves so all of her students just end up lost and confused. Overall, terrible. Don't recommend.

Calc II is one of the more challenging math classes at UF and Ms. Shabazz was my professor for it for Spring 2019. I took flipped and regret it, I did not enjoy that teaching style. Ms. Shabazz is a nice professor and a good human, and she helps a lot. Just be careful of flipped and don't fall behind, but overall I recommend if you're into flipped.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Shabazz was a fun professor. I actually looked forward to going to class. That said Calculus 2 is not easy and you have to be consistent with keeping up with work. I would definitely take her again.

There is an excessive amount of work to do. She assigns a lot of online homework (quizzes) and group worksheets are due every week. The groups work is graded as a whole on accuracy so make sure you are in a group with good people who know what theyre doing. She does prepare you for the tests though. Also took her for MAC2312 and it was the same.
So much better than high school AP Calculus

you earn what you work for. She was such a wonderful professor, she was hard but in the fairest way possible. I would definitely take another class with her. She was always available to go over concepts that you dont understand and she genuinely cared about us as people as well as students.

Many people did not like Shabazz, but I freaking loved her. She is one of the most amazing women I have met and she is incredibly helpful during lecture. She is actually quite organized, despite many people saying she is not. 127 is not an easy course, no one should expect it to be easy. Shabazz does a wonderful job teaching the material!
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Good teacher that makes expectations clear. Study over your previous homework assignments--get to know the problems inside and out--and you'll do fine. She also posts full tests from previous years for you to study, and it's a great tool.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I enjoyed this class even if Shabadass is obsessed with purple. Go to lectures, take notes, go to labs, study old homework and old exams and you'll do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests? Not many--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I thought this was the best Calculus class of the three. I like going to lectures.
PreCalculus is a really hard class but Shabazz was helpful and fun.

If you've done well in math classes in the past (passed Calc II on your first try with a B or higher), you'll be fine. She'll try to help if you reach out for it, but she's not very good at dumbing it down for struggling students.
Listen to her when she says to study homework and group word for exams and you'll do fine.
She really cares about you as a person and your future. Go see Shabazz in her office hours.
Shabazz has been one on my favorite teachers at Ku!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Terrible at teaching, I could teach a class better than her. Material was not even relevant to tests. Just took the final which had things thrown on there that were not even on the review. I went to every class, had a tutor, and studied hard. Barley passing which I had all A's coming here. Worst Teacher i've ever had. Avoid being in her class.
The first test was tough.  But she prepared us well for the second midterm.  Her lectures are engaging. It's not as hard as 126 but still difficult. Overall she's a great person and good teacher.
Great teacher, cares about students and is very helpful and available outside of class :-)

Tough grader!  Hard to plan ahead for her class; she changes the schedule every week.  Teaches straight out of this horrible book, and you usually get only one example of new problems.  She expects you to know everything from past math classes.  She is very friendly, so much that it's distracting in class because she talks off topic so much.

Dr. Shabazz is by far the best math professor that I have had so far. Her class can be challenging and some weeks she likes to go crazy with the homework/quizzes, but overall her class is manageable. She is very friendly, has conversations during lecture, and is willing to help anyone who asks for it. I would definitely recommend her to everyone.

If you watch pre-recorded lectures at 2x speed and follow along with the guided notes, you will know how to do everything. The study guides she makes are SUPER important. Course lectures are outdated but 720p doesn't stop me from learning. You don't need to buy extra materials

Most of her videos are outdated, have poor video/audio quality, and are a chore to sit through. Her explanations were often rushed and unhelpful. Lots of homework and pointless busywork. Exams make up 75% of total grade and she has a very unfair grading scale. Offers extra credit that makes almost no difference. Very frustrating experience overall
If the teacher updated her materials we would not need to buy outside resources. Nevertheless my exam 1 and 2 grade were solid As thanks to teachmezach, best service for this class.

She has a different mic problem every single lecture. nothing is explained well and everything seems to be explained in a rushed manner. Everyone else on here is recommending for students to buy some other course material from a third party and that just shows how poor her teaching is.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do the ECs before they are due(saves time & is easy).The professor is empathic and considerate. One of my favorite so far at UF. Use TeachMeZach if you aren't great with numbers and applications. His videos explain the materials better than her pre-recorded videos because hers seems so outdated. Don't need the textbook for this class.

She is very lenient with homework (able to complete EACH for full credit 5 whole days after due date). Her online lectures were much more helpful than those short prerecorded videos. Offers some EC, an easy project thing, and exams are fair. I didn't study for the final exam a lot so my grade dropped from B+ to B-. Watch lectures and do practice Qs
Tmz all the way! Zach saved my grade after exam 1. Had all the updated content and so happy I learned about him. Mocko is kind but her videos are old and some outdated.

Idk if I just didn't understand the topics at all but I went through and watched her videos, did the homework, and would do the 100+ question exam reviews and nothing helped. I couldn't grasp a single concept and her teaching didn't help me understand anything!

I would have had an A had I done the extra credit. Don't blow it off like I did. Mocko seems to care about the success of her students, and gives you all the tools you need to succeed. Some of her older pre-recorded lectures have poor quality and can be hard to sit through, but the content is good.

Tons of hw but it's hw that's actually like the exams. The exams aren't hard AT ALL, I studied maybe 5 hours for each and did very well. The 100+ practice q's are a godsend. The prof is great, and she made me enjoy stats (mind u i bombed intro to stats). Just watch her pre-rec lectures and take good notes. Don't waste your money on study edge

I love Mocko! The videos could be updated, but it wasn't that bad. If you know basic stats principles, this class will be a breeze. I barely put in any effort and should end up with an A-. The little homework assignments about data are kinda goofy but whatever.

For those that say you dont need teachmezach, good for them. Some of us have not taken stats in years and zach breaks down all the modules and the 100 plus problems. I am taking a break from studying to say if you need a resource there is one out there that is amazing.

This was genuinely the most frustrating class I have ever taken. Sure, there's materials provided for you to succeed, but most of it is so arbitrary and will never be used. I need to do 100+ question exam reviews when 90% of the material in the review won't be on the test? This class felt like a waste of time. It is a required class, just bare it.
You do not need zach trust me!! The lectures and practice problems are all you need to succeed. Really amazing professor and workload is very manageable :)
So understanding, good amount of projects, she clearly cares about her students. I really respect her.

3 tests is the bulk of the grade. LOTS, I mean LOTS of assignments. Homework will correlate to the tests. Used Zach like everyone else, has the most up to date content, best price, and saved me a lot of time.

Class is relatively straightforward. There are 3 exams, and she gave us 100+ practice questions, which are comparable to the exam. A ton of busy work in this class, including filming videos to send to students at other schools. Some assignments where you'd have to physically go somewhere, like a . There are 5 points of extra credit too.

Dr. Mocko was a great professor and teaches the material very straight forward. She also has a 5 day late extension for nearly all assignments so it's never an issue to get things done on time. The exams were exactly like the practice problems; if you feel confident on those you'll do well on the exam.

There was annoying busy work, and her videos were sometimes hard to get through, but overall, the class is pretty easy. It's not hard to do well on exams. Doing the practice questions prepared me very well for the exams. If you feel confident doing those, you'll be fine. There's also easy extra credit to get, so do that.

So much content and busy work. The lectures aren't the best quality or updated to match the current functions. I watched the lectures and used Zach to soldify the content and study. Do the 100 practice questions and go over homework problems. Exam 2 was the hardest and Exam 1 was the easiest.

Unnecessary busy work, but the content was manageable if you watch the lectures and do the shell notes. She's very kind and the extra credit helps a lot. Make sure to do all of her practice problems and you should be fine.

While she seems like a good person and passionate about the topic, the course is frustrating in many ways. The production quality of the lecture videos (where you actually learn, unlike the in-person lectures) is far below the expected quality of a school like UF, and the presentation of information is far worse than a resource such as StudyEdge.

This class isn't bad at all! If you do the 100 exam review practice problems, you will succeed on the exam. Theres some busy work in the class (doesn't take long but kinda annoying). There is a lot of homework & lecture vids but the material isn't hard. Also, theres extra credit (do it!!).
The hype is real! I owe my exam 1 grade to teachmezach. Helps with the homework and exams and the best resource out there.
Lots of assignments, wow! Tests are like almost 75% of the class. USE ZACH! Saved so much time.

75% of grade is tests but for the amount of busy work and random assignments you have to do it should be less. professor is nice but the prerecorded lectures are annoying when a class time is offered. they're also outdated. the in class section is useless. Zach is helpful but not necessary unless ur failing.

My fav prof this semester. Her shell notes are amazingly done. The formula sheet was extremely helpful, so familiarize yourself with it before exams. If you don't understand the difference between the different tests look at the review notes for the exam as those helped me differentiate them (hypotheses, assumptions, etc). Exams mirrored the hw.
teachmezach all the way. Saved me time and my grade. LOTS of assignments so be ready!
Test 1 is the hardest. Dont cram and spend a good week before doing the module hws and Mockos massive practice problems. Used Zach to solidify everything.

Use Zach, his website is teachmezach Went from failing Exam 1 to passing exam 2 and 3 with his exam reviews. Tests are 75% of the course! and LOTS of homework but there is an extension on everything from the professor.
Used Zach for exams. Study 100 questions. Do the extra credit.

Professor Mocko does a great job explaining the material and making herself available for further explanation. Watch all the lectures, do all the homework, fill in all the note shells, do the 100 practice problems, and there is no reason you should get anything lower than a B. This class actually got me more interested in statistics in general.

Nice lady but this class shouldn't only be available online. Lectures are all prerecorded which makes it difficult to learn the material, although she does provide noteshells that help to follow along with. Take advantage of all the extra credit and complete the homeworks to boost your grade. Exams are weighted about 75% of your overall grade.

Professor Mocko is a great teacher and all but class consists of just watching lecture videos on modules. Can become module-heavy during busy weeks. I think one time I completed 3 in a week and it took up the majority of my afternoons for one lecture. Her voice is very annoying.

Wonderful professor. Do the extra credit! She is very clear with the exam instructions and provides excellent material for revision. Homeworks are done twice per week and should be worth a bit more than just 15%. She is very precise about her expectations and what she wants. Her videos help a lot to understand the material.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Do the extra credit, it was the difference between an A- and an A for me. Do the 100 question exam reviews, I would just watch the walk-through videos. The international group project is annoying; I chose UF-only to make coordinating with other members easier. Use all three attempts for the homework. One of the easier classes for business school.

The tests are weighted heavily, so it can be very hard to make up your grade if you do not do well on a test. I recommend doing all the study content she provides, especially the 100 question study guide. Make sure to do all the extra credit research opportunities. Use all attempts for the homework because every point matters. Really nice professor
Honestly, I'm not great with math, but this course is like a breeze. Just watch the lectures and do the practice problems, and you'll get a solid grade.
Video and audio quality is terrible. She also has a habit of doing rather then explaining.
The class scheduling is really odd. You start weeks of exam 3 content before you even take exam 2. Her lectures are also a bit jarring.
The class is average difficulty but her lectures are unbearable, mostly due to the audio.

She's nice and the class is setup well. The lectures however are unbearable, her voice inflections appear in my nightmares. You get out what you put into this class. Exams are fair, just do the practice questions. You get 3 attempts on HW.. use them. Extra Credit seems like a joke... 500 word essays for just 1 point, could chatgpt them if you care.

Really great professor! Everything is stated clearly and she isnt trying to trick or deceive you at all. The homework you can retake up to 3 times and she does various makeup assignments to drop the lowest. Do the 5 points extra credit, and the practice exam before each test, and you should be fine

I'm not a math person but she made the material understandable. The class can be a lot of work and the exams are kinda tough but if you do the 100 practice questions she offers you will be set for the exam. Responds to emails quickly and overall seems like a caring professor. She says the textbook is mandatory, it's not, save yourself the money.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: It's a challenging course and there are a lot of concepts to remember. But she gives you a formula sheet for each exam and has exam reviews a week before each. Overall she's a great professor - it's just a difficult class.
Great professor with a good explanation of all the material. You could get good grades on the exam by taking notes during the videos and reviewing the HW. Pick this professor!!!

Math has never been my forte. With that being said, I am so glad to be done with this class! Prof. Mocko is nice and always willing to help, but the course itself is just tiring, especially if math isn't your strong area. Do the practice problems and extra credit. & know which concept to apply with each question. Exam 2 is easiest by far.
great prof :) she was so sweet

Not great at math, so the first test screwed me. But overall, knowing how to use JMP and applying formulas is all you need to focus on. Do the homework and EC and watch her lectures! Study Edge only worked for review, not actually learning the material for the exam. She was a good professor though.

Really enjoyed my semester with Professor Mocko. She is passionate about what she does and it shows in her lectures. Study edge is helpful in this class, but it is not necessary. Her weekly recordings are engaging and informative and cover everything you need to know come exam time. Use her office hours! She was so polite every time I dropped in.

Very easy class if u were decent in stats 1. Most of the calculations are done through JMP (kinda like excel). Tests make up a large portion of ur grade though, so be sure to study (doing the professor's 100 problems and looking at past homework quizzes should be enough). I personally didn't need the xtra cred to get an A

Professor Mocko's course is super organized and her online modules are very thorough. She tells you exactly what you have to do to succeed and provides you with the materials to do so. My grade reflects the various health issues I had this semester, which Professor Mocko was very understanding of. She is very accommodating to medical emergencies.

Prof Mocko seems like a nice person, and her lectures make sense if you have the time to watch them all. Studyedge is not helpful for this class. The worst thing about this class is that an A is a 94 or above, and exams are 75% of the final grade, meaning that you must nearly ace every exam to get an A, which seems unfair.
I was lazy and only got a B+ because of it, but her lectures are good, exams are straightforward. JMP sucks, but you get used to it. Just make sure to watch her lectures.

Unlike what others have said, I didn't find this class to be very difficult. I took AP stats over 3 years ago and still finished with a high A. Definitely use the note shells when watching the lectures, and don't waste your time on the textbook. Do all 100 of the practice problems for each exam and watch the TA review sessions for them.

The course material is difficult and she doesnt do the greatest job explaining everything. Use the note shells and the test reviews. Even with the test review, everything on the test was different than the homework and her lectures. Lectures are dull and lifeless. Not sure how this lady got into teaching.

Shes nice but the class is difficult. Took stats in a community college 6 years ago which didnt help. Exam 1 Is kind of difficult. Exam 2 is easy. Exam 3 is very difficult. Make sure to read every little note and detail with exam 3. Her grading scale is pretty brutal as well. You need to average a 92 on the exams for an A. EC is only worth 1.25%

This class is a breeze! She makes the material easy to understand, and gives many practice questions that are helpful to study for the exam. The extra credit is super easy. Best part of the class was definitely the occasional cat cameos.

Great professor. It had been 10+ years since I took my last statistics class and I remembered literally nothing, but her lectures are very straight forward and prepared me for the exams perfectly. Never used the book. Expect to put in some time studying, but by reviewing the homework, notes, and exam prep materials I got an A on every exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I took her online section and the class was very structured and organized, 2 homework assignments due per week. Provided plenty of videos and explanations on topics, as well as plenty of review material for exams. StudyEdge also helps explains concepts well for this class. She also provides formula sheets that are very helpful on exams.

Pre recorded lectures that I would watch!! Do extra credit! First 2 exams her 100 practice problems were enough but 3rd exam was extremely hard. Re-read every note for the 3rd. Study edge isnt enough for the whole class but used as a review for the exams!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Prof. Mocko is literally great. She has pre-recorded lectures so you can watch them whenever, but she also has an optional synchronous session every week so that students can log on and get help. Exams are iffy, but you should be able to do well if you utilize the extra stuff offered and study. She also has extra credit opportunities.
At first, I had doubts about this class but honestly if you watch the lectures and study before the exam you should be fine. No need to use study edge, her lectures are pretty straightforward.

Many claim that you need Study Edge for this course, but that is an absolute lie. Professor Mocko makes everything extremely easy to understand, and as long as your acing the homework and studying before each exam, you'll definitely get an A. If you have a good statistics foundation already, this class is a breeze.

Mocko cares about her students. You get that impression from her and how she goes about the course. The subject matter sadly, was a little difficult for me. Though, it got better over time. If you struggled with statistics prior, you will need to put in the time to study. Thankfully, she provides some great tools to do so along with StudyEdge.

Prof. Mocko is a queen. She explains things well in the prerecorded lectures, so usually those are all you need. If something is confusing, she hosts live sessions to explain so you don't need a textbook. Make sure you understand the mods the first time through, then review those and do her practice problems and you're set for exams.

Her class was not bad at all! If you watch her lectures and study for her exams about a week in advance, you'll be fine. She gives extra credit, which was the reason I got an A. She is also very quick to respond to emails about exam concerns, she is definitely one of my favorite professors at UF! Dont use study edge, it didn't help at all.

Pretty straightforward material and you learn to use JMP software. Just need to watch the pre-recorded lecture videos to get all of the info. Study Edge helps, but isnt necessary for an A. The textbook is completely unnecessary. First exam is all stats 1, so dont wait too long to take QMB.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Mocko is a really good teacher. The lectures are very informative for the homework, and she is such a nice person outside the class. I solely used study edge to prepare for the tests and I averaged 95 on each exam. The material isn't difficult and the 100 practice problems are very helpful. Simple mistakes can lead to an undesired grade.

Overall, professor is kind and exams are fair. Her 100 practice problems for each exam are an accurate reflection of what to expect. Gives three attempts for each Canvas homework assignment. Also provides an extra credit opportunity which makes the A  94%+ reasonably attainable.

Overall a very doable class if you put in the effort. Her lectures can be a little long, but they are helpful for tests/homework's. The tests were always very fair and you can tell she isn't trying to trick you as long as you studied. Highly recommend her as a professor and getting Study Edge!
I recommend Study Edge for this class. The first exam was brutal for a lot of people, but its because everyone focused on the formulas and not the concepts and wording! Long lectures though

She's very kind, but not the best professor. Her directions were often unclear and her exams were much harder than the quizzes and practice questions. You get 3 quiz attempts and she responds quickly to the discussion board. Course is JMP heavy with lots of group work. She has lots of assignments which help make up for the class's poor performance.

Note: I took this class over a year after taking intro stats, which definitely did not help. Taking this class, it's clear that she understands stats and puts effort into her class. However, it was not the easiest to grasp. There were so many different concepts that it was hard to keep count. StudyEdge definitely helped immediately before exams.
Amazing professor. No study edge needed. Perhaps the best professor in the business school I've had so far.

The exams arent too bad if you do her exam review and study the concepts & JMP. Her lectures were pretty good. The online exams are somewhat annoying bc you have to keep switching windows/tabs. The HW helped a lot with exam prep and was mostly timed Canvas quizzes w/ 3 tries, shuffled questions and 3 drops. Overall, this class is better than most.

Ms. Mocko is great at teaching the subject but it's very difficult if you aren't skilled in math. Exams are about 50% solving problems, 50% understanding application and definitions. HW is easy but exams are tough and they're a large percentage of your grade. Some questions are designed to throw you off so read them well and don't overthink it.

Professor Mocko is a great! She goes above and beyond to help her students whenever they need it. The course has quite a bit of homework, but the homework is really in place to increase your grade because all assignments have at least 3 attempts. The course covers a lot of material but Professor Mocko does a great job explaining the material.

Mocko is a nice professor who is very quick to reply to discussion board posts and emails. Her exam reviews are also very good and provide everything you need to know. Study Edge isn't necessary as long as you utilize her exam review materials and keep up with the lectures (which are very long and dull but also clear and informative).

Mocko is a great lecturer, however, she can be slow and boring. This class is very straight forward. She has lots of office hours and posts great exam review content. Not an easy A but not a killer class.

Not that hard. Just keep up w/ the modules/hw and fill out the exam reviews she posts. Those really do cover everything that will be on the exam. MAKE SURE to go over the conceptual type questions. I went through the exam review 3 times and made sure I understood the processes in JMP and the steps to get the answer and got 100's. Easy A!

Very reasonable and fair course and professor. The lectures have useful notes, Mocko is very straightforward and organized, and the exams are not loaded with tricks and unfair questions (like ACG2071). I've actually enjoyed learning new information. It is a Stats 2 course though, and I've found how she structures the class helpful and logical.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Watch lectures on 2x speed and review a lot before exam, bc not much HW or practice Qs. Pretty interesting examples, and very helpful in responding to student questions through canvas discussions for each module. Not difficult material, because JMP and formula sheet are given. Exam scale is very high (94 and above for an A), so do the extra credit
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She is a good professor and seems really nice however, her lectures are VERY long and slow. If Stat doesn't come easy to you, get Study Edge. The biggest issue is the lack of homework, tough concepts to grasp and you have 5-6 problems to practice each chapter. If the class had more repetition in hw students may do better overall.

The class is not taught as an introductory course to statistics which is exactly what it is supposed to be. The tutoring session/videos are recorded live so they are filled with errors and leave you more confusing, the thick foreign accent of the T.A also doesn't help. The class is also taught differently than other Statistics courses.

Super easy class. You don't need SE. Just watch the lectures and keep up with the hw... you can even use JMP for the exams. She does make little mistakes but it's not easy to figure out what she meant if you paid attention.

Great professor, made me really like Statistics and even consider focusing my career in that area. Lectures are long but I found them interesting, and she's really nice. If you don't like stats you'll find the class pretty tough, but if you do she's a really great professor!!

Worst course I've taken at UF. The lectures are long and hard to follow. Random information is given with no explanation as to why until someone asks, I.E. Why there's a different number listed on our notes vs. what she's writing. Moves entirely too quickly to even have a chance to grasp concepts. PURCHASE STUDY EDGE or accept you C or below.

Her lectures are the worst. They are long, almost 2 hours long, covers so much information. The lectures are super monotone and extremely boring to say the least. She is not a good teacher at all. Look elsewhere.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: There was a brand new curriculum with a lot of ambiguity, we were constantly behind schedule, and that meant that some lectures were rushed and the material is too difficult to just fly through it. Not a great teacher, BUT she is incredibly nice and wants you to do well. Extra credit ops and end of term curve led me to an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Intro to Managerial Statistics was not too difficult and Mocko is a clear teacher. You have a project/presentation, two inclass exams, and homework after each module. It was pretty straightforward. Not a lot of emphasis on math, but on using JMP and understanding computer output.

She is a good professor. I used study edge to reinforce what I learned in her lectures. Her tests are easy if you studied (I crammed the day of the exam and got a 91). I missed an A- by 0.01% points because I did not have time to study for the final so it was on me. I would take her class again. She also offers make up assignments and extra credit.

Mocko's goal is to teach students the material, not trick students into failing the class and that makes this class which could have been a pain much more manageable. Talks a little slow but 1.4X covers that. StudyEdge is going to be a complete waste of money, because all the resources needed to succeed in this course are already provided

Lectures are dull but clear. There is weekly homework, but you get 3 tries and Mystatlab gives you hints if you're stuck. Gives a formula sheet for exams. You have to use JMP for homeworks and exams, but it's not that bad. She answers questions on the discussion board and replies to emails fast. StudyEdge is helpful too.
Boring lectures but she gives you the material needed to succeed on her exams.
This class wasn't too difficult but it was BORING. However, once i started using study edge like everyone told me to, it got a lot easier and easier to actually focus on stats.

Overall, this class was an easy A. Her exams weren't very hard, especially if you studied the previous exam questions she released. Her main drawback is that she has the worst, most boring and monotone voice. You will certainly fall asleep watching lecture, so skip them and use Study Edge instead. I have her for QMB now & its the same thing.
She cares a lot about her students and will help you no matter what. Highly recommend taking her class. She now teaches business stats and everyone who couldn't have her for stats 1 was so upset.
She is great! Class wasn't too difficult and she was very quick to answer any questions
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Might be hard for you if you're not great at math, but I am good at math and found this quite easy.

Online Stats is pretty easy. The mini projects and the quizzes are straightforward. If you do the quizzes right after you watch the videos, you can stay on top of your game. The tests can be tricky but if you practice the old problems she posts, it will help a lot. She's really good about replying to emails and updating Canvas.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Took STA2023 online with her Summer A and thought she was pretty good. If you email her, she gets back to you right away. The Island projects and quizzes are easy, they comprise 40% of your grade and should help boost your grade. The material isn't hard but the class is fast paced -- covers 10 chapters in 6 weeks. So don't slack off!

I had Mocko for Stats I and Business Statistics, and thought she did a great job teaching the classes. QMB3250: Keep up with the Excel assignments (not too hard), they should help buffer your grade. The tests are a little bit harder and there are a lot of them (5 total) but if use Study Edge to reinforce and practice, you should be golden!

I took Mocko for Stats 1 my freshman fall. The first exam was really hard for me, especially since it was my first semester at UF. I would recommend doing a ton of practice problems and using Study Edge. I actually preferred Study Edge to Mocko's lectures.
Great teacher, very helpful. Really needed an A in class and if you show effort and meet with her, she is more than happy to help!

I used StudyEdge and got a B (honestly, mostly because I blew off the final and shouldn't have). Your lowest exam score gets dropped and extra credit is offered for marketing labs. She took over for Thompson a week into the semester, so considering that she was pretty good. I think she'll improve as she gets used to the course.

Professor Mocko is one of the BEST teachers at UF. Initially the course can be overwhelming because of the content (24 modules with video instruction, quizzes, lab workbook, textbook, 3x weekly conferences & mid-terms) but you get the hang of it. I didn't use the books or watch conferences, I just worked the modules and did TONS of practice exams.

Ms Mocko took over for Dr Thompson the 2nd week of class during the Spring 2018 semester in QMB3250. She did a great job readjusting the schedule of assignments. Get ready to read and practice many problems. I didn't use Study Edge but still passed with a B. The practice exams she provides are golden. She also provides formula sheets for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She leaves no excuse for failing. She even shares past exams with hand written notes for how to get the correct answers. She and her aids have live help sessions 2x a week and she answers all questions quickly.

The material in this class is fairly easy and her lecture notes are fill in the blank, which makes it very easy to follow and know what is important. There are "quizzes" after every lecture, but each is only worth 5 points and just a basic check up where you can get most of the info from the notes. Mocko provides a lot of extra credit opportunities
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Took this class because it was required for my major. All of the lectures are recorded which is convenient and the labs are very simple. My friends and I all used study edge which was super helpful to prepare for her exam questions which can sometimes be worded weird.

Dr. Mocko's class is definitely reasonable. The exams can be tricky because she puts answer choices that you can get when you do problems the wrong way. The lab and quizzes are pretty straightforward, though. Keeping up with the material & Study Edge helps! Overall a manageable class and Dr. Mocko is great.

I actually loved Dr. Mocko's stats class! She makes the material as interesting as it can be made IMO. The quizzes and labs are easy grade boosters. Watch out for the tests, though. They can be tricky! I used skoolers week by week. Really helpful.

The lectures and quizzes make it seem like the material is really simple and straightforward but when it comes to the exam, watch out. The tests can be very tricky and difficult, but the final wasn't bad. The once a week lab was kind of pointless but you can get easy points to boost your grade, so make sure to attend them.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: My stats class was a hybrid so my lectures were online and she is a very clear instructor. She is a bit slow so I would always speed her up on the videos but her lectures and quizzes were good for understanding the material. She is specific about what she expects on the exams and the practice exams she posts are perfect for preparing for exams.

I took this class as a hybrid and found it to be pretty easy, however I am good at math. Rented the textbook but never used it. Mocko is great and really explains things well. If you watch the lectures, and do the quizzes anyone can do well in the class.

AWESOME! I was hospitalized and she worked with me a lot to get me to not fail out. STUDY for exams! Labs are not the easiest but TAs help a lot. She is so nice and knowledgable. Did poorly on first two exams and still ended with a B.

Having taken Stats in high school, I went in thinking this class was going to be an easy A. I learned the hard way by having to get a 97 on the final to get an A in the class. Don't brush this class off, take it serious. Overall though, Mocko is a very nice lady that wants to see you do well. Do interactive online lessons as these are a breeze.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests? Not many--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The 3 quizzes/wk can be annoying but keep you on top of it. Mocko is generous with the EC & wants you to succeed. Her voice is super monotone, but she is clearly passionate. The second test sucks regardless, even if you think you're prepared. Don't let it get you down!! I made a C on it & still got an A in the class. Put in the work & it'll pay off

I took a hybrid and it was actually the best choice. I only had to go to labs once a week since you could watch her lectures online. However, I preferred using the interactive online lessons. Her exams were a bit difficult, but I actually found the final exam way easier than the first two. Shes a great teacher. Definitely recommend.

Exams were difficult, I highly suggest smokin' notes. I did the interactive lectures online and loved those more than the live lectures. Lots of quizzes and around 10 labs. Lots of extra credit opportunities

I took a hybrid but watched her lectures online and she is a great instructor. Very understanding and wants to see you succeed. She is always available for help and her TAs have tutoring hours everyday of the week.

I used the interactive lessons the most and they gave you the basic rundownd of all the topics. I just suck at math but the class was fine I guess. You'll get tired of her voice very quickly. Her tests are hard. The once a week lab is the dumbest thing and was never helpful it just felt like a waste.

Tests can be hard because is a mixture of concepts plus actual calculations (mostly concepts) but she gives a lot of practice problems, and when I say a lot I mean it: exams from previous semesters, homework ( not graded), a sheet with many practice problems before the exams, and the quizzes, (graded) but you get three attempts. Labs are easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: I took this class hybrid, and would recommend that to others. Only had to go once a week for a lab section, that was basically free A's if you pay attention. Exams are 75% and worded kind of tricky but if you study with old exams you should be fine. I never watched lectures, only read the book and have an A.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Megan Mocko is GREAT!!! I truly like how the lectures coincide the workbook so you actually retain what she is lecturing. Also the weekly quizzes are great because you get 3 tries, it actually pertains to the lectures, and they help your grade: most of the time. Professor Mocko gets that we are college students and treats us like human beings!

Professor Mocko is an amazing statistics teacher. I watched the online interactive lessons and she relayed concepts clearly. She was quick to respond to emails and is always willing to help. She offers a lot of extra credit opportunities and really wants her students to succeed. Exams are tough, especially for those not strong in statistics.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Mocko is the best stat teacher. Def recommend the hybrid version. All her lectures are recorded and/or interactive. Not particularly difficult. Do your best on the first exam because it is the easiest. She offers extra credit for everyone. She doesn't actually teach the labs- the TAs lead those.

I did not go to any in-class lectures and did all interactive video lessons. She made it easy to understand the content and explained the examples well. Offers extra credit opportunities throughout the semester. Labs were directly related to modules and pretty simple. Easy to moderate class and a helpful professor.

Lectures are amazing!!!! Mocko gives good feedback, and what is even more helpful is that fill in workbook as the lectures go on. Not saying that the class is easy by any means, but it is definitely a good class.
I currently am in the class and love it! If you get a chance to take her, DO IT! She wants you to succeed, and if you put in the work there is no reason you shouldn't pass.

She makes the lectures very basic and easy to understand. Her voice drives me up the wall a little bit but take hybrid and you can just pause her lectures. The exams are way harder than the module quizzes but she gives plenty of study material to prepare

Dr. Mocko, although her voice will drive you half-mad, is actually a very caring professor who really takes her time explaining things and going into detail with them. I struggled in this class because I am by no means a math brain, but she did really do her best to help me succeed as much as she could.

Professor Mocko is the best out of all stats teachers. She truly cares about each individual student. With that being said, there are a lot of students and not everyone can get the help they need. So, a great tool I recommend is Study Edge as an additional help provider to get you to that A. Overall, she's a great teacher and makes the class fun.

Professor Mocko is known to be the best stats 1 prof at UF. I am terrible at math and I got an A with her because she is so careful in really explaining the material. You definitely have to work hard, pay attention, and study, but if you are doing that you should be fine. She gives lots of different learning and studying methods, too.

Mrs. Mocko was an amazing professor! I took IB Stats in high school, so I already had previous knowledge on the course, but I think that even with no/little knowledge, you should do fine. She is easily accessible through email and very caring. I've asked her so many questions and she always got back to me in the sweetest way. HIGHLY recommend!!
Really wants her students to succeed and offers many additional sources to learn the material

She is awesome! Posts all her lectures online so you never have to go to class, but watch her lectures she is good at explaining and will give hints for exams. Use study edge. Online homework is a quiz and you get 3 tries. 1st and 3rd exam had high averages but study for the 2nd because she'll try and trick you. Definitely the best Stat professor.

Taking Mocko for STA2023 online over summer A. Her lectures are extremely helpful and concise, and she provides online office hours and conference calls every day if you have additional questions. Even though I'm at home taking the class and her lectures are pre recorded, she is responsive and helpful. Her exams are fair and she's super sweet.

Mocko is the best it gets when it comes to Statistics. She is clear in her lectures and provides great examples. The majority of your grade comes from three exams, but then a portion of it comes from the lab assignments and online quizzes. Labs are run by your TA so they are usually easy. Online quizzes can be taken three times.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Stat with Mocko was great! Attendance is optional except for the discussion period. The exams were fairly easy as long as you watch the lectures and do the practice tests. Doing practice problems in the textbook is not necessary. DO NOT waste money on the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Professor Mocko is a great a teaching "Introduction to Statistics I". Her lectures were pretty detailed and she posts all her old exams to practice from for the exams. She responds pretty quickly is usually clear in her answer back to you. Posts a few modules at a time so you could get ahead. The class isn't too hard if you put the effort.

I took a hybrid of this class and my only advice is to STAY ON TOP OF THE LECTURES. There are weekly quizzes and you will no succeed in the class if you are not on top of your work. Otherwise she makes this class very doable.

I never thought I would like statistics, I've always heard horror stories from my friends in high school and college, and I'm not much of a math person myself. However, this class and Professor Mocko has really made me enjoy statistics and I would definitely take it again! She explains everything super clearly and the class is extremely easy!

I'm not a math person by any means but still ended with an A in the class.  You have to put some effort in but it's more than doable.  She gives clear lectures, and if you're struggling at all get study edge which helps a ton!  The exams are not bad just make sure to study the terms and her study guides.  Would recommend this class.

Not too challenging of a course. There's plenty of extra credit and Prof Mocko is a very good lecturer (attendance isn't required but keep up w/the lectures.) Definitely use Study Edge for this class because it makes it a VERY easy A & you get free Smokin' Notes when you go to exam reviews. I used mainly Study Edge and got 91+ on every exam!

Although her exams can be extremely tricky (questions meant to mislead you), she ultimately is a good professor who explains things well. However, I would recommend using Study Edge because it helped me a ton, and her lectures tend to be a little dry. Just keep up with her lectures, she's lenient on attendance but not grading.

I took this class as a hybrid. I'd go to lab once a week as it was mandatory. The labs and the quizzes were super easy. The exams were pretty straight-forward with enough studying. Exam 2 was rough for many people so I'd recommend studying hard for it. She's passionate about the subject and tries to ensure that everyone understands the material.

Megan Mocko is an amazing professor. She seems like a really sweet person and is really great at explaining concepts. Her exams are easy and straightforward. If you listen to her lectures you will know exactly what to expect.  Don't listen to people that say this class is hard. If  you watch the lectures and do the practice exams it's an easy A.

Super thankful I got to take STA2023 with Mocko.  She's very kind and knowledgeable, and always willing to help outside of class. The way she organizes her workbook is A1, and she goes at a pace that lets you absorb the info. All exams are exactly like previous ones, so make sure you do those! I believe she only teaches STA2023 in fall.
