Very easy class, I did not do anything the whole semester except go to a study edge review a few days before the test and learn all of her practice exams the day before, sure its a lot of cramming but you are free the rest of the time because the material is that easy to cram.

Lectures are easy to understand and follow the lab workbook perfectly. Textbook was not necessary to purchase unless you need lots of extra practice as Mocko posts practice problems and exams online. As long as you keep up with lectures and go to lab, there is no reason you shouldn't pass this class.

Prof. Mocko is an Easy going professor who is very caring and understanding. However, she sets multiple choice exams that are very tricky. I would recommend meeting with her to figure out how she like to word questions. I Learn a lot, did very well on labs and quiz, but wish I had the exam results to prove it!

Mocko is a great stats teacher.  Her grading scale is very rough though, as there are only 3 exams and the three of them make up 75% of your grade.  If you bomb one, your grade can quickly drop.  Labs are mandatory each week, and if you can, try to get the hybrid version so you can just watch her lectures online.  You also need to buy the workbook.
She is a great lecturer and really knows how to explain the concepts clearly. She teaches from a workbook that she created so she's pretty legit. Highly recommend for stats 1
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Watched all the lectures to fill out the workbook but this wasn't the best use of my time. Used Study Edge for all the quizzes and exams. Easy class but assured A/less time consuming with the help of Study Edge

Professor Mocko was the best. Her lectures are online so you can watch them whenever, but don't fall behind. I watched her lectures on weekends and used Study Edge as a supplement, and did very well in this course. Very straightforward and fair professor, Study Edge helped too.

If Prof Mocko taught every math class, I would be a math major. She is so amazing. Her lectures are so on point and she wrote the workbook so everything she teaches is applicable to the work. Uses Statlab & Piazza and is always available. Clear grading. I didn't want this class to end! Not easy but if you put in the effort, you will see results.

Best professor I've had at UF. This is not the easiest course, but Professor Mocko always wants to see her students succeed. She thoroughly explains topics, holds live reviews before each exam, and is available to answer any questions. I would take this class again in a heartbeat.

Allows you to work ahead if you like.  Lectures go with lab book, which is a must.  Textbook itself not mandatory.  If you plan your time wisely, project is not bad.  Grades are fair and done quickly.  Allows repeat tries for certain homework assignments and quizzes.  Drops a few of the lowest scores on homework.  Easy A.

She is so nice & there for you every step along the way. It might seem like a lot of homework but there's a purpose- it prepares you completely. She wrote the workbook so there's nothing off-topic. Her lectures explain everything & she does review sessions. She encourages class communication through Piazza & you're never in the dark. Take her!!
This class was pretty straight forward. At some points it was pretty challenging but Study Edge saved my life. It helped me make the A in this class.

I can't say I really know much about Mocko. I stopped watching her lectures about a month into the semester because they are taught at too slow of a pace. She gives extra credit, online quizzes are easy, tests are pretty easy. Just practice old exams before each test and you'll be fine.

There is no scenario where I could recommend this class or this professor. It is absolutely terrible. She is absolutely terrible and the fact that all of the reviews of the class say that you need to use an online tutor is only further proof that she does not do her job properly. Save yourself some time, take it at a local community college.
This class was pretty easy.  The tests aren't hard and she does reviews and gives you many old exams to study.  Go over those, and you should get a good grade.  She's nice and helpful.

She is one of the best professors you will come across at UF. She's thorough and cares about the success of her students. If you care, you'll pass. Watch her lectures, get the smokin' notes, study for the exams and you'll be fine!

If you stay on top of everything then it will be easy. I recommend Smokin' Notes, it helps a lot because it is hard to know what to study with just her review and workbook. The tests are straight forward but they make up a lot of your grade. However, she gives a lot of practice exams and extra credit.

You will love her. She explains the material so well and you use every page of the workbook! She is quick at responding to emails and is so helpful. She takes her time to explain and has extra material to prepare you for exams. There is a lot of homework but it's perfect for learning the material in order to pass exams. She is there every step!

Took this class online during Summer B. There is plenty of homework, I found myself doing 3 homework's per day. There are some weird projects that you are expected to do. I can surely say that the homework was the worst part of the class, simply because of the workload. Tests are okay, not easy but not super hard. She is very good at responding.

Her lectures are very simple and well broken down for step by step. Really makes a difference and helps you understand the material. I don't like that her assignments are due everyday during the week as opposed to all being due on Sunday. Just take plenty of notes and you'll be fine.

A genuinely good hearted teacher, Professor Mocko's class was super easy, watch lectures online, DON'T BUY THE BOOK, only buy the workbook, keep up with lectures, go to lab(easy), tests are easy if you practice(old exams, problems)  WARNING: Lectures are mostly boring, don't do what I did and watched all 3 (MWF) on Friday afternoons.

Very straightforward class. Don't buy the textbook. Watch lectures and you'll be fine. Quizzes and labs are extremely easy, especially since you have 3 tries. I got 100 on my first test, 97 on my second test, and I'll probably get an "A" on the last one too. Very easy class, one that you don't even have to go to the lecture. Easy A, good teacher.

Very friendly & helpful. Didn't buy textbook; just get workbook. Studyedge and TZ aren't needed. Labsquizzes are super easy! She speaks slow so if you watch them on 1.6x, lectures are short. She's straightforward with the material, but exams are worth 75% of your grade. So a few mistakes can easily bring your grade down, though no lower than a B.

Mocko is extremely friendly, her tests aren't that hard, and the labs and quizzes are a joke. Don't buy the textbook, just get the workbook instead. Not an easy A, but a very doable one. She does speak pretty slowly though, so you might have a hard time seeing back to back lectures.
Studyedge for quizzes, and smokin notes for exams and all you have to do is just go to lab.  thats it!   3 grades, lab you are on your own.

Mocko is a slow speaker and lectures are boring, but it helps to watch the videos at 1.6 or twice the regular speed. Quizzes are easy, exams are OK (got 86% on all three), and the labs are very easy (hardest part is interpreting the Asian TA). The lab book is great for organizing notes, and the HW is optional.
Mocko is very nice, but her lectures are slow and boring. The online quizzes are easy and the labs are a joke. The tests are manageable if you study and the other grades will help you do well.

This class is very doable. All the lectures are online. I would NOT waste my money on ANY of the tutoring material. Just review the workbook, do the practice questions, and the old exams and you can easy pass the exams.
It was kind of hard for me to tie everything together, Mocko is a fine teacher but stats is kind of hard. TZ is good before the exams.
She was a fantastic professor! Willing to help anyone who comes to her for it.

Mocko is a genuinely nice teacher who actually wants her students to learn. She's the nicest professor I've had here and is a great teacher; the class is easy if you keep up with the lectures and do your work. There's also free tutoring with TAs if you need extra help. I found the textbook free online but hardly use it. Workbook is essential.

Mocko is a good professor but she goes through the class in a very slow manner (at the beginning, a lot of the stuff is review and a waste of time). I used study edge (zach is AMAZING) and got an A. They had quiz reviews too (those quizzes are a pain) Really easy class. Don't waste time watching lectures. also don't need to buy the book.

Mocko is very friendly and overall helpful .She is very easy to reach and will answer all your questions clearly . Her tests are fair although this is not an Easy A , if you do the HW and go over the notes then you should get no less then a B .

Awesome teacher and very helpful. I took the course completely online. If you do every Homework and Lesson and actually watch her videos which are within the lessons then you will do good on the test. Also projects ma seem hard but are actually very simple once you start them

DO NOT FALL BEHIND IN THIS CLASS. The grading scale is forgiving and she is a very helpful teacher, but stay on top of everything. Also, don't buy the textbook and don't do the homework unless you feel like you need extra review.

Pretty good professor! Just need to keep up with her and not fall behind to pass; she provides weekly quizzes that help you with that and the quizzes are simple and you have 3 tries to get the best grade. Smokin' Notes helped a lot though, especially as I didn't keep up as often.

Great Stat class to take online!  Just make sure to stay up-to-date with the videos and quizzes.  The online quizzes consist of 6 multiple-choice questions and you get 3 chances.  There are 3 exams which are ok (but not super easy).  Just make sure to do the online quizzes and go to the weekly lab meetings and you'll be fine!

She was incredibly boring during lectures, put me to sleep. But she is knowledgable on statistics and the class is not hard as long as you do what is assigned when it's assigned. I fell 9 lectures behind in the class mid-semester which resulted in my barely missing an A in the class

This class was super easy. It is also easy to get behind. I remember at one point I was 6 lectures behind and that sucked. The quizzes are pretty easy too especially since you get 3 tries. Lectures are all online. Never set foot in the class. You still have to put some effort into it.
Never used (or bought) the textbook, never went to class. Spent about 5 hours studying before each individual exam and got an A-. Definitely could've gotten an A if I would have put in more effort.

Professor Mocko was great! The course can be difficult, but Mrs. Mocko is always willing to help. The class consists of 3 exams worth 100 points each and weekly quizzes and labs which equal 100 points together. She also gives some opportunities for extra credit. All around a good course.

For a 2000 level class, it can be difficult. Labs and quizzes are pretty easy, but mandatory for a good grade. Exams can be very tricky, particularly with conceptional questions. Actual material isn't too hard, especially if you took stats in high school. Grade skill is pretty forgiving, and after bombing the first two exams, I'll end up with a C.

All lectures are put online, so you don't have to go to class. You do not NEED the textbook, but it is definitely helpful to have. The workbook is absolutely necessary. She is a good teacher, provides lots of review for exams, however this class definitely requires effort if you have never had statistics before-it was a little challenging

Mocko is very nice and likes to help students. She makes you aware of what is going to be on the exam and doesn't throw in surprises. Don't buy the book, it's on reserve at the library if you want extra practice problems. You will need to spend time studying if you want a good grade.

She teaches well, but her tests can be difficult.  Make sure that you study hard and do practice problems.  Ask questions if you need help and KEEP UP WITH THE LECTURES. too many people don't and get too far behind to catch up.

The lectures are online but you have the option of going to live lectures. The subject is pretty boring and maybe a little difficult but often mandatory. There are three exams which you take on campus. You will need to buy the workbook but the textbook is just for extra practice and clarification. Smokin Notes may help for studying.

Took her class online. Her lectures can be slow and boring, but she's pretty clear and not hard at all. Material isn't hard. Very nice lady. Textbook ABSOLUTELY NOT REQUIRED (and expensive, don't waste money), only the workbook necessary. Tests aren't too hard, but a TZ or SE review is really important. Easier than Ripol.

I procrastinated 2/3 of this class and bombed the first two tests, but managed to still get a C because of her very forgiving grading scale. This class requires a lot of time and effort, especially for someone who doesn't like math. Her exam questions can be confusing, but the actual material wasn't very difficult.

Mocko is a pretty decent teacher in my opinion. You can watch the classes online if u don't want to go physically, all of the homework isn't required to do, the stat labs themselves were easy, and the quizzes you got to take up to 3 times. Overall, a very fair class and you'll get the grade you deserve if you put the time in.

I thought this class would be easy, but this is the most time consuming/stressful one. HIGHLY recommend doing the homework, watching ALL lectures, and attending the tutoring room once a week. Her tests don't evaluate your comprehension on the material, but rather your comprehension of her questions.
