Won't help you out if you were sick and missed class, so make sure to go to every class or your going to be hurting in your grade. Also, difficult to listen to her speak an entire class because she whines when she talks.

I had Meece for both Stats 1 and Stats 2 and I got an A in both courses. I honestly want to stay that I stayed on top of things and always went to class, but the truth is, I barely worked at all for my grades. Meece's lecture notes are a great indication of whats on the test. She is a fantastic and easy professor. One of UF's best.
No Comments

I would highly recommend taking this class especially if you found STA2023 was a bit challenging, because she goes back and explains things a little bit if you have forgotten the info.  Plus she holds review sessions before tests and offers E.C. for coming to class. take her!

One of the best teacher I've ever had in UF. She provides excellent notes and you don't even need to buy books to do well in the class. She's also always available to help you and has extra review session before the exam. A very kind and very helpful pretty teacher :)
Lectures are good if you don't fall asleep. She talks really slow so take the online course where you can set the video lecture to 2x.

She is an easy teacher.  I first came into class nervous because i had never taken stat.  i found out her test consist of hw problems and practice questions.  Her lecture notes are your best guideline into getting an 'A' in the class.  But she does make alot of mistakes on grammar not really on the math.
Shes a very good teacher. The material can sometimes be boring, but not too difficult. She is very helpful and seems like she really wants the class to succeed. HIghly recommended!
VERY good teacher, aced the class. Stay ontop of the remote points and the online quizes and you will be fine. Still don't know how I came out with an A, but overall, was a fun course.

she makes learning stats very easy. i'd never taken statistics before, and i was nervous going into it. her materials make learning quick and painless. she provides a lot of practice materials like quizzes and homework problems, review sheets and practice problems, and has two reviews before every test. i highly recomment her.

Even if math is your worst subject, this professor makes achieving an A possible. Do the practice questions and go to class! She has a review session a day before each exam which is extremely helpful too! She's thorough, clear and encourages class participation. I would recommend her class to anyone.
do the homework problems and online quizzes. materials are pretty boring, but she makes things brief, and easy to understand
Easy class, she makes a lot of mistakes durin lecture though.  if you understand 4th grade math you should do fine in this class

Buy the book. Do the homework problems. Do the practice tests.  Tests are straight forward and sometimes include problems seen in the homework.  She's extremely accomodating and an overall nice person.

SHE IS HORRIBLE.  Not helpful at all, stuck in her ways, and unwilling to compromise, she is one of the worst and most selfish professors I have had the displeasure of knowing thus far in my college career.  If another teacher is available, take the alternative.  Trust me.

Professor Meece did a good job teaching a boring subject.  I would take any class that she taught.  I struggled with the subject but only because I did not like it and was overwelmed in other classes.  The format which she utilizes gaurantees a good grade if you put forth any effort whatsoever.

I'm horrible at math but I got an A in Stats with no problem. Meece is a great teacher, very clear and concise. She is able to communicate the info to students effectively. The tests were fair as long as you studied. Labs and quizzes help your grade if you don't do so well on the tests, though.

Great professor. Really knows her stuff and is able to communicate it to her students well. Class was easy...got an A with no problem and minimal effort. Quizzes and labs really help if you don't do so well on the tests. Definitely recommend her over Randalls for this class.

I love stats because of her! She made me want to get a minor in stats..seriously AWESOME BEST professor I have had thus far, has a really nice voice to listen to and learn from, and is great overall! DONT BUY BOOK lol I never opened it. And got an A.
Class is easy, her lectures are pretty interesting and she is straightforward and helpful. Absolutly no reason to complain here. Makes Stats as painless as possible.
no tricky business. everything is pretty much str8 forward.
Intro. to stat. was a breeze.  Prof. Meece was very clear and helpful.
I hate math and its related subjects, but she definitely made it more bearable.  Very pleasant, also.
very easy material, tests are pretty straight forward. easy A if u do all the quizzes and labs and do fairly well on the tests. teacher is verynice
Extremely uninterested in statistics, but she made it a relatively decent experience. Sweet professor, study and you'll do fine.
keep up with lectures. not too difficult, just dont fall behind. good teacher and tests arent too hard
Very easy, very laid back professor. She will help you in as much as you might need and seek help. One of the best stat teachers at UF. Highly recommend. Need I say more?
She is so nice and you don't need buy the book because she does a great job teaching the material

She was so nice and easy to understand. One of the best math teachers I have ever had.  Do all of her practice problems that she provides on the website and the class is a lot easier! Don't waste money on the book.  Oh ya, she's hot too!

Meece does a really good job teaching. as said before, the book is pretty much useless, don't waste your money. she does teach pretty slowly, but she is thorough. not a hard class, but easy to get behind if you don't keep up with lectures.

Meece is a great professor. Very clear and easy to understand. I didn't enjoy the labs and found that they were little help to me. The exams were pretty tough for me, but more math-oriented people found them easy.
Really great professor. Very clear, definitely seems to care about you despite the fact that there are 2000 people in the class.

AWESOME professor. I love stats because of her! wonderful pace, am currently cramming 11hrs of lecture for her final tomorrow (NOTE: do NOT procrastinate in watching lectures!) Labs and quizzes are a good way to boost grade, just keep up and you'll do great. DONT BUY BOOK, waste of $ have not opened
Very very nice professor who explains the material really well.  She goes at a very good pace.
Wonderful teacher!!!! Very very very nice!!!

Very very easy class.  If you are pretty good at math you should have no problems.  Her tests are straight forward and make sure to do the practice problems online cuz most of those are on the test.  An easy A for sure!!
awesome teacher. goes very slow. dont buy the book. no need to go to class, just listen the lectures, but DONT get behind!
she's the man.
yup, very clear and consistent.  don't bother buying the book (or going to class, u'd rather watch it online).
Don't bother buying the book. It is rarely used. Go to the tutoring room if you do need to use it. Attend labs and do quizzes cuz that's an easy A, which counts for 1 exam grade.
She's very clear in her lectures.  Breaks everything down so that you can understand it.  The tests are very, very tricky but the quizzes and labs are like free points.
She's very clear in her lectures and follows the outline of notes that we already have. Makes it very easy to learn the material if you keep up with the online lectures.
can watch all the lectures online which is great. she's very clear in her lectures. tests are a little hard but quizzes and labs can boost your grade some.

She is VERY helpful and the test prep is basically most of the test. Fair in grading on paper and the tests are scan tron. She hands out useful examples and has a nice teaching style.Sit near front though sometimes she speaks a bit soft.

Great teacher! She is very well spoken, and clearly presents the material. The tests and quizzes are fair (doesn't try to trick you). Get your remote points, get some tutoring, and do you quizzes on time and you should be good to go.

Very helpful; also a very nice person.  She handed out the notes to fill in during class, and reviewed before each test.  The tests were not easy, but if you went to class and studied the notes you'd be fine.  Don't buy a new book; it isn't used much.

Excellent Professor. Extremely nice and she's always there to help. She truly cares about her job. If you study (not that much), do you homework, do your online quizzes, and always go to class you'll pull an A.

Very easy-Just remember to do ur online quizzes before the deadline & go to class & use ur H-ITT remote to earn participation points-she doesn't do them every day, and since this class was at 9:30AM I won't get an A :( but it was easy even for a freshman.
Very good teacher; helpful and enthusiastic; wants students to succeed
Excellent teacher, good lectures, enthusiastic test are very tricky though.
She is very organized and the lectures are very clear and easy to follow. Great teacher!
No Comments
alright class. explains well, and great hand out notes. tests can be somewhat difficult..specially the first one.
She was very nice and made the class easy.
Very nice and very easy to understand!
No Comments
Made Stats both interesting and easy to understand.
good, well-organized
Said to me  Well, I THINK you can do it this way...
excellent explainer, but cold and impersonal

If you do the homework and attend class, you're guaranteed a 70% on the tests. Offers homework corrections and yeah the lecture is long but it's interesting. Not super hard if you have taken set and logic and abstract algebra.
The modules are super lengthy. The lectures are long and yap fests.

Fully online class with Honorlock. As long as you study before each exam and do the practice questions, the exams are very manageable. I think I averaged an 85% on every exam until the final, which I got a 96% on. Not a hard class at all, but be prepared to teach yourself a lot of material. Khan Academy helped a ton.

The professor had limited contact and usually only messaged before exams, but expectations were clear. Study Edge helped me understand most of the material and do well. Put in the work, take practice exams multiple times, and review quizzes. Exams were manageable, especially online.

I really enjoyed professor Nowell's lectures. You can tell he really cares about what he teaches and makes a big effort to make his videos as understandable as possible. He always tries to make us laugh with corny math jokes (which I loved) and it made the lectures easier to get through. And he always had a smile. Thank you so much professor!
This guy is great. Most of the down votes I assume are from non-math majors and introductory courses.

Overall, as my rating would suggest, the class was an absolute mess. The professor speaks as if he has created an entire “new way of learning”, in actuality it is an excuse to teach less yet speak longer. With every question, it's as if he is trying to trick you, and when going to UF tutoring they are often confused and thrown off by him.

Took online, but in his lecture videos he just yaps. 
Lots of theory, little clear instruction. Like why was Pre-Calc the hardest class I had in college. Also canceled office hours a lot and gave us a quiz on thanksgiving and homework over break. No extra credit. He is excited about math, but should be a researcher, not a lecturer.

Doesn't have the best lectures for online courses. I don't think he explains the material to be able to do well on the test. The practice tests are not a good reflection of the actual test. Make sure to really know the concepts. He lets you take quizzes all the way up to the test with no penalty, which is nice.

You don't contact the professor but his lessons online were amazing and he's pretty funny. Overall it's a super easy class because you get practice exams a lot like the real ones (except for the first one there's some concept questions on that one not on the practice), but just introductory and you can cram a module in 3 days if you really try.

Overexplained/complicated lectures, weird quizzes that differ from lectures by a bit. He cannot teach at all. It was me and gauth and my high school precalc notes. Skip him if u can. Only good thing is that he drops ur lowest 4 quiz grades.

Do not take this class with Mr. Nowell. The content itself is not difficult but he makes everything way more complicated than it needs to be. His exams are AWFUL. His lectures and practice problems do not prepare you for the material on his exams. Save yourself and go straight to MAC1147 or take another teacher.

There is generally no professor contact in the online version MAC2233, so be ready to learn on your own unless you go to office hours. You are, however, provided with a practice exam that is almost an exact replica of the actual exam, so take it as many times as you can to solidify the feel of the exam and questions!!!!!
Expecting an A thanks to teachmezach, clears up the concepts in his short videos format.

Coming from someone who struggles with math, these reviews are so inaccurate. Professor Nowell is very accessible and would drop everything to tutor you. Xronos gives practice problems and review that mirrors the exams. He drops 4 quizzes and deadlines are flexible. If you're taking this class, PLEASE go to office hours - you'll see improvement!
Teachmezach all the way. Taught me in less than 2 hours how to prepare for each test. Not pricey at all and so worth it.

Sets and Logic is an inherently difficult class but Professor Nowell did a good job explaining these difficult, conceptual topics. He gave the class a say in what kind of exams we wanted and provided extra credit throughout the course. He was very helpful when you went to him for help.

I thought that these calc 1,2 precalc kids were tripping out with these low ratings and then drop add week ended and he genuinely does not know how to teach to save his life. Pick literally anyone else
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I think that he has fun making the lectures go on absurd tangents. If you're a math major, consider another professor, he wants to constantly do random proofs in class and in the homework give us another random proof to do. It would be good practice if it wasn't the largest chunk of your grade ever for something that we should not know yet
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You're pretty much on your own for this class apart from the lecture videos. If you can self pace this class you should be fine. The Xronos practice exam is basically the real exam with different numbers. I thought the final exam was very difficult though as he threw a lot of curveballs in. Pretty manageable class, except with the HW taking forever
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I've never seen a worst professor. He relies HEAVILY on this Xronos software and rambles. Dear lord he constantly rambles and has no idea how to teach. I'm sure he understands his subject,but he needs to be fired.Go to literally anyone else. He will make 1+1 into a confusing lecture and then test you on how to use exponents claiming you should know

Dr. Nowell is a good professor, Gave the option at the begining of the semester to have take home exams or in class exams (take home being more difficult). Even though I gave him a 3/5 I think his ratings should be higher. Class was made up of three exams and five homeworks. Tough grader but gives good feedback thats crucial to get better.

There is no reason to take Nowell over Vatter, Turull, or Kim. P-sets are interesting and lectures are good, but the grading is ridiculously harsh and you will lose a lot of points if you write anything outside of what he wanted. If you want a good grade in Sets, take almost any other option.

Don't let the negative reviews scare you, this class is 100% doable with some effort. Put the learning targets into ChatGPT to generate practice problems, and throughly review past quizzes to study for exams.
Really enjoyed his lectures despite the difficulty of the class! Grade is based mainly on 5 homework sets and 3 take home exams. Highly recommend.

Most people struggle with this course bc it is the first math class they take at UF. Every math class at UF will be this difficult. Get used to unfamiliar problems on the homework and exams. Very frustrating, but builds problem solving skills. Lecture videos are useful but expect to google some homework questions. Four exams, weekly quizzes.
I am not great calculus so I found this class fairly difficult, but it is attainable to do well if you study and commit time to get good grades on homework's and quizzes.
Lots of time wasted in Xronos and videos that are way too long. Started using teachmezach and saved me time. Do that plus the professors exam reviews.

The class can be challenging, but Unstuck study and the professor's dropped quiz policy help offset the difficulty. Attend lectures and use supplementary resources like Khan Academy to reinforce concepts. With consistent effort, you can succeed in this course.

This class is challenging because the teacher does not prepare you well. The exams are most of your grade, and they are unlike the Xronos provided. The final is not awful as it is comprised of old exam questions. Nowell isn't great by any means, I do not recommend this class. If you take it, be prepared to spend a lot of time teaching yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Nowell completely revolutionized this course at UF for the better. I had not taken a math class in years and was extremely worried about calculus. However, by keeping up with the recommended deadlines, watching each lecture, and using Study Edge to supplement, I was able to truly enjoy it. TAKE THE PRACTICE EXAMS. Your grade is up to you, 100%.

This class was so frustrating at times and the professor was clearly unengaged (reached out very few times during the semester). Exams are overly difficult and do not match the Xronos practice. Lecture videos were long-winded and muddled. Questions would even confuse my friends who were taking Calc 3. Overall, very difficult and would not recommend

I'm a good notetaker, understood the lectures fine enough, and was able to get most of Xronos done - but the exams are horrible. They don't line up with Xronos or the study guides, and wounded my grade. Others complained about the course not aligning with pre-calc from high school, and as someone who didn't take it then, it didn't help much here.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Honestly, don't even bother with this class just go straight to Survey of Calc I or Calc I and retake the Alecs. This was a waste of my time and energy trying to understand his 20 year old lecture videos that are pre-recorded and with BARELY any practice for exams. Nothing prepares you for the exams---questions are pulled out of thin air.

The good thing is that if you stay on top of Xronos, you should only have to dedicate ~3 hours once per week to this class. This time was ALWAYS unpleasant though. Xronos is total garbage and got progressively more disorganized. He gave awful, basic lectures then posted "theoretically difficult" problems to complete that made me question my sanity.

Professor Nowell's lectures were great, though at times he made them unnecessarily long. Xronos was ok, sometimes the practice exercises/exams felt a bit different from the actual exams and quizzes, but not as bad as some people claim to be honest. Also, his exams are all multiple choice and worth 50 points each, so be very careful with that.

Totally inaccessible while taking an online course. There's nothing to go off of except the xronos which looks nothing like the quizzes or tests. Read everything in xronos because not all the material is in the lectures. During the hurricane no announcements were made to the class (likewise during the whole semester)and no due dates were changed.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The lectures do not explain the material well at all. The homework and lectures on the website are not similar at all to the quizzes and exams on canvas. I took pre-calculus in high school but thought I should take it again to be prepared for calc 1, but it was not similar at all to what I learned and just ended up killing my GPA.

This was one of the worst experiences of my life. Not only does he not respond to his emails when I ask for help but his methods of teaching are non existent. The videos he provided would go over the concepts he was trying to teach but would not tell you how to apply them. My friends in calc 3 couldn't help me either.

Absolutely terrible! I am very good in math, and I am not just some dummy I graduated 3rd in my class of 4k students. This prof was absolutely horrific. I swear his goal was to confuse u as much as possible. He'd have a lecture that would give practice questions that were simple, then you take the quiz and have no idea what you're looking at. Run.

I was never too good at math, but was still able to get a good grade. The lectures are not that good, and exams are tough. But the worst part by far is the homework website. The questions NEVER align with the videos and homework, had to be at office hours for help every other day. Genuinely terrible homework website it was the worst part.
Tell me why my friends in Calc 3 did not understand what he was teaching, so confusing. His methods of teaching are questionable...

Do not take this class. The lectures do not teach you how to do the homework, quizzes, or exams as they are filled with content beyond what the teacher has ever taught. It's so frustrating and I don't understand how you are supposed to know how to do problems without any sort of explanation on how to solve it beforehand.
Overall, the class was easy if you kept up the work and he was easy to learn from.

Have had him since Precalc through Survey of Calc 1

Awesome proff I failed alg 2 3 times and he actually made me like math and restore faith in my math abilities

This class was pretty straightforward. I would recommend staying on top of the weekly quizzes and homework. The people who fell behind didn't do great in the class and had to cram before the exam. Sometimes the videos weren't helpful and for some lessons, there was no video and you were expected to read about math concepts, which was difficult.

Professor Nowell was very clear regarding all grading criteria and worked hard to make sure that all students were succeeding on both quizzes and exams. Overall, this was not a difficult course as long you kept up to date with all work.
very nice professor who definitely has interest in what he does, but learning materials never matched exams or the xronos. very difficult. do not take this class online do it in person 100%.
He's unhelpful and condescending. His software, Xronos, is faulty and he refuses to debug it. Other than that, his prerecorded lectures are fine.
This is the easiest and most straightforward calculus class ever. I don't know why people had a tough time

The course was taught by the TA, but the quizzes did not make sense and the material was not the same as the homework. You only have to meet once a week, but the TA tries to cram a week's worth of material in 50 minutes.

The most unclear professor I have ever had
Teaches the course like it is a review course

This class wasn't bad at all and study edge made it super easy. The lectures and xronos tiles are pretty straight forward. The practice exams are very similar to the real exam. I highly recommend taking this class online.

Dr. Nowell was not bad at all. His class gave me a good review of high school pre-calc. However, he really overexplains things that are genuinely just so easy and makes them difficult. I would suggest looking on Khan Academy if you don't understand something as that'll be a simpler explanation. Prof. also drops 4 lowest quizzes which is nice.

Dr. Nowell is knowledgeable and caring. He was always quick to respond to any concerns I had. The Xronos platform he uses can be kind of confusing but you should get used to it. Otherwise, his Survey of Calc 1 course is pretty straightforward, just study and keep on track and you should do fine. He provides detailed examples, which is helpful.

I've taken pre calc before but the way he explains concepts makes it 10x harder and more confusing. All course content is on Xronos, and his videos are often unhelpful, unnecessarily long, and irrelevant. His method of teaching needs improvement, but once you've taught yourself the content, tests are somewhat straightforward.

I already knew a lot of the material that he lectured on, but I struggled in his class because he overcomplicates simple material. The questions on the practice exams are NOTHING like the actual module exams. His final was easy, just study previous exams! I love that he drops your lowest 4 quiz grades because it brought me from an A- to an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Manage your time well, do all the practice/homework, and study your past tests and quizzes!!! Nowell reuses the same questions from the quizzes on the exams. He drops 4/14 of your lowest quizzes, and the final makes up for your worst exam grade. Overall, a pretty simple class just take your time with it.

Over-complicates material. This course consisted of concepts I have learned before, but this professor makes it very difficult to relearn/understand. I had to watch hours of lectures and even had to watch youtube videos to get a grasp of what was going on. The practice exams don't prepare you at all. Some lectures don't teach you concepts.

I took this class online and was nervous because I don't do well in math typically. But, Nowell gives detailed responses to your questions and responds quickly. His teaching style is honestly fine; I think there are easier ways to solve the problems he explains but overall I enjoyed this class and did not think it was difficult. Do practice exams!

The stuff he goes over in the lectures does not pertain to the practice questions and I almost never know how to approach them as I have never seen them before. Before exams, I have to watch videos on youtube on top of the hours of his lectures as he is not very good at explaining things. He overcomplicates things, making it more confusing.

Very nice, but definitely makes easy concepts much more confusing. Basically everything you learn in this course you've probably already learned in Algebra 2; yet, I found myself having to reteach everything to myself as his lectures approached certain concepts in a much more convoluted way than I'd previously learned.

I actually really liked his teaching style. He goes over the concepts behind the math but if that isn't your thing you can just skip through his lecture videos. His exams are EXACTLY like the practice exams he provides so it is really easy to do well. There's one quiz a week and they are really easy.

Literally the worst teacher I have ever had in my entire life, I would seriously rather go to prison for at least 30 days than take this class again. As said by almost every person on here, he completely overcomplicates everything and doesn't go over all the material needed for the exams. The way he does these problems makes me question my sanity.
Overcomplicates everything at the same time as not explaining anything. Exam questions are out of left field and in office hours he ends up confusing you more than helping you
n/a

He is nice but unbelievably overcomplicates absolutely everything. Simple concepts become extremely hard to learn. The provided math website is so confusing to navigate. Worse class I've taken in any subject ever.

Good professor, teaching style is a new one to me but the information was pretty straightforward. He uses Xronos which is a new teaching tool, if you actually take the time for the class you will get an easy A.

Very easy online class with east to follow grading criteria. The tests are very similar to practice tests, and the lectures are very informative. People that gave a bad review probably didn't put in much effort because this is an easy class. Especially if you are taking it over fall, the content should be a lot more spread out. 100% reccomend

Please do not take this class online. The Xronos platform made absolutely no sense and the lectures were extremely difficult to understand. The tests were very very hard, no matter how much work I put in. Even study edge didn't get me through. I highly recommend the in person classes as I heard they were much better.

This is not too difficult of a class and I would say your precalculus does not have to be that strong. Lectures and practice are in Xronos which is fine, but if you get something wrong it can be hard to tell why. Practice exams are pretty close to actual exams; you don't need Study Edge. Drops 3 quizzes, final will replace lowest exam if it helps.

Professor Nowell is passionate about his subject and seems to thoroughly understand precalculus. I like that he explains why we solve mathematics in a certain way rather than just giving us formulas and expecting us to figure things out from there. The practice exams are exactly like the real ones, just study those and you'll do well.

If you have not taken calculus before I would not take this class and opt for the in person one instead. There are not enough examples in the lecturers for you to understand the concepts at all. Also, he is not the easiest man to get in touch with but he seems like nice guy. Definitely do the practice exams on xronos but the actual exams are harder
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment:
Mr. Nowell seems like an awesome guy, and he seems like he genuinely loves teaching. That's awesome!
What isn't awesome, however, is how he barely explains many concepts. He makes everything in the lecture look easy enough for a 5-year-old to complete, but come exam time you can't even understand what you're looking at. It was a frustrating class.

I took MAC1140 as a hybrid course. The online portion on Xronos was easy. But once a week the TA would reteach everything we supposedly learned on Xronos the previous week, but using different methods and adding confusing new terms. Then in the last 10 minutes of class we'd get a quiz about what we just learned 5 minutes before.

Overall professor Nowell is a good lecturer. He makes the material more easy to understand and provides good examples. However, some of the practice and exam questions are much more difficult than the ones he explains leaving a gap that you have to fill. Study edge helped a lot for survey of calc.

This class was practically all online. All of the lectures are videos by the professor on a program called Xronos. You meet once a week with a TA to take a quiz. TA was practically useless in explaining concepts, so if you don't understand them with just the videos, you have to teach yourself.

This year he introduced Xronos which has countless bugs and creates problems that are seemingly impossible when trying to do the homework. His tests frequently had mistakes but he was understanding and easy to reach out to, to fix the mistakes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Nowell was a great lecturer and I came away from every online lecture understanding fully the topic covered. Exams and quizzes were fair and office hours were awesome for preparing for the exam. Xronos does occasionally have its problems but overall was good for practice.

lectures are great, he explains amazing and the class is just homework and exams which he is flexible about the timing. but i would never recommend him to anyone. be prepared to have emails unread, hard TA'S, extremely hard randomized generated homework, and he skips office hours lol. good luck trying to stuck by yourself if you don't know how to

his teaching is like the meme where the teacher teaches how 1 + 1 = 2, then the homework is to find the length of the table (you haven't been taught how to find the length of a table yet), and then you have to then find the dimensions of the table in physical space. Just annoying. He doesnt do a very good job prepping the students for the material

Professor was amazing. I took an online course, which can go terrible for mathematics, but his lectures are incredibly informative and easy to follow. He teaches many different styles and thoroughly works through examples in the lectures. The course is also laid out in a very logical and reasonable way, making it less confusing overall.

Literally just do the practice exams and you will do fine trust me. I suck at math but Professor Nowell really did have informative lectures and was nice about extra credit when I took it. Also had a really great TA who would always respond to questions fast.

Jason inspired me to think of math as an elegant and intellectually stimulating art form instead of a tedious trudge through formulas. Take the practice exams - the real exams pull directly from them. Do Xronos daily instead of saving it for the last minute - you won't finish it in time! You can get an A+ if you give this course the time it needs.

The in person section of this course was more difficult than expected. The TA was very nice and helpful, but the exams were pretty difficult.  I found the real exams to be more challenging than the practice tests. I suggest keeping up with the online lectures and then really focusing on going through the practice exams to study.

Online lectures do not prepare you at all for practice problems or exams. They'll teach you the basics with 0 types of problems seen later. He claims he does this to encourage creativity, however, all of the xronos questions per section are the exact same format with different numbers meaning they do not prepare you for this exam style at all.

Lectures were pretty easy to understand, however assignments were a bit more complicated. Easy to BS though since it's online, as long as you have an understanding of the math and do the practice exams. A lot of the exam questions were the same or structured the same as the practice. Seems nice and seems to respond well to questions.

The interactive textbook gives you the option to attempt multiple types of the same problem to build your skills. His lectures were usually clear and easy to follow. Take the practice exams as many times as possible and review quizzes for exams on Canvas, many of the questions were recycled so study and you will do well! Same for the final.

Took pre-calc online with him through Xronos, which I really didn't like. I don't like having to watch video lectures bc its easier to get distracted and learning math online is just really hard. The practice exams had the exact same questions as on the exams so it wasn't that hard to get a good grade though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class was basically Algebra 2 pt.2 pretty easy. He uses his own website thing Xronos. It's pretty alright. His lecture videos are so long and he basically talked about nothing. Just put him on 2x and read the bottom part. Exams are exactly like practice exams, weekly quizzes. Class was a pretty easy A if you try and do the practice exams.

Jason Nowell is one of the best teachers I have had to this date. He is so incredibly good at explaining things and makes topics easier to understand. He responds to emails pretty quickly (1-4 days) and they are ALWAYS lengthy, helpful emails that actually answer your questions or concerns.

If youre not a math person like me dont take this class. Nowells lectures made it seem like the material would be easy, the homework and tests would be nothing like the examples. The only good part about his class was that the practice exams were similar to the real ones. You 100% have to teach yourself everything. Hes also hard to contact.

You get graded on Xronos, which is ur homework and how u learn the material. It is based on completion and u can try multiple times until u get the answer right. The quizzes are also part of the grade and theres one every week but its only 4 questions and rlly easy to look up the answers, also the exams are exactly the same as the practice exams

Prof. Nowell NEVER responds to emails, doesn't offer help when students are struggling, and didn't ever show up to office hours either. He seemed nice over videos, but they were recorded years ago I think. Please do not take this teacher if you are a struggling freshman :(
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took AB Calc for an AP credit my senior year of high school and completed pre-calc in one semester my junior year of high school and from my experience, Jason Nowell is one of the worst math teachers I have ever had. His examples are easy and the lectures make you feel like you understand the material but this is not the case during hw and tests.
Utilizes pre recorded lectures that are slow and do not make sense. None of the info taught on the lectures is on the quizzes. You basically have to teach yourself math.

Horrible experience. Literally all of the lectures were on YouTube. Hard to reach and was out for like the first month of class with an "illness". Hard grader and not lenient at all. Doesn't answer emails. All of my classmates complained about him. DONT CHOOSE HIM!!

Very nice guy. The coursework is really difficult if math is not your strongest subject. No textbook is required since you're using the math software for learning the concepts. I personally did not think the material was reflected on the exams and quizzes. I used YouTube for most of my learning because of the confusing material that was presented.

He seemed like a nice guy and eager to help. He was flexible when I had an issue with an exam date, which I appreciated. However, I felt his teaching style was confusing more often than not. I have a lot of trouble with math in general so the class was definitely a challenge for me. The exams were not too bad if you do the practice exams.

I really liked this class! The material was difficult but Professor Nowell made it bearable. The practice exams were just like the real exams. I also liked how you could practice your skills on Xronos. Overall, I would definitely recommend Professor Nowell.
Pretty easy class, but study edge helped. Lectures were posted on Xronos and the whole class is just Xronos, quizzes, and 4 exams + final. Not bad just busy work

Xronos has been updated and is more reliable. The quizzes are harder at the beginning of the semester but as you progress it gets easier as they are not proctored. To score well on the exam, religiously study his practice exams. He's honestly not bad and the TAs are helpful and his office hours are said to be helpful.

Professor Nowell's lectures were sometimes boring, but Xronos (program used) was actually helpful sometimes in teaching you stuff, I liked the practice questions. However, I don't know how much precalc I actually learned, but it seemed like a review of Alg 2. Nowell's exams are SUPER easy tho. DO THE PRACTICE EXAMS! They are extremely beneficial!

Jason is a nice guy and easy to reach. The practice exams reveal all questions you will have in the real one. As long as you watch his videos, you will get an A for free. Took this course last semester as a gpa booster and ended up with 100.(I am not a math person)

Lectures were pre-recorded and easy to watch. Explains material in a simple way. Grade depends on weekly quizzes, 4 online exams and the final. Uses Xronos program heavily, but it's easy to navigate and gives you a lot of practice so it's easy to learn the material when the class is taken online. Professor Nowell sends out good updates on canvas.

Professor Nowell was awesome! He was easy to reach, despite the course being 100% online. His lectures were clear and informative. He appreciates feedback from his students and is always looking for ways to improve an already amazing course. Im not a big fan of precalculus, but he made it oddly enjoyable. I would highly recommend him!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: doesn't know how to explain or teach math in a logical way, khan academy was more helpful, had students do stupid projects that didn't relate to math

This guy was. incredibly. unorganized and spent so much time teaching things that weren't important and didn't really correlate to the exams. Class was frustrating but I stopped watching his lectures and. just went to my TA breakout session weekly. My TA was phenomenal and held review sessions before exams. Practice exams he gives are very helpful.

Take this class online if you can. Tests are very similar to practice exams and nothing to struggle over. The guy legitimately cares about his students and is very helpful in giving review sessions/flexible office hours.

He is extremely bad/disorganized at teaching math, you are really in trouble if you don't understand the concepts before hand. For example, we ran out of time before an exam, and were told to teach ourselves logarithms. Tests are copies of past exams, so study those really well. He ends up hyper-inflating your grade over 7% points.

I took Precalculus with Professor Nowell. He was very willing to help struggling students and he explained the material well in lecture. There were a few organizational issues with the class- with the online homework system, Xronos, being buggy, as well as the grade book consistently being updated late. But overall this class is very manageable.

He isn't the greatest teacher. Honestly, going to review sessions, tutoring at Little Hall, and going to offices for my TA were the main contributors of getting an A in this class. I did attend Nowell's office hours sometimes, but it was only helpful because he pointed out the mistakes made in the practice exam that he created. Lectures were okay.

This class is not that bad at all, I don't get why there are so many negative reviews. I'm not a math person AT ALL and I ended up with an A. As long as you put in some type of effort you will get a good grade in the class, seeing as he has resources available for students like practice exams that will help you succeed.

Clearly most of his reviews are bias from people taking MAC 1140, and from my poverties they prob don't care much about the class or have any other interest but getting a good grade. Took calc 2 and sets & logic with him and he was by far one of the best math teachers at uf.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I can honestly say I did not learn a single thing from this man. I got an A in this class 100% from the TA's help and hours of teaching myself each question. THANKFULLY his exams were almost identical to previous exams that he posts online. Don't expect him or his Xronos to teach you anything. It's all on your TA and you to get an A in this class.

I am not one to complain about teachers, but this was the most disheartening course I have ever taken. I cannot say I have ever had a worse, unprepared teacher. Exam questions are constantly incorrectly marked wrong due to laziness and improper review. Lectures are absolutely pointless. Believe me when I say, DO NOT TAKE THIS. SAVE YOURSELF.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Honestly, this class is not as bad as others say, but Nowell does often seem unprepared and flustered during his lectures. The past exams have been almost copies of the practice exams, so just memorize the process. I don't honestly feel like I have learned that much. Xronos, the online textbook, is not very helpful. Try to go to TA review sessions.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: His class was really easy to follow and he gives you all the materials you need to get an A. The exam reviews are extremely helpful for the exams so pay attention to those. I mostly used the Xronos to learn but some people payed more attention to the lectures. Hes super willing to help you. Im not great at math but this class wasnt bad at all.

The class itself is not difficult to pass as long as you can do the kind of math that you wouldve learned in algebra 2 and precalculus in high school. The lectures dont help much and Im sure Jason is a great person but I was not confident in his teaching skills at all. Personally my TA was not terrible but didnt always know what he was doing.

This class is NOT hard. His lectures are not helpful but the TA's understand that and do a great job re-explaining the material. You're allowed to go to any TA's office hours so make time to go! The tests are exactly like the practice exams so study those! Quizzes are easy and TA reviews before them. Group project is easy and includes extra credit.

Dr Nowel needs to learn to not go into such deep detail because it's unnecessary. He has a model project at the start of the semester that is very easy, and he wasted a lot of time unfortunately. Really just make sure to do the study guides and hope and pray for either a TA who can teach or go to the tutoring center for extra help if lost

I took his class as a hybrid so his lectures were posted online. He always posted the lectures late on canvas which was annoying. His lectures made simple math confusing. Quiz every week in the discussion classes taught by a TA. I had a really good TA who gave us easy quizzes. Practice exams are just like the exams given. Just study and you're okay

I'll just leave a little excerpt from the syllabus that sums up the teaching style, which is, don't actually teach what's on the exam? "If you have always had problems that are variations of problems that have been demonstrated for you already, then your teachers have done you a grave disservice.". Thanks Jason.

He's not really as bad as some of these reviews make him out to be. I would say as long as you have an ok-ish background in algebra 2 from high school you should be pretty ok in the class. The exams are very similar to the practice tests he gives and help a ton! He's a really nice guy just can be a little bit lost during the lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: I'm sure he's a great person but oh my GOD this man can not teach. Everything he says comes out very confusing during lectures, and we're never prepared for his own exams. Not to mention Xronos which I guess he made himself? Tons of unbelievably hard problems on the SAME topic over and over. Redundant and STUPID, why use an online tool for math?!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I cannot begin to describe how awful this class is. I have never had an issue with math but this professor has made every lecture, assignment, and test more complicated than it needs to be. This class not only lowered my GPA but also confused me more about calculus and I am extremely upset about it. For your own sake, do not take this course.

Absolutely one of the worst teachers I have had at UF. I feel so unprepared for my Calculus class and I am very sad about it. His lectures make no sense and he makes PRE CALC harder than it should be. I thought I knew pre calc from high school but through this class, I can successfully say I unlearned it. DO NOT TAKE THIS

Not a good professor. His lectures are pointless and a waste of time as he does not clearly explain ANYTHING. All of the work he writes out he is essentially doing in his own head and not explaining to the class. This class confused me even more than I was when I came into it. I don't feel prepared for my next math course and I am a math major

Jason is not organized at all. Jason doesn't talk with the TAs and they don't know what is going on in the class. Jason's logic doesn't make sense. He re-designed the class a year ago and it's not structured well. In your discussions, you get quizzed every week, a project and 3 exams. I would recommend NOT having Jason as a professor. WORST EVER

Jason Nowell will ramble on about utter nonsense for the entire lecture. Im unsure how he doesnt bore himself. Practically speaks to a wall. Then after lecturing about nonsense he will test on the most obscure topic and it will not bode well. Take my word about and sign up for another class, anything would be more interesting than this course.
Excellent professor, take him for Calculus 2, or Sets and Logic, or if you are planning on becoming a math major.
Good guy, very funny and willing to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is one of the worst classes I have had in my college career. You will learn absolutely nothing and be tested on topics youve never seen in class or online. Its the most BS class Ive ever had and thats the tea.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Jason is a wholesome person but is not effective at teaching. There is little to no communication between him, and the TAs. what we are taught in class does not reflect what we are tested on in the exam. I have used EVERY resource this class has to offer and have spent countless hours with a study group, and I do all that and still get low grades?

Taking Jason's pre-calculus class was the most disappointing experience imaginable. For one thing, the tests contained information that we had not yet covered (or, at least, PROPERLY covered). Also, he would often go off-topic during his lectures (which might be why he never got around to teaching us everything that would be on the test).
Exams had nothing to do with what was taught in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Nowell made things a lot more complicated than needed. A lot of material covered during lecture and homework was not reflective on exams past the first and second exams. Make sure to read the lecture notes even though they are long and boring because certain questions will be work a lot and come from there. Pick a good TA if you have him.

Jason definitely made concepts that made sense in high school seem 10x more difficult. Claimed that this class would be about truly learning material, but wound up leaving me more confused then when I started. He would often go off on tangents on his lectures, making some of the problems he would do difficult to follow. Really hard to get an A...
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Jason is pretty cool, but this class was ridiculously hard in my opinion. I didn't think I would pass at all.

Jason, who although seems like a very kind and smart individual, does not know how to effectively teach a large body of students. His lectures and lecture notes are extremely confusing , even when they are on simple concepts. All of the work throughout the semester (homework, exams,lecture notes) contained multiple typos and mistakes.

The way he teaches in lecture makes everything hard. The steps that you thought you knew from middle and high school has to be thrown away to understand his style of teaching. The problems he does in lectures are way easier than what he puts on the test. Every test we took, there were mistakes he made on the exam. You really have to try hard .
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Made Pre-calc way harder than it should be. Tries to explain topics so that you understand more than just the formula but ends up confusing students. Exams ALWAYS have something on them that was never taught in class.

He is very helpful during office hours and I think that's what led me to getting an A in the class. Do as many practice tests and problems as you can until you don't get the questions wrong. Plenty of extra credit available so use it! Study edge is minimally helpful in my opinion. You learn the material in this class by DOING not watching.

Great TA, took him over summer so he taught all of the material. He's a pretty fair grader, he does follow a rubric, though. Collects in class group work for participation, and gives more than enough opportunity for points. He'll work with you if you're on the edge of a grade. The class itself is tough, and requires a good amount of studying.

He is not the one who makes the exams. Skips steps he feels everyone should know but if many people need explanation he would stop and explain a step. If someone leaves early form lecture, he would give extra clicker point opportunities. Funny sometimes.

Boring lectures. Need to be there to participate and get credit. Sometimes funny though and gives more points after students leave early. Tough hw and tests. Lots of work. DO NOT waste money on the textbook.
Solid Professor. Class isn't too difficult, but if you want an A use study edge. Go to class.
Great professor. Some lectures can get confusing and he sometimes skips certain information that is necessary. Study Edge helped so much. His teaching plus study edge allowed me to get an A.

At times he can be kind of confusing. He clearly knows he subject and can explain it, but sometimes has a difficult time showing us how to do a problem. He makes mistakes sometimes so you really just have to pay attention to see what is going on. Office hours were helpful. He has really nice math related t-shirts.

Not a bad instructor. Very clear with steps and explanations of concept. The class itself is very very hard due to the subject matter. Use office hours and do the homework! That's the best way to prepare for the exams.

Skips many steps, makes frequent mistakes and doesn't always clarify when he has made one. For a basic class he would have a great teaching style, but in this challenging course he just skips too much content. Treats lectures like a review

I like Jason a lot. He has a very collected personality and obviously knows what he's talking about. However, if you're not too solid at math, I would imagine that he seems confusing because he skips a lot of simple algebraic steps when explaining solutions, such as simplifications and distributions. Nonetheless, I like the way he teaches.
lectures are really boring, busy work and group project is basically all you do. get ready to self teach web dev technologies and hope for a good group

really easy class, i didn't go to class at all after the first week. attendance not required and there is no point to go to class because its all group projects outside of class with no exams so no content to learn. didn't really learn anything in this class from the prof, just learning stuff when doing projects... have a competent group
This is a nothing burger class. Busy work and semester project.

Nothing wrong with HER, just the class. She's super nice, just the class is all busy work in the first half, then dealing with horrible teammates in the second half. Impossible not to get an A. But it's just an INTRO swe course, and she taught the relevant workforce swe content. Idk why people are so dramatic about it. Pick good group members.

Lectures are mandatory for in-class activities. The course consists of some assignments and a semester group project, with no exams or quizzes. As long as you do the work, the course should be an easy A. Not a very useful class ultimately, but it wasn't bad.
Lectures are useless when it comes to learning anything useful for software engineering. Every week there is an in-class assignment that is a complete waste of time.

I took her for summer. The class is essentially just a group project/participation award. Her lectures don't matter for the class and have no real substance. The difficulty depends on how ambitious your group is, you could get an A with very few workhours if your group wants to do the bare minimum. Attendance was once per week and could be virtual.

This class felt very fake. The prof pretended to lecture, the TAs pretended to grade, and the students pretended to learn. You have to make a website without learning how or being assigned prereqs. It was an easy A if you do the work, but the weekly assignments are repetative & unnecessary. Wastes potential to simulate a real work enviroment.

The class itself wasn't terrible, more of busy work. However, beware of some of the TAs. Mine put in grades at the end and then gave us one day to dispute them and then *ghosted me* when I emailed them 🤦‍♀️

Professor couldn't care less about class so most people breeze by with an A, but pray to god you don't have an issue. Got a zero on a couple of key assignments and despite all the evidence in the world she refused to change it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Basically just a semester-long group project, but requirements are vague and assignments are disorganized. Lectures are kind of pointless but there are in-class assignments you have to do on Fridays, but you can join on zoom.
The lectures didn't really add much, and most of what you learn comes from whatever tech you end up using for the semester project

Her lectures were completely a waste of time and she looked like she didn't want to be teaching. We were not prepared by her lectures or the TA's discussion to create the main group project. All the documentation assignments took away from our time teaching ourselves full-stack dev and it seemed like busy work. This class was so frustrating.

Essentially a semester-long group project with hours and hours of useless busywork sprinkled in. During lectures, all she does is read off slides with near-zero emotion in her voice. The only reason to attend class is the required, completely unrelated in-class assignment every week. Easy A, but the biggest waste of time I've ever been put through.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class is full of pointless busy work—weekly activities with long readings and lectures where she just reads off the slides. I was excited for Intro to Software Engineering, but Rani made it dull and unhelpful. The only good part is the group project, but even that comes with weeks where we have 3-4 useless assignments due.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Average professor and the semester-long project was fun. Just make sure to reach out to your teammates and actually interact with them and you're guaranteed an A.

class is easy but she is pretty disorganized and not clear with grading guidelines or deadlines. her lectures can be interesting sometimes if you are genuinely interested in HCI but other times very redundant. Easy A if you put in the work but be prepared for last minute assignment changes and almost the whole class is group work based

Honestly I've taken CEN3031 and am now taking CEN4721. I think classes she teaches are just busy work with weekly assignments and her lectures aren't very necessary to pass the class or assignments. Easy GPA boost.
Maybe 10 hours of work total for the entire semester. Easiest A of my life. I don't think a single person in the class did not get an A.

Consider this class the easiest A ever unless you genuinely want to learn software engineering practices. This was her first time teaching this class and it absolutely shows in her lectures. Consistently contradicts her requirements, communication with everyone is nonexistent. Group project is managable, but dont expect much from this class.

I believe this was her first class she ever lectured. She really struggled to captivate the class's attention during lectures, almost no one attended beyond the first couple weeks. The structure of assignments was also a mess. Hopefully she'll improve after a few semesters of teaching

Lectures aren't mandatory, and probably unnecessary. There are Friday in-class activities you must turn in during class time, but you can be on the Zoom. Also discussions are mandatory. The class is basically just working on a group project the whole time. I feel the criteria is not clear many times, but the grading is very lenient anyway.

Her lectures and work given often felt unorganized and we had few assignments to be graded on. The lectures would often focus too much on concepts, but then the exams would be more math heavy in comparison. I would recommend utilizing your textbook and outside sources. Otherwise it was still an interesting class to take.
Her exams are poorly managed. She has no prep material for exams, which makes exam prep an overly difficult process.
I think my other review got deleted. Don't take this class online, she's completely useless in terms of help and the tests are way too hyper-specific for a 1000 level course.

I found her AST3018 class to be quite enjoyable! She formats the class so that lectures are online and class time is spent working on practice problems. Some have mentioned that her lectures were hard to understand, but I didn't experience this myself. Overall, she loves to connect with her students and is a great professor to have!
Pretty easy class. Impossible tests but lots of assignments to make it up. Marinas never responded to any emails i sent her, and there was no clear way to see any TAs.

It was an interesting class and most of the assignments/quizzes are on quizlet. The information is complicated though and kind of hard to remember unless you're interested in it. The lectures can be long sometimes but not too bad. The exams aren't hard if you study, but most of the questions are from the practice exams/previous quizzes.

My TA graded discussion posts like she took joy in ruining our grades. First college class I've gotten multiple D's on discussions. The projects take forever if you don't pay for a website like CourseHero. A ton of online assignments due every week and if you miss a few theres no shot you're getting an A. TOOOO much work for an 1000 level gen-ed.

The class itself is A LOT of information but its kind of interesting. The quizzes are super easy and the exams are mostly questions from the quizzes or practice exams. The projects arent too bad and the homework can sometimes take a while but its not hard at all. The lectures are sometimes hard to understand and usually contain a lot of info.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Ive seen a lot of people here say this professor is a lot of work. I took AST1002 during the Summer, so it may be different for me. Prof. Naibi is fair and understanding. Shes passionate about the subject. While theres a little bit of work, its really not all that much. Just do your quizzes (easy for the most part) and go to class, youre fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: This class is awesome and he has a way to make every lecture interesting and enjoyable. The exams are weighted less than your typical math/science courses and the homework is 45% of your grade. I was able to understand a majority of the material with light studying.

Absolutely love this man he really knows the material he teaches, and does it extremely well. This is my second semester taking a class with him, and his expectations were the same. He wants all of his students to not only succeed, but understand the material and take it with them. Very awesome guy.

Dr. Narayanan was awesome! Outright said he wanted us all to get As, and made that a reality for anyone who tried. Encouraged collaboration on homework and made it a major portion of the grade so exams were less stressful. His lectures were entertaining and I enjoyed this class much more than I expected. If you have a choice, choose his section!
Dr. Narayanan is amazing just take him as a professor
The goat (Took AST3019)

I learned so many really applicable programming skills from this class. He's very generous with grading and really wants you to succeed. The project was challenging but really fun to try to figure out (I think only one person got it right but we all scored really well for effort lol). Would recommend this class to every physics/astrophysics major.
Great professor, very excited about what he teaches which makes me excited to learn. Always has a positive attitude, wants to help you at all costs if you ask. 10/10

This teacher was amazing! Very kind, responded to emails in a timely manner. The information in the class can be a little difficult to understand sometimes, but that is expected. Overall, would be more than happy to take another class with this professor.

First of all, she is a good teacher, however, there are no textbooks or recorded lectures. She pulls test questions from articles and videos she posts each week. Many articles would not work. Midterm exam had questions that were covered last week of class. Not enough time on quizzes, but two attempts. It is a good class, not the easiest.
While the content itself can be boring, she is very kind and caring and responds very quickly to emails. Obviously very knowledgable in her field already, despite only being a graduate student.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: class is not hard to comprehend but only 3 exams and they are worth 90% of ur grade. GET STUDYEDGE if you dont go to lectures or watch them bc you can def pass with just the review from study edge. notecard allowed for exam. some of the exam wording can get you but really is an easy class

would advise against watching his lectures (you can if ur confused) but you must not go in person. He speaks at 1x speed in person, and it is physically unbearable. But he does keep you up-to-date on information. says 2 questions r based on lectures, they r ez and not based on lectures. I last minute studied all exams, used PAST EXAMS

reviews.comment: rush vs the director

Rush is a very funny professor with terrific lectures. They are definitely on the longer side but very interesting and engaging. Study Edge helps if you want to spend less time on the course but definitely isn't necessary.

Super funny and great lecturer, however, it's literally impossible to get a 100% on an exam. The way the questions are written makes some questions literally impossible, and there is no curve unless the average is under a 66%, which never happens. Great teacher though.

Dr. Rush is a great professor and super passionate! I really liked him and his class, but I know a lot of people who felt differently. There are 3 exams that are 90% of your grade, so if you aren't a good test taker, don't take ECO2023 unless you HAVE to. Great class IMO but not for everyone!

reviews.comment: So he has some cheezy lectures and is personable. What I didn't like is that there was no practice on homework and that means you are guessing when you turn in homework. Since each assignment was 3 points, he gave weird grades like 2.1, and 2.4 which really hurt your grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: This class is almost impossible to get an A in. 90% of the final exam is based on 3 exams (30 questions each). I read the entire textbook, watched all his lectures, and studied and still found it difficult to not get a few wrong. The other 10% is on weekly quizzes which are open note and easy. Study from the beginning if you want any chance at an A
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is extremely fair and well structured. His lectures are great and cover everything needed for the exams, which are very similar to the practice ones. My only complaint is that exams are worth 90% of the grade.

+
- Makes an effort in lectures
- Light workload & no hw

-:
- Exams = 90% of your grade
- He gets off track in lectures
- He gives little practice & super old exams
- Doesn't prep you for exam well, so you NEED study edge to do well in this class

If I got study edge earlier (ppl told me you don't need it), I would've ended the class with an A.

This class is manageable if you put in consistent effort. Lectures aren't bad at all, and staying on top of them plus doing practice tests helps a lot. I got Study Edge after the first exam and felt it was helpful but not necessary. An A is tough due to test weighting, but overall, not a hard class.

felt like he wanted students to fail with the way he structured the grading scale. sent out condescending emails and offered absolutely no extra credit on top of it. did not care for this class but since you have to take it with him just get study edge his lectures aren't really helpful.

He is very nice, but his lectures are awful and boring. Study edge will teach you everything and has everything you need. The tests count for 90% of grade making it just about impossible to get an A. Exams are so hard for no reason. Idk why he changed the course to be so difficult. You really need to be a genius or dedicate hours to this course. 90% of your grade for tests for an intro class is insane as many freshmen take this. Practice exams are sm easier. Please do not take this class if it is not required. Genuinely the worst professor I have ever had on this campus.

do not take.

He's pretty funny but not a great professor.

None of these reviews do Professor Rush justice. It's clear he doesn't want students to succeed & even admits to making the course harder over the years. Yet his practice material is outdated. I cannot rave about Professor Rush enough! He is hilarious and great at lecturing. I always made sure to attend class in person. This, and reading the assigned chapters made microeconomics a breeze! If you can take this with Rush, do it!
40% of class time spent on tangents that diverts focus away from learning. This hurts especially because the 3 exams are 90% of your grade.
No sympathy for students. Tests unlike practice exams and super unpredictable. Get ready to study.

Exams make up too much of the grade. He is really fun and engaging in class but he is definitely old-school. He will mostly make announcements through his live lectures. I would say he is a good teacher but could use some work on his course structuring.

Fun class, professor likes teaching. It's true it's very test-heavy but you get practice exams you can use and there's office hours you can go to so I would say if you get a 100% on a practice you're good, but if you're getting less than 90% you have to change something as you probably won't get an A in the class, also get the 10 points on quizzes.
Good professor, exams are 90% of the grade. Be very careful, you need to lock in from the start.

Prof himself has a good personality and cares about the course. However, he recently changed the grading scale to be 90% exams, comprised of 3, 30-question exams. Very inaccessible and unresponsive to students. He discourages emails and provides little to no academic support. Three exams determine 90% of the final grade, with no extra credit. reviews.comment: Professor Mark Rush was fantastic! I highly recommend any course that he teaches. Not only is he extremely intelligent and professional, but he makes you excited about learning. I liked Dr. Rush's class. The most important thing when taking the class is taking and understanding the practice exams, because they're very similar to the exams he gives. I definitely recommend using the textbook and I also used StudyEdge on topics that confused me. As a whole, I thought it was a little bit hard but it wasn't too bad.

Professor Rush is such a nice and funny lecturer. He makes it very clear what is being asked in exams and his practice exams are super similar to real exams. Study edge helps but not necessary. He is very entertaining and truly seems to enjoy teaching that class. Totally recommend!!

Literally the cutest lil professor ever. He explains the topics really well and the class was super informative and applicable to the real world. He's also super funny and the class is very entertaining.

Lectures are informative and engaging. Material is only difficult for the final exam, I studied the same amount for all exams and did considerably worse on the final. Lots of extra credit. I would definitely recommend taking this class with Professor Rush.

Good luck passing this class without smokin notes or study edge! Lectures are really a waste of time. Did better in Orgo than I did in this class. He does not adjust grades or give extra credit. Don't bother emailing to ask because you'll receive a smart answer back. If you're not a business major and in CALS, take the other alternative AEB2014.

Never watched a lecture but grinded Study Edge a few days before each test. Practice tests are great for practice. Weekly quizzes (not worth much of grade). Clearly passionate and had a great sense of humor. However, the lectures could be a little all over the place. Would have appreciated a bit more structure. Didn't love some of the exam questions, but the material isn't too bad if you practice. A good amount of extra credit was given.

highly reccomend

Rush's lectures are fun to watch and pretty engaging for how boring the material is. Dad type humor, always making fun of director. Really great professor, exams aren't too hard

He is a good lecturer and pretty funny. He cares about the subject and tries his best to teach in an approachable way. Rush is great, very entertaining but sometimes examples can be drawn out and can lose you a bit. You can get def get by without reading the textbook chapters but lectures are helpful. There are 3 writing/graphing assignments that you have to complete, as well as weekly quizzes.

90 percent of grade comes from three, 30 question exams (each question is one percent of grade). Practice exams are helpful and relevant. Cut off for an A is a 95, A- is 92. Gave extra credit and dropped lowest quizzes. Go to class & take notes, draw graphs, and do the optional practice questions.

Honestly a great and respectable professor, but do not expect to get ANY extensions. I got the flu and am working in the hospital 24/7, and he never helped with either situations when needed meanwhile all my other professors were nothing but helpful. He was pretty funny and had entertaining lectures, and I did not have difficulty with material.
Dr. Rush was awesome and this course covers a lot of information in a short time. He is quick and thorough with his feedback.
Cool dude that wants to see you succeed.

Professor Rush is amazing and makes economics enjoyable to learn. I did not study much besides grinding practice exams and was able to get a B+. I think it is very doable to get an A if you put in just a couple hours a week. Studyedge is not needed in my opinion

Mark Rush was honestly a great professor. He clearly enjoyed teaching and has been teaching this class for so long he knows how to deliver. I watched the lectures online and they were great. The professor is great at explaining concepts and has a fun sense of humor, making the class more entertaining. It's on me for not getting an A, which is totally possible. Watch the lectures, skim over the book (paying attention to vocab and key concepts he doesn't mention in class), and do ALL practice exams.

He was entertaining in class but the only thing is that he goes off topic quite often; the lectures are longer than it needs to be. The midterms and the final exam are what really determine your grade so if you're a bad test taker...yeah. I suck at exams so I struggled a bit. He also refuses to give out extra credit.
Dr. Rush is an amazing professor! He explains concepts thoroughly and prepares you well for exams.

As someone who knows nothing about economics this was a horrible class. I took it to fill a req but had to withdraw because the material was so completely different from anything before. Mark Rush is a great professor this just wasn't the class for me as an art major.

He is such a good guy and is obviously very experienced and knowledgeable on the topic. His lecturers are funny and very helpful. He gives everyone previous exams to study and will steal some questions from them. Take this class.

GET STUDY EDGE. reviews.comment: Rush is the man, he gives engaging and informative lectures that prepare you for the exams very well.

Lectures are largely unnecessary. Focus on the textbook, use the Dynamic Study Modules in Pearson, do all the practice exams - questions on the exams are frequently very similar to those in the past. Practice exams are a very good indicator of how you will do. Try to understand rather than memorize, it'll be easier that way.

One of the nicest people you'll meet. Don't need study edge. Do his practice exams, and you're virtually guaranteed an A. I cried on the last day of class knowing that I wouldn't have him the following semester. Definitely go to his office hours as he's way different and extremely caring. Honestly couldn't recommend this dude enough.

Professor Rush is a great teacher. The lectures are long, but he makes economics actually interesting to learn. The one thing that sucks is that the exams include questions from the textbook that aren't covered in class. Overall, I would say that MicroEcon was a pretty easy course, just make sure you study for the exams.

Rush is a super cool guy. Took his class for fun and I would recommend everybody taking a class with him. He truly loves his job and loves econ and the class itself was relatively straight forward and easy

Dr. Rush is awesome! I've never seen a professor be so enthusiastic about student questions. He is also super helpful in office hours and loves when students attend.  Exams are tough but doing the practice tests really help. Lectures are super easy to understand and his banter with the director adds extra entertainment and makes them even better :)

Prof Rush is a funny guy, and teaches the course very well. Make sure to watch the lectures and reviews before midterms, especially his final exam review. Only thing that sucked is that he made the 2nd midterm extremely difficult for no reason. However, he made up for it with his amazing final exam review. Def do the practice exams.
