The content is not hard; however, the exam questions are. Mark Rush is an entertaining guy though!

Mark Rush as a person is extremely funny, but the class was unnecessarily difficult. It's exam heavy so if you don't do well on those you'll get a lower grade (granted it won't be that much lower). I just wish there were more professors and it could be more personal (but that's not his fault). You can tell he has tenure.

The material itself wasn't hard, but the way the grading scale was set up, it's hard to get an A unless you do really well on all your exams. The actual exams are pretty difficult. I did all the practice exams for every exam and still scored average. I didn't have study edge, so if you get it, that might help. I enjoyed his lectures though. Fun guy

I do recommend buying Study Edge or studying for the exams in advance because I did not do as well as I had hoped and the exams are more difficult than the quizzes.

Rush is super entertaining, and is clearly very passionate about what he is teaching. Exams are 90% of your grade so you have to keep up with the lectures and study hard. I didn't have study edge, but my friends have told me it was super helpful.

Nice guy but wasn't expecting the class to be so hard. Relied on study edge for a lot. Found exams to be really challenging and tricky because there's so much information. Definitely recommend getting study edge. Also keep up with the lectures, if you get behind it is hard to catch up.

Dr. Rush is hilarious, clearly cares about the subject, and makes his lectures entertaining. There are not many grades, so it's important to do well on your exams. Pay attention to the lectures and do all the practice exams, and you'll be just fine. I also recommend reading the textbook; sometimes, he pulls exam questions from there.

Hilarious guy. 3 exams make up a ton of your grade. Exams are only 30 questions all multiple choice. Some exam questions were unclear. If you barely miss a few exam question you can easily go down a full letter grade.

The best professor I've had so far at UF, hands down. Super great guy, you can tell he genuinely loves teaching. He makes the lectures entertaining, uses plenty of examples, and his office hours are super helpful. Doesn't try to trick you on exams, and the practice tests are very similar to the real thing. I want an economics minor now

Professor Rush was excellent, you can tell he deeply cares about his field and is pretty succinct in his lectures. I'd recommend reading the book in conjunction with the lectures. The quizzes are easy but for the exam you'll need to read with the lectures.

reviews.comment: The professor was very good, but there were only 2 assignments, so the tests weighed a lot.
Grade is how well you do on three exams, study edge should make it easy to get at least a B in the class. Rush's lectures are good to watch,  he explains the material very well.

Tests were worth 75% of grade, but they are not hard at all. All I did was watch the lectures and then do 1/2 practice exams the day of, concepts are easy and straightforward. I wasn't able to get a better grade only because all the test were right after I got home from a full time internship and was too lazy to actually study beforehand.

I suggest really being thorough with your HW & Project. The questions are easy (2+2=4) but if you just put 4, expect some points taken away. The questions are broad but he has a specific answer!

The exams are worth 3/4 of your grade so a bad score on even 1 of them essentially screws you over for the semester. Using outside resources such as StudyEdge didn't prove useful for exam preparation and even choosing to gruel through the online lectures doesn't assure a passing score. The professor is nice but avoid this class if you can!

reviews.comment: Do not screw up the SWAs. They are super important to off set the tough tests. Rush is a good g

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Rush! He's a funny guy, which makes him a good lecturer. All that is needed to succeed in this class (I got a 100.7) is to take notes on his lectures and base your notecard on them. Take all of the practice exams available to you using your notecard and add/adjust. StudyEdge is not needed; they got the only unclear part of a SWA wrong.

He is often rude and unwilling to help his students. While I got an A on every exam, the lack of standardization with TAs grading writing assignments hurt my grade and when I showed him how my paper scored 12 points below very similar ones, all he did was offer to lower other students' grades. He does not try to fix any issues for anyone.

Smokin Notes was so helpful for this course. I didn't watch a single lecture and only studied Smokin Notes the day of for every exam and they were very helpful. Do the practice exams that Rush provides as there are repeat questions from them on the actual exams. There are extra credit questions on exams and SWAs that help with your grade as well.

Although Rush's lectures can be helpful, I found this class tough due to the wording of the exams and the amount of material you need to know for each one. The short writing assignments boost your grade a ton but he has ultra-specific instructions that you need to follow to a T to not get a 0. Do all the practice exams and then do them again.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is a legend. 40+ years of teaching here and still making students smile. Several of my uncles had him back in 1989! The previous exams are just like the real exams. I reccomend using Smokin Notes over Study Edge. If you pay the utmost attention to the previous exams on Canvas, you may not need any other study aids!

He's an okay professor. I wouldn't blame him for academics. My problem with him is that he is a terrible person. Keeps your grades locked so you have to calculate it on your own, makes hurtful jokes about past students, spends the whole class "shaming" his director, sends pretty backhanded emails. He just feels so negative, not fun to be around.

Rush is an awesome guy. I went to all of his lectures in person because I learn better that way, and he loves taking questions from students. 3 exams (worth 20% each) and make up the majority of your grade and these can be tricky, but he gives you ample resources to prepare. I definitely recommend making a study group and taking the practice exams.

AMAZING. Made me pursue an economics major. Super funny and he is really passionate about what he teaches. Go to his office hours, he really likes that. He is super approachable and loves questions. Gives exam reviews and old exams which is super helpful!

Professor Rush is so funny and always kept the attention of the class. I did not do well on the first two exams at all, but going to office hours showed me how caring he was and willing to help me understand the material. I ended up getting a B on the final exam and can't recommend him enough!
I used Smokin' Notes for all of his exams and passed. Do the practice exams!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Mark Rush is highly intelligent and one of the most passionate professors I have ever taken a course under. He explains topics in a pleasant and constructive way, making the course easy for those who watch the lectures, the one problem is the lack of an in person section, so you actually have to watch the lectures.

Do not recommend this class at all. First off, the exams are nothing like the lectures, and the textbook doesn't really help. He is not very approachable and also will not really help whatsoever. I read every chapter through and through and studied and still did terrible on the exams. Even if you ace every assignment, one bad midterm ruins it.

reviews.comment: There are 3 exams and you can bring a flashcard of material to help. I thought the exams were very hard, although he provided past exams, some questions on the exams were nothing like past exams. I studied so hard particularly for exams 2 and 3, going to office hours multiple times for hours on end, and still could never do well on the exams.

Dr. Rush's lectures are great! Enjoyable and funny lectures. You can easily put them on 2x speed. The content was very intuitive and exams were not hard if you did practice exams. Study Edge helped break down content and for SWAs. I stopped reading the book halfway through the semester though since it was not useful to me.

i liked dr. rush's humor and the effort he put into the class. i wish the class wasn't online since it was hard to keep up sometimes, but i recommend him for microeconomics! exams are somewhat tricky, but if you read the textbook and do practice exams, you'll be fine. def recommend studyedge to help you with the difficult concepts
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Rush is a legend! After 30+ years of teaching, he is still very passionate about economics. He is professional but also quite witty and fun. I am grateful to have had him for ECO2023. My grade of a C+ does not reflect him as a professor, but rather my personal shortfalls in mastering economics. Try and go to all his lectures and office hours.

Dr. Rush is super funny. He was an easy to understand professor, but sometimes he just gave you that feeling that he always thought that if you took his class that it was the most important class in your schedule. On the bright side, he responds to emails pretty quickly.

I started off the semester rough but started going to office hours, which helped so much. He is super open, loves getting questions, and doesn't make you feel stupid for asking repeated questions, he really wants you to understand the material.

Prof. Rush is pretty funny guy and he likes to joke around during his lectures. You have to buy the textbook but you just use the textbook website to do the quizzes, I didn't read the textbook and I got an A. Showing up to the in person lectures is 10x better than watching online. You won't need study edge.
I don't typically leave professor reviews, but Professor Rush was amazing. He makes the lectures entertaining and really knows what he's talking about. Just all around great professor!

If you keep up with the study edges you will be fine. Do not fall behind in the recoreded lectures. Exams are very similar to previous years so studying the past exams is helpful. Overall great class.

3 Tests are 20% each with EC opportunity if you can predict your grade. 40 multiple choice questions each that you can get 100% just by watching the lectures at 2x speed; there are only 1-2 negligible book-only questions. Quizzes are tedious but do not use proctoring, SWAs just focus on answering the questions as writing quality is only worth 10%.

Hands down one of the best professors I have ever had at UF. I'm a science major so don't have a lot of use for in depth econ but have a healthy respect for the subject and can relate it to the real world having taken this course. Thanks, Dr. Rush!

Huge online class where its really on you to get the grade you want. 30% of the grade is short writing assignments which you can get a 100% on every time. Exams can be difficult at times but this class is more about how you study and work. Never had a problem with his grading.
goated, use study edge, ez exam 2

His teaching style was very difficult to understand for me. His writing assignments are graded toughly, like you would get lots of points off for grammar and "awkward wording". The hilarious part is that there are so few assignments in this class so the writing assignments can deeply hurt your grade. The tests were super hard too
His lectures are really easy to digest, as he's really knowledgeable on how students usually misinterpret the course material and makes

The best professor I've ever had at UF. Just go to lecture and do 1-2 practice exams before your exam, and you'll likely get an A or A-. Ask questions too, he loves answering them and is really funny in class.

Professor Rush is more concerned about his jokes rather than the information that he is lecturing. He can spend 45 minutes going over the same graph on the board because of miscommunication. Not to mention the online practice exams have several wrong answers. This class is overly difficult for absolutely no reason. Take it elsewhere!

Professor Rush was a great professor he tried to make class worthwhile. I found this course difficult as there were 3 main tests when I took it in 2019. I think I also used studyedge that did help somewhat. The concepts were difficult for me to understand at times.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: We love Doctor Rush.

Rush definitely knows what he is talking about and the syllabus and grading is very clear.  I definitely had to work for the A, but it was achievable; there are few assignments, each pretty easy, most of the class is three exams which you need to study for and repeatedly do practice exams.  I found it to be slightly easier than macro.

Professor Rush is a great professor for ECO2023. I didn't use the textbook (mostly relied on the recorded lectures) and was able to be successful in the class. His lectures were entertaining to watch and he genuinely cares about his students. I used Study Edge for the exam reviews and did all of the practice exams posted on Canvas.
Excellent professor. Lectures are fun and engaging, and exams aren't too hard.

this class would've definitely been a lot more difficult without professor rush. to be honest, watching the lectures is optional. if you read the textbook and study good, you'll do fine on the exams. you get a notecard for the exams, and he gives out extra credit on pretty much every major assignment

His lectures are light-hearted and funny. Make sure to understand the factors that shift the supply and demand graphs and that should be an easy A for the short response homeworks. I wasn't naturally good at econ, so I def had to study a lot for each test it starts becoming easier. By the end, you'll enjoy the class and his jokes.

I liked Knight a lot more as a professor than Rush. I heard good things about Rush and I'm fine with him, he has his fun, but his lectures were longer than the should've been and he gets off track too much and sometimes doesn't cover all the content. StudyEdge is much more concise. He's a sweet person but I don't like his teaching style.
Funny professor, good lectures. The exams are pretty easy if you understand economics well, I never had any trouble, hardly studied. Not difficult to get an A
Mark Rush is an amazing professor with tests that you feel very well prepared for.
Dr. Rush is an amazing teacher. He prepares you for the exam so well. Also, study edge helped me so much with preparing for exams in this course.

One of the best professors I have had. He is clearly knowledgeable and passionate about what he does and he keeps the lectures interesting. This class is not too difficult if you watch the lectures and study some for the tests, I would highly recommend Professor Rush.
Very straightforward, knowledgeable, and fair professor. It is just very important to do well on exams, as they count for 40% each if you tank one of them.

Overall a great professor. He is funny and really cares about students learning. He answers student questions during in-person lectures which can make the lectures seem longer than they have to be but you leave understanding everything.

I really enjoyed this class. He made the lectures engaging with lots of jokes on the director and most of the exam material was covered in the lectures, with the exception of a few questions to encourage you to read the textbook. Overall very easy and interesting course.

The class was very easy if you watch lectures. There's not much homework other than 4 short writing assignments over the semester and they aren't hard at all. You don't have to read the textbook, I got through the semester without it. I had some friends who didn't watch lectures and instead read the textbooks and they also did decent on exams.

Professor Rush is great. He is teaching a massive class which means he is not super accessible, but he still tries to be available to help all of his students. The tests and assignments are all very easy if you study well and watch the lectures. If you aren't like me and actually watch the lectures on time, this class should be an easy A.

Rush was the best professor in my fall freshman semester. His lectures are interesting and practice exams are so helpful. Study Edge definitely helped a lot too but you should be fine if you keep up with the lectures. The textbook is more confusing than actually helpful. Do well on the two midterms so your cumulative finals isn't as heavy grader.

Great professor, I definitely think I did as good as I did thanks to study edge exam reviews, other than that I relied on the professors lectures. He is very funny and clearly loves his job. His practice exams are up to date and helpful.
Class is very lecture heavy and he doesn't really show how to answer problems in them. Study edge was a lifesaver and makes the class very easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Rush is simply amazing. He teaches very well and has a funny personality. I fell in love with microeconomics because of him and can't thank him enough for the kindness and knowledge he gave to us. I recommend him 100%!

Really enjoyed Rush's class.  It was the right balance of requiring you to make a genuine effort to invest in learning the material without being overwhelmingly difficult.  I enjoyed his lectures and left feeling like I truly learned something - Rush was great!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The prof is engaging, but on an online format it's kind of hard to watch 4 hours of lecture a week. Even if you don't watch all of the lectures, it's easy to prepare for the exams since he gives so many practice exams that are very similar to the actual test. He also curves exams if the average is less than a 72%.

Overall Micro is super easy with Dr. Rush, I would recommend getting Study Edge. I never watched any lectures because they were so hard to keep up with (4 hrs of lecture per week). He recycles a lot of exam material so doing the old exams as practice is the best way to study. The exams are not hard. He wasn't the nicest if you emailed him though.
Dr Rush is a great guy, unfortunately this year the first exam was a bunch of chapters because of the hurricane. Overall great class, do practice exams and you'll pass easily

There are 4 short writing assignments that you should easily be able to get a 100 on, but two midterms and a final mostly determine your grade so do well on them. The writing assignments are worth 20% of your grade, which may seem like a good amount, but when the other 80% is based off of the 3 easyish exams, it really isn't much. Rush is great.

Dr. Rush is great; however, you must know how to cummulative study or you will fail the first exam. Grade is very test heavy (two exams, a final, and four short response assignments). Highly recommend study edge. He posts previous exams; study with those and you will do well. Rush is awesome, but the tests are difficult. Get ready to study!
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor. 4 assignments and 3 tests determine your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Test heavy

reviews.comment: There was 4 very short, easy assignments the entire semester. Your grade is essentially how well you do on your midterms and final. As long as you watch the lectures and do the practice exams its not a hard class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This teacher was amazing! He taught the topics so well and I am very bad at economics. There are 4 assignments and 3 tests in the class. The assignments are SO extremely easy and the tests aren't bad either. He tests what he actually teaches which is rare for some teachers. He cares a lot when you need help and have questions too.

Professor Rush is a great professor. His lectures are super engaging, he always takes questions and jokes with the director while still teaching the material well. Watch the lectures, ask questions, do the SWAs, and study the practice tests, and you'll get an A. He also is super great during his office hours, so go there if you do not understand.

Professor Rush is awesome. His passion for the subject really shows through in his lectures. I used Study Edge for this class and it helped a lot. I would 100% recommend getting it to help with re-explaining the concepts and providing extra studying materials. Take advantage of the past exams when studying. Overall, great professor and class.

The professor lays out and explains everything with detail and easy-to-understand examples. His class is fun and interesting, partly due to him and the director always joking around. Overall very educative, interesting, as well as interactive lectures :)

The best professor I've had at UF so far. He's passionate about the subject and is a great lecturer. I did use Study Edge and it helped a lot. I would watch the study edge, then Rush's lecture, then do the study edge end of packet problems. You NEED to do the practice exams to get an A. Don't worry if you've never taken econ before, it's not hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: easily one of the best profs I've had so far, switching to an economics major bc I liked his class sm, which says a lot bc im a sustainability major lol. didnt buy the textbook, take thorough notes and make sure you understand fully what just happened after you finish a lecture or you'll fall behind. practice exams are a must if u want an A

By far one of the best professors I've had at UF. He's a very engaging lecturer who cares about teaching the material. Exams were 100% of our grade, but the practice exams were very similar to the actual exam so it was easy to prepare and do well. The class seems intimidating because it's 4 credits, but the workload is very light.
He's a tenured professor who's been here forever. Still, he is very energetic and extremely funny. Keeps lectures engaging.

Rush is a great professor and a great person. Extremely funny and informative in his lectures. Easy to contact and will respond to emails quickly. If this class had any other teacher, I would have most likely failed.

Rush is a great professor, cares a lot about his content, and is overall a really good professor. Used his lectures in first half with study edge then just study edge, but with studying an A is definitely achievable.

Class is extremely easy imo. With study edge its a free a. Very few assignments so exams are majority of grade. They are fair and easy to study for if you do the practice exams. The short writing assignments are cake as well.

Rush is hilarious. His banter between the director and himself makes for some entertaining lectures. Speaking of the lectures, they are the best of any teacher I've had at UF. Rush has a crystal clear teaching style, and you can tell he is extremely knowledgeable about what he's talking about. The ratings don't lie. Rush is a brilliant professor.
The best professor I've had thus far at UF
Rush is the GOAT
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's very understanding. Go to his office hours. I had to drop sadly because of medical issues that made me fall behind, but I will be taking his class again. 10/10 would recommend.

Professor Rush is a great Professor. His Lectures were engaging, he taught the material in a way that is easy to understand, and his lectures were actually fun to watch, especially with the director. The class didn't have many assignments so it was important to do very well on all the ones you had, especially the exams. However, the exams were easy

GREAT PROFESSOR. I have never taken an economics course before but now I am considering majoring in economics. Tests are very fair and he even gives you access to previous exams to study which are similar to the exams. There are two different grading scales that are used depending on which one makes your grade the highest.
Extremely engaging, very funny, and made the material easy to learn and accessible. Excellent.

Prof Rush is by far the best professor I have had at UF so far. You DO NOT need Study Edge, I'm pretty sure they are putting bad reviews to advertise why you should get it. His lectures are very straightforward and engaging, and exams very fair. He answers all questions and simplifies what he teaches.

Tests aren't too hard if you read the textbook and watch the lectures.
Great and hilarious professor!
He is like the dad i never had, I changed my ways by seeing how driven this guy is. He is a exceptional professor and I would LOVE to take his class again.
Very clear, down to earth, and funny lectures. I wouldn't recommend study edge or the textbook. Just doing the lectures and practice exams will prepare you very well for the exams.

The class is lecture heavy. That's the only hard things about the class. Professor Rush helps with any questions you have and is funny in the lectures. I would suggest doing as many practice exams as you can cause they'll help you on the exams. There's no extra credit because he gives you an extra credit question on each exam.

Rush is great at teaching economics. The people who resort to smokin' notes or studyedge are trolling. They'd rather pay extra than watch the lectures they are already paying for. All you need to do is to watch all his lectures and take the practice exams before the test and I'm confident you'll get a good grade. Also, you don't need the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Rush was a great professor. Micro was a bit hard for me to follow but he lets you use an index card during the exam. Study edge helped a lot! They gave more detailed explanations of problems I had a hard time understanding as well as examples of how professor rush would frame his question on exams from previous knowledge. I recommend it!!

Dr. Rush is really funny and the material is pretty straightforward. I used StudyEdge for this course for the review videos and practice exams that saved my grade after I tried to go through the course without it. His lectures are very useful but definitely get StudyEdge.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really good professor and if you just practice the pas exam reviews you should do fine. However, what gave me that extra boost was Study Edge. Study Edge taught me a lot more than I feel like Rush did so 100% recommend!

This class was honestly fine. I bought the text book and showed up to the first couple of classes but noticed that Study Edge was so much more efficient. For this class, all you need is Study Edge. I skipped every class after the second and just watched all of the study edge before my exams and I got an A in the class.
Outstanding professor: friendly, funny and unassuming. There's a reason he's been around as long as he has and is as well-liked as he is.
This class was very manageable; I recommend using study edge for practice problems and going over material that Rush likes to test on OUTSIDE of his lectures.
Rush is awesome, for an 8 week class, he understands what is reasonably possible to learn in that time frame and reinforces it well. By far the best class in the program so far.

Professor Rush was great on his own, but I definitely would not have done as well as I did in his class without the help of Study Edge. Study Edge helped present Rush's material in an easy-to-understand fashion that ultimately led to my success in his course. They also gave me a ton of practice problems to help me prepare for exams.

Professor Rush was quite the character in his lectures - his jokes were great and relatable; however, he wasn't as clear as I would've liked. I mainly used Study Edge, which helped me throughout the course and the exams more than his lectures. Overall, you have to do well on exams because that is basically your whole grade.

Professor Rush is a very good professor, he is able to explain difficult concepts in a way that everyone can understand, he gives many examples for each problem type. He is funny and enjoyable to listen to during lecture.

Dr. Rush is one of the best professors I've had at UF. His lectures are hilarious but very informative, and I would credit him with sparking my interest in economics. Do the previous exams that he provides, they are super similar to what the exam will be and he does not try to go out of his way to trick you. Study Edge is a nice supplement, too.

Great professor, fun jokes! I didn't read the textbook and still got an A, but make sure to do all the practice tests, a lot of questions from previous semesters will show up on your exam. Don't forget that the deadline to turn the Short writing assignments is at 10pm, not 11.59!

You will be an expert with the effects of supply and demand after this class. Absolutely make sure to look at every single problem on Rush's practice tests, they are in Canvas files and will certainly show up on your tests in some similar form. Watching lectures at 1.75x or 2x speed recommended and doable. Also learn the graphs for each topic.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great class, great professor. Not a large time commitment as long as you keep up with lectures and read the textbook. Rush is also a nice guy that cares about giving you the tools to pass his class, no tricks on exams. I got perfect scores on exams 2 and 3 just by drilling the hell out of the practice exams and watching all lectures. 100% recommend

I would have gotten an A if I used study edge all year and if I actually studied for the first two tests. Got a 100 on the final exam. Definitely doable you just actually have to try. There are 3 exams and 4 short writing assignments and thats it so make sure to do everything. He is very passionate about economics and is very nice.
The grading is generous, and if you read the textbook and watch the lectures, getting an A should be easy. Several practice exams are offered, and the exam questions are pretty straight forward.

I loved Dr. Rush this semester, however, the only reason I came out of his class with an A was because StudyEdge. He has a very generous grading system, allowing you to bomb a test and still achieve an A. I got a 66% on Midterm 1 and still finished with an A! No need for textbook or to watch the lectures if you just make use of Studyedge.

Rush is a fun guy, but not the best at actually teaching. If you haven't taken the class before, then Smokin' Notes or Study Edge are your best bet at passing. Only 4 assignments, 2 exams, and a final so make sure you study well.
He is a great professor. Just watch the lectures and take all the practice exams and you'll be good.

I took Professor Rush for microeconomics and he was a really good teacher. His class has only a few grades in it but they are not hard, just watch the lectures. All you need to do is watch the lectures, which themselves are very entertaining and very understandable. Highly recommend.
super cool and tests are fair. I highly recommend staying up to date with lectures, and doing all of the practice exams provided

I absolutely loved micro with Prof. Rush. His lectures are entertaining, funny, and insightful. He uses great examples that truly help you understand concepts that may be initially hard to grasp. I used Smokin Notes to study for exams; however, I do not think that they were necessary. His reviews and past exams are extremely helpful.

Rush is a great teacher. He explains concepts well and keeps his lectures engaging. As great as that is, study edge saved me hours of lecture time. Whether you have study edge or not, you'll do great if you watch the lectures.

Professor Rush is the best teacher I've ever had. He explains everything so well and he genuinely makes the class super fun. As long as you actually watch the lectures and do the practice exams before the exam, you'll be more than fine. His practice exams are pretty much the exact same as his actual exams. 10/10 recommend taking this class.

I am usually not inspired to write Rate My Professor reviews but Dr. Rush is the most deserving professor of one. I took two master's courses with him and he is the most thorough, caring, and funny professor I have ever had. He writes paragraphs of feedback for every assignment and truly cares about his students. Take his courses if you can!

Rush is one of the best professors I've had at UF. Don't fall behind on the lectures, though, it may take a bit to catch up. I recommend reading the textbook because he does ask a few questions on it. Get Study Edge if you need it, it's a great supplement. There are only a few tests so be ready to know the material.
Rush is a really nice proffessor, the textbook is an absolute bore though and you need to read it to do well in the tests. If you take the practice tests before the test youll get an A

I'm an econ major: His lectures are engaging and explain the material well enough that you don't have to teach it to yourself. His passion for the subject is obvious, and he truly wants each of his students to be excited, and learn, about economics. His grading is based more on general understanding of the concepts than on technicalities.

Professor Rush is one of the most understanding and caring professors. He tries really hard to help all students understand and pass his class, and while there are only a few assignments that dictate your grade, if you listen in lectures and do practice exams then you will have no struggle/difficulty passing.

I would NOT recommend taking this class, especially if you are in pace or online. There are only 4 assignments and two exam grades, and everything is graded so harshly. I watched all the lectures, and rewatched them to study for exams, but his teaching style made no sense to me. I'm normally an A and B student but I may not even get a C.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Makes learning Econ really fun! Online lectures are great and going to them in person is also good for asking questions and interacting. Studying for the tests is very easy because he provides like 5 different practice exams, and often repeats very similar questions.
Explains topics in great detail, which makes the course very easy, I read the textbook but barely, as I felt I didnt need it the majority of the time.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Has to be one of the greatest professors I've ever encountered. Would definitely recommend his class. I had my doubts about taking this course online, but he is just such a great, funny, and charismatic guy; it makes it very fun to watch his lectures. 10/10. Would take his class a million times over.

Some people like economics and other people hate it, but professor rush made this class so interesting and so relevant! Just pay attention to the lectures and do the practice exams and youre golden - if youre struggling with anything to hesitate to ask him for help and the textbook is a great supplement! Great class.
Before taking his class, I read many reviews recommending purchasing a studying aid. I am here to tell you that you dont need it. Just watch his lectures (I did them at 2x) and read the chapters.

Rush is an outstanding professor and his class is easy to understand. If you can be smart enough to get into UF you should have no problem with the class. Just show up to lecture and do the practice exams and you will be fine

One of the best educators I've ever had. Seriously this man deserves a medal. However, this is my first A- in college and I studied for the exams for 3 days each. Could not for the life of me get above a 93%. DO NOT get behind on lectures, get sparknotes/ crashcourse, And you probably don't need the book. NO EXTRA CREDIT OR ASSIGNMENTS BUT THE TEST
He is an amazing professor! He keeps class entertaining, and makes the information easy to understand. I watched all the lectures and did some of the practice exams he provided, and it was an easy A.

This dude is so awesome and funny, but the fact that your grade is dependent on 3 exams is annoying. He offers two different ways of weighting those exams in order to get you the highest score, but even then that only does so much. Didn't watch a single lecture, religiously watched studyedge 3 days before exams, and passed w an A lol.
This class is difficult because it is only graded on exams. It is important to watch the exams. Professor Rush does a good job of keeping your attention in the exams.

Rush is ok. He definitely cares a lot about the subject but his lectures can be long and monotonous and he doesnt give the best examples. After the first couple weeks I switched to only using study edge which works great. Theres no homework only three exams so you cant mess them up.

I didnt really enjoy his teaching style or the fact that the only grades are three exams. I also felt like his insults/jokes about the director got so annoying and distracting so quick. I really wanted to like this class as many people do but I had to resort to Study Edge. Not the worse but enjoyed Macro structure and teaching more.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I was a junior when I took his class and I wish I took it before! It would make finance and accounting classes way more interesting and understandable for me. I loved his lectures but I did use Study Edge and Smokin notes instead of reading the textbook.

I took his class during COVID. But I have never had a more disengaged teacher ever. He posted his lectures, and that was it. If you need to ask questions or get help, he wasn't available. And in the one email he sends out all semester, he told half the class to drop. Nice man, awful online teacher

Awesome guy. Cares about every student. Grade is based off three exams. He offers a flexible grading option. After second exam, reaches out to everyone and gives them scenarios if they should drop or not. He gives you plenty of resources to be successful. Gave us advice on the stock market. Truly goes above and beyond. Test questions are tricky!

Rush is a great professor and this class was very informative, but Study Edge helped me big time. They have reviews with unique practice problems, videos from tutors who explain well, and summaries of the textbook readings which made it easier to get everything done way faster and actually understand it.

Professor Rush is a great professor and really cares about his students. His class is fairly easy to follow but the lectures can be very long and tiring. I turned to Study Edge to rely on getting a good grade in the class. The study edge tutor understands Professor Rush and his exams and gives the best chapter and exam reviews.

Professor Rush is a very humorous and thorough professor. The class is graded based on three exams, so it is very test heavy. He gives access to about six old practice exams, which are incredibly helpful. Study Edge has also been extremely helpful, providing lecture summary videos, extra practice problems, and in person and online exam reviews!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Rush has been one of the best professors I have had at UF. You need to buy the textbook, but it correlates with a lot of the lecture material. He truly cares about his students and goes out of his way to give a lot of feedback on your assignments. I highly recommend you take his classes!

Dr. Rush is iconic and pretty funny, but his lectures were often confusing or didn't offer enough examples for me. Because the class is ONLY based on exams, I really recommend Study Edge/Smokin Notes, especially if you've never taken econ, it was SO helpful. For exams, definitely do practice exams and DO NOT procrastinate on watching lectures!

Attending lectures is a MUST since most of his tests come from lectures and past papers. If you do those two things you will easily get an A. he says he doesn't like trick questions but he puts one or two on the test, but whatever just be ready.

So far, Rush is one of my favorite professors. His lectures were very helpful and interesting to watch. Since the course grade is dependent on three exams, make sure that you keep up with the lectures and study the practice tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Rush was a great professor. Vey passionate about the class and in my opinion his lectures were very helpful. Definitely be prepared to put a lot of work in the class, seeing as the final grade consists of 3 exams (no extra credit at all). I got a B in the class and I feel like I did not put the most work into it... definitely manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Rush tries his best to make the lectures entertaining and makes jokes. Very nice, but also very realistic and straight forward about his expectations and how the class functions. If you don't keep up with the lectures you will not pass. Grade is determined by 3 online exams so there's nothing to pad your grade if you do bad. Be sure to study!!

If you watch the lectures you should be good, but I also found reading the textbook interesting and useful. Each lecture tends to be around 50 minutes and you get two at a time but you can easily put it in 2x speed and be over with it within an hour.
He is one of the best professors at UF. He makes the material engaging and easy to understand. I 100% recommend taking this class.

Professor Rush is hilarious. He makes economics so much more enjoyable than it is. The only downside is that your entire grade is based upon 3 exams (2 midterms and a final). It is important for you to do the practice exams; most of the questions on the exams are formatted very similarly. Also read his email. If you can afford studyedge, get it.
Dr. Rush made Micro very enjoyable and made his lectures interesting. He talks slow so watch them in 1.4x speed. Easy A if you watch lectures and do the practice exams.

Dr. Rush is a very knowledgeable prof, however, it is clear he has taught the class the exact same way for decades, the lectures drag and content is delivered pretty boringly. The course is ONLY graded by 2 or 3 exams which sucks. The content is ok but personally found the class boring, not super hard, lots of reading and self study for an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Rush is literally so amazing. It wasn't an easy class but after you work for it you really know the subject.

Great Professor. Does not waste your time with assignments, only have to complete 3 tests. Thoroughly explains topic in lectures and lectures are recorded so you can go back to review. Lectures are also very fun and engaging to watch. Likes to keep things simple with no trick questions. Do the Practice exams, will make it easier.

I find economics to be very boring, but Rush helped make the class more exciting. As long as you watch every lecture and do the practice exams you will be fine. I did not do very well on one of the midterms, but Rush's grading scale lets you drop a test so I'm ending with a B. Overall this class was not too bad an Rush is a great professor.

Professor Rush clearly knows economics, and makes you learn a lot. He makes cheesy jokes, but if you are watching online, you can speed things up and make it go by really quickly. You can make this an online class or an in-person class depending on your schedule. The tests include material from the textbook, so you must read it. Great class!
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The only grades for the class are two midterms and a final, which sounds scary but if you put in the work it's totally fine! Prof. Rush is super passionate and knowledgeable about economics. He jokes around in class making things more light hearted.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Take him! Clear expectations and bearable lectures.

Rush is really passionate about economics. His relationship with the director (camera man) is hilarious! Although this class is only based on 3 grades (2 midterms and the final), if you do practice exams, watch lectures,  and read the textbook, you'll do fine! Rush also gives the BEST food recommendations; still haven't tried Leonardo's though :(
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Loves what he teaches and has a great sense of humor to make the content more interesting. To get A's on the exams watch the lectures and do all the practice tests. (many questions are repeats or ask the same general idea) Extra credit on every test. He responds very quickly to emails and loves to help students.

I really enjoyed taking this class. I watched all of the lectures as well as used Study Edge. I think that without Study Edge the exams would have been difficult to get an A on. Mark Rush is a funny teacher and cares about his students. I would suggest watching lectures and using Study Edge to succeed in this class.

Content-difficult class; I had some hard time understanding some chapters.I started using Study Edge and it really helped me understand it using simple terms. As an international student and English being my second language,I really appreciated extra explanations, simple problem solving and practicing that Study Edge provided.I got an A in the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Rush is a great professor. During my internship, he was really open with when I could take my exam. Thanks to him being flexible, I was able to get an A in the class even though I did terribly in the 2nd midterm. Email or reach out to him! He's really responsive.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Rush is bae! I took his class in spring on the verge of being kicked out of UF for my GPA, and he made me love learning again! He is very knowledgable of the subject material and I wish I would have taken his class sooner. I even surprised myself and got a 100 % on one of his exams. Just do the practice exams and watch lectures.

Professor Rush is absolutely amazing. I had him for micro over the summer and he was just a thrill to watch during his lectures. I ended up not even needing the class but he made it so interesting that I wanted to stay. Grades were based off of three exams so you need to make sure to study but they're really easy and straight forward. No surprises!

Rush is one of the better professors I had at UF. It was nice being able to watch all of his lectures online. Since the only way you would be able to ask questions is if you actually went to class, I used Study Edge to help me get a better grasp of the concepts and an easy A.

Professor rush is a great economics professor but do not be fooled because this is still a very difficult course. I really struggled on his first exam. After using Study Edge I was able to be much more successful. I would strongly suggest using Study Edge if you are taking this class. They really do provide the tools and tutors to be successful.

Honestly, as long as you try all of those practice exams available on his site beforehand and review the material little by little, you should do well! The exams determine your grade. I almost failed the class because I did not take it seriously and had to work extra hard to ace the third exam. Rush really cares about his students.

-Study Edge AND Smoking notes, personally study edge helped me learn the concept behind the material very easily rather than SN.  -Take EVERY PRACTICE EXAM possible, provides so many and he repeats question maybe with different numbers on exams  -Like every UF exam his questions are tricky, read and reread every question on exam day.
Best professor at UF

He is an awesome professor. He really cares about his students and loves it when students participate. Go to his office hours and he will love you. He is fair, though, and does not give extra credit. Study and do your best and you'll be fine.

Awesome Professor and very interesting class. If you read the book and watch his lectures and take solid notes you should be fine on the exam. Smokin notes can be helpful (I bought them for the final) but not essential. Do as many practice exams as you have time too. He is fair with grading. The class is all exams so you have to work hard.

Excellent professor. I really enjoyed learning about the subject. Although the textbook barely helped, Study Edge really clarified everything for me. It made everything so much easier to understand and helped me get an A in the class.

Probably my favorite professor here at UF. Fun lectures you actually want to watch while making sure you get the material. However, as my other classes picked up I had less time to watch his lectures. Study Edge helped me with what I began getting confused with and also saved me a bunch of time.
He is a great professor and as long as you watch the lectures and get smokin' notes to help solidify the ideas you'll do very well.

I thought the class was interesting and that I had done enough studying, until I got my grade back from the first exam. Make sure you really know the material. Study Edge helped me finish the clas with a good grade.
He is the funniest, sweetest professor I had at UF.

Dr. Rush is a pretty cool guy. Definitely funny. However, I stopped watching his lectures after the first exam because they are long and are taught at a very slow pace. Just went to StudyEdge monthly reviews and exam reviews. Your grade in the class is entirely based on the 3 exams, so you have very little margin of error if you want to get an A.

He's a great teacher, but this class kind of requires supplemental material, such as TutoringZone or Study Edge to really do well. Also, his lectures can be a little long and boring, and he tends to repeat himself.

The reason I had to take Rush's class is because I didn't do well enough in high school economics to get credit, but he made every point super clear and was quick to respond to questions via email. I'm so glad I got to have him as a professor.
Excellent lecturer. Not the easiest class but if you watch the lectures and read the chapters you'll be fine.

Your grade is composed of two midterms and one final.  If you do poorly on one midterm, you can drop it so your grade in the class is weighed 50/50 with the final.  If not, 2 finals80% of grade, and final is 20%. Do all of the previous exams and you should be okay.  Very friendly.  Only downside is the fact your grade is based solely on exams.

Fantastic teacher. Extremely clear and very enthusiastic. I would say he's my favorite teacher this semester. Although he tends to over-explain, since I'm not physically in the class, I'd prefer that to under-explaining.

Great teacher, explains economics better than any other teachers I've had and is a total goof. Prepare yourself though for only 3 grades which are tests. They aren't hard if you do the practice tests. I just don't like how they're only 30 questions. That's not a truly accurate sample of a student's comprehension of 10 chapters of material.

The lectures are extremely boring. Overall I did not like the system where students only had two midterms and a final, that consisted for the entire semester grade. There are no other assignments or quizzes. He is hilarious but still the lectures are ridiculously long and put me to sleep.

Easily the best teacher I have had so far at UF. He explains concepts very well in his lectures, the tests are easy, and he is hysterical. I laughed at all of his jokes. I recommend buying the study guide and watching lectures.
Rush is easily the homie.  Lectures are not mandatory, tests are almost identical from year to year.  Just get the smoking notes and take practice exams he sends out and you will be fine.

This was the hardest class ever! He swears A LOT! The only way you get graded is by taking 3 super challenging exams. That's it. No homework, quizzes, projects, tests. So your grade is based on three exams. Don't bother buying the book or study workbook. Keep up with lecture videos and study from old exams. Be prepared to teach yourself Microecon!
Unfortunately required class, fortunately a great professor! I started off watching lecture, and then I just did exam reviews at TZ, still got A's. Don't bother getting the book.
fun guy and a UF legend. do the practice exams because his questionsquestion styles repeat often!

He rambles on a lot. If you watch his lectures online, skip the first 5 minutes and skip several times throughout the lecture. He will pause and ramblerepeat things. When he is talking with the director, skip that part until he is no longer talking about irrelevant things. It'd suck to actually be in the class. ZzZzZzZ

Rush has been my favorite professor on campus.  I literally wake up, excited to watch his lectures.  He is so funny and has a great passion for economics.  I had a test question and went into office hours.  He was sooooooo incredibly helpful and nice about it. I would take his class 100 times if I could!
Great teacher but your grade is based off a point system. Better get a 33 on every quiz or you wont get an A.
Great Professor, though not an Econ major, he's inspired me to switch majors from Engineering to Accounting. Really great class, and truly glad I took it.
This class was not that hard, and I was originally scared to take it

I took macro in hs and passed the ap exam, so taking micro just a few months later made it easier (I'd recommend doing the same).I did not watch but 4 or 5 lectures, studied day of and got a B in the class. Being said if you put in the work you can get an A. He is so nice and it is impossible to forget assignments with his nice email reminders. :)

Humorous and goofy professor. Makes micro interesting but lectures are long. I didn't watch them; used Smokin'Notes. Textbook isn't needed. Every single point counts so don't forget to do the quizzes! DO practice exams!!! The previous years' Qs are very similar to the actual exam. Not difficult, but DON'T slack off like I did and you will do well.

Professor Rush is a great lecturer--engaging with his chatting back and forth with the director, and he has good pacing. I learned 95% of the material from the lectures and barely referenced the textbook, though it was helpful to read through the chapters again before an exam. TAKE THE PRACTICE TESTS. It's absolutely the best way to prepare you.
I love him. Take his class. I LOVE YOU MARK RUSH!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! :-)
lectures are tooooooo looong

This guy's goofy but he's the man. I am an upper classmen at UF and Rush is the fairest professor in the business school. Everything on his exams are directly from his lectures. Book is useless, exam questions are not out to trick you. Did 3 practice exams before tests and watched the lectures in 2X speed and I missed 1 question out of his 3 exams

Dr. Rush is a class act. Granted, he is a bit goofy but, the man is fair and he enjoys the teaching. The exams are very similar to the years prior, use them. Absolutely recommend SE if you aren't consistent on watching lectures... or even at all. Don't forget to do the quizzes every point counts! Enjoy the class it's pretty interesting.

The best professor at UF. He is hilarious and covers everything you need to know. You will thoroughly enjoy watching his lectures and love the banter between him and the director. He  is very helpful and teaches the subject with such enthusiasm. His course convinced me to switch my major to economics. One of the best courses you will ever take.
BEST PROFESSOR IN UF!

Rush is the best teacher! The material can be hard and confusing, but he makes it so simple and clear. His lectures are entertaining too (Oh Director!) If you get lost, shoot him an email and he's always helpful. The class can be taken live or online, i took online and thought it was easy. If you take notes, maybe go over the book, youll pass!

Professor Rush is extremely helpful, witty and brilliant. The subject isn't easy but he works with you and helps you every step of the way. His online lectures are very witty and worth it! Always do your HW and use the review questions to help you to study for the test and you will do well.

Professor Rush is a great professor... Very witty! I would recommend going to his office hours if you are confused about anything that he has covered. He is more than willing to help his students. He has been my favorite professor since starting at UF.

He is a great professor! His class is entertaining because he jokes a lot! The class isn't too difficult because it is straight forward but it is only out of 100 points so it is not that easy to get an A!

I really enjoyed taking this class, despite being challenged. Every point in every assignment is weighed heavily, which I didn't realize until after missing a few quiz points. Be diligent in watching the lectures, skim key concepts in the book, do old practice exams, and Smokin' Notes.
Incredible teacher. Nice, funny, obviously caring. I have to admit that he talks kind of slowly so being able to put him on 2 times the speed was nice. However, he is smart and knows his stuff.
Make sure that you do your very best on the quizzes because they count as a large part of your grade. I missed an A- by one question on the final exam because each question is 1% of your grade.

Rush is a very knowledgeable and entertaining in his lectures. Although the lectures are recorded and watched online, I recommend going to them live if possible, there you will be able to ask him questions and talk to him after class if you need clarification in a topic. Do all the practice exams from previews years and Smoking Notes to get an A.

This guy was fantastic. Easily one of the most entertaining professors I've ever had. He also makes sure, over and over, that the material is clear. He asks if there are any questions after each little section, and his fights with the Director are second to none.

Rush is honestly one of the best professors I've ever had. His lectures may be a bit slow at times and definitely aren't necessary for getting an A. However, if anything, please just watch for the director's comments and their hilarious banter. Its like watching a 5th grader argue with his alter ego but the Rush is older and probably funnier.

Rush is awesome.  The class is online but you can go to the taping if you want.  I personally never went because it was too early in the morning but had it been later I definitely would have gone.  He makes everything easy to understand and does his best to keep it light, as it can be a somewhat boring subject.  Definitely take this class.
DONT NEED TEXT. the study guide and past exams are all I used to study and did fine. Keep up to date on lectures! easy to to get behind. seems like a cool guy. take this class with him!
Great, fun instructor.

Rush is the man. He makes the material relatable and easy to understand, and never tries to trick you on exams. I missed an A by one point cause I stupidly missed a quiz, but as long as you watch some lectures and read smokin notes along with practice exams an A is not out of reach
best teacher at the School of Business. I took him in 1988. I am glad that he is still getting stellar reviews.

Rush is the coolest guy EVER! He is a really nice, helpful guy who is really passionate about what he teaches. Textbook is not really required as long as you watch the lectures. Smokin' Notes and going to office hours can be helpful. Not a hard class, plus his banter with the director keeps it interesting all the time.
Rush is awesome. He explains the material really well and his interactions with the director keep the class interesting. His exams are not too terrible, but studying is definitely recommended.
Awesome guy. He'll help you; all you have to do is ask! Very clear in what he wants you to know. "Oh, director!"

Rush is the man. Can't get much better as a professor than him, he gives every available opportunity to you so you can pass and even sends the class an email on things to always remember in life at the end. Just watch the lectures, do the practice tests and use smoking notes and you'll be more than fine

Very funny and entertaining. But most importantly, great lecturer and great professor!!! He even sent us an email at the end of the semester with a summary of the important info which we learned in class! He's absolutely brilliant!!! Take him!!!

Amazing professor.  If you watch the lectures the day they're released, take the practice exams, and review your notes from lecture, this class is a fairly easy A. The banter b/w him and the director makes class/economics interesting and kept me from losing focus during class.

Fantastic professor. If you have the option to take micro or macro, TAKE MICRO WITH RUSH. He's very friendly, helpful, and makes the information much more applicable to life and easier to understand. Take it from someone who took both micro (and got a B+) and macro (and got a D+), micro is the way to go. Plus you get to bring a notecard to exams...
He was one of the best teachers I had at UF. I highly recommend taking this course; it is educational and overall a good class to have under your belt.

Ok lemme start up! Rush is the man. He's the funniest professor I've ever had. even though the watching the lectures aren't necessary, i don't get why you wouldn't want to listen to him and the Oh Director. TAKE THIS CLASS! He gave me extra help at Burrito Brother and Leonardos! He brought us KRISPY Kreme doughnuts and microphones once in class!!!!

REALLY easy class as long as you read smokin' notes and do practice exams. You don't really have to do anything more than that to get an A. His lectures are great and he's funny, but it's not necessary to watch them.

Very good teacher. Lectures and smokin notes are more important than the textbook. I also bought his study guide and found it very useful - I read it instead of the book. Do all the practice tests before each exam! Make sure you double check your answers on each exam because the wording can be tricky. Good luck!

Great Prof and pretty str8 forward class. if you watch the lectures and do as many practice tests, you should def get an "A". If you're a logical person, just reading smoking notes, attending tutoringzone, and doing the practice tests will be enough to get an "A" as well. I never read the book once. The director jokes are annoying-Fast forward!
Fantastics teacher. I do prefer to watch his lectures online with the fastforward on. :P

He is one of the best professors at UF. He teaches crystal clear and is funny to watch. He is really good at answering emails and his tests are very similar to the practice tests. Interesting class, but not overly difficult nor too overly easy.

Excellent professor. Dr. Rush is very entertaining, but he also makes the material very clear. Read the book since a few of the exam questions are on book material. The main method to do well is print out and do old exams on Sakai. Go to office hours to ask about old exam questions you got wrong. The old exams are quite like the new. "OH DIRECTOR!"
He's great!

Never watched a lecture. Went to tutoring zone and read smokin' notes before each exam and got an A. If you're a logical person this class is a breeze, but those who have a tough time with economics would benefit from actually going to class and office hours. From what I did see, Rush is a great professor, wish he taught another class too.

What a GREAT professor! Dr. Rush definitely know his stuff and is a great teacher. The class isn't easy but it's not impossible. I didn't read the book but I watched the lectures (you have to do at least one) and definitely do Tutoringzone/Smokin Notes before each test.
Interesting guy. Very helpful in office hours (SO GO!)

Great Professor. Knows his stuff. I have an A in the class. Didn't read much of the book at all because his lectures pretty much cover everything. Study Smokin Notes before his midterms and you'll do well.

I love Rush! He's a great teacher even though his tests are pretty difficult. I also think he is an extremely good looking man <3<3<3 with that perfectly quaffed and those blue jeans? YUM! his teaching is also pretty great ;)

Cannot stand to watch more than one lecture at a time. His voice drowns on. There are only 2 midterms and a final so be sure and study hard. I would recommend reading the book before you watch the lecture.  I learned a lot more from the text than i did from his lectures. OH DIRECTOR!! I just fast forward through all of the extra stuff.

Very nice and funny guy. Fun to watch, very clear, great teaching skills. Material is hard and tests are hard, but there is a little xtra cred. Managed to get an A but took a lot of effort. Great teacher, hard class.

You gotta love Rush! Watch all his lectures and do the work and the class is a breeze. I went to tutoringzone too and it was the perfect exam prep, it cut my study time to like a quarter of what it would have been.

I love mark rush! he is very funny and it makes watching his lectures entertaining. With smokin notes and TZ as extra help, his class is easy to pass. DO ALL OF HIS OLF TESTS!! most of his questions come from them

This is NOT the easiest class in the world, but Rush makes it interesting and funny. You have to study, and study hard. Watch the lectures, read the book, do the practice tests, feel sorry for the Director lol.  Rush is one of the few true Professors left.  Denslow can't hold a candle to him. Really enjoyed the class.
Must watch lectures. Skim book a couple days before the test. Do all the practice exams. Not the easiest class in the world

Great class to take overall! Watch the lectures and above all: Do the practice exams!!!!Failed the 1st 2 exams b/c I didn't do them. Got a 100 on the Final! Rush is pretty funny too so it makes the content easier to comprehend.

He is SUPER clear with his lectures and if you watch them you won't need Tutoringzone and Smokin' notes. For the exams study his old exams! Do about 5 old exams and you will OWN the exams. His classes are fun to watch for me and I love the stupid jokes and randomness at times. I took ECO2013 along with this and it was so easy. DO WORK! -Hunter

What a great and down to earth professor. I had to take this class in high school as well and this time around it was SO much easier. My grades were best when I watched the lectures, but they're not necessary. Use Tutoring Zone. He truly is one of the best professors at UF.
Such a great teacher! Makes class interesting and is funny too. Take Microeconomics if you have the choice between that and Macro.
Rush is GREAT! I love him. Super clear and concise. Exams are a piece of cake--specially since you are allowed to use a 3x5 index card. Lectures are online. Plus, I enjoyed his witty sense of humor.

Professor Rush is AWESOME! He teaches in a way that makes it easy to learn and reviews everything multiple times.  The class isnt hard you just have to study when a test comes. His corny/sometimes funny jokes also make the class lighter and more fun. He does waste time on stupid stories and repeats himself though. but overall awesome!

This guy is SO GREAT. I sent him an email with 2 LONG questions and got one back the next morning with two really complete thought out answers. I have never even been to his office hours so he doesnt know me or anything. He just really cares about his students success. Highly highly recommended.

This class was very difficult for me. Most people do well, but for me it was hard. Professor Rush worked very hard to ensure that I passed his class. (I had to take it twice). VISIT HIM IN OFFICE HOURS!!! Also, TZ is helpful. Watch all lectures or if you're free that period, go to lecture...Great professor!
No comment.

TAKE THIS CLASS!! He is an absolutely fantastic professor with a lot of intellect. It is true that he sometimes get off topic and has lame jokes, but his easy tests make up for it. I loved this class and I would HIGHLY recommend ANYONE to take it. Watch the lectures!!!!

This class is extremely easy. Watch the lectures and do the practice tests and you will do fine. Don't buy the book - I didn't open it once and got an A. Only waste your money on TZ if you haven't watched lectures and don't understand the practice tests. Other than that, Rush seems like a really nice professor that actually cares about his students

This class was a great first semester experience.  It was tough to keep up with the lectures, but they were always entertaining.  You MUST go to TZ and do the practice tests or else you will not do good.  Other than that Rush is pretty cool.

Everyone should take this class.  Rush is hilarious and an awesome teacher.  Video lectures are very convenient.  GO TO TUTORING ZONE AND DO THE PRACTICE TESTS.  TZ is really good for this class.  Do those two things and watch all the lectures and you'll make an A. Textbook is not needed.

He is an extremely helpful person. Just make sure to WATCH THE LECTURES and ask questions when necessary. The book isn't even that important, he is your greatest resource. And as an added bonus, his class is extremely funny which makes the course more enjoyable.

Professor Rush is a GREAT teacher. He explained everything in multiple ways, and he was extremely knowledgable.  The class itself was pretty easy, I got high A's on all three exams.  TAKE THE PRACTICE TESTS.  That is the best advice I could give you.  Seriously.  TAKE THE PRACTICE EXAMS.   I found tutoringzone to be a huge waste of time.

Easy. Don't buy the book. Take online, watch lectures and take notes, study smokin' notes and write the "from the textbook" info on your note card because he pulls 2-3 questions from the text. Study the old exams. Very easy A if you study. I got an A+.

This class was pretty demanding.There are 2 midterm exams and a final. Each exam had about 33 -35 questions, making it difficult to maintain an A. Buying Smokin' Notes helped out alot! Also doing the practice exams from previous semesters (which he gives you) helps with studying the general questions he might ask. Overall, Rush was a good professor

Great professor, great class. Very helpful in office hours. You don't really need the textbook, but he always puts 2 or 3 out-of-the-book questions on the test (he literally tells you its out of the book) and so you need to get everything else correct to get an A on the test. The class isn't hard, just do lots of old exams

Though I was hospitalized and wound up taking a medical withdrawal for the whole semester, I thought he was a great guy and a good teacher and I was sorry I had not made more use of his office hours.  The only thing is, though, you can't miss more than three questions on a test and expect an A.  Practice, and you'll be golden.  Def. recommend.

Really great professor, such a nice guy, but HARD CLASS! Best kept secret about Rush- go to his office hours! Its basically tutoring hour with Rush, he is much more helpful one on one. And don't bother buying the book- useless. Just buy Smokin' Notes.

Great teacher. Rush really loves what he teaches, and makes class bearable with the corny jokes. He explains the information in a way so that students can understand it. The class IS NOT easy though. The exams are only about 33 questions, Only missing 4 questions will drop you to a B, so be careful for dumb mistakes.

Awesome professor. The lectures are fun to watch and if you watch them you will get an A. If you don't, you can probably still get an A with the TZ notes and the practice exams online. He allows you to drop an exam and his exchanges with "the director" are hilarious. If you are really bad with economics you may have to work harder.

Fun guy, but dont bother getting the textbook. Just take notes on his lectures and go to tutoringzone. Lectures are boring to watch though and he "jokes" with the director too much. Overall, I'd recommend this class.
easy and you'll have fun watching the lectures. no joke.
Great class. Favorite at UF so far. Watch the lectures if you want to get an A. If you're happy with a B, just go to tutoring zone the week of the exam.  Great guy and the director is entertaining.
Relatively easy class, good teacher, very clear, hate his jokes, the director is the funny one.

Easy class. Didn't read the book. Watch all of the lectures! Do the practice exams. Smokin notes helps some (I only used it for practice exam explanations). Funny class especially with him and the director. He is easy to understand. Definitely recommend the class.

Great teacher! Lectures are online and fun to listen to. Study guide written by Rush is useful (instead of reading the textbook). Smokin Notes are excellent! Easy A or B+ if you either read the book or listen to the lectures. MUST DO PRACTICE EXAMS! Wish all teachers were like Rush!

Everyone should take ECO 2023 with Rush at some point. His class is extremely easy, and he does not make the material harder than it has to be. His constant joking with the  Director keeps the class interesting and makes it easy to watch lecture. Reading the book is optional, but he does put in some from the book questions to reward those who do.
Best economics professor I've ever encountered.
Gotta love Rush and his antics with the director.  Cool guy, really wants to ensure that everyone gets the material.  Just make sure you keep up with the lectures and reading, and you'll do just fine

You MUST watch all the lectures if you're taking this class on-line like I did. His tests are directly from the lectures, e-mails and essays. Very important to read pretty much everything he gives you except the book, never once used it and got an A in the class.

Probably the best class I have ever taken at UF. If you just watch the lectures and do the old practice exams you will be more than fine. This was the first economics test that I have ever taken and I never opened the book once. Rush is a great professor who is hilarious. TAKE THIS CLASS
I watched all the lectures on time, took good notes, studied for hours, and still failed the tests. Rush isn't a bad teacher, but his tests are really difficult and the grading scale is a unfair.
Hilarious.  Great professor.
Great guy who has hundreds of students to teach and still responds to individual emails.  Tests are fair and easy.  Great professor.

FANTASTIC!, Rush is a wonderful professor, and a really friendly guy.  His lectures are far better than most online videos.  Exams aren't to difficult. DUE OLD EXAMS ONLINE, all of them! don't buy the textbook.  Smokin' notes is the way to go before these exams! Overall good class.

Dr. Rush is a great teacher and his class is fairly easy to pass.  Attend tutoring zone and do his study guide and memorize his study guide.  I never read the text book.  Old practice exams are GOLDEN, so use them.  Also, take this class before ECO2013 with Dr. Denslow, as Denslow's class is EXTREMELY DIFFICULT!!!!!!

this class is by far one of the easiest ive taken. got a 100 in the class and didnt watch a single lecture or buy the book. read smokin notes the night before each exam and the exams were so similiar to practice ones it easy. def recommend to everyone, even if you are not interested in economics simply for the easy A

All the people who rate this are the select economic-smart business majors... this class is TOUGH if you're not interested in economics. I worked my economic hating butt off to get a B. Read the book (OR watch the lectures) and spend three days before the test looking at nothing but the practice tests. Good luck!
By far one of the easist classes at UF! I didnt watch lectures or buy the book and just used smokin notes and practice tests to get an A. Def reccomend taking this class as an easy A to boost GPA
Extremely nice guy, easy class overall just do not get behind on lectures. Study old tests and you should do just fine.
DO ALL THE PRACTICE TESTS, watch the lectures online, you'll be fine. Rush is hilarious and enjoyable--lectures are fun to watch. Rush is a legend. Take the class.
LOVE RUSH! make sure to watch all lectures, read smokin notes and DO OLD TESTS! he makes corny jokes, but its still entertaining. didnt read the book once and got an A in the class =]
Professor Rush is amazing. Watch EVERY lecture ON TIME, buy the Smokin Notes, study a little every day and you'll be just fine. Book not really needed.

This class is my favorite class I've taken at UF so far, and it will probably end as one of my favorites. Professor Rush really knows his stuff. As long as you keep up with the lectures and study old exams, this class is a piece of cake.

I've gone through this class without the book. I watch all the lectures the same day they come out! I also buy the smokin notes. You should be fine with that. but then again im good at math... i recommend this class you learn a lot about things u need into know in life! and Dr. Rush makes it entertaining you cant go wrong! =P

Dr. Rush is a very good teacher.  I learned a lot in the class.  He explains the concepts very well. He may be a little corny and I definitely sped most of the lectures up, but the course is doable. Do his old exams, because they really help!
Excellent professor.  Entertaining, makes everything easy to understand. Had to take Economics for my major and I am very glad I did!  Wish he could teach all my classes from here on out!!
Mark Rush is the man! really funny and a really good teacher. do all the practice tests online and you will be fine.

Awesome professor! Sometimes joking with the director can take up time, but if you watch the lectures on higher speed, its fine. Very funny, flexible office hours. Little book use, but some of his questions are "From the book" questions.

Fantastic professor! He is very entertaining and intelligent. You will learn alot from him. Reading the book helps, but primarily do the practice exams before each test and you will do fine. Highly recommend for anyone with a passing interest in economics.
most entertaining professor yet! very helpful. super easy and interesting class! highly recommendeddd

Don't buy the book, you won't need it.  Watch the lectures on time, then buy the smokin' notes when they come out. 3 exams, you can choose if you want 40-40-20(final) grading or 50-50 and you drop one exam. Allows you to bring a 5'X3'note card to the test. All old exams online. BEST PROFESSOR I EVER HAD. His class is the most enteraining class I have ever been in. Your grade is based on just 2 exams. He is also super helpful. First exam's intuition = 100.
