Awesome teacher!!!!!! Made 100's on almost all tests, they are just the old practice test questions with different numbers or re arrangement, as long as you watch some lectures and do all the practice tests you will do great. He is so entertaining and hilarious! loved him!

Terrific professor. He's very funny and made the class much more interesting than one would think. That I got an A was almost an afterthought.

Dr. Rush is the man! I never went to class but absolutely LOVED watching him online. He lets you use both sides of a notecard (I printed mine out in 6-pt font and took screen shots of lectures). GREAT CLASS. I learned so much and Rush was extremely helpful. If you go to his office hours and show your face, he will be much more helpful if need be. One of the best...

good

Dr. Rush is the man! He is an awesome and hilarious teacher. He totally rocks! Makes material very understandable with his made up scenarios. Tests are very clear and straight forward if you study! Watch all the lectures and you'll do fine. Possibly the best teacher at UF.

Dr Rush was AWESOME! One of the greatest professors ever! class was hilarious, i watched them mostly for the comedy in them.  definitely would recommend Rush to anyone, you'll enjoy the class! Great times...

DR. RUSH IS GREAT! He is very clear, funny, and so cute!!! Take it even if you don't have to. And if you have any problems, you just go to **** since the material hasn't changed in the past 10 years at all. I love DR. RUSH!!!

reviews.comment: Dr. Aleksiun is amazing. She does a great job handling a challenging topic and is very knowledgeable. Grade based on weekly assignments, attendance, midterm, and final, all of which were not extremely challenging but still test your knowledge effectively. I loved this course and Dr. Aleksiun and would recommend it highly.

Professor Aleksiun is a great professor. Her class was full of difficult topics that she handled really well, and I found the weekly assignments to be pretty easy if you do the readings. The class is dark, but interesting, and I definitely recommend it to those who enjoy history.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor was a ghost. Curriculum was bad. Lectures were recorded decades ago. My TA taught me everything I learned in this class.

There are InQuizitives and videos with questions throughout it every week. They are very easy to do but lots of busy work. The only annoying thing about this class is the projects, but they can be easily chatted. Take this for your humanities if you can!
TAs do most of the work. I got lucky and had an easy one. Just a couple assingments a week. One essay, and one project with an essay.

You don't actually interact with Professor Nicholson too much in this class, as the TAs do all the grading and the lectures are done by somebody else. However the work is pretty easy, online assignments on a weekly basis. Depending on your TA, they may grade harsher than others, but overall should still be an easy A if you put in the work.

Not hard, just very repetitive. You'll do discussion posts and watch lectures with integrated questions. none of it is hard but I found it to be very boring. TA's grade large assignments very slowly, took nearly two months to grade a 1000-word essay. Cannot say much about the professor, you never interact with them.
Very calm A, low effort humanities credit. Did not really interact with the professor, more so the TAs.

She's almost not involved in this course its mostly you and your TA. The work was pretty simple throughout the semester besides the final project but that was also ok. What really bothered me was how long it took to release the grades for the museum essay. I turned it in oct 5 and the grades were released dec 2 which is an insane wait time.

Easy class for a state-core credit. All the assignments are a nonsense waste of time. TAs took FOREVER to grade. Like not hard in any sense but all the important grades do not come out until the very end so there isn't recovery or any way to know ur grade until its over.
It was a fine class. I thought it was pretty easy but some of my friends thought it was tedious.

This class is not necessarily hard, it's just annoying. A lot of random assignments but they aren't difficult, just a waste of time if you don't care about the subject. The only time I communicated with the professor was in a Q&A discussion post. She's fine, nothing bad/good. Everything seemed to be graded by the TA's, who take forever to grade.

The work is usually pretty clear and pretty managable especially if taken online, but she (or the TAs) take FOREVER to grade things. As of writing this, I submitted an essay a month and a half ago and it is not graded yet. My TA answered emails quickly but graded too harsh. They are sticklers over the dumbest things, but give good feedback.

The assignments for this class are nonsense and are graded so slowly. We did a paper over a month ago with no feedback whatsoever and now we have to start our final project and cram our proposal into a 2 minute video presentation that has many requirements. Online lectures are super boring and slow. Only redeeming quality is the light workload.

Do the work and it's an easy A. My TA was good, no complaints - timely grader, gave good feedback, and answered questions promptly. PlayPosit is used for lectures (cannot speed up/skip, questions asked throughout), and InQuizative (annoying af, but easy) for hw. There are a few Canvas discussions as well. Final project can be a lot - plan ahead!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dismissive of technological concerns but more understanding of emergencies. My TA was very harsh with grading but provided feedback.
Her TAs basically do everything and it takes awhile to get any scores back, but overall very easy course with no problems. She is an easy grader and assignments are very easy.
You don't actually interact with the professor much in this class. It's really just you and your TA within your little group. It's an easy course to take if you just do the work on time.

Not sure what's up with everybody else. This class is pretty easy. Your work is graded by your TA, and I think I had a pretty good one. Just do your work and follow the instructions. Start the essay and the final project components EARLY.

This course is terrible in so many ways. Your grade depends on who your TA is, some can be very harsh in grading. So much homework. For me I learnt absolutely nothing. Course is very boring. Lowk makes you wanna hate art. Prof is rude and brushes off any concerns and replies to you in a very cold and dismissing way. TA answers email 2 months after.

She wasn't bad but she wasn't great. You will rarely hear from her as the TAs do almost all if not all of the grading and they are TOUGH. Lots of assignments got marked off with little to no explanation. This is a humanities course being graded as a core class. Nicholson will not help if your TA is mean and strict, so good luck!

idk what these other ratings are yapping about, but this class was very easy. It is true that you never see the professor and the TA's grade everything. The content consists of an occasional discussion, online lectures, dumb assignments and two major projects.

This is just a boring class. The assignments are tedious and repetitive. This professor doesn't actually teach or grade anything. The TA's grade most of the assignments and for the most part, they were very tough and gave very little feedback to go off of. I would not recommend this class.

Never saw the professor expect for the occasional announcement, everything is graded by TAs and takes about a month to get any feedback. Lectures were by this other guy, and you can't click off or it will stop playing. Inquizitive was used for 'quizzes', but I stopped reading and got most things right. Wouldn't recommend if it weren't required.
Shes rude and doesn't care about your grade.

She is an extremely rude professor and honestly does not care about her students at all. Disrespectful in emails and brushes off any concerns (personal or emergencies) that students have. This should be one of the easiest classes at UF, but even after ending with A's in Orgo and Anatomy, this was the class that brought down my GPA. So annoying.
Completely terrible do not take art appreciation this class is horrendous.

ARH2000

She's super picky about everything and it's mostly TAs that grade your papers in the end, but her attitude is not one of a good professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: terrible. one of the worst professors at UF. do not take her as she grades very harshly.

It depends highly on who you get as your TA, and if you get her, do not expect it to be an easy A. She is very picky with grading, following the prompts do not mean you're going to get a good grade. Don't recommend.

She is the worst TA I've ever had. She's not clear about what she expects. The prompt will ask for one thing, but she expects you to answer another question notrelated, even though the prompt and the rubric cleary don't expect you to answer. You have to read her mind in order to score well. Also, sometimes she just writes "?" as a comment. Horrible
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She's one of the pickiest people I've ever met. Most of the other Good Life instructors are nowhere near as critical as she is. She's a decent instructor, but not expect to get A's on all of the writing assignment, especially the midterm and final paper.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He is a great professor. Takes the time to explain topics thoroughly and is very knowledgeable in his field. He is really respectful, and his class was overall easy. Two exams that were based on lecture slides that were posted, and two in-class writing assignments that were not difficult. He is not a tough grader at all.

First half is based on textbook (basic social movement theory), second half is interesting cases. Lectures are based on the readings, not super inventive. Very nice and helpful if you go to office hours. TA grades everything so that's a toss-up.

Great professor! His lectures served as good review of the readings, which were all very interesting. A large portion of the grade was based off of exams, so it's important to do the readings for this class and memorize the vocab words. I hope to have him again for future classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the worst professors and people I have ever encountered. Assigns an essay, gives you 40 minutes to write it, and then expects perfect organization and grammar and 2000 words????
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Worst designed class ever. Gives you 40 to write an essay and somehow magically expects perfect organization and grammar. Plus he does not even grade work himself. He hands it off to some TA who has no clue what he is doing.

He's a really kind professor, even if the class can be difficult sometimes. The final exam was a lot easier; he adjusted the tests based on how students performed during the exams before. Definitely get to know the textbooks since the exam is super similar to it. TA sessions can be rough depending on your TA but his lectures are interactive!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The entire grade is attendance and three exams. If you are not a political science major (like me) they will not dumb it down for you. I felt like he was talking straight over my head. Terrible lecturer.  Exams are hard but passable if you study. Stay strong journalism majors, you can do it!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lecures unhelpful - professor seems kind but rambles too much & test doesn't come from lectures. Your grade depends on TA. Some are helpful and actually work to make sure you understand the material. Others do absolutely nothing and are actively unhelpful. The "participation" grade seems to be subjective and secretive. Avoid this class if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Teacher is very nice and wholesome! Diagnostic pop quizzes are given once a week. Very knowledgable on the subject, so he tends to ramble during lectures. The due dates of assigned chapters move at a much quicker pace than the material he covers in class. Heavy reading workload. Just take notes on all readings and you'll get a B or higher on exam:)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Super chill professor, really good at teaching this topic! Does not judge you for questions, even if they might seem like dumb ones. Really understanding, but make sure you study hard for the exams and read the materials for the three essays you'll have!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A great class with a highly interesting topic. He fosters a great deal of participation and always provides help if requested. He is knowledgeable and friendly.

An excellent professor who knows a lot about what he teaches and uses a very student-driven model. He us great at explaining topics and is open outside of class. He provides a great deal of aid if requested for assignments.

Professor O'Dwyer was amazing. He is incredibly kind, knowledgeable, and passionate. His lectures were organized and nuanced, sparking engaging discussion. There is a lot of reading, but I took notes on only the lectures and earned 100% on every exam. I learned much more than anticipated and left the class with a solid political science foundation.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: I took professor Odwyer for eastern European politics and enjoyed the class a lot more than I thought I would. He doesn't give many assignments it was three one page single space papers and two exams. The papers are straightforward and graded leniently and you can easily his pass his multiple choice exams if you pay attention to his lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. O'Dwyer is very knowledgeable about the subject and very accessible for help! Was very helpful during the corona adjustment period. Otherwise, be self-disciplined to keep up with readings and you'll be fine!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Just a straight up bad professor. I got multiple questions on my exam right showed him where in the textbook they were right and he literally refused to change my grade. Extremely monotone and hard to listen to for over 5 min. Do not recommend.

He was clearly passionate about the class, but I felt like he got off topic a lot and the class was way harder than it needed to be for an intro class. He knew a lot about specific countries and I felt like I was taking an Eastern European class. But, the discussion class with the TA was great and learned a lot from that. The tests were hard too.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Very kind/understanding. Lectures are not very engaging, but he is still a decent professor who shares valuable insight. Gives pop quizzes that count as attendance grades. Textbook reading is straightforward, along with the in-class PowerPoints. Tests aren't hard as long as you review the study guide and do the reading
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Professor O'Dwyer is particularly knowledgeable about his field of specialization, but his soft-spoken lecture style makes it difficult to pay attention in class. The course is heavily based on readings, and going to class subsequently felt extraneous and necessary only for those who refuse to read.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Great professor, very knowledgeable, class really is not hard, If you're struggling with this class frankly you should not be majoring in Political Science.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: His lectures are kind of boring, and I wish I took Politics in Russia instead. There are a lot of readings you have to keep up with, and if you can summarize them you'll do well on exams. He provides a review sheet for the midterm and final. There are 4 one page papers you have to write that are not too difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor O'Dwyer is lecture heavy and you have to attend his class if you want to really pass the exams with flying colors. Sometimes the lecture can be boring if you aren't interested in the subject but if you are, I think you would find his class to be interesting. He clearly has great expertise in the field and I would recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The weekly quizzes are tough even if you do the readings because the questions are pretty specific. There were three exams and they were kind of difficult so it was essential to do the readings and review the lecture notes. There are three books for the class and we read a chapter in all three of them each week. Attending lecture is not mandatory.

Don't be fooled the syllabus says the three tests are "Short" but that's a lie they take the whole hour period and are mostly essay questions. I wouldn't suggest taking this class unless you like EU politics

He is a very knowledgeable professor but not a good lecturer. The tests were on material that we had not learned (like maps of eastern europe) and they were not simple. Attendance is MANDATORY meaning that if you miss more than 1 day you're grade will suffer (excused or not). Wouldn't take him again, but I learned a lot - mainly from the readings.
Took his EU class. He is a very intelligent teacher. Lectures are interesting and he tries to make them more discussion based.
Great professor. Young but motivated and passionate for what he teaches. Good balance between lecture and discussion.

i took his EU class co-taught with petia kostadinova and really liked it. he has a great understanding of the politics of the EU. he can be unclear at times but is always willing to clarify if asked. tests were easy since they came straight from his notes. don't skip class...it'll hurt your grade in the end.

I'm not sure how he is in other classes, as he seems to receive strong ratings, but it was a general consensus in our Research Methods class that this guy doesn't have a clue. He's unclear in lectures and rude when asked for help. To be fair, I'm not sure he's had much experience teaching this particular class.

Took him for East European Politics. Unless you have a very strong background of Eastern Europe and LOVE it, don't take this class! The exams are awful and thats pretty much all you are graded on. All you read is stuff written by him.

Really good class but if you like to skip- i wouldn't take the class. He takes attendance every class and tests come straight from the notes with some integration of the books. Overall, he is really nice and helpful plus is really smart. UF is lucky to have him as a teacher.
I had this profesor for numerous classes and he is one of the best that you will find.  Tests come mostly straight from lecture and he strives to make every class interesting.  Good teacher!

Conor is a very good teacher.  His lecture style is a bit tangental, but he is always working to improve which is admirable.  He's also very helpful in office hours and I feel I now have a good grasp of EU politics.
Politics of the EU. I learned sooo much and his tests come straight from lecture and the projects. All around great class.

He is a very nice professor. If you talk to him during office hours, he is very helpful, and really respects all of his students. Plus, it helps that he is a genius; studied with Hungtington at Harvard for his undergrad.
Good guy, pretty good teacher.  Sometimes he was a littel unclear with the notes but if you asked he would clearify.  I would take him again.
No Comments
He is a really good teacher.  This teacher will get you interested in E. Europe.

Lots of really engaging presentations in his classes that make showing up and participating so worth it. The way Prof O'Connor teaches is already great, but you really get the most out of it when you're present and active! Amazing professor all around.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Loved this class! I'd take it again in a heartbeat. It really opened my eyes to the way we tell stories through digital means and even positively influenced my own work. Very caring professor that likes to have fun with his students while teaching, which makes the learning much more enjoyable. Learned about lots of new media as well!

Always happy to go to one of his lectures. Never felt anxious or worried going to his classes, it was always relaxing, fun, and informative. This professor definitely proves that learning and fun are not mutually exclusive!
I really enjoyed the two classes I took with this professor. Attendance wasn't required, but the lectures were so consistently engaging and insightful that I didn't want to miss a class.

He's an awesome professor who makes lectures fun. I have a hard time paying attention in general, but he knows how to keep it interesting. Assignments are fun, and interpretation is quite open. It's a really good way for students to really understand and explore their interpretation of an answer, and sharing. Expect to actually enjoy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He's great, always fun to go to his class and engages well with the students. He gives some great readings to learn from and the presentations are really funny. I enjoyed a lot of the assignments we did and had fun looking at my classmate's work in critique, was always hilarious and a fun learning environment. Love this guy

One of my favorite most inspiring professors at this university. He is driven to help us succeed and he cares so much about ensuring his classes work for all of us. The class is what you make of it, all assignments are up to you whether or not you want to make something amazing. O'connor is always there to help you improve.
One of the best professors I've ever had, very understanding, is easy to understand and has interesting assignments. Would forever take this class again
He's the GOAT. I love this guy. He's passionate about what he teaches, which really shows in his lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Hw and the class were super easy HOWEVER he "feels bad" grading papers so the TA grades everything. O'Connor will provide feedback on the essays but because he isn't the one grading them anyway it isn't very helpful. Submit your essays early and do the extra credit and you'll be good.

Great guy! Had my quest 1 with him, and he was chill. Weekly reading assignments and 1(pretty easy) group project, and 3 essays. Lectures were pretty cool, and I found him engaging and pretty funny. Participation in class encouraged but not necessary if you're the type that worries about that.

I honestly think he forgot he had an online class. There's no syllabus, no way to talk to him, no communication, nothing. He posts assignments randomly and expects you to know how to do things without giving you material to work with. Seriously, Google is the way to learn in his class. He doesn't give feedback or rubrics on his assignments either.

He rarely acknowledged the online section of the course, and I was constantly left in the dark on various matters. He sounds like a good teacher if you take his class in person, but from my experience in the online version, he barely gave us a second thought. His lectures are also super long and unfocused.

2025 Summer B Student - 6 week course so fast paced, but easy if you stay on top of it! It was an interesting class and the work you do is meaningful. Pretty easy grader. You shouldn't have too much trouble with this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Highly recommend. The course is pretty straight forward and the professor and TA are really funny and down to earth. The only warning is the majority of your grade is based on 3 essays but if you go to the Writing Center you should be ok. He also offers extra credit. Ended the class with 103%

One of the better quest 1 courses at UF. Interesting topics, insanely funny lecturer. There was a bit of reading, and essay grading at time felt a little ambiguous but the course was not difficult. Genuinely one of the funniest professors I have had though.
Class is boring. Tries too hard to be hip and cool. Unfortunately it is a required course.

The professor was hilarious. He always made lectures interesting. While there is a lot to read and it's not always that interesting, his personality makes up for it. I enjoyed the discussions he allowed for in class.

Life Well Played is one of the better Quest 1 courses. Professor O'Connor is a super nice guy and has a good understanding of his students' perspectives and needs. He assigns a good amount of reading (usually 30 or so pages of dense text), but you are given about a week to get through it. Very manageable. He throws memes into his lecture slides.

The class was very manageable and far better than a lot of the other Quest 1's that I heard about. One or two readings per week and three essays throughout the semester; he answers questions about the prompts or requirements promptly and kindly. Professor is incredibly nice and lectures are funny, I would highly recommend this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is one of my favorite professors at UF. I took him for both Storytelling and Interactive Media, both were pretty simple classes. I enjoyed both of these classes, as well as all the material covered in them. It was fun to watch his lectures, which is extremely rare for me to say. He's incredibly intelligent, but is respectful and kind.

Eammon is an incredible lecturer. I took both Digital Storytelling and writing for Interactive Media with him and he was an absolute blast. Every class is full of thought-provoking discussion and he always brings new media to class that is incredibly interesting. I wish I had more time to take more classes that he will teach. 10/10 Garfields!

This has been one of my favorite professors at UF so far. I took him for both Storytelling and Interactive Media, both were super easy classes with group quizzes and participation credit. I am searching for more classes from him because he seemed so real and taught content that was actually really interesting because he could. 11/10.

I took O'Connor for Dig. Storytelling and on the first day of class, I knew it was about to be good. He's very passionate about the subject and brings up interesting ideas and prompts for us to participate in. I'm taking him again next semester for a different class, and I'm looking forward to it!

Professor O'Connell is a very chill and engaging professor who is really fun to learn from. He brings a lot of new and interesting knowledge to the class without making it feel overwhelming, since he speaks to his students in a very open and conversational manner. Excited to take another class with him next year!

I took Professor O'Connor for Digital Storytelling, and right off the bat, we were greeted with a picture of Garfield. Overall, the class was very engaging, and the professor clearly cares about what he's teaching. The projects were fun and interesting, and he made a "writing" class super exciting and passionate.

Attendance is mandatory, despite the lectures merely repeating the slide content. The heart and muscles are not talked about once, even though this is a bioelectrical systems class. I was very disappointed with the course and the professor's teaching style, and would have preferred more practical topics.

Professor Oweiss knows the course material with high technical competence. He can answer any question the student asks regarding the topic in a clear and concise manner. I regularly found myself encountering ideas I had heard about previously but they were said in a new and more concise way that allowed me to more deeply understand basic principles
Lack of details about assignments
He's tough and can't teach anything to save his life

Dr. Ortiz was, hands down, the best instructor for an online course I have ever had. Not only did he personalize each and every bit of feedback, he also responded to every email, note, or joke I had written in the margins of my papers. He gave me an amazing experience, and the personal yet professional touch he added was amazing. 10/10 Recommended

a lot of ppl saying he's a harsh grader but I didn't get that at all. If you showed up to discussion, he outlines exactly what you need in the paper, sometimes word for word what he expects. He makes what was explained in lectures super clear, and does a good job at going over them.
unnecessarily tough grader avoid at all costs if you want a good GPA lol
He grades way too much for an intro to philosophy class. He lectures well, but it is just extremely hard to get a good grade, especially with an A being a 94<. Orgo and physics was an easier A.

There are only 4 assignments for the whole semester, and they're pretty hard for an intro class. The grade you get is mostly from following the rubric, not the content of your paper. Nonetheless, Professor Ortiz was very helpful in filtering the tough readings for our understanding. Show up to office hours, they help a lot with the writing.

Professor Ortiz was the BEST at explaining things that sounded impossible to understand. You do need to come to class because he explains the readings of the night before into detail and helps you better understand. Would highly recommend!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Hes good at explaining material but grades extremely harshly. On canvas, it shows us that no one has received a grade above a 95 for any assignment yet. Its sometimes hard to ask questions because he can be kind of condescending. Overall, he does a good job of making sense of difficult material

The hardest grader I've ever had at UF. I managed to do okay, but there are only four graded essays for the semester, he never once graded above a 95, and for every single essay the class average was a C-. Definitely not impossible to pass, but if you want a good grade, don't take this class. The grading criteria is too strict and we worked hard.

The main criticism I have for David is that he grades incredibly harsh for an intro course. Also, David's feedback when trying to make an outline for an essay was unhelpful in my experience. I relied on the other TA (Thomas Schuyler) to guide me when writing a paper. David does however manage to make sense of the complicated lectures via discussion
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: this TA super helped me in this class he explained the lecture and made it super clear super hard grader though; I never quite understood how you were supposed to write the philosophy papers/writing assignments

Decent teacher/TA in terms of conveying knowledge. A little boring, condescending, and intimidating. His feedback is useless and extremely vague. It is about writing the essay he wants, not necessarily a good essay so grading is very subjective. One of the toughest graders I've seen. Calculus 3, Chem, Bio, and Physics were easier As.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: David Ortiz is a graduate TA at the University of Florida. I will not lie, the only reason I understand the core concepts of this class is because of his discussions. However, he grades far too harshly. He grades us as if we're third year Philosophy majors, not Intro students. Not only that, but his comments on our papers are simply are useless.

David is the saving grace of PHI2010. The class is hard and I couldn't understand the professor at all. In the discussion class led by David though he explains everything extremely well. (Make sure to take notes for essays.) He is a tough grader for your essays, but overall he's an amazing TA. If you take PHI2010 take advantage of his office hours.

David is a grad student TA for PHI2010, and he leads a small group discussion and grades most of my papers/assignments. He teaches well, but he grades papers really hard, especially given that a 93+ is an A.
TAs grade extremely harshly for how minor of a class it is. Main lectures are very hard to follow and take notes on.
Dr. Noll is the best!

I have nothing new to say, very nice guy.

P.S. you do not get to keep the stuffed animals, as I thought you did.

Could not speak higher about this professor. Did not go to a single class and ended with a 97 by reading the syllabus carefully and turning everything in on time. Best prof ever most understanding and likable guy.

He is funny but could occasionally make jokes at students that definitely create an uncomfortable atmosphere in the class. On writing prompts, you will be graded with no explanation while students that use AI get better scores than you. For the most part an easy class.
DON'T take this class unless you are a history nerd!! So much reading and homework! Just annoying and he grades kind of harshly. Unless you have to take it save yourself the trouble!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: My advice to anyone at UF: TAKE ONE OF HIS CLASSES. Regardless of major or minor take one of his classes. He's an amazing person and professor. Also stay in touch with him- He's a bestie for life.

Great guy, very entertaining and funny lecturer. 3 papers (full book for each), 2 quizzes, midterm(?), 10 weekly readings/summaries (long, 20-40 pages). MANY extra credit opportunities. Super interesting class IMO. Noll goes on political tangents sometimes but amazing otherwise. TA feedback inconsistent with (sometimes harsh) grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Noll is the most unusual professor I have ever come across, but I mean that in the best way possible. He is crazy and fun when lecturing and keeps his students engaged by throwing them a stuffed manatee when they participate. I highly recommend Dr. Noll. Attendance in lectures is not mandatory, but it is in discussion sections.

I felt bad because I was laughing too much at his lectures. Hilarious guy that made me care about history even though this class was taken for the civic literacy assignment. Show up to his lectures. Also, TA Miguel was pretty cool as well.

Dr. Steven Noll is, by far, one of my favorite professors here at UF! I have learned sooo much from taking this class, his lecture style is entertaining, clear, and extremely engaging. He is also very understanding and will work with you no matter what. I looked forward to his lectures and his jokes; they made my day!

If you have to knock out a few history classes during your time at UF, you are totally missing out if you don't take Dr. Noll's classes. I haven't had another professor who cares as much about the material and his students as he does. Attendance is not mandatory, but GO! He knows who goes and who doesn't, so he can tell if you're trying!

Dr. Noll is honestly one of the best, if not the best professor I've had in my 3 years at UF. He's the nicest guy ever and his lectures are the best. I took his class for my history major and I do not regret it one bit. Attendance is not mandatory but if you can make it to class please go!! Take the Florida History course if you can ;)

Dr. Noll is by far one of the best professors at UF. Dr. Noll is here for your success and wants to see you succeed. He is a very open professor and is very accessible outside of class. I would take his class over and over again.
Had a great experience with this class. I had a good TA, but Dr. Noll's lectures take the cake. I really liked that Dr. Noll takes the time to grade all the final projects.
Dr. Noll rocks!!! He is the most sweet and caring professor. He cares about his students and always makes class fun. Highly highly recommend him.

The best professor I have ever had at UF. His lectures are absolutely amazing and he truly cares about his students. He is very understanding when it comes to grading and tries to make class as fun as possible. He is also very funny and makes class interactive. Highly recommend all his classes.
Dr. Noll is a great professor if you can catch up to his pace. At first, it doesn't seem like it but his lectures always follow a logical flow.

Professor Noll keeps the class engaging with his humor and interactive teaching style. The work is manageable, and unstuckstudy proved to be a helpful study tool alongside the lecture notes. Overall, a great class with an enthusiastic professor.

I took Dr. Noll's History Practicum, which was Labor in the Gilded Age. The lectures covered a lot of material but he kept them engaging and entertaining. There is a lot of reading and some group projects, but the workload is reasonable and he is quite understanding as far as attendance. I highly recommend taking whatever courses you can with him.

Dr. Noll is an engaging, caring, and knowledgable teacher who genuinely cares about his students and their success (albeit with some quirks and humor). He wants you to learn and likes when you participate but does not require attendance. You can tell that he works hard to make his lectures interesting and relevant while also being unique.

Dr. Noll is the most understanding and caring professor. He wants all his students to succeed and will do anything to help. His lectures are also very good and help understand the material a lot better. He's also very funny and makes class entertaining! Would highly recommend taking his classes.

Dr. Noll had very interesting lectures, so if you can go I'd recommend it. He was very responsive to emails and helpful when needed. The grading for most assignments is done by TAs. Sometimes, assignment instructions were a bit unclear. Still, Dr. Noll is a great professor for AMH2020 and I absolutely would tell anyone to

Professor Noll is super nice and the class was really easy. It is clear that he cares about his students and wants everyone to do well. He is not strict at all, and pushed back almost every due date throughout the semester. He offered extra credit and re do's throughout the semester which was nice.

Dr. Noll is my fave professor at UF!! That gets said a lot on this website, but this was genuinely my favorite class I've ever taken. Funny, understanding, and knowledgeable guy. Class material was super fun and engaging. One page papers due every week and a few other assignments. PLEASE take this class!

Dr. Noll was recommended to me by so many, and now I see why. He keeps the class's attention very well and interacts with students to help concepts make sense. Weekly reading responses tend to be a dread, but easy grades nonetheless.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Noll is funny in lectures, although lecture isn't mandatory. Writing assignments every week can be tedious, but don't take too long. I didn't attend many lectures but got all the work done on time and got an A.

Professional Noll is very passionate about history and truly cares about all his students. He is very understanding and does anything to help his students succeed. He's really funny and loves to reward students for answering questions, so attend his lectures. There is a quite a bit of work, but it's not hard at all, just requires some reading.

Noll is the best history professor I've had, he is very funny and enthusiastic. He covers the material in a mostly unbiased way and is ready to help. That being said, he's not tech savvy and his jokes sometimes seem rude although he never means to be offensive. Class with him can be a lot of work but it's mostly easy work, just very time consuming.

Good professor but tends to ramble in lectures. Not tech savvy so pay attention for assignment requirements in class. Also can be a bit overly political in class, but has a good sense of humor. Would definitely recommend.

Professor Noll is great, and I would like to take another one of his classes. This class is really heavy on reading, but as long as you stay on schedule with it you'll be fine. Attendance was not required, but go to class anyway because his lectures are engaging and fun!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Noll's class is engaging, with interesting lectures and unique rewards like his manatee stuffed animal for class participation. While attendance isn't required, it's worth it for the extra engagement. Attend his office hours for help; he's always open. Recommended for a manageable workload and a supportive learning environment.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Noll so much when I took AMH2020 that I took another one of his classes: AMH3423! Though the class was slightly more difficult than AMH2020, it was very manageable, and the grading was fair. The class is very lecture-heavy, and the powerpoints contain very little information, so it's important to attend class and pay attention!

As just about everyone else here has said, Dr. Noll is a fantastic professor! His lectures are vibrant and entertaining, and he balanced the content of Labor in the Gilded Age with the purpose of the class, which was basically how-to history major. The resources he showed us were genuinely invaluable, and I keep a document with all of it

Professor Noll is an amazing teacher and I wish I could take every class possible with him. His lectures are great and even though participation for lectures isn't mandatory, the lecture notes give all the answers to his quizzes. There are no exams, but there are papers, but they are very manageable. He makes the course very fun and interesting!

Dr. Noll makes his class interactive and fosters an environment in which students feel comfortable speaking with him one on one. He awarded me full credit for missed assignments and granted assignment extensions when I explained some family events. He's hilarious and personable. He clearly cares about his course material and his students. Take him!
Noll has something that a lot of these other professors don't, humanity. Best history class ever
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Noll is a funny guy but is very knowledgeable and passionate about what he teaches. Assignments were frequent but only worth 10 points each and an essay take home final worth 20 points

Noll is probably one of the best professors I have ever taken at UF. Very funny and entertaining lectures and does not hold back from telling the truths of history. Rewards for participation and asks questions often.

Dr. Noll is a pretty cool guy. There are not many assignments, just a midterm (at-home essays) and a final (at-home blog post) along with weekly readings and summaries (1 page) and biweekly quizzes (at-home, 5 questions). Show up to TA sections and try to go to lecture, he is very funny but at times blunt. Work hard and keep up, and you will pass.

Dr. Noll is crazy witty and smart, an awesome and passionate lecturer. If you need to satisfy the civic literacy requirement, choose him! There is an annoying amount of work for the class (600 word summary for readings every week) so beware. TAs do discussions on Fridays and determine a lot of the grade. Dr. Noll himself is caring and personable!

Professor Noll created an inviting environment that fostered student engagement. You can tell he is well respected by students and colleagues alike. Grades and assignments were fair, and if you put in effort and time, your grade reflected that. I would 1000% take Dr. Noll's class again!

Dr. Noll is the greatest teacher I have ever had in my entire life. He is so knowledgeable, carasmatic, and truly brings history to life. There is a reason that he has taught at UF for as long as he has. This class was fascinating and an appropriate amount of work (w amble EC). Loved him so much that I am in his seminar in the fall- take Dr. Noll!!

Dr. Noll was a very funny person who knew a lot about the information that he was teaching. His lectures could get long at times but attendance was only mandatory for the discussion sections. You could be very successful in the class as long as you did your work and did well on the papers. TA's were very helpful to your success in the class too.

Really chill. It was a big class so I had a TA. Had a really nice TA. Basically your class is based off your TA not Noll himself. But he is a good lecturer and makes it engaging and low-key dumbs it down for those who are not history majors.

I LOVE Dr. Noll. He is funny and makes class fun. His lectures are interesting and he provides tons of extra credit opportunities. FL History has been one of my favorite classes at UF and Dr. Noll is so passionate about the subject. He is understanding and accommodating and wants his students to succeed. Lots of reading but assignments are easy.

I loved him with my whole heart. I took his class as 1 of 2 freshman, the rest of the class were juniors and seniors working on their theses. He would come up to us after class and just check in to make sure we were doing okay with the material, other classes, life, and to just chat with us. He is so funny, but be prepared to answer questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Noll is a super fun lecturer and he made this class fun for me to attend despite me not being super interested in the subject matter. The class is very flexible and he's very understanding if you speak to him. The assignments are straightforward and well explained. Be prepared for a bit class participation and some fun rewards for good answers.

Dr. Noll was incredible. Lectures were very engaging and he encouraged everyone to participate. Essays/assignments were all very doable--he really just wants everyone to understand the subject matter and have good discussions. Highly recommend!

I've had several classes with DR. Noll and he is by far my favorite professor. His lectures are really informative and the more you participate, the better they are. His work is very easy to complete and he offers so much extra credit if you need it. Most of the time I don't even do the readings! He holds up Hugh Manatee for great questions lol

Easily my favorite professor at UF. Dr. Noll is a phenomenal lecturer. He's engaging and hilarious. He genuinely cares about his students and is always available via his office hours or email. He can grade harshly but he wants each student to learn and is open to allowing revisions, etc.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof. Noll is an amazing professor. His lectures are engaging, informative, and relevant. He really cares about his students, too. I would definitely recommend taking a class with him.

Professor Noll is a passionate, caring, and entertaining teacher. Lots of EC, easy to contact, great TA, good feedback. Its a lot of writing, but an easy A if you put in the effort. Guidelines were loose but its a new class and the Coronavirus complicated things. Generally Good Life/Quest classes suck, but this was a valuable experience.

Dr. Noll cares about each of his students. During lectures he is funny, relatable, and all in all a great lecturer. Attendance to lectures is not mandatory however, a big chunk of your grade goes towards attendance to the TA sections once a week. You can email Dr. Noll with any questions or concerns and he will usually get back in minutes.

Dr. Noll is the best professor I have ever had!! He is an AMAZING lecturer. Attendance is not mandatory, but you'll want to go. Of course, there's a lot of reading, but it's a history course, so what do you expect? Besides, everything we read was well-selected and fascinating, and every assignment serves a purpose. WOULD DEFINITELY RECOMMEND!!!
Never enjoyed going to a lecture before his class. Great professor that makes a large lecture hall feel like personal learning. Very educated and cares about what he teaches.
Dr. Noll is a great prof! He was so understanding of any problems and always gave us plenty of time to ask questions and excell!

He was the best professor ever, he is so so funny and cares so much about his students. If I could take a class of his every semester I would. There was a lot of reading, but it was spaced out enough that it was fine. He gives such good help and feedback for everything.

Noll is the best professor by far that I have had at UF. He's super passionate about history and makes a ton of jokes, so even if you don't like history you may still enjoy his class. He explains everything in a way that is understandable and relatable. He is very open about office hours and wants to help you succeed. Amazing professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: I had Prof. Noll for AMH2010, and AMH2020, and I will be taking his AMH3931 class in the Fall. He's a little eccentric, but he makes the lectures interesting, and he is a great prof. and who genuinely cares. Do ALL the Extra Credit, it will seriously help, especially since the grades are mostly determined by the Midterm, the Paper, and the Final.

Dr. Noll is absolutely hilarious. He also seems to really care for his students. His lectures are a little all over the place, however. Attendance is not necessarily mandatory, but it is because the lectures contain all you need to know for the assignments. Lots of EC!

Just fantastic. He's funny, not afraid to tell it how it is, very understanding (but will give you a hard time for the hell of it), and is very personable. He brings stuffed animals to class to pass to students who answer questions correctly, which keeps things exciting. He always tells you what's interesting and relevant, not just the usual stuff.

He's a great teacher. His lectures tend to be all over the place but as long as you follow along and take notes frequently, you'll be just fine. His grading is pretty straightforward and he gives a good amount of EC opportunities.
Would recommend taking as many classes with Dr. Noll as possible, very interesting lectures, great personality, and extremely informative.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Noll is by far the best teacher I've had at UF! He is very knowledgeable and is always willing to explain further or offer feedback. He also makes class very entertaining. I had it in the morning but didn't even mind because it's fun to go to his lectures. I didn't think I would enjoy a history class, but because of him I am taking more.

Favorite professor at UF. Not even a history major and going to sign up for another one of his classes. I had him online and he's more than willing to email you/ meet with in person to answer questions. If you take detailed notes on his lectures and study the study guide you'll get an A. Also gave an easy EC project that bumps ur final grade 4% pts

Great, interesting lecturer. Writes a lot of messy, sort of random notes on the board, so you need to just take really detail notes based on what he says. His exams are all essay and short answer. They are hard and harshly graded, so be extra prepared. Usually two chapters a week to read. Not many assignments,so each exam/paper REALLY affects grade
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I have never been into history but Noll made it so interesting. The exams are difficult but if you study you'll be fine. I only read the textbook enough to write the paper and to know a little bit for the exam. Otherwise, I just attended class, took notes, and studied those. His pop quizzes are based on material already discussed and are very easy.

Best Professor I have had at UF, thus far! Prof. Noll is absolutely hilarious and makes an effort to keep the lectures interesting. He is super understanding and lenient on certain things if you talk to him about any issues. He does not post lectures online, so going to class is a must if you want to learn/get notes.

The lectures are pointed but can be lengthy and boring to get through. Prof Noll is so unclear when it comes to assignments and how he grades things. I got a bad grade on the midterm because he was expecting something that I was unaware of and it messed up my grade for the rest of the class. Email him questions so you are aware of what he wants.

He is very wacky. He tries to make the lectures fun, by being odd, but he does not annunciate well and scribbles random notes on the board. With already limited interest of the subject, he is extremely difficult to follow. Unless you take extremely detailed notes, they will not really help you either.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Doc Noll is the absolute man. If you're at UF and need to take a history class, find a way to make it one of his. Attendance isn't mandatory but you'll want to go to his class both for entertainment and because you definitely need it to pass his quizzes and exams. Lectures are hilarious and makes history extremely interesting. Would take him again.

Noll is hands down the funniest professor I have ever met. He has a bold, rough, but witty personality that initially intimidated me but quickly won me over. I feel like I have learned a ton in his lectures, but they're amazingly entertaining. He really involves you if you participate and cracks jokes constantly, but knows his stuff very very well.

An absolutely AMAZING professor. I've never been a fan of history but Noll makes his lectures so interesting. Hilarious if you like sarcastic/dry humor. Pop quizzes in discussion classes. Not super heavy on textbook readings; most exam material comes from lecture and (short) supplementary readings. Take notes in class and you'll pass. Easy.

LOTS of reading that you must do to pass with a decent grade. Part of the exams are base off the reading, and the paper you'll have to write is based on the readings. By the end of the class you'll have read three entire books (not including the textbook). If you don't like reading just take another class. Dr. Noll is a very good lecturer however.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: One of the absolute best professors I've ever had. His class can be tough if you don't read the textbooks and don't show up, but as long as you show up, you'll be in good shape. He's hilarious and makes US History really interesting and easy to comprehend. Would take him again 10 times out of 10.

This professor is hilarious!!! He makes the class so much fun. I had it early in the day, and never missed despite how tired I was because he makes the class so much fun. I am not even a history major, but I would take another of his classes again. This class was fairly easy as long as you showed up and paid attention.
I'm not a huge history fan, but I would take another history class with him. He makes the information interesting and doesn't make it another history class. Loved him!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Professor Noll was the first professor I took at UF and I am so happy about that! Going into this course (The Making of Modern America), I thought I knew a good amount about US history. I was wrong! We went over ALOT of material but it was very interesting. You do have to write papers but he is ALWAYS willing to help you and look over rough drafts.

Dr. Noll is very interesting and overall and amazing professor. However, you'll have to do a good amount of reading, and write a paragraph response to hand into the TA's. I made the mistake of not going to class so I missed a few quizzes. Despite a decent workload, I recommend taking this class if you actually care about history
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've had so far. It's a class where you LEARN rather than memorize, meanwhile very engaging. My TA was also fantastic. It's a lot of reading but it all has a higher purpose. I would highly recommend this professor

Best online lectures I've ever had, and I've taken quite a lot of online courses. Lots of reading/assignments, but they help cement the material; take good notes, review frequently throughout the semester, and you'll do great. He doesn't expect memorization of trivial information; he focuses on important info/events in US history. Born a teacher.

I see many comments saying that Noll is hilarious, but I did't get to see that side on him on the online lectures. There is a LOT of reading in this class. 3 books to read every week. Though the class subject isn't hard, it feels hard to get an A. There is little room for mistake. Overall, the massive amount of work really made me dislike the class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Probably one of the best professors at UF. He is a true students teacher. His class is challenging and complex, but if you show up everyday, you would have to try to make a C. He gives extra credit so there is no excuse to not get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Dr. Noll is everything you want in a professor. Helpful, Good Instruction, Awesome Lectures, Fairly Easy Tests. Plus, he's pretty funny. If you have to take a U.S. History, get Dr. Noll.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: There's a reason why Dr. Noll is one of the best professors in the country. I had a double block but his lectures are so engaging and fun that it didn't feel like a double block. He has a great sense of humor and genuinely tries to know the students he's teaching. Even if you don't like history I suggest you take a class with him.
The man is hilarious. Gives extra credit (usually 5 points). Make sure you do your readings!!!
Favorite Professor that I have ever had.

Noll is a great teacher and makes lecture interesting. He is so passionate about history. He gives multiple chances for extra credit. If you study for the exams you will get a good grade. Lectures are optional, but if you go and take notes, then its way easier for the exam.
If you're taking a History class at UF, don't miss Dr. Noll.

Noll is, by far, the best professor that I've ever had. I'm not even a history student, but he made me interested in everything he was teaching. He acted like a goofball in class, and came down hard when he needed to, but he would ALWAYS help a student. I skipped AMH2020 for a semester just so I could take it with him again in a following semester.
There is a chance for a 6 point boost to your final grade if you do his extra credit.  Loves what he does. Makes history a lot less boring.

Professor Noll is a great guy, he makes his lectures easy to watch and the homework he assigns is a lot but doable. The only aspect of the class I did not like is that he was not very clear all of the time. Especially on a project that counted for half your grade, when I asked him to clarify he was not able to do so.

He is by far the most dedicated prof in UF history, which has an gross number of married couples in clear violation of quid pro quo. But he's an adjunct, which makes no sense considering all of the married couples are tenured. That sad fact is indicative of all wrong with higher ed, and especially UF history. Greek Life and sports trump edu at UF.
Awesome professor, always willing to help his students. He is very funny and makes the lectures entertaining!!

He gives us exam essays ahead of time, but once you actually have to write them for the exam date they're graded really intensely. He is open to give feedback for exams and papers and to go over assignments with you. Incredibly fair professor who keeps the class entertained. You get to hold a trophy every time you get a right answer in class.

Dr. Noll is an amazing professor, and by far the best history professor I've had at UF. As a history student, you'll probably find this class easier than other history classes. Many non-history majors take this class and you can see it in the assignments. The quizzes seem easy as long as you attend class and keep diligent notes.

Noll is one of the funniest professors I've ever had, but he also keeps the class on track and covers all the material in a catchy way that makes it easy to recall for quizzes and exams. He posts the exam essay questions online a few weeks before the midterm and final, so there are no surprises. GO TO CLASS and you will pass.
One of my favorite professors so far. He's awesome and I wouldn't have taken AMH with any other professor!
Dr. Noll is hands down the best professor I've ever had and am desperately hoping he teaches more classes so I get to take him again
Hilarious. Good guy.

Best teacher I have ever had in 14 years of schooling.  Makes history come alive and is hilarious. His lectures are so good you'll want to go to class.  Sit at the front, speak up, and you'll get Michael for a few minutes.  The accomplishment I am most proud of at UF ;)

If you have to take AMH2010/20 or both, take it with Professor Noll! You won't regret it (I didn't!). A little intimidating at first, especially in a big lecture hall, but you'll grow to love him. Not too bad of a class if you go to lecture & take good notes. I ended up with an A and I'm not a big history person.

Professor Noll is the BEST PROFESSOR I have ever had at UF. He's full of jokes and sarcasm which in a weird way, makes him better. He loves to teach and makes history  so interesting and loves to get the class involved. I am definitely taking AMH2020 with him. This man is amazing, take him!!!!!

Do not take American History with anyone BUT Professor Noll. As long as you attend lectures and study before the exams, you'll get an A. Disregard the textbook. I never liked history before this class, but he is hilarious and easy to follow. Super nice and helpful. Literally nothing bad to say about him - taking him again for AMH2020 for sure!
By far the best professor I have ever had - by the end of the year you will be WANTING to do well in the class whether you like the material or not simply because he such a fantastic teacher.
He's one of those teachers that makes class enjoyable while you learn. He cares about his students and makes a lecture hall seem smaller by how much he incorporates everyone.

Noll is the man. The BEST professor I have ever had -- he will have you laughing your ass off every class. You must take his class before you graduate from UF! Even if you're an idiot he teaches in a way that will make history understandable. Overall an easy class and an easy A. Get Elana as a TA!
He likes to make history seem interesting to us, he is a great professor, and he likes getting the class involve with the discussion.

He is an awesome teacher! Do not take anyone else for AMH if you don't have to. It's two tests and a paper, and he's a very fair grader. History can sometimes be boring, but he always keeps the class interested and engaged!

Professor Noll is one of the best profs I've ever had at UF. He doesn't teach from a powerpoint and is so passionate about what he does. Super helpful and understanding. Take a class with him! You won't regret it.

This class is not difficult if you just attend Noll's lectures. Buying neither of the two textbooks isn't necessary if you just go to class and take notes. I only took notes on what he said in class and based my exams off that and got an A. He also gives random 5-question pop quizzes in class that are really easy and based on his lectures.

I have had professor Noll for 2 semesters- AMH 2010 and AMH2020. Just like all the raters, he is hands down the best professor at UF. Although his exams are extremely stressful to study for, he makes the class fun and interesting. You will regret taking one of these classes with anyone else!

Literally the best teacher I have ever had. I've never looked forward to going to a class so much and he is so helpful in office hours. Definitely take his class! You will love it! I have never been a huge history person and I've come to love it after taking him!

Professor Noll is the best professor you will have at UF. He makes something so dull, and a class that many students only take for gen ed requirements, so interesting. He's a great professor and has written a number of recommendation letters for kids going to law school. Go to class, if you miss a couple it's OK. Go to office hours. Take him!

Prof. Noll was great. His lectures were interesting and he kept us laughing. He makes sure students understand, and it seems like he picks TAs that are good at explaining things so you can get even more out of the class(I had Ms. Lyon for 2020 and another blond for 2010). But, keep it real, you REALLY have to study. It's not an easy class.

Dr. Noll is simply amazing! I had him two consecutive semesters and wouldn't change it for the world. I learned so much with him and from him. We keep in touch still; He really does care bout his students. TAKE HIM! Yes you have to put in some effort... but come on, you're at UF!

I've had Noll for two semesters now and he is simply amazing. Princeton Review doesn't have him in the top 300 in the US for no reason. He is hilarious and makes history interesting. It was definitely a class I actually looked forward to attending. You have to work for your grade, but it's only as tough as you make it.

Simply the best Prof. ever.  His classes show that one can still smile in the world of Academia.  I have never seen him act uppity.  Welcomes and encourages debate on items that you don't agree with him on, but you better be able to make a concise argument about your opinion.

Take anything you can with him!!! He's a wonderful professor. You do have to work for your A but not too hard, just the average amount that you'd expect. His lectures are extremely interesting and he offers a lot of extra credit as well. Highly recommended. His classes were always enjoyable.

Noll is by far the best professor I've had at UF. I've never liked history but he has gotten me to understand it. You have to work for your grade but it is extremely rewarding when you look back on everything you've learned. I took him for AMH 2010 also. I highly recommend him if you want a quality professor.

Dr. Noll is an amazing professor. Probably one of the best teachers I have had since I have been in school. He speaks so that everyone understands, and he keeps the class entertaining. I am taking him again for AMH 2020 because he's just that awesome.
AMAZING professor! So fun and very helpful. He's a genius, but he keeps things dumbed down.
he is a good teacher , you actually  learn a lot in his class but the exams are hard becuase he doesnt give you a study guide and youonly have  amidterm, a final paper and the final

one of the best teachers i have had at UF! I am usually very critical but Noll impressed me every day i went to class. his passion for the subject and for student to succeed is far better than any teachers i have had at uf. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!

Noll is the Best. He has a great sense of humor and makes history exciting. He is very nice and his ta's are wonderful. I would recommend him to anyone. As long as you do the work you can get a B or above =)

Fantastic professor. Extremely knowledgeable, and helpful. Use his office hours, they are tremendously worth it. Grades are worth how much effort you put into the class, and reading the materials. Great lecturer, even for those who hate lectures.

Amazing teacher. He keeps the class fun and you learn so much. You have a 5 page paper, a midterm and a final. Alot of extra credit is given. An A is very possible. Gives quizzes to check for attendance.

Took his practi****last semester for my major. Dr. Noll is my favorite professor at UF so far.  Super interesting, really knows his stuff, wants you to do well and is more than willing to help students outside of class, and actually pretty funny.  I really enjoyed his class and highly recommend anything taught by him.
he is really nice guy, some of his assignments are hard
FLIPPIN AWESOME...nuff said...if you get a chance to take a class by him...do it!!! I am taking AMH2020 taught by him next semester as well!!!
Very funny guy, he is easy going and keeps class interesting... Something which is hard to find within the history department at UF!

I respected his academic brilliance. He is truly a fantastic professor, but he plays favorites. Big time. He will downright ignore you if he feels so inclined. I tried to be respectful to him and he never gave me the time of day. Oh well. I would definitely recommend the class based on his teaching, not at all on him as a person.

Prof. Noll does a great job of keeping the lectures lively and exciting but this was not an easy class. Would not rec. this as an easy humanities course. Tests are essay format. Quizzes are unannounced. Weekly readings are mandatory to get a decent grade in the class. LOT'S OF READING!
Excellent professor. I would take any class he taught. He is engaging and knows his stuff. You can tell he really cares about history and his students. Awesome all around.

He makes history understandable and bearable. Although attendance wasn't mandatory you must go unless you get the notes from someone. He lets you make up the quiz if he likes you so sit in the front so he gets to know you. Tests are annoying essays and the paper took forever. DO THE EXTRA CREDIT because he grades hard on the FIRST test.

I had Doctor Noll as an undergrad and I believe I took three classes with him. I am so happy that I did, because he really is inspirational. He plays out history like you're right there living it. I did my thesis with Dr. Noll and even volunteered at his wife's elementary school. Overall, wonderful classes, oustanding teacher.

Dr. Noll is a very helpful and entertaining.  He makes history fun and exciting to learn. However, the class is not an easy A, the midterm/final and paper are graded very hard. Make sure you study for quizzes, go to TA sections, and read texts. Books are expensive, but you NEED them. There is not much room to make any mistakes.  Whole class is 100p

One of my favorite professors at UF! Super hilarious and EXTREMELY knowledgeable. He makes class fun. Again, so much knowledge to offer. Energetic, enthusiastic. Likes to assign LOTS of reading, I don't do it, and I got on a B on the midterm, A on the paper. Just go to class and take good notes. Take his classes!!!
He's really helpful, as long as you attend class.  He cares about your success, as long as you care.  He will go into detail and explain things until they are understood.

By far the most amazing professor I have had at UF. He is a genius and absolutely hysterical. For anyone who has struggled with learning history in the past-he is the professor for you. His TA's were very helpful as well. Attendance isn't enforced but trust me, you'll want to go.

Best history class EVER!! I never did well in history, or understood it, but Noll made it so simple. The exams are easy, it was just the paper that was hard. He is really funny, and I recommend this class for sure. He gives really good notes.
My absolute favoriate prof!! He's adorable, cute and funny and goes way out of his way to help students. visit him to get help on paper and tests!
Amazing teacher! Tests/Quizs were not especially difficult if you attended lecture and paper topics were very accessible. Definitely one of the most memorable professors at UF.

Professor Noll is by far my favorite professor at UF. I have had him for three classes now, (AMH2010, 2020, and guilded age, no clue the course number) I hate doing reading assignments with a fiery passion. If you attend lecture, and pay attention, the information you get is sufficient for the tests. He's incredibly fair and understanding.Funny man
Best teacher I've had so far at UF. He is funny, and witty, and keeps it interesting. I will be sad when I don't have class with him anymore.

Dr. Noll is hands down the most down to earth History professor I have ever encountered. He is extremely fair and incredibly enthusiastic. He is extremely funny and likes to have a good time. If you haven't had him for a class yet, take him!

By far the best teacher I've had at UF so far. His lectures are entertaining and he makes history REALLY interesting. Attendance isnt mandatory but you'll want to go to his class because he makes it worthwhile. He gives occasional quizzes which are easy and there is 1 paper to write on a book. Hes always willing to help students.

Noll is hilarious. Never opened the textbook once but went to class every week. There are only two tests and a paper so you have to work hard for the week before each of those but thats about it. Take his class!

Very good professor, I hate American History and he made me enjoy it. Go to lectures, they are helpful. Quizzes given in T.A. sections, those were not very helpful b/c of T.A. but review sessions before tests are. Really knows his stuff and is available to help students anytime.
Dr. Noll was fantastic. If you haven't taken AP history, then I recomend getting the book, but I only used it as a reference. All of the really important stuff is covered in lecture. Loved the class!
great teacher !!!!! go to class, talk to him during his office hours, he is really willing to help students do well, has a great sense of humor,  makes you interested in the content

AMAZING! This professor loves history so much and you can tell he's passionate. He makes it all very interesting, he's funny, and is a easy person to go up to if you need help. His TA's are generally good too, there are helpful study sessions before exams and while attendance isn't mandatory, you should go to all lectures.

GREAT TEACHER!!!! so knowledgable about the subject and actually cares about his students.  Speak up  in class and actually do your work and your sure to get an A.  Im going to try to take all of my history classes with him  in the future because he sooooo funny and really interesting!!!

Dr. Noll is awesome professor! He is always available for extra help so definitely  TAKE ADVANTAGE OF OFFICE HOURS! If you get to know him he's a nice guy and may be willing to work with you at the end of the semester ;) DEFINITELY RECOMMEND!

Dr. Noll is an awesome teacher, he knows his stuff and is a great teacher.  Go to class and you'll have no problem and he is easily accessible if you have any questions.  Just don't be late.  He HATES it.

I had him for two classes and loved both of them. Dr. Noll's classes can be enjoyed by both the serious history major and the student who doesn't even like history. He is very knowledgeable, funny, and is extremely generous with his time outside of class. Overall, he was the second best professor I had during my four years at UF.
This guy made history so interesting but you had better go to class if you want an A because he gives random pop quizzes.

Very enthusiaistic about history, also very funny. Laughed a lot in his class. Show up, take notes, use his study guides for tests, you will get an A. Lecture is usually entertaining and engaging, even if you don't love history. May come off harsher than he really is on first impression. I wish I could take more of his classes.
Awesome teacher, highly recomended

He's a good teacher, and makes history much more interesting. The tests aren't too bad if you prepare ahead of time, which is easy because he gives you the promts about a week in advance. He's also really helpful during office hours, so take advantage of them.

Noll is a great professor, class is always interesting and he does give extra credit for showing up.  However, he expects way to much on the two essay exams (about 6 pages in 50 minutes) so if you are a slow writer, you may not be able to get an A or B.

AWESOME professor! He is very interesting in class, and goes out of his way to learn his students.  Go to class (he frequently gives extra credit just for showing up) and try to read the book as much as possible.  He makes history funny, but speak up in class because he likes participation.

I loved this professor. He really teaches you to think for yourself and learn material. There is one paper 4-6 pages and midterm/final. gives pop quizzes so be sure to go to class. also gives extra credit some days for just being there.  Midterm/final are essay tests and he gives you the questions and chooses from those. He really likes specifics!!

professor noll is amazing!! he actually makes the class enjoyable.... he is so wacky and funny and everyone loves his jokes. attendance isnt mandatory but there are pop quizzes and sometimes he gives extra points for coming to class.... believe me, you'll WANT to go to that class
great teacher - very interested it what he is lecturing about.....not an easy A tho
This professor is amazing!!  By far the best teacher here at UF!  Take him, very easy to do well in this class.
Oustanding, dedicated. Best professor at UF.

This professor is crazy and loves history so much. Go to class as much as possible because pretty much everything comes from the lecture notes. Yous should probably read, although I didn't and still did fine. There are also pop quizzes, which is another reason to go to class. Just write your paper and study a few days before the two exams.
Great class, he really knows his stuff. Only negative with his class is that his exams are solely essays. Very enthusiastic and lecture is never a bore.
A MUST

Great teacher! There are two exams, several quizes, a paper, and A LOT of reading. He also offers some extra credit. His class is not an easy A and it requires a lot of time and effort. You can get an A if you work hard for it.

My favortie professor in this University!  He's the one that made me want to go for my PHD.  An amazing man that facilitates all that is history in such a way that you're not only interested, but you won't forget.

Professor Noll is the best history teacher I've ever had.
