If history isn't your best subject but you want to learn, this is the class for you....He'll explain a concept until you fully understand it, and always add an entertaining twist. Take advantage of his office hours. Hey'll help you a lot with exam prep if you take the initiative.

Professor Noll is awesome. Perfect class to take if you aren't a history major. His lectures are very entertaining and he is very approachable and always willing to help. If you prepare a few days ahead for the tests and write a decent paper then you should get a good grade.
professor noll is the coolest guy in gainesville..if you want to have fun and learn some random stuff take this class! no..seriously best teacher in uf.
This guy makes going to class very interesting and fun. Expect tons of reading and writing assignments. Hard but definitely worth it if your going to school to actually learn something.
he may be a good teacher but this is not the class to take if you dont like history. it is very intense and the essay tests are crazy hard!

Professor Noll is probably one of the best this school has.  Perfect class.  Lectures were always interesting and easy to follow.  Prepare for your midterm and final and you'll do fine, he gives you essay topics ahead of time for the tests, but picks them randomly on exam day.  I love this guy, I'm taking him again this semester for 2020.
he did a great job explaining and teaching the subject...and kept it very interesting and fun...excellent teacher to take.

He is a great guy and hilarious in class.  Go to class, do the work (don't procrastinate like I did)...class participation counts for 20% of final grade.  Not an easy class but it can be fun.  I will definately try to take him for other courses!

GREAT GUY! GREAT LECTURER! GREAT HUMOR! lots of work and reading but it's worth it! reading journals, one mini presentation, papers and a 12-15 pg paper. its worth the work. he's so amazing! im willing to take EVERY SINGLE class he teaches!
Hands down the best professor I have ever had at Florida!! I will take any class he ever teaches.

I am currently enrolled in this class.  He is a great professor, the best history teacher I have ever had, and I had to miss many days for a death in the family and he was very accomodating.  Make sure you are well prepared for the mid-term and final, because they are essay tests, but he gives you the questions ahead of time, so study them.
Best teacher i've ever had. enough said.
he is so FUNNY!!! take the class go to class n jhust laugh...i love it...hes not boring at all!
fabulous teacher, made sure i had him for both halves of AMH... hard grader, but worth it.
awsome funniest teacher ever

Dr. Noll is awesome. His lectures are a can't miss.  He is energetic, intelligent, and funny.  He does a great job teaching a time period that you'll love at the end of the class. Grading is a little tough on the papers, but not horrible. If you can, take it!
Teacher made what would usually be a boring class very interesting.

I hate history. I enjoyed myself and did well w/o reading. Has a sense of humor and cares. Knows students are adults and treats you like one. lecture is important. ask any questions you have, he wont make you feel dumb, even if you are. on the paper: attribute pronouns and direct quote!

Dr. Noll is a funny a** teacher. The class is not too bad, pretty demanding. The books are expensive, but you do need them for the papers and essay exams.  He makes the class very interesting, and make sure to go to class everyday because you never know when he is going to give a quiz.

Noll is wonderful. The books for his class cost an arm and a leg, though. Almost $300. He's really amusing, says some off the wall stuff and really knows what he's talking about. Will keep you interested.
great professor, he made class go by fast and he was really funny!  i wish i could take him again!

What a fabulous profesor!! He is interested in what he teaches and is very clear with material.  Expects a lot out of you and there is lots of reading from different texts/week.  Make sure you go to class! Participate-he gets kinda upset otherwise.  I wish i could take him again!
Great teacher, very understanding and helpful
Professor Noll made this topic really interesting.  He demands alot of work but I learned more in his class than in any other.  I miss his class!
Just like everyone else said, "He is GREAT!" I really enjoyed his class. He can be a tough grader at times but he is also very willing to work with you!  Probably my favorite professor at UF so far!
One of the best professors I've had at UF.  Be sure to go to class and talk though!!
Noll Rocks! He's awesome! Attend ever lecture though... it'll save you in the end!
Dr. Noll is the best prof I've had at UF so far. He is incredible and funny and he really knows what he's talking about. I'd give anything to have him again!

He helped me out a lot. I failed the midterm but aced the final because he helped me. He tries to get to know all of his students and the lecture is very interesting. Has been my favorite professor thus far.

Amazing prof! Quite excentric! REALLY knows his subject. Expects class to engage him in discussion, seriously. Gets frustrated when there is no participation. Pretty strict grader, but VERY willing to sit down with you and help. I wish I could take him again.
LOVE him!!!  Knows what he's talking about and will be more than happy to work with you on anything you may need help on
the class is very demanding of your time with all the reading.  the lectures are funny and he keeps it simple, make sure you talk in class!
Sooooo great!
The teacher is very funny and he makes history entertaining. Expect him to make jokes about you and tease you. :)

Yes, he knew what he was talking about, but I just didn't like the way he ran his class. That being said, it was also TOO reading intensive. You'll like it is you like uppity teachers and you like to read ALOT.
He is the best professor I've had at UF.  He puts such a great spin on history that it keeps you very interested.
Loved the cass, the best professor I've had so far.

AWESOME. Dr. Noll is what a professor should be. Involved/gets you involved. You actually will want to go to class. Amazing learning potentional there. I wish I could take it again! Very helpful. Gives essay topics for test well in advance! GREAT!!!!
His class is very interesting and easy to stay up to date with. As long as you go to his class you'll be fine in the class!~

Ahh Mr Noll and his crazy hair.  He's a real funny guy.  His tests are pretty much right from the notes and he tells you exactly what the essay questions are going to be.  He's real helpful and approachable.  He made me not hate history as much any more.

Wow, Dr. Noll like to make you read. This class had 5 required books, plus 3 book reports on *other* books. And then a research paper. That being said, he's a great, fun teacher and lecture is really fun.
Great Class!!!

Awsome teacher! Very lively and exciting. Keeps class awake and participating! If you listen closely to his lectures he explains well enough that you don't have to read the text.. only the other outside readings! Essay exams are very fair and given ahead.
No Comments

Passivea ggressive to students and her faculty don't like her. Interactions may feel more critical than constructive, which makes it hard for students who value supportive, solution-oriented mentorship... would not get on her bad side.

Dr. Oli tends to be very disorganised. Course content was a mess; the Canvas pages were very hard to navigate. Emails would occasionally get lost for days or weeks, and communication with Dr. Oli and the TAs was nigh impossible. Requirements and expectations were constantly shifting, making it very difficult to keep track of what needed to be done.

I had Sade Thomas as my TA, and this was by far the most disorganized course I have ever taken. The expectations are unclear, everyone is always confused about what we're even doing in the lab, and when you ask questions for clarity they just run you in circles. If you want a decent grade in a 1 credit lab steer clear of this TA.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: My teacher was Sade Thomas and I feel as though the course was very confusing with most of the time spent in lab with her along with the TA's being confused half the time. The course was quite easy to get an A in but it was stressful during class and you were constantly trying to figure out what was going on and what you were supposed to do
Expects way too much from students but doesn't put any thought into the class. Constantly expressed disappointment at our projects and presentations. Class was very disorganized and overall a mess

I never saw/heard from Dr. Oli. Her GA was Shaun and he was awful. He contradicted himself on things he said, assignments, and even messed up grading on the midterm. He said the midterm was not gonna be hard and then our class had an average of a 60. Not helpful and condescending at times. The ELN were long but they didn't read them easy A given.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Initially very interesting and fun course, but sometimes didn't explain labs too well. When it came to research projects she became very critical of students, saying their work wasn't good enough but couldn't give a reason why or how to improve. Some of the things she said were very upsetting and discouraged my interest in microbio or lab work.

Disorganized and unclear expectations. Refused to answer students questions for the final project, sent emails expressing how we were disappointing after refusing to help.Told us we were part of the reason why science is loosing traction.Overall, short with students and discouraging, especially to those who have never taken a lab like this before.

She truly cares about her student's well-being and wants them to learn and engage in the material rather than just focus on getting a good grade. The most passionate, dedicated professor I've had. Takes the time to connect with her students and creates a caring environment with motivated students.

Dr Oli can a little disorganised and unclear at times, but her lab is a lot of fun and you learn a lot of useful techniques. Her TAs are also awesome and very helpful. Grading and deadlines were very lenient. The class is time consuming but not difficult to get an A as long as you try ans submit all your work.

The lab itself is run by TAs which is a good thing because Dr. Oli has created a disaster of a lab. Everything is so disorganized and the canvas page gives you a headache trying to navigate. Labs could be 45 minutes if she just gave proper instructions. She also extends labs through the very last week of classes doing meaningless activities.

Professor Oli is understanding with deadlines, offers extra credit, and exhibits strong subject knowledge. However, occasional ambiguity in grading and course disorganization caused challenges for students. Yet, her caring, respectful, and attentive nature stands out.

Took with TA Benjamin (Myles) Bumgarner. Super laid back and easy going he's pretty cool. As long as you do the work and are trying you're best you'll get an A. Weekly quiz, ELN for every lab, midterm, one group presentation project, no final. Extra credit opportunities and multiple retakes for quizzes. Really no interaction with Dr. Oli.

IDS2935 MICROBES WITHOUT BORDERS (no course option for that). Interesting and fairly fun for a quest class but a lot of assignments. 1 discussion, 1-2 activities, 1 quiz, and 1 assessment every week. Plus 3-4 big PowerPoint presentations. Prof was somewhat responsive but the syllabus is confusing and due dates change often. No required lectures!

I'm really surprised by some of the negative reviews on here, I had Oli for microbio lab and she was absolutely wonderful. Almost everyone gets an A and all she wants is for you to try your best. The material was interesting, there's lots of extra credit, you can redo questions you got wrong on the midterm for 1/2 credit. Super fair!! love her!

This course proved the most time consuming and difficult course I took this semester (even more so than organic chemistry). Assigments/instructions were unclear and kept changing and some TAs were unresponsive for months at a time. Take the in-person class and you're good to go. If you do choose online, get yourself in a group of classmates asap.

Dr. Oli does not really run the course. Your GTA runs the course. Due to this, your GTA determines the course difficulty. I had a phenomenal one: Saloni Bhimani. She made class so much fun, and it was challenging still but in a fun way. Out of all the major STEM labs, this is definitely the best!
Favorite class this semester. The lab is a lot or work and you have to put good effort, but is a fun class and you actually do learn a lot. Dr. Oli is very knowledgeable and helpful.

Knowledgable professor but is a poor teacher. Very disorganized with unclear guidelines and expectations. Can be short to you when you ask for clarifications. Waste of time and energy and discouraging to all those interesting in Microbio. Avoid professor if you can
Dr Oli is the best. The lab is a lot of work but you also learn a lot in her class. She is very helpful and wants everyone in succeed. She is very quick to respond to questions.

I had GTA Shannon Brown and she was amazing. Grading rubrics are very clear and she cares to make sure each student understands to pass. Gives lots of extra credit worth 1% total grade each. There are just a ton of lab write ups and busy work assignments for this to only be a one credit class. Everything is pretty straightforward and fun.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Waste of time. TAs dont know what theyre doing. Theyre always confused just as the students its sad. Where is the professor for a one credit class its so much work. Study for midterm its difficult and not easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Most work Ive ever had to do for a one credit class. Its more work than any of my other classes this semester, actually. If this was a 3 credit class, I wouldnt mind but its not.. Bio majors, take PCB instead of MCB just so you dont have to do this lab.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: coordinator for MCB lab. had dr lee for TA. she is very nice and responds to emails fast and is very caring. really cares about all students and learning. just makes too much work for grad TAs to have in their mcb class (they choose what they want from her own work to assign)

Very disorganized and unclear with instructions, due dates, etc. Had a difficult time getting Dr. Oli or my TA to answer emails (even urgent ones). Professor seemed like she never knew what was going on, as did the TA's. I thought the class overall was disorganized and highly demanding.

This class was a total train wreck from the start. The deadlines and assignments weren't clear at all and kept changing without much notice. It's an easy class, it just involves a lot of busy work and confusion. She's a really sweet professor, just pretty pointless.

This was so unorganized and chaotic. The due dates got changed every week and she changed the test format halfway into the semester. However she is flexible and willing to help you out with grades. The class is super easy and just for paying attention and doing the work I ended with an 100%. Easy credit super disorganized.

I took Prof. Oli for MCB4394 and she was extremely passionate about the material. It was hard to follow deadlines because oftentimes they were unclear, as well as the grading. She was very sweet and caring during the pandemic, however, did not provide as much organization as is standard.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Oli is so unorganized and never had definite dates. Even the TA's had no idea to what to. She really cares about the material, but it makes no sense when all the dates are always changing. Didn't know what was due until the night before. Would not take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: class was a lot of work but not too hard to get an A. she has GTAs teach but they are very strict about what Dr. Oli wants out of students. our semester got cut by COVID so we didn't do a lot of lab stuff because you can't online. midterm is really important (it is 1/2 written and 1/2 practical) --> study for hours
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I had a great GTA for this class! The class can be difficult as the GTA makes it to be, but mine was a real gem. He understood that the class was only 1 credit and really wanted to learn. MCB3020L is taught by GTA and UTA so it all depends on the GTA you get.

This lab isn't as bad as everyone is saying it was. Every week there will be 2-3 assignments due. The assignments can be time consuming so I recommend starting them during lab times and asking TAs questions. The schedule and modules can be disorganized which makes it confusing for students.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Unclear deadlines and assignments. Doesnt respond to emails. Class was overall a waste of my time. You also dont know what grade you got until the very last second which is more inconvenient than in other classes because of the way her grades are done.

Fantastic educator! Will not only teach you science but HOW to be a scientist. Felt confused in the bootcamp sometimes but in the summer lab she emphasized the importance for scientists to know how to figure things out on their own. Passionate and intelligent, cares greatly for students. As long as you make an honest effort, she'll have your back!!
Really great professor, not much work. Never used my textbook.

Not really sure why this 1 credit lab is the hardest most tedious class I have taken at all of UF... and im a senior, pre-med. Literally makes this lab AWFUL and it takes 2 full days for me to complete all the assignments she has us do. I thought this was a 1 credit class, yet I spend 10x longer doing stuff for this class. AVOID IF U CAN

I would NOT recommend taking this with multiple other time-consuming classes. I'm a sixth year by credits and can tell you this is the most disorganized, confusing, and time-wasting class I have ever taken. She has wild expectations for what a lab is supposed to be like. IMO, takes more time up than any lab I've had at UF. Doesn't respond to email
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: I enjoyed Dr. Oli class very much!!! Although it's a lot of work for a one credit class, it is an easy A as long as you do your work. She also gives out extra credits. There is no way you to get a low grade in this class.

Dr. Oli isn't the worst, but she's certainly not all that she's cracked up to be. She cares about teaching, sure, but picks favorites, condescends, and loves to ruin any shred of morale students may have. She can be unpredictable and bipolar with her personality which makes her presence burdensome. She is a decent teacher and the lab is an auto-A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I had the opportunity of having intro to micro lab with Dr. Oli- she is AWESOME. If you put in honest participation, she will help you grade-wise-- there are few times that undergrad students get the opportunity to *really* learn lab techniques and to keep repeating them until they've mastered them in introductory-level courses. Dr. Oli is a gem!

Was originally excited for the class. Not once did I ever see the professor. Only taught by TA's who usually had no idea what was going on. Whenever I asked for help, I would usually get the response, "I don't really know." Majority of the projects had no rubric. If you try you can pass with an A. The class was just very unorganized.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: The lab is one credit but its more of a part time job. Get ready for quizzes once a week based on two modules with material that won't be useful to study from because the TA makes the quizzes up. Multiple projects throughout the semester and a final project each worth 100 points. Most unorganized class I have ever taken and I'm a senior.
She is a good Nepali Teacher :). Learned so many things

Dr. Oli is sweet; it's very clear that she genuinely cares about her students and wants them to learn.  It's true that she does cater her classes mostly towards those entering related career fields, but I always felt that she treated everyone equally.  My only problem with her was that she could go on talking forever if someone didn't stop her.

The class is catered towards people wanting to go into microbiological careers. Unfortunately, as her own survey showed, that's like 2 of the 30 people in the class. Tons of busy work and wasted time. It's an easy A, but you'll be in lab 6 hours a week for no reason. I'd take another prof.
Just had her in immersion lab. Awesome professor. A lot of work, but she is out to teach you, not fail you. It was actually a really fun class. If you can, take this professor.

Amazing and knowledgable teacher. downside replies back to you take a little long and getting specifics for papers is a little vague. However I really learned the material and feel knowledgable after taking her class.

Dr. Oli is wonderful teacher! Although her lab may not be easy, she is very helpful if you seek it. Sometimes she gets disappointed when you are unprepared but it makes you a better student in the end. I would recommend her any day.

Great teacher! She seems hard at first, but I'm pretty sure that's just to intimidate students. She's actually very funny and approachable, and understanding as well. She's open to suggestion and is helpful although she takes her subject veryyy seriously. She gave everyone a ton of extra credit at the end to make up for her difficult exams.

Dr. Park cares a lot about seeing his students succeed. This class had lots of extra credit and multiple exam drops, so it was hard not to get an A. Although he was not very knowledgeable in data science, I highly recommend taking a class with him.

I have never written a review before but Dr. Park is MORE than deserving. He provided so much encouragement to us as we improved, gave lots of extra credit and multiple drops, and made himself available by meeting and online frequently. He even cancelled the final because his students made such an impact on him. Best professor ever. Take his class.

Caring professor from day one, dedicated to student success. Seven exams may seem like a lot, but each covers manageable material. Always available on Discord and never declined in-person meetings. Extra credit offers low-pressure coding practice. The best professor I have had at UF, highly recommend you take the class if you have the chance.

Dr.Park is by far one of the best teachers i have had! Go to class, he is super nice and lectures well (most times class gets out early). His exams are very representative of what is learned in class and he listens to his students!
Best professor I have ever had, if you are looking at this while thinking whether to take his class, just take it.

I'd highly recommend taking any course with this professor. The exams were very representative of the content covered in class. He also provided ample extra credit opportunities and exam drops. He genuinely cares about his students and wants everyone to succeed.

This guy is an absolute sweetheart. He really wants each and every one of his students to succeed. Yes, the course is test heavy but because tests are frequently there's not much material between each test so it's not as rigorous as you think. He's always available to ask for help through Discord. 10 out of 10 professor.

1 month into class and bros a wreck. cant teach the class well, couldnt write a multiple choice quiz correctly, assigned straightforward homework -- and then lost it bc students couldnt answer random abstract math questions on the spot for an 'audit' that was rlly an in person oral exam. now hes cancelling the syllabus?? steer clear.

Bro is the goat, he is so helpful and he's too funny and very chill. Very understanding if you need an extension and even allowed for custom office hours bc I couldn't make the ones already set up. Most homework is in the Google Colab and class isn't mandatory unless he says so. But yeah, very chill, easy class, highly recommend for prob any class

Dr. Park responds to emails promptly, answers questions well, and is always willing to help students understand the material or the homework better. He is a great professor, and I learned a lot in this class. He is passionate about math bio and he also is well versed in the subject material. The homework can be hard, but is always fair.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: clearly took prev feedback seriously. I loved this class and have 0 complaints. was fun, content is very useful, assignments were interesting and taught me something (and not too hard at all), lectures are recorded so it's convenient (though I recommend going to class). he is very nice and very chill and wants to help you learn! highly recommend

Lin alg for data science is a very fun class that has a little bit of everything. Theory, math, python coding. Assignments are all very cool and build upon smaller tasks done during lecture. Entirely coding based for grading. Park teaches very well and all content has a purpose, there's no fluff or 'why am I learning this' moment. Great time
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I get that it was his first semester, but still he seemed so unmotivated and came to lecture unprepared. He spent all his time copying theorems from the textbook word for word and often times struggled to prove them. The class itself is an easy A since 80% of the exam questions were HW questions but do not expect to learn much from the instructor.

Super nice and easy-going guy, but not a passionate instructor. Exams were exact copies of homework and were never passed back. Lectures were copied from the textbook with literally zero derivation. In one case, class ended early because he couldn't explain a theorem he spent 15 minutes copying a proof of. You'll pass, but you won't actually learn.

Mr. Park is a nice person, but this teaching style isn't the best. He reads from the textbook and openly admits that he isn't familiar with the material. The class is an easy A though, but I didn't learn much. He was open to feedback though. My class consisted of graded homework, two exams, and a final.

Dr. Park is great. He provides tons of examples and the course is graded entirely on homework assignments. It is best if you have some programming knowledge (python is pretty easy to pick up). He even started the semester by going over basic MAS 4105 or 3114 topics. As long as you do the assignments, getting a B is not that difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Park is good at teaching, unfortunately, his lectures aren't recorded. He doesn't really do a lot of practice problems/examples, but if you come to class regularly you should be fine doing the homework and exams. He is really funny, nice, and very lenient with the grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Provides material to actually learn Portuguese or to just skid by and get language credit. GPA-friendly class if you put effort in.

Quinn was an amazing and passionate professor to have, he really loves soccer and even if you're not a soccer fan, or a sports fan at all, you will have fun in this class. The lectures and assignments were very engaging, fair amount of group projects but nothing too bad. He wants you to do well in this class and was very open to student feedback.

LOVEDDD THIS CLASS!!! if you can get it for you quest 1: do it. it's super engaging and fun, even if you aren't a sports fan! the grading isn't tough at all (shout out to cristina fr) and the assignments are very easy to complete. overall, he's a super caring person and you can tell he's truly passionate about what he teaches. 100/10

Easy class obviously as it sounds, and if you're lucky enough to get it as your Quest 1, enjoy it. Every class was awesome and it was super enjoyable and laid back. Cool projects and some in class essays but never hard or difficultly graded. Very debate based and its cool to hear everyone's takes on things. He lives up to the 4.9.
Dr. Hansen is truly a great professor. Soccer Explains the World is easily the best Quest 1 course because he makes the class super engaging and thought provoking. Highly recommend.

Amazing class and amazing professor. The assignments are super easy and the workload is so light and he's genuinely so passionate about what he teaches. Easiest possible quest class to take at UF and I highly recommend. He's also an amazing person and super chill. Best possible quest class imo.
Best professor I've had by far, cares about his class and lectures are entertaining. If you are lucky enough to get in his class, then you have the easiest A of your life incoming.

Such a fun and interesting guy. Never once felt bored during lectures or doing assignments, which were pretty easy anyways. Includes everyone in the discussions and covers a wide variety of topics even for non-sports fans. Best quest class and would highly recommend taking.

Professor Quinn is one of the best professors that I have ever had. You can tell that he is super passionate about what he is teaching, and that he cares about the input of every student in his class. The class itself is a quest 1, and is full of super interesting content connecting soccer to micro and macro issues in the world. 10/10 class
PRT1515 is possibly the best class I have ever taken in my life. You do not need to be an avid Spots fan to succeed in this class. The lectures are engaging and interactive.
Very enjoyable and informational. The people that gave this guy less than a 5/5 were just trying to be different.
Great professor and really wants to make class and the material fun

If you need a quest 1 course this is it. I learned a lot about the integration of sports in to societal issues which was something I previously had not thought about. Great professor and assignments are extremely easy. Highly recommend!
Amazing class, definitely recommend!

This is by far my favorite class I have had. If you are able to manage to get a spot in professor Hansen's class you will not regret it! Even if you do not know anything about soccer or sports, it is such an interesting and fun class. You can tell he is really passionate about what he teaches and has great lectures. Highly recommend! Easy quest 1.

The class does require effort, but it is very manageable as long as you keep up with the assignments. LinguaMeetings initially feel intimidating, but they're not too bad! This class is more about effort than perfection.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Great teacher, made learning super fun and enjoyable. Very chill and laid back, easy to talk to. Gets to know each person in the class. Easy class but I learned a lot.
The best ever. As a portuguese minor I can't wait to take his class again. Had him for 2 years now. More than happy to write Letters of Rec for you.
Quinn was such a fantastic professor. He's super thoughtful and approachable and helps you learn the content he teaches. 1000% would take again.

Quinn is a great person and professor. I loved his class in every aspect, from getting every student involved, to how relaxed and comfortable he makes the classroom environment for everyone. You can tell that he truly cares about his students and makes sure to do anything he can to help you learn the material. 11/10.
Quinn is such a great teacher for Portuguese. I had him for my Intro to Portuguese Culture class and he was such a sweetheart. If you get the chance, take a class with him! An absolute legend.
Very fun class especially if you are interested in sports. Just say a few things in class and try a little bit on the assignments.

Dr. Quinn is one of the best overall professors any student could have at UF. His lectures are intuitive and fun which draws all students into participating in conversation. The overall course work is relatively light. I highly recommend taking soccer explains the world for both the content and the professor!
Professor Hansen is genuinely the best teacher I have ever had and I could not recommend his Quest course enough! The class was super engaging and interesting, especially as a big sports fan.

This was an enjoyable and informative course. Overall, the professor creates a relaxed environment where you learn without being stressed about memorizing the material. This class is not difficult but will prompt you to think.
Awesome class. Assignments were very simple and we had multiple attempts. Really cool guy and always made the class fun.

Soccer explains the world was my favorite class this semester. Prof. Hansen is really passionate and enthusiastic about the content in the course. Assignments and grading are clear and the class structure is good. Would recommend for Quest 1.

I really loved this class and this professor. He is super passionate about the subject, which makes all of the lectures/assignments even more interesting. I never liked to miss class because I enjoyed it so much. I'd recommend this course and professor to anyone.
Very good professor, cares a lot about his students and if you can take this class I absolutely recommend it. The lectures are early but they are worth waking up for.
He is a great professor and I thoroughly enjoyed my time in class.
He is a great guy and an even better professor. Great class, I would recommend it heavily!

He's a very good lecturer and you will do well in his course if you pay attention to the class and go to his office hours. If you can't put in the time, then I'd take someone else(although orgo itself is going to take time)

reviews.comment: Pete is my favorite professor at UF. He explained orgo so clearly and encouraged students to think critically about the material rather than simply memorizing. However, your grade is based only on tests, so make sure you know the material well. Overall amazing lecturer and kind person.

One of the best orgo1 professor! Dr.Pete made orgo fun to learn through his organized lectures and joyful personality. He offers a lot of practice (Officehours+studyguides), which is essential for orgo. The TAs are also amazing!

He responded to emails fast. Watching the videos and coming to office hour every day is sufficient, class not mandatory. He can be a little rude or inconsiderate, but never purposefully. Exams are hard but usually straight from homework. He thinks orgo is ur number one priority (assigning video lectures and homework over a hurricane), so be prepped

I took Pete for Orgo 1&2. His lectures were engaging and he gave guided notes for every lecture + uploaded the powerpoint slides. He gave so many opportunities to practice: a massive "study guide" with 100s of problems and explanations, practice exams, and daily office hours where he does additional practice problems and exam reviews.

He made Orgo2 a much harder class than it could've been. He loves to be extra. All exam averages were VERY LOW (50%), especially compared to Habenict. Told us that he was going to put reactions on the final that we've never seen before because at this point in orgo we should be able to "figure them out", and he did. Best word to describe him: TOXIC

Had Pete for orgo 1-2, thought he was an engaging lecturer and explained the material clearly. I found the exams to be moderately difficult but overall fair. I suggest going to as many office hours as you can as this was much of my exam prep. There's no hw but there was extra credit which was very helpful. Highly recommend him as a professor.

Took Punthasee for both Orgo 1 and 2 during my freshman year, it was a huge learning experience, even for someone that had already done lots of organic chemistry in AICE A levels, be ready to do lots of studying and reviewing, his exams are superr tough. Office Hours and extra credits saved me because I had failed multiple exams in both classes.
Honestly do not take him, any other teacher is so much better.

Graded by exams and some extra credit. Final was brutal and he's honestly not a great lecturer, plus he doesn't offer recordings. IMO he goes way too fast, rushes through, and doesn't fully answer questions. Do the study guides as that's where he pulls his questions from. Just remember everything he shows you. Habenicht stays on top.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The average on the final was a 60. 60%?!?!?!

He cares about his students, but he goes fast through material. Up until the final, I thought his exams were fair if you did the study guides. Final was misleading. He put a lot of unnecessary study materials and then tested only on new material. I had an A all semester until the final, so it was disappointing. Just put in the work and you'll pass

orgo is hard, so you have to study harder and Pete goes hard with you 24/7. I have no idea he did OH everyday and gives us his 100% for 2 semesters. Use Pete and his resources a lot and work hard and you will get an A. He really cares about you and wants you to learn. His cuttoff for a A is higher, but i thought his exams were easier and he gave EC

Pete is an amazing chemistry professor and cares so much about all of his students. He gives hundreds of practice problems and tons of office hours similar to exam questions so as long as you put effort in you will do good. I had him for orgo 1 and 2 and loved both. He also gives good extra credit opportunities
Pete is an amazing chemistry professor. He cares so much about all his students and learns as many names as he can. So many resources and office hours that as long as you put eff

Do not take this professor if you genuinely want to get a good grade. Exams are actually nothing like the resources he offers. Everyone says that Office hours beneficial but newsflash the exam is nothing like it! If you just want to get a good grade or genuinely just pass take another professor. Not worth taking for all the stress he gives.

Most caring professor I've ever had in college. I dropped Orgo 1 my freshman year fall and retook with Pete for both Orgo 1 & 2 and got high As in both! No need for studyedge for this class, make sure to go to offices hours, do ALL study guide questions, and write 2nd notes. If you want an A in orgo, take with Pete!

TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN
I had Habenicht and Punthasee, you have to actively listen: Habenicht records: he dont

Pete no hw buffer: but the XC, and buffers on exams, both outweigh Hab's HW buffer

Both good explaining orgo: but his exams easier

All orgo will be difficult (rated 4) but he makes easiest path

He is good man and funny and very fair:

I do not usually rate professors but this time I had to. Genuinely one the best professors in my life. Exams are as fair as they get. Extra credit makes a huge difference. Gives tons of practice. Guides you through chapters. Biggest Advice: Really focus on listening in class and really understand the driving forces for each chapter.

This class is hard, duh, its orgo 2. Orgo 2 is known to be one of the hardest stem classes. But, i'm telling you Pete is fair and he sets you up for success. How to suceed in his class: do the study guide (yes the entire thing, sit down and do it) or go to office hours (he picks study guide questions), take seconds notes on his slides/ask questions

Class only has exams. He's very open when it comes to office hours, but his way of explaining stuff and what he focuses on compared to other orgo prof is what I wish someone had told me before taking this class with him. If you must take the course with this prof, use study edge, it is super helpful. Goodluck!

BEST PROF EVER!!! Makes lectures entertaining, explains concepts VERY WELL. Office hours daily with accurate mock exams. Genuinely CARES for the success of his students, answers emails with questions within minutes. Exams are very fair if you do the long study guides he gives. Nothing but a 5/5.

....The exam are very hard, some I don't even think that I have learnt before. If you are no a really really good at chemistry, don't take his orgo. Most of the questions are changed in some way. I never get a C before, but for this class, I think I will get a D first. His teaching is good, just if you want a good grade, don't take his class.

Pete is really that guy! Orgo is notoriously hard and Pete lets you know how to study for his class. He gives you all the tools to be successful. Make sure you show up to lectures and GO TO OFFICE HOURS!! I never showed up to office hours before taking orgo, but to really be successful go and ask questions and do practice problems.

Best professor I have had at UF that really cares about teaching & makes learning orgo enjoyable. Very detailed lectures and gives so much practice problems in study guides and practice exams. Hosts helpful daily office hours. Exams are very fair if you study hard, often include exact problems from his study guides, & contain extra credit points.

I was skeptical getting Pete for orgo since he was a new professor, but he was amazing. The class is hard, but if you ACTUALLY pay attention in class, do your second notes, and do the study guide questions before exams, you are set. The man has an algorithm and it really works. 10/10 would definitely recommend if you like faster-paced lectures.

Best professor I've ever had at UF and the most helpful professor as well. Very test heavy, but he has office hours everyday which will help you get an A. Do every single study guide and go to every office hours session and you will get an A! The third exam was definitely the most difficult and so was the final.
The best professor I have had at UF! He is very caring about his students and provides ample amount of resources to succeed. I would take Pete over any other professor in a heartbeat!!

New professor at UF, very good lectures but very unclear about exam content. Exams significantly more difficult than Habinicht, however does offer extra credit. No homeworks to cushion grade 4 exams and final. VERY HEAVY ON SYNTHE

Must take Pete, best professor. Orgo is hard no matter what but with Pete, if you are willing to follow his lead and trust him, you have the ability to succeed. Very fair tests and gives sneaky extra credit. Dont use study edge and use all his resources and go to every office hour.

Pete is amazing, he is so encouraging and is adamant about the fact that all of his students can succeed if they follow his directions and work hard. This class is tough, it's organic chemistry. But Pete clearly lines everything out for you and is able to simplify hard subjects. You need to put in alot of work and show up to class, but it is doable

Everyone should have Pete as your professor for Organic Chemistry. He is extremely nice and with the help of Tuski I felt the material was easier to understand. He gave plenty of practice exams and questions. All of his tests were fair and it is manageable and time-consuming to get an A. His teaching style is refreshing to see at UF.

Pete is the best!!!! He has been my favorite professor so far! Lectures are actually interesting and you come out feeling like you actually learned. He gives sooooo many resources and AMAZING handouts that go right with the PowerPoints. His slides are amazing and so fun. You can tell he cares so much and wants everyone to succeed.
Very responsive and generally very helpful!

I was surprised to see her bad ratings. I had her for WW Microbio and she was great. You had to come to class to take the quizzes, which are 40% of your final grade, but they're super easy as long as you show up. Don't slack off too much though, as you need a 94% to make an A. You can use class resources like notes and slides on all the assessments

reviews.comment: You don't learn a lot in the class, but are still expected to take an exam on material that was "taught". The labs were fine, but the lab reports were the worst. New to teaching, it really shows. Going to lecture is pointless. The meat of the class is lab reports, which take 8+ hours per week to complete. She made the 1st exam too long, had to trash it. Re-graded lab reports because TAs didn't "grade to her standards." Don't punish us for following instructions by the TAs. Worst prof at UF.

reviews.comment: Professor Gibson is a wonderful professor, and I recommend taking her.  There are 4 tests and no final cumulative other things to Inc Grade. She makes every class interactive. reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Loved her, lectures were very easy to understand, quizzes were easy as long as you attended lectures. She was always quick to answer any questions I had.

does not present her material in a way that students can understand. She is inconsistent on her tests. You must attend class and do all assignments if you want to even pass her class. Her tests are all conceptual and not one multiple choice is presented. Do not take this teacher unless you intend on making a C or lower.

He has one TA who was super sweet and gave nice feedback and an A on a decent paper, the other TA was awful and super condescending when grading papers and gave everybody a B- in an intro-level class. reviews.comment: A genius, down to earth & genuinely cares. Mess up a submission? He'll email u to let u send it to him, no penalty. Had a life crisis? He'll check up on you on a personal level & give extensions. Yes there's a lot of readings and some essays but mostly watch the lectures & use the slides as notes. Skim readings for quotes to use. Communicate w him.

Took the class online during summer b. Very few assignments with a lot of lecture videos. It was hard to understand him but attend office hours and its better. TA grades everything, one was definetily chiller than the other one. Overall, actually watch the lecture videos and take good notes and put time in on your own and the class is not too hard.

reviews.comment: Tough to understand but willing to take time to explain the concepts during office ours. First part of the class is difficult but get better. Apply yourself and you get out what you put in.

This class is not as hard as some make it out to be. The tests were entirely based on lecture notes. As long as you study those, the test will not be that difficult! The only problem I had with this class was his thick accent during lectures which made it sometimes hard to understand what he was saying.

Good intentions as a person but not a great professor. He gave extra credit and was sometimes understanding, but sometimes wasn't. His accent was very heavy, and especially in an online class with no transcripts, it was virtually impossible to understand him. The course was intro level and he made it much harder/ complicated that it needed to be.

reviews.comment: I can't understand anything he is saying because of his accent. This isn't meant to be racist at all; I am very against that. reviews.comment: Class was easy and the prof was more than fair on grading.

Denise was an amazing discussion leader for POS2041. She was open to students of all ideologies and opened the floor for some amazing conversations. She made it clear she was always there to help us do well and she even kept up with our lives, asking how things were going and sending support during tough times. If you have the choice, take her!

She is a great TA and would make an amazing professor! She is understanding and cares about her students. She doesn't grade harshly and wants you to be able to earn an A and succeed in the course. Her lectures are engaging and she makes discussions fun. I highly recommend!

I took ISM6423 Data Analysis for Decision Support. The man (I hesitate referring to Liangfei as a mortal because he) responds to emails lightning quick and can talk without faltering for 2 hours straight with no break and no water. Respect.
Amazing professor! His slides are very useful. He knows his subject very well.

Liangfei is a good guy who cares about his students, and his class is pretty straightforward and east if you put in any effort. It may be difficult to work through his accent, but the slides are well put together enough to learn on your own.

He clearly understands the material and is able to explain the content but lack of accompanying materials makes it harder to follow the concepts. I personally felt that just using the textbook by itself and not paying much attention to the lectures helped me the most but he still answered questions.
He is a good lecturer, very lackluster at answering questions. Don't ask him questions. Very enthusiastic teacher.
Bad professor, not someone you want teaching you. He is inaccessible outside of class and treats you terrible.

Great professor! He gives clear and understandable lectures. His example problems actually help you on the homework (and the hw problems are all on chegg). He has 3 exams and no cumulative final. He does a review before each exam and If you study the review and HW problems, you'll ace the exams. Cons: He takes about 2 weeks to grade exams.

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I have ever had
While Ron is wise and seasoned in the art world, he definitely will let you know if he believes you lack potential.

I LOVE PROFESSOR JANOWICH! Hes honestly the nicest teacher ever. He always compliments students no matter their experience level and makes sure to point out the things you did right while also giving valid critiques. I hated waking up early but this class made it worth it. My favorite class ive taken BY FAR. He really helped boost my confidence��

Most chill, helpful, and supportive guy ever. We love King Ronald. If I catch you talking bad on him I'm swinging. He finds the good in everything you turn in and never berates you if you mess up, can't find time to finish an assignment, accidentally sleep past class (oops), etc. Also super knowledgeable on artists and techniques. Light of my life.
Ron is a great professor. He gives you great feedback and many helpful tips. He wants to see you do well in the class. I feel like I have actually learned a lot in this class.

Ron is so laid-back that he is almost horizontal. Put forth some good effort and you'll be happy with your grade, but it is up to you whether you will just go through the motions or actually try to learn something and create decent portfolio work.
Ron is my favorite painting teacher. He knows everything about everything. He is so open to taking risks that you are free to explore what you want how you want.
No Comments

This professor knows a lot about certain philosophical topics and he makes sure you know it. He likes to go on long winding tangents about the most mundane of things and never lets students actually talk about a philosophical topic. He doesn't teach you he teaches at you and he couldn't care less about your grade. You start at 0 and go up.

Take any other one. The readings make absolutely no sense and you are expected to participate every class for points. His essay assignments are also very wordy and confusing.

reviews.comment: Humorous and makes the class easy to follow. Very calm and understanding. Has a high standard for essays. Grades mostly everything at the end of the semester.

reviews.comment: Must verbally participate in each lecture if you want a decent grade. Most of the readings you were supposed to do outside of class aren't actually graded or tested on in any way. Also, don't expect your work to be graded until the semester ends

I took Intro to Philosophy and you won't learn how to move things with your mind or anything but it's enjoyable and this professor is very nice and humorous. Not a very advanced or rigorous class at all. Just make sure to do the readings, which are 20 pages per week on average but easy to digest.

Professor Rick definitely cared about this class despite the honestly very low expectations and chill vibe. The readings were very reasonable and genuinely very interesting. Rick's breakdowns of the content in class was very approachable. Most of the grade is essays which I thought had great prompts. I gave a 4/5 because grading was super slow

He never posts the paper grades until the very end because they are completely graded by the TA, participation matters, and is why I ended with a B+, even though the TA giving the participation grade didn't even know our names. None of these grades were posted until after the semester was over, so we couldn't even try to fix it.

Office hours were super beneficial as he is excellent in helping you prepare your paper, lectures were very interesting and I found them engaging. He is very nice and his sense of humor is quite dry but garnered some laughs for sure. If I didnt graduate already Id take him more times

reviews.comment: You can tell he loves his job, but maybe a little too much. Harsh grader and a quiz every single week, and you will be graded harshly on your participation as well. Maybe don't take his class if you have social anxiety

Papers were very harshly graded. The last two papers (worth 40% of the grade together) never had the grade posted to canvas. Prof. Rick did seem like a nice guy though, and his lectures were interesting. He was helpful and willing to explain the material and go over the papers in his office hours.

Lectures were very boring and he read straight from the slides. Never even graded our last two papers, found out what I when final grades came out. Office hours are a must but he won't read your paper for you. Easy topics pretty easy to make up stuff but ridiculously hard grader.

Overall, the class was very simple. You were only graded by three essays which were 80% of the grade, participation, attendance, and a small extra credit opportunity. reviews.comment: This class was honestly a little difficult. In order to succeed read the readings, and talk during discussion!! reviews.comment: There are 3 papers and 1 EC assignment(100pt). He is really accessible and super sweet. You know his opinion very clearly but you can write the way you see fit. Overall a boring class.

reviews.comment: Do not take this class

Dr. Rick is wonderful- he's really knowledgeable, passionate and invested in his students' success. You will need to read A LOT (10-30 pages before each class) and if you don't read you'll struggle, but it was interesting!

reviews.comment: Professor Rick was a very enjoyable teacher. I took this class because I was interested, and the topics he covers were very interesting. reviews.comment: Dr. Rick is awesome! Knowledgeable and helpful, interesting lectures. But, IDS2935 is not easy. It's super cool, but graded on 4 essays. TA (Jim) was interesting. Tough grader, but go to his office hours, it helps! Lots of people disliked him, but I thought he was chill. Good music taste. A is manageable if you do the reading and write well.

reviews.comment: For a quest 1 class, this course uses heavy, philosophical jargon that was hard to understand. Your grade in this class is dependent on three main essays. The TA for this class grades very harshly. Don't expect an A in this class. The grade for the last paper wasn't even published for anyone to see. Extremely unhappy and sad with this situation.

reviews.comment: not a bad professor, just talks really quietly which makes his lectures boring and hard to hear. he helps out during his office hours though, which I highly recommend doing when writing papers. the material itself didn't really interest me so the papers and readings were not super fun to do.

Prof. Rick was awesome. This course was really difficult for me and he really gave me all the resources and guidance to help me understand the material and succeed. He is a super smart, caring guy, and it's clear he really has a passion for helping students learn. I really recommend taking a course with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Rick is really good. I had him for the summer A term for PHI2010. We only did five papers, a lot of them were really small, and the last two were really easy. His lectures are really good and sometimes funny as well.

reviews.comment: The class has very interesting content, and he is a nice and understanding guy, but grading is done by the TA and is very vague and tough grading for an intro class.

Professor Rick was a really great professor. He was extremely understanding and caring towards his students. He kelt his personal bias out of the controversial topics discussed. He offered an extra credit opportunity at the end of the course that was really useful. The class was graded on 3 papers and discussion section attendance/ participation.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Rick is an okay lecturer, but his grading criteria is vague. His TA was in charge of grading and was slow and not helpful with feedback. Discussion sections were redundant. Last two assignments were graded very last minute with no comments. Interesting course but quite boring and challenging for a Quest 1 class.

Very kind and approachable professor but lectures were boring and very redundant. I had him for cultural animals for MWF classes - the lectures on Monday and Wednesday, plus the discussion period on Friday were literally the exact same thing. Your grade is based on 4 papers. Theyre graded by the TA so pray that you get a good one- i didnt
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Rick is the bomb! Hes respectful of students and encourages us to share our thoughts and take risks. The topics he chooses for class are interesting and relevant. One of my favorite professors

Professor Rick is amazing. The first half of the class is based around Karl Marx and Adam Smith and the second half is about morality and the market place. In my four years of undergrad, I have never had a professor with such an understanding of Smith & Marx. Prof. Rick is a real gem.

(This is for Cultural Animals) Professor Rick is very passionate about the subjects he teaches and teaches them with great enthusiasm. Overall a great guy, very kind and accessible if you need assistance. Your grade is primarily 4 papers, which are not super hard if you start them early and read the material.

reviews.comment: Contemporary Moral Issues This course is very literature heavy, as we were expected to have read the articles prior to coming into each lecture. reviews.comment: Had for Cultural Animals. Readings are boring and don't get interesting but topics are unique. reviews.comment: Robbins was very nice and understanding and made sure everyone understood the material, versus just lecturing without care. For specific to work with R and Quarto she made it easy to adhere to for new students to R.

Suzanne is one of the better poli sci professors within the department. Her lectures are usually good, just might have a hard time always wanting to go as this class every semester is bright and early at 9:35. You might have to skip a few depending on your habits. She does a great job explaining the material and what is important for the test.

She is one of the best professors I have ever had, her class is well organized and she is VERY knowledgeable on the subject. She makes a boring topic interesting and engaging. Only issues are that there are a lot of readings, and there is also a semester long project with one partner (which is a LOT of work) so make sure you have a good partner.
Great and engaging professor. Homework and reading is doable, and tests are not too difficult. Go to lectures and pay attention and you'll do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Totally recommend taking Dr. Robbins for AFG. The class is mostly graded on exams, and I skimmed through the reading and studied with the online platform and got A's on all three of them. The essays are not difficult and can be done in like a day. Discussion was not hard. Just skimming the reading and slight participation should get you an A.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Love Professor Robbins. Knowledgeable, Smart, and gives a lot of extra credit. Interesting content as well, recommend everyone take this class as an elective. 
There were 3 papers, but they were relatively easy to complete.

3 papers + 3 exams. Lectures weren't super information dense making them a little boring. I just did all the Inquizitive practice tests the night before each exam and that will teach you EVERYTHING you need as long as you do each module to 100%. Took about 2 hours to study per exam, and I did very well on all of them. Extra credit on each exam.

Tough class, incredible professor. Dr. Robbins makes stats  surprisingly engaging and accessible. She's super organized, always available, and genuinely wants you to succeed. You'll work hard, but she's with you every step.

Very easy to talk to and isn't a boring lecturer. Everything she said in lecture was relevant to exams, but you're forced to attend anyway because of iClicker. Reading the textbook is key to success on exams, but that can be done with the 2 days prior. Went to her office hours for tips on how to study, she was super helpful (I got my B+ to an A)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She was such a diva. Anyways, she was sometimes a little too fast paced but she's a good lecturer overall. Essays were pretty straightforward (graded by TAs) and if you read from the textbook then the exams were relatively easy (my lowest grade was a 94%). One of my least time consuming classes this semester surprisingly.
Super easy, go to lectures and participate in discussions and its light

You have to read the textbook in order to get a good grade in the class - most of the lectures pull from there either directly from the questions at the end or topics that aren't covered in the lecture. other than that, she's funny and kind and she offered extra credit on every test.

Dr. Robbins has interesting lectures and tries to get to know her students. She has rubrics for discussion posts as well as discussion section grades. The only thing difficult with Dr. Robbins's class are her exams. To study, the textbook is mandatory as her lectures are relatively scattered in comparison. Memorize lecture and TB notes to prepare.
A very good prof who cares about the material she teaches. 99% of the material she covers in lectures comes straight from the textbook, so if you want to get an A definitely look through it.

Lectures are interesting, but have very little information on the slides, so take note of what she is saying and try not to miss class or else you miss the lesson. Don't buy the textbook because all of the readings for discussion can be found online. Exams are pretty difficult because any small detail she mentions can be a question on the exam.

I found Dr. Robbins' lectures to always be very confusing and all over the place. Her power point slides have very little information on them and she does not record her lectures, so if you have to miss class you can't get the lesson.

There's SO MANY THEORY READINGS but hopefully you'll have someone in class who reads it all and answers her class discussion questions. She explains really well if you don't understand the readings. Semester-long project is with one partner so make sure they're a good person. Fairly easy grader but timed exam is killer. Final paper is LONG.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class is largely based on how much effort you put in to learn the material. attendance is mandatory and things she mentions once will be on the exam. there are 2 textbooks and the main one you absolutely have to read and take thorough notes because her exams are very hard. the 2nd is for discussion posts, 3-5 passages a week. too much work!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I took this for my civic literacy credit and enjoyed the class. Robbins is a great professor and you only need to study a bit for the exams to do well. Weekly discussion posts are the only homework given.
Good teacher.  Go to lectures and pay attention, and if government isn't your strong suit then be sure to study for exams.

Love Robbins and her lectures; didn't love my TA, but that isn't her fault. Monday and Wednesday are lectures; Friday is small group discussion. If you want to do well on exams, take really good notes on the American Politics Today textbook. Lectures are engaging.

Prof. Robbins was an amazing lecturer.  Questions from exams came from lectures and using inquisitive for practice helped.  If you pay attention and study you should do well.  I never bought any books.  There was only one discussion board a week so there wasn't much work outside of the three non-cumulative exams.

Professor Robbins was an incredible lecturer and was extremely passionate about federal government. The TA took care of the grades for essays and things, and my TA was not the most resourceful- but not Prof. Robbins fault. As long as you go to class and complete the papers you will be successful.

Dr. Robbins is amazing! She's very knowledgeable and lectures were interesting. I was not a fan of the subject matter prior to the course, but ended up really enjoying it! Exams were take home essays, and while they made you think, they weren't very difficult overall. She's super sweet and cares about her students too. Very highly recommend!

Dr. Robbins is a nice professor, she encourages discussion through her lectures and workshops in class. Very passionate about the topic as well. Your grade is dependent on four papers, one of which is the take home final. She seems lenient on grading the papers though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Solid Professor teaching relevant and informative content. Honestly, a lot of busy work but it's an easy way to raise your grade.

Class was not too bad. Three exams with an essay due at the end of each exam week. Material is pretty straightforward and out of the textbook as well. Make sure to participate in discussion sections with your TA as that is a decent portion of your grade!
Her lectures are okay but to really understand the material I would read the book.

I took this class online for Fall 2020. Of course with the class 100% online it was vastly different than other experiences on here, but I'm super blunt and honest. Likely an easy A- class is 3essays, 3 exams. Exams and lectures are biased but fairly easy(and on quizlet) Shallow lectures- I skipped quite a few. Read textbook to actually learn.

I didn't have the best experience with her. The TA really taught the class better than she did. She put questions on her exams that were mentioned for literally a couple seconds during lecture. Obviously having it online for half the year made it easier but still watch yourself carefully and be very attentive during lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: THE BEST PROFESSOR. So sweet, caring, passionate. She is one of the few professors I have had that truly cares about her students. Her lectures are amazing, but regardless, your experience with this class has a lot to do with your TA. I have a good one, so it's fun, but just keep in mind. I would take all of my classes with her if I could!

Professor Robbins was amazing during this new class she decided to teach. Everything about money in politics was great. Some people don't like writing that much so if that is you, do no take this course. It was straight papers about 7 of them if I am correct. maybe less. Overall she hosted a great class, great discussions. I would take it again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--So many papers

reviews.comment: The lectures are interesting and interactive. The class is graded mainly on 3 essays and 3 exams all of which rely heavily on the textbook and lectures so take notes. Participate during discussions with your TA's as they are the key to getting A's on assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Super nice, pay attention and go to class and you will do fine. Make sure to read and be attentive in discussion because its for points.

Suzanne was an incredibly uplifting part of my week for a semester. Despite instructing an entire lecture hall, she managed to memorize names and make it a personal experience. Very well-spoken, knowledgable, friendly, and passionate! Will be taking other classes taught by her.

Honestly, if you can take this class with any Professor do it. All of her exams were biased and if you don't agree with her political views you will struggle to get any opinionated question correct. Lectures were pointless but you still need to go for clicker questions and I got an A by just reading the textbook. Make sure to get a good TA!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Robbins makes her lectures detailed and interactive so that students can understand the concepts from the course with ease. The class has a discussion section that meets once a week and helps go in-depth with specific topics. If you read and take notes from both the lecture and the book, you should do really well in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Robbins is a great lecturer and you'll learn a lot in her class. She genuinely cares about her students and current events and will discuss them in class and take in opinions through iClicker, which is also participation grade. Do the textbook reading and Dicussion reading, especially for the 3 Papers and 3 Exams. Easy if you engage.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Can't skip class. Very discussion-based. Great feedback on papers especially if you go to office hours and ask. Sometimes got overwhelming writing papers all the time but they ended up helping me understand the material a lot which helped on the midterm and final too. Relatively lenient grader. Overall, enjoyed her class and would take her again
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Professor Robbins is an eloquent lecturer who will provide you with a solid foundation for future political science courses. Reading the textbook is the best bet for great exam scores, and her lectures and assignments provide good supplements. In contrast to other poli sci professors at UF, she actually makes intro-level material enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Class has 6 essays and 3 exams. You will spend max 2-3 hours out of class per week studying. Participate heavy in the discussion because TAs are responsible for grading essays. Very interesting lectures, keeps up with events, leans left. Super sweet lady, would recommend this class 100%.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I really liked Professor Robbins' American Federal Government course. Her lecture's were interesting and I felt like the structure of the course was a good base for more advanced political science courses. Attendance is taken by iClicker questions so be sure to go to class and you should be fine. Easy grading scale too (91% is still an A)
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Easy class. Lectures twice a week with reading quizzes nearly each lecture. Just read before class and it is pretty simple. Only 2 writing exams which are open note. Interesting class. Should be a manageable A.
Dr. Ross is my favorite professor at UF. It's clear how passionate she is about her field of study, and if you pay attention/participate, you will do well in her courses!
Honestly easy quest but very harshly graded by few things.

Professor Ross was unorganized and took almost a month to provide feedback on the paper. I was looking at the reviews about how she relies on TAs' to much but would of been preferable to what I experienced this semester. She was also late to a lot of her lectures and came unprepared even though that is one of the requirements for her students.

She is by far the worst professor I've ever had here at UF. She is unorganized, takes way too many tangental questions from students and entertains them for far too long which eats up class time. It also means she doesn't talk about relevant material very much. 2 1/2 months since submitting my first paper and still don't have the grade back.

The lectures were interesting and you can tell Dr. Ross really enjoys the subject. Your grade is solely based on your TA and you don't get much feedback. There are basically only 4 grades for the class which were easy but the TA's are very picky, which makes it hard to secure 100's which made me end up with an A- on a very easy class.

The professor (or TA, whoever grades the essays and other stuff) puts in grades last minute, a few hours before grades are submitted so you cannot argue for an increase in grade or go over the essay to argue for points. The essays are graded willy-nilly and are unnecessarily scrutinised way too hard. Not a single person got a 100% in participation.

Very disorganized and some spontaneous rescheduling of critical in class assignments. Her lectures are too surface level to be engaging if you did the readings and know technology, making them come off patronizing. She claims no laptops in the syllabus, but thankfully she didn't enforce it or take attendance in lectures. Could've been worse.

Ross was great and lectures were fun to attend, but grades are completely based on the quality of your TA. She only allowed us to take notes by hand but in class essays were open note. The due dates for assignments were always changing, but if you attend class and keep an eye on the syllabus it is easy to know when things are due.

Ross is super nice but everything depends on TAs. Javier is not accessible outside of class, which sucks because i cant attend office hours. He's a tough grader and I'll get 7 points off (with a comment why) for writing half a sentence he doesn't like or feels "inaccurate" to him. Not great in discussion either, even though he's smart.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Ross is clearly very passionate about philosophy, making her lectures easy to sit through with a subject I'm not particularly interested in! She is very laid back with this class - a tad disorganized. In-class essays are a perfect exam style for this subject in my opinion. She does need to communicate more clearly with the TAs though...

I really enjoyed this class! Dr. Ross is extremely passionate about philosophy and it shows. She encourages students to engage with philosophy and ask questions but doesn't force anyone to participate. She also put lots of time into grading each of our essays so we would have helpful feedback.
Easy homework. Lots of reading but essays weren't very difficult. Great class.

Honestly, I don't have many great things to say. Professor Ross made attendance so difficult, she wasn't good at tracking time, she didn't mention upcoming homework, etc. Lots of group work. She promised we'd have no final and only have a midterm paper. At the end of the course, she gave us one week for a double final: a presentation and an essay.

Received maybe 4 grades back during the entire semester. Horrible communications on expectations and didn't give any feedback the entire course. The grade posted on my unofficial transcript was completely different and much lower from my final canvas grade. Expect to get screwed on criteria that you didn't even know existed with no feedback.

I've never had a professor this disorganized. Case study grading seemed to be random and expectations were unclear such as word limit or content expectations. Some assignments on Perusall weren't listed on Canvas. The syllabus specified a midterm paper but that didn't happen. Overall, I felt like the professor was ill-prepared to teach this course.

In the beginning, I thought I was in for a good class with how well Ross articulated her words and displayed passion towards philosophy. However, as the semester progressed, it became more disorganized. It felt that for the case studies, it was very subjective and there wasn't much leniency in different opinions. Not challenging, but frustrating.

I took this professor for IDS2935 which was a quest course on AI and Philosophy. The Professor is very engaging in her lectures and likes to have a conversational lecture with the students instead of merely a power point with a bunch of definitions. Although this can be scary, a lot of people talked because she was that engaging.
Lectures were very boring and attendance was mandatory. Case Studies are graded however the TA's want and there's no rubric. With clear grading criteria, they'd be fine.
Awful

Dr. Ross is an amazing professor, and I always looked forward to attending her lectures. There is class 3 times a week, with Fridays being a discussion session with your TA. There is almost no work, only a sign-in assignment, weekly annotations, and group case studies. Easy class that is very fun and interactive!

The lectures are boring but they aren't really necessary to getting a good grade in the class. She doesn't make you participate during lecture and doesn't randomly call on people or anything. I would just go on my phone most of the time it was really chill.

Very boring and unclear lectures and grading standards are super confusing, almost need to retake it because I totally messed up the assignment as I misunderstood how the assignments work: they are extremely consufing. And this class is almost all about political topics. This should be a politically related class instead of a philosophy class.

Professor Ross is very passionate about the subject matter and really cares for her students. She worked very hard to adjust the course after the hurricane in case anyone needed it (though no one really did). TA's grade everything.
