I wouldn't recommend taking under him. His scoring system (negative marking) really screwed a lot of people in the finals. He is a really smart guy no doubt and probably a great researcher, but not a good teacher. He tries hard to complete the text, so he rushes a bit. His assignments are pretty hard so 80% of the class ends up copying.

One of the worst professor.Doesnt help student.Kind of lazy in explaining things.Dont ever take class under him.Uses cormen slides to teach,reluctant in using  the board.Doesnt even prepare his own slides.He is not even clear in his explaination.He knows all algorithms to make student suffer.
very bad.Dont take any class under him.He makes people suffer except few who are really good.
this guys easy

honestly a very mean person. you never really interact with her because she just floats around the chem lab, but if she sees anything even slightly wrong with your lab attire she WILL yell at you in a very mean way in front of everyone else in the lab. like gang it isnt deep enough to yell. its general chemistry lab.

Your experience in this lab is defined by your TA and your lab partner, since you never interact with her. The pre-lab and post-lab assignments have very clear grading criteria and the final exam was really easy. As long as you attend your lab every week and turn in assignments on time, it is an easy A.
Very strict with dress code and glasses, not very nice

Entirely dependent on your TA. My TA was Colin, and he was amazing! The labs themselves were very straightforward. Make sure you look through the rubric on post labs to make sure you answered everything they are looking for.

Quizzes can be specific. A question's answer was 0.044 but I put 0.04. Even though sig figs were never mentioned, it was still implied. Other questions will have implications/ specifications, some won't, but remember those little things. Knowledge Check + final can be studied by going through each lab and their information/ procedural calculations.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Lab grades are dependent on TA but w/ supervision of supervisors. So even if you get something wrong, the TA will have to mark it but they can dictate how many points are taken off. Its great to get to know them so that not too many points will get taken off out of generosity.

This class is a lot of fun. I do not like that some assignments are added to the exam category, and said assignments have typos that make questions almost impossible to solve. If you ever loose points, she is very clear on why and how to fix it for the next lab. Labs are lots of fun, but it seems everything else is not made with quality.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Viege was fine for an online class. Of course, it is hard to rate a professor that isn't that involved in the course as an on campus course, but for what the class was, she made it very easy to keep track of due dates and deadlines. Professor Viege constantly reminded people of exam times, which is all you can ask for from an online class
Since this is a lab, it is entirely up to your TA

This class will solely depend on your TA since they are the ones that you communicate with and that grade your work. I personally have never had an interaction with the actual professor. Directions are always straightforward though so just make sure to check the rubric and you'll be fine.
Ur experience will 100% depend on ur TA. Read everything beforehand and follow the rubrics posted for the submissions and you'll get an A. The labs weren't hard.

Never had a conversation with Dr. Viege but the assignments and final exam were fair and representative of content given. Your TA is more important on how your grade is determined. Make sure to have a good relationship with your TA. Also, make sure to double check the night before your assignments are due that they were actually submitted.

Taking CHM2046L with Viege was pretty standard. As always, your TA makes or breaks you. If you have her for CHM2045L/CHM2046L, be wary that she is not forgiving of any technical issues, even those documented. I recommend closing out the whole browser and re-downloading what you submitted to make sure it was indeed submitted and also not corrupted.

having 50% of a post lab score be taken off because of technical issues is absolute bs, they could literally care less about accommodating for technical issues. grade really does depend on ta and I had a very pick ta which made things worse.

Never saw her and only interacted with my TA for the labs which usually took me at least 2 hours to complete since my partner sucked at being cooperative. Still ended up with an A even though I didn't do so hot on the final which she didn't give enough specific details about what the topics were on.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The classwork is very tedious but it's what you'd expect from an online course. Time management is important and it took be about 2 hours for each assignment, excluding discussions and tests. The lectures are basically a review of the textbook with some supplementary material. I'd still rather take this course than another physical science though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Lectures are pretty useless. Lots of "alternative" assignments to the hard exams, but they're ridiculously tedious. The only thing worse than the extra assignments are the smartbooks. Even if you don't get a single question wrong they'll take hours to complete with one due every week. Goes way too in-depth for a basic liberal arts science class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class solely depends on what TA you have, they do all grading and explaining. My TA was good and an easy grader, some were tough for people I knew though. Assignments were very easy and labs were fun. It doesn't take full 3 hours, usually only an hour and a half to finish labs. Very little work outside the lab and low stress.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The exams are EXTREMELY SPECIFIC and she expects u to apply concepts the textbook/lectures barely built upon. Smartbook assignments, quizzes, even LECTURES feel absolutely useless. Thank god for the grading scale, though. This is supposed to be a class for liberal arts majors but it doesnt seem like that at all. Take this w someone else if possible

I took this during COVID but it is still an online class regardless. Make sure that you pace yourself with ALEKS and the HWs because they will be important in understanding the exams. This class is easy if you pay attention and do the ALEKS and HW genuinely. It is also relatively self-paced and she offers a schedule to help with that.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The class is completely self taught and through ALEKs, I didn't learn anything through the instructor at all. The book was way more helpful than any of the recorded lectures. I'm pretty sure the TA grades everything. Office hours were always at very inconvenient times because she does them only in the mornings when other class periods are going on
Easy class if you study for exams and take textbook notes

I would 100% recommend getting study edge for this class, Rich know what hes talking about. ALEKS homework is tedious but it does help with understanding the content (use YouTube). Definitely review the quizzes and take the practice exams before each exam. Dr. Viege has videos posted for the topics which help sometimes.
if you HAVE to take 1025 you gotta do what you gotta do, but be warned, do not expect to learn anything from the prof, just do aleks and survive
Took this class online/asynchronous... homework does not match quizzes, quizzes sometimes match the exams. Prof is pretty much absent from the entire teaching process.
I never saw Professor Vieges face a single time in the entire semester. Get ready to teach yourself the entire course. The class was pretty easy, but ger study edge if you want an A.

Took this class bc I wanted to be 100% confident in the basics before CHM2045 and beyond, but it was a lot of unhelpful busy work (ALEKS) that took away from the time I could have spent studying .The instructor isnt the worst, she records short lecture videos and if you use the textbook to study youll be fine. Wish we had more helpful homework

She doesnt teach at all. Very apathetic response to emails concerning problems that were had during tests. Doesnt really answer questions asked but rather tells you to rewatch the lectures. Id recommend taking this course with a different teacher.

I felt that this class was a bit harder than it needed to be. The intense amount of ALEKS work made me miserable at times and it oftentimes felt like I was trying to drink out of a firehose. It frequently felt like I was all by myself in this class, it didn't really feel like I had a lot of resources.

Don't take this class unless you have to. Lectures barely teach anything on the tests/quizzes. Try to go straight to CHM2045 if you can. Tests and quizzes are a complete curveball and are way more difficult than the material "taught" in online lectures. You "learn" the majority of stuff on ALEKS, not from the lectures

I just wanted to take this class to brush up on chemistry before chem 1 but regret it completely. The place I learned the most from was ALEKS yet the tests were so different. I struggled to find good materials to study from in this class. Please do not take this class with Viege.

Gen. CHM 1 Lab is split into a lot of TA's. Your TA's grade your lab submissions, and it's honestly a hit or miss. If you're lucky, then your TA is a reasonable grader and good at explaining the lab! If your TA gives you clear instructions in the beginning, you'll be done with the lab fast.

she is the worst professor i have ever had. 1. she tests us on material that was not taught, and when we say something about it she says, and i quote "it's up for grabs". what does that mean? she literally tested us in PHYSICS. also she is so inaccessible, refuses to help students out of class. please do NOT take her.

I took chem online. So many assignments and used aleks. It's learning intro to chem material, but the test is advanced chem. Everything you learn is twisted on the test and is extremely confusing. I suck at chem. If you suck at chem, do not take this professor. I'm barely holding on here.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Doesn't do too great a job at teaching and just leaves you to learn the course all by yourself through ALEKS. Then, the tests and quizzes barely correspond to the ALEKS done and you end up having to just hope the practice exams she gives you are close enough to the real exam so you actually get some relevant exposure to the topics on the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The ALEKS program for homework does not teach you anything that will be on the quizzes, and the lecture videos do not coincide with what is on the exams. Be prepared to watch a lot of youtube videos and be very frustrated trying to learn this material.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: To give you an idea about this class, I took AP chem in high school and wanted to take this class as a refresher before I took Chem 1 and I don't have an A. The questions on exams are super confusing and worded strangely and ALEKS was super annoying. All I can say is if you have to take this class, Rich from Study Edge is your new best friend.

If you do not have a strong chemistry background, I would not recommend this class. Since it is online, you do have to teach yourself everything. Also, some of the online work and textbook readings do not correlate, which gets frustrating.

This is not an easy class if you've never taken chem. Be prepared to teach yourself and/or go to tutoring. She does nothing to make the material more understandable. Google/ALEKS/StudyEdge and a LOT of hard work are the only reasons I passed. She is very organized, responsive, & grading criteria is clear. I will give her that. But this class sucks.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Class wasn't overall that hard. Enjoyed it, because Chemistry came easy to me. I never relied on the Professor and their class was usually not helpful. Didn't have issues with the class until I didn't do well on Exam 2. Highly recommend getting a tutoring service such as Study Edge which helped me more than I thought it would on Exam 3.

She wasn't as bad as I thought she was going to be. Whenever you have a question about something you post it to this blog-type website called Piazza.  On Piazza, either she or another student can answer your question. Most of the time whenever I had a question she answered it within two days. Her online lectures are boring  & not very informative.

I took her online Intro to Chemistry class Fall, everybody who took it over the summer were telling me not to because they said it was the worst class ever and it was so hard but honestly this was the easiest class ever and I maintained above a 100% the whole time.  There's like not that much work involved at all. I guess dont take it over summer

Decent class, one of the first ones I took at UF so it was more challenging then I expected. Professor is okay but since its an online class it was confusing to learn what was going on. Study edge was the only reason I got through the class and helped me get an A so I would definitely recommend that! I just used that to study and her old exams.

**Disclaimer: I hate chemistry with a passion** Took this class online knowing I wouldn't enjoy it. Lecture videos were pretty unhelpful. She is not very organized, and often goes over irrelevant material in greater depth than the stuff you HAVE TO know. I didn't think the class was hard, but she certainly didn't make it bearable.

Literally taught myself chemistry for a whole semester this class is a complete waste of time. If you're going to take it at all I recommend taking it over summer b or something because this just felt tedious and wasteful. Her lecture are very robotic and the assignments that do help you understand are worth 2% of your grade.

Nightmare course.  Be prepared to teach yourself Chemistry.  The online textbook was boring and obnoxious.  She gives you so many work intensive assignments, but they mean so little in terms of your grade.  She has short ten minute power points.  I stopped watching them they were so pitiful.  The grading scale is a life saver.  Avoid this course!!!

If a student asks her a question, she almost always responds with something like "Talk to the tech team, that's not my job" or "Go look in the syllabus."  Her lectures are long and boring and she rambles about irrelevant things.  Although there is a Q&A board set up, she never gave direct, helpful answers to students' questions.

I have nothing positive to say about Prof. Viege. She posts YouTube videos for you to watch, posts homework, and sends out rude messages. I can't believe she gets paid for what she does. I learned from the textbook. Absolutely awful. Do not recommend.

I took this class to prepare myself for Chem 1, but I learned nothing. The most useful lecture videos were ones the professor posted that linked to YouTube videos, so I had to rely on the textbook to learn anything. You have to make a collage every week--it's a ton of busy work. Whenever anyone asked her a question, the prof was short and rude.

You have to put work to get a good grade in this class. Which means reading the textbook and doing the online assignments. There are a ton of little assignments that can help you if you fail a couple of tests .  The professor is pretty helpful. She is very approachable and welcomes questions and class participation.

I took this online class because I had to and I hated it. Seriously  take CHM1025 in class not online, here you will learn nothing. As long as you do your homework and other assignments you'll at least pass. However, Viege is a really bad at explaining things and is very unhelpful.

Pretty easy course, however his lectures are not engaging at all and he barely interacts with the class. I did poorly in the class simply because I couldn't pay attention, but any normal student can pass with an easy A. Gives a ton of extra credit but its just not worth his mandatory lectures.
Great teacher, interesting topic. Didn't add a lot to make the lectures engaging but the class was alright.

loved him. especially for quest, it was the easiest class ive ever taken. the good thing is he doesnt have a final either (we have final projects but they didnt take more then a few hours to complete), but take whatever you wish with that information

Very easy Quest 1 class. Lectures are optional (most of class does not go) and not needed to do well on the Canvas quizzes. They have some good information if you're interested in the topic, but can be a snooze fest if not. No exams. The major grades in the class are projects: 2 individual and 1 group. Would 100% recommend.

I took Quest 1 Human Shelter Development.The class was pretty easy, 3 projects that aren't difficult, a discussion and open-note quiz every 2 weeks, and optional in-class assignments. Attendance wasn't manadatory but the lectures aren't recorded. However, I do recommend going to class because the lectures are interesting. He was great & so cool!!

Professor Von Meding was great! He is very knowledgeable and passionate about what he teaches. If you have the chance to take him for Quest 1, I would highly recommend doing so, especially over the summer. Guidelines were super clear and all the TAs were awesome. 10/10 would recommend.

An amazing (and very easy) option for a Quest 1 class. Even though you aren't required to go to class, it's honestly interesting material. There are a couple projects but honestly all are pretty simple. Just be aware that the final project is a group, so be scouting out people you'd want to work with during the year (benefit of going to class).

Dr. Von Meding is an amazing professor! I took him for my quest 1 class during summer B. He's extremely caring and he really wants you to learn and succeed in his course. The workload also isn't super bad especially for the whole course being complete in 6 weeks! Make sure you have a good group for your big group project and you'll be set.
Amazing professor, would take again!

Best professor EVER!!!! I had such a great experience, he cares about you and your grade. attendance isn't mandatory but its good to show up there's occasionally classwork. I would recommend to everyone for quest 1

I was just randomly put in this class to fulfill my quest requirement, but I was really surprised by how interesting this class was. The lectures were pretty interesting, he didn't care about attendance, and he was honestly just a cool dude. 10/10 would recommend if you need a quest 1.

TAKE THIS CLASS AS YOUR QUEST 1. Super easy, lots of extra credit available (oftentimes your attendance), discussion-based, interactive learning, some group projects. Choose a good group for your group projects for sure. A short writing assignment and 20 Q quiz are due at the end of the week, but are easy to breeze through. Luv Prof Von Meding.

great quest 1!! the lectures were clear and the ppts are all you need for the module quizzes. proff is very passionate about the subject and listens to everyone's opinions in class, the discussion topics are interesting, and there are loads of extra credit opportunities. 2 papers, 1 project, and little assignments are a nice balance!!

I took BCN1582 International Sustainable Development with him. Von Meding is a smart and passionate person and I always enjoyed discussions and lectures with him. Homework and tests are fun, pretty light and the TAs give excellent feedback. It's a very nice course  with some building tours with a very nice professor.

this was a great quest 1, highly recommend. my ta was pretty strict grader, but not bad to keep an A. always ready to help and provide good feedback for anything. the group projects and essays were a bit annoying, but that just a quest 1. no exams, you can also pretty much get away with only going to class a handful of times

Great quest class and pretty easy A. In the summer semester you could get by without attending most  classes. TA grades kinda strict though she kept taking off points for designs. Would def recommend for quest.

If you are looking to take a Quest 1 take Shelter Development with Dr. Von Meding. This is the best quest class I could've ever taken. There aren't actual exams only weekly 20 question quizzes on canvas which are based on the slides he presented during lectures. BTW attendance isn't mandatory and the slides are posted on Canvas. PLEASE TAKE THIS!!!

This was a great quest class to take. The professor is very chill and approachable. The lectures were somewhat boring, but you can definitely get away with watching the lectures through zoom or missing them occasionally. The TA grades somewhat harshly, but it isn't difficult to get an A overall.

Really nice guy who is super accommodating. TAs grade to the rubric, so follow it closely and you'll be fine. His voice is really quiet and soothing so you'll want to fall asleep. Assignments and projects are easy, especially if you have good group members. You can get away with skipping and barely skimming the readings.

Dr. Von Meding is a great professor, his quest course is very interesting and overall easy. There are three main projects and all are very doable. The TA grades kind of strictly but as long as you follow the rubric it'll be ok. I totally recommend this class and professor.

Prof. is amazing, caring, lenient, and chill. The class is super easy and just need to pay some attention in class/ read modules to pass quizzes. Lectures are a kind of boring though. There is only 3 big assignments in the class worth lots of points. Lots of group discussions and activities. One of the easiest quest 1 you can take.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Meding was a good professor, but his voice was somewhat boring at times and the class setup did not help, as I had to basically seat with my back turned to him 2/3 of the class period.

Very easy (everyone gets an A even if you don't do all the work) and personable. He can be super strict but just gives off good vibes and energy. Class is just talking about books he likes. Some stopped going after a while but I found his classes useful he just has attitude but no aptitude

Dr. Hero is an amazing professor! He's the best ever in history of Florida men! I loved going to his class and hearing the music!! Dr. Hero is best DJ since Tiesto! What a wonderful person. I went to every class just to listen to the music. Greatest of all time professor and a real A+ human. He even offered to buy me a book he's great professor Dr.

Not sure why he has any negative reviews, this was one of my favorite classes and my favorite professor. This class was super helpful but not overwhelming at all. His lectures were very fun and he's very understanding, and he brought treats for us sometimes! I would take any of his classes in a heartbeat.
Dr. DH has been my favorite professor so far at UF! You can tell he cares about his students and really enjoys teaching.

Professor del Hierro is a master at disappearing acts—especially when it comes to emails. Need clarification on an assignment? Good luck! By the time he replies (if he ever does), the semester will be over. Communication is clearly not his superpower, so don't expect much unless you have a carrier pigeon handy.

He is very kind and understanding. I enjoyed the project-based nature of the class and actually ended up gaining super useful skills and connections, such as a connection to the Director of Medical Humanities at UF COM from a podcast project we were assigned. I love how we were able to tailor the class to our own interests/aspirations in this way.
Terribly unprepared teacher
Very judgmental. Gives the impression he didn't do the readings for his own class...

Dr. DH is an amazing professor. I had him for a Quest class titled Adaptations. We would watch a movie in class every other week and discuss it on Friday. He is very flexible with due dates and assignments. He truly cares about you and your future at not only UF, but life as a whole. 10/10 guy. Don 't think I'll ever have a better professor.

Dr. Del Hierro is the best professor I've had. He made it a priority to make class fun and not stressful. He is also very accommodating of any situation and is willing to be flexible. As for the course, he strove to make it the easiest class on our schedule. Best Quest 1 experience I've heard of.

Very thoughtful and supportive professor, will work to your strengths and encourage you to participate to the best of your ability. Makes the course material -no matter how complicated or unorthodox - accessible and interesting. I can say with full confidence that Dr. Del Hierro embodies all the qualities of a great teacher!
Very easy class just participate graded on a few assignments but graded easy. Love this prof a great addition to any degree
Just an overall amazing professor. Very gracious with extensions for assignments and is willing to provide feedback on drafts.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Amazing!
Love Del Hierro. Took him for hypermedia and the projects were fun and taught me how to edit and speak better. Would recommend 10/10 . Very nice. As long as you put in work, easy A.
Good professor and pretty funny guy. Class is interested and also easy, and he will even admit that. Easy A but you will still come out of the class with new knowledge. Would recommend him!
Can't say much about him I had 0% interaction. The course tests are pretty difficult. So much reading I had a hard time keeping up and staying engaged. It's basically READ, READ, READ, TEST!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Showed no interest in his students, only emailed when he made mistakes, had his teacher's assistant do everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Vining is an amazing teacher and his lectures are very informative. Highly recommend taking this course!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The tests are FIVE HOURS LONG! Study, study, study and don't try to hold a job while you take this professor. He expects a lot and delivers little. He never even spoke to us the entire class except to ask for forgiveness when his modules were not uploaded properly.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He seems nice enough but he doesn't participate very much at all. I feel like he needs a lot more experience. Lots of work and slow grading, he isn't the one that grades. The videos were inaccessible, I mean I even wondered if there were videos at all or if it was just his PowerPoint?
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: He never shows up! He doesn't respond in a reasonable time and changes your grades after you rate him for evals so you will give him a good rating. His teacher's assistant does everything. He is prideful and lacking compassion.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Since this is an asynchronous course you don't hear much from him unless you need to. There is one quiz due each week and that makes up the majority of your grade. The class is open note and book which is why you should watch the lectures. He takes a long time to grade papers and the written exams but he isn't a difficult grader.

Prof Vining was great! The class was fairly easy and there's extra credit. Prof helped me with a civil rights problem that arose outside of class, which I am extremely thankful for. Lectures and one quiz per week, few assignments, and two exams with essay questions and multiple choice. Most of the content in the exam was covered in lectures.

10/10 recommend. 85-90% of the information on quizzes & exams comes from his lectures! They are powerpoint with voiceover, max length of 20 mins, & don't have to necessarily listen-just read. Weekly quizzes, 2 exams, & a few other assignments. Super nice & understanding guy, definitely would take his courses in the future.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class is interesting but exams are HARD!! Read the textbook and reread your class notes every day. 80% of the exam is straight from his lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This was a super super easy Latin class (I took it back in 2023, forgot to rate her) but she was amazing and so funny. She's also super understanding.
I highly recommend her conspiracy theory class, it was so much fun. It's super easy, especially if you show up to class.
Dr. Pagan is literally so nice, I love her. She tells the funniest stories and she's very down to earth, but she was literally UF's teacher of the year last year, so she knows her stuff.

Dr. Pagan is the absolute best. I've taken tons of classes with her, and she does a great job keeping people engaged. Her topics are always really interesting, too -- she doesn't teach boring classes like "Roman History" or "Latin Literature." She's taught classes on sports in Ancient Greece, conspiracy theory in classics, and Gardening! How fun!

Dr Pagan will always do her best to make you enthusiastic about anything she's teaching, but is honest with you about what she thinks and is hilarious. She's kind and super understanding about any issues you're having, especially if she can see you're willing to put in effort. Always highly recommend her class -- if she's teaching it, take it.

dr. pagan is the sweetest. gardens to read and visit is a great quest 1. few assignments and she's an easy grader. she accepts late work ("docks points for it" but i've never gotten anything but an A). she brought us cupcakes for her birthday. she genuinely cares about students and makes an effort to talk to everyone individually. i adore her!!!

I took Gardens to Read and Visit (Quest 1)! 100% recommend this quest 1. Assigned weekly readings but not necessary + she gives outlines. Take some notes for essays. She is one of the kindest professors I have ever met...she'll help you whenever she can. Great O.H. and field trips. 
If this is available and she's not on sabbatical TAKE IT!!

Dr. Pagan is very tenderhearted and funny. The class has a lot of reading but it really isn't necessary because there are note outlines. The rubrics are very clear. The field trips were so much fun and this class was a great social opportunity. However, lectures were too long, often off-topic, and useless. TA sessions felt like a waste of time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Took class in summer B. Overall the class was great and very insightful. Personally believe that the lectures aren't necessary (the sections with TAs are better discussion), but she shares stories which are fun to hear. Lots of field trips but they are fun. Won't be bored in class and as long as you do the work you can get an A. She is amazing

Dr. Pagan is my absolute favorite teacher, I took her for Gardens. Her lectures are fun and she is super funny and caring! Attendance is mandatory, but she's nice about waiving absences if you are sick etc. There is lots of reading, but you can get away without reading some. There is only one essay, but the TA grades everything which I didn't love.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Wow would I take another class by her again if I could. She loves to lecture about what she is passionate about and her kooky, funny, lighthearted attitude made her class one of my favorites. You have to read a lot in Gardens to Read and Visit but I know people could get away with sparknotes for some materials. Assignments are easy and fun.

Dr. Pagan is SO AWESOME. Very kind and approachable and engaging. Also an amazing teacher and really good at making difficult material easy to understand. If you come to class and put in work, this class is not too difficult as it seems and she makes it very fun and worth your time.

Kind and understanding (got sick and emailed her and she excused me), she explained the material well and always made herself available. Class was engaging, low-stress, and easy to pass; refreshing, somewhat interesting content. It was fun to tour campus this way and discover the gardens. Reading does get tedious sometimes, but it's not terrible.

Amazing professor, I had her for my Gardens Quest class and it was my favorite class I've taken at UF so far. Super kind and funny, assessed what she taught, and taught what she assessed (her saying). Really enjoyed the literature she chose for us to read and the field trips to gardens and Harn Museum. Would 100% take a class from her again.

Her gardens quest is the best! We took field trips, readings and discussions were genuinely interesting, and assignments were sparse and easy. Attendance is graded but you'll honestly want to attend. Do the readings for class though, otherwise class will be awkwardly silent.

Probably the best quest course offered at the school, bar none. She encourages discussion, and all the assigned readings were genuinely really interesting. Attendance is mandatory, but frankly, you will look forward to attending. You will go on class trips to gardens and a museum. Will be the least stressful class in your schedule, easily. Take it.

I had her for conspiracy theories last semester and I recommend this class to anyone even remotely interested in the classics. If you're an exploratory major, she'll have converted you by the end. She assesses what she teaches and teaches what she assesses. Not a lot of work and talks the class through every assignment. Also attendance is graded.

She is clearly a knowledgeable professor who cares about her topic. Lectures are not as dynamic as they could be, are too slow and dumbed-down, some of the readings are rather useless considering the real aim of the course and the course itself is a hollowed-out shell of what it used to be. A kind professor who is always happy to see everyone.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Sitting in one of her lectures right now! I love watching her take something she is passionate about and go. She's also hysterical, and much respect for being a Navy veteran. Would take her again if I could.
She is super enthusiastic and genuinely cares about the subject matter, even in the mandatory Good Life Class. She is even more active than the students during discussions!
She's very cool and understanding. She loves to interact with her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Pretty good at lecturing.
She learns your name very quickly

I love Dr. Pagan, she's super personable and really cares about you passing her class and learning something. Weekly quizzes, she won't move to the next chapter if the class average is below 80. Always found ways to aid our studying. Homework seemed mundane but helpful. Need to study though, it is a language class. CLA2120 was super easy, one essay

She is very passionate about her work, and tries to make class as interesting as possible. The only problem that I have is that she likes to assign busy work that doesn't even count as a grade. I would have much rather spent the time in class learning more of the Roman history, than pointless activities that didn't increase my understanding at all.

She is nice and helpful, but i didn't really enjoy the class. She was new, and she was really passionate about the work but her lectures weren't in depth and she really used every story that we had to read.
I had her for good life, she is very nice and helpful but your TAs grade everything so kissing up to her does not help.
Dr. Pagan is great! Very interesting class and lecturer. Her tests are fair and straightfoward. Had a great time in class.

This is my favorite class this semester. She's so funny and her lectures are always interesting and useful. Her tests are very straight-forward and she doesn't try to trick you. She actually tells you exactly what they cover. I thoroughly enjoyed this class...just know that you have to read the plays to get along in the semester.
Such a great teacher! I can't wait to take more of her classes.  She's funny and helpful and makes everyone feel welcome.
Pagan is amazing. She will teach you so much.
Dr. Pagan is very demanding but reasonable. She is fantastic!

Dr. Pagan's class is the highlight of my week (despite the early hour).  She is DEMANDING, BUT REASONABLE, and my Latin and research skills get better every time she opens her mouth.  I would recommend her classes to anyone serious about his/her studies.

AWESOME professor!! Dr Pagan is one of the best teachers I've had. She makes her lectures very enjoyable. There is always something to learn from her. I totally recommend her as a professor. Very professional and some times funny =D  I learned LOTS in her class!!

When I was in this class with Dr. Pagan, I thought it was only okay, but now that I've moved on to harder classes I realize HOW MUCH she taught me!  I really owe a lot to this class and to Dr. Pagan!  She is so good at explaining complex sentences or syntax, and you WILL learn (or relearn) grammar with her.  She's amazing.  Take her Latin classes!!

Super capable and certainly knows her stuff: she is awesome.  I don't think it is possible for her to open her mouth without teaching you SOMETHING interesting.  You can tell that Pagan tries really hard to keep the lectures interesting.  She can be a little strict, but go to class and stay on her good side and it will be an enjoyable experience.

I thought the class would be completely BORING, but Pagan is an amazing teacher and I'm so happy to have taken a class with her. I am taking more Latin courses just so I can take a translation class with her!
The only thing I hated about the class was the lexicography, but I loved the class and everything else. Pagan is a great teacher and this class was worth all the work.

An excellent, excellent teacher. Although she assigns a decent amount of homework, it's only to get through the material in time. She is exceptionally supportive and helpful in her teaching, and definitely one of the best teachers I've ever had. DEFINITELY get her as a teacher if you have the chance.

This is for CAI4104 MLE. Great class, but for me it was as much work and as hard as OS. Exams are intense on memorization. Lectures are high quality and you will learn a lot. The homework teaches you well but they are HARD. Caveat, didn't know Python so I lost time debugging silly mistakes. If you want a huge jumpstart into ML, take this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This review is for CAI4104-ML Engineering. Very knowledgeable professor, asks great questions during lectures and clearly understands the material well. Class had 5 HWs, some were easy and some had to spend 12+ hours on. Frustrating since feedback on the last 3 came near finals week. Intense exams, take notes during lectures and use those to study.
really hard to keep up with lectures unless you study really hard isn't going to let you go easy with exams
exams are tough not easy to get through without studying day and night
hard to follow up if you arent attentive in class, not a easy grader teaches well tho

He was knowledgeable, helpful, and explained the topics well. He went over numerous practice problems and exercises, and really did his best to help students learn. Everything about this class was reasonable. The tests were tough but the projects were realistic.
He gives nice lectures and easy-to-follow projects.
Amazing professor. I learned a lot in his class. His instructions were clear even though some assignments were rough. He is very caring about his students and will help anyone in need. Def reccomend.

One of the most organized professors.
The only issue was delayed feedback on my assignments. It is almost end of semester and I have not received grades for 4/9 submissions (That is on TAs mostly though, not the professor). Course is easy and teaches you a lot

One of the most organized professors in the department. Informative class with very useful lectures and coding assignments.  Just the right amount of difficulty, too. Highly recommended if you're at all interested in ML.

Dr. Bindschaedler does a very good job at teaching applied ML without making it a ton of work. He covers higher level concepts on a lower level for students and doesn't go into any complex math. For the course description, "Applied" ML, he does a great job since it teaches mostly how to use and apply SK-learn and Tensorflow. Overall great course.
Amazing professor, very good at teaching. Breaks things down into chunks, very clean slides, stops to ask questions and make you think. Very good class for anyone remotely interested in ML.

Getting A is easy if you put in the work, Trustworthy ML is not an easy course but professor teaches really well. Professor solves the silliest of your doubts. Beware of the final exam it was a little tough.

Applied ML. Excellent professor, definitely one of the best I've had at UF; probably my favorite class I've taken so far. If you're interested in machine learning at all, definitely take it with him. He's a natural at teaching/lecturing and conveying concepts clearly. Exams were just the right difficulty. Learned a lot and all of it was practical.

Applied ML. His lectures are very engaging and interesting. He stops to ask questions often, both about the material and if students need help. The homework and exams weren't hard at all but I still learned a lot. Perfect introduction to machine learning.

Great professor, cares about students. Assignments take a couple of hours to do but if you watch his Exercise lecture, you should have an easy time. Tests are incredibly easy, go through his powerpoints and you should be good.

HE IS NOT RECOMMENDED AT ALL FOR EDUCATION!
 AVOID HIM EVEN IF IT"S YOU'RE LAST CLASS IN THE DEGREE.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Valle's Bayesian statistics class is quite involving, but it is also very rewarding.

This class was difficult to keep up. As a graduate student you already have so much work to do and this class expects you to have a pop-quiz at 8.30am every week (open book luckily), you have to submit discussion questions on sunday night and it takes the whole week to work through a homework set due on friday.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class is tough. Attack the work early as you're really at the mercy of message boards for help with codes. He is not understanding if you need help,No leniency so don't even ask. Set a few hours aside MWF for concept quizzes, data quizzes, and actual quiz time, and take the class with someone you can call with Qs. Quizzes are tough but openbk.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Stats class had good content. Difficult to understand his accent and also not very understanding of others problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: ALS5932 is a great class. Dr. Valle is able to present complex ideas in a simple and straight-forward way. Look forward to more of his courses.
Dr. Valle was very helpful when I had questions about using RStudio or about the course material.
This class is very difficult. Assigned readings are long quizzes are obscure and homework assignments are vague are made harder than necessary.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Vasquez was incredibly kind and supportive. As an online student, I appreciated how easy he was to contact. Even if I was getting some points taken off, he made it clear what he wanted to see improvement on. The course was engaging, not overwhelming. Highly recommend this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Vazquez is great for Theatre Appreciation. I took the class online, and the work was very light. You could easily use ChatGPT for the whole course and get a 95+. Only reason not to get an A is if you forget to do the work, and the work is very easy to do. Quizzes are also online on canvas and there's no final exam, making them open note!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took this class for my gen ed credit. The class was super easy and pretty interesting. Most of the grading is done by TAs and the quizzes are a little specific at times. Overall pretty easy course. The professor ended up dropping the lowest quiz and discussion post at the end of the semester. The final was a super easy project.

Took this class over Summer B and was honestly pretty simple and interesting. I'm not a theatre major but the different plays were very interesting and made the assignments enjoyable and easy to get through. Grading was very clear and TA's would respond and grade fairly quickly. Def recommend if you need a humanities/diversity credit or for fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: This was an online class, so there was little collaboration/conversation. Course was easy if you read material, grades come in fast (usually after 2 days) and are very lenient. I had a 98.5 or something, so very easy. Teacher was kind, assignments had detailed instructions. I like theatre (not my major), I enjoyed the readings, may not be for all.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Online Savvy

reviews.comment: BEST CHEM 2 PROF!!!!! He's so nice and has a greater demeanor. That said, you should definitely read the textbook/watch yt videos or else lectures didn't make sense and a lot of classmates struggled on exams. At very least write down the practice problems before lecture since he goes through those fast. Everyone wanted to take more classes with him

Veige is passionate about the subject but it's easy to get behind if you don't keep up with lecture and also do the recommended textbook practice problems (i used studyedge) because nothing is required in this class other than the exams and quizzes. There's optional worksheets given in discussion, attendance not required, and he's pretty laid back.

Amazing professor. Engaging and respectful. Explains everything with background, asks for feedback, and tells us the types of questions we could encounter about each unit. Answers emails quickly. Sweet guy, cares about his students and their understanding. Attendance not mandatory but helps a lot. Highest chem grade I've gotten.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Best chem professor I've ever had. I used to consider chemistry the hardest subject; earned 100 on an exam & 96 on the final; owe it ALL to Dr. Veige. Engaging, respectful, never boring. His lectures are clear, & he takes time to explain everything/ask for feedback. Responds to emails within a day. Makes jokes in class & gives real-world examples.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class was so hard. He was such a bad lecturer towards the end that I just stopped going and self-studied. Office hours were useless when I went because he would just argue about a problem students genuinely struggled with. It was like he didn't care if we didn't completely understand a concept. Sure he's funny sometimes, but I wish I had Hale.

Dr. Veige is not the best lecturer, he often gets side tracked and sometimes refuses to answer specific questions. To be successful in this class, you definitely want to read the textbook and do all the textbook problems. I would also recommend doing study edge videos before the lectures so you can understand the concepts beforehand.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: How are you going to look at your students and say “I didnt solve this problem but this answer LOOKS correct” and then refuse to believe the 5 students (who actually did the problem) telling you the answer is wrong? That was the last day I went to class because this is outrageous. Just self study using the text book.

The content is pretty hard, and the PowerPoints are not fully representative of what you're supposed to know on the exam. You'll definitely need to use the textbook or any other external sources. I recommend watching the videos attached on canvas. He doesn't use the textbook for any homework but it's recommended that you read it. He's so sweet.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The course is very difficult but Professor Veige works to make it clear and answers any questions as simply as possible. Make sure to ask questions as he may not explain everything you need to know until students start asking questions. The problem sets are not representative of what is on the exam so focus on any old exams when preparing.

Dr. Veige is my favorite professor at UF! If you have the chance to take him I highly recommend you do because he has a lot of knowledge to impart on you. His office hours are always a delight and he can talk about anything with you. He inspired me to go to grad school in chemistry because that's where my passion lies.

Dr. Veige managed to make a seemingly boring and difficult subject kind of enjoyable. He is personable, funny, and really cares about his students. However, it is in no way an easy class so definitely recommend going to his office hours to work on problem sets. One of my favorite professors at UF for sure though.

Took this class in Spring of 2023 and the class was split into two sections. Veige covered quantum theory and his explanations were great but material is hard. He didn't focus too much an extraneous detail but if you were curious about a topic he would explain. He made it very clear what would be on the tests. HW due once a week but very useful.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Veige taught with Cao this semester, and anyone is better than Cao, so Veige was great in comparison. His PPTs are structured well and are good to review. He goes over practice problems quickly in class, but they are fully written out on the PPTs. There is not a lot of homework. StudyEdge and third-party practice problems were essential for me.

Dr. Veige is very knowledgeable about chemistry, and his lectures are pretty good, but he does get off topic quite a bit. He does not have a lot of homework, and his tests are pretty difficult. Use study edge and rely on office hours or your TA.

I took Dr. Veige's class the first semester of my freshmen year. His Canadian accent is enjoyable to listen to during lecture and he is a funny man who cares about his students. His PowerPoint slides follow directly with the textbook, making it great to read ahead prior to lecture. Use practice problems at end of each chapter, and exams will be ez.
Dr Veige was very clear in explaining the chemistry topics, however, I wished he would have explained the examples more thoroughly rather than just showing them with the PowerPoint.

He was an amazing lecturer and an overall great guy. He made sure we understood the material before we moved on which made us get behind for the whole semester. His exams were very fair and Study edge was a necessity. The first exam is the easiest so make sure to study to boost your grade. The 2nd exam is hard so don't procrastinate. GET STUDY EDGE

Veige was a very middle of the road professor. He was fair and way more lenient than Cao when it came to the rigor of the course. Nevertheless, I still think that his lectures were not very helpful nor reflective of the exam and I would recommend study edge and self-teaching as a better resource.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Respected

reviews.comment: Professor Veige was an incredible professor. He's slow and deliberate in his explanations, which made studying very easy for me because I understood everything. He keeps his explanations simple and uses relevant examples. He's also a genuinely nice and accessible person who wants to help his students succeed.
Professor Veige was very good at making complex topics simple. He was very repetitive and clear about the content you were learning.

He puts on PowerPoint slides and points with a laser. Hard to follow along since he goes over chemistry calculations that trail off onto other slides. Ended up dropping the class. To be successful read the textbook and practice textbook problems. All the exams had mistakes in multiple questions. Worst class I have ever taken.

He's honestly been my least favorite professor at UF, because the concepts make no sense in class, and make way more sense when I learn them at home. He rarely every puts out his own questions, so you don't know how his test will be. DO NOT TAKE HIM.

Though very knowledgeable in the field of Chemistry, he does not convey concepts in a manner relevant to course assignments and exams. He tends to assume that students know complex concepts that (unless you took AP Chemistry and/or UF chemistry) you probably do not know. I recommend sticking to the Aleks textbook for this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Veige is a really funny guy and seems like he genuinely cares about his students. He tries hard to explain the concepts in the powerpoints, and his tests are very very fair and only include material that was taught. I wish we had more practice problems that we did together as a class though. If you study and use study edge you'll be fine.

I have gotten an A or A- in CHM2045 with Summner and an A in CHM1025 with Held. If 0 was an option I would give him a 0 because he does not even deserve a 1. I remember reading these ratings before I took his class but convinced myself I would be fine. Study Edge cannot save you nothing will. Take my warning seriously or fail your choice, good luck

Dr. Veige was good at explaining chemistry using everyday examples. His teaching style was helpful, however I wish he did the problems on the board instead of just pointing to a PowerPoint with the answer. I relied mainly on Study Edge to get review videos, as the professor did not provide any. You definitely need to save time for studying.

I took 3610 with Drs. Veige and Murray this last fall, and I thought that Dr. Veige was excellent in his ability to make quantum effects easy to understand without delving into the math behind it. He is funny, relaxed, and will test fairly.

Inorganic chemistry is probably the hardest class I've ever taken, but Veige made it doable. He explains everything so well that I actually ended up enjoying the class! He's very straightforward, charismatic, and personable. The class is tougher on Murray's end so just know it gets better once Veige takes over. Still hard though.

I haven't had an exam from his material yet, but I really enjoy his lectures. He makes sure to answer every single question you ask in detail. So far, so good. I enjoy his part way more than prof. Murray's in the same course.
probably one of the worst lecturers I have ever had, he goes all over the place & over complicates; should not be teaching at all

Cannot say how much I hated this class. One of the most stressful classes I've ever taken. Talham and Veige teaching at the same time made the class unpredictable and impossible to study for. When they swap off and you go to office hours, there's a good chance the other one has no clue what you're talking about because he didn't teach it.

Veige is helpful with the content during office hours. However, the exams in this course felt like they were written to trick students so his help did not improve my grade. The material was presented differently in lecture than it was presented on the exams which was extremely frustrating. I felt like I couldn't do anything right in his class.

Veige is a nice man and he is willing to help and all but his exams are way different than his teachings. He does not prepare you for the exams. Exams are ridiculously hard. An A is possible but it requires luck and way too much work EVEN FOR AN A. If you're stuck with him, commit yourself and don't let him win.

If you want your GPA to suffer, this is the BEST CLASS TO TAKE! Dr. Veige's chem 2 is such a nightmare, it's hard to describe. Dr. Veige is cocky, arrogant, and it is clear that he doesn't give a hoot about your performance. He provides little to no guidance when it comes to preparing for exams, which are impossible. SAVE YOURSELF AND YOUR DIGNITY!

Chem 2 with Dr. Veige can be described simply as a "train wreck". He is cocky, and his arrogance is clear with his exams that are designed to be near impossible. The class average for one exam was a 60% and he blamed that average on students not studying hard. Believe me when I tell you if you want an A in chem 2, stay far away from him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This is the professor, where you can't study enough for their exams. You have to worry about how they could trick you and try to prepare for that. If you are pre-med and looking to get an A, any of the other CHM2046 professors are better.

This class was very difficult, I left every exam feeling defeated even using study edge and studying a week a lot. His exams are tricky and nothing like the questions you see in class. Get study edge and it will help but he is a difficult professor.

I enjoyed Prof. Veige's class. His lectures are helpful for the exams and he is clear when he speaks. He is always willing to answer students questions during lecture. His class is very test/quiz heavy as there is no homework to buffer your grade. I would recommend study edge to help prepare for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Veige is very fair, but inorganic chemistry is a VERY hard course. Tests are very straightforward. Very funny guy, pay attention in lecture. The material builds on itself, so if you get behind, it will be veryyy hard to catch up.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great Professor! Exams are hard but you will be prepared well. It is a tough class, however, I ended up receiving and A through going to lectures and attending study edge reviews. The combination of both definitely guaranteed success

Dr. Veige is one of the best professors I've had at UF. Inorganic concepts aren't too easy, however, Veige tests fairly. I've heard of inorgo professors testing so hard the class averages are 40-50s. Veige's test averages are in the B- to B+ range. Veige tests on what he teaches. Also, he doesnt like dumb questions(aka read your book)

Veige is a very smart and cocky professor. He is however a good one who makes plenty of funny jokes. He teaches the basic frameowrk, but in order to do well on tests and quizzes, you HAVE to study and do MANY practice problems. Study edge helped a lot. Doable for sure, but not without work (can't stress that for Veige enough).

Dr. Veige's class was very challenging but doable if you put in the work. Do the problem sets in the back of the book, they are very helpful for the quizzes and the exams. He is also hilarious and makes the lectures as enjoyable as they can be for chemistry. He explains the material well but practice is a must.
This class is really difficult. There is no homework, only quizzes and exams. I've heard that taking this class with Toth is much more doable. However, Veige is a really nice and funny guy.

Chemistry is hard. Period. But at UF, I think this is the best Chem teacher as far as teaching/lecturing skills. The pros are that he is funny and teaches well, the con is that his quizzes and tests are very difficult. STUDY STUDY STUDY. He doesn't give homework so you have to give yourself it. If you try hard and you'll get a rewarding A.
He is a good guy but the class is hard. He doesn't give out a lot of study material so you have to get it from other teachers or just use the book.

This class is difficult, but that's just because college level Chemistry is difficult in general. He puts effort into teaching which says a lot. Try to use as many supplemental material as possible like old practice tests, Study Edge, and your TAs. You actually have to understand the material tod o well in the class (what a surprise!)

Dr. Veige is very difficult.  There is no possible way to get an A in his class without genuinely learning inorganic chemistry.  You have to study frequently, try to follow along with the book and KNOW the problem sets he gives you.  His tests are very challenging and he is very hard, but again (as someone else said) he communicates this clearly.
The final exam was nearly impossible, but that was the only negative aspect. Very good teacher. Very good.
Going to lecture will prepare you for quizzes, but NOT the exams. Only one of the three exams, in my opinion, were fair, and the final was ridiculous.

His class is challenging but doable. Do all the practice problems from the end of the chapters and go to class and you will be fine. Don't be scared of Veige he is a very nice guy and will help you if you ask.

He refused to help me when I asked him and his exams were hard. He threw in a lot of tricks that I didn't think were really fair. At this point, I may have to drop this class. Therefore, you should probably take it with Martin because I hear he is VERY easy.
Great Professor! Good sense of humor and keeps the subject very interesting. Class is difficult and requires countless hours of studying and his test are pretty challenging, so be prepared.

Much too smart to be teaching!  A very nice guy and always helping, but like the above comments, gets flustered when you dont get it.  Tests are HARD HARD HARD.  Overall, unless you are a genius, wait and take it with Dr. Scott.
This professor was excellent.  He explained concepts very and was always enthusiastic about class
loved this professor!! he was so funny and very nice. very clear lecturer and his tests were pretty fair! i would take him again if i had the choice!

Really great professor. I actually enjoyed going to class. He explains the concepts really well. He really seems to love teaching, and keeps your attention by throwing in funny comments or stories. But the final sucks....study!

Martin is a more competent teacher for 2046. Veige at times even stated he "didn't want to be here" teaching. Thats when you know he's here for research, NOT teaching. It's almost as if teaching this class was a pain to him. Go to the TAs for help.
I would recommend Prof. Veige to anyone.  He's clear and concise and makes chemistry easy to understand.

Took him for chm 2, he is funny and explains the material very well. the tests aren't that easy (class average is usually a b or c), but he is always willing to clarify anything, and he is a great teacher.
Amazing! i love this guy! Chemistry is, of course, no fun, but he is so funny and will keep u entertained during lecture.  I would get him if u can, he is a very good teacher and a very nice guy :)

Veige was a great professor. His expectations are high, but he communicates that clearly. Tests were difficult, but they focused on critical thinking...not memorization. If you're looking to learn something instead of simply ingest the words of a book, he's a great professor. If you're looking to read and regurgitate, his class is not for you.

Dr. Veige is not a good teacher and top of that his exams are nothing close to that taught in class or his homework. The TA's of this class were not very helpful either. Overall it was like a disaster!

Dr. Veige seems like a nice enough guy, but is not very helpful. He does not have any patience for undergrads and gets flustered easily if you don't understand. His favorite line is, "I can't help you with that." The material itself is not bad, but it makes it difficult when the prof doesn't do a good job teaching.

The sweetest professor you will ever find at UF! He is a lenient grader and does not ask for documentation for missed attendance. He truly cares and workload is light unless you fully read the readings every week (not necessary to do well). TAKE HIS CLASSES!!!!!

I cannot recommend this professor more! He is super flexible about absences and is very forward about what he expects and is leniant on grading. The class has a short weekly discussion post, two exams, one paper, and a presentation which sound way worse than they are! If I could take him again I would in a heartbeat!!

OH MY LORD THIS PROFESSOR IS AMAZING. PERIODT. One discussion post per week, about 100-150 words. Then you're also graded on a presentation, a paper, and a essay-based midterm and a final. This professor is the GOAT, ngl, and he also gives us the prompts a week before the exam date. TAKE HIS CLASSES RIGHT NOW

Lots of reading but never did any of it. Prof is chill, just make sure to raise hand at least every other day to ask a question for participation grade. Took over summer B. 2 papers, weekly mini-paper, participation grade (attendance graded), and group project you do on one of the 6 weeks. Paper prompts given week ahead of time. Easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Wang is the goat. He is really easy to talk to and made this class really interesting. He's a chill grader as long as you put in effort. The readings seem like a lot but as long as you understand the general concepts your good. I would def recommend this class!

What a king. He's new and clearly wants you to like him, which isn't hard because he's very likeable. Really encourages discussion and makes you feel smart. Lots of readings but he lectures on them, so you can skim. Tests are easy if you review the readings. Learned a lot, thought a lot, and I would gladly take another class of his.

Lecture was not mandatory, prerecorded lectures provided by the course coordinator were super helpful and accessible at all times. Expected people to be quiet in lecture and had dry humor, everything was graded by TAs. Content was not super difficult.

I enjoyed Professor Keeran's lectures, they weren't boring at all and I feel like attending lectures helped me do really well in the class. Exams are very similar to homework examples, and studying about a week in advance worked for me. I would definitely take another class with Professor Keeran.

Extremely boring and uninspired teacher. Most of the lectures he'd start by saying how much he hated teaching and in particular this course. Your time is better spent watching the online Shabazz lectures and going to her office hours. That's what made this course relatively easy.

Willard was one of the best proof teachers I have ever taken. I did not fully understand proofs until taking his course. If you pay attention in lecture, go to his office hours, and break down proofs/theorems given in the textbook you can pass this class with an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I was nervous about taking this class my first semester without MAC2312, but Dr. Keeran is a great lecturer with a good sense of humor. While the course had online lectures, he's very good at comprehensively deriving formulas/pictures rather than memorizing them. The exams aren't his, but are also very straightforward. Great professor.

He seemed very tired during the midday lecture. His lectures did not prepare you for the tests as Dr. Shabazz's lecture recordings do. He gets caught up on simple arithmetic and would be better off just showing problem setup like the other calc 3 professors at UF. Very strict, not engaging, and I found the online lectures more valuable. Homework!

Lectures/Online recordings are hard to understand and they skip material. The associated "textbook" and yt videos carried. Doing the HW, lecture quizzes, and practice tests were more than enough to do great on exams. Low time commitment but probably not the best content quality.
Great professor! Lectures were worded in a way that made very conceptual material manageable and easier to understand although the fourth module was pretty rough.

Doesn't know how to teach. Avoid taking him at all costs. Dropped him within a week and took the class with the goat Dr. John Streese. If you not going to lectures and your confident in your math abilities then it's fine cuz there's a lil bit of extra credit and the his homework is easier than the other profs.

Most of the content was introduced in the lectures, and then you would take a quiz in discussion. The difficulty of the quiz depends on the TA you get, but it's really just two questions and isn't that hard. The tests were what determined your whole grade, basically. Four tests, the final is cumulative, but it wasn't the hardest test that we took.

I was originally weary of taking Keeran after reading his reviews, but I truly enjoyed his course. He goes quickly through lectures, but explains material well. Weekly quizzes depend on TA. I highly recommend Study Edge for the class! It helped me with practice problems and a more in-depth understanding that we didn't have time to cover in class.
Great teaching style. Goes through material fast and yet explains every step of the processes. Would definitely take the class again.
Great professor. Don't skip lectures they are very important.

Keeran is honestly not bad. His explanations are confusing at times, but you can just watch Shabazz's lectures for those topics. Study, do practice exams, and show up to lecture, and you'll be fine. He goes quick, so be prepared for that. Super funny guy, too.
Kind of a hard class, make sure to study a LOT for tests but he does give a lot of review material and in lecture he is pretty good. Kind of depends on your TA and how hard your quizzes are.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Keeran is a very funny man. During his lectures, he writes every step, which is very helpful, and not many professors do that.
He explains everything really well, and he moves pretty fast through the material.
Very smart man but goes so fast, he also teaches Calc 3 and moves at that speed. I was never too good at calculus so I did not enjoy his teaching style.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Don't listen to everybody else, for calc 3 just show up to the lectures and listen and you will be fine. The concepts are pretty easy and the tests are on material that was covered in class. He is a good teacher that shows you derivation and takes his time to explain.

I took him for Calc 1, he was good at explaining things if you can keep up with a quick pace. There are past lectures posted that are useful if you miss a lecture or didn't quite understand it. He has a plethora of past exams to study that are great for the real exam. But there are very frequent quizzes and lots of weekly to daily homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He was nice but his lectures were very memorize heavy - you don't really learn the concepts very well and instead memorize ways to solve the various problems. The tests are very easy with practice tests posted that are exactly like the real thing, but I feel like I forgot everything already. Take if you want an easy class, not if you want to learn

Dr. Keeran is a great math professor. His lectures are great! They are fast-paced, so if you can't do a fast-paced math, then watch the lecture videos online. Speaking of which, he gives great resources on Canvas. Tests aren't terrible. Study, practice, go to lecture, and you'll do great.

Good professor overall. I did not find his lectures very useful, however he posts another professor's lectures which are more helpful. Homework and homework quizzes do not affect your grade too much and you can retry them as much as you would like. He also posts previous semester tests which are great to study off of. Grade depends on tests.
Lectures are easy to understand and he's a pretty engaging guy. He gives you all the materials you need to pass.

This guy honestly seems like he hates his job. He's clearly really good at math but does not know how to teach it. I'd stick to watching Shabazz's lecture videos at home on your own time as attendance is not mandatory.

PAY ATTENTION IN LECTURE!!! I cannot say this enough. Keeran gets a bad rap because professors like Streese are so good, but he's really not that bad. He's very helpful during office hours and funny with a dry sense of humor. The only problem with him is that he writes VERY fast during lecture. But pay attention and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I will start by saying I'm not the best at math. Dr. Keeran is a nice teacher and is definitely very funny. However, if you lose focus for a minute, you will have missed 7 new concepts. His lectures are fast-paced, and he mostly just goes through examples. In my experience, the practice tests were nothing like the exams (exams were much harder).

Keeran is an excellent professor for linear algebra. I'm not sure why people say it took them a while to realize exams are based on hw problems….he pretty much emphasizes this from the first day of class. He is very strict on grading hw but exams are a bit more lenient. If you do all suggested hw problems and GO TO LECTURE this class is doable.

Can't say anything bad about the guy, not the most enthusiastic but he does cover all the required content. Lectures are paraphrasing and explaining the textbook, but I mean mostly all classes are like that. The "optional homework" is not all that optional, 2 or 3 of the questions in the exam are based on it. I learned this until the last exam.

Mr. Keeran is the GOAT for Differential Equations. I actually wanted to go to lecture because he taught us in the way he would want to be taught. He kept the lectures interesting and paced things appropriately. Really nice dude, very happy I took him for Diff Eq.

I loved having him as a professor! If you go to office hours prepared, he is awesome and really helpful. He can go pretty quick but he reviews and always takes questions. Tests are hard even if you do the recommended problems, but he's willing to help if you show effort. Hard class, but a great professor to take it with if you're willing to work.

SO MUCH homework, but not Keeran's fault. As a department-controlled course, Keeran only controls how he lectures, and his lectures are easily the best of any MAP2302 professor. Explained all content clearly and with good examples, and was funny at times. Overall enjoyed his lectures, and looking forward to taking him again for MAS4105 this summer.
He was aight, just sometimes never finished lectures in class. Ended up just watching shabazz videos which arent the best. Overall though he isn't the worst, and taught well when he explained.

There are a lot of assigned homeworks and a few collected homeworks, and those are very important for your understanding. Prof Keeran makes that very clear and as long as you do the practice problems, practice tests, and take his feedback on your proofs seriously then you should be able to pass. This is a difficult class so expect difficult work.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Keeran is so so good. Would definitely take diff eq with him again. So helpful in office hours and always wanting to help during class

A tough grader when it comes to writing proofs but is not good at explaining proofs techniques and the proofs in linear algebra. He copies and reads off the textbook's proofs, which can be way overloaded with information. Does not simplify the proof in a way that is easy to understand. Lectures were him showing the proof on projector from the book

Made the proofs way overly complicated than need be. Literally copies the proofs straight off the textbook and doesn't even condense it down during class. Nice guy but not good at teaching proofs or explaining the material in an accessible way. Better off just reading the textbook.

Professor Keeran has a unique teaching style, using a flipped classroom approach. While it takes some adjustment, his availability and willingness to help make the class manageable. Unstuck study ai proved a great study tool alongside the course materials.

A little bit of a grumpy goose, but an absolute legend. Dr. Keeran is hilarious and so easily annoyed by robocalls during class that it would be impossible not to like him. Tests are based heavily on recommended problems from the book. Do the recommended problems. He's willing to give hints on proofs and he takes your ideas seriously.

Dr. Keeran is such an enjoyable lecturer for such a difficult class as linear algebra, cannot recommend him more. He's a tough grader on the homeworks but that just prepares you for the exams. Highly recommended.

Dr. Keeran is overall a pretty good guy. He is funny and cares about his students. However, he doesn't do minus grade, and every other prof will give you a 2 point extra credit discussion board, except him. Also, he also didn't have the decently to respond to my email asking be be bumped 0.03% to a B+. Not the best, but not the worst.
Great lecturer and very knowledgeable. Friendly and funny guy. He keeps the class quiet during lectures which I love. He obviously cares a lot about students.
