Massive class where attendance is a joke. I used Study Edge and it's why I passed. It's beyond me why this class, required for many majors, is this terrible.

Study Edge. Professor Williamson is by far the worst teacher I've ever had. Her accent is extremely difficult to understand, and the 500 person lectures treat her like a joke. Save yourself the time and buy study edge. She gives a coding project that has no relevance and grades it extremely harsh. Attendance is mandatory to watch Netflix.

Take any other Calc 1 class. Attendance is mandatory but she cannot teach for the life of her, simply copies down practice problems and expects you to understand. 10% of your grade is a group coding project that she provides absolutely no guidance on. Material itself is not difficult, but you are going to be teaching it to yourself.
She is awful, just get study edge because you are not gonna pay attention

Don't take this class unless you have basic knowledge of calculus 1. It's not the fact that her accent is so heavy that you can't understand but the fact she can't teach the class. She just does examples and expects you to know what to do. Has a final project that has nothing to do with calculus and is on a coding software and provides no guide.

Lectures are a waste of time as she just writes so fast and you can't understand her. Study edge taught me the whole course. First exam was the easiest. Fully failed the second exam because it was nothing like the practice exams. 3rd was fine but you need to really study. Save yourself and just take this online. Also be prepared to code :))))))))))

If you put a lot of effort in this class is doable, but definitely not easy. The group project is ridiculous because it is completely based on your ability to code and has little to nothing to do with the material. The first exam is the easiest, the second is a lot more challenging, and the third was ok.

I mean she is genuinely just not good at her job. Zero point in attending her lectures, they are the biggest waste of time, you seriously can't understand a word she says. The content isn't that hard, so if you start studying 3 days before the exam, you can probably do fine, but sometimes she just decides to make the exam unpassable. Take it online
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: The homework is useless and requires a calculator, while tests are non-calculator. Final project is a group project that solely relies on your and your groupmates' ability to code in a software. Her lectures are also useless due to her thick Russian accent most students cannot understand.
Don't take this class. Do it online. Thick accent, stupid homework, worthless lectures, and exam average between the 3 was 85% on the first, then around 65% for the last 2.
It's a stain on UF's reputation as an institution that she is still employed. Worst teacher I have ever had; exams are all Scantron, and nothing like the materials you are given to prepare with.

Hardest part of the class is having the willpower to show up, SHE DOESNT TEACH ANYTHING. Survey of Calc 1, it's a pretty easy class but if this was a difficult class it would be over I would fail. Just a bad teacher.

Similar to calc 1-3, there is no attendance and the lectures are recorded online. 30% homework, 70% exams and 5% extra credit. It doesn't really matter if you have Williamson or Demas because you can watch Demas' lectures and we all take the same exams.

She has no idea how to teach this class. You NEED to get study edge to pass this class. Exams are nothing like the practice exams or reviews. She doesn't explain how to do anything, and homework is so much different than what exams test on (tbh, a lot of it too). There is like a coding group project???? which was a NIGHTMARE. Avoid her if you can.

Awful. The thickest accent of all time makes her so hard to understand. she moves too fast so by the time you finally figure out what in the world she said, shes moved onto a different topic. Homework is not the least bit helpful when studying for tests. Theres also a coding project that has nothing to do with math. STAY AWAY IF POSSIBLE
So hard to understand. She did not teach!!

Do Not take this class. She doesn't teach well. There is so much HW i can't pay attention at all or follow her speaking. For the first test and got a 95 because of Study Edge. The second exam was so hard for no reason  I studied the same way as the first exam but got a 50.
Doesn't teach just does examples and expects the entire class to pick up on things, has a thick accent which isn't her fault but it makes it incredibily difficult to learn things in her class.

I wish I could quit. I don't understand her at all. Microphone blasts in everyone's ears. Projects are coding and I cried while doing it. If u don't have study edge.. good luck bois. Yea just no. PLZ stay away but u probs cant bc its a business requirement so buckle up.

Cannot use a microphone to save her life. Ears hurt due to her inability even though I could not hear her speaking the entire class. Somehow the microphone stayed on even though she wasn't using it. Even if I could hear her, I wouldn't be able to understand a single word she said over her thick accent
I don;t know how to describe this class
terrible, couldnt understand and had to withdraw
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Doesn't seem to understand that lectures are supposed to simplify things, not make them more complicated. Gave up paying attention in class and would just watch study edge while she talked. Attendance is required. Annoying project and lots of homework. But material isn't bad at all if you get study edge. Her accent isn't the problem, she is lol.

You cannot hear her in the lectures, she doesn't teach only reads off the slides and the MATLAB code yet makes attendance mandatory. HW is annoying and you have to use a calc even though it is a no calc class. Annoying project that is unrelated to coursework and she provides zero guidance on. Use study edge and you will get an A on the exams.

I do not understand why she structures her class like this. She KNOWS she can't give full, quality lectures in person. And YET, she insists on mandatory attendance. It makes NO sense!! In addition, there is a project using MatLab. A CODING platform. Ridiculous course structure and she doesn't lecture good. You learn more from the HW than from her.

Absolutely terrible. Confusing and rushed lectures, useless participation quizzes, unnecessary homework, and a completely irrelevant coding project make this the worst class I've taken. Unless you have a good understanding of calc 1 material don't bother. This is not an exaggeration and the 100+     1-star reviews speak for themselves. STAY AWAY!!!
Very robotic, does not engage with students at all. Hard to understand, and does not seem to care if we understand the material or not.
You cannot understand what she is saying, and her lectures are no help. You either have to teach yourself or use study edge.

Has an accent AND can't explain concepts to save her life. She is very confusing and constantly changing grading criteria and guidelines. Also has an unnecessary group project on Matlab that will drive you insane. If you can, just take the online section of MAC2233. Not worth it unless you're good at teaching yourself.

Just one of those classes where the Youtube (Organic Chemistry tutor) is your real teacher. I'm not good at math so I did horrible on exams, still there's many ways to get a decent grade. A lot of people used study edge, but I did not feel I had to and ended up with an 85% which is considered a B+.

This class isn't as hard as everyone says. If you're naturally good at math, you'll be better off. You have to teach yourself the content because each class is only 50 min. which doesn't give enough time to ask questions and engage w/ the content. The project IS unnecessary but you can figure it out with some effort. A similar project is for EC.

Dr. Williamson is quite hard to understand in her lectures. Personally, I attended lectures solely for participation credit and never took notes and used StudyEdge only when exams came around and ended with an A. There is a decent amount of assignments on Pearson for each module, but they are all doable. There are 3 in-person exams and a final.

Although Prof Williamson means well, she has a very thick accent rendering her lectures useless. I tried to sit in the front, but ended up ignoring most of her lectures and self-taught myself on Youtube.The MATLAB project was not relevant to the course at all and tedious.

Would not wish this class upon my worst enemy... not the ice age baby... not the hawk tuah girl... not even big pharma and gosh I hate big pharma. IDK how I ended with an A, she makes you do a matlab project that has nothing to do with the class that you have to learn on your own and it is outrageously frustrating and she just laughs if you ask q's

Receiving an A in this class is completely attainable, however you must put in a lot of work. It's difficult to learn from the lectures and you will have to self teach. Study edge is a must for this class. I would also suggest not waiting until the last minute to begin the Project as it takes lots of time to understand the program and complete it.

Impossible exams! Tedious homework! Lecture participation quizzes! MATLAB coding (gave little to no instructions on how to code and did not even relate to anything we were doing in class) which was unnecessarily hard and worth a large part of a grade. Very rude! Do not go to office hours as she gets upset with students for expressing confusion.

Could not understand anything the professor said, study edge saved me. Coding project made absolutely no sense. Homework was very tedious and difficult. came in with no calc background but still an A is manageable.

Lots of homework that takes forever to do, she grades the coding project harshly and knocks off points for very small mistakes, was not happy with the exam review she provides, final was harder than expected even after being confident with problems from Study Edge and review. Nice but lectures are difficult to hear and everyone talks through them.

If you have no prior calc experience, DON'T take this class. But if you do, you'll be fine. Yes, her teaching isn't the best, but the content isn't difficult at all. I self-taught myself everything and scored high on all her exams (w/o study edge). The project she assigns is AWFUL. My exam scores were high enough, so I ended up not doing it at all

Most despicable class I've ever taken. I knew I was hopeless from day 1 and was forced to get study edge. Even using study edge the tests were unbearable and I basically assume half the questions are trick questions. The coding project was genuinely the most outrageous, unrelated, and impossible assignment I've ever had to do. Just avoid.

Could not understand a single word this lady was saying. The only reason I did not fail is because I paid for study edge. The homework does not reflect exam questions or class examples, and it takes hours to complete. There's also a coding project that was very confusing and the professor did not even know how to use the platform herself. BEWARE.

hard Homework that legitimately takes hours to do. First exam is easy but 2 and 3 have 7 problems are are pretty hard. She skims through material and problems. Doesn't have good test prep materials, and Matlab coding was virtually impossible and unrelated to in class material with little to no explanation. This class I not as bad as most are saying

Take any other calculus course. Pointless MATLAB project that there is not instructions for. She does not teach any math simply completed the lecture shell in class. Attendance is mandatory with 2 annoying problems one in the middle of class and one at the end (you can do them from home). She doesn't provide past exams for studying.

Nice teacher and is pretty lenient on exams (22 multiple choice and 2 are bonus). Lectures are inaudible and homework is excessive. The MATLAB project is the worst part of this course (5 exercises of coding, 10% of grade). Study edge does help and she subs lowest exam grade for final (if better). Take MAC2231 online instead. (A) is not impossible.

Everything about this class is pure evil. Her exam reviews are nothing like the actual exams so good luck. Study Edge hasn't been able to save me. Lectures are inaudible and not worth your time. She is not a mean professor but that definitely does not make her a good one. Also, a coding project in a calculus class??? Never again.

Essentially make a coding project 10 percent of your grade and then grades you on it based on personal opinions of your work not actually laid in the requirements. A ridiculous amount of HW which really doesnt prepare you for the tests. Tests are not impossibly difficult but she has no flexability in the other assignments and will not give feedback
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The homework assignments are unrelated to the class materials. Calculator is a must for the homework, but not allowed during the exams. Unnecessary coding project irrelevant to the course. The instructions are unclear, but this project significantly impacts your grade. My grade went down from an A to a B because of this project.

Worst professor I've ever had, high school included. Homeworks are nothing like the in-class examples or exams, and they take hours to complete. They require a calculator even though on exams you can't use one. Still don't understand why there are coding assignments.  Lectures are confusing. Attendance is mandatory. Stay far away.
ok why is there a programming project in this non math major math class???

Genuinely one of the worst experiences I've had at UF. If you did not take AP Calc in high school PLEASE stay away from this course and professor. Even with StudyEdge, her exams have questions that are impossible to solve without a calculator. The class exam average for this last exam was 60%. This class is an absolute GPA killer please do not take

Objectively abissmal. Long winded confusing inaudible lectures. She revels in making the tests extremely difficult and designs questions to trick you. Hours of hw and assigned a comp sci project in a survey of calculus class. Would take with ANY other professor over her. Worst professor at UF and it's not close!

This class has been a terrible experience in every way possible. This professor impressively makes what should be an easy class into something unnecessarily difficult and genuinely painful. I can't even describe how awful she is and this class in the 350 words I am provided. I just hope she knows how much everyone despises her and her teaching.

I am surprised as to why she has not retired yet. Lectures are very confusing. The homework requires a calculator, even though we are not allowed to use calculators in the class. The homework questions are unnecessarily hard and are nothing like the exam questions. Study Edge saves and is a must!!! The professor makes no sense whatsoever.

Simply a bad professor. Impossible to understand due to her accent, and will die by the schedule. Attendance is mandatory; which she does because of it wasn't mandatory, nobody would show up. StudyEdge and self teaching are what you need to get an A in this class. Do NOT take this class. Just go to MAC2311.
Shes got a heavy accent but shes pretty understanding with grades and such

She was super understanding, has a bit of an accent, and has her notes up before class so you can print or buy from targetcopy. They were super easy to follow and she teaches you exactly what you need to know for the exam. The practice problems in the notes are basically the ones in the exam. Bit of homework, but easy! Super easy class over summer!

The class is challenging, but using unstuckstudy ai along with other study resources like the textbook and tutoring helped me get through it. Attendance is mandatory, so be prepared to actively engage during lectures.

If you have the option, please do not take this class.I came into this class with no background in calculus so I had to rely on youtube videos and tutors to help me get through the semester. She speeds through lectures and her work is so hard to follow. If you ask her a question in class or after class her answers are no help.

Overall, she is a very sweet professor, but when it comes to her lectures they are hard to comprehend and follow. Attendance is mandatory and takes attendance every class. For homework, it usually takes a couple hours to complete each week. Most people in this course use Study Edge and it is a MUST. Without it I would have no ended with an A.
Worst class ever. Professor does not prepare you for anything. Tries to punish students for not attending her useless lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Good luck! Tough to get past the accent and even tougher exams. She gets placed into the courses that the math department cares too little about, which is interesting because it will be the classes with the most students in them. She is a sub par lecturer, and attendance is measured by questions at the end of each lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: death by a million cuts. had an A all semester before she decided to make the already hard tests harder. if you don't have a background in calc coming into this, you will not pass. the extra credit project is absolutely irritating and useless, but trust me, you'll need it. nobody bothered to show up to lectures anymore because it was useless.

Lots of homework, attendance is graded, harder course than it should be and I regret not just taking normal mac2311. Very difficult to understand because of her heavy accent and hyperventilating while giving lectures. Besides that there is lots of review material available but I highly recommend getting studyedge for this course.

She is simply a terrible lecturer. She goes through guided notes explained with weird nomenclature/heavy in variables that doesn't effectively teach the content, on top of that it is difficult to even understand her speech. Everyone has StudyEdge, you ABSOLUTELY NEED it. 2 attendance questions per class, really long homework assignments. Avoid her.

Lectures are completely useless as it is hard to understand what the professor is saying. She never finished the lectures and were not helpful. Homework was extremely long and pointless as you need to use a calculator but you are unable to on exams. Exams are also quite difficult. Williamson is a nice lady though. STUDY EDGE SAVED MY LIFE!

Absolutely horrible class. Can't understand a single word she says in lectures. Hours and hours of pointless homework every week, incomprehensible lectures, and insanely hard exams. I just use her lectures as a chance to get homework done at this point. Without Study Edge I don't know if I would have passed. AVOID THIS CLASS LIKE THE PLAGUE.

If I hadn't taken calculus in high school, I would be failing. There is no point in paying attention to lectures- you can barely hear her and she is not good at explaining anything. she provides helpful resources on canvas like the filled out notes and recommended textbook problems to do, which help me. The homework is awful and takes forever.

I took this class in Summer B where there are only 6 weeks in the semester and any struggles I had were not because of this professor. Williamson is very lenient when setting up the design for this class, since there are 2 discussion quizzes, 2 exams, an optional final, and weekly homework. If you MUST take diff eq for Summer B take Williamson!
The worst professor I have ever had by far. Avoid this class at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Use the textbook to study, the lectures are not very useful. She speaks really low in class and the homeworks are pretty hard.

She rarely finishes her lectures in the allotted class time, making you watch her videos on Canvas. Also, the homework does not properly showcase what is on the exams, which makes it hard to study for the exams. Definitely get Study Edge, it will save your grade!

Sit in the front!!! She has an accent and sometimes the mic isn't close, but if you sit in the front, the class should be doable. Once you get used to her accent, you'll understand most of what she's explaining. It's a bit easier for those who like math, so if you don't, don't be afraid to ask for help and/or do lots of practice problems in the HW.

She has a very thick accent and high pitched voice that makes her hard to understand. She also is not great at explaining what she is doing during class. If you are not great at math I would strongly recommend taking pre-calc with Carmichael before taking this class. The concepts are not that hard but you will have to teach some of it to yourself.

One of the worst professors. Best piece of advice is to find a group of people in your class and work on study edge questions and exam reviews together. If you study the material everyday you should be fine. I procrastinated till the last day and the tests were hard. Definitely make friends that are just as driven as you. Best of luck.

Extremely hard to understand, making the lectures practically useless. Had to learn the material for this class entirely through study edge because she was so bad. Also, be ready to do about a full days worth of homework per week.

This class was extremely difficult. The Professors heavy accent, class lectures that are very different from the exam, and insane homework assignments are not helpful. With study edge I was able to do very well but this class requires a ton of studying. Class doesn't help so you will be teaching yourself.

She moves really quickly for no reason. Syllabus says that students are allowed to use Desmos... which is not true. She places extremely difficult fractions and large numbers for calculations (we aren't allowed to use calculators. Really heavy accent, difficult to understand her. Goes really slow in easy part of lectures but fast in the hard parts.

I was required to take this course for my major but if you are not required I would not recommend taking a class with professor Williamson. The lectures were not helpful and the homework is very long. If you have previous knowledge or are good at teaching yourself you should be fine.

Unfortunately I did not have a good experience. Professor Williamson is very intelligent, but she lacks the ability to teach. The lectures were useless, as nothing prepared me for the exams. The exams were absurdly difficult, and the homework was long, tiring, and useless. The homework required calculator, but the exams were strictly no calculator.

This was honestly the worst experience ever. If you have to take this class, good luck! Do your homework in class and do lecture participation for credit. Do not listen to her lectures because you will be wasting all of your time. Exams are not on anything that she goes over in class either.

She barely speaks english so it's impossible to understand what she's saying. Attendance is a grade counted by dumb questions that she puts up randomly throughout lecture. Homework takes forever. She really likes to teach about topics that aren't on exam. If you have to take this class, learn from study edge and work on homework during lectures.

Williamson is probably the worst professor I've experienced here at UF so far. It's incredibly difficult to understand her lectures and her recorded lecture audio cuts out every other word. The audio issues were brought up at the beginning of the semester and still have not been fixed. The only way I am passing this course is through StudyEdge.

Thick accent that makes everything she says hard to understand. Make sure you sit near the front if you want a chance of hearing her. Never actually explains any of her work and just writes it out. Class itself is not difficult but be prepared to teach yourself literally every unit because you will be so lost after every lecture.

It is very difficult to learn in this class because her lectures are monotonous and she explains everything in an extremely confusing way for every concept even when they are not that difficult. I would never take this class again and if you get her as a professor switch out if you can.

It is almost impossible to learn anything in this class. She does not explain or teach anything from the lecture, and it is incredibly heard to understand anything she is saying. I would recommend switching to a different professor if given the chance. You need a tutor or study edge if you want a chance at passing this class.

She is really good at math, but cannot teach. She just goes through lecture notes and does not teach how to do stuff. You're better off just paying for study edge or getting tutored. Try to take this class with anyone else. The lecture participation quizzes are unnecessarily complicated and does not even work half the time.
Impossible to hear, teaches concepts in weird, unconventional ways that are different than how they were previously taught.

This professor is one of the worst professors I have ever had. Yes, she is a nice person, but she barely knows English. You cant understand her one bit and she explains things in the most confusing ways possible. If you get her as a professor, switch out, you will not have a good time.
Her projects are absolute bs

class itself is not hard. I used recorded lectures and learned by doing hw. good portion of grade depends on group projects, members are random+permanent. my group sucked, it made it much harder to do well (I'd do my parts fine, they'd do terrible, grade plummeted). communicate w her EARLY if this happens to you and she might be more lenient

I actually liked Dr. Williamson and didn't really mind this class. She was very kind and gives a decent amount of extra credit plus an opportunity to redo one exam at the end of the semester (no final either). The MATLAB projects were hell and there were no in-class instructions, but the actual math you're tested on is relatively easy.

You'll be solving matrices for 4 months. Recorded lectures are useless and slow. It's better to learn material just by doing the homework or watching youtube videos. It is REQUIRED to get a good coding group for Matlab projects or you will suffer. Exams not that hard if you look at the reviews.

The most important thing for this class is to have a good group for your projects... the exams were not too bad, the assignments and lectures were a bit tedious, but as long as you have a good group then you will most likely be fine

Absolutely the worst experience I've ever had with a class. Makes you feel like you're back in high school. You get 3 homework assignments a week, 12 questions each, and some have multiple parts. Group projects are numerous and atrocious. Make sure to have friends in the class. This class can kill your passion for math like it did mine.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Youtube and various online calculators kept my sanity in this course. Take this class over a summer and definitely don't take it with physics or data structures. Easily the worst class I've taken, much worse than discrete. TA's are pretty generous when grading projects because our broken code still got consistent 29/30.

The notes are printouts that you fill in. She has prerecorded lectures that go over the same sheet so you dont even have to attend class sometimes and some homework problems are number for number on the exam. Exams are fast but not impossible: 12 MC and 5 bonus. The worst part is the group projects, I knew matlab but my groupmates didnt as well.
Terrible professor. Do not recommend. Avoid at all costs. Endless stress.

She's nice but her lectures are awful. You're better off learning from YouTube or just by doing the HW. But her exam review lectures are fairly similar to the exams. She also offers some extra credit. The TA (Mahya Agahee) gives zero help for MATLAB projects. If you get a bad group or group leader, good luck trying to get an A in the class.

The lectures were repeated from previous recordings. She assigned massive group projects in MATLAB without showing or explaining the software. Projects are excessively time-consuming, if you got a bad group leader work wouldn't get done and your grade would suffer a lot. Exams were fast-paced at only 50min making them harder than they should be.

The math material in this class is not even that hard. She just makes her lectures unnecessarily confusing at times. You are best off teaching yourself by doing the homework. The reviews are good for exams though. The coding projects make this class awful. The TA is a strict grader on these and the instructions/lessons on how to code is nonexistent

The tests are fair thanks to the review material given, and the homework can be helpful to study for a test. But the Learning Catalytics are annoying. And the group projects are a real pain: though it's nice to gain skills in Matlab programming, the work is long and not easy, so having a good group is a real +.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Anything I didn't learn from the 4000 level version of this class I surely didn't learn in this class. Williamson has a slow monotonous voice that takes an eternity to get through material. Be sure to get competent group members for the projects or else 20% of your grade will be on the line.

The lectures I found hard to follow, the tests difficult, and the projects even more annoying. The tests use ProctorU, which absolutely sucks unless you like getting yelled at by proctors for sneezing or turning your fan on. The projects usually consist of doing one or two matlab problems, except some of them can take hours to complete.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She doesn't teach the last few sections for the homework and the textbook does not help. This is likely going to drop my A- to a B. There are many other problems with this class like MatLab, but I was able to get by that.

One of the worst classes I have ever taken. She is rather unfair. I had the system MyLab Math glitch which took points away and she said she couldn't fix it because she had to stay by the book? I have crap partners for group projects, and she wouldn't let me change. If I fail, it is mostly her fault for she does not care about the students.

Homework is outside what she teaches. Tests are outside homework and what she teachers. The homework is so heavy. The system that our homework is done through glitched and erased four sections of my homework. She said since I had no proof there was nothing she could do. That dropped my grade by 2% which is a lot for me. Hire professors who care...

We have to teach are selves how to code on something called MatLab with no instruction at all. The document we are given says what the outcome should be but not how to set it up. When I went to her for help about it she said she didn't know how to use MatLab. Why are we doing something the teacher can't even do? This is a joke. I want my money back

Her exams are predictable and straight from the homework but there is SO much homework. This was supposed to be an afterthought of a class but it takes the most time of all my classes (even DML). Take a different technical elective.

I don't believe she actually knows what she is teaching. She has to stay on script or else she will say something wrong. She is incapable of answering questions I have outside the class. Waste of time and money: mine and the school's. I am transferring to UCF this Spring, half way through my Junior year, literally because of Williamson.

I have no coding experience and yet I was advised to take this class. If I don't code to help with the group projects I don't get a grade for it. They don't teach you how to code or give you proper resources for learning MATLAB at all. Teaching yourself the code is impossible. The 50 min exams are more focused on testing your pacing.

The 50 minute exams are more about pacing (really need more time). For projects you have to write code to create a function for problems and I have no coding experience. The group projects grades are shared and I have no way of helping with the coding. If I don't help I don't get a grade for it. Don't understand why I was advised to take this class

You teach yourself. You spend so much time with this homework (being you teach yourself) that you don't have time for other classes. There is no partial credit on tests. This class is a mess and I would suggest not taking it.
Honestly, its probably better to take the 4000 level class instead of the 3000 level one with a horrible teacher and grading system.

This is the worst class I have ever taken. The professor teaches absolutely nothing. When you go to office hours to get help with your projects she tells you she can't even look at your code. If all I am doing is watching prerecorded lectures and can't get any help in office hours then she shouldn't even get paid. This class needs to be scrapped.

50 minutes for a technical math quiz, no calculator, no credit for work. Ridiculous You have to teach yourself MatLab. Why am I teaching myself stuff? Isn't that the teacher's job. I am only finishing this 'cause I have to. UF should seriously reconsider their teaching methods. Already getting a lawyer involved being they aren't teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: We use MatLab... But we have to teach ourselves how to use it... We have exams in class, however, 50 minutes is not enough time to do a technical exam that is that long. She is not clear with how we are supposed to do anything. You can't understand what she says. Not a bad person, but definitely bad at her job.

She is not a good teacher, as I got a pretty good grade in the class but feel as if I haven't learned anything. Lectures are overly complicated with long drawn out proofs that are completely irrelevant to exams and projects. She puts in little to no effort at all. Basically not too difficult but don't expect to learn anything.

Lectures are more complicated than actual material (which is pretty easy), but the examples she does are helpful. You can learn the material just by doing the hw. Exams are almost identical to the review & hw. I recommend taking this class with ppl u know for the group projects. Even if 1 person doesnt pull their weight its gonna hurt.

Overcomplicates every topic by diving into tons of long proofs instead of focusing on real applications. Her lectures consists of her reading 100% word for word the textbook in a monotone voice. The group projects consists of 10+ pages of confusing directions with no ability to check that your program works. I hope to never see her again.

Your experience is probably shaped by your group members/projects. They were tough but grading depends on the TA and can be graded easily. Love the recorded lectures. They were as much fun as a math lecture can be (which imo isn't much but still). Straightforward and goes through all you need for exams. HW every week took me 1-2hrs.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Lectures are kind of overcomplicated, the subject matter is simple. I learned through HW. Watch the video reviews and do them alongside the prof to ace the exams (which are not hard at all, and include opportunities for extra credit). The MATLAB projects can be difficult, but message the prof w/ questions and you'll get answers.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: - Group projects: PDFs are detailed and help further content understanding. Make sure to choose a group with members who are proactive and organized. - HW: Due weekly. Stay ahead, do NOT procrastinate. Helps prepare for exams. - Exams: Based on HW and lectures; very easy if you understand material + study the reviews. 5 pts EC (max 65 / 60 pts).

To summarize the class: meh. It was honestly a pain getting through lectures and homework, but they weren't overall too difficult. Make sure to do them and the practice to do well on the exams. The worst part were the projects. If you can, try to get a group of people you know so it goes smoothly. Overall, easy to do well in but felt like a chore.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Project sucks cuz she didn't provide samples to let you check if you did correctly or not. Basically read notes on her recorded lectures and barely have any explanations to the notes.

Williamson will answer questions if you reach out to her. I didn't watch most lectures, I just learned from the homework. Getting an A is not hard, but the MATLAB projects and the regular homework can take a decent amount of time. Linear algebra by nature is not a cake walk.

Very nice professor and overall chill class. Video lectures were boring and tough to listen to. Exams and the quiz were straightforward if you did the homework and her reviews. Be warned, though, as a group project leader you will likely have to do a lot of heavy lifting yourself (like making up for the slacker who didn't do their part)
MAS3114 is cake if you actually study. The lectures are very straight forward. Review the online homeworks and reviews at the end of each section for the exams.

She overcomplicates the lectures. The material is pretty easy overall and if you stay on top of everything, it's an easy A. The most annoying thing about this class is the group projects which can be time consuming, especially if you are placed in a bad group.

Can't understand a word she says in class. I watch the recorded lectures. Homework isn't bad, group projects are challenging programming assignments. Tests are a bit easier than the material covered in class. I studied from the homework.

The class material was easy which made this class doable. However, she doesnt teach well and its hard to understand her sometimes. She uses learning catalytics for attendance but I did it remotely so I never had to actually go to class except for exams. If youve never coded before the projects can be difficult just hope you get a good group.

If you know how to do the homeworks you'll do well on the exams. Show up to class to do the little quizzes in lecture for easy points. The only annoying part of this class is the projects where you code in Matlab. Some people in this class have never coded before or don't want to do their part. I hate online classes but just take her online.

Professor Williamson is everything I look for in a professor in terms of administration. She answered all emails and concerns i had within the hour, grades are received for almost all material within a day as well. You will always know where you stand in that class, and you will always have the resources available to get where you need to be.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Her lectures are like reading a textbook out loud. Your grade will depend entirely on how good your group is for the projects.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Worst math teacher I have ever had. Lectures are terribly boring and poorly coordinated. Projects are not graded reasonably and often times if a group member is a slacker, you get and A for him or fail with him. An unreasonable amount of homework. Would take Linear Algebra in hindsight with another teacher even if the class is harder.
It can get pretty tedious, but it's definitely an easy A. Lots of extra credit is available, and the final is optional.

Very difficult to listen to - her lectures actually gave me headaches on several occasions, on top of being tedious and hard to understand. You'll learn more from doing the MyLab homework than from lectures, but participation is mandatory for a grade. Group projects are also mandatory and the usage of the rubric is not clear.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Here is my guide: I stopped watching the lectures after the first exam. Most of her lectures are just her explaining the theory. To pass the exams, all you must do is watch her unit review videos. Practice those problems over and over and you will do very well on the exam. Final exam is optional. The HW is weekly but easy to get done.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: This class is a lot of work, but a lot of easy work. Lectures are pretty lengthy and numerous, but watching at 2x speed helps a lot and you can knock out weeks of work in one night if needed. Homework is where you learn, and there are guided solutions for most problems. Exams/projects were easy, quiz was a joke (open book... could just use MATLAB)

AVOID HER AT ALL COST! She won't care about your grade. She gives ALOT of work and its not easy at all or explained well. Her exams are super hard and you don't have enough time to finish. She has lecture quizzes, homework quizzes, exams, and projects (none are easy). Everything is done by hand. She is quick with an e-mail response though.
class isn't very hard, but she's poor at lecturing unfortunately. group matlab projects that may or may not suck depending on who you get stuck with in your group.

AVOID HER AT ALL COST. from the first day of class to the last day she wont care about your grade. she gives ALOT of work and its not easy at all. her exams are super hard and you don't have enough time to finish. she has lecture quizzes, hw quizzes, exams, and projects (none are easy). she wont change her office hours if you cant make it. terrible

I highly suggest you NOT to take her for advanced calculus 2. Her tests consist of 3-5 proofs out of 25-30 she wrote in class and 5-7 computational problems from homework assignments. Also she does not curve the class. The highest grade on the first exam was a 62%, where 66% was passing.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Did not use text. For online class, print out her lecture notes and fill out while watching the lectures (1.6x speed) and completing LCs. Get used to MATLAB. Tests aren't bad, just do the HW (lets you try a question 3 times). I got sick and gave her doc's note and she was nice about extending some HW deadlines. One test is dropped.
Thank you to who recommended the lecture notes! Very useful!

She was a very nice professor that had great notes - I would recommend that you buy them from Target Copy and fill them out as you watch her lectures, because they are a great resource when it comes for studying for exams and quizzes, as they are identical to the material from the notes. Even as a beginning programmer, the projects were fairly easy
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Good and kind professor. The class isn't too difficult.

Dr. Williamson is very helpful. She goes out of her way to answer questions you have, even on the weekends. Though the projects are difficult, they're done in groups, and if you have any programming experience, they shouldn't be too difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The most annoying voice ever. Hard to sit through her lectures because they are so boring and her voice is painful to listen to. Easy class otherwise, MATLAB projects can be difficult but the tests are very similar to her reviews.

Her lectures are verbatim printouts of what is covered in the text. She does not elaborate on the points she discusses; rather, she merely sits in front of the printouts, annotates them, and reads them aloud. You can easily just read the text yourself; her lectures don't add anything new. Very disappointed with the quality of this course.

Larissa is very slow and boring at lecturing. However, the exams are very easy if you have some idea as to what's going on. The homework is also very easy.  Worst part are the MATLAB projects but just go on coursehero and youll find all of the past projects there. Overall easy class but quite annoying with all the homework.

If you're decent at math, this is a breeze. The lectures are a little slow, but the exams are extremely easy. The matlab projects can be difficult if you're not great at programming but you're in a group so you'll probably at least be with someone who knows what they are doing. She works out review problems before the exams and they really help!

The class material was not too bad to pick up and understand but Williamson could have done a better job explaining the material at times. I didn't do too well on the first exam but I used Study Edge for the rest of the year and ended with a high B in the class. Would recommend this class but only if you use Study Edge on top of her material.

Between much too wordy definitions with far too few examples to illustrate what they are telling me, multiple choice questions designed to trip me up in the semantics, and the mousiest personality I have ever seen in an adult, this class is easy, but supremely grating on my nerves. Easy because what I don't get I can Google.
Loved this class!

Easy A. Highly recommend the online version, it was very convenient. Overall a very easy summer class to fill my schedule. The MATLAB projects were sometimes frustrating and a bit time consuming, but completely doable. Exams are very easy if you complete the reviews. There are also numerous opportunities to get extra credit.

Average professor, easy class. The MATLAB projects get really annoying, as for the most part it's stuff you won't get tested on. Other than that, tests are easy if you use the study guide, and homeworks don't take too much time.

Sweet old lady who's more than willing to explain and re-explain concepts as necessary. However, halfway through the semester, many lectures weren't done in time & we finished learning from her online videos.  Matlab group projects (5 total) were a pain. . Still, you SHOULD be getting an A in this class. It's not too difficult at all.
Good teacher

Dr. Williamson is so nice!  The class itself is easy.  Basically, just put in the average effort: go to class, do the homework, study a decent amount for tests and you'll get an A.  The MATLAB projects are a pain sometimes, but if you have any remote programming knowledge you should be fine.
Her accent it tough to understand, but she is a great teacher. You have to go to class though because participation is a large portion of your grade.

I thought the lectures and course materials were excellent. I did not use the online textbook at all except for the mandatory homework and lecture content questions. Group projects are a royal pain both in the amount of time necessary to complete them and in the total crap shoot of group quality.

Compared to some of the other math classes you've probably already taken, her Linear Algebra course should be really easy. She's a little slow with the lectures and usually won't finish on time but do the homework and you should be pretty solid with the arithmetic. Exam reviews are golden. Group MATLab projects are simple. Lectures are boring.

Ms. Williamson is a very sweet lady. I took her class online and all of the notes are available for printing and her lectures are clear and provide all of the information you need for success. Her exams are very similar to the review, and she provides extra credit. I would not hesitate to take her again. Highly recommended.
She is the nicest professor. The exams are super easy and just like the reviews. They even have bonus points. She makes everything very clear.
She is a pretty easy professor.
HITT clickers messed people's grades, she's a really good professor.

Super sweet lady! All you have to do is write down what she writes in class an now you have the best, most concise version of notes to refer to for hw and exams. She gives a review sheet a few days before the exam that is basically what will be on the actual test Lots of extra credit floating around. If you do well you don't need to take the final.

Dr. Williamson is a phenomenal teacher. I took her for both MAS3114 and MAP2302, and would gladly take more of her classes if I needed to. Her accent took maybe two days to get used to. She knows her stuff and made the material very easy. The tests were similar to the reviews, which were both cake. Highly recommended.

Easy A. Her exams are very similar to the reviews she posts, so if you do them all the way through you can definitely get 100% every time. She gives a lot of bonus points too and she's always willing to help. Very sweet lady. Will take her for other courses.

She is a great teacher. Her exams come directly from the homework so as long as you do that, you're golden. There is a lot of homework though so make sure you do it.  She is extremely helpful so attend her office hours if you have an issue with homework or an exam. I would definitely take her again.
Very nice professor. Easy class.
Great professor. Very good at explaining details, just the accent takes a little bit to get used to. Tests cover all the material thoroughly, and are still easy if you paid attention at all.
Although she has a slight accent, if you just pay attention she is clearly understood. She has very fair tests and genuinely wants everyone to succeed in her class.

She is a very good teach but her accent is so thick it's hard to understand her unless you give her your undivided attention. I used Study Edge and it definitely cleared up what I couldn't understand. Her exams have A LOT of bonus questions and the questions are pretty straight forward.

She is so nice!!!!! I love her. She clearly knows what she is talking about. Today's world is a global one and you need to be able to understand foreign accents if you want to be able to communicate with other people. Her English is a lot better than that of many native speakers, so give her a break regarding her accent.

Trying to decipher what she is saying while trying to learn is a very inefficient way to learn. I no longer listen to her lectures and I simply teach myself. The only reason I go to class is because she uses the "clickers" that count as  14% of our grade. During tests she has 5 people walking around and staring at you and it is VERY distracting.

Dr. Williamson is the one of the nicest math professors I have ever had at UF. She makes the course very interesting and easy to learn. The online homework is sometimes challenging, however her tests were fair. Overall a great professor for differential equations.

She is an amazing teacher! Had her for diffeq and she is such an easy teacher, always willing to help. She does clicker questions in class, so you must attend, but if you take notes in class and use her review sheet to study it's so straight forward and easy.

SO easy. I was hesitant to take her course because of Calc 3 but it is nothing like that. As long as you do the lecture notes or homework youre basically guaranteed an A. Plus she really is so helpful and the nicest professor.

Makes the class pretty easy with so much extra credit on the tests. Tests were always straight forward and computational. Not many conceptual questions on the tests. Final is non mandatory, and there are 4 tests before it. I'd say the most I've gotten out of the class (besides a basic understanding of linear algebra) is some knowledge of MATLAB.

She was an amazing instructor. For the students complaining, they must not have done the homework. Her lectures are clear and precise. She occasionally fumbles on arithmetic but who doesn't at this point in math. She has an accent but if you come to class the first couple days, you learn her quickly! I would recommend her to anyone!
Dr. Williamson is the nicest person on earth. She very friendly and helpful. Very dedicated too. She explains everything well. If you study you will get good grade

I swear to you... she tries to reinvent calculus(3).The entire class had to report her to the Dean of UF and engineering to force a massive curve on the grading scale. We had to work in a large groups to manipulate the HW and online exams. You will not learn anything. AVOID HER!!! or MAY THE CURVE BE EVER IN YOUR FAVOR... if she gives one.

Pretty easy A. Posts her lecture outlines online, but go to class because she'll tell you what to study. Tests are multiple choice with a lot of extra credit. Make sure you get into a group with people you know can actually program, because the projects are terrible when you have to do them alone.

The worst math professor was the university. Tests are so hard and she spends a lot of time on theoretical nonsense and confuses the hell out of you. Uses online homework which is wayyyyyy to hard and too much of it. I hate her.

She is really one of the worst professors I have ever had. Impossible to understand, ridiculous amount of useless and mechanic homework. Finally, she doesn't master the theoretical material for this class; I asked 5 questions from the book during the semester,  and she only could give me a correct answer for one of them.
THE MOST WONDERFUL SWEET PERSON IN THE WORLD

Great professor! Very friendly and approachable. Yeah she has an accent but I understood her just fine. Exams are multiple choice with extra credit. Easy A, just make sure you study the practice exams and keep up with the homework.

Dont we scared by the previous comments about her. She is a very nice teacher. Explains everything well. The tests are not that hard at all, of you practice the problems in the lecture. I recommend her for this class. Very nice lady
There was too much work in the class. I didn't have time to actually learn the material. I couldn't understand what she was saying
Not at all a bad teacher. This class is an easy A. Quizzes are just lecture notes and homework, and she was generous with grading.

The high workload helped a lot with exam preparation. I feel a lot more comfortable with 3D visualization after taking this class. The actual lecture wasn't helpful, though; I learned more from the MIT videos and office hours.
There is a huge amount of online work. The lectures are prety useless as she just teaches you really dense theory. Exams aren't too hard.

The class isn't the easiest but it isn't impossible. The tests are like the study guides she makes but they are difficult. there is a lot of homework but it prepares to for the discussion quizzes and you actually learn the material. grades don't just depend on the exams which is really nice because every exam only counts for like 8% of the grades.

Poor communication, does not do examples in class. She only focuses on the theory of the material, which does not help at all with studying for her difficult tests. I learned more from this class by just doing the homework by myself.
She is the worst I've ever had. Ridiculous amounts of HW and she is virtually impossible to understand, avoid her at all costs.

The only thing more absurd than the menial and towering homework in this class is how little it and lectures apply to exams.  She is a research professor through and through, and should not be teaching undergrads. Comments cant convey how awful her class is, so talk to a previous student of hers so you can be convinced out of making my mistake.

Seriously the worst professor I've had so far, which is saying something. UF loves to get these foreign "research" professors who can't teach to save their lives- she's useless! Class is so easy if you know your algebra going in, but it has an obscene amount of homework for such an easy class. Take it at a community college over summer instead.
i cannot understand her this class is supposed to help me so i can go further in math and all it does is frustrate me more worst class ever 2nd time taking it and i still dont understand her !

This class was harder than it needed to be solely because of the professor. Not only was she difficult to understand but she had little regard for her students. She did end up curving the class and dropping our lowest exam score and replacing with our highest but only because she had a meeting with the math department because of so many complaints.
She gives ridiculous amounts of online work and her exams are very difficult. She is not a great teacher overall and the class in unnecessarily hard.
Exams do not reflect course material. Unable to understand due to heavy accent. Homework is doable, however, does not help in exam.

Easy class with way too much work. She's flexible with your schedule for exams, but otherwise you'll never see her. Math lab is more useful for learning. not impossible, but definitely too time consuming for an algebra course.Take it during the summer instead.
Easy class. She doesn't actually teach the class. A not very good lady does lecture and then you have a TA. I stopped watching lectures half way through and I have an 89%.
Worst teacher i have had at the University, even worse than Kozinski, which is saying something.  The test and quizzes are unreasonable, and the drop rate is unbelievable.

Hard to understand with her accent. Tests are completely unfair. There's ever enough time to finish and many times the tests have material not thoroughly covered. Extreme amount of homework due dates inconsistent with syllabus. Take any professor but her.

Absolutely the worst class I have ever taken. This class is college algebra but we do calculus and precalc. She is not helpful, the work load is so   long, and the TA says we have to learn it on our own even though its a discussion class He doesnt know whats going on and is late to every class. This professor and TA is a disgrace to the university!

I was good at Algebra before I took this class. I can barely understand her accent. Every time I email her she takes forever to respond and usually says "I don't know what to tell you". She has never responded with a clear answer to my question. TA has shown up >15 mins late to every discussion and has NO clue whats going on. WAY TOO MUCH WORK.
She is not helpful at all whatsoever. I've never done so poorly in a class in my entire life.
Keep up with the due dates, because there is a lot of work. So much for teaching myself math, that's basically what you're doing.

The material is pretty easy to understand, but there is a A LOT of hw! It's extremely time consuming. The lecturer online is another woman, and you have discussion with your TA once a week, so I've never actually seen Williamson.
Easy class but way too much work. The online portion of the class takes up A LOT of time. The TA is okay and since it's mainly online she's the only one we ever learn from.

I would not recommend this professor or this class. The set up of the online class is really poor, and the TA seemed like he had no idea what was going on. She is NOT and approachable professor and don't be fooled by her appearance.

HATED this class with a passion.  Sure, the level of difficulty isn't too bad, but the workload was absolutely insane.  4 warm ups,3 quizzes, and 8 HW assignments every week.  I found myself spending more time on this class than any of my required major classes.  The day this class ends will be the happiest day of my life.

This class requires far too much homework and "warm up" problems for a lower level mathematics course.  The professor's lectures are certainly not worth watching since you can easily learn more about math from mymathlab.  It's pretty ridiculous how much homework there is in relation to how much you actually learn.

Which the content of the class is not too difficult the homework is unending. According to the syllabus there are a total of 100 hw assignments. Also this teaching is almost completely up to you because her lectures offer little to no help on the assignments. If possible take the course with another professor.

Questions on quizzes and exams should come from hw and examples. Very strict with her students, but also easier to follow since she has notes already prepared. Make sure to get her binded book instead of printing them.

Very flexible.  Passionate about subject.  Reasonable grade policy.  Approachable.  She supplies abundant resources online.  Very clear.  I recommend you read the lecture material before attending class.  I would definitely take a class with her again.

Easy class, she hand feeds you the exact formulas you need for her quizzes. No exams, just 7 quizzes(~50%), online hw(~25%), and a final(~25%). Lowest quiz grade is dropped. She prefers to avoid confrontation, so if you feel like you should've received more points on your quiz, take it to her office hours and she'll add points (almost every time).

She thinks that there is nothing wrong with her teaching and doesn't understand when people do poorly. She holds a grudge against students that don't attend every lecture, even though attendance is not mandatory. Then when you make an attempt to go to this useless lecture, she still thinks you don't go, and holds it against you.

Could not care less about her students...treats them like generic cardboard cutouts. Also her accent is very peculiar. She teaches the material very quickly, and the MathXL work is very time consuming and frustrating.

This professor is a bit hard to understand and she presents the material very quickly. Hope you're a quick note taker if you take her. Hard/long quizzes. Tests aren't very hard just quite tricky, because they are multiple choice. You must be acclimated to self-teaching and precise on tests to do well. Otherwise I recommend switching.

This class was pretty much a joke of a math class. The material was humorously easy with only a few difficulties arising here and there. It's true what others say, you'll need to teach yourself a lot of the material and attending class is pointless. She offers extra credit and second chances. Final Grade was a ridiculously high A.
Take her if you're a good self-teacher.

Horrible, horrible, horrible teacher. Multiple choice exams, does not curve. On the day of the final, there were 20-25% of the students from the beginning of the course left. Avoid this lady like the plague. Drop now or switch into a new section. I considered this during drop/add but didn't want to ruin my convenient schedule. Big mistake.

I don't recommend her. She teaches straight from the book. You don't need to go to class to pass. Her exams and quizzes are not tricky, but what makes them hard is that she doesn't give enough time. She does not like to curve but if grades are really bad she will add bonus questions. Weekly hw and quizzes. the 1 good thing is she is very organized.
wow she was terrible. VERY HARD QUIZZES AND TESTS and so much homework, you feel like you'll never finish!! DON'T TAKE THIS CLASS WHATEVER YOU DO!
Absolutely  the number one worst teacher you might have. She is a Math teacher from 18th century, has no respect for students. HARD exams, boring lectures, etc
Horrible. I was just lucky to get B in this class. More than half of students dropped her class. Not recommended at all.

Definitely the WORST teacher in my life. She is the true definition of Nightmare. Very aggressive. She tortures students as if she enjoys it. About 70% of class dropped the course. She messed my 4.0 GPA. We had 2 HARD exams every week. Believe me, you gotta stay away from this Russian teacher!

Terrible teacher, very hard to understand. She makes jokes that usually no one laughs. She insists on her teaching method, even if 100% of class fails, she would put the blame on class. Exams are horrible, extremely harder than class materials. I hate it when she looks at students eye and drop off points with a nasty smile.

One of the worst teacher and person I have ever met in UF. She is obsessive, tries to keep her smile and pretend kindness while releases her childhood knots. She takes her class to seriously and easily gets pissed off when criticized. Exams are 100 times harder than her notes, we had 9 exams, each 5 hard questions and 1 final exam.

She is a brilliant professor, but a terrible teacher. Usually a professor blames himself/herself when the whole class does bad. Instead, she ends up blaming the class. Kind of hard to understand, and is useless when it comes to answering questions. Tests are much harder than examples/homework, and then takes off way too many points. Switch teachers
She is the kind of professor that smiles in your face and then gives you an "F". Her test are difficult and she doesn't care.
This class is so easy.  Its a lot of work-you have to keep up with lectures and do all the homework. The exams are easy but do the reviews.  She is nice-allows for one makeup exam. Easy A!

The class is definitely doable. Yes, she has an accent, but it's not that bad. Try to take Edwards, but if you get stuck with her then it's no big deal. She tries to make jokes during the lecture, but they're really not funny. Go to tutoring zone and you'll be okay.

WAY too much hw, questions are grammatically incorrect/confusing, she has exams on days that we don't even meet for class and they are late at night too. She doesn't keep up with the grades so I never know what exactly I have in her class.
Has a heavy accent but is a nice prof. lets you re-take one of the exams. Not bad...
Extremely critical and picky with grading. Chances are, she'll take off more points from you than you deserve. Do not take her!

Perhaps knows TOO much about the material. She rushes through lectures and by about half-way through each you're wondering what exactly it is you're trying to do. Not the absolute worst teacher ever, but below average.
Not a very good teacher, doesn't explain things very well.

Nice lady, but rushes through lectures and tries to fit in too much. You end up getting lost in her words. Luckily I had awesome TA and ended up with an A. I learned more in the once a week discussions with him than in her lectures.

Not nearly as hard as people make it out to be. Lectures are a waste of time though, dont go to them. Teach yourself the material or go to TZ if need be. Quizzes are hard but not worth that much. Do well on the tests and you'll be fine. I got a B+ with minimal effort.
TZ all the way.  Saved my grade and helped me study efficiently.   Zach is the man!

Dr.Williamson is a sweet and funny lady, but the class was HORRIBLE. Lectures were rushed, you kind of had to teach yourself. Quizzes are harder than exams. This was the class I worked the HARDEST for and ended up with the WORST grade in my life. If you really need or want to take this class, find outside help.
Very nice teacher. The class isn't too hard if you go to office hours, do the reviews, and study!! Ended up with an A and got a 100 on the final! Lectures are mandatory!

Larissa was great! You get used to her accent after the first day. She teaches well, gives challenging, but fair exams. Also, her in class reviews for the tests ALWAYS included extremely similar problems to those on exams. She is extremely helpful in her office hours. She's a sweet woman who cares about her students! Also, gave a fair amount of EC!

She seems like a really sweet lady, but it's the course that really sucks. It is definitely a weed-out course, so don't get too intimidated if you find this low-level math class ridiculous. Chances are you won't be able to understand Williamson or your TA because everyone is foreign, so you're on your own if you don't speak Russian or Chinese.

Just as the syllabus says, all of the learning involved in this course takes place outside of the classroom. Lectures are rushed and discussion sections are generally unhelpful. Do yourself a favor and take MAC1147 so you can use a calculator. No complaints about Williamson herself though.

Nothing personal, this lady is very nice, although the way she teaches is very hard to follow along with and quite useless. This is partialy due to her strong foreign accent, but her teaching style is not very good either. I do not go to class anymore because I get nothing from it, and have to be tutored non-stop. I would not recommend.

She really isn't as bad as everyone makes her out to be. When I saw these comments, I made every attempt to get out of her class, but she was the only one teaching it. You'll get used to her accent and sometimes, she's actually funny. Make sure you get a good TA. Cameron Browne was awesome! Don't freak when you hear her for the first time.

I liked Larissa a lot contrary to what ppl have 2 say about her. She uses this packet u buy 4rm target copy to go along with her lecturez that explain n organize everything really well. Her tests are pretty easy there's just a lot of hw. The only problem is that she's more concerned with finishing her notes than thoroughly explaining info

Honestly, she was not that bad. At the beginning, you woun't understand her accent, but after a while you get used to it. Plus half the stuff she says, she is also writing down, so just copy it. The class is easy. Just do the online homeowork because it shows you how to do it STEP-BY-STEP! And if you still don't get just ask your TA.
I hated this class. It was difficult and not only was my teacher useless, but my ta was no horrible. No one had a clue how to actually teach this subject.

BORING and incomprehensible. Forget watching the lectures, but it is easy to get an A if you go to the Broward math lab and have them explain it to you and help you with the online HW (tons of it). I got an A and am no math nerd. Tutoringzone definetly helps and do the practice exams at the math lab and ull do well.

If it wasn't for my TA, I would have failed this class. It's not that the material was so hard, it was that they way it was presented and reinforced was difficult for me to catch on. The MathXL was WAY over the top, not so much of a grade should rely on online homework ever. The woman herself was very impatient, dispassionate, and insensitive.

this lady have a horrible accent plus she turn off the lights in the class so you will go to sleep so don't go in there at all. Watch the lectures only if you have nothing else to do. Buy the notes from target copy if you so desire ... i didn't !! Just do the mathxl hw... if you can't figure it out ... use the view example option there.

Has a very annoying accent that is hard to understand. You do not need to attend the lectures because it is online but you have to make sure you watch them. She makes easy things hard but if you have a good TA you can get an A pretty easily because of extra credit and the mathxl homework.
She is horrible...She makes easy stuff hard, her accent is terrible and she is annoying, classes are also online. Just hope for a really good T.A. Math XL is annoying too but its easy points.

She makes the class a lot harder than it really needs to be. MathXL is a pain in the rear but a big part of your grade so do it. The lectures are online so you don't have to go to lectures which is nice because she's too hard to follow anyways. I just played them in fast mode on mute :)

She has a CRAZY accent and is very difficult to understand even though she speaks ridiculously slow. It's better to watch her online--in FAST mode--however, you miss a lot that way. I wouldn't recommend this class unless you HAVE to take it or you like math. & use TZ--Zach is amazing. Also, the dicussions can be helpful--but idk. GOOD LUCK!

Definitely an easy class considering you're allowed a calculator on the test. Online work is crucial-30% of the grade almost. Thick accent is no fun. Trig towards the end was when it got a little less easier. Whatever she teaches, don't listen to. Invent your own methods to solve the problems.
Do the Math XL!!!!!!

DO THE HOMEWORK!!! It will help your grade out as well as with the tests. She gave extra credit at end of semester, and extra credit on the final. So its not a piece of cake, but its do-able. I got an A

He is the best, 10000% recommend

the best prof hands down. u get a double sided cheat sheet on exams that u can type and print out, lowest quiz is dropped, both he and his lectures are super funny. sometimes his questions can be confusing, but still super easy. he randomly takes attendance 10 times during the semester but youll want to go to his class anyways. extra credit too!!

Great guy and professor

Great class to begin to understand the foundation of international politics and relations. The class itself was very hard; exam 1 average was ~75% and exam 2 average was ~55%.

He was a very nice guy, but his lectures just weren't great and hard to follow. He'd ramble about unimportant stuff for 75% of class and then rush through what actually mattered and most of the time miss important slides completely. Nothing he said ever really stuck for me, but you're going to have to do a lot of work on your own regardless of prof

Professor Zhang seemed like a good guy but his lectures taught me absolutely nothing. He constantly rambled about derivations and unimportant details then when he got to the examples he would always be out of time. Chang, who was the other lecturer, was significantly better and actually taught me something about physics.

A professor whose class is almost entirely determined by 3 exam grades. Lectures are really rudimentary and don't do much to prepare you for the exams which are much harder than the reviews. You'll most likely end up teaching yourself the topics or learn from and do review with the TA's. You can definitely do well in this class but Zhang won't help

He was such a nice guy, but he was an average physics professor. The class is structured nicely with lots of built in extra credit, but the exams were awful, and the lectures seemed like a waster of time. The textbook taught me pretty well, and I learned physics well.

He is very knowledgable and confusing lecturer. Exams are much more difficult that previous exams. I would never recommend taking this class with him, and you should just wait another semester for another professor. He was horrible at teaching fall 2023.
This dude was awesome. He would always start lectures with a comic relating to the topic and would tell jokes to keep people engaged. He was a great lecturer too.
great physics professor, his lectures were interesting and he explains concepts well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Although he was really nice and approachable, his lectures were so unorganized and i had no idea what was happening the entire time. he did put the iclicker questions in the pre-lecture slides though so if you missed his day you could still get credit.

Listen.. I found his lecture incredibly boring and his classes dragged on, but this has got to be the easiest class I've ever taken. You have to TRY not to get an A. There is so much extra credit that I had over a 100% in the class and just guessed on every question of the final and still ended with a high A. Half of the exam is Iclicker questions.

Dr. Bai deserves all the good things. He is by far the best Professor at UF. I know everyone says “this Professor truly cares about their students” but Dr. Bai blows every other professor out of the water. He is there not to hinder students but to see everyone succeed. Pay attention, do the work, do the extra credit. Effort will be rewarded.

Dr. Bai has been the best professor I've had. I don't typically rate professors on this platform, but Dr. Bai deserves it. He cares more about his students understanding and interest in the material more than anything else. His lectures are fantastic, the exams are material based and you won't be surprised by anything and take adv. of xtra credit.

Professor is super enthusiastic and will help you if you have any questions regarding the lecture. Lectures are presentation that are very easy to read and understand. Tons of extra credit. Tests are not that hard if you go over the lecture slides and practice questions he posts.
If you have to take genetics, take it with him. He wants you to succeed and makes it so attainable to do very well in his class. Exams are straightforward and there's extra credit.

Makes genetics feel interesting and straightforward! Make sure to sit towards the front of the class if you want to hear/understand whats going on. 

Definitely take this professor!!

Ive never rated a professor before but I feel like Bai deserves the shoutout he truly cares about his students doing well and you should take him if you want to do well in genetics his test are very straight forward most of the exam question come from in class Iclickers which he goes over and the other comes from homework.He also ofers extra credit

Dr. Bai cares so much for his students and wants all of them to succeed. He provides lots of extra credit assignments, all of which are rooted in enhancing understanding of genetics. His exams are based on iclickers that he goes over during class and are super fair. Overall, super great professor and I wouldn't take genetics with anyone else.
Great professor! He genuinely cares about his students' success. The exams are straightforward, and he often offers extra credit opportunities, which is super helpful. Highly recommend!
Great professor! I would give a higher rating if I could. Make sure to take advantage of all the extra credit.
Best class I've taken at UF! Would 100% recommend

She provides a lot of information, but does not communicate exactly what will be tested. We had 4 exams, two multiple choice and two essay format. Her grading criteria is unclear and subjective. If you're thinking of taking this as an elective, I'd suggest taking something else.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. You is very nice and obviously cares about our success in the class. Over the semester, there were 5 discussions posts and one essay, with two open note/online exams that were taken in class. The graphs that she made for lectures were hard to understand, but the slides themself had all the information. Easy A and really nice person in general!

2 open note exams in class heavily weighted. 5 discussion posts, EASY & a final essay. Grades discussions and essays very easily. Exams are pretty hard as you dont have much time to look for the answers in the slides so use other sources. All theories we talk about I learned in crim theory so u dont need to listen to lectures but go for attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Her class was easy but her organization needs serious work, a majority of her lectures consisted of scribbles on a white board and she barely covered the useful slides that she has posted on canvas. The exams are open note, but short on time. Its an easy class but not an easy elective to get an A in because of the two heavily weighted exams.

Mrs. You is the sweetest professor I have had, and she really cares about her students. I easily got a 99.75% in this class as both exams were open notes and all answers were in the PowerPoint.
