Prof. Held is an amazing professor, especially considering that she is only a graduate student right now! Her exams are very straightforward and similar to her homework assignments, and she is always eager to help when I need it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Eh shes cool

Avoid this professor if you can help it. She is inflexible, callus and inconsiderate. She has consistently made mistakes on every exam we have taken to date. Any suggestions you have to improve your experience will be overlooked. Do not expect a practice exam or any form of reliable study material. Our homework is non beneficial busywork.

Prof Abrams is such an enthusiastic professor who loves what she does. She will always show up to class excited to lecture! Her passion for her subject actually made me want to major. Her exams are a bit tough but she is generous when grading assignments.

Prof Abrams is very caring and a great lecturer. I learned a lot. But her quizzes are SO DIFFICULT, pure memorization: she would pull out one random sentence from a reading and ask you to fill in the blank. She's very nice but very hard to talk to and is so strict about grading. Don't take her intro if you have other choices.

As a sophomore, I found this class comparable in difficulty to CMC Cog Psych, for example, if not easier. Yes quizzes are about memorization, but quiz format is really great change this year instead of huge tests. Prof A is super kind and accessible. Again, intro doesn't always equal easy, but it was very interesting.

Prof Abrams is okay. There are lots of quizzes that are almost entirely memorization and it was frustrating because the multiple choice and true/false were worth so many points. She's a great person but I just didn't love the class
The professor is hard to communicate with, the weekly quiz covers too much material and the rubric is very strict. This class is just about rote learning.

Took this class 4 years ago.  By far the hardest UF class I have ever taken.  But 4 years later I actually remember a ton from this class.  Yes, I had to study my a** off, but I learned fantastic study skills and came out a better student, and a better psychologist.  If you can take the heat and put in the effort, Dr. Abrams is SO worth it.

Unless this class is required, don't take this class.  I wasted most my time studying for this class, as opposed to my other 3 and got the worst grade in this class.  She's convinced her class in interesting and thinks everybody should spend 24/7 on her class.

Tests are too hard and after going to her office hours many times, she still wouldn't help me out with a curve saying it was unfair to other students.  Then, right after that, she emailed the class saying she curved people who she thought showed interest in her class. Her class is dreadfully boring and I wouldn't sign up for it if I were you.

Abrams is an excellent teacher. If you want to learn a lot about cognitive psychology's current research, take this class. That being said, it's not easy. Study several days in advance for the exams. They will be hard. You will need the book, because the exam includes questions from experiments that are only covered in the book (not in class).

If you are looking for an easy A do NOT take this class. On that note, Dr Abrams is a fantastic teacher. SUPER nice and helpful and uses plenty of examples to make sure the concept really sinks in. Her tests are hard. Really hard. But you can go sit in her office & talk about it later. Very casual, comfortable office hours. Approachable. But tough.

Best professor at UF!  I had no interest in cognitive psych before I took the class, am in love now.  REALLY hard tests, have to study your butt off, but you learn a lot.  Visit in office hours, very approachable. Take detailed notes! You can print the slides before class and take notes on them, will be much easier.  Make her your friend!

Fantastic professor. Difficult class and crazy hard exams, but she definitely makes the material interesting. I very much enjoyed her class and would highly recommend it, although quite the challenge. She is also the type of individual who loves to chat with her students during her office hours- very approachable

Dr. Abrams is seriously one of the most dedicated and caring profs at UF. anyone who says otherwise is BITTER bc her tests are hard. well guess what? life is hard! Go to her office hours and learn how to tackle her difficult tests. you will learn a lot and thats what college is about.
great professor, tests can be really hard if not studied, but by doing the study guides she gives you should cover all the information you  need to pass the tests

All of the other comments are 100% true.  This is an interesting class, she keeps class fun.  The test are HARD!! the book and attendance is a must! Don't be fooled, this class does require a lot of time!!

Dr. Abrams is the best professor I have had at UF so far. She is not easy but you know what you need to know for the future. I have never learned more in my life. Go to class, book is mandatory, study, and you should do fine.

Knowledgable, helpful, clear, and she keeps you attentive. She  manages to pay attention to each individual even if there are 100+ kids. I missed an A by a point, but she gave it to me b/c she knows I participate in class. You have to study every slide, every page in the book, and every article. Her wording on tests will kill grades, STUDY.

This class was a lot of fun! I enjoyed attending but PLEASE DO NOT BE FOOLED! The tests are very hard even with a lot of studing. If you attend every class, read the text and study A LOT you can get an A. If you don't want a class that you have to REALLY work for, don't take this one. But besides that, she is very understanding and interesting.

Dr. Abrams is one of my favorite teachers at UF.  She genuinely cares about your progress in the class and will help you a lot in office hours.  The class most definitely is not easy - but she does give extra credit!

Abrams is a great professor. Lectures are interesting and informative. I always thought when other students would say "the tests are just too hard!" that it was just because they didn't study hard enough. Her tests are hard- study for about 5 days in advance, go to class, do the extra credit, work hard and you can manage an A.

Dr. Abrams is a great professor, she really knows her stuff and lectures very well. The classes are not boring but the class is EXTREMELY difficult and tests are not in the least something you can blow off until the night before. I would honestly recommend you take this class with someone else if you're looking for an A.

Initially I was intimidated by this course, but after one class session I was excited to face the challenge.  Dr. Abrams is enthusiastic and knowledgable about psychology.  She guided us through our class discussions in such a way that our 3hr class never got boring.  I learned a lot, and she treated us to pizza on the last day!  Dr. Abrams rocks.

Lise Abrams is my favorite professor at UF so far. her cognitive psych class is hard, but i haven't learned so much in any other class i have taken. the tests are tough, so start doing the study guide 4 or 5 days in advance. I realized that the difference between getting an A and a B on her tests is about 5 or 6 (more) study hours

She says the class is tough but fair, which sums it up really well. Abrams is a great professor and you will learn a lot. Tests are challenging so study hard. She also takes attendence on random days.

I took her class last semester. I thought she was a good teacher. She's very nice and teaches well. The test were not too bad. I read the book and studied her slides and did pretty well. She's very good overall.

Her exams were hard for no reason because of the stupid fill in the blank questions that i hated. Her exams are harder than any other exam I have taken in any other psychology class. Start studying 4 days before the exam. Read a chapter a day or so and try to integrate the material so that you can do better on her fill in the blank terminology.

Dr. Abrams is amazing. Everyone complains about how hard her class is, but come on it college what did you expect? She is the first professor that has truly challenged me, and I love her for it. She loves what she teaches and is extremely helpful. I think he exams are difficult but fair. If you really want to learn cog. psych. take it w/ her :o)

This is quite possibly the most difficylt class I have taken at UF. She is a nice teacher, very knowledgeable, and helpful, but her tests are absolutely ridiculous! I haven't experienced anything like this in my 5 semesters at college. This class DOES make you want to shoot yourself. Seriously, find a different teacher b/c you don't wanna take her
Terribly boring teacher, unnecessarily hard tests, and its just a class that makes u want to shoot urself, she is nice but in a sort of stab u in the back way, cause her class is so hard

She's a real GPA buster! Cognitive psych - lots of us in this class are scraping by with a B or C.  Abrams takes pride in making her tests more complex than the material.  If you need an A, stay away! (But, she's nice and knowledgeable, just her tests are the most unreasonably difficult I have taken in five semesters of college.)

I do not consider Dr. Abrams a fair teacher..I am taking her class and am recieving an A, and still, I find her completely unfair and if i did not come into this class with a decent bacground with cognitive psych i think i would be doing misrable. She is a very nice women, but seriously...take a different teacher.

Truly a great example of what a college professor should be: well-educated, able to clearly communicate information to students, and an excellent mentor.  If you're serious about learning cognitive psych and are willing to work and think HARD, this is the professor to choose!
very tough grad course but she is nice and interesting
she is awesome.  difficult class, but very fair & i learned a ton

This class is great, and I don't even like cognitive psych. Abrams is AWESOME. Her tests are challenging, but come on folks, this is college... and UF nonetheless. Stop expecting an easy A. I got a C+, and I admit I didn't try as hard as I should have,  bu

Dr. A is awesome...she's helpful & loves what she does (and it shows)...her tests are hard, but if you pay attention and read (YUK)..you'll do just fine....the best part of class: the day Dr. A imitates Yoda!!!

Dr. Abrams is a good professor. Her lectures are clear, the material is interesting, and the tests are fair. The class is not an easy A however it is pretty easy to obtain a B. I highly recommend this course, I learned a lot. If you want to get an easy A, don't take this class but if you want to learn, take this course.
She is a great teacher, but the test are WAY hard!!
She's a great teacher, though you have to do work to get a good grade. She gives you every opportunity to do good, it's up to you to show up to class and pay attention.
If you go to class, pay attention and study well you will do really well. She is a great teacher and I learned so much! I highly recommend taking this class!

Tough, really tough tests. You'll not pass this class without squeezing your brain seriously. Pay attention in class and take very good notes. She talks non stop and more than half of what she puts on her tests, comes from lectures.
Fun class but really tough tests, prepare for lots of quality study time

Not an easy class at all the way she sets it up. Tests are very critical thinking oriented and have essays/fill in the blanks with no word bank. She makes the class interesting but a LOT of studying is required.
No Comments
She is not very helpful when you have questions or concerns. Sometimes she does not explain things clearly and often expects more on the test than she previously states.
Dr. Abrams is an AMAZING teacher!!!  You will learn so much from!!!!
Dr. Abrams is wonderful, which is why she recently won a teaching award.

Great lecturer, but make sure you go to class because you'll miss so much if you don't. The only negative thing I will say is that her exams are pretty tough, but they're very low stakes (8% each) so you will be fine if you perform poor on one. An A is definitely achievable, I managed a B+ while being sick for 3 weeks and missing tons of lectures.

Professor Ahlgren is an amazing professor. She is extremely well-spoken and knows the material extremely well. She is not the type to rely on slides and explains things very throughly. She is always open to answering questions and her office hours are extremely helpful.

Great lectures, organized and high quality, with a knowledgeable instructor. However, the workload is intense (21+ hrs/week), making it stressful, especially without an anatomy background. Many worry about AI/Honorlock. I would NOT take this class again. I've gotten A's in my past courses and this is my first C. This course will lower your GPA.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Great lectures, organized, engaging, and high quality, with a knowledgeable instructor. However, the workload is intense (21+ hrs/week), making it stressful, especially without an anatomy background. Many worry about AI/Honorlock. I would NOT take it again I got a C when I usually get A's in my previous courses.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Doc A is so paranoid about cheating that it negatively affected my learning experience. I've looked things up from class using other reliable anatomical resources to find them not to exist or be contradictory. I appreciate being graded on effort for assignments. But some of her questions do not align with what we are being taught.
Wow. Incredible, knowledgeable, smart

Amazing enthusiastic professor. Explains content clearly and encourages questions. Study consistently because the lab and lecture have their own material and exams (7 total). Lots of easy assignments and extra credit to boost your grade—homework is like 20% of the total. She is also active on the groupme which is great.

Although her class is very test heavy and on the more difficult side, her lectures are amazing and really help you prepare for her tests! Make sure to start studying as you go because it'll all pile up on you and her test questions get very niche. Such a passionate teacher and so caring for her students.

Dr. A is the best! She was extremely passionate about the subject, and explained material in ways that we could understand. Her lectures were very engaging, and extra credit additionally motivated me to come to class. She is extremely responsive and always makes time for questions. You can tell that she truly cares about her students.

She is a fantastic lecturer, but the class is the only way to get most of the information. I wish there were notes or she lectured out of the textbook. It would make it much easier to fully absorb information if you could review it multiple times, even if you're bad at taking notes.
Incredibly kind, caring, and a great lecturer. Gives you all the materials you need to succeed and get an A.

She's a great professor and very passionate about her class and students. Her lectures are interesting and she lectures great. Definitely study weekly because there's always a test around the corner. She has help resources and a final SG. Smokinnotes also offers the class which is helpful.

She is very passionate about the subject and cares about her students. Use her LO's, smokin notes, and go to class to get her notes. The class is very exam heavy, but she offers a lot of extra credit opportunities.
Professor Ahlgren cares so much about her students and wants to see them succeed! For this class I would recommend doing the learning objectives and using Smokin' Notes to study for her exams!

Lectures are packed with material, but she explains topics very clearly and always provides time for questions if she thinks people may be unsure. Attendance isn't mandatory, but it is definitely recommended in order to suceed. She also offers plenty of other opportunities to do good in her class beyond the exams.

Lectures are packed with information and she moves super quick and expects you to know everything. Lecture exams are very difficult. Overall she is very nice and well informed in the subject but not an easy class.

Doc A. is FANTASTIC. An amazing and entertaining lecturer who definitely loves what she's teaching. The lecture exams are actually difficult nonetheless and hard to prep for because there's no practice exams but she does offer extra credit. She really loves students and designs her class so that you are forced to succeed.

Dr. A is easily one of the best professors I have ever had. Lectures explain concepts really well, and although there is a lot of info to know on exams, exam questions are fair and straightforward. Pop quizzes for attendance as well as sharing study materials gain you extra credit points. Dr. A cares so much about her students and their success!

If you're an APK student with the chance to take kinetic anatomy with Doc A, I highly recommend it! It helped me lots for my other classes. It's also pretty fun! Lectures are online that you watch before going to class. Once a week in-class activity (you choose which day you come). For lab period, everyone attends and you learn with anatomy models.
Very passionate about anatomy and amazing lectures. Lecture exams are HARD but not weighted very much. Take advantage of all the extra credit and do well on lab exams to pad your grade.

Doc A is the best! I cannot imagine taking anatomy with anyone else. Lecture exams are challenging but grade is padded with other assignments/lab exams. One of the best lecturers - go to class and pay attention! That is how you will learn and do well in this class along with doing all the extra credit.

Doc A has a great lecture and loves teaching this class. The hardest part of this class is the lecture exams. They are extremely difficult, do not expect to score high. But with the hw, lab exams, and extra credit, do not worry about scoring low on the lecture exams, it all works out.

Great class overall and great lectures. The tests are difficult and require you to REALLY know the material but there was a good amount fo extra credit to motivate you to go to class. I would definitely recommend Doc A over another professor
She was great. There are strict grading criteria and NO minus grades. Lots of extra credit but tests are difficult. Know the material inside out and backwards

best prof ever. talks very fast but rly passionate and cares about if you learn. wants you to know everything down to the smallest detail. 100000% prepares you for the mcat and medical school. tons of EC offered in pop attendance quizzes. easy exams tbh. didn't read the book ever. very accessible outside the classroom. very nice and easy to talk to
She is such a passionate instructor, amazing lectures. Tests are tough but it will get easier once you get used to them, she really wants you to learn from the class.

She is one of the best professors I've ever had! Loved her and the class. It was hard, but she was really fair. She really cares about her students. I highly recommend reaching out to her if you need help, and she will meet with you and do everything she can for the students active in the course.

Dr. Ahlgren is a very caring and passionate professor, with well designed lectures. With that said, her class was the most difficult class I have taken in my career. But, the course is set up so the exams aren't worth the majority of your grade. . Would recommend if you are very passionate about anatomy.

I loved her class, she made me love anatomy more than I already did. She is very knowledgeable about the content and clearly loves what she does. I would definitely take another one of her classes. Everything on the exams is said in lecture, you just have to pay attention. Studying with groups or reading other people's notes/flashcards is helpful
Awful tests are completely unfair avoid.

The absolute best! The class is tough and requires lots of studying, but there are lots of resources available to help you. Her lectures are amazing! Be ready to study. The exams are tricky if you aren't fully prepared

Ahlgren is amazing. She has a real passion for anatomy and it shows. She is super enthusiastic about the class and is always telling stories about her life and how it relates to the stuff she's teaching. Her exams are hard but fair and she provides opportunity for extra credit. I learned a lot and it was fun. Overall great experience!

Ahlgren is amazing, honestly the best professor I have had so far at UF. If you can, try to take her online section, as you'll have access to all of her (amazing) lectures whenever you want. Difficult exams, but if you study you will do fine. Offered a ton of extra credit, the lab portion was fun and a grade booster. This class made me love anatomy

Avoid the fake reviews. If you can avoid, please do It will save your GPA. take it at a community college instead. Same credit. Ahlgren is a great professor she is funny, caring, she has lots of personality to her. However, her exams are extremely hard they are not meant to help you but trick you. She offers a lot of extra credit. hardest class

Dr. Ahlgren was by far my favorite professor I have had so far at the university. She gives great lectures that include all the information you need to know for the exams. The homework is a quiz or two every week that is on the topic you're covering in class. Smokin notes helped me with the exams but you would probably be fine without it.

She is an AMAZING professor!! She is genuinely interested in what she teaches and it shows. I would 100% tell someone to take her class. I was obsessed with her, shes so cool. Anatomy is a lot of labeling and can be boring but she makes it fun to learn.

Doc A is the best! She is very passionate about the subject and tells fun stories during lecture. Her tests are difficult and lots of questions are application-based, but she offers some extra credit opportunities to help. My advice is to relisten through her lectures, since the exams are based more on the lectures rather than the book.

Amazing teacher highly recommend!! She is so passionate and makes learning the material fun. It is a very material dense class. Also spend time in the lab, especially before the first lab exam because there is tons of content, and it doesnt align with lecture material like the lab 2 exam does.

Dr. A is a great professor who cares deeply about her students and wants them to be successful. She gives difficult and application based tests. She is a great professor and I highly recommend taking her class. If you want a good grade you will absolutely have to put in the work. Focus on her lectures but use the textbook to supplement
Understanding and respectful, especially about mental health. I'd love to take another class with her
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Ahlgren is the best professor I have ever had. She is an amazing lecturer and is passionate about anatomy and the success of her students. She genuinely wants you to learn and do well. Her lecture exams are extremely difficult, but what you learn in this class is more valuable than any grade. Lab Exams, Homework, and Extra Credit help a TON!

Doc A is one of, if not the best, teachers I have had in my life and my time at UF. She is extremely passionate about anatomy and her passion for the subject was contagious! She made our course content so interesting, relevant, fun to learn, and engaging. I learned a ton this semester, and I am so thankful I got to take this class with Doc A

Doc A is absolutely the most wonderful teacher ever. Along with many other reviews I can vouch that she truly cares about her students and the course material. Tests are hard but instruction is clear on what you need to know. The homework really helps bringing your grade back up too if you need it.

Doc A is the best and most understanding college professor you will ever get. I had some extreme family circumstances this semester, and she worked with me to help me succeed in her class. So caring and so amazing. Midterm exams are difficult, but lab exams, homework, and extra credit help to cushion it.
i love her, i could marry her. best prof i've had at UF yet. tests are very hard but the class is fair bc HW helps you out a ton. study and go to office hours and you'll be fine!

Absolutely loved Ahlgren. She was the best professor I have had so far at college. She truly cares about her students and is incredibly knowledgeable about the material. Yes her tests are hard, but they are incredibly fair. There isn't really anything that you don't learn in class. Definitely take her if you have a choice.

Ahlgren is an amazing professor! You can tell she truly LOVES the material she teaches. She will warn you and is fully aware that her tests are super difficult though. If you study and put in the work to actually learn instead of memorize you'll be fine!! 10/10 recommend over anybody else. Attendance is not a grade, but you need to go to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great professor.... teaches the material exceptionally well but will still take a ton of time to get a good grade. She makes her exams difficult, but helps with retaining information for future classes.

One of my favorite profs at UF so far :) Workload was very fair, mostly quizzes and discussions with two projects that we had the whole semester to do (also fun because we got to choose any topics about the microbiome we liked). I really enjoyed her lectures and can tell she is very passionate about what she does! Very sweet and accessible as well

Dr Ahrens accomplishes what she sets out to do: Cause you to be and stay curious! You are largely allowed to follow your own specific microbial interests within the scope of the class, and this makes one much more scientifically literate and competent.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Ahrens made sure to always keep in contact with her students. In an online program, this is crucial. However, she also was there for hands-on help and primarily required you to interact with your podmates. She fostered a very welcome and advantageous environment for students. I took this course in the summer and would not recommend it enough!

Wonderful professor! Long lectures but no exams. Capstone presentation (25 min) and a Ted talk (5 min). Handful of open note quizzes (lowest dropped). Put in the work and you'll get an A. The people who rated her poor got a low grade because they didn't try. She's a wonderful professor!

Dr. Ahrens is the best professor I have had in my graduate time at UF thus far!!! The class has 2 major projects and open book quizzes (3 attempts, highest kept), and a few purusall assignments in-between. She is extremely knowledgeable about the subject, extremely nice to talk to and provides excellent feedback. Put in effort = A! I got a 98!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Very easy class, a lot of busy work, spent 1-3 hours a week on this class. 2 major projects and only 1 was tedious but u have a lot of time to do it. no exams, lowest quiz dropped, everything open note and unproctored. uses a groupme and is very understanding. i submitted a project late due to sickness and she did not penalize me and reached out

This was Exploring Our Genome, and I found it simple. The weekly assignments were easy as long as you kept track of them. There was not much interaction with the professors. However, Dr. Ahrens's pre-recorded lectures were needlessly long. However, quizzes were open notes and there was no final, just a capstone project.

Dr. Ahrens, was excellent. Now, I will say there were multiple projects, but I loved that the discussions were on a different platform. I loved that this was not a test-heavy course and more aligned with other master's courses than some extremely test-heavy ones. I loved this class. I will say she is slow to respond but always responds.

Somewhat work-heavy, but very doable. Do your discussion work (usually summarizing/analyzing a research article) in bits throughout the week and knock out the quizzes (short, easy, open notes) when they open. Big project is manageable and not graded particularly harshly. No essays, no exams, extra credit available on some discussions.

I am one of many reviews that attest to how actually awful taking this class was. There were probably four professors for this class which should've been a red flag off the bat because this is a Quest class. Are we serious. So many hours weekly spent doing the most arbitrary and useless busy work that contributes nothing to the course. DONT TAKE.
I am taking Chem 2 at the same time that I'm taking this class. I spend more time doing stuff for this class. I chose this quest because it was online. It was not worth it.

Way more interested in forcing group collaboration & following internet trends than in actual teaching. Claims that grades are individual and not based on group projects, but assignments are based on group participation and grades are based on how well you work with the group. Confusing due dates. Constant changes to rules. Unclear grading scales
Awful professor with no grading criteria.

Genuinely awful class and professors. Said they expect 6 hours of effort a week towards a level 2000 quest class. 
Half of your grade is based on a single group pro

Definitely the hardest quest 2 class I've heard of. Way too many lectures that are way too long and still none of the quiz questions come from the lectures. Over half of your grade is based on a group project and the class is online which makes it extremely difficult to collaborate effectively.

Worst Quest 2 class ever. We signed up because there's no options for online Quest 2 classes not because we care about the Human Genome. We are doing a group project on a topic and not only do we ALL get points off when members don't participate/show up to the zoom calls, we also have to find and interview a researcher in the field we're studying.

I had to spend more time on this class than all of my other classes this semester. Lots of assignments with confusing due dates. The biggest grade is a group project so yeah.. not the best. Also, grading is extremely slow most times.

A bit stressful because she really expects you to put in the effort. However, if you submit good work and actively participate you shouldn't have any problems. There are a ton of group projects in this class but the quizzes are open note and easy.

Would not recommend for Quest 1. Entire class was graded on one project and 4 papers. Papers had little to no instruction and if you asked Dr. Ahlberg or the TA for clarification they would say “it depends.” Papers were also graded harshly and feedback was vague and  3 unexcused absences for the semester.

Dr. Ahlberg was extremely easy to understand, especially considering this was my first philosophy class. The readings were extremely interesting and her insight on what we had read connected all the dots, but also if you miss a reading its not a big deal at all. Do NOT be intimidated by this class, it was the perfect introduction to philosophy.

Dr. Ahlberg is a fantastic teacher. She always generated interesting conversations and fostered our curiosity, but made sure to keep everyone on track. Class discussions were lively and relevant. You definitely have to read, but the readings weren't bad. Attendance/participation is graded, but you get 3 free unexcused absences.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Ahlberg is able to break down some of the most dense philosophy and make it make sense. The assignments are structured in a way where you have to keep up with the reading, but it's manageable. A lot of the class is discussion-centered, so it's really engaging if you're new to philosophy. Definitely recommend if you're interested in it!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I heard people say she's intimidating but like one time she asked at the start of class how we're all doing, and some girl upfront said "vibes," then the professor was like "that sounds cool I'm gonna start saying 'vibes' now." definitely not intimidating. Really awesome prof, i love her
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: For a Quest 1 course that is mainly for freshmen to take, she expects more than just introductory college level writing, more like philosophy major level writing. She can be pretty vague in terms of expectations and criteria for papers. Very nice person and was very understanding for COVID. Also great lecturer. Just wished she graded better.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I thought Professor Ahlberg was overall very fair and caring. She really tried to engage the class and seemed very passionate about what she was teaching. She also adapted the class very well when we were suddenly changed to an online format due to COVID-19.

If u don't like reading/writing, don't take it. All assignments & exams are written. The TA grades all the work, I had Jim & he was cool. Lectures are required if you have to turn in a paper or don't understand the reading but missing a class overall isn't a big deal. Great lecturer & loves to call people out when their arguments don't make sense.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very disappointed with this class. The course name has "feminism" in it, and this topic was definitely not the focus of this class. Lots of reading and assignments with very subjective grading and misleading guidelines. In lecture she is not clear with the points she is trying to get across. This class was not an enjoyable experience, very hard A
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Assigns TONS of reading, and if you're interested in feminism, be careful--this is very much a philosophy class, and she wants her papers written that way without really describing how to. She was very nice, though the lectures could be kind of drab.

Prof Ahlberg is really kind, but pushes back when people say things that don't make sense. Her lectures are clear and intelligent. She makes connections throughout the course and doesn't assume the class is dumb. She also allows students to participate, even in large lectures.

She's nice. Classes can somewhat catch your interest. Discussion is really boring and pointless tho. Two 1200 word papers worth half the grade and a lot of pesky little homework assignments that are 20%. Final exam is 20%. The class reminds me of a high school  class. She writes the notes for you and you just copy them down
My favorite in the department. So kind, helpful, down to earth, and knowledgeable. If you demonstrate effort you will be rewarded.

A very cool professor who can communicate ideas clearly and is very helpful. However, papers are graded solely by TAs and, unfortunately, the quality of them is unpredictable and oftentimes disappointing because they are all phil grad students (little to no teaching experience). I learned so much from this class though! I got a B+.

She is great! Really sweet, fair, the kind of people that will listen to you, care, and its clear to what she expects. Provides you with study guides, very organized lectures, and always willing to help. Definitely recommend it!

Loved this class. The grade is based on two short papers and a final paper, but make sure you KNOW WHAT YOUR TALKING ABOUT! It also helps to give personal incite in your papers. Attendance is mandatory, so if don't like going to class you'll have a problem. The discussions are interesting and she likes to call you out when your wrong.
Great professor! I took this course for a gen ed requirement, and would 100% take it with her again.
Easy class, mostly playposit videos with few written assignments that take ~1-2 hours.

Man's Food was absolutely amazing online. General class about food- nutrition, food art, flavors, food groups etc. Each week: 10 min lecture, open note quiz, no exams, and one assignment (ex: eat at a restaurant and document the experience, make food art, make a personalized diet plan.) Final exam was a digital scrapbook.

Remember when learning used to be fun? Dr. Ahn actually makes it fun again. Can't believe I'm saying this, but I actually enjoyed doing the assignments in this class. Super engaging and easy to follow. Definitely recommend it for bio credit, international credit, or just a chill elective.

There is genuinely so much extra credit and opportunities to get an A in this course that you frankly need to be doing nothing to not. It can be a little tedious at times, but it is extremely easy -- and the many assignments can be done in 1-2 hrs.

Dr. Ahn's FOS2001 class is super easy to navigate, and her lectures are really relatable and interesting. She genuinely cares about her students and is always willing to help. The low-stakes assignments are fun and manageable, making the course stress-free—but don't miss the due dates!
Dr. Ahn's FOS2001 class is great! There are lots of assignments (about two a week), but they're fun and different. She uses quizzes, discussions, and projects—plus awesome extra credit opportunities!
Dr. Ahn is such a great professor! She's really caring and explains everything clearly. Her class is super interesting, and the assignments are fun and meaningful. I'm loving this course!
Absolute Ton of work for an Online Course, but the material is pretty easy. Was a struggle to get through the amount of work sometimes.
Super easy class. No exams, open note quizzes straight from lecture. Assignments are simple. Best class for a bio gen ed credit and her lectures are interesting.

Professor Ahn was super nice, took this course for credits and gpa boost, and it was super easy. Lectures are on PlayPosit and are super easy. The quizzes are easy, too. No exam, just some discussions and a digital project. I passed with an A, and I'm someone who gets distracted easily.
Super easy A. Strongly recommend for a gen ed class. Maybe 2-3 hours of work per week max.
Easy class. 100% recommended if you're looking for easy bio gen ed.
Very very easy class to fulfill gen ed requirements!!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Super chill class; lectures are split into short videos; weekly quizzes are Honorlocked, but allowed to have a page of notes; 3 major assignments, but none take more than a day; most people end with over an 100 with all the extra credit there is

Dr. Ahn's lectures were short, funny, and interesting. The class is very easy if you need GenEd credits, but also interesting if Food Science is what you care about. You could tell she was caring of the students and puts a lot of extra credit opportunities. Overall an easy grade for a fun class.
Man's Food is an easy A course if you put in the 1-2 hours of work per week. Very nicely organized class  and Dr. Ahn is a great lecturer; no complaints.

Probably one of the easiest classes at UF. Weekly open note quizzes and assignments. Only critique is all of the quizzes are honorlocked which can be annoying. Other than that, 100000% would recommend for an easy biological science credit

Dr. Ahn is amazing! She cares about your success and tried her best to get to know each person in class. Lectures were easy to follow, and we were allowed to have 2 sheets of paper, front and back, to use as a cheat sheet for the exam. Exam mostly covers topics from the study guide, but be prepared for some questions regarding in-class discussions.

Absolutely love this course! The professor's lectures are amazing and super organized. The topics are inspiring, and even though there are more assignments than I expected, they're actually fun! This is the first course I've truly enjoyed while learning so much. The professor is funny and caring. Highly recommend!

The professor is polite and organized, but the course is not enjoyable. It's a combination of rote memorization and busy work. I understand most students assign a favorable rating to professor's who are easy, but I think its disrespectful that we have come to terms with paying ridiculous fees for subpar courses just to satisfy useless degree reqs.
Dr Ahn is lovely & passionate about FS. I took this class to fulfill a credit, but ended up enjoying the content. Print out your notes for quizzes and you should get an A

Super easy class with small work load. Lectures were easy to understand and directly related to exams. Just make sure to take notes or print them out as all quizzes and exams were open notes. Very hard to get below an A in this class.

She has a textbook you can read but I got an A- without ever even looking at it.  Dr. Ahn is very understanding and amazing at explaining complex concepts in a fun way.  I was not interested in food science but her teaching made me so interested.  Everything is open note and come pretty much directly from the lectures, which tend to be short.

The BEST food science course I have taken at UF. Dr. Ahn is so much fun and she really cares about her students. She has talent for explaining complex concepts in the easiest way possible. And she brings many real-life examples. This is a fun course with a nice professor that you can actually learn a lot about food safety.

This professor is WONDERFUL! If you're looking for a bio online credit- this is it. The lectures were interesting and I felt like I learned things despite not needing to do a ton of work. The class is organized and straight forward. This is the blueprint for a good online class. Ended the semester with a 101% while putting in 1-2 hours a week!
Actually such an easy class if you are taking Man's food. Don't stress at all I spent maybe 1-2 hrs per week. Also, I found the lectures to be very engaging and fun to watch.

Super easy class. You don't even need the textbook. Just watch the lectures, either take notes or print the transcript and highlight the important stuff. Dr. Ahn makes her lectures really simple and easy to understand, just don't let due dates sneak up on you. Assignments aren't that hard, just require slightly more work. Open note exams & quizzes.
Super easy online course. Not hard at all if you watched lectures and read the textbook and take decent notes.

Interesting course. Maybe the most organized online course offered at UF and the best option for Gen Ed Bio. Very nice and caring professor. One of my favorite courses I have taken at UF, and probably the best online course.

Dr. Ahn was very caring. She was always available to speak with her students and asked if there was
something she could help with. I might have ended up with C or D, but she encouraged me to do better. Happy that I ended with B+! Thanks, Dr. Ahn. You are the best.

I took this class as a bio credit and it ended up being my favorite class of the semester. Very easygoing professor and the material is interesting to learn about. Exams and quizzes are Honorlocked, but she allows you to use notes on paper, so make sure you take notes on lecture slides because they end up being very useful.
Easiest bio science credit at UF, 100% would recommend taking as it was also pretty interesting.
This professor is so sweet and the class was quite easy. The quizzes are all open note and she drops the lowest exam grade. Very fair grader, would 100% recommend this course.

This class was very fun to learn about. The professor is very sweet and her exams and quizzes are very fair. Definitely take this class if you are considering it and need a class to lighten your course load.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This course requires LOADS of writing. But if you are interested in the topic, this is definitely a fun course. Business plan is confusing, but if you request a meeting, Dr Ahn takes her time to help you complete the plan. She was always available and willing to help. I did learn a lot. And Dr Ahn was very caring.

meh, wasnt the best professor ever and wasnt the worst either. some busy work which is common in online courses but it is what it is. if you do some minor studying youll be fine. quizzes are open note, exams are not. review quiz questions and lecture notes to succeed

This course was recommended by my roommates. Unfortunately Dr. Ahn changed exams to closed note (thanks to all those stupid people jabbering how easy it was, I guess) so more difficult than I thought. But if you study, you will do fine. I am learning a lot, and she is also very accommodating. Still a good option for Bio credit.

I took Man's Food because my friends recommended it. It seems she made change in the course and it is not as easy as I thought, but I am learning a lot. This course is quite interesting, and Dr. Ahn is a great teacher. She explains complex concept well, and cares a lot about her students. I will find more courses that she teaches.

She makes the assignments for this class so tedious and requires a lot of unnecessary things such as adding citations/sources on me tracking my OWN diet (which I don't understand how that's possible).
Dr. Ahn was very positive and wanted to help students in any way she could. Her lectures were very easy to follow and she was very fair in grading too.

Dr. Ahn was a decent prof. There was a quiz due almost every week based on the lectures plus 2 assignments which were a bit challenging, but doable. Both quizzes and exams were open notes, but I would still study if I were you. Be sure to review the quizzes and take notes from lectures to prepare yourself for exams.

I had personal issues this year and was giving up most school work. Dr. A reached me, made sure if I am doing OK, and helped me. Thanks to her, I was able to complete the course. She inspired me to do so and I thank Dr. A for that. The nicest professor I have had at uf.

Great professor who knows how to effectively teach an online course. Lectures were short and fun to watch, and her grading was very fair. And she really cares about her students' success and wellbeing. Highly recommended.

Great professor with well-structured course. Only 2 big assignments as well as 3 exams. Exams are open note and lectures are great so just print those out. Participation comes from simply watching the lectures with 2 questions for each. Would definitely recommend taking it.

I love how Dr. Ahn managed the course. She is super-organized and gives the best online lectures - not boring but actually fun, and assignments are interesting. To me, this course was not too easy, but not too hard. Perfect for someone who just started college as she is so caring and constantly checks up on students.

I love Dr. Ahn and her class. She understands students' need and make her course very manageable. Her exam and quiz questions were fair as long as you listen to her lectures, and assignments were super fun. She is so organized and lectures are wonderful, making so easy to understand. Best course I've taken at UF.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Ahn is the best professor I have at UF. Lectures are fun and her exams are fair. She is very organized ane so caring. She always replied to my emails within a couple of hours. I even didn't know this class was so big (500 or something) because she always made me feel like I am the only one in class. Highly recommended.

Super manageable class, just watch lectures, takes notes, and you will get an A on all the exams and quizzes. Exams and quizzes are both open notes and based exactly off of her lecture slides. Super easy and great class to get a gen ed out of the way.

Super easy class! Easy way to get some requirements done at UF. Pro tip: print the module power powers before each exam so you have it next to you (she said this is allowed), the questions on the exams are in order to the module powerpoints.

I will be taking my third course with Dr. Ahn in spring 23 to complete my minor in food science. She is amazing! She makes her exams open note and gives you great feedback. She always encourages and motivates you, if you got a low score on an exam and will help you in every way possible. 100/10

Loved Professor Ahn!! Her lectures prepare you for the quizzes and test. If you do the work you will get an easily get an A. Her tests are open note and she allows you to print out the transcripts from her lessons for them. I definitely recommend this because the questions come straight from the lecture.

This class was a CAKE walk. Not only that, it was very enjoyable and interesting. Do NOT buy the textbook, not needed. The exams are completely open note and assignments are simple. Definitely recommend!

You don't need the textbook. Take simple notes on the super short lectures each week and you're set for A's on all the exams. Everything is open-note. Extra credit opportunities that aren't needed, but too easy not to do. Highly recommend!
Really easy class with minimal work per week. Don't buy the textbook as you never use it.

very easy, DON'T BUY THE TEXTBOOK I FINISHED WITH 100.8% WITHOUT IT, you can finish the work for the week in an hour, just stay on top of assignments and it's mad easy and more interesting than other bio sciences

Great professor. Tests were literally info from the lectures. Just take notes, look at lecture transcripts, and do the extra credit. Honestly the best class I've taken in years at UF. Highly recommend it for a biological course requirement. Plus the professor was really nice and informative.

Amazing professor and a great class to take. The class is very organized and very easy to access all the information and lectures. I loved that the lectures keep you engages by asking questions in them. Such a great class and very interesting.

FOS 2001 Man's food was one of easiest classes I have taken at UF. Dr. Ahn organized the course in a manner that was structured and easy to understand. The exams are open notes and as long as you take notes on the lectures, you'll get an A on each on of them. Most of the course is watching the lecture and taking a short easy quiz after.

I took Dr. Ahn's Nutrition through Flex Learning. Her entire course set up was AMAZING with great lecture videos, nice course page and fun assignments. Exam questions were fair and she graded my work super fast. My roommate took HUN2201 with other instructor, and we both agree Dr. Ahn's course is far better and interesting. Highly Recommended!
She is knowledgeable about the topics and explains complicated topics very well. Her lectures were fun and she made even dull topics enjoyable. Very understanding and caring professor.
By far the easiest class I have taken at UF...If you need a bio credit TAKE THIS CLASS! I finished with over a 100%

She is so sweet and caring. She has the course very well organized and concise expectations. She is willing to work with her students and actually made the course content interesting. The exam reviews were solid and the exams are open note.

She gave amazing lectures and always kept the material interesting. One of the few online classes where I did not find myself dreading to watch the lectures. The tests and quizzes are all open note and are pulled straight from her lecture slides. Overall easy A and there is a good amount of extra credit.

Dr. Ahn is very understanding and cares for her students. I had serious mental issue and could not focus, failing in her class. She really helped me through, encouraging me every step, giving more time. I was able to finish the course with B+! THANK YOU, Dr. Ahn
She is very understanding and provides many opportunities to do well in this course. Easy A.
She is a very understanding professor and provides lots of opportunities to do well in this course. Easy A.

Dr. Ahn is THE BEST. I had some difficulties this year, and could not focus in any class. Dr. Ahn helped me through, and supported in various ways. Also, her lectures are amazing and so fun. It is obvious that she truly cares about her students.

Easy course that has weekly lectures and quizzes, which are very simple and straightforward. The few assignments are not hard but slightly time-consuming. Exams are open-note/not proctored and extra credit is offered. A pretty easy 3 credit course with an interesting topic.
This is the easiest class I've ever taken. I can finish assignments for the week in like 30 minutes. The professor is super nice and exams and quizzes are all open note.
I love Dr. Ahn - She can make any boring subject interesting one. I never thought I would love laws and regulations. And she is also very understanding.
So easy!!! Take this class to fill your credits. There are weekly quizzes which you can look right at her lecture slides for word to word answers. There are three exams all open notes!
The best professor i had at UF. She cares about her students. Whatever issue, she will work with you to help you and make sure you succeed in her course.
Dr. Ahn is passionate and knowledgeable about her field. This class was really fun, easy, and educational!
Easy A

Dr. Ahn is so sweet and caring. Her course is extremely well organized. From Day 1, you would know what happens when, and she constantly checks upon her students by sending out reminders. I think other professors should learn from her!

THE BEST professor I've had at UF. She is so understanding and caring. I had some issues and missed some quizzes but she helped me make up and constantly checked up on me and my progress. If you need Bio Gen Ed, this is the course you should take.
Best online class ever. Dr. Ahn made everything so easy for her students. Exams and quizzes are very fair, and she is the most understand professor I ever met. Strongly recommend.

Dr. Ahn might be the sweetest lady ever. Her class is fairly easy and she wants her students to succeed. There are about 2-3 10-15ish minute lecture Playposits per week and one quiz. There are 3 assignments per term. Exams are similar to quizzes and are open notes.

This class is all online and assessments are open note, so it is good to pay attention to the video lectures and take notes. Most of the videos are pretty boring with Dr. Ahn being monotone, but the information is somewhat interesting. The quiz and test material come right from the lectures.
Dr. Ahn is amazing. She was extremely engaging and explained all concepts extremely well. One of the best online learning experiences that I have ever had.

Literally so easy. You actually learn about the topic, and every exam is open note. She takes the time to do video lectures, and they are super short and informative. There are 2 projects that she literally shows examples of what exactly you need to write. She is so sweet.
This class was amazing. You learn so much about food and many important aspects of nutrition.

Dr. Ahn is one of the best professors I have ever had. She was really passionate about what she was teaching. I really enjoyed taking this course and she actually made me curious and passionate about what I was learning, which is not typical for me.
Very enthusiastic and sweet! She was responsive and really is trying to help us succeed

One of the best online course i took at UF. Dr. Ahn is a very kind and engaging professor who is very knowledgeable on the subject area and helps foster an engaging learning environment. Highly recommend if anyone looks for a high quality online course or a good option for GenEd Bio Sciences
The instructor organized the course very well and made it easy to understand. Very nice professor who is committed to students' success.

Dr. Ahn came off as very nice and her lectures were very informative. The class is structured in a way that makes it easy if you take lecture-based notes and turn in most of the assignments you can get a good grade. Took it as an easy gen-ed but came out with more interesting information on food science than I expected.
Dr. Ahn is awesome. Take notes and do all the assignments and quizzes on time. Get an easy A+, as well as the required Biological Science requirement.

Unbiased Review: Dr. Ahn gives concise and entertaining lectures. The class material is very easy but it is interesting and valuable. It is one of those easy classes that you enjoy because of the great material you learn. This is a great option if you need a Biological science course, and professor Ahn is great.
Dr. Ahn is the sweetest professor ever. She cares for her students, and I can tell she enjoys what she lectures on. She gave me an extension for an exam, when I was deathly sick and I appreciate her!
A very kind professor that wants to help her students.
Dr. Ahn is a tremendously kind and caring professor. She cares deeply about her students and really wants everyone to understand and enjoy the material. Never be afraid to ask questions.
Watch the lectures, take your quizzes, and do your projects. Easy A
Super easy class. Everything is open note. The professor wants you to do well and gives lots of opportunities for extra credit.
Great teacher and wants you to succeed. Lectures give you all you need for exams. Open note exams!
Dr. Ahn has good knowledge of course materials, and very enthusiastic in delivering the course. She REALLY cared about her students.
Dr. Ahn was really nice and really passionate about the subject she was covering.

Dr. Ahn is THE BEST. She is an excellent instructor and makes difficult concepts very easy to understand. And she is very caring. When I missed quizzes and assignment to take care of family, she emailed me to check if I am OK and offered extra time for make up. Knowing she care about me was wonderful (and this is online course with 200 students!)

I am taking her Man's Food this summer and this is the first time Dr. Ahn teaches this course (it was taught by others in the past). I heard many bad things about FOS2001 with its former instructors, but Dr. Ahn's teaching was excellent. Easy and clear lecture. Fun assignment and open note quizzes and exams. And always quick response to my emails!

She is fantastic. Truly caring, funny, and always available for her students. And she is a great instructor. She can turn ever boring subjects into something interesting. I wish she teaches more classes. I would take her class in a heartbeat. Strongly recommended!

Dr. Ahn is one of the best instructors I had at UF. She is super-friendly and really cares about her students and their success. I was a little worried about taking this class because I thought learning about laws and regulations would be boring, but she really WOWed me. I highly recommend her!

Having him as one of my first professors was lwk a bad first impression of what college professors would be like. Ashish was one of the best instructors I have ever had. Teaching a programming language is not easy, but he makes it easy. If you attend all lectures and actually do the assignments, you will be perfectly fine in this class.
This guy is genuinely top 5 all time. He made my first semester at UF sunshine and rainbows. I had no idea how good I had it until second semester rolled in (Prog 2). I'll miss you Ashish.
Professor Wooclap!
Genuinely the GOAT. Magnificent teacher, explains the content wonderfully, and truly cares about his students passing. Pretty easy class too.
Day one of saying I love you ashish

He teaches decently - but has a weird flipped classroom approach that sorta confuses me. He forces students to watch online lectures for python but then teaches it in class in lectures anyways, making the online or in-person lectures redundant. I also didn't enjoy the projects much, but I found the grading system to be fair enough to get an A.

I loved Professor Aggarwal. Would attend his office hours anytime I was stuck with a lab/project and he would walk me through practically the entire thing if needed. With that said, the labs and projects were typically way harder than what was covered in the lecture videos, but are good preparation for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He tries to do a flipped classroom approach, but then ends up just teaching in class anyway. He covers easy material and asks either too easy or too hard questions. I learned python in high school so I knew most of it already. The final project was not good/easy because it used a lot of Pygame which we didn't really cover.

Lowkey easy class, i never go to lectures or read the book, the exams are annoying as shi tho never have enough time. You genuinely need to know how to code cuz the exams are like 65-70% of the grade. All the assigments and labs are easy 100% though.

He's a pretty good professor, my only gripe is that on some of the longer assignments that included additional software he didn't provide as much explanation when it came to errors, which just took a lot longer to figure out.

One of the best professors I've ever had. I came in with no coding experience, and his lectures and assignments made the class very doable with honest effort. He's incredibly kind and helpful in office hours and will often extend deadlines. Exams 2/3, you are allowed 3 pages of notes, and you're allowed 3 lab/quiz drops.

He is a great professor however it is hard if you have had no coding experience, so I would look over the syllabus and watch videos before on python. There are three projects and one final group project. He allows 3 pages of notes on exam 2 and 3 which helps alot. Along with that there are always TA's with office hours to help you.

He's one of my favorite professors and he explains things extremely well. You always know what is going to be on a test and this makes studying very clear. The class is structured well too, and its not too much work, but enough to make you learn.
Great guy and amazing lecturer. Learned a lot during his class. Also TAs are always there to help, and there is office hours to attend literally all day.
Great professor! Highly recommend!
Great professor. Tests are slightly difficult but great resources to help you study. Other than that ts light asf.

this is a beginner class BUT not very beginner-friendly. i came into my first semester ever with no coding experience before i took this class & it was pretty hard ngl. tests aren't too bad and i was still able to get a 95 on my second exam (not gonna talk abt the first one..). u also get 3 cheat sheets so its super helpful for the syntax
My GOAT Ashish Aggarwal. I would fail this class simply to take it again with him as the professor.

Good professor. He had some health issues the beginning of the semester meaning we missed a few classes but his lectures are solid. Discussion periods are kind of annoying but decent practice. There are a few extra credit projects throughout which you should definitely do. The 3 tests are just average difficulty and the final proj. is with a group.
Not very accessible, but otherwise he was a great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Labs are very easy until like the last few weeks, but you get 3 drops so just do the labs at the start so you don't need to do them. Final project must be done in a group, so make sure you get one quick. Tests are extremely easy it's like intro to intro to CS and you get like 66% on the programming test questions for just typing code it feels like
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The teacher was amazing. Although he went a bit slower through the lectures, he explained exactly how to code and gave great examples. As someone with no experience coding, he did a great job thoroughly explaining how to do the projects, and none of the assignments were overly complicated.

I love this professor but your enjoyment in the class really depends on your TA in the discussion section. Me personally, programming was so hard for me and the TA sessions only left me more confused. You can turn in Labs, Lecture Assignments, and Projects as many times as you want until your code gets you a 100.

Oh, where do I start? Ashish Aggarwal, you are a beacon of sunshine in the otherwise dull atmosphere of CISE. Ashish's lectures are simply beautiful: thorough, engaging, and to the point. His exams are as fair as they get. If I could have Ashish teach all of my classes, I would. If you think there is a better professor than Ashish, think again.

I have beef with this dude bc I didn't do what I thought was an optional end of class survey- turns out it was actually part of our final project grade. Ended up knocking me down to a very regrettable B+, which sucks because this class was easy asf

This class was definitely an easy class with about half of your grade depending on homeworks such as quizzes and coding assignments. The professor gives amazing lectures and also streams them. This class also has a group project which was very fun to work on.

my first cs course & prof aggarwal was nothing short of amazing. lectures arent mandatory but help a lot, one quiz & lab per week, 3 tests worth 35% total, no final, 3-4 projects. super caring professor. insane amount of resources and office hours. textbook is free online with interactive activities that help a lot, and practice questions for exams
Great, forgiving class that teaches you what you need to know with mostly useful projects. TAs/PMs are always accessible and helpful.

Prof Aggarwal is amazing! There are 2 lectures a week, but attendance isn't mandatory, he records the lectures incase you miss it. 1 lab a week. Offers a lot of extensions. Super nice and cares about his students.
He is clear and the labs are not too complicated. Really nice guy.
I miss my Glorious King Aggarwal

Professor Aggarwal is a great professor. He is kind, soft-spoken, and takes his time going through the lecture material. He loves it when students participate and is respectful whether of not the student answers correctly. Attendance is not mandatory in lectures, but it is in discussion sections (lab). There are many different forms of homework.

Very good teacher, his lectures are easy to understand and he engages the class well. Explained concepts really well and tests weren't too hard. Only lab attendance is mandatory but the labs themselves weren't too hard. Overall would definitely take him again and recommend others to take him.

The attendance part is only mandatory for labs, the lectures are recorded if you miss. He is a really nice guy, very helpful in office hours. I came in having a little programming experience but was still very terrible at it, but the design and structure of this class helped me be able to understand the logic behind it. Would recommend to anyone.

Super easy class! Ended up with a 100+.  Ashish is great, TAs very goofy and fun. Exams very straightforward w/good practice tests. Labs + projects always possible. Bit intense group project at the end but it was very fun. The exact opposite of a weed-out class (in a good way) as Prof will go out of his way to make sure you succeed!

For a beginner who has no background in coding, this class is no joke. Ashish's lectures were very insightful and contained lots of valuable information, but the pacing of the class is brutal, especially on newbies. There were extensions very frequently, Ashish really cares about his students. Great guy, hard class

Very good way to start off anything involving programming. He explains things in ways which are beginner friendly and provides many examples during lecture to actually engage you. Missed a few lectures because of sickness but he overall did an amazing job.
Really nice professor. Class wasn't bad and my TA was also helpful. There are a lot of office hours and TA's to help with the more complex projects but it's a really good intro class.

Class was pretty easy; exams weren't bad, assignments were pretty simple and TAs/ChatGPT helped clear up any confusion on those (the AutoGrader was great for feedback and debugging). Unfortunately he got very ill for a while so lectures went off course for a bit. I missed almost half of the lectures and could understand the class on slides alone.

Decent lecturer and very lenient. The deadline got extended on most of our assignments and his communication was great in Canvas. Some of the TAs aren't great, went to office hours in a room where a bunch of courses have their office hours and a TA for another course said the COP3502C TA just never shows up. Attendance only mandatory for labs.

The professor genuinely cares about his students and is extremely nice and understanding. He extended deadlines for several labs for the entire class. The quizzes are also guaranteed 100% because he allows 2 attempts. Overall, I really enjoyed this class!

The professor was good. Would take again. The class was not hard, but required a lot of attention. Mandatory labs each week with a TA that grades all your assignments. Exams weren't tough (averaged high 80s) and everything else graded on completion.

Professor Aggarwal, a true delight,
With wisdom that shines so bright.
His humor fills the classroom air,
A teacher beyond compare.

A caring heart, a guiding hand,
He helps us all to understand.
With a voice so rich, an accent strong,
Learning with him feels like a song.


In the world of code, you're a star,
Ashish Aggarwal, the best by far!
Oh ashish, my sweet sunshine.
Professor aggarwal is so nice and caring. The prof and tas are easily reachable after class time and are always super helpful. Offers 3% extra credit.

Pretty solid intro to Python. Lecture attendance isn't mandatory, but weekly labs are. Everything was submitted online. 9 quizzes and 2 non-cumulative exams are all proctored by Honorlock. Everything was straightforward except for the final project. Get with a good group and start early.

Lectures are pretty straightforward and easy to understand. Exams are taken through canvas honorlock and are not too bad. Every homework is a small project and they are enjoyable and often a good challenge. There are quizzes at the end of every topic, and they too are through canvas honorlock.

Ashish is extremely knowledgable of MATLAB, and will gladly help any student whenever they get stuck. There is no better professor for learning how to code MATLAB. The class itself was totally worth it, very easy and not too intensive. It was actually my favorite class I ever took at UF.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I absolutely love professor Aggarwal. He is easily the most compassionate and understanding professor I've ever had. He genuinely cares about his students, their well being, and their understanding of the class. His office hours were incredible.
Dr. Aggarwal is extremely knowledgeable and is very helpful and kind. His videos are easy to understand and provide ample examples.
Flipped classroom actually works. Really cares about the subject and students. All around great guy, take him. Exams can be killer but everything else is basically a guaranteed 100.

The lab is tricky and can sometimes require a ton of effort (the chess assignment took me several hundred lines to code), but it is very fun and satisfying to finally get the right output. Professor Aggarwal is extremely  caring. 
 and sometimes he would even stay after class to help people who were really struggling.

He sometimes got frustrated about questions but he was generally a good professor. The TAs were very good at helping you through the question you got stuck on!! The assignments are very easy. The exams are based on the assignments/HW so as long as you understand them you should be fine for the exams.

Professor Aggarwal can get frustrated at times if a student asks for help and they do not utilize his advice well.
In all other cases, I believe Professor Aggarwal is an excellent teacher.
Clear thought processes written out, clear solutions, very helpful.
Easy to get a B, harder to get an A, study for exams, they can be killer.

Awesome professor. While he can be short tempered at times, this is because students ask him stuff clearly mentioned in lecture videos. If you put in an honesty effort and do all the practice materials he gives you, you're golden. Good choice if you want to learn MATLAB.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I genuinely hate this professor. He is really just the worst. The content is an easy A but he grades so harshly. He is the least bit helpful and when you come to him with questions he gets frustrated easily. I wish I had taken this course with any other professor.

The class is flipped and you're expected to watch the lectures and learn the syntax before coming to class. They were really good and as long as you went to class, did the activities, and all the practice material given, this is an easy A.

Will not teach you anything, you will have to go to class and learn from your other classmates. He will get angry if you ask for help very short temper. His tests will not match his practices or the practices he gives you. Really bad at communication and overall the worst professor I've ever had avoid him like the plague!!!

He was very helpful during class and in office hours, so you should get 100% on every in-class activity and homework. Even for the final project, he basically told us exactly how to do it. He can get frustrated with students at times which I didn't love. Learning Matlab can be very tough, but I believe Professor Aggarwal does make it a bit easier.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This professor is horrible at actually teaching you anything. Exams look nothing like the practice tests. You pretty much have to teach yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Awful teacher but easy A. Just don't be stupid and you'll pass .

He's AMAZING at explaining everything in this course! I never felt confused, and I had never written any code before. He helps you out with any assignments you're stuck on, and the tests are manageable, but I definitely recommend studying for them if you've never taken CS before. Overall a great professor. HIGHLY recommend!
A really nice guy and you can tell he actually wants you to learn logic and programming. He will take the time to explain things many times if you are struggling.

Amazing Professor. I had him for COP2271L and he definitely knows what he is teaching. He can debug your program for you and will make sure you don't get stuck on a certain part for too long if you ask for help. He also recorded the lectures for COP2271 and is very informational in those. Overall, Amazing guy!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great prof! Only time that I felt live zooms over prerecorded lectures were beneficial. Very helpful and good at explaining the material. Class activities and homework could be tough and time consming but in a collaborative learning environment, it worked well. Exams could be pretty tough, there's only 2

(Taken during lockdown of Fall 2020) Ashish is such a great professor for MATLAB. He teaches the material really well initially and he's also insanely helpful 1 on 1 with class activities/hw's. He's an extremely safe bet for MATLAB.
Great lecturer, patient and knowledgeable. Really tried to get students interested in comp sci and engage them in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Aggarwal is great. His lectures are very easy to follow, and are all you need to learn the material for the course. In class, Aggarwal does expect participation, and the homework assignments can be overwhelming. However, Aggarwal holds plenty of office hours, and is always willing to help.

Had him for the lab for MATLAB, and his videos were used for the actual MATLAB course I was in (I had Cho as my lecturer). He's incredibly smart and very good at explaining things. I never thought that anything was too hard in his course because he would relate everything back to easier concepts. I have a new appreciation for coding thanks to him.

Dr. Aggarwal is very knowledgeable with respect to programming and he wants to see students succeed. Class is very homework oriented, and homework can sometimes be pretty challenging. Exams were always fair. Lectures are entirely online, and the class depends on you being able to think through problems like logic puzzles. Very helpful office hours.

Really awesome guy. He really cares about his students and wants to actually help them succeed. He will help you with the homework or any concepts you don't understand if you go to his office hours. Don't underestimate the class, it's supposed to be an intro to programming but it is not an easy A by any means. Be prepared to put in alot of work
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: First time taking coding this semester, Dr. Aggarwal made it way less intimidating than I thought it'd be. He really teaches you how to think like a programmer. The homework, in-class activities, and exams all build on each other. If you can do the classwork, you can do the homework, and if you can do the homework, you can do the exams.
The professor provides good videos and slides, exams were fair.

Heard they changed the course format. Lectures are pretty informative, but definitely do not include everything. It makes classwork and exams extremely annoying and unfair. Definitely not an introductory course like it's labeled as because it is commonly retaken. Exams test your ability to problem solve under pressure rather than Matlab knowledge.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The most wonderful professor that I've had at UF so far. He's brilliant, explains the material extremely well, and if you just go to office hours you will do more than succeed in the class, especially if you don't understand the HW (GO TO OH's). Not to mention he gave everyone 1.5% extra credit at the end of the semester. A gem.

Amazing Professor! He genuinely cares about his students and goes out of his way to make sure that you are understanding the material and doing well in the class. He explains things thoroughly and makes sure you grasp the concepts and are prepared for the exams. He will stay after class to help you and he has a lot of office hours!

This is the best professor at UF. Even if youre not engineering, you should still bear witness to world class teaching. He will explain every detail of every line. No magic tricks. This is teaching on a level I have never seen before.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures
