reviews.comment: For a real challenge on understanding and paying attention to a prof giving a lecture, this is your class. Dude's a good guy but he's the most horrendous professor I have ever taken. Class is completely unorganized. Word of advice, write as much as you can for notes and try to understand hws. Grade is all open notes quizzes. Textbook may help. Gl!

Dr. Shanker is clearly a nice guy but wholly ineffective teacher. Class consists of him rambling about his knowledge of steel and concrete construction, but doesn't teach you anything useful. He never does problems in class, and the first time you see problems is the quizzes. Has some lenient grading policies though, with some quiz drops.

Professor Shanker is not able to present information clearly, and it is extremely difficult to understand him. Homeworks only somewhat line up with what is taught in class, and quizzes are at a difficulty level not seen in lectures, and are extremely difficult.
If we could rate him a 0/5 instead of 1/5 I would have. Boring and hard to understand. Would expect more out of UF
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Monotone. Super boring. Hard to understand. Jumps around and skips important steps in problems leaving you wondering where he got that answer. Terrible at explaining. You pretty much have to teach yourself everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Honestly hes a nice guy and extremely intelligent and wants to see everyone succeed but the class itself is all over the place
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: His lectures make zero sense,assumes you already know the material, and you cant even understand him

Doesn't teach any of the material for Homework or quizzes. Spends class time showing pictures of beams, trusses, etc. rather than teaching material. Supposedly has great powerpoints for lectures that he never uses. Very unclear regarding grading policy and what will be on the quizzes. Promised to drop 4 lowest quiz grades and is now refusing.

While he may be monotone (w/ some accent) and hard to focus on for two straight hours, this class is not hard by any means. This semester, we had no exams; just open note/book/hw quizzes once per week. Quiz day depends on how many people are there, if we feel prepared, etc. (he's very lenient and will push things back if you ask). MANY DROPS TOO :D

Dr. Shanker is a great professor. He assumes you know certain things that you should know prior to taking his class. He is a little difficult to understand but you can teach yourself if you cannot understand him. His test are open book, open notes, you can bring anything to them but they are still difficult. He really loves steel and concrete.
Very hard to understand, the concepts need to be clearly taught however he doesn't do this. You end up teaching yourself from the text book.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH HER!! Throughout my time in grad school this is the hardest grader i've had for no reason. Its frustrating because her grading is based off of opinions, so you have to guess what she will like. When I went to office hours she had little feedback and then ended up taking off many points for "potential changes."

DO NOT TAKE THIS!!! She is such a strict grader but gives very little feedback. It genuinely took a toll on my mental health. She told my section she was curving our grades down because the average was too high... basically avoid at all cost!

Avoid this class if you can!! Professor Jung is a very strict grader and will contradict herself when grading assignments. Your grade is very subjective; she has very few office hour timeslots and takes 3-4 weeks to grade assignments. Don't bother disputing your grade because it can go down if she finds more errors.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Wow where do I begin, maybe avoid at all costs, maybe she shouldn't be teching this class when she isn't the best speaker.  She gives no guidance on grading and then tears you apart in the rubric.  This should be an easy class that helps you grow but I actually got nothing out of this BS.  She just tells you to make your slides more Mickey Mouse.
She is horrible, avoid at all costs. Entire grade is one presentation and she is a nitpicker

The "nobody is perfect" mindset to toxic extremes. Rubrics have no details but she has specific expectations. She'll arbitrarily mark off points because only a "perfect" speaker gets above a B. And perfect speakers don't exist. Appeals & office hours are a scam. I have lots of experience presenting professionally but now completely dread it.

DONT take with AJ JUNG if you have any concern about public speaking. The way it is structured is like hazing/exposure therapy. Grades are extremely harsh and I've put more work into this than any other in my education only to maybe get a B. She does warn people with saying that she never gives out As and it is RARE to get an A on any assignment.

SUPER harsh grader!! Picks apart every little detail, and then leaves minimal feedback. I lost points over and accidental space in one of my assignments, such as " To:" instead of "To:". Takes her job and authority way to seriously. Be prepared to rage over your feedback!

An extremely nitpicky grader, often for no reason and with little explanation. With little to no assignments, the presentations in the class hold a lot of weight. It felt like you as a student were expected to already be confident with public speaking when that was the purpose of the class. Would pick the other instructor if given the option.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Jung is a great professor. She really knows what she is talking about and can train you well on how to be a great speaker. However, she is a very tough grader and removes points for the smallest things. She is also very strict on attendance. She is very nice though and has time outside of class to help with any concerns.

Uses Packback for assignments, all quizzes/exams are open note. I read through the textbook extensively, so it took me longer, but you can still pass without doing that. There were a couple other assignments graded by the TA but I took as a gen ed and it was super easy.

Took during Summer B, super easy class. Directions were always clear, quizzes/exams were multiple choice (no free response) and were open note. Not hard at all if you actually do your work and watch the lectures. There are textbook readings.

EC every module so I ended with 103 in the class. 1 Quiz and 2 Packback discussions every module. Only 2 open exams for the whole semester. I never interacted with Jung once, but the course was so easy and straightforward. Sometimes the packbacks took a little bit of time, but there's no reason you can't get 100 on everything if you put in effort.

No guidance. Gives less than 3 short lecture videos on average per week but the quizzes & tests are on several lengthy chapters. Doesn't respond to questions. The content in the book and lectures are very nonsensical and void of any quality information yet the most abstract ideas are picked for quizzes & tests and asked in the most vague way.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: We had discussions and quizzes almost every week. She had SO much EC I don't know how you don't get an A. Everything was open book, open note, and she wanted you to meet with others and do work together. There was a final and midterm, same rules as above. Super sweet. I got a 101 in the class, like I said there is no reason to not get an A.

If you don't get an A in this class, I don't know what to say. Extremely easy. The material was also slightly useful I guess. You can probably spend less than an 45 minutes on this class per week and still get an A easily.

The professor and TA are nice and the class is decently enjoyable.

I had an amazing experience with AJ Jung in GEB3218. She was a great instructor and had very clear lessons and expectations. She graded very easy and you will get an A if you put the effort in. She was compassionate and very patient.

Entire class is graded by three presentations. Two will be by yourself and one will be in a group. Lectures are boring and full of information that is common sense. Grades extremely harshly on the presentations. Be careful- if you have a plant in the background that looks out of place during your zoom presentation, you will lose points.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I honestly don't have much to say about her personally, but her class was super easy. 2 discussion posts and a quiz every two weeks and she encourages you to collaborate with other students on the quizzes and exams so that makes things simple enough. She is always pretty available as she offers extra credit zoom meetings every module.

It was a basic intro class but definitely had to read the textbook for module quizzes and 3 exams. There was a theory project as well that was easy. Didn't interact with the professor that much but there is a weekly extra credit option to meet via Zoom. The worst part was paying $40 for Packback to do discussions.

Prof Jung is awesome! The actual course material isn't too difficult and she grades fairly easy. She is super accessible and willing to help. She is also super understanding that things can happen in life and is accomodating. I really enjoyed her class and would recommend her to any student. Super nice lady.

Relied heavily on the textbook, and only occasionally gave lectures that just summarized what you read. Five speeches total, with one group and one online. Discussion posts are semi-often and were easy, exams are open everything. Clear rubrics for each speech, overall very easy class with good feedback. Jung is supportive and rarely critical.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Horrible class format.  TA doesn't help whatsoever

Despite from a heavy accent, Ajinyka does not communicate information well. He often times stutters and pauses in search of appropriate words. Many questions were left unanswered or vaguely resolved. In order to do well, read all chapters (multiple times) do ALL homework problems (MULTIPLE TIMES) and do not forget to look over all handouts!!!!

The class is Tough, but the information is interesting.  It takes a little while to get use to his accent, but come to class because he notices.  Work through homework multiple times, read chapters.  Have questions in class and know general concepts.  Passing is easy, getting an A will be a LOT of work.
can not understand a word he says!
No Comments
My second time having a course with Professor Akyapi and he is a great professor! Make sure you go to class or you will be a little lost.

I really enjoyed having him as a professor for this class. He made everything as simple as he could and if you emailed any time even 9pm at night he responds within minutes with full explanations of a question you have. He was very helpful in office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The professor assumes we already know Java and teaches at an accelerated rate. The exams were difficult, but if you attempt the practice exam, you will be fine.

Do not worry about buying book for QMB 4701. Go to class and take good notes will very easy if you do. Test are open excels which is super helpful. The Professor cares and dude is super chill. Go to office hours if you have questions. but he knows his stuff and this class is easy if you take good notes.

Berkay is a very fair professor that cares about students having a well rounded understanding of concepts. I have seen the same topics being taught by other professors seem more complex, but Berkay structures the content in a great way to learn. The exams can be challenging for some, but I believe they are very fair with the content in lectures.

Berkay is a kind and caring professor. His lectures are extremely helpful with quizzes and exams. The first exam was super easy, but the second exam is really hard. He made most of the questions into trick questions with barely sufficient time. If you are confused, ask him because its easy to fall behind.
Good professor, makes content and course structure very clear and straightforward. Attendance isn't mandatory but he doesn't record lectures so you should go to class anyway.
Very good lectures. All content in the homework, quizzes, and exams was covered by lecture. Overall the class was fairly easy.
This course is very similar in form compared to QMB4701 taught by Dr. Apyaki. 4702 is slightly easier than 4701 and doesn't have quizzes. You should already have the textbook from 4701, use it!

Great class. Great professor. Attendance is not mandatory but GO TO CLASS! The course is half term and progresses quickly. If you skip class you will fall behind. Textbook was not used in class, but it was VERY helpful  for homework assignments and studying for quizzes/tests. Dr. Apyaki is very caring and I loved going to his office hours.

He was patience and thorough in his lectures. Would recommend attending lectures even though it wasn't mandatory. Always responsive over emails and willing to answer questions. Homework questions are reflective of the lecture examples. Exams could be tricky to some but if you have a general understanding of the material, you'll do fine.

Horrible class. First exam consisted of 2 fair problems discussed in class and on the hw, and one problem worth the majority of points that was never reviewed in class, online, on the homework or anywhere. Completely unfair to students who are studying class material only to be surprised on the exam. 2 exams are 60% of grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was super manageable. The grading is very lenient, you have multiple attempts on pretty much every assignment, and the practice exams are very similar to the exam. I put very little time into this class and ended with an A because of the exam reviews she gave.

I had her for Survey of Calc 2 which is an online course. The lectures were not that great and were not given by her. I needed study edge to get through the course. However, her grading criteria is clear with 3 lowest lecture quizzes being dropped and lowest exam grade being dropped. It was not that hard of a class and is very doable.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She was my professor/TA for Survey of Calc 2. The lectures were all Kevin Knudson, but her grading criteria was incredibly lenient. Lowest 3 quizzes and homework dropped, and lowest exam was dropped. I basically didn't do the last week's work and still ended the course with 100%.

I am being completely sincere and not malicious when I say that she should resign as a TA.  She cannot, in good faith, continue. She consistently made errors during the explanation of problems. Every day she couldn't explain questions. She is very kind and passionate about math, but I cannot say she is an effective teacher.

She gave amazing lectures, and clear notes. She was super nice, and gave really good feedback. I'm terrible with trig, but I managed to pass the class with her notes. Attendance doesn't matter grade wise, but you gain a much better understanding going to class than just reading from the class notes.

idk why the rating is so low. urp3001 was so easy. all the quizzes and exams are on quizlet. the discussion were kind of long (theres 3) but as long as u follow the criteria and write about 800 words, its an easy A for those. and there is a group project but its pretty simple and short (2 slides). easy 3000 lvl class. just follow instructions well

This professor really isn't terrible. I was surprised at the amount of work for the course but it forces you to learn a lot. The course is just on urban planning issues since that's what Professor Akiely studies. The feedback on assignments was poor and vague, also graded harshly. The discussions were all high-level essays. Assignments are creative

Took a class that had two professors, and she was one of them. My experience with them was horrible. They are rude, condesending, and unnaccomodating. Some assignment critera they provide isn't always clear and they wont clarify, telling you to do as the rubric says. Even if you follow the rubric exactly, they will find ways to lower your grade.

Very tough grader, some expectations not listed in the rubric. Online class so there is basically no interaction with the professor. There is extra credit at the end of the semester but as long as you do the work and put in effort you shouldn't need to do it.
Good class if you do the homework and assignments on time. Extra credit helped me a lot.
It was an online class so not much interaction with the professor. Very strict on grading and there was a lot of writing assignments in the class.

Dr Akcali is definitely one of the best professors I have had. She holds great lectures and knows how to keep a steady pace throughout. There are six quizzes, six homeworks, six in-class assignments and three exams.
She was the best math teacher at OzU of all times.

Mediocre teacher. She knows her material well. Every time I emailed her asking questions, she has ignored them. Sometimes in class can be condescending and/or arrogant to students at times, but like I said she knows her subject.
Fair grader. Always answers questions. Keep an eye out for her mistakes in class, point them out and she will fix them.

Probably one of the best professors I've had at the University.  She is really helpful and all of her homework and tests are fair.  Very clear and gives you notes in class so you can follow along.  As long as you go to class and pay attention you should be able to get a A.
No Comments
Excellent Teacher!  Very organized.  Her tests and homework are fair and she updates her website frequently.

Professor Akiely is great!
I had a health issue which made me fall behind in class work. She was very accommodating and reassuring. We met during office hours and she was very understanding.
Quizzes open for one day, I wish they open for longer. Grades are fair and based on rubric. It is an easy A, but has lots of work.
She is too strict with her discussion posts
Great class. Professor Akeily is so responsive.

I enjoyed this elective. This course requires readings for quizzes and some work on the discussions, plus a group project. Getting an A is not very difficult. Discussions were the assignments that need some time and effort, and Farah was a very fair grader.

Decent elective. It is not difficult to get an A as long as you put work in. Quizzes and exams are not difficult if you use your resources. Discussion posts are lengthy and require citations but are graded fairly as long as you follow the rubric. Group project is tedious but fine if you have good group members. Overall interesting class material

Professor Akiely was a very tough grader. Discussion and group project instructions seemed clear, but she would take off points for not doing things that were not included in the instructions. I took this class as an elective, but I would not recommend someone to take it as an elective unless you had a true interest in these topics.
Great class. Easy A if you do homework and assignments on time. Extra credit is worth like thirty points. It helped a lot!

Course was very easy and straightforward. There would be readings and then short quizzes. Exams were just longer quizzes and they questions were the same difficulty. A very good choice for outside electives!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Good course and responsive professor
Replies so fast and has extra credit
Replies so fast and has extra credits.

Not a bad elective to take. There are 3 discussion posts, weekly quizzes (quizlet), and extra credit at the end. I would advise that you pay attention to the due dates as assignments are due the same day they open. She is a tough grader so review discussion posts before submitting.
This course has 3 discussion posts and a group project. Grading criteria is detailed. Fair grader and quick to respond to my emails.
Discussion posts were so time consuming and graded harshly. The quizzes were disproportionately easy compared to how much reading there was for a module. Lectures though were completely useless.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment:
Prof. Akiely is helpful and responds to emails promptly. In addition to weekly module quizzes, this course requires a group projects and 4 discussions boards posts. The instructions are detailed and the rubric explains the point break for each assignment.
Excellent teacher and course overall.
Professor Akiely was very helpful and understanding during the hurricane week. She was always very responsive and followed up on my ability to do course work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Fair grader. Detailed instructions and Rubric. Great class overall

The class requires 3 unnecessarily detailed "discussions" (basically papers since u have to have a bibliography, in-text citations, at least 4 paragraphs). The other professor Aldunce grades these incredibly harshly, marking points off mine for whatever reason meanwhile half of my group couldn't even be bothered to respond. Professor Akiely is ok

This class wasn't too bad until you realize how extra and inefficient the discussion posts and group project are. The professor is extremely strict on grading and does not offer any make up opportunities for missed assignments no matter the cause. Though I understand, it is still pretty ridiculous how much work goes into this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Overall a pretty easy classes. Just make sure you do a good job on your discussions as well as on your group project at end of the semester.

I felt this class was unnecessarily hard. You need to buy the textbook because quizzes come directly from it. Discussion board posts were quite lengthy with multiple topics to analyze. Class itself wasn't the worst but many discussion board posts got graded heavy considering how little interaction with professors there is. Lectures are useless!!!!

This class takes some work but it was overall an easy class. I found it really interesting. The discussions are 500 words and there is a quiz every weekend. The exams are straight out of the textbook which you will need to get to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Discussion posts were so time consuming for an "easy" class and you wouldn't pass the quizzes without the book since they come from it word for word. The lectures are pointless (didn't watch them after the first week) and the profs give little instruction for assignments then bomb your grades when you don't interpret what they meant correctly.

Getting 100 on every assignment without any study and effort. Just 5 min pre-recorded lecture per week, then write short essay and discussion. Final exam is somewhat unreasonable, bc he did not teach, but he curved it. All people I know in this course getting an A.

I don't know why this professor has a low rating... I got a ~100% on every assignment he manually graded. Only problem with the class were the quizzes, they're pretty much impossible to do good on, but they are only worth 10% of your grade, so it isn't the biggest deal.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Terrible professor! He ignores students emails when asked about grading! Even when he is clearly wrong! For example, he gave me 0 marks for a criteria that states "Include reference section in APA format", which I did! Overall, terrible professor, and I would absolutely not recommend!

For economic geography. Very easy online class and meets 6000 words. You have one discussion every week which is pretty easy to do. One 300 word prompt a week, which they say you have to read the textbook but you never have to. Very relaxed grader.

Do no read the textbook, it is the largest waste of your time. Go into each chapter and use quotes from their intros as evidence in your papers. Easy grading as long as you answer the prompts (which can be answered without any reading). The only test is only worth 10% of your grade and I just used quizlets I found to study for it. Overall EZ class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: You have 13 assignments, 6 quizzes w/2 attempts each 17%, 6 assignments 40%,+ 1 final exam (proctored) 43%. The quizzes are hard, question bank is from book chapters but the book is long winded and very hard to comprehend as well as the lectures. The 2 written assignments he is a picky grader and the final exam had questions not reviewed in course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The nicest professor to exist, period. He is so compassionate and genuinely cares about each person in the class. Research is done in a group with minimal assignments. Very easy class (even with the worst group members). It's very easy to reach him via email and he's very open to comments from students regarding class structure and such. The best!
Prof. Akanbi is an amazing professor. He cares greatly about his students and wants you to learn and grow while taking his course. He is caring, kind and compassionate and is always in a good mood!

Professor Akanbi is an angel. He is by far the nicest and most caring teacher at the CJC. I would recommend that you take this professor if you ever get the chance. He cares about the welfare of his students. Professor Akanbi understands that being a student with other course loads is difficult and he works with you to make sure you succeed.

Definitely one of my favorite professors at UF. If you are taking this class, definitely take it with Francis, you will not regret it. He is so kind and does everything in his power to make sure each of his students succeed.

One of the greatest professors i've had at UF by far! Professor Akanbi takes students opinions and feelings into consideration and always does his best to make sure we are doing okay with the material being learned. He is great at teaching and made it seem like a 3 hr class went by quick! Very engaging conversations as well. 10/10 would take  again

He's just a really nice guy! His African Oral Literatures class was straightforward and interesting. I've had a continued relationship with him as he's written me recommendation letters and I took a Yoruba course with him. He's really patient and I can only say positive things about him.
One of the worst teachers I've ever had in my life and a disgusting human being.

African Oral Literature sounds boring but he makes it pretty fun. It's a lot of story time and learning about Nigerian culture. Show some effort or interest and you'll get a good grade. Super nice guy. He's also got a really cool African accent which makes listening more interesting.
easy class, he likes people who pay attention and contribute in class. If you show interest and read some of the materials he gives and talk about them in class you are on your way to an A!!!!
Very easy class. He likes respectful people and people who show interest in his materials. Participate a lot in class and you will be on your way to an A
Great Teacher! Really understanding. Knows his stuff but not in an arrogant way. Humble guy. Funny.
hE IS A VERY NICE MAN

He is a great teacher. Go to class, participate, read the books, do your best on tests. He is extremely understanding. If you mess up a couple times, just tell him the truth and he'll work with you. Awesome Teacher!!
You may find his class confusing, but he is very helpful outside of class and very understanding.  Don't hesitate to visit his office.
He is very good teacher, very understanding.  Do not try to take him for granted or you will irritate him.  Just do your work, show up to class, participate and you will be fine.

I enjoyed Dr. Akalin's class a lot. I found the subject material really interesting. The reading reflections were difficult at times and the class was really lecture heavy/ based on outside readings. I didn't enjoy that participation was mandatory, but she made the class really accessible which I appreciated.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class is interesting and very easy to get an A. There are only 2 in-class exams that have open-ended short answer questions about concepts we learn and you're expected to tie in some information from the readings she assigns. You can definitely do really well on exams without reading every single article. Just skim them and you'll get the gist.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor nilufer was so approachable and very kind- you could tell she was passionate about the material. For WST2322, you're graded by few things but the assignments and even tests are very easy. Just show up to class and you should be able to make an easy A

Professor Akalin was so passionate and knowledgable about the course material. Many skipped class due to attendance not being mandatory, but those who went formed a great relationship with her. The coursework consisted of minimal assignments that were graded very easy. Don't stress about the exams, there was no final, and extra credit is offered.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This was a great class with a great professor!
I enjoyed this class!
If you don't like him it's more like a you problem, because he's really cool and nice.

Don't listen to the other comments please!! He actually really cares for his students that he teaches. I had him for multiple calc lectures from calc 1-3. And is super friendly, funny, and helps you understand in a very good way if you don't seem to understand the topic. I would 100% take him again for any single class he teaches.
Doesn't seem like he really cares about teaching.

LAA2379C- I have never learned so much in so little time, truly an amazing professor. The work is long and sometimes difficult but worth it. If you put in the time and respond to feedback, you will succeed. Professor is also incredibly kind.

I was excited to take the class at first, but I'm so disappointed I got this professor again. The only thing I found "enjoyable" was writing childhood narratives since we didn't have to research. There's actually an insane amount of content she wants you to watch/read, and it makes it so uninteresting. It's easy to get an A but omg it's draining.

Professor is unreachable. Had a situation where my  grade was docked heavily because of something my partner did and I would've received an A otherwise, but the teacher literally never responded back. Ever. Class is structured so bad and uninteresting, so work felt so heavy. Professor didn't start grading until like 2 days before class was over...

Dude the semester ends in one week and she has not graded a single thing. Our entire grade is pretty much one project that we add onto every week yet she has not graded a single submission. How do I know how I am doing if I get no instructor feedback?

Got a bad grade but I honestly credit her course structure for my grade not being worse. Her recorded lectures were engaging and understandable. Exams and HW weren't graded too harshly. The kindest and most encouraging professor I have ever had at UF.
very nice professor! she used examples to make things clearer and prepared us well for exams. was accommodating to unforseen difficulties of students. definitely recommend to take classes with her!

This professor is super nice, and definitely cares about her students. Her exams can be straight forward, but some of them feel very out of nowhere. Overall highly recommend! Her slides are super helpful and comprehensive.
Dr. Aifantis makes class exciting and fun!!! She transmits her love for science without overwhelming us:)

The best professor I have had at UF. She is unbelievably caring and accessible outside of class time. She will even check your homework before you submit it so you can get a 100% every time. Her exams are fair and her lectures are great. I had a great experience in this class, and I hope to have her again. Highly recommend.
Makes sure we understand the material and gets our feedback on the class pace. She really cares about students and is always available to help us.
Taking Mech Design this semester with Dr. A. It is my best class so far at UF. She makes sure we understand all new concepts and sets up extra office hours before exams!
Take her battery class this spring!!!! Best class I had!! Amazing prof, totally different than all others. She really loves science and it shows!

Dr. Aifantis is the most awesome prof I have had! She goes into depth but at the same time keeps the class enjoyable. She is always available to help us and can break down the concepts very nicely. Definitely take every class she teaches!!!

Professor Aifantis is a great professor. Currently taking EML 4930 with her, which I highly recommend for a specialization elective. She prepares you very well for exams and gives a fairly light amount of homework (7 assignments for the semester, 2-5 hours each). She radiates kindness and is always willing to help, plus she rewards participation
She was really enthusiastic and gave great lectures.

Prof Aifantis is great. Her class is interesting because she briefly focuses on the most relevant topics and then goes through a lot of examples. Exams are similar to homework and shes always available to answer questions by email. Would definitely take again!
Nice
Ze wurst!
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Ganz, ganz schlimm!

Does not give feedback/corrections when grading. She is just using pre-made assignments from when another prof was teaching this course. She does not grade quickly and responds to emails slowly or not at all. When you ask questions about criteria she often gives unclear non-answers. Just don't bother.

Rude, mean, and disrespectful. She will laugh in your face and tell you how terrible and awful you are doing. She gives absolutely no motivation. She actually discourages me from learning. I am not being hyperbolic. It is a pain speaking with our. My day gets worse crossing per path. She should not be a teacher. Do not take this course!

If you genuinely want to learn German, find a different way. This course is structured very poorly, over 100 vocab words in a single week, 12-15 quizzes a week. Does not answer email questions and instead tells you to ask your group members. Required group work over zoom each week. Learn to say very basic words while learning vague difficult ones.
She laughs in your face if you get something wrong. Good luck trying to get a question answered.
GER1126 was the hardest class Ive taken at UF. Expect to spend a minimum of 2 hours a day on assignments. GER1126 should only be taken by those who have a STRONG desire to learn the German language.
Definitely makes you work hard, but in the long run I did learn a lot! Could have also been more helpful at times

There is little attempt to describe how the language operates and she will simply speak it as if you're already supposed to know. She'll get angry and stomp her feet if you phrase your sentences incorrectly or are hesitant to speak in class. There are many assignments due every day online and she won't care if you have technical difficulties.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She deducts points without explaining why or what was wrong. I emailed her asking what the correct answer was on a past test and attached a picture of the question and she told me she was busy and could not look up the answer. This was after she told us to email her with questions.

She's awful at explaining the material. I'm taking the class online and even though she answers e-mails, she never actually helps you with the question you have. She makes it seem like explaining things is a hassle to her and she's busy to read attachments. She never provides written feedback or comments explaining why you got the grade you got.

-Harsh grader no rubric.
- Quizzes on content to be discussed in coming week make lectures feel unnecessary or unimportant to pay attention to.
- In lectures tends to ramble.
- attending office hours is basically mandatory if you want to succeed in this course- she will hate you if you don't and grade even harsher.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Waste of time. The readings and lectures are awful she rambles and treats everything as profound. She's an inconsistent grader taking points off for not being emotional enough or not saying exactly what she wants, even when it's not in the prompt. She claims not to care about AI but gives 0 based on suspicion alone and won't let you explain.

Professor Hozic is a nice lady. She seems to care about her students and really wants them to be satisfied as well as better off after the class. My biggest issue with her is that she can be quite snarky with feedback. She doesn't use rubrics and can be rather mean if you don't write with complexity or don't do the readings "justice" on quizzes.

Overall a very caring and knowledgeable prof. Is a nuanced grader but always gave good feedback. Assignment explanations can feel vague at start but expectations are consistent. Readings were assessed before lecture started for the week, sometimes made lecture feel redundant even though attendance was required. Warm and accessible.

I can't say enough good things about Professor Hozic. I took her class Divided Cities and really learned a lot. She is one of the most caring professors I've had at UF and she really makes an effort to check up on her students. You can tell she is very knowledgeable and passionate about what she teaches. Not a harsh grader.

Dr. Hozic is the best and most interesting professor I've had so far at UF! I took her class in summer 2020, on Zoom. The class was very interesting and she did a great job of engaging students throughout the class. Highly recommend!

I love Professor Hozic so much. She really puts in the time and effort to make very student feel like they matter. She comes into class and greets everyone with a warm smile. She was the highlight of my semester and I hope to take more classes with her!

Hozic was by far one of my favorite professors at UF. Lectures are interesting and thought-provoking as well as helpful for the essays she assigns and the exams. This class is meant to be taken seriously as there are A LOT of pages to read and weekly quizzes, but if you put in the time you should pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Shes an amazing teacher who really cares about what she teaches. She is not a hard grader. There is a Lot of reading which you don't need to thoroughly do but you need to read. Her assignments are meaningful.

She's a great teacher, but you HAVE to do your readings to do well on the quizzes/tests. She is a lecture teacher and does not have outlined notes. Make sure you understand the chapters and ask questions when you need to. She's intimidating and her lectures are confusing at times, but keep up with your readings, do your work and you'll be fine.

Hozic is an incredible individual & professor. Compassionate towards students & highly educated. Loves questions & almost always responds to them in a way that is valuable for the entire class. 13 miniquizzes, 1 midterm (in class), & 1 final (take home). Not a harsh grader & and if you have genuine interest in int. politics/IR - she's a must have

Professor Hozic was one of the most respectful and passionate teachers I have had at UF. Their are a lot of readings each week, but you can get by skimming to do the weekly assignment (although the readings are very interesting). There are three 2000 word papers due at the end of the semester and no exams!

Dr. Hozic cares a lot about the students and always gives good feedback on your work, and any questions you have in general. Dr. Hozic has gone out of her way to make sure that students are okay. She is available to meet outside of class whenever you need it. You will be reading a lot and working hard, but also learning a lot. Fantastic professor.
One of the most approachable professors I have ever had. Gives excellent feedback and makes the material relatable! Taking one of her other courses next semester.

Dr. Hozic is a well-spoken woman with a unique past; Good Life is notorious for being a terrible class, but I enjoyed Hozic's lectures. Those that say that her accent is hard to understand probably didn't grow up around people of other cultures b/c her English is 100% fine. You can tell she is smart and knows much about literature and the arts.

IUF1000 is so structured by UF that the actual professor you get doesn't seem to matter much. That being said, Hozic wasn't spectacular, but she seemed to just follow what the university told her to teach considering it's a mandatory class.

Dr. Hozic is a very sweet woman who seems to really care about her students' well being. Lectures are pretty boring and her accent is hard to understand at first. Course material isn't hard though, just make sure you keep up with the reading, especially if you are taking it over the summer, where everything is packed in. And don't skip class!

Her class isn't too fun, but neither are any good life classes.  From speaking with many peers, it IS evident that her homework and exam questions are FAR EASIER than those of the other professors. She is also extremely accessible if you need help with anything, class related or not. She's a boring lecturer, but lectures aren't important anyways.

She is a genuinely nice lady. Her accent is relatively strong, but you'll get used to it. Her lectures can get a bit boring (probably because they were good life lectures), but she still cared about what she was teaching.

Professor Hozic is one of the best professors in the Poli Sci Department and made my time as a Poli Sci major much more enjoyable. She knows a ton about pretty much any subject and has a great wit, both making her classes very interesting, no matter the subject at hand. I had her for Divided Cities and Politics of the World Economy. Take a class.
Can be difficult to understand, due to accent. Got off topic very easily. I don't dislike her, so much as the class was fairly pointless.

Dr. Hozic knows what she is talking about but she does get off-topic very easily. There is some reading so make sure to stay on top of everything. Also, some points will come solely from attendance to discussion and lecture sections! Do your readings and you should easily get an A. All readings are online.

I had professor Hozic as my lecturer for good life and it was honestly hard to pay attention in class. It is clear that Hozic knows what she's talking about, but she is prone to going off on irrelevant tangents during lecture. I would not recommend having her as a lecturer but it is fairly easy to get an A with her in IUF1000.

Dr. Hozic is brilliant, and she truly cares about her students. I would take her again, BUT not for a class like theory (i.e. theory-heavy reading). She is an awful lecturer, but she does make you think & she sparks interesting discussions. The amount she cares about her students makes up for the bad lectures. She is a no BS type person....

I wouldn't take a class with her again. Her communication skills are poor and she seems unhappy in and out of class. There were some good aspects to her course, but overall she lacks patience and generally seems frustrated. Her inflexibility, rigidness, and lack of clarity makes her difficult to work with. I am a graduate student.

Absolutely terrible professor. No clarity, consistency, true method, or substantial material. Her exams were disconnected from lectures. She tries to "open your mind" but instead instigates quarrels and ridiculous debates unrelated to the class. Just plain awful. Worked too hard for my A.

If you are Republican, do not take her classes. She is very liberal, and unless you are right-wing and really no your stuff and can articulate well, then don't take it because she will destroy right-wing orthodoxy pretty harshly. If you want to put in the work and are smart enough, a Republican can get an A, but it is harder.

Dr. Hozic is SO intelligent, nice & funny. At first, class is difficult to adjust b/c she pushes for open discussions from readings & ur opinions, making u confused on what u are "learning" abt. Lecture isn't "systematic" where u write all period but based on participation. Only 3 papers- MUST WRITE WELL! Read, attend class, talk & u will get an A

DON'T TAKE THIS CLASS. 3 EXAMS AND A FEW REPORTS. THE REPORTS ARE EASY BUT HER TESTS HAVE NOTHING TO DO WITH LECTURES. IF YOU TAKE HTIS CLASS AND YOU DO ALL THE REPORTS BUT YOU DON'T DO SO WELL IN HER EXAMS! DROPPP ITTT!!! TRUST ME YOU MIGHT THINK YOU'LL PASS BUT HER FINAL EXAM WORST THEN THE FIRST TWO.
Awesome Class. Only two pop quizes to worry about. Professor truly opens your eyes about the realities of "International Relations"... Take her class, I loved it!

This class is not difficult at all, and requires very little work. If you read the book, go to class every so often, then you will do extremely well. Hozic's lectures are thought provoking and interesting if you are interested in politics. Though she is from Bosnia, she probably knows more about America than most americans.

This class can be interesting if you allow it to be. The tests require thinking, so if you are able to do so well then i would recommend this class. If you wish to simply memorize definitions dont bother. And you need to read the book too.

I stuck with this class for more than 3 months, and I regret putting forth so much effort. I don't doubt she is intelligent, but she is a poor teacher. When she attempts to lecture, she becomes very flustered and makes little sense. She is frustrated with America. Reading the book is the best you can do, but the tests require more than just that.

this class mad me laugh out loud. Hozic tries to be a good teacher, but she has a habit of not answering questions. If asked a question she will give two answers on opposite ends of the spectrum. You dont even have to go to class because she shows a movie every other day.  If you want to do well read the textbook and apply the concepts.
Dr. Hozic is a real asset to UF and lends herself well to helping students...I would take another class with her anytime. Her worldly insights are unmatched.
Dr Hozic is my favorite professor, she is very smart and empathetic. show interest for the class and she will reward you!

Dr Hozic is the most intelligent professor I have had at UF. She encourages free thinking and challenges students to think outside the box. However, if you are not a poli sci major, I wouldn't take her classes, because you might not understand what she is talking about. Enjoy her classes!!!

Her class is hard, so if your interested in an easy A then you might not want to take her class.  She is extremely intelligent, and there are times in class when you just don't get what she is saying, but her ability to help outside of class is outstanding.

The most boring college class I've ever had. She wants you to read 7 books for the class. Your grade comes from 3 5-page papers. She loves to use fancy words. you will hear her say "in a certin sense", "again" a million times in her class.

She seems rather angry at the world sometimes. She is so unclear I ended up dropping INR and taking it again. If you are a poli sci major DO NOT take this class with her you will need more a foundation than she provides. The TA's for this class SUCKED too
Horrible teacher, unclear, tests hard.
No Comments
You will have no idea what's going on in this class.  However, on the up side, I never paid attention and still pulled a C so do with that what you will.
No Comments
Easy class.  Good teacher.  Easy A
She encourages free thinking and is very willing to help students, she is not  easy  (as college professors should not be)
