The textbook is all table and formula based, but the class requires R. There are no handouts or sample problems in for R. Don't expect him to respond after the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Online course - watch the lectures and work the homework practice problems online

His lecture notes assume you already understand statistics instead of breaking down the concepts in simple language. As for the lecture videos themselves, he speeds through a lot of material and does not organize his thoughts very well. I want to understand and enjoy statistics, but this class is making it very difficult to do either of those.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Tells rude jokes and speeds through material. Not helpful in office hours. Homework is all calculations while the test are all conceptual which leaves you with no practice for test. Homework is not a useful indicator of testing material. He curved test at end of semester in fear of student feedback for bad evals.

His class is really organized and he even has a complete pdf. version note about this course.I am minoring in statistics, his teaching style made me really comfortable learning new stuffs and even made me feel stats is fun. If you go to his office hours, he would be really patient to answer every question in detail. Overall, I enjoyed his class
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I took his class in Fall 2016. He is very organized, grades very fairly and gives great feedback so you know exactly where you went wrong and genuinely cares about his students. His rules are outlined at the beginning of the semester and he sticks to them. I would definitely take his class again.
In 6 years of taking online courses, this has been the most frustrating experience. His class is in no way a designated for online attendance.

I took his class in Fall 2016. He is disorganized, grades unfairly, and does not like to provide complete feedback. In his eyes, he chooses the rules and plays by them selectively.  Avoid if your grade counts.

This guy should not be allowed to teach. His lectures are completely ineffective. He insults people all the time in class. He hates his job. This was one of the hardest classes I have ever taken and for no good reason. Statistics is important to learn, so don't take it with this guy.

When lecturing, he frequently skips steps, making it incredibly difficult to follow and makes going to class only useful on quiz days.   The tests are very difficult, as they are completely different than any examples or homework problems. Self-teaching was necessary for me to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: A good professor that cares about theearning of his students. He can be inflexible if you don't adhere to the syllabus, but that mostly lies in student competency.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: I really liked statistics, so I found the content and the way he taught to be quite enjoyable. Although he might not seem like it, he is very understanding as a teacher if you talk to him a lot after class. Participating actively in class as well as online helps out a lot, to do well in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Avoid if possible. Homework, Quizzes, and Exams usually relate to each other in some way. His never did. He said R would be helpful. Um, R is required for quizzes, would have been nice to know. Any warning would have been nice honestly. I was also taking Calc 3, Differential Equations, and a writing intensive class. This was somehow the hardest.

1) Average professor. I thought he was decent, but some students didn't like him. 2) Don't let his humor/tone intimidate you; he's actually nice and pretty helpful. 3) You *can* get by  skipping class, but then you miss chances of extra credit and strong test and "pop" quiz hints which are VERY important to getting that A. 4) Very fair grader

Biggest problem is that he teaches mostly via examples done in R, but then his tests don't make use of any of that. Tests are tough because none of the examples in class prepare you well. Does both online and in class quizzes and won't tell you which beforehand. Gave us a fully multiple choice final exam because he was busy with his other classes.

He's not the best teacher, and his online quizzes were a bit frustrating. The textbook you can find online. Since he's not a very good teacher, his tests were difficult, but I feel like if you have good prior knowledge you'll be fine. In my opinion I would try to avoid him, but he's not the worst. He does curve at the end.

One of the better teachers in the stats department. His humor is very dry which I liked but others didn't. His tests aren't easy but he'll curve at the end of the semester. Overall, pretty good, although his online quizzes where you just scan homework problems were pointless.

Professor uses his own podcast/textbook for the class it is $100+ but 100% mandatory. The only assignments for the class are the EXAMS. 3 exams and 1 final. ALL open and due on the same day. 100% of the test material comes from the textbook. Look up Astronomy 2002 on quizlet if you cannot/do not buy textbook. 
No other assignment but the EXAMS

Prof. Sarajedini is definitely worth taking! The material is overwhelming at times (theoretical physics), but he's really passionate and has a vested interest in helping his students succeed. It's definitely possible to get an A, as long as you devote time to reading the book, attending lectures, and asking questions. The universe is a cool place!

Professor Ata made what could have been a very boring class exciting and interesting. He clearly has a passion for the subject. However, the exams were brutal for a 1000 level course. If you're looking for an awesome teacher that will really challenge you, take this class. If you're looking for an easy A, I'd go elsewhere.

He was very interested in the subject, and it made me very interested in the subject. Open note, open book tests because he would rather see us enjoy the material than struggle. I strongly recommend him.

He tried something new this semester, open book and open notes exam. I thought this was a gift from the astronomy God but it wasn't. His exams were a lot harder then anything in his notes. I don't know how anyone got higher then a C on his exams. That's as good as I could do :/ But he is extremely interested in the subject, has interesting lectures
Great teacher who loves his subject.  Very helpful and goes over stuff before exams.  Read book and website and you'll get an A on every test
pretty good teacher
Ata is the man. I'm not a science person, but he made astronomy understandable and interesting. Loved going to his class!
kind of tough class but really interesting, you learn a lot
I went to class so I didnt miss quizzes but I really just read the alligator while he was lecturing. If you study the online practice questions the tests are pretty easy though. Easy B.
he explains atronomy very well. 3 tests count for 75%, you have an observation proj for 10% and in class quizes that count for attendance. astronomy is insane, and he makes it interesting.
He's ok, his lectures are boring, but the class wasn't THAT hard... you just have to study a lot and do the reviews. Otherwise you're screwed.

Ugh, what to say that hasn't already said. I am definitely not a science person, and wanted an easy "P" credit. Should've went for another class, as I ended up only getting a B after a lot of hand-wringing, cursing and frustration. A 1000-level class in name only!
He's a very nice teacher. Allows notes and group help on in class quizes. The tests are straight forward and as long as you do the review guide you'll be fine
dont take this class! so hard for a 1000 level class. Took it as a physical science and thought it would be easy. Stay away from this unless you are interested in it.
His lectures are so boring and the class is so hard if you're not into the subject. I can't believe I had to waste one of my drops on a 1000-level class...
I'm falling alseep just trying to type this guy's rating. THE MOST BORING LECTURES YOU CAN EVER IMAGINE!!! other than that, not THAT bad...
soooooo difficult!!! oh how i wish i'd just taken Age of Dinosaurs.  sigh.

RUN. Run as fast as you can. This class is not easy. Because it is a 1000 level class you would think that it would be easy. NO!!!! Need physical science. Take it with someone else or take something else. I wish I had never taken his class. Ohh why did I take this class :( sniff

My boring alarm goes off every time I think about him.  His lectures are exactly like the book and he puts the notes on the web.  His class is easy but 2 periods of lectures by him are terrible.  He knows his stuff but still zzzzzzzzz
Easy to get an A, but the class was boring.
Really easy class, average lectures. Adaptive quizzes on mcgraw hill is most of the homework and they are very annoying to do.

Great professor and amazing lectures. There are readings after each lecture but take no longer than half and hour. Does not take late work but leaves assignments open for a little over a week. Fairly easy assignments and the tests are based all on the lectures and are not overly hard because of the practice tests.

Such a caring professor. I love microbiology so this class was interesting to me. Not very hard, weekly homework (take 2 hours or so), weekly quizzes (10 questions), 4 exams (non-cumulative), some perusall, 2 extra credits. His lectures give all the info for exam, just long.

Didn't like his lectures. They were very dense and he often rambled. Study the lecture slides and study guide for exams! Smokin'Notes help, but the practice questions aren't as good. His exam questions can get very specific, so study hard! He had weekly homework assignments that were ~100 questions. Take advantage of the extra credit offered!

Dr. Asghari is very approachable. Keep up with the material instead of cramming at the last minute because its a lot of information. Smokin notes organizes information well and is very helpful in this course.

The lectures can be very long, but they include all the information needed for exams. He gives out a comprehensive study guide with all the learning objectives that will on the exam, and a vast majority of his questions come from that. He also responds quickly to email and loves it when people as questions. Easy A if you put in effort.

It was very easy to get an A in this course. I never even watched the lectures, just did the study guides.
His lectures can be boring but smokin notes carried my grade. Overall, he's a very nice guy and is responsive to questions about the course material. He always does a review session a week before the exam, which is super generous.

He is so understanding and is genuinely interested in his topics. His excitement for the course always made me feel more engaged and supported. Though the content was not particularly my favorite, I really enjoyed MCB2000 due to Professor Asghari. He is also very clear about exam contents and his expectations for the course.

I'm currently taking him for MCB2000 online and I don't know if it's just me but his lectures are very hard to go along with and don't often correspond with the slides behind him. I have trouble focusing as I have ADHD and it just really throws me in a loop the way he speaks. Other then that the class is very easy, mostly just preparing for exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took this as a summer A class, which I don't necessarily recommend. The class was doable, but challenging because it was such a short time period. Exams were harder than I expected, but all the assignments and getting Smokin' Notes helped. Would recommend watching the lectures too. Good prof overall, just wish I took it over a normal semester.

Professor Asghari is understanding and offers lots of extra credit. The exams focus on lecture slides, and resources like Smokin Notes and quizzes really help with study prep. Definitely take this class if you need an easy A!

Professor was great and understanding! He was honest about the lectures and exams and what the content was going to be on. Exams are purely the lecture slides and study guides and Smokin Notes really helps in reviewing this content and making sure you retain the information. The practice exams on Smokin Notes was the reason I got an A+!

Professor was great and understanding! He was honest about the lectures and exams and what the content was going to be on! Exams are purely the lecture slides and study guides and Smokin notes really helps in reviewing this content and making sure you retain the information! The practice exams on Smokin Notes was the reason I got an A+!

Dr. Asghari is a really good professor, he is caring and understanding of circumstances. Your grade is made up of 4 exams and Pearson assignments. All of the lectures are pre-recorded and open for the week. If you study leading up to the exams, you will be fine. He extended one of our exams and gave us an end-of-semester extra credit opportunity.

Dr. Asghari is a great lecturer and always responds super quick. Definitely use his practice exams and study guide.
There's always at least a few question on the exam taken directly from the practice exams. Another great resource was Smokin Notes, they give answers to his study guide questions. really liked this class and professor!

Definitely recommend taking the practice exams since they are similar to the real exams. Dr. Asghari does a good job at explaining specific concepts. Also, I recommend Smokin Notes the suggested study guide responses and physical flash cards are very helpful.

my opinion is biased because i struggle learning through an online format and this class is only offered online. his lectures are very boring, so I used smokin notes to study. his exams are extremely detail-specific when they don't have to be. grade is comprised by four exams and extra credit helps boost the grade.

Lots of extra credit quizzes that help your grade. Your grade is based off of 4 exams. Watch all the lectures and do the study guides!! I only used Smokin' Notes for the first two exams and did bad but didn't use smokin notes on the last two exams and did well with just the study guide alone. Test questions are difficult and pretty specific.
Great professor. Cares about his students and the material. Offers lots of extra credit, so an A is pretty attainable if you study for the exams. You don't need smokin notes lol.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: As a graduate student, this class was rough. Lots of reading. His lectures are very long and honestly boring. This class definitely requires lots of time for studying. He does offer extra credit, but the tests are kinda awful. He does give study guides but only for the lecture material not the reading material which is 25% of the tests :/
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Asghari is fantastic. He really wants students to succeed. He is clear about what to expect on exams and his lectures help hammer in the main points. Four exams make up your whole grade, but extra credit is available to apply to each exam score. Glad I took this course.

After a previously terrible Microbio experience (forced to drop), Dr. Asghari was a breath of fresh air. He gives fair exams and good lectures (although hard to decipher at times). If you have the money SmokinNotes will give you a guaranteed A in the class. Overall, good professor and class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor was very helpful in class lectures and made the content very understandable. I paired lectures with smokin notes and it helped to solidify my knowledge since I was able to see the information multiple times. The class only have extra credit quizzes and exams and does require a lot of memorization.

Passed entirely on SmokinNotes. First exam I didn't need SmokinNotes because it was stuff I learned in high school + common sense, the tests are very easy. I had over 100% in the class at some point from EC but ended up with a 98% even though I was scoring in the 80-90 range for exams. External camera is required for this class though.

Dr. Asghari truly cares about his students. Even though exams are 100% of your grade, he is very generous with extra credit and is accessible for students. Smokin Notes is helpful to summarize his lectures which are pretty long and dense. Take advantage of the extra credit quizzes because it boosts your grade a lot!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The 100% test format was intimidating, but I was fine using Smokin' Notes. Honestly, I would watch all 8, hour-long lecture a week or 2 days before exams while reading Smokin' Notes, and I retained a lot. The prerecorded lectures sounded awful. The exams are SPECIFIC! The EC made my B an A. The textbook has practice materials and the EC.

This class is made up of 4 exams and a few extra credit opportunities which really help your grade. Everything on the exams is included in the pre-recorded lectures. Good class and manageable if you watch the lectures and study:)

Prof Asghari is very nice and he really cares about his students. His lectures are long and he does stutter a lot. The lectures and the study are all you need for the exams. Smoking notes can help but it's not necessary. Also do the extra credit quizzes! You will thank me later. Overall good class

The lectures were prerecorded from an in person section and are very unhelpful. He stumbles a lot and will say random information that "won't be on the exam" but then is. You also have to read the textbook which is very content dense. There are four exams but 10 pt of extra credit each exam from taking quizzes. I would take Bacusmo's class instead
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Asghari was very helpful throughout the semester. Anytime you needed extra assistance, he was a phone call away. His lectures were very informative and I really enjoyed watching them. Make sure you watch them through out the course and not right before the exams.

Professor Asghari is a great teacher in my opinion. He makes the tests 100% based on this he goes over on the lectures and he gives recaps of each lecture in the next lecture. He gives A LOT of extra credit (enough to raise a whole letter grade) and his exams are very very fair. Understand the lectures and take detailed notes and study quizlets.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Asghari is the worst professor I have had so far at UF. His lectures hardly provide any useful information, and his exams are extremely specific. The exams are mostly based off the textbook, but the book contains an excess of redundant information. Also, the exams contain typos on almost every single question.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Lots of extra credit up to 10 per exam (4 exams). Easy class all you need to do is study and do the practice questions on mastering microbiology. Get Smokin notes if you have to but it is not necessary. I studied on Quizlet made by previous students and it helped me a lot. Exams are proctored with a side view camera
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Lots of extra credit (10 points possible per exam), exams are pretty straight forward. Don't waste your time on lectures, all you need is Smokin notes.

This class has recorded lectures from in person lectures which is super helpful. He offers two extra credit quizzes that add at most 10% onto your exam, but the answers are on Quizlet so it's impossible to get them wrong. The grade is based of 4 exams but they aren't bad and he explains concepts well in his lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: His lectures are really easy to understand! He uploaded lectures online from the past and it really helps. In his lectures he tends to repeat himself a lot but it nails it in your head. SO MUCH extra credit!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I enjoyed Dr. Asghari's class. In the online accelerated Summer course we had exams every week so you need to stay on top of the lectures or you will not do well in them. Extra Credit helps as well. Questions are straightforward you just need to know the material. Definitely would take again he is a great teacher and his lecture videos were solid.

Pros: -A lot of extra credit -Exams aren't that hard -Lectures are pretty easy to understand Cons -He sometimes makes grammar errors that make it hard to understand exactly what he's asking on exams -I think I'm alone in this, but I hated the case study. It took me much longer than I thought it would so start that early. I'd take him again.

Exams make up 100% of your grade. However, there are up to 40 points of extra credit. This class is an easy A due to the extra credit. The lectures are DENSE and old. The material is taught well, it is not hard to understand. Exams were relatively straightforward.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Truly one of the best professors ive had at UF. Makes the content oversimplified so you actually understand it; goes over topics again and again so you actually understand it. Very thorough. Watching the lectures is the only way to pass- even he says all exam questions come from his lectures.

4 exams & 1 case study. total 400 points. Extra credit is worth 40 points. Exams are all multiple choice. Asghari does not teach. You get recorded lectures that are many years old with incorrect, outdated, and incoherent information. For a graduate course, I have learned nothing useful. But hey, easy A.

Great professor, but you basically teach yourself everything. The lecture videos are not very helpful. Reading the required textbook readings and doing the study guide is how you'll do good on the exams. Plenty of extra credit that help quite A LOT! Your grade is based off 4 exams, that's it. There are extra credit quizzes though. Would recommend!

Do your extra credit, make the easy A and then get an education somewhere else. Exam "readings" are cut/paste from websites, not cited & can contradict eachother. He teaches incorrect material, mixes things up & doesn't proof read quizzes/exams. Case study only cite him, primary references are NOT ALLOWED. Find a groupme, you won't learn here

Dr. Asghari uploaded recorded lectures from an in-person semester, which I think was better than live zoom lectures. He seems like a great professor to take in person, and he is very informed on current research for the information covered. He is very thorough in his teaching and expects you to have a thorough knowledge of the material covered.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took this grad level course a few months ago and wanted to come back and leave a review. During the COVID-19 pandemic this professor was very kind to his students and sent out weekly emails telling everyone he was available to talk during the difficult time. To whoever reading this, please make sure to appreciate your professors.

Although your grade is based off of 4 exams, he still gives you ample opportunities for extra credit, which is extremely helpful, considering how some of the exam questions can be tricky. Asghari makes the material easy to understand and also applicable to real life. This easily became one of my favorite courses I have taken at UF.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This class is almost entirely based on lecture (so you have to watch them all) and if you fill out his study guide YOURSELF and do the extra credit you will be totally fine. I didn't use SmokinNotes and was totally fine. I only used the book a few times for the study guide. The exams are easy if you do the study guide well.

I did great in this class yet I'm going to say he is a horrible lecturer. He makes many contradicting statements in lecture which is confusing. It's also shady that he doesn't let us look at exams to see what we missed and doesn't have clear cut replies to emails for clarification. Thousands of dollars for this? I don't think so.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Actually doing the study guide (not copying someone else's answers and reading them) and Smokin Notes are both extremely helpful for the exams. Knowing both of these well will really help you out in the long run, although it can be a lot of work!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Your entire grade is based off 4 exams. The exams are difficult, but if you fill out the study guide and use smokin notes its fine. He gives tons of extra credit which are all on quizlet. Personally got high C/s and B's on his exam and still ended up with an A because of extra credit. Lectures are very boring, but he's good at answering emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Ok so here's the thing, yes the lectures are VERY dry BUT blaming a professor's English for not doing well in the course is just plain pathetic. Grad students this semester complained too much. Look here now this is a graduate level course so if you haven't figured out how to study and do well by this time then that's your problem. Period.

This is a required class for my program and he is setting students up to fail. The information he presents is either dated or untrue. Long lectures that are rambling in nature and very repetitive. Often talks about things that are unrelated to the presentation he is giving. Take everything he says with a grain of salt and double check what he says.

Horrible class but it is required for many majors and health tracks. His lectures are boring and he talks so slow. Half of his test questions have literally nothing to do with his lectures, I dont know where he comes up with them. The other half are on lectures we were told were for the NEXT exam. Your grade is based on exams and some quizzes

His lectures and very difficult to understand because of his accent, as well as being boring. The textbook was almost useless as a study tool because it covers too much material, and doesn't cover everything on the tests. This is a hard class. Be prepared to study a lot, especially if you haven't had a Biology refresher in a while.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The online lectures were very interesting and manageable. Exams were somewhat difficult but are very straightforward. If you take good notes and read the textbook, you will do great.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Make sure to take every extra credit quiz. The recorded lectures were so incredibly boring that I stopped watching them altogether after the first exam. I read through the smokin notes before every test and was fine. Overall he was an average prof and its possible to get an A with a minimal amount of effort.
Not an easy A. Boring, old lectures. Very specific, confusing test questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The lectures are presented on power points which he reads verbatim to the class, although he does give further explanation and repeats the most important info. His lectures are a good representation of test material and his explanations, although lengthy, are helpful. Hint: watch the videos to 1.5x speed, brings his slower tone to a normal speed.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Not an easy class. Information isn't that complex for a science class, but tests have very difficult and specific question. Most questions come from the lectures which are great, if you can get past his accent (don't need to read book). Test questions have grammatical errors, but EC makes up for that. Good class, but not easy as others have said.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Not an easy A, but definitely doable. Make sure to take every extra credit quiz, answers are all on quizlet and taking both before each exam is worth 10% back on your exam grade. Recommend completing the study guides by yourself before each exam, as well as re-watching parts of the lectures that are emphasized. Don't really need to read textbook.

Dr Asghari asks very tricky exam questions. Honestly Im surprised at the few people who said it's easy to get an A. It's not. I have taken several upper-level science courses that had more straightfwd questions. They were mostly which of these are true: I&II, II&III, none, etc. Extra credit was almost not worth the time spent to get a point.

He was kinda rude when I emailed him and not helpful at all. The class requires a lot of memorization and his lectures are extremely boring. The videos dont have closed captions and it is hard to understand him at times. I wouldnt recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Asghari is a great professor! His tests are not hard but can be very tricky to see if you actually studied the material. Watch lectures, do the required readings & smoking notes & you'll be good. He also gives A LOT of extra credit. Word of advice: don't skip lectures and rely heavily on smoking notes, I made this mistake and it cost me an A

Professor Asghari is a good lecturer and his class is pretty easy. He only grades you on 4 exams, however, provides a bunch of extra credit quizzes to boost your grade. Before each exam he provides a study guide which is basically the entire exam. Exams can be tricky though because of the way he asks questions.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Extremely knowledgeable professor in microbiology. Exams can be tricky because he likes to throw in a lot of "all of the above" or "none of the above" questions, so you really gotta know the stuff. An A is definitely manageable with the EC, practice exams and study guides. Very fair on grading. Blaming his english wont get you the A, just STUDY.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The only grades for this course are the 4 exams. Each exam you can earn up to 10 extra credit points through online quizzes. You need to get a 90 on each exam to get an A, so with the 10 extra credit points you only need an 80 on each exam. If you read the Smokin' Notes the week up to the exam you will be fine! Just study hard and don't stress!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: His tests are awful. Grammatical errors, not enough direct question/answers. This is supposed to be a fully online class, so the eBook (and even the smokin notes) you got to pay for should be enough, but that is not the case here. Worse online class I've ever taken
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Use the study guides and practice exams that he posts as the questions on the exam are very similar to the ones asked on the study guide and practice exams. Watch every lecture too cause he pulls a lot of questions from there as well. He's very smart and knows what he's talking about.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Class is very straightforward and structured. Very generous extra credit on each exam, and gives you a study guide that goes over almost every topic on the exam. Do the practice tests online a couple times and you should be more than fine. Interesting class and grading is very fair.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Asghari is a very passionate professor. He knows what he's talking about and really just wants you to succeed. He gives 10 pts extra credit for every exam (if you get a 70 on the exam, its really an 80 if you do the extra credit quiz). The quizzes are all online and have answers on quizlet so it is easy. His exams are really fair. Easy A.

Lots of extra credit, very lenient scaling. Grades are exam based (they are multiple choice) with a clinical case study project (structured like an untimed, open-note exam). A bit negligent as an online instructor (did not answer many questions in discussions), but the grading and coursework was fair. Easily manageable, introductory material.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: His class is extremely easy to get an A in, it just takes work. With the extra credit, you only need an 80% on 4 exams to get an A. As much as it sucks, watch the lectures. He alludes to the answers of questions he will put on his exams. You've got to know the material well since a lot of his exam Q's are "all of the above/NOTA" and "2 of these".

I genuinely enjoyed this Professor. He knows the material and really seems to care about teaching his students. He is lecture heavy, but he is very transparent on what you will be tested on, and gives extra credit opportunities, a study guide, and a practice exam. You walk away having actually learned something, which lets be honest, is rare.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I loved this professor! He made the criteria for the exams really clear and pretty much everything came from his lectures. Exams are straightforward. In my class he gave 4 exams, each 25% of grade. But, he gave quizzes that amounted to a total of 11.5% on the final grade. Super enjoyable class and I really learned a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He is one of those professors who knows what he is talking about, is truly passionate about the subject and at the end of the day just wants his students to be successful. He provides you with everything you need to succeed. UTILIZE HIS STUDY GUIDES! Filling these out may be a pain but I promise they are the key to success when it comes to exams.
I was very scared coming into this course because I struggled with chemistry but found it really enjoyable.

Definitely not an EASY class, but you'll do okay if you just study! He gives A LOT of extra credit so initially if you have a C, it can easily bump you up to an B. His accent is thick as well so try to pay attention to his lectures.

Incredibly fair class with ample amounts of extra credit to boost your grade! It is true that the exams have confusing answer choices (A, B &C, All, None), but if you really study and take your time during the exam, you will know what he is asking! Skip reading the textbook and just get smokin notes!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: A lot of textbook readings. He does give extra credit readings, but they are extremely difficult. His accent is a bit thick and sometimes he gets confused during lectures and will say one thing and a couple minutes later will say that same thing has a completely different definition. Seems to get confused sometimes.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: There are four tests that account for the entirety of your grade with some extra credit offered. The test questions are super specific; you really have to know the material in-depth. Not a fan of the multiple choice of multiple choice format. Smokin notes, lectures and study guides and you'll be fine.

I love this man. He is one of the few professors at UF that actually cares about his students. Yes, his accent is thick, but you get used to it. All of the information you need for the exams comes from his lectures and his "required readings". If you don't do so hot on the exams there is so much extra credit you can do!

Plenty of extra credit was given and he made it very clear how to study for exams. Watch the lectures, take notes, do the study guide, and know the study guide very well. Yes, exam questions were tricky but you can get past them if you know what he said in the lectures. Don't just read the book. He says most exam material comes from the lectures.

I dont want to blame it all on Dr. Asghari. In reality, there are many opportunities to get points. And the accent is not that bad. I think, part of the problem is that this class should be an in-classroom course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Tests are tough--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Worst professor ever. He knows his stuff but is not a great teacher. Lectures are hard to understand. UF really needs to make this course and in-seat class. The test are very difficult to study for because his questions are very specific. He ends class 2 weeks early? Why not distribute that time throughout the course. Step it up UF!
His tests question you on VERY specific details. The study guides he gives are basically useless. Definitely do all the extra credit he offers even if they're long.
Tough tests. Many grammatical errors in his tests. Tests us mainly on specific details mentioned only in lecture. Even the study guides he provided us were useless.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This class was honestly awful. I dont understand how people thought this class was good. The exams have so many grammar mistakes and are very tricky. Buy smokin notes and literally know every little detail. do the extra credit As well. Didnt feel like the lectures were good for exams and hes not a good communicator or very nice but JMO.

I came into this class as a freshman not knowing what to expect. The entire grade is based off of 4 multiple choice proctorU tests. Multiple choice ?s are VERY difficult, often have grammatical errors, and focus on obscure details I didn't retain even after reading the textbook. Wouldn't recommend the class unless you have to take it
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: You get ample opportunities for extra credit in this course that help a lot. His exams are difficult to understand because of the grammatical errors but if you studied enough and went over lecture slides it's easy to tell what he's asking. Highly recommend doing all extra credit he offers. They're long but worth it in the end.

Dr. Asghari is a very good professor. He cares about students, tries his best to be accessible, and has an obvious passion for microbiology. His MCB3020 requires a lot of studying to do well on exams (which is expected), but an A is very easily attainable if you complete the extra credit assignments and take an interest in the subject matter.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The tests are really hard. A few students were involved in an incident that happened around the middle of the semester. I think, as a result, the last two tests were very hard. I do not recommend you take this class with Dr. Asghari.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Took Dr. Asghari for both MCB5252 and MCB6937/3020 in the same semester. The perfect example of a tough (yet fair) professor. His tests are very difficult and there is a lot of material to learn, but he gives about 1 letter-grade worth of *helpful* extra credit assignments, not busy work.A great transition into grad school.

I took his class in the spring. He makes it VERY clear how he wants you to study for exams. I didn't read the book and I was one of the 8 people who showed up to his 8:30 am lectures. Keys to do well: DO THE STUDY GUIDE, TAKE THE PRACTICE TESTS...A LOT. Seriously, questions for the exams come from the practice tests and study guide.

I took this course Fall 2016, it is information dense and a lot of information to take in since lectures are online. I watched every lecture and took notes, went to his office hours which were helpful, and I used smokin notes to prepare for each exam. The course is interesting and it takes effort to get a good grade. A good grade is possible!
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: 4 difficult exams. 4 extra credit quizzes. 4 extra credit practice exams. He gives 4 study guides, posts all the material on canvas, and you take the exams on ProctorU.  Don't try to cram (way too much material that can be easy to confuse) and you'll do fine.

Your grade is based entirely on exams, but there is a TON of extra credit (enough to go from B- to A).  My best advice would be to fill in the study guides as you watch the lectures and DO THE PRACTICE TESTS.  He draws a lot of questions from them.  I also found the "Smart Book" to be helpful too because it had quizzes.  I thought he was very fair.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Asghari was an amazing professor he explains everything so you can understand well.  Watch all the lectures online so you can pause them and take detailed notes. Do the study guide, and know everything in your notes.  Lots of extra credit! You should be able to do very well in this class.

As with most online courses, your grade is a reflection of your effort. If you keep up with lectures, you should do well. Some lectures can be dry, but no overly difficult concepts are covered. The test question format can be tricky, but there are many extra credit quizzes to balance this out. If you do the study guide in full, you should do well.

Went in thinking class would be a breeze. The information is not exactly simple. There is a textbook, and I specifically studied the textbook for the first two exams, and did ok. The second two exams paid attention to the lectures and did well. Your grades  come from four exams over the semester, but there is a lot of extra credit. Gotta study.

I don't really know why people complain about this class. General bio is way harder. Smoking notes is key to success, you don't even have to watch the lectures. The amount EXTRA CREDIT is insane, I had over an 100% in the class the entire semester. His accent is really not as bad as people say it is, if you do decide to watch the lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: So there are four exams. The test a tricky due there being so many options meaning there are five answer choices being a,b,c,all of the above or none or the above. Lectures are very dry but he goes over all the material. study guide is long and would recommend to make a friend to help complete. Just have to work to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Professor Asghari is generous when it comes to extra credit, this semester he gave about 30 points of extra credit. There are 4 exams filled with confusing wording and answer choices that consist of selections such as "A and B only, ALL but except one" etc. I recommend heavily to buy smokin' notes and studying them a week in advance to do well.

Tests questions are really tricky, so make sure you get good enough study time before each test. Smokin notes helped a lot with the information, but is hard to learn everything a week before. He can be hard to understand, but definitely watch the lectures, they are super helpful.

Exams are very tricky! Beware. If you don't know your stuff you won't do well. Smokin Notes are a MUST. They are all you need to pass the class. You don't really need Connect ($80) unless you want to take his practice exams (which give you extra credit). However these practice exam question don't appear on the test. Again, Smokin Notes is your BFF.

Your grade consists of four 100 point exams,  and there is a 5 point extra credit quiz for each exam. The professor explains concepts in a simple way, which is good. However, he tends to go over the same slides more than once, so watch the lectures online. The exams are very detailed, just make sure to complete the study guide thoroughly.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Lectures give absolutely no indication of how detailed and confusing the questions on the exam will be so make sure you really really know your stuff or use outside help for studying. Interesting guy, enjoyed the lectures, but need to work a bit to get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: MCB 2000 is one of the easiest science classes I have taken at UF. All of your grades come from exams, but he gives you 5 bonus points per exam and you get 2 bonus questions on the exam itself (another 5 pts). Everything you need to know is in the lecture. I found that the best way to study was to 1) watch all the lectures, 2) do the study guide.

You can earn 20 points of extra credit, so you need an average of an 85 on all the tests to get an A which is doable.  Watch the lectures and take notes; Smokinnotes were helpful too.  Be prepared since the multiple choice format is specific i.e all of the above, none of the above, B and D etc.

He was nice, always responded to my emails when I wanted clarification about lecture material. There's only 4 exams, worth 100 points each. He gives you 4 extra credit opportunities for each exam where you have to do an extra reading and take a 10 question quiz, worth 5 points for each quiz, not too hard. Curves exams.  Study and you'll be good!!

Dr. Asghari makes the class really enjoyable. Sometimes its hard to understand him, but the lectures are online so you can always rewind it and watch it again. He gives a lot of extra credit opportunities and curves the exam grades. You have to watch the lectures. As long as you watch them, do the study guide, and the extra credit you'll be fine.

Watch every lecture and take good notes, do the extra credit , study guides, and practice exams from the ebook and you you will be fine. Go to his office hours also, he is more than willing to help and is honestly such a nice man.

Dr. Asghari is a great lecturer; he emphasizes and repeats the things you need to know for tests. I found the class easy but he offers four extra credit quizzes that can help your grade. I found it really helpful to make the study guide while watching his lectures again!

The material itself wasn't too bad but his tests were ridiculously difficult. They're multiple choice but the options go like A, A &B, B &C, all of the above, two of the above, none of the above! You have to know the material in detail. Smokin notes help as long as you're ready to remember each and every word of it. You have to work really hard!!

Tests are hard; watching lectures and remembering the info is a must, even with Smokin' Notes. And don't be that one guy at his office after the semester begging for 2.5 points to get an A. He already gives out a BUNCH of extra credit so there really is no reason not to get an A provided that you know, study as if you want to get into med school.
Good class, somewhat difficult to follow in lecture.  Smokin'Notes were very helpful for this class.

Dr. Asghari has to be one of the best professors at UF. He really genuinely cares for students and wants them to do well. There are so many resources available for you it's amazing! It is heavy material and I mean  what science class doesn't require effort? Never used smokin notes.

This class should be an easy A/A- with some effort. SmokinNotes ended up being a waste of money as I ended up just watching lecture. Take notes on lecture, do the practice exams the SI leaders post. Glance at the Study Guides he posts to make sure you know what's on them. Test are tricky at times, so give yourself at least 2-3 days studying time.

The material is overall simple but his tests are brutal. His lectures seem okay to comprehend and his study guide is helpful. The test questions are tricky despite it being multiple choice because each choice is not straight forward and has a multitude of options such as all of the above , none of the above, A and B or A,B and C or B and E.

This class was harder than I expected. You don't go to class, you just watch his lectures (about 3 a week, 1 hour ish each). There are 4 exams that make up your grade, but he offers some extra credit. I put this class on a pedestal and did everything in my power to do well, and I still got Cs on his exams, even when I felt confident.

The class overall is definitely not easy. Going to class was not mandatory, instead he posted pre-recorded lectures online which are critical to watch. Everything on the exams are in those lectures, while the book is not necessary to read at all. Requires a lot of memorization.

His lectures are clear and organized.  All the test questions are tricky and meant to confuse you. The questions are in the format: "All the of following are true except, or all of the following are false except." And the answer choices would be: one of these, two of these, none of the above, all are false, all are correct. Hard tests. Be ready.
Four exams, lectures are all online. If you watch the lectures, take notes, and do the study guide, you'll be fine. Take the practice exams and do the extra credit. Great professor!!

I loved this class & would 100% take it again. Lectures were long, but very interesting if you are going into the health field. He's very knowledgable & offered a ton of office hours. Exams weren't bad & he offers practice exams which are VERY similar to the actual exams. Plus, he offered a TON of extra credit points!

This class is great. I would take it again if I could. I loved Dr. Asghari; it is true that his lectures are dry but if you really pay attention and take good notes, you will have a great experience. He is really helpful and wants his students to succeed. I didn't use the book at all. You need to study hard to get an A. Take him!
Definitely the easiest of the pre-med classes. Smokin Notes are helpful as his lectures bounce around a lot and can be kind've hard to follow. Offered 20 points of extra credit this semester.

This class is straight forward. Lectures are posted online. They're a bit dry, but watch them and annotate your notes. Reading is assigned and is good for reinforcement. The notes have everything you need to make an A. He offers a lot of extra credit too.
Very straightforward professor, watch your lectures and make sure to take notes on what he says. Book and reading not needed at all. Easy A

Loved this class! Overall it wasn't too difficult. Just keep up with the lectures and take notes. When you study focus on the study guide, notes and lectures. Whatever he says is basically on the test. Buying the book isn't necessary, I never used it while I was in his class. Don't fall behind!! That's the worst since his lectures are pretty slow.

His exam questions are based on what he says during his lectures. Make sure you write down everything that comes out of his mouth, especially if he mentions it TWICE. If you plan on skipping the lectures and just memorizing the slides you'll end up with n F.

Dr. Asghari is a very helpful professor. He does have an accent but anyone blaming their troubles on that fact are just taking cheap shots because it is not bad at all. He is thorough and knows the material well. The exams are not easy, you have to study for them. You don't have to buy the book, I got an A without it, just study the slides.

He is very articulate and has a natural gift in teaching. I really enjoyed coming to class and never felt bored, because he was always so enthusiastic and entertaining.He taught a challenging course and I definitely learned a lot.

Dr. Asghari is a really nice and helpful professor, but can be pretty difficult to understand. To study, make sure you read the slides thoroughly and take the practice tests as many times as possible, they can give you hints on the real exam. I managed a B in the class and never once picked up the textbook, do NOT buy it.

Tricky professor, the best at making confusing questions on tests. This class would be 100x more interesting without all the crazy questions he asks which would actually improve learning. A lot of typos on them too. Lectures are pretty disorganized too.

This class is VERY DIFFICULTY. You have to study a lot for the exam because it has trick questions and they are very different from the practice exams. Your basically stuck taking this class with him if you a pre nursing major

Dr. Asghari is great. My class with him was online, but my occasional interactions with him were wonderful. He bent over backwards to make himself available to students and always responded promptly to emails. His course was informative and challenging, but not frustratingly difficult. He does have a noticeable accent, but it never bothered me.

All lectures online. Audio quality can be poor. All exam material comes from lectures and additional assigned reading. Do the practice exams several times (4-5) because they give different questions each time. Many practice questions will be on exam. Weekly online quizzes are easy and open note.

All exam material comes from lectures, easy to memorize, questions can be badly worded but he will be fair about awarding points for his mistakes. Getting an A can be challenging but there is no reason to get less than a B.

Exam is straight from lectures which is easy to memorize. Lectures are online only, even though you sign up for a live lecture. He can be hard to understand because of his accent. His speech is very slow which means he goes over the 50 min mark all the time. Lectures also seem very unorganized. Watch his lectures at 1.5 speed and you should be fine

Most frustrating class I've taken yet. Lectures: bad quality recordings of him mumbling and scribbling on slides. Textbook is "recommended", so must rely on his notes which are utterly useless. A child could compose more coherent slides. Altered grade breakdown halfway thru semester for our "benefit" (ie his laziness/unorganization). Inconsistency

His lectures are ALL online...be sure to watch them in a timely manner as you cannot cram for his exams. That being said, his exams are very easy if you study. The material isn't hard and you also have mandatory (but very easy) online quizzes. He's very knowledgeable and helpful! Definitely a doable class. Also DO NOT buy the textbook!
He is super nice and helpful. He tries his best to speak clearly but his accent is sometimes very hard to understand.

Very good teacher! Asghari is a dedicated teacher to help out his students. Yes he is busy BUT he is always there to help. I took him over the summer and it was not bad. Just study, do the study guide and keep doing the practice exams to see how he tests

I took him online over the summer, and I believe he is going to be teaching the class from now on. Yes he did post his lectures last minute. But overall, the class was not that hard! if you just memorize his slides- ur golden. he is nice in office hours, but not any clearer than in the videos

AVOID HIS CLASS!  The class is completely online but he won't post the lectures until a week before the exam.  His lectures are painful to watch- he's not organized, hard to understand, and often contradicts himself.  There is no book so you have to rely on his video lectures that go into way too much detail. Most frustrating class I've ever taken!

Easiest microbio professor hands down if you keep up. You just have to memorize the slides & take good notes on what he says- they're key to what ends up on the exams. Do the study guide and the practice exams and you'll be fine.

I'm in awe of how this teacher got a decent rating. He is very unhelpful, makes excused when you approach him with problems, posts almost ALL material late (that is unless YOU remind him to upload something), unclear, disorganized. This class was supposed to be a live lecture, but he does it strictly online, which I thought was kind of ridiculous.

I took this class in 6 weeks and managed a 94. Keys to success are watching the lectures while taking notes on the slides, filling out the review he posts, and taking the practice exams (some questions appear on the real exams). Text not necessary. Have to keep up with the class. Not a difficult A.

Literally the best professor I've ever had. the entire semester he was so helpful and kind, and genuinely cared about his students. While the class was somewhat difficult, he always made time to go over the material again, which definitely helped me understand the concepts better. He also gives alot of extra credit and is always willing to help!

I didn't absolutely love this class or hate it. I'm in the middle.  It's not super hard and he does give some extra credit quizzes.  His exams are fairly difficult, he likes to put answer choices like "a &d" or "a,b,c" on every test.  Study Study Study. Do not cram for this test. The semester is almost over, I will be expecting an A in this class:)

easy class just a lot of memorizing so don't think you can cram for exams or watch the lectures last minute. this is a great class to take while taking physiology. ALOT of the information that you will learn in this class will parallel information being learned in physiology which will make your life much easier.

Awesome professor- really tries everything he can to help his students. If you need help, go to office hours! I didn't have time, but I would have liked to. He's a good prof. Sometimes he's a little hard to understand, and the lectures are somewhat disorganized, but it's good.

Class is easy but requires a ton of memorizing. DO NOT buy the textbook exam questions come from notes. You HAVE to take notes, many of the q's come from things he says that are not in the notes. Offers ex. credit quizzes which are online. lectures are also recorded & put online. Optional Final. Has an accent. Easy but a pain in the you know what.

He is so disorganized. I'm in this class now and it's so difficult to even understand what he expects and what to study. He says one thing and something else is on the exams. If you don't need this class, don't bother. I made that mistake.

Get the How I Got an A notes! They help so much and save you from sorting through hundreds of slides that are unorganized and not comprehensive in my opinion. Attend class to take the random extra credit quizzes. All of my friends needed those points! Do not underestimate the difficulty of this class just because it's "intro." Memorize so much!

He is a really great professor, he really wants you to learn. Attd. is not mandatory but he gives extra credit if you do. Study the review guide you fill in yourself, don't study the practice questions like they did in the past. Bottom line: Come to class, take notes, and study what he says is important. Don't buy the book, buy the slide book.

Don't underestimate this class. You actually have to attend (even tho it is not mandatory) class to take the notes, even tho powerpoints are provided prior to class. Study his practice exams. I screwed up in this class b/c I thought it would be easy from all the previous reviews. But it's not really. Just study a week ahead before the exam.

He is an awesome guy. however lecture is a little weird. I didnt like this class. i would study for every test and end up with a high C. the extra credit helped. I know there are people that get 100 on the test i honestly think that they have a cheating method. idk. its a good class but beware of test!

Nice Professor! He goes the extra mile to help students. I took this class Summer A 2010, made a 94, 100, 100, 96. It's really an easy A if you go to class, study the slides and do the review questions in the course pack.

Study the quizzes for the exams. Ask lots of questions about the labs, I think his directions are confusing and I usually forgot them once he finished explaining. Study the labs before class so you do well on the quizzes and you should get a good grade.

He is the nicest guy in the world. DO NOT show up to class late or leave early, he hates it. Be respectfully and genuinely show an interest in class. The exams are based heavily on practice exams in the course pack, don't bother studying the slides much unless he mentions it in particular.

This Class is an easy A IF you study. If you attend class, Dr. Asghari does an EXCELLENT job is teaching and giving hints for exams. Study the slides and practice exams and you'll be fine. I got: 95, 100, 100, and 95 on my 4 exams. Great class, you learn how to truly study and it's an Easy A!
Coming to class is not mandatory, but it's best to come for the extra credit quizes. DONT buy the book its a waste of time and money. just my the packet and learn it from top to bottom.
I loved this class. Make sure you study. If you need help he is willing to help you pass. Such a nice man.

Great lecturer and really nice guy. Goes out of his way to offer test reviews, extra credit quizzes (if you attend class), etc. Go to class and do all the practice tests and you'll be fine. If you slack and never attend anything (Ahem, person below me) then obviously you won't get a good grade!

Asghari is a good professor, course is well organized. Do the practice tests in the course pack and the exam review sheets he sends out before the tests. Course is graded on 4 out of 5 exams, so the final can replace one. I am a business major, took this as a gen-ed and got an A-. It did take a bit of work though.

The class is not too difficult. Do the exam review he gives you, study the slides, go to class, and you should be fine. He's a really nice guy; a little hard to understand at times, but always willing to help. Other than the fact that it's an early class, it's not too bad.

He is a great professor and very understanding. Attendence is mandatory because the test are based on his notes but the class is very early (7:25) Do the study guide and practice questions more than once and you will get an A

I didn't go to a single day of class (not even the first day, syllabus is on the course website). I just bought the course pack and the day before each exam I pored over the slides, studied the practice exams hard, and then looked over it all once more before taking the exam. I got 90, 90, 98 and 90 on the 4 exams. EASY!
deathly early in the morning and hard to understand. horrible lecturer and test questions didnt match up to study guides. I went to 5 classes the entire semester and got a C in the class.

Not too bad of a class once you get the hang of it...definitely go to class for the extra credit quizes, and definitely go to the reviews before the exams...if you have any other questions he is helpful in office hours...go over the tests after you take them especially if you take the optional final...make tables and index cards and you'll do fine
The material wasn't that difficult and the tests were doable. The cumulative final wasn't that bad either if you have to takit. He also does reviews which helps.
great guy. very helpful. come to class and get the extra credit quizzes.

I dont know what all of these people are talking about.  I am a 4.0 student, a senior, and have had many professors.  This guy is just not a good professor.  His lecture notes for MCB4203 are horibbly disorganized and the book doesn't correspond at all.  I had to us wikipedia for this class!  I got an A, but what a waste of time this class was.

The teacher makes this class very interesting.  You have to study for the tests but if you mess up u can always take the cummulative final. Class is very early (7:20 in the morning).  For the 1st test I didnt go to class and got a C on my test. For the rest of the tests I went to class everyday and got A's on the rests of the tests. So go to class!

You gotta work hard for an A. He has a soft voice and an accent so it's hard to listen to him lecture. Only buy the course pack and listen to him lecture b/c that's what his exams focus on. His exam reviews are helpful and make sure to do the extra credit quizzes for extra padding on those exams! I learned alot in his class; he's a great teacher.
He was a really good teacher, but i still had to work to get a B. it was very close!
Great class! Learned a lot. Tests are fair and attendance is a must. I recommend this class!

He was a good professor. He knew his stuff and really enjoyed it. It isn't the easiest material though you need to go over it frequently. I enjoyed the class but still had a hard time in there. There were only 4 tests with one drop.
VERY helpful..best Professor ever, even gave me much needed advice on my major..def recommend him

Attendance is a must since he explains what's on lecture coursepack. Don't buy the book and he doesn't give extra credit from cd...he gave us extra credit quiz 1-3 but that's it. It was somewhat interesting.

really easy teacher. if you study the notes packet that you can buy at gator textbook and do the practice tests included in it then you will get an A on every test. he is a pretty good lecturer but speaks really softly so it is hard to hear him sometimes.
Awesome professor. VERY SMART. I honestly don't think I've learned this much from a class a while. I really enjoyed despite getting up at 6:30 in the morning

Dr. A is a great professor. He definitely knows the subject and brings in alot of information that you can relate to the real world to make class interesting. He really is adorable. He make little jokes throughout the class that keep you awake. Only down side is how early the class is. DONT BUT THE BOOK!! Study course pack and cd's and you'll pass

WONDERFUL PROFESSOR!!! Gives lots of extra credit and really tries to make the class interesting! Really funny! You do have to study but the class is pretty interesting. Dont buy the book but definately get his course packet and cd!!! Its where all the test questions come from!
I loved this class! Lots of extra credit opportunities and He really makes the material interesting to learn and he's really funny. Definitely take it!

Wonderful teacher! He was interesting, humorous, and cute! I was actually interested in microbiology with him. He gives TONS of extra credit opportunities in class and really cares about his students doing well. He's a great teacher, pretty easy, makes things clear and I would recommend him to anyone.
No Comments

Dr. Asghari is a good instructor. The class is really early, and I fell asleep nearly everyday, but you have no choice really. The concepts in class are sort of difficult, but the tests are pretty easy even if you don't exactly understand everything and there are many extra credit opp. Don't buy the book, you don't need it just need the coursepack.
Amazing professor! I learned so much from this class and I recommend it!
I def recommend him to anyone taking classes this fall. Great prof who really cares about what he is doing. Extremely intelligent on the subject matter. GREAT CLASS!!!!
Soooo helpful. He really knows what he's talking about and is very informative. CD is GREAT!!!!! Overall if you have the cd and actually use it, expect an A.

Professor Asghari was one of the best profs I have ever had. This course single-handedly conviced me to change my major to microbiology. The lectures are. He is an awesome professor and is incredibly helpful. The Cd is great! All professors should do this, you save TONS of money by not having to buy the book. Many opportunities for extra credit!!
Not a bad class.  Lots of opportunities for extra credit.  Like a lot of people said, the book wasn't used very much.  Just make sure you take note of what he says to study when you go to lecture.

Asghari is a GREAT professor!! one of my favorites since being here @ UF!! very easy A as long as you go to lecture and study the notes and practice questions! DO NOT BUY THE BOOK!! i never even opened mine!! he also gives alot of extra credit that helps you out! Take this class!!! highly recommend it and accent is not bad at all....

People complain that his accent is hard to understand but they are just complaining.  MCB 2000 was very easey. I never read the chapters and got an A.  Just read the notes and the pratice exams. A lot of notes are from teh pratice exams.

Not the best teacher ive had. Accent is hard to understand at first. Cuts down reading so that it is bearable and lectures are kinda boring. some test questions are ambiguous and a leap from lecture material. other than that many questions are directly from notes and he gives 15 pts of E.C which in my opinion are NOT that easy but available. easy B

Dr. Asghari is a good teacher. His accent is a little tough to understand but he is more than willing to help anyone who has trouble. His exams are straightforward and he gives extra credit quizzes in class.  Good teacher, really cares about what he is doing.

Dr. Asghari is a graet professor, kind of hard to understand at first, but you get use to his accent.  Go to class every day so you dont miss out on easy extra credit points, and go to the review sessions, very helpful!
He is a great professor, lectures are interesting, and exams aren't too bad if you study.  Make sure to go to the reviews he gives before the test, they are really helpful.
Holds reviews for exams, is very nice, but has a strong accent
No Comments
Really hard to understand and his lectures put you to sleep, especially at 7:25 am.
Dr Asghari is a very nice and interesting professor. The class is not easy but he makes it interesting and the labs are good/sometimes fun. gives lots of extra credit

As expected, this course has alot if information, but Dr. Asghari does well to keep the class interesting.  You do have to work for your grade, but his tests are fair & consistent with his lectures.  Lots of xtra credit too!
lots of extra credit available :)

lol In regards to understanding him, I'm South Asian and still had trouble understanding what the heck he was talking about. He's nice as a person but class is overall a bit boring even though material is highly interesting. You have no choice on what teacher for MCB anyway so ;( sry guys!

I have no trouble understanding his lectures.  He's been in the US for a long time- there's only remnants of an accent.  He's very helpful, and the class is pretty straight-forward.  Topic is interesting, and he does a lot to apply it to real-life situations.
EASY class! make sure to study the practice tests and GO TO CLASS because he gives extra credit!
such an easy class if u study.  if u go to the review sessions that he holds the day before the test, he tells you what to study.  and gives a lot of points in extra credit!
No Comments

Sort of hard to understand; very cooperative, helps you out whenever you need it, CD is insanely expensive and lecture notes don't help too much; tests can be difficult but extra credit helps out a lot
Not a bad science.  It's a lot easier than I expected, though going to lecture is necessary.  There is a lot (6-10 points) of extra credit on every test.  The accompanying lab is also fairly easy.

Dr. Asghari was a great teacher, really helpful,offers reviews prior to exams. Expect to spend $70 + for a CD/Class notes. He gives tons of extra credit,roughly 1 whole letter grade in extra credit he offers per exam.Makeups - killer and in writing only!!
Lectures are pretty boring.  Study the stupid quizzes on his EXPENSIVE cd and the notes and u will do fine in the class. Microbiology can be very interesting!

Professor Athayde was truly amazing! She was kind, caring, knowledgeable and really straight forward. The quizzes were straight forward as well as the discussions and the homework! Her lectures were recorded so you can watch them at your convenience and the PowerPoints include lots of pictures and references! She grades quickly and responds fast!

Super nice, made stuff very straightforward. I took this online summer 2020 & had a really busy semester, but everything for this class was laid out nicely and I didn't feel like I was drowning in work. We were allowed I think one sheet of notes on exams which was really nice.

Simone is a really nice and caring person. There are rubrics for every assignment and they are all super easy. Grading is super lenient and she explains things very clearly. Textbook for me was not needed, but it could be useful. Quizzes are cake and the exams are a bit difficult, but don't count for your entire grade so its fine.

She's hateful, she continued to threaten us with due date times that did not go along with the syllabus, and when we corrected her she went on canvas and changed every due date time from 11:59 pm to 10:00 pm, mostly out of spite.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She's amazing! Learned so much from her and she's a super flexible, kind professor. Shame she's not teaching anymore next semester, was hoping to take more classes with her

I took The Listening Life for Quest 1 and it was... fine. Maybe just not my "cup of tea," but I thought it was a bit boring and repetitive. The class is very easy (she tells you on the first day that it'll probably be your easiest class this semester), and if you put in any effort, you'll do well. She can be a bit snarky if you're on her bad side.

The Listening Life is very easy and feels like a self-help class. At first I didn't really get what we would be learning, but I feel like everything was very valuable. Dr. A is a very engaging lecturer and grades essays very quickly. The only thing was that she was a bit short with students sometimes and seemed to try to embarrass them.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took Dr. A for the quest 1 course, The Listening Life. She is very passionate on the topic, although lectures can get repetitive at times. Super easy A, a few papers and exams (she gives half the questions/answers in the review session and rest come straight from the powerpoints).

I took this class for my minor and it was a great addition to my busy schedule. It wasn't hard and the few assignments we had were enjoyable and didn't take long to complete. The two exams are also extremely easy as she tells you exactly what will be on them. Dr. A is really fun and interesting and is clearly very passionate about listening.

Really fun class and Dr. A gets you engaged in listening, a topic many people often disregard in interpersonal communication. I definitely learned more about myself. The class itself is relatively easy as well, just stay engaged and be willing to learn.

Dr. A is a joy. She makes lectures engaging and is extremely knowledgeable about the course material. Willing to hear students feedback and change around dates if necessary. Quick grader and a fair grader. Highly recommend taking Dr. A for any of her courses, in-person preferred as she is extremely funny.

The Listening Life is SUCH a good class! The exams were a breeze, and the 3 essays were graded so easily. Attendance is mandatory, but the lectures are super entertaining. Dr. Athearn is so kind, and she truly cares about her students. She is funny, outgoing, easy to talk to, and really wants her students to learn the material while having fun.

Dr. A is an amazing professor and I'd highly recommend taking her Listening Life class for Quest 1. Yes, this class was very easy but it was so interesting, fun, and actually helped me grow as a person. Dr. A is so bubbly, enthusiastic, and engages students through fun outside activities and funny references. Everyone should take this class!

The only downside of this class was that attendance was mandatory, but honestly her lectures were pretty interesting. Light homework, just a couple papers but she's a nice grader and gives you a killer study guide for the two exams. Def would take again

A very chill and understanding professor who is good at teaching, passionate about what she talks about. Content is almost 90% self-explanatory, though. Exams are cake and just a few writing assignments, easiest A at UF.

Dr. A is an engaging instructor and delivered exciting lectures. The textbook is a book about how social media affects political perceptions, but it is very neutral and doesn't discuss specific political opinions. Not many assignments. My only complaint is that her grading rubric is very vague, and she does not give feedback about scores.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. A is very nice and understanding. She answers emails very quickly. You have to participate almost every class in order to receive participation credit but it's not too bad. There's a group project and at the end of the semester, you have the option to partner with someone to do a presentation or write a paper. Easy A and you learn too.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Athearn really cares about this class and her students. It isn't an "easy A" in that you have to actually show up and do things to pass, but it isn't a chore. I really liked this course and her teaching style.

I highly recommend taking her listening class! The workload is light (exams and just a few assignments) and class is super insightful. Dr. A is also super nice and truly cares about us liking the material. This is a super great class to take with a harder schedule since you will enjoy it while also learning a lot of relevant stuff.

Dr. A was literally one of the best teachers I have gotten to study under ever. She truly does care about her student and has well place priorities. She teaches you real-world concepts that actually help you, and is all around hilarious, and fun to be in class with.

Dr. A rocked!! Definitely take this class! Grading was mostly from participation and 2 projects, but the projects were fun and not too difficult. She put a lot of effort into making class engaging and finding creative ways to link the material to real life. This class was super useful and Dr. A made it infinitely better, so I 100% recommend.

Dr. A rocks! She is funny and her class was interesting. She genuinely cares about her students well-being. Most classes are discussions. There is a group project and a final paper, but neither are difficult. I took this class for my com minor and am going to take her listening class next semester!

I took Dr. A for Empathy and Instagram and she was AMAZING. The textbook is no more than 40$ and her quizzes were open notes, with no exams. The grades consist of mostly two group projects that are super simple and fun. Attendance is rarely mandatory unless its to view a student presentation. TAKE HER CLASS
