I had Professor Dorr for NLP this semester. The class was very well laid out and she was very knowledgeable about the topic. The assignments are at the perfect level of engaging and challenging while not being overwhelming. You can for sure get an A if you put in the effort and pay attention/participate during class.

I really like Professor Dorr, and the class was manageable and not too difficult if you watch the lectures. However, the online lectures are kind of hard to follow since it sounds like the professor is reading off a script. The part where she explains in class is very clear and insightful though.

If you take this class you will probably get an A but you will have NO idea what's going on. It's near the end of the semester and I am completely and utterly lost. I watch the lectures and it doesn't even sound like English because there are so many acronyms. Luckily you don't have to understand to get a good grade because exams are open note.

Great prof. Kind and very clear lecturer.

I didn't go to a single class and skipped almost all lectures and currently have a C+. Used AI on all assignments (which was allowed)

TBH, I regret not paying attention bc she seems cool.

If you take this class, pay attention. If you do, its an easy A. If you don't, its hard to catch up
Prof Dorr is cool

Amazing professor, she's so kind and enthusiastic about NLP.  Attendance isn't mandatory but she lovess when people participate in class. The three exams are open book and she gives a time frame (like 36 hours) to take them. Overall, she's insanely smart and honestly really funny I would definitely recommend this class.

The class itself was pretty easy. The due dates weren't accurate, so make sure you do the homework a few days in advance. The lectures were all you needed, the textbook was unnecessary. Quizzes were open-note with no time limit. Assignments were simple. The professor didn't grade in a timely manner and several grades were posted on the last day.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The class is easy because it is online and no exams, if there was I would fail. She posted deadlines to a canvas announcement multiple times, only to change them to be earlier causing numerous students to submit assignments late. Overall, a very nothing burger of a class, waste of time I wish I chose another class. Doesnt count for H credit

The class was tough. Professor Bouhnin didn't help: slow grading, no feedback, and assignments often ungraded until the last minute. Without timely feedback, it's impossible to improve before the next assignment. Several tasks from months ago were graded right before the end. This approach was frustrating and needs improvement overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: While others are harsh for Dr. Bumbach, I don't think this is a fair or accurate description. He teaches in a graduate program, so I anticipate his courses to be more difficult. There is a lot of reading and exams are pretty tough. He is accessible and always willing to work with any issues. I would take his classes again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This is a tough class although he is very upfront about this. He is a tough grader, but this is graduate school and should be. There is a lot of information, get ready to read. Also, this is an online course, I did love that I can read/learn when I wanted.

I have his class where the lectures are pre-recorded and then we have a 1 hour Q & A session. I have another professor for lab. The class is pretty straight forward and he's a nice guy! I would recommend going to his Q &A sessions because he gives hints for the exams. You don't really need the textbook. Go over the slides in the modules!

Yeah, some of the worst lectures I've ever experienced. Everything is from elsevier: lectures, tests, quizzes. Verbatim. Inconsistent grading on assignments with poor guidance in the first place. Will deduct points from something somewhere for you, but not for your classmate. I will say he is responsive via email but passive aggressive at times.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Prep for tests are a joke, just a Chapter # and how many questions will be from that chapter ex. Chap 5-10 questions. Tons of Chapters, quizzes and lectures every week to the point you won't be able to learn only shovel through. Very arrogant and will not consider any reasoning to his line of thought.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Took two of his grad courses. Clearly recycled material. He was responsive via email but his responses were usually not helpful. I understand he prob has a huge workload but I'm not even sure he understood his own rubrics and guidelines. Poor instructions and guidance when it came to assignments. Really inconsistent grading. Exams straight textbook

He did not seem to really care for his students. Tests were 100% word for word from the textbook. Do not bother to watch his lectures, they are pointless because the questions do not come from them. The class is tough so read the entire textbook 2x and you will end up with a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: online lectures are kind of useless but the class was great. He was an amazing instructor. Kind of sad to see him go. Be ready to fill out like an entire workbook though lol
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Bumbach was a great teacher. Really friendly, knowledgeable, and always available for help. Seemed to really care that we understood the material and explained things well. Lectures were online and somewhat dry. Tests were a little difficult due to the material and NCLEX style questioning. Would definitely love to take a class from him again.

to pass the class, you def need to attend the lectures bc she'll tell you what's on the exam and what isn't. the exams are all situation based, so her wording can be more difficult at times. it's not hard to get an A, but you have to attend lecture. i didn't read the textbook and just attended lecture and ended with an A. very test heavy though

Such an amazing professor. She has so much PR experience under her belt and her lectures reflect it. Textbook is useful for studying but not mandatory. Her review sessions are amazing! As long as you attend lectures and contribute with the group project, it's an easy A. She also has tons of guest speakers and networking experiences in her lectures!

Christine is great! There are only a few assignments and 4 exams for the course. However, if you sit for the first three exams and do well, you do not need to take the final (she drops your lowest exam grade). Exams are not too hard as long as you read the textbook and review lecture slides. Assignments are not too hard nor time-consuming.

So informative and clearly passionate about what she is teaching. The class isn't super difficult, but spend time memorizing key terms for the exams. She offers lots of extra credit and connections to people she knows in the industry. However, my TA gave me great grades on all individual assignments and a pretty bad grade on the group project.

I love her! She was so knowledgable and experienced. As long as you attend and put some effort in, you'll do well. It's a few easy assignments, 1 group project, 3 exams (read the textbook for it). She lets you drop the lowest exam and assignment grade if you complete everything. Couldn't recommend this enough if you're slightly interested in PR.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: AMAZING! Loved her class and was mostly made up of a liek five assignments and four tests (she drops the one with the lowest grade). She is one of the best PR professors ever. I highly highly recommend her class.

Attendance is not mandatory, but it is helpful for the lecture content. Grades are based on a group project, assignments, and three exams. The exams are tough and heavily weighted in your overall grade. Overall, Professor Bucan was pleasant and very experienced in the PR field.

Christine was a fantastic professor. There is one big group project but it's relatively easy. Exams are straightforward and she gives tons of review. Even though attendance isn't mandatory, her lectures and review sessions were so good that I didn't really have to study for the exams and I recommend going as often as you can!

Professor Bucan is great! You can tell she loves her job and PR, and wants to help students succeed. The lectures are pretty informative, but i would recommend reading the book to make sure you understand. You do have a big group project, but its pretty easy. 100% would recommend.

she was great. if u go to lectures and take notes and do the extra credit you'll do well. she sets the class up for success. only annoying thing is the group project but it's not bad if you have a good group

Super engaging lectures. Five assignments but they are simple and no longer than two paragraphs each. Four exams, the lowest exam gets dropped. You choose group project partners. Extra credit opportunities from guest lectures. Didn't purchase the textbook & passed my exams only based on lectures. Experienced & passionate professor in the PR field.

She cares a lot. Lectures are engaging but you don't really have to go. Textbook required and as exams went on it became more important to read it but I always did it right before the exam. Homework is easy and clear rubrics. Would take her again!
Professor Bucan is so funny and nice. The material is super easy and understandable with her lectures, and she makes it all very enjoyable!!!

Christine is so so awesome. She has such an interesting career background and has a lot of experience in the field of public relations. Her lectures are fun and interesting and the textbook is an interesting read. Take this class for a PR minor or an elective, so fun!
Professor Bucan is an amazing teacher regarding public relations. She is extremely experienced in the field and is knowledgable first hand on everything she teaches.
The lectures were interesting, but didn't cover material on the exams - you had to read the textbook for that. Otherwise she was a great lecturer and I enjoyed the class!

She's super kind and very experienced in the PR field. The class was pretty straightforward. Attend the lectures and read the textbook- you'll get an A. Graded on a group project, a couple of assignments, and 3 MC exams. Everything is pretty common sense and if you put in minimum effort you'll be ok. She gives tons of extra credit!!

I absolutely loved Professor Bucan. She really wanted her students to learn and succeed. Participation isn't required but go to lecture to do well on exams. Exams and assignments were straightforward and mostly common sense. Will 100% be taking her again!

She was honestly such a sweetheart and has so much experience in PR. Come to lecture and you'll do great on exams. Assignments were kind of unclear but generally common sense and easy to get a 100. One big group project but you'll do well if you put in genuine effort. Very useful material.

I really enjoyed going to this class every week. Homework once a week. Lectures were very good. Take lots of notes and follow the rubric given to a T and make sure to answer the question in the discussion as a whole and mimic the language in the readings. Not that many readings for this class.

Passionate about subject, but extremely knowledgable. Any BA or BFA major looking for an art history credit take this. Focuses on both the ART and the HISTORY which I feel many other professors in art history classes focus too heavily on the art without explaining the history or context. Burdette goes above and beyond explaining both's importance.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Burdette is the best professor I've had at UF. He is smart, funny, and down to earth. He knows his subject really well.
Easy Art course highly recommend. I am not an art person but I truly enjoyed the course due to its connection to history.

Amazing class to take! The lectures and assignments were informative, and the curriculum was overall very interesting but not hard at all. Quizzes/Collaborative assignments were easy to follow, and as long as you follow the due dates and put a good thought-process into responses for assignments/projects, you will pass. Highly recommend!
Took class online, it was ok.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took it for my art requirement, so it was easy but boring. Had weekly discussions that sometimes you would have to create "art", but you don't have to put much effort into it. Quizzes were on this site that you answer questions until you get the grade you want. No exams but has 2 essays. This class was more of a nuisance but not bad at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: This class was a piece of cake. I took it for the diversity credit. There was one assignment a week plus a discussion board as well. I did read the chapters and honestly, I thought they were interesting. There is an essay where you have to go to a museum but it wasn't too bad. There is also a recorded final presentation that you can just read off.

Easy Gen-ed, graded off of mostly quizzes and discussion posts, and you should get 100 on all of them. Couple of larger assignments, but they are pretty light. Lectures are interesting but not necessary.
Easiest class you will ever take.
Easiest class at uf midterm paper and final presentation are cake.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Had a great experience with this class, and Burdette has organized it very well! This class is not in my field of interest, but it was a lot of fun to be able to learn from Burdette. Super stress-free, and highly recommend this class to fulfill a humanities requirement. Dr Burdette is caring and the lectures are interesting, so it's a fun class.
Super easy class. Maximum 1 hour of work a week and most information can be found on quizlet. Essay in the middle and presentation at the end.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class is super easy and a great way to fulfill the humanities requirement. I spend less than an hour each week on this class, other than the final project presentation, which still can be completed in a day.

Really easy A, boring lectures though. Stopped paying attention after the first week. The assignments, including the essay and the presentations are easy, although sort of ridiculous and unnecessary. Recommend if you need an easy class for a diversity or humanities credit.

His lectures were nice but never interacted with him. All of grading is done by TA so as long as you get a good one, you're set. There's 1 essay about 1000 words but it wasn't too hard. Final project is a presentation which was also straightforward and simple. Also weekly discussion posts. Definitely recommend for the gen ed humanities.

It is not very engaging and the assignments are quite silly. The reading is interesting, but I could read a book or watch a documentary for far cheaper. There is a mid-term paper and a final presentation on an artwork. I never interacted with the professor, and only had a few comments from the TA. I would recommend this if you need the credit.

This class was an easy A and got the work done for the week in an hour. I would say the most annoying thing is the 1 essay we have to write for the midterm and the project for the final. Essay and project were graded lowkey hard but I still got an A. I would talk this for credit again

While my interactions with Dr. Burdette were short each one was very helpful. If you reach out he is extremely friendly. TAs grade everything and I had a very hard grader, but I put a lot of effort into my big final project and my midterm paper and did very well in the class. Just don't completely push this class to the side and you'll be fine.

ARH2000 was SO EASY, highly recommend! There's weekly discussion posts and Inquizitives but they're easy to get a 100. The essays are probably the hardest assignments but if you get a good TA (they grade everything) you'll be fine. Professor Burdette is very passionate about art and his rubrics are very clear. Very open communication too.

Hes a good lecturer and you def learn some good analyzation skills for art. Overall the class is really easy. Probably about an hour of work per week. One essay and presentation due near the end of the semester.

Dr. Burdette is amazing. I took this class for the gen ed credits tbh but he made the class so doable (depending on how nice your TA is), especially if you have an otherwise busy schedule. He would always send an email if a due date was different than usual so we weren't surprised, and he made deadlines and grading criteria so clear.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Easy class but all of the assignments are super pointless and don't teach you anything. Lectures are super boring and you don't need to watch then. Quizzes are guaranteed 100 if you do enough questions. No exams but a midterm paper and final presentation.

You really don't have to watch the lectures to pass. My one complaint is that the assignments, particularly discussion boards, felt arbitrary & unimportant. But they were still very, very easy. Quizzes were open book too. Overall Easy A, by far my least stressful class.
I had Dr. Burdette for Spanish Golden Age and the class was amazing. He's a great lecturer and is great at keeping everyone engaged. I would definitely take another class taught by him.
Random assignments that don't teach anything
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: TA grades everything and even if they're a harsh grader, you can still get an A just by consistently doing the assignments. Not a totally braindead blow off class, but pretty easy. Some goofy social justicey elements to it. But what can you expect from the humanities, they're all corrupted with the nonsense.

The online format this fall was new, but the class was so easy. There are weekly assignments that should not take more than an hour to do. The rubric for each assignment is clear on what the TA is looking for- the TAs do all of the grading. With a good TA, this class is an easy A.

I took Art Appreciation with him and his online formatting of the class is great and really easy to follow. I just completed the work for each week and it was all really simple, I would definitely recommend this course with him to get the humanities credit.

I never interacted with Dr. Burdette, but his lectures were AMAZING. If you are even a little interested in art, I highly recommend taking ARH2000. Because of this class, I want to take more art classes in the future. This is also an easy A (one short assignment and quiz per week) and an easy project instead of a final.

Art history is an extremely easy gen-ed credit. The fully online class has 1 assignment and a textbook reading each week, which takes 2 hours/week max. The final project is analyzing a famous piece, which i spent 2 hours doing. Definitely recommend for a GPA boost and easy gen-ed credit. Never interacted with actual professor, only TA.
Easy class. Took online and was still quite easy and accommodating. Not too interested in art, but found the material fascinating.

His Art Appreciation course was very easy and fun. There are weekly discussion posts and textbook quizzes that are a free A. The final is just a project about a famous art piece. The content is not difficult and is easy to learn

I took this class for fun and always found his lectures passionate and interesting. The lecture quizzes are in-class only written assignments are extremely easy, and exams are taken outside of class and open-note. He drops a few of your lowest scores too, very easy A and I learned a lot about Florida's hydrology

Professor Bonczek is an incredible professor who is very passionate about what he teaches. You can miss up to 7 lecture quizzes but I never wanted to miss a lecture as I always learned something fascinating about water. Exams are open note, I highly recommend this course!

He's awesome. Very chill teacher and doesn't take himself too seriously. But the exams have really niche questions. You're allowed to look off the notes, but that won't help. You need to know the material.

This is an amazing professor who understands that most students are only taking the class to fulfill a science credit. He is very passionate about what he teaches and outside of the lecture quiz taken in class and an open note quiz every 2 weeks or so, there really is no work required. The exams are open note and can be taken wherever.

Could literally say nothing bad about Mr. Bonczek. He's clearly into what he teaches, and his lectures are always interesting. There are lecture quizzes almost every lecture, but if you are paying attention, they are very easy. Tests are open-note and online, and they aren't taken in class. Such a nice and funny teacher, I highly recommend him!

Took this class for science credit and so did a bunch of other students. Straightforward class, but the material can get a bit repetitive and monotonous after a while. He is very generous with rounding grades and wants you to pass.

He can be quiet so don't sit towards the back. Canvas lecture quiz every lecture - 5 questions, super easy, 7 are dropped at the end of the semester. Exams are open book and online. Some other assignments are given but they are pretty easy. It is heavily chemistry-based, but he starts from the basics to make sure everyone is on the same page.
Exams are open-note and online. Assignments are easy, and the average was 19.5/20. There are lecture quizzes every day, but 7 are dropped.

Laidback and informative class, exams are based only on the lecture slides, and the exams are open-note. You have in-class quizzes which may also show up on an exam, so pretty useful and can boost your grade a teeny bit. Only a few assignments and quizzes outside of class, never took me more than thirty minutes at most.

Took this class to knock out a gen-ed requirement, and he was very aware that most people were in it for an easy A.  I really ended up enjoying the content and his lectures were very interesting.  Very little hw and exams are online and open note.  Lecture quizzes can be a little tricky but you get 7 drops so its very reasonable.  Highly recommend!

Nice professor, dry humor. Can be quiet so don't sit at the very back. Lectures are packed with info but include a lot of review. Most of the grade depends on exams, but the exams are very reasonable if you pay attention in class + attend his great review sessions. Interesting material, ranges from history to geology to chemistry. Highly recommend!

Very knowledgeable and patient professor, he can be quiet so don't sit at the very back. Most of the grade depends on exams, but they are manageable if you attend classes and review sessions. This class gets pretty chemistry-heavy, but the professor teaches assuming you know nothing, which helps. Ask questions!
This is an incredibly easy class to take as the exams are open note and online. The content is made interesting in class but very lecture heavy.

There were lecture quizzes every class (his way to ensure attendance) but they were online and easy. There were abt 4 hw assignments the whole semester and they were all short and easy. the main grading components were the three exams, which were all online and open note (and he gives a study guide with a review session the class before). No final

I took World of Water as a gen ed and now I'm considering minoring in SWS. Prof made class easy to pass, and I'd look forward to taking a class with him again. He's understanding and very relaxed.

As long as you can copy what's on the slides/get the gist of what he's saying, you'll do great (beware of lecture quizzes -- they used to trip me up)

Clearly passionate about lectures making them enjoyable. I actually found the beginning sections very interesting. Even when topics were boring, it was manageable. Open note exams online, but beware of specific questions. Lecture quizzes each class for attendance, but you can miss (I think it was six) without penalty. Just show up and take notes!

Really chill guy, class is not difficult and he wants you to do well. Just make sure to go to lectures to do the lecture quizzes, you are allowed to miss 7 unexcused. Really easy and chill assignments and all exams were open notes no honorlock

Class is boring but not a lot of work. You get up to 7 classes that you can miss. You have to take notes as there are quizzes after every class. All tests have no honor lock. Not difficult, but I was at a borderline A- .
Dr. Bonczek is the greatest. This class is a super easy A and he makes everything really clear. Content is somewhat boring but the professor is really passionate about it which is a plus.

Bonczek is a knowledgeable professor who makes the material engaging, even for non-majors. The exams can be challenging, but going to office hours and using resources like unstuckstudy can really help. Overall, a worthwhile class.

Class was super boring, but I have absolutely no interest in the topic. Bonczek lectures every class, but you can miss up to 7 classes with no point deductions. He moved our final to online and open book this semester, and he cancelled classes sometimes. There are a few online assignments that are easy to forget if you don't write them down

I love Dr. Bonczek. He was a great soil professor, but also a fantastic chem teacher. He explained the underlying science of soil very clearly and had great lectures. I was sad on the last class because no more soil or Dr. Bonczek. Highly recommend taking if you need the class or as an elective.
Basically memorizing the slides, but tests are straightforward and all multiple choice or true and false.
The grade is primarily based on the exams, the first two were in-person and closed notes and extremely nitpicky. If you have the option to take this course online 10000% do that.

I thought this would be an easy A but my exam average was an 84 and I got an A-. The first two exams were closed-note in person which from what I've heard is different from previous years and I don't appreciate that. I think a 90 should be an A for this class but its an A-. There is little curving or leverage so exam scores must be about perfect.

Dr. Bonczek is the most understanding professor I've had thus far. Allowed to miss 7 classes with no penalty, and there are 3 exams. Study guides are given beforehand, and there's a review day where he gives you the answers. Easy A!

Easy A as advertised. He just asks that you go to class and has an attendance assignment to track it, but 7 drops which is very forgiving. Good to be an easy class that you don't have to think about a lot, and interesting ish material sometimes.

This class was pretty easy. There were 3 big exams that only had material that was on the study guide. If you go to the lectures it's a pretty easy class to get an A in. He does lecture questions and bonus questions for extra credit every class.

His lectures can be complex and a few I had to listen to twice to get it, but wow!  I learned so much in this class about the importance of our soil and the impacts humans have on the environment.  It was a unique and ideal class to learn about the State of Florida. Professor Bonczek is enthusiastic, challenging and available.  Really great class.

Gets boring but easiest physical science credit. Attend class because you have to follow along with the lecture since he gives you a paper with blanks to fill in. Gives plenty of extra credit and a study guide for exams.

I can't say it's a bad course or prof is bad. However, do not take it if you think it is an easy A class. The exam is online, open the notes before. but, he changed exam to in person, close note. I ended up with an A- thanks to him changing back to an online open book for the third exam. Otherwise, I'm going to get b or b+.

Great professor with straight forward and clear lectures, assignments, quizzes, and exams. He gives a study guide before every exam and if you take the time to fill it out and look it over you will get an A on his exam. There are in class lecture questions that are given before class and you fill it out during lecture.

I took this course as a physical science req. BUT, if your not a geology major or have actual interest in it, it can become pretty difficult for being an "INTRO" class. Luckily, Dr.Bonczek is pretty awesome & helpful via Zoom. There's a weekly quiz, 2 assignments, & 3 exams. Even w/ 90% of study material online I struggled, but study & you'll pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Make sure to take notes during the lectures. There is a lot of info but his assessments and HW are usually almost word-for-word how he explained it in class. He tries his best to make it interesting/practical. If you do the study guides and study a little, it should be easy.

James is a very solid professor. He is charismatic and enthusiastic about what he teaches which makes the lectures much more bearable. There's no textbook and very few assignments with only 10 quizzes and 3 exams; so as long as you show up to class, and take notes (quickly, he goes kind of fast), you'll easily pass. I 100% would take it again.

Easy A science credit because his lectures are so easy to pay attention to. Just go to class and review the study guide before the tests. Lectures were very interesting and the material was relevant in everyday life.

I needed a physical science credit and this was such an easy class to fulfill that credit!! Just need to attend class and answer five questions that are answered during the lecture, it's collected and used as attendance. He gives you a study guide with answers before each exam and is such an easy grader. Barely any homework.
Professor Bonczek was an awesome professor. Very approachable, knowledgable, and just an overall great guy. If you need a physical science credit, take his class.

I am not a geology major so this class was pretty difficult for me. However, he is an awesome professor and would go over all the material during his office hours and was great at explaining the material. Nice professor and if you have to take a physical science, I recommend him! Definitely go to office hours if you're having trouble.
Dr. Bonczek makes his course very easy. Answers are on Quizlet if you need help and exams are not proctored. Material is straight forward and easy to understand.
This professor is extremely and nice and cares about his students so much. He is very passionate about what he teaches and just wants his students to do well. Highly recommend!!

EASIEST CLASS EVER! Allows 7 unexcused absences per semester, only 5 hw and you can drop one, 5 quizzes with 3 attempts and can drop one, only 3 exams multiple choice and everything is on quizlet. Literally no effort required for this class plus he is a really nice guy. He loves what he teaches and you can tell. overall an amazing class, def recom.

Extremely knowledgable about what he is teaching, and you can tell he is passionate about it too. This really helps when material can be a bit dry, he is able to make it comprehensible and interesting. We got seven freebies as far as absences go. Quizzes and exams were take home, pretty easy. Five HW assignments total, also easy. HE IS SO GREAT!!!

Awesome professor! Took SWS2007 just as an elective and really liked how he teaches so Im taking another course with him in Fall. Great teacher, feels like he is talking and explaining to you instead of reciting a lecture. And the course was really interesting too

Really nice guy and understanding. I felt the zoom lectures were a little boring at times and not as engaging as they could have been. The information was interesting nonetheless. Overall, I would recommend the class and prof.

Freest class of my life. Perfect if you need a physical science credit. Everything is on Quizlet and there is so much extra credit. Prof Bonczek knows what's up. He's not trying to make your life suck. Definitely recommend it to anyone looking for an easy class.
Most of the quizzes and exams are repeated from years' past, using quizlet to help study was the best tool. Really fun teacher, sometimes can talk too much but it is fine.

A chill professor for anyone that wants to complete their physical science credit. Quizzes are open note and exams will always have a study guide and review day. Assignments also take an hour at most. Unless you actively skip class/lecture or don't pay attention, it is pretty difficult to get anything other than an A.

This class was a super easy A. Professor Bonczek is very chill; he allows 8 unexcused absences per semester. You answer lecture questions for attendance and he gives the opportunity for extra credit through bonus questions. Basically no homework (4 assignments total); quizzes and exams easily found on Quizlet and his lecture PPTs

Loved this Prof and his class. The class is a super easy A, exams and quizzes aren't proctored and he's really flexible about everything. Super funny guy. Attendance is mandatory but the lectures were super interesting and you can tell he really cares about what he's teaching. Definitely recommend this class.
He is a really iconic guy! The class is pretty easy and you learn a lot of important information. He is really great professor and I suggest taking him at least once while at UF!

Bonczek will leave lab in the middle of class for awhile/leave early and not say anything. Quizzes are difficult and unclear. He refuses to update due dates on canvas & hasnt updated grades in months. Requires a printed lab report.
Super easy class and every exam is open notes. Go to class, because he gives a ton of extra credit

Overall great professor! Many lectures for this course, but as long as you show up a good portion of your grade is lecture questions which are easy points. Overall a good gen-ed science to take highly recommend.
Great, super easy class to complete physical science requirement. Just watch weekly lectures and take notes, and it will be an easy A.

Super easy class to take as a physical science requirement. Weekly open-note quizzes (all of the info is in his powerpoints), occasional assignments that take ten minutes or less, and open-note unit quizzes. No cumulative midterm/final. Also offers extensive opportunities for extra credit.
Is this class a super easy A and science gen ed? Yes. Is the class also interesting and actually worth taking? Also yes.
Easy A.  Good Professor and very passionate. The topics covered are very boring but the class is easy, just read the power points.

The class is an easy A. Exams are open note and not proctored. Attendance is not mandatory, but there are extra credit quizzes involved in each lecture. He was a very boring lecturer. If you need a GPA booster, this is it.

The lab has very few grades and is not well adapted to be delivered online. There was no feedback given on lab reports. Personally, I would not recommend the online lab. He seems pretty cool and understanding in general though.

Pretty easy class, the content is not hard to grasp and exams are exactly like the weekly quizzes. Very few assignments but the lectures are boring. Dr. Bonczek was a great guy but seemed uninterested during lectures (however he did express that teaching the online format of the course was difficult for him so I understand). Overall an easy A.

3 Recorded lectures a week with one quiz. Very easy and watched lectures at 1.5 speed. Unit quizzes are not difficult. Professor Bonczek is well respected and will help with anything you need. Show up to lectures if you are confused on a topic. Highly recommend this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Here was my weekly routine: read the two to four PowerPoints given for the week and take notes on the slides, then go in and ace the quizzes. The quiz material is not very difficult (you get 2 tries too) and the assignments are very easy to get an A in. This class is an easy A but you DO need to learn the material.
He finds a way to make uninteresting material enjoyable to learn. It is not a class you will just get an 'A' in without putting work in, but if you put the work in you will be successful.
Great professor! Goes above and beyond to help his students. He will make sure you pass his class.
Great prof, homework accounts for a large portion of the class and exams are exactly like the course objectives.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!! Literally thought it would be an easy gen ed class and I was wrong he found out people were posting his quizzes and exams online so he decided to punish the entire class by making everything so difficult - he shorted the amount of time you can take a test and quiz, reduced the amount of attempts and barely provided info

Easy class. Watch the lectures and take the weekly quiz which is straight forward. He has a slow, monotone voice, so if you are taking it online, watch them speed up. Takes a bit of time to watch the lectures, but the quiz and exam questions come right out of them. 5 super easy, 15 minute assignments other than the quizzes
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Came into this course looking for an easy gen ed and was not disappointed. The professor is a really cool guy and I honestly thought his lectures were interesting and well-structured. The assignments are usually pretty easy, there were only 3 big unit tests and as long as you show up to class and study even a little, you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Bonczek doesn't care about students. In the middle of a pandemic, he made the class harder because the class was doing well in the online format. The class should have just been an easy gen-ed, but it became one of the most annoying classes. Pick a different course if the class is still online. It was apparently easy in-person though.

Take him if you can! Lectures can be a bit boring at times, but I found myself really learning a lot in this class that is relevant to the real world. The class just had 5 small assignments, weekly quizzes, and 3 unit quizzes, super easy.

Bonczek is a really nice guy, class is just really boring if you're not interested in the topic. He understands most people are only there for the physical science credit. Easy A if you do the quizzes and easy assignments. 3 exams that are exactly like the study guide he gives you.
Fairly easy class especially if you already grasp basic acid/base chemistry. Show up, take the online quizzes, study the slides once, and you will get an A.

Professor Bonczek cares about his topics and understands that anyone taking World of Water is just taking it for the science credit. Its pretty interesting even if you do not enjoy science and Bonczek gives pretty easy exams. There is also very little homework.

3 exams - study the study guide and you'll pass. 5 simple quizzes, just take notes. HW assignments were easy and done in 20 minutes. Lecture and bonus questions every class, so can't skip, but you get 5 drops. Nice enough guy. Goes over time a lot in lecture even though he said he lets us out early - he doesn't! TA's aren't really helpful.

Nice guy, boring class, very boring. Lecture and bonus questions every class, so you can't skip, but you get 5 drops. 5 simple quizzes. 3 exams - study the study guide and you'll do well. HW assignments were really easy. Overall easy class, nice professor, but just boring so don't expect too much excitement. He also goes over time a lot in lecture.

I've had Professor Bonczek twice now and he is just the best. His class is designed to have you learn at minimum challenge. The material is fascinating and the expectations are clear. The man makes dirt interesting. Can I say any more?

Dr. Bonczek was great. His lectures were clear and easy to understand. Somehow he made dirt interesting? Takes attendance every class using lecture quizzes, but they are super easy to fill out. Exams follow the study guides, (and he has a day to answer questions about it), so if you fill them out, you can do well on the exams. Great class overall.

Professor Bonczek is super funny and tries to make the lectures enjoyable even though a lot of the material can seem repetitive. Super easy physical science credit, the study guides follow the lectures and powerpoint directly and if you pay attention you'll get a good grade.
Great and easy physical science class. He is hilarious and a good professor and the subject is pretty interesting if you give it the chance. very easy cannot stress that enough.
Loved taking his class. Takes a lot to make water seem interesting and he definetly succeeded. Class was easy as long as u study the study guide and go to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Bonczek is a great professor who cares about the students and the material, as well. The class can be boring at times, but the underlying theme is very interesting. Attendance is mandatory because he gives lecture questions, but 5-7 are dropped at the end of the semester. The study guide IS THE EXAM! Incredibly easy class to take to de-stress.

I loved this class. It was very easy and Bonczek was very straightforward as to what was required of us. The study guides go over everything on the test and nothing is a surprise. He takes attendance by little question sheets we fill out but you can miss 7 before there's a penalty. A pretty cool guy and an interesting class.

I loved him! He is a funky guy, and wears the almost exact thing to class every day, but he makes a (pretty boring) class super interesting! As long as you do the homeworks, quizzes, and study guides for the tests, you'll be fine. He lets you skip like 7 times without penalty. I really enjoyed this class, and would for sure recommend it for gen ed.

Professor Bonczek cares about his subject and it shows in his lecture. The class covers everything from evolution to chemistry and none of it is difficult to understand. He lectures in a narrative like style that allows you to just sit back and listen. Exams aren't hard and he provides drops in homework and quizzes.

Gonna be honest, I could care less about soils. I thought this class was relatively easier in the second half because it was a review of fundamental acid/base chem and I'm in orgo2 right now. If you've taken chems, it's a piece of cake. There are already Quizlet cards based on all his study guides. That's all you need. Showing up was annoying.

Learned a lot from this class. It is not everyone's cup of tea, but the notes are easy to follow and he gives you a study guide for the exams, so don't be discouraged if you are looking for a gen ed course. Not difficult if you dedicate a bit of time.
This professor is really fantastic. He elaborates and relates topics. The lecture is directly related to quizzes and exams.

This professor is a great guy and pretty entertaining. The class material can be a little boring at times but the tests cover exactly what the lectures are about. He also allows you to have 7 absences without affecting your grade and drops your lowest quiz score. 10/10 would recommend this class for your state gen ed science.
Great professor, straightforward subject matter, fair quizzes and tests. Interesting assignments. Great course to satisfy the e Physical Science GenED requirement.
Good professor. He teaches well, tests on what he teaches. No complaints.
Very easy to do well. I did not study enough for exams. If you do the bare minimum you can get at worst an A-. Very knowledgable and helpful, literally gives away answers.

This was a fairly easy class to take for a gen-ed physical science, I would recommend. I do not have much to say since this was only a gen-ed for me, but as long as you score well on exams you will receive a good grade.

He is a good professor and the study guides he gives, tell you exactly what's coming on the exams. Quizzes and homeworks are easy and have lots of attempts. This was an interesting course about soils.

This is the easiest class I have ever taken, but Professor Bonczek made the material more interesting than a lesser professor would have. Although I found the material to be boring at its core, I enjoyed listening to the lectures. The tests are a breeze with the study guides, as are the quizzes and few homework assignments. He's a nice guy!

Be prepared for Dr. Bonczek to lecture every class. However, he is engaging and tries to make the material as accessible as possible. It is not a hard class, and as long as you complete the study guides, you will ace the exams.

This class is SO easy and so interesting. You can take the 5 quizzes 5 times so you definitely get 100's on all of them. There are also 5 homework assignments that take less than 20 minutes each and are ridiculously easy. The lectures are fun and I actually learned more than I have in any other class. Favorite class this semester by far.

During each class he gives you a set of questions to answer during the lecture. But, he drops your lowest 7 scores, which means you can miss 7 classes without it affecting your grade. There are 5 online quizzes and assignments, he drops your lowest score for each. Plus, they're easy. 3 exams, but just use the study guide and you should be fine!

I never knew soil could be so interesting! Turned out to be my favorite class of the semester. He gives lecture questions every class, so go to class for free points. Online quizzes are easy, and help you synthesize the content. All of the PPTs are online. Bonczek likes to make jokes in class, and thinks he's hilarious, but he's very cool. Loved it

Super easy. He's also SUPER nice. I took this as an elective and I thought soil, really? God help me. I actually liked it. I still have no interest in soil but the class was fun. EASY A. Literally go to class. Review the study guide the day before the exam (or earlier) and you'll do fine. Last exam I only had 1 hour to study for and it went great!

I thought it would be an easy A. Unfortunately, it wasn't. This class is really BORING. I just couldn't understand the material at all. Some people were able to get all 100's on the tests. Not me. There is a lot of information on the test. Not only that, but he likes to give "trick questions. Thanks to extra credit/quizzes/HW I made a B
Really caring professor who knows his stuff. Very clear class. Would recommend to anyone
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Gives a lot of lecture questions to ensure attendance, but they're easy. Also provides an exam review and study guide that makes exams really easy. Very helpful and caring professor.
easy and little homework, easy and little quizzes. he gives you a study guide before the exams and everything is on it. easy A
Easy A. Great professor who knows what he's talking about and is passionate about it. Show up to lecture and you'll be fine.
the man

Professor Bonczek was extremely helpful.  The chemistry homework wasn't completely clear to me and he tutored me one-on-one over the phone until I understood.  He also frequently arranged online help sessions.  He challenges students in a positive and constructive way.  Do the readings and take notes.  If you try, you can pass. Great course.

Great professor. I never thought someone could make a soil class so interesting. Show up to class and take good notes (as in just copy his power point) and you will definitely do well. If you have any reason to take this class or just need a science credit I highly recommend.
James is a silver fox! He is a great guy and professor. Easy A but put in the effort!!

He had me hooked on the 1st day! He is passionate about what he is teaching and wants us to actually leave the class with an understanding  of soil. He gives study guides for exams, so the exams are decent. Great man and would take him again. No phones! Please respect him.

Not the easiest lab, but it goes hand in hand with the lecture. Great guy. Labs are interesting and you do learn.  2 exams and one includes a lab practical. There are also daily quizzes, but they are not difficult.
This guy is the dude. Hands down the best science course I've had in college thus far, and nudges me toward switching to a soils major (or at least resource management).

Soil lab was a pretty easy lab credit. You have to buy the lab manual which was only like $15. There were lab reports after almost every lab, but they were fairly simple. There were also quizzes about the previous lab which were simple as long as you review the previous lab beforehand. Then there were two exams that were no too difficult.

This is an easy science class to take even if you are not interested in soil at all. You have lecture questions every day but also extra credit nearly every day. There were three exams and he provides a study guide for each, as well as a review before each exam. Definitely would recommend for an easy science credit! Also, no text book!!
This class is great for an easy science credit. You have to go to most classes but he gives some days off. He explains everything very well and gives a detailed study guide before each exam.

Prof Bonczek is the man. Absolutely great professor. Yes the class is easy, but it's actually interesting. He makes the class easy so a lot of different kids from around UF take a class in his department, so give him respect and listen to his topic. You have to go to class to pass because its very attendance heavy, but go with an open mind.
Great class, super easy. He made me want to learn more about the environment. Also, kind of a silver fox

The class was pretty easy. He takes attendance through the form of daily questions during lectures and provides bonus point questions nearly every class. There were online assignments and quizzes sporadically throughout the class but there was always ample time to complete them and you could take each quiz up to five times. Easy science credit!
This guy is awesome. Plan and simple. He knows that kids take his class for bs and he just wants you to gain some respect about the environment along the way. This class is how all Gen-Eds should be.
Simply interesting and easy to validate.
Awesome professor. He knows his stuff and teaches it well so that it's easy to understand- even if science isn't your thing. He makes dirt an interesting subject to learn!

Simply one of the easiest classes ever. I just needed a science course and this class was a great filler for the summer semester.    Just dont get lazy and wait to study the day of. Its not fun to listen to multiple lectures per day. Spread the lectures out, study, fill out the review sheet and you should be fine come test day.

Very easy class. Dr. Bonczek post the powerpoints after every class. There are 3 easy homework assignments and 1 10 question multiple choice quiz which you can take until you make an 100. There are 4 exam and he drops the lowest test grade. Most people do so well on the first 3 exam and as a result they don't have to take the last exam

I have absolutely no regrets taking this class. I never thought learning about water could be SO interesting, but Bonczek definitely makes it that way. He is extremely nice and patient, and he is readily available to anyone who needs help. This is the most painless way to knock out a physical science gen-ed credit. Seriously take this class! (:

I am terrible at science and very much not interested, and this class was fantastic. Dr. Bonczek makes it incredibly interesting, and incredibly easy to get an A. Go to class, do what he says, and you'll get the A. I highly recommend this class to anyone for whom science is not their thing.

Dr. Bonczek does a great job making such a seemingly insipid subject actually quite interesting and very accessible to students. Simply GO to class, review your notes maybe an hour or two a week, and always do the (very) straightforward study guides and you'll surely get an A. The 4 homework assignments and 3 quizzes are easy. Great class.

SUPER easy and interesting class. Dr. Bonczek is VERY good at explaining material in laymen's terms. Only a few homeworks and quizzes and 4 super easy tests (gives you study guide that tells you all info you will need for the test). Easy A, take it when you have a tough semester!

One of the best classes I've take at UF. Surprisingly interesting subject and he makes sure to include lots of points that are relevant. Would recommend this class to anyone. Go to class, listen, do the study guide, and get an A in the class. It really is that simple in his class.
AWESOME PROFESSOR! He def. makes sure you that you understand the material and that you are prepared for the exams. He is so nice and definitely made the class so interesting!! TAKE HIM!!
Easy class! Show up, study the study guide. Bring laptop!
Go to class. Take the extra credit. Get an A. It really is that simple. It's a fun class, and it is an easy general education credit. Take him!!!
Hands down, the BEST professor at UF! He makes the material surprisingly interesting, and makes it so easy to get an A.

Go to class. The tests are easy if you pay attention in class and study the review sheet. Just because he goes over slides quickly doesn't mean the material isn't important (you'll see it in t/f form on the test). Great teacher. Learned a lot and was an interesting topic that has meaning outside school!!! Best teacher at UF?!! Could be.

Go to class for the lecture questions and bonus questions. They will make or break you at the end of the semester!!! Also, the exam questions are mostly fair with some tricky ones to see if you really studied. Very best teacher; fun and loves the subject which makes the class much more exciting.

He explains the material really well, especially for non-science majors. He is obviously very passionate about it but clear in his presentation. Attendance is mandatory, so go and pay attention to get the daily "lecture questions" and the extra credit. Exams are not too bad, mainly because of the review the class before the exam. No surprises.

I highly recommend this class. There's no textbook and no need to study outside of class, minus right before each exam. Attendance in mandatory (you can miss 4 classes). Extra credit given out each class. He's a great professor. Very friendly and knowledgeable. Easy A.

To this class as an online class over the summer. It was a bit more challenging than I thought for a gen ed class. For summer distance learning students, do study guide, listen to lectures and don't underestimate this class becuase its an online gen ed class.

He is a terrific professor.  Knows so much about his subject that it is astonishing.  There is always a powerpoint but he explains what he is talking about very clearly.  Class is mandatory and lots of extra credit is offered throughout the semester.

Class is easy and straight to the point. Barely any homework assignments. You have lecture questions each class (attendance-you can miss 4), but they are really easy and he will give answers. Extra credit is offered. Material can be boring, but he gives study guides that are exactly like the tests. Study those for an hour before and you'll be fine
pretty good professor

Mr. Bonczek is a GREAT professor!  He makes this class interesting.  I got a B+, but that is because I missed 2 homeworks and missed quite a few classes.  If you attend most of the classes, do all of your homeworks, and study the reviews, you easily can get an A.  I highly recommend this class!

A great professor, he really knows his material. The class is an easy A. He gives attendance quizzes, they're easy and he drops the lowest exam grade. Memorize the exam review and you'll pass the exam.

Honestly, one of the best science classes that I have taken at UF. Great (P) gen ed credit for non science majors. I learned so much in this class and it has to do with more that soil and water (which sounds boring). Based on five exams, occasional homework, and gives extra credit quizes (on the notes for the day). Easy A!
I enjoyed his lab, we got to do hands on and he provided everything we needed so as not to make it an undue burden on us as students. I appreciated him.
World of Water was a great class. Easy A!

I've never had a teacher who explained things better. The classes are going to be about water or soil... so they're not the most interesting, but he's fun and the class is easy. I recommend this for your gen ed.
He is extremely nice and helpful- he explains things really well. I loved this class and it was very applicable to everyday life. I highly recommend this class for a science credit or just for fun!

This class was so easy and enjoyable. Attendance is mandatory but I missed at least five classes and am still getting an A. There are three homeworks that are all really easy. Teacher is really nice and makes it interesting. Tests were easy, def. recommend this as an easy gen ed.

James Cameron, as a lot of us like to call him, was an okay teacher. Class is easy, but dont let it take advantage of you. Memorize BOTH NOTES AND SLIDES. He likes to be detailed in a lot of his stuff, so memorizing what I told you, you should be fine. AttendaNce is mandatory due to the lecture questions he gives out every class. Easy A, just work.
This class was a piece of cake! Attend class, memorize every word of the study guide the night before, and you will get 100s on everyone of the tests. Trust me!!!

THIS CLASS IS NOT EASY.  I get As in almost every class I take.  I am not going to get an A in this class.  The professor is nice, but his tests are ridiculous.  he gives a study guide, but it only covers maybe 50% of the test.  Terrible class.

Definitely not as easy as it is made out to be here. The professor is really nice, but the material can get boring. He gives a study guide before the test, but the test is much more detailed and much harder than the study guide. Attendance is mandatory.

Not as easy of a class as you'd think. Bonczek is a really wonderful guy though. Very considerate and concerned about how students are doing. You can't find a nicer professor on campus. Attendance is mandatory. The material can get a little boring. Know slightly more than what the study guides say and you should do fine.

World of Watercraft is the best!  Do not buy the textbook. I always use my textbook, but NOT in this class. Prof Bonczek is great - well-spoken and humorous - and OBSCENELY EASY. Interesting material with a lot of local Florida stuff. He actually seemed a little bothered that I asked for help in office hours.

Extremely helpful, kind, and understanding professor. Really tries to make the material interesting and help students excel in class. Relatively easy class, but lots of engaging material. Excellent Powerpoint notes (all posted online, too). Attendance mandatory, but you'll want to go. One of the best professors I've had (and this was just Gen Ed!)

Definitely take this class if you need a physical science!  He tells you that you do not need the book, practically gives you the tests, and he posts all notes.  The only thing is that he really wants you to be there so he randomly gives attendance quizzes.  All of his assignments are super easy and he is a really nice guy!

Dr B. is such a great guy, he is very understanding and truley wants you to enjoy the material and do well in his class. His exams/quizzes/lab reports are very fair and is willing to go out of his way to help you write your lab report. I just took his class for a Gen. Ed physical science lab, (I'm a religion major), and I would def. do it again.
he was an awesome teacher..so helpful and he made the final optional. you don't need the textbook at all. definitely take this class.

This class was easy, and Dr. B was great.  Really cares about the students learning and will pause in lecture to make sure everyone understands.  Tests were straight from study guide and very fair.  Presented lots of examples from out in the field.  Excellent!

I was somewhat suprised and definitely pleased to find this class pretty interesting.  Dr. Bonczek presented everything in an easy-to-understand manner, and tests covered exactly what we learned in class.

Dr. Bunch is so fun and extremely caring for his Ag Ed students! I took AEC4324 which is a discussion based class where participation is crucial to getting anything out of the class. He is has a wealth of knowledge in this field, so ask questions and put forth an effort to get to know him. This class has a low workload but is an intro to Ag Ed.
By far my favorite professor since I got to UF. Lectures are actually really interesting and he makes them fun. Tests are also really easy.
Great professor, the class isnt easy but offers valuable information.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He is really really hard but good. I def remember everything from his class but be ready for super challenging exams that make up 100% of your grade and a fast moving pace. He is helpful though, but just be warned when he says something will be simple that is a lie.

Professor Butler is a tough professor. The only grades in the class were from exams, which were fair but tough. At least a third of the lectures were derivations, and the rest were examples. The class is not impossible, but be prepared to spend extra time getting to know material like the back of your hand, because anything could be on the exam.

He is the worst professor I ever had while I have been in college. He does not care weather you pass or not. While he may be smart, he does not know how to convey his knowledge onto his students. If you take COT with him be ready to work really hard and pretty much be on your own or find a study group.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Butler seems like a mean guy and that's because he is(he says it) but deep down he cares for the students. His lectures aren't the best, I never understood what was going on at all and I was below the average on all the exams. But I killed on the final and ended well. My advice, youtube every topic and don't be afraid to ask butler for help!

Jason is tough but extremely helpful. He's quite knowledgeable and a great resource. Always answers emails. Swallow your pride and he will help you. Tests and quizzes are HARD but doing the homework will partially prepare you. He has optional texts, reading relevant sections of those helps too. Try to understand, not figure out what's on the test.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: He is the best when you are doing it right. Has a mathematical sense of humor. Likes results which are meaningful and would give partial grades if your solution makes sense.
He is a good professor. Makes you work for grade.

Dr. Butler was a really good professor for fluids. Explained concepts in a crystal-clear manner at a reasonable pace. Gave quizzes that were often just like the homework assigned, and tests weren't bad at all. I'd recommend him for fluids (not so much for COT).

Dr. Butler is very smart and knows what he is talking about.  A little rude at times, but that's just his style.  Difficult tests but very doable if you put in the ridiculous hours on the HW.  All in all, I would take him again.

Dr. Butler knows what he's talking about, but sometimes had trouble conveying it to the class. Tests and HW were usually pretty tough (averages were in the 40%-60% range) but grading was completely scaled so it worked out.
Great teacher. Explains concepts very well. His grading system must have changed because he was in most cases generous. Tests were difficult but manageable.
Not personable. Knows what he's teaching but office hours are always awkward. Exams and quizzes are difficult.

Clear lecture style, a lot of algebra workouts left to the student. You must know and understand the homework to the point of being able to teach it to others in order to pass exams/quizzes.  Very difficult grader, not a lot of partial credit. Do extra homework problems and go to his office hours. Final exam is difficult.
Great Professor but hard.

Great lecturer.  Very clear; your notes are well-thought out and aren't riddled with errors.  His tests tend to have 2 questions covering the "basics" and one to distinguish the A-students from the B-students.  They're extremely fair, however, as the previous student pointed out, if you make a mistake early on, you're done.

Great lecturer. Horrible grader. Very clear and helpful in class, but if you go to his office hours to ask a question, he will make you feel like an idiot. When grading, he only grades up to the first mistake and gives you points up to there. So if you get the first line of a problem wrong, you get a 0 on that assignment.

If you like chaos, unstructured classes and assignments, a really difficult syllabus to read and use, issues with tech at every corner, class being lead by primarily students, inconsistent grades, but interesting readings and the ability to change the final into only a 50 word statement, go right ahead.

Kind, funny, and clearly appreciates his students. Classes were so fun [at times] but the overall lecture style was always entertaining. Participation and understanding of the films and readings are necessary, but other than that and weekly assignments, this class will not overload you. Burt is an awesome guy and loves his students.

This was one of my top 3 classes ever; in class discussions were absolutely amazing and I always looked forward to going to class! Reading is not negligible but totally manageable. He is not the most organized and he does love to talk. Live grading was stressful but genuinely so beneficial to my paper writing skills. Would definitely take again.

Richard Burt is a great professor. He is very caring and approachable and funny and kind. Richard Burt is a god amongst mere mortals. He is a GOAT tier professor that you do not want to miss out of. I hope I have appealed to your heart and mind

Burt is a great professor and this was probably one of my favorite classes during my time at UF. Hilarious, open-minded, insightful, and knowledgeable, he gave students room to form their own opinions while still taking the time to teach. As long as you watch the movies (its a film class, what did you expect?) you'll have a blast!

He was awesome! He is quiet, but if you listen he is hilarious and well spoken. Quite a bit of reading, but it is a 4000 level LIT class. It is what you sign up for. Show up, read, and participate in discussions! Hearing everyone's thoughts makes class go by fast and ends up being pretty fun.

He is an inconsistent grader with NO SYLLABUS. He uses this weird, unorganized handmade website to display class info-he doesn't like canvas. He adds nothing to classes. Every single class is lead by an equally clueless student. Do not take him, save yourself the trouble of being stuck for hours in a classroom with him AND the endless homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Burt is a great and entertaining person, but his course structure is non-existent and the class is entirely reliant on co-leading discussions by students rather than the professor. His homework assignments and expectations are always changing and he barely uses Canvas. Computers are banned in class, making physical books a requirement.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The worst professor at UF. Beware his sporadic grading, nonsensical emails, and ceaseless monologues. You will glean nothing from this class. His attendance policy is borderline impossible and frustrating. He does not have a syllabus and bans technology in class. My only advice is to contribute and try your best to survive in his kingdom.
A waste of my time and money. I still questioned myself about what this class was about, besides this guy's boring taste in books.

He's an amazing prof. He cares about you so much. All his classes are seminar-based. He rarely if ever lectures. He believes in student-run classes, which means every day you will be talking about what you find interesting. The only downside is there's a lot of reading and you have to pay attention. There's an assignment due every few days.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: I took two classes with Burt because the descriptions seemed so interesting, and the classes have not disappointed. If you care about stories and WANT to learn/discuss, he will return that. His classes are my favorites. If you want strange, obscure, important knowledge & want to be challenged, take him! If you're serious and fun, take him!

Burt is unlike any professor I've ever had. His classes might not all adhere to one single topic, but I've come away from every class with a new perspective. He encourages his students to speak up with their own opinion, even if it differs from his own. Burt has taught me more than any other professor has, and I'm so grateful for him.

Burt deeply cares for his work and his students, and it may come across as harsh sometimes. Its pretty time consuming to watch two movies a week and write basically a one page paper on both, but the films are great and its worth it for the discussion. He loves forming a community, and class will be amazing if you all speak up. Enjoy!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Burt's classes are like entering a family restaurant serving unknown cuisine. The space eclectic, the fare unexpected, and the restaurateur invested in patrons. Student discussion is his primary goal. He gives wonderful feedback on the few papers he assigns. A humble professor that loves teaching over looking smart. Love and miss you Burt.
The mans a genius

Professor Burt's unique class format ensures that every discussion is productive, with a steady flow of ideas that are not a result of groupthink, but a culmination of creative ideas presented by individuals who are invested in the subject matter. I am a sharper critical thinker, stronger writer, & more persuasive speaker, thanks to Burt .

Burt is a fantastic professor. He is a very caring and kind person who appreciates good literature and feels passionate about teaching. The class consists on 3 essays and participation. Homework is important and long, but it's not difficult. Overall, a great class that will give you an easy A if you work for it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: attendance is mandatory. And so is class participation + leading two classes with a fellow classmate. Not difficult for an upperdivision English class.

Probably the best English professor at UF. If you like close reading/viewing, you will love his classes. He can be disorganized, but his treasure of a website keeps everything afloat. You will have DQs due before every class. Expect many poignant, bizarre, incomprehensible, and genius monologues during class.

He's perhaps the most notorious professor in the English Department, and that is a wildly good thing. Burt has something of a cult following and that's because of the way he has students engage the films and writings. You will never watch a movie the same way again. Also, the class is pretty easy, just expect a lot of watching/reading.

Funny guy, but the class was pointless. It's all discussion with no real takeaway. He does live grading, but the papers are often very easy. He takes criticism really well and likes to have his opinions challenged. Watch the syllabus because it's ALWAYS changing. It was a decent course... but it should've been online. Would've saved me a walk.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I took three classes with Burt because I respected him and his teaching style so immensely. He challenged his students with difficult texts, and guided us through discussion like a lighthouse. Burt makes his classes accessible  to everyone, while leaving room open for people to excel. He receives criticism well, as he is humble and hilarious.

Though his genius is often overwhelming, he learns from us as much as we learn from him. The class is a lot of work and his expectations are high but it's worth it, Burt is a brilliant, hilarious professor who I will be taking again.
The class would be fine if it was taught by a different teacher. Burt makes the class uncomfortable.

There is A LOT of reading.  It can get pretty confusing and philosophical, but is mostly enjoyable.  Every now and then we watched films.  Course is discussion based, with Burt acting more like a moderator than a lecturer.  So you need to speak up.  He values all opinions and makes jokes every once in a while.  Burt is great!

I love Burt. If I could take his class every semester for the rest of my undergraduate career, I would. By far the most helpful teachers I have encountered at UF. He is hilarious; not to mention last semester he often brought us doughnuts. Class topics are authentic and although some of the movies are old, they're classics. Definitely recommend

Burt's syllabus never had more than a couple minor changes and all books were thoroughly read and discussed. Most of them you didn't even have to buy because the library had them for free online. Anyway, Burt's class was great! I feel like some students just can't handle a more freedom in discussion and need a teacher to lecture them exclusively

The person who wrote that this class was confusing and that he never taught is sadly misguided.  Richard Burt gives students the opportunity to choose what they learn and the quality of class they have. As long as you contribute you can alter the class. If you don't understand the class you're probably used to being spoon feed as well.

SUPER confusing class! Very little in the way of guidelines. The syllabus changed weekly and we had to buy about 10 books (specific editions)that we barely used.  He never taught a single class, he had the students teach it. Really, really, boring! You have been warned.

Took hamlet vs lear w Burt per positive reviews on here. Boy was I misled. Like shakespeare&hoped for a critical analysis learning experience. No such luck. Burt is unclear, all over the place scatter brained, & has students run class. So if you want a class with little substance but an annoying amount of busy work and learning nothing, take Burt

People tend to have polarizing views on him.  Burt is an extremely brilliant, hilarious, somewhere-in-between really difficult and really easy professor. Read, listen, and participate (and use his office hours -- they are hilarious), and you will likely consider any course of his a bizarre, unique but intensely rewarding intellectual experience.

I've taken ENG3011 and ENG4953 with Burt and they are my favorites of all the classes I have taken at UF. Burt's hilarious and he knows a ton about a ton of stuff. The texts we explored in both of those classes still resonate for me everyday. The way they all connect at the end of the class shows he takes a huge effort to plan a worthwhile class.

Burt is a great teacher! His classes aren't the typical sterile classroom environment. The material covered is just amazing, especially for English majors, but not exclusively. I felt free to play and experiment with my readings, and also to take risks. Highly recommend him if you want to take a trip outside the old literary cannon. Burt rocks!

This class was totally illegitimate. He's very biased in lecture (lots of conspiracy theory), but cannot apply the same criticism to the low quality philosophic novels. This class will cause you to fantasize about violently storming out of the room. If the state wasn't paying my tuition I'd be absolutely infuriated.

Burt's class is definitely my favorite so far. He is so interesting and just DIFFERENT than your standard English professor. It's a small class but we have the greatest discussions, even before/after class. It's hard work - lots of reading and writing - but I always leave feeling like I've learned a lot. He genuinely cares and is willing to help.

Prof. Burt IS the best film teacher at UF. No question. May also be the best english/cultural studies prof too...or just the best professor period. He's my all-time favorite, but he's hard! His difficulty is perfect if you're interested in the subject, but if you're not, do yourself (and Burt) a favor and don't take his classes.

Burt is an amazing teacher. You must speak up in discussions to do well but he is such an interesting teacher, you will want to. I loved this class and Burt, he does care about his students when he sees that they are making an effort. He knows so much about movies its ridiculous. You will learn so much if you take this class seriously. AWESOM!

But is an eccentric and interesting prof. He is genius and you'll learn a lot. But his classes are not easy, you will have to think critically, read a lot, and write a lot. He is a good Prof. Show up to class, do the work, pay attention, and try and you should be okay. But you will be busy! Short notice on deadlines as well.

Laid back He can be disorganized at times but it doesnt seem to cause major problems While it appears his grades fairly subjectively at times he is willing to discuss papers with you Though he will at times mark you down for things that are style prefrences rather than actually wrong. Burt is totally enthuastic though and genius in his topics

You fools be trippin, he is Burtalicious for a reason!  Don't even try to hate on his styl-e; he's just laid back.  That's a GOOD THING.  His classes are TIGHT, and he knows his SH*T.  Fo sho.  Class is fun, you learn, and you read/write a lot but it's worth it.  Burt, in reality, is energetic, funny, and definitely cares.  Word.
No Comments

Assignments were unclear, expectations were less clear, discussions were mediocre, and the professor was breathtakingly unconcerned about his students. His classes are on fascinating topics, but he makes them suck. Which is quite a talent, in its own warped way. Avoid.
he's passionate about his subject which helps when taking a class

burt was an excellent teacher when focused on helping his students.  however, sometimes he's absentminded and you constantly check on him in terms of your assignments and grades.  but he has a great passion for what he teaches and forces his students to interact with the class in manner most teachers don't.
