reviews.comment: He's a great lecturer, but more in a silly and engaging way that makes going to learn about theater three times a week a lot more enticing. Strong Gen X energy! Take notes at lecture, read the plays and participate in discussion and this is an easy A and a pretty fun time overall.

if you're not interested in theater take art or music appreciation. The in-person section of this class is too much work. You have to read a play a week and take a quiz on it and write a critique on 3 plays outside of class. He does give decent study guides tho. textbook material: CNTR F is your best friend. Only got an A bc of extra credit.

I genuinely enjoyed going to these lectures because I found them so entertaining. The professor is a fantastic lecturer who will keep your attention. The tests had clear study guides so you knew what was on them and studying wasn't too time-consuming. If you put in the effort you will be fine.

Dr. Mitchell really loves theatre, which makes the lectures very engaging and fascinating. He provides study guides based on the questions on the exam. There are required readings but they are not overwhelming and usually tie in directly with what is being discussed in the lecture. Amazing class and fantastic instructor!

Great professor, passionate about the material and engaging. 3 papers on school plays, 3 easy exams (go to the review + know everything on the study guide and you'll do great), and weekly quizzes in a break out session on a play. Don't be scared of taking it in person! It's not difficult and you'll learn more. Nicholas is an awesome TA!

Dr.Mitchell was very passionate about the subject he was teaching even for a gen-ed class. The work he gave was not very difficult and the tests were pretty straight forward. Attendance is mandatory and so is participating in the discussion sections. Quizzes nearly weekly about plays you had to read. He does make a study guide for each test though!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Mitchell is a pretty cool professor overall but for a Gen-Ed class I wasn't expecting to have so much homework. These aren't on the syllabus, but there are weekly quizzes for every play during discussion sections. Some plays were pretty cool reads and others were dense. As far as the textbook goes, Dr. Mitchell has a free link online.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Mitchell is funny and knowledgable, but he kinda has an inflated ego. Attendance is mandatory, and he doesn't post his notes anywhere. There is a lot of reading between the textbook and plays, but if you read you will be fine. You have to attend in-person plays which was annoying since one was off campus. Grading is all dependent on your TA.

Honestly one of the best lecturer's I've experienced. Information is insightful and seen on the exam, so you aren't just learning useless info. Your breakout is TA dependent but all of them are super nice and genuinely care about the material.
He was very entertaining in class and made sure to provide study guides for exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Mitchell was a funny and entertaining lecturer and I enjoyed going to his lectures. However, for a gen-ed course, he made us do way too much work. Every week you needed to read and take a quiz on a play, and you had to watch three different plays and write a paper about each one. So the class was fun but too time consuming for a gen-ed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--So many papers

reviews.comment: Pretty interesting class. Should be an easy A if you read the textbook and the required readings, but grading is highly dependent on your TA.

Not a hard class, but harder than it should be for the course. As long as you read the plays and pay attention (mostly) in class its an easy A. The lectures were pretty entertaining as Dr. Mitchell is pretty funny. The plays you have to see were annoying to see sometimes as they were long but only one was miserable to be.

Dr. Mitchell is the funniest person ever. Lectures were engaging and our homework was watching plays and writing about them. Just take notes on slides and actually read the plays and you'll be golden.

Dr. Mitchell gives hilarious lectures, is always read to help and gives very good study guides. The class is a lot of work but Dr. Mitchell makes it fun and engaging and the work is worth it because the class is so fun. I would definitely take this again and Dr. Mitchell is an amazing teacher and resource.

Lectures were genuinely enjoyable. You have a quiz on a new play every Friday but they were short, I finished them the morning of in under two hours. 3 papers on 3 plays (free tickets given) but TA might grade harsh. Exams are in person but he gives a study guide. You have to sign in at lectures though and can only miss so many (TA might cover you)

THIS CLASS IS NOT AN EASY A. you have to buy and read a new play almost every week. You have to watch 3 plays and write essays on them which are easy A's depending on your TA. Participation and attendance really affects your grade at the end of the semester. Class was interesting but this class needed an excessive amount of time put into it.
The class was too difficult for a gen ed, only got an a because the exam was curved an I did the extra credit
made this class way harder than it needed to be.

I enjoyed his lectures very much. The class is structured with papers, exams, quizzes, and shows you have to watch. I wouldn't describe it as an easy A, but it is definitely possible to get an A. The discussion quizzes are about the plays you read outside of class which are very specific and hard to score very high on. Papers are graded by TAs!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Pr. Mitchell makes lectures engaging and fun. Write down everything that's on the slides, use the study guide he gives, and you will be fine. Three exams and a final, all multiple choice. Almost weekly quizzes on plays, questions are ridiculously easy. A few papers, around 2 pages double-spaced so nothing crazy, but your grade depends on your TA.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Mitchell was an amazing lecturer, but there was a lot of content to memorize for the class. Weekly quizzes and 3 exams make up a large portion of your grade and an outlined study guide is provided before each exam. There are also 5 short papers throughout the semester, and it entirely depends on your TA on how harshly they are graded.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Mitchell was a great teacher, very knowledgable about the subject and passionate about the material. Kind and understanding, available during office hours twice a week. 3 exams, quizzes on plays during discussion section, 3 papers (graded by TA), 2 homework assignments, and a final exam. Would highly recommend professor and class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Mitchell was such a cool guy. It was nice to go to his class after having STEM classes all day and just having that nice break. Exams are super easy and he gives you a study guide with everything on it. Papers are easy and the TAs graded them and they were all super cool. Going to the plays was sometimes annoying but they were pretty okay

Theater appreciation doesn't sound like it would be for everybody, but the class is actually super fun. There is quite a bit of reading but it just took me like an hour every other week and the plays were usually pretty interesting. The tests aren't hard at all as long as you study. He gives you a paper with everything that's gonna be on the test.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof. Mitchell's lectures were funny and informative. I enjoyed that we covered theatre across different cultures. We have to read plays every other week, which can be a bit tedious at times. The prof also doesn't allow technology in class and all assignments are submitted physically, which can sometimes be a pain. Overall, I had a good experience!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This course is absolutely not a course you should take if it is not a course of your critical tracking. There are many contents that are covered in each of the lectures, the quiz and exams contains excessive minor and minor details that are very hardly to be remembers even with very detailed reviews. Also, the instructor use no technology.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: THE 2000 was not nearly as easy in person. The professor was strict about the little things and did not believe in technology. The class seemed to be more about politics than actual theater which was disappointing. Assignments were often unclear and grading depended on which TA you received.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Cool class to take even if you aren't a theater major. Pretty simple class with weekly discussion post and quizzes. Also two papers and a creative project at the end. He is pretty accessible outside during the beginning but towards the end of the semester it can be hard to get a reply.

Good class. Weekly quizzes and discussion posts, plus 2 papers based on plays that we watch (or listen to) and a final creative project. Mitchell isn't a bad prof. You can tell he cares about the material and is passionate about it in the few lectures he's given this semester. Quizzes are very specific about notes in textbook, so beware, but easy.

This class was so much fun! You learn about theatre in a very fun way. Previously, I was very involved in theatre, but I still learned so much from this class. Dr. Mitchell really knows what he's talking about and knows how to teach it in a fun way! The most annoying part of this class was going to plays that were long (only one), but it's not bad.

Dr. Mitchell is a great professor and obviously passionate about the class. Really enjoyable course, as other reviewers said - very easy. Two papers and one final project along with a few quizzes and discussion posts. Highly recommend.

This class was a very easy A. As long as you read the material, or have a quizlet account, you should pass the class with flying colors. This was a very straightforward class and presented theatre in a way that was interesting and thought provoking. Definitely recommend if you need it to satisfy a requirement or are interested in theatre.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class is an easy A as long as you keep up with the quizzes and discussion boards. TAs do most of the grading, but they have been pretty fair in my experience. Very straight forward class, a little heavy on readings, but hard to mess up. All of the plays we were assigned were interesting in my opinion.

Dr. Mitchell is pretty funny and reasonable. His lectures are painless, and the class is pretty easy to pass. All of the quizzes are on quizlet, and the material doesn't take that long to read. You do have to read a few plays and write 3 papers on performances, so just be ready.

Great professor! Course ramps up fast so be sure to keep up with all assignments. Exams are quite difficult with averages in the 50s but not worth much of your grade compared to other classes. You'll learn a lot if you put the effort in. Just make sure to actually do the assignments yourself or you will struggle on exams and more advanced material.
This was a required class for my major. The class was time consuming, probably because I had little coding experience. Dr. Cho was really great at teaching the subject.

Professor Cho was the best! She's so sweet, caring and structures the class and homework in a way that -- if you don't use GPT -- will teach you a lot.

Also, there's live codings where you go up and try to apply what you learn. It's a bit daunting at first, but it's super worth to do it. Have fun!

She is awesome! Her lectures are concise and useful and the class is structured very well for a programming class. You get hands on experience from the start and that made me excited to always learn more. Highly recommend especially if you're choosing between this and EEL3834.

Getting an A is definitely doable, but it will require a lot of work on your end or prior coding experience. Dr. Cho is a tough grader, but is caring. Lectures and textbook were unhelpful as I learned much of the content on my own for weekly quizzes. Exams are HARD (averages in the 50s) and content gets hard fast.  Take online for easier A.

Lectures are long boring and wordy and you can't read what she's writing. Weekly assignments can be 30 minute assignment or could be a couple hours. With every part of the class being through coding software to make the exams hand writing code its not reflective of what you learn. Professor Cho is degrading if you ask questions. Take online section

I cannot believe the disparity between the in-person and online sections. All exams, both online and in-person, used to be online. This semester the exams for the in-person section were explicitly on paper and it BOMBED my grade. Paper doesn't tell you if your code is erroneous and you will be graded harshly for it if it is. Just take online.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Lectures are unnecessarily long and wordy. Does a poor job at explaining applications of the code. One day in class I asked for help on an assignment and she proceeds to degrade me telling me how stupid I am. Made comments like, "it's so simple, why can't you do it?" Which is fair but if you're going to say I am doing it wrong at least help me.

The absolute GOAT. She gave multiple examples in class and was very straightforward with what the exams would cover, the types of questions that would appear, etc. She was also very helpful when you asked for help.

Professor was great for my learning the subject. I had no prior knowledge of coding and took this class for Summer B as a freshman, so it was a difficult learning curve. Sometimes her explanations felt a little bit confusing, but overall exams were very fair and decently easy if you write down past LCAs for exam part C.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Class is flipped learning, you learn via ChatGPT trial/error w/ the weekly hw. Attendance req but can just treat the in-person sections as work periods as she doesn't teach in class (nothing against her, just how course is set up). Can leave after 30 min for the 2 hour class. Exams are just easier HW/weekly examples. WRITE DOWN THE TA EXAM REVIEWS.

She doesn't teach much, but everything is Googleable. If you do good on the assignments every week, the exams are easy. You get a page front/back for notes on exams, and just put class examples, and you will be fine. Attendance is mandatory, if you miss one day of the week, you will automatically get a zero on the weekly assignment.
She is very organized but the class itself has so much information to it so it's sometimes hard to catch up. Very kind however and understanding.

Ms. Cho is very talented at coding and knows what she is talking about. However, she does not do much teaching in her classes. The entirety of the class is self-taught from a miserable textbook, and the mandatory in person classes were only practice problems without any real coding instruction. Not at all a fan.

As someone with programming experience, the content and assignments were pretty easy. There were also multiple opportunities for extra credit. I didn't like required attendance (she says your homework for the week won't get graded if you don't show up for class) because her lectures were slow and often redundant of required reading.

If you're a programmer, this teacher is amazing, explaining both how to program and what happens behind the cover of the compiler. She gives advice for coding for outside of class and the courses breadth is perfect. If you're not a programmer, expect to be struggling, but reach out to the TA's or even ask classmates for help.

Taking this course as a complete beginner to programing felt like a dauting task at first, but with the videos and the live coding sessions, it ended up being fairly easy. Just make sure to attend the live sessions or you will get lost quickly. Professor is forgiving, offering numerous extra credit opportunities during the semester.

She was a very good lecturer, and the live coding sessions were very helpful. The class is flipped, so sometimes I would be very confused on the lecture until we got to class and started working on practice. Overall, the class was an easy A for me, but it somewhat depends on prior programming experience, as the textbook is very confusing.

ONLY take this class if you've had programming experience. This course is meant to be an introductory course, but it definitely was way more advanced. The grading of assignments was nitpicky, it was hard to learn from only a textbook, and the time given to complete the homework was too short.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: If you don't have a coding brain, DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. I found myself struggling for HOURS/DAYS on every. single. assignment. ChatGPT was my teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: dont miss pts on the weekly projects (you have 2 days to submit 3 mini projects every week) only 3 exams that were heavy weighted. getting 100% on the big HWs and the weekly projects is HUGELY important and makes easy to get A. totally doable class + wasnt too time consuming. great teacher who loves feedback on the class. would def recommend
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: OMG SHE IS AMAZING please take Matlab with her. Her grading weights are different than the other professors and are more lenient than the others. Exams are pretty easy and she is really good at explaining stuff.

She was a great coding teacher, particularly during class and office hours. She gave great feedback during office hours, and was very helpful in guiding you so you have a sort of aha moment and understand the content way better.

Professor Cho is awesome. She really knows what she's talking about and is a lenient grader. Will work with you to make sure that you understand the material; when the whole class does poorly she will reevaluate the grading scale. Learned so much in C++, almost wish it was a two-course sequence!

C++ section. She's an amazing person and works with the students as the semester progresses for exams. She saw we were struggling and changed some exam structure and allowed credit recovery. Her lectures are confusing at times and first half of each class is mandatory, with 3 programs being due 2 days after lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is an amazing professor who really knows how to help students learn. She is organized but also lenient with the timeline if something happens in your life. She has online videos (brief ones), then live coding, in class assignments, and finally homework and exams. She also allows 1-2 pages of notes on exams. Doable and I learned a lot!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The professor makes sure that students questions are answered before moving on. Also will respond relatively quickly and be helpful when reached out to.

She is an amazing Cop2271 Matlab teacher. The class is flipped so a lot of it is teaching yourself and you don't really interact with her too much, but moreso the class is structured towards your success. Definitely recommend her for Matlab as she can help with any problems you have.

It's a flipped class so you watch lectures before class and do coding problems in class. She is very nice and gives extra time if you don't finish the problems during class. The in class problems and homework's prepare you well for the coding portions of the exams. The debugging portions on the exams can be a bit tricky though.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: While the lectures were a little dull, I think Professor Cho does a good job of making sure that no one gets left behind and that everyone has a chance to learn Matlab. She is a very nice lady teaching a course that is not too difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Took her online, really good professor and was able to teach well. However, there was a lot of lectures and a lot of assignments each week.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This was a retake for me, and I think Chui was fine compared to other professors. She can be monotone and not very engaging at times, but if you do stay engaged, she's good! But compared to in person, her online section was far tougher. No partial credit, and the exams were much harder. Don't take it with other hard classes. Take her in person!

lolol I didnt even have her as my main calc 2 prof officially (had adams) but I might as well have, because I ended up just going to her office hours and watched her lectures to learn. She is so nice and always willing to help anyone who needs it. Takes the time to learn your name and actually cares about your success. Always gives tips and tricks
I found that Chui's lectures were very easy to understand, the exams and quizzes are difficult, but the homework and past exams are very helpful

Professor Chui was an amazing professor her lectures were very thorough and beneficial. There were a lot of assignments which if you do them and actively participate it's very beneficial. She is always willing to help her students and is always encouraging. Calc 2 is a hard course but Professor Chui is great at explains the material.

Great professor for a difficult class. There is 1 homework assignment per lecture, and they are usually pretty difficult but prepare you for the exams. Exams are also difficult but every past exam is available on canvas. Also, Chui always answers questions in class, and she is always helpful in office hours. Would definitely recommend her.

She speaks fast. If you're trying to listen to her and take notes.. goodluck. She's the sweetest lady you'll meet and she wants everyone to do well. She's non threatening and like a silly little grandma.

Love her! She's very sweet and energetic and her lectures are great! If you have questions during lecture, you can lowkey just shout them out and she'll stop to explain, or you can ask her after class. Calc 2 is a hard class, and I didn't do well (my own fault...), but she makes it a lot better.

Very chill for a calc 2 class, she is very understanding and there is lots of extra credit. The exams are just like the practice ones and the lecture quizzes so as long as you do those you should be fine.

I pretty much "learned" most calculus two concepts from IB HL Math AA from a high school teacher, but I cannot express how much better my understanding of the concepts was from Dr. Chui. She is very kind and goes the extra mile to make sure you understand both the how and why behind concepts. If you're taking Calc II, I 100% reccomend her!

Professor Chui is super nice and was so willing to help, often going far past the end of her office hours to help students who were still there. I have no criticisms--the only thing I think the course could potentially benefit from are updated lecture videos, as the older ones used were occasionally a little hard to watch due to quality issues.
Dr. Chui is an amazing professor. Highly highly recommend!

I took her Calc 2 class, she explains everything clearly, answers questions well in class, and is always available to explain topics after class or in office hours. She's also funny asf. Exams aren't too hard, she provides past exams so studying for them is easy and there are 5 pts of extra credit available on the exams

The course is very challenging but she is passionate and cares about helping her students succeed and is one of the best professors at UF. Go to her office hours and she will help you go step by step if you need it. The exams are difficult but fair so start studying early. Her lectures are easy to follow and explain things well.

I loved Calc 2 with Dr. Chui! She is a good lecturer. The Xronos Homework assignments are easy. There are weekly quizzes during discussion sections. Exams are not too bad and have a max of 105/100 points.

Dr. Chui is incredible. She has a discussion where she often personally responds to questions. She holds zoom office hours where she clearly and calmly goes through any material until you understand it. She is kind, understanding, intelligent, and wants her students to succeed. This is a hard class, but if you put in the work you will be fine.

calc 2 is a pretty hard class mainly covering integrals and series. professor Chui did a really good job of explaining it and making the class fun. I enjoyed attending her class. lectures are recorded. make sure to actually do the homeworks properly and not just right click for the answers... as they prepare you for the exam.

This is a really hard class, but Professor Chui's lectures really make the content as easy to understand as possible and she gives a lot of opportunities for improvement. DO THE EXTRA CREDIT, take the homeworks seriously because they prepare you for the quizzes, and do the practice exams and you'll be fine- definitely recommend taking Chui's class.

Found lectures to be unclear and skip over smaller concepts that were fundamental to learning the larger concepts. Lots of assignments that didn't seem to help boost my grade. Overall felt unprepared for exams with just her material, ended up having to purchase study edge just to pass.
Found lectures hard to follow along and did not prepare us for tests adequately.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor! She makes Calc 2 so easy to understand and makes it easy to get an A with extra credit and lots of past exams to study from. Her tests are exactly like her reviews and past exams. She also gives 2 days of extra time to do lecture quizzes/homework which comes in handy.
She's a great teacher, really good lectures. I never went to office hours so can't speak on that but the exams are difficult but definitely doable.

The professor was amazing and really nice. Office hours were very helpful. You could ask any question and the professor would show the step-by-step process to the answer and explain it thoroughly. She makes sure that you understand it completely. The TAs were very good and helpful in their office hours, too. The quizzes and exams weren't too bad.

If I had to choose between Steven Adams and Chui for Calc 2, I would definatley go with Chui. Both instructors teach the same material, but Chui goes above and beyond leading to more knowledge. Chui's reviews are exactly like what the exam will be like, meanwhile Adams will be vague and not say what will or will not be on the exam.

Amazing professor! The lectures made sense, and the course content is not too challenging if math is your thing. She does a great job of breaking concepts down in an understandable way. You only need lecture material for this class and note outlines will be provided for you to follow along. Exams are very fair - there weren't many difficult ones.

great teacher and class, she taught the material really well and if you were confused she would help you. i sat in the front and if i looked really confused she would ask me if i understood while people worked which was really nice. there was class participation from questions we would do in class and take a quiz online but you could do it later.

Professor Chui is the best lecturer, and I am so glad I took it with her instead of Adams (not that Adams is a bad professor). She is such a nice person and explains the content very clearly, I had no problem getting a very high grade in the class. It also helps that you get some insurance points on the exams, like the max score being 105/100.

Professor Chui truly cares about her students and somehow makes Calculus 2 fun. Lecture recordings are posted on Canvas along with past exams with worked out solutions and extra problems. Homework on Xronos was manageable but past exams will be your best resource for studying. Discussion quizzes are two simple questions based on lecture material.

She is super sweet. Cares a lot for her students and tries to get to know them. She tries to help as much as she can. She isn't the one that makes the exams but she is great at teaching. Exams are tough but if you study and go to office hours you'll be fine. Don't fall behind!!

Professor Chui is one of the best mathematics professors at the University of Florida. While Calculus 2 is known for one of the most rigorous math courses, I can attest to the fact that Chui does a great job in presenting her video lectures and really wants all her students to succeed and ultimately pass her class. Take advantage of extra credit!

Chui is a very good lecturer, even through videos! The online section has a lot of work, and seems to cover a couple more topics than the in person sections, but it is very doable if you stay organized and on top of the assignments. The final exam was much harder than I anticipated, and I didn't think it resembled the practice exams very well.
Learned a lot!

Chui is my idol. I love her so much. She's a great teacher, very kind and sweet, and she cares about her students and wants them to do well. She clearly loves what she teaches and teaches it with enthusiasm. Calculus 2 is a hard class and the homework is meant to be challenging, but Chui is a fantastic teacher and I'd take a class with her again.

If I could take Chui for all my math courses I would! Legit one of the best professors I've ever had, Chui takes great care to answer all questions and makes an effort to learn about everyone in my class as ppl. She's caring and attentive, and understands that sometimes you need to miss a lecture or two (all lectures are recorded). TAKE HER CLASS!

Professor Chui's Calc 2 class is challenging but manageable with dedication. The pre-recorded lectures and abundant practice materials are invaluable. Leveraging unstuckstudy ai alongside standard resources made studying much more efficient. Overall, a thoughtful instructor who genuinely cares about student success.

Professor Chui was such a great prof! I was super nervous taking this class as a 9th grader, but she helped me though it! I got a 59% on my first exam, but she worked with me and i ended up with an A for a final grade! I can't stress this enough though, GO TO OFFICE HOURS!! She remembers each of the students and makes sure they get help!
Took online over Summer C. Calc 2 is difficult but her lectures are very good. Watch all the lectures and do all the extra problems and reviews and the class is passable.

Attendance is a quiz, that can be done from home. Lectures and tests between all profs were identical, occasionally in a diff order. Never got frustrated with students. Very passionate and easy to talk to. Videos lectures. Very clear and gave a lot of resources. Totally recommend. Nothing particularly bad or amazing, would take again with Chui.

Prof Chui is a great teacher for Calc 2. For those that didn't ever take BC Calc/equiv in high school, be ready to really study for this class. You are provided so many practice exams and practice problems, just make sure to stay up to date with Chui's lectures and use your resources.

Professor Chui is one of the most caring professors I've had yet. Due to the content heavy nature of the course, she sometimes ran out of time during lectures, but she was so willing to help students the best that she could when this did happen. I had a couple of conversations with her and she was very sweet, and her office hours were very useful.
Very nice prof. but lectures felt rushed and sometimes a little bit disorganized. Canvas page is very oragnized and helpful to fill in any gaps from the lectures. Exams and quizzes were fairly easy.

Chui is super sweet and knowledgeable. I found that Calc 3 was hard to grasp from the lectures so I usually watched them online, but that's not her fault, it's just a lot of content. She was always eager to help and frequently stayed after class to answer questions. Lots of homework but it was helpful for the exams which were fair and very doable.

Chui is super nice and you can tell she cares about her students and is very knowledgable about the material. I struggled a little bit in calc 3 but she is always game to re-explain topics to students and even though i barely spoke to her she always asked about my exam grades and wished me the best on said exams

Calc 3 is rough but I still made it! Professor Chui is super nice and always tries to help if we need it. However, she is a fast pace lecture, so you may need to be careful not to fall behind during the lecture.

She is a very fast lecturer and misses some things sometimes but overall very nice. Her exam reviews are catered directly to exams which help a lot. Professor Adams is the MAC2312 in person course coordinator, so she does not answer emails pertaining to the course

The pre recorded lectures that she posts for the online class are very well made and easy to understand. She explains topics very well. There is a lot of homework and quizzes but they are very helpful in furthering your understanding of the class. The exams are as expected and similar to homework problems and past exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Chui is an amazing professor and I really enjoyed this class. I was super nervous coming into it because I'm not a "natural" at math, but her lectures were easy to understand and her quizzes/exams were just like the homework. This class is time-consuming if you want to do well, but it's worth it!! :)

I took Dr. Chui for calc 2 online. She had so many assignments but I felt like they were all necessary in doing well. By the time the exams came around, I barely had to study. I feel like she genuinely cares about all of her students and their success.

Great person, really kind and willing to help. Attendance was mandatory due to Shabazz who was the program coordinator. I took calc 2 with her and attendance was optional. You learn more from Prof Leonard but she is pretty good. If attendance were optional I would just show up to office hours.

Dr. Chui was AMAZING. She is someone who truly cares about her students' success and it shows. She would often stay for way longer than she should've for OH all to accommodate the people who would come in late and still ask for help. She also made sure to remember every name. She was amazing and her recorded lectures were great. Best professor ever

This lectures for this class were recorded but I found that by going to the lectures everyday, I stayed on track which helped me overall do well in the class. Chui was a great professor and used useful notes in class. She offered helpful office hours as well.

Calc 2 isn't an easy class but prof Chui does the best she can to help students out! I took the online version of the course, so attending her office hours and keeping up with lecture videos really did the trick. Exams are long but doable. If you have any questions reach out to her and she'll do a great work at explaining one on one
Professor Chui makes a clear effort to help students succeed and was very kind when answering questions. Calculus 2 is very difficult but she is careful to explain everything as clearly as possible.

Chui was a great professor and accessible during office hours! Calc 2 was definitely more challenging than Calc 1, but I still managed to end up with an 96.5% in the class. My only pet peeve was that the quizzes were proctored by Honorlock, but other than that I had no complaints.

I took this class online so there wasn't much interaction with her, but her lectures were pretty good and she seemed to really care about us. If you are taking this class online, definitely get study edge.

CHUI IS THE SWEETEST PROFESSOR EVER! Even if you are not good at calc, she makes this class enjoyable. I love Professor Chui, and if possible I will take her with Calc 3. Highly recommend her, she clearly knows what she is talking about.

This professor was great and really explained everything very well. While the material was really tough at times, I was able to keep up and do well. I recommend taking any class with her, I had a good experience.
Chui is amazing!! Her lectures are great and her office hours saved me in this course.

Dr. Chui explained Calc 2 very well. Her lectures are very straightforward- if you miss lecture, you will miss a lot of information. Tests can be difficult but she supplies a ton of practice/old exams, which were very similar to the actual exam. Do the homework (worth points) and go to class and you won't have a problem- I finished with a 103%.

The course content was pretty complex, but Professor Chui did a great job making those topics easier to understand. She was also very helpful outside of the classroom and was helpful in answering students' questions.
Professor Chui was an amazing professor and her class was very manageable online.

Dr. Chui is an amazing professor. She really cares about the students and makes an effort to explain concepts in a fun way in and outside of class. She provides extra resources for her students and is always accessible for questions. Overall an amazing professor and the best calc 2 professor imo.

She is SUPER caring and makes learns her students' names. OUT OF HUNDREDS. Her lectures are great and she holds office hours for as long as people still have questions. Calc 2 is hard, but her teaching helped a lot with everything. We had participation quizzes online after class, but it was easy to get the answers if you didn't go to class.

Professor Chui is very caring and often provides OH/stays after class to answer questions. You will have to put in a lot of individual effort weekly, but as long as you don't fall behind you should be fine. Weekly work consists of online homework and participation surveys, very exam heavy so stay on top of preparations when one rolls around.

I loved Professor Chui's class. She was caring and sweet and always took the time to explain things to students. Tests were a large part of the grade but all had some extra credit. The lectures were posted online which was great. Some topics however were not explained enough, especially for the exam weight (polar area, physics application).

Prof Chui cares a lot about her students and is always there if you need help w a topic. The class is difficult and requires lots of practice but her lectures are always super helpful and her announcements normally have some review materials included to make studying easier. Overall very nice although she sometimes speeds through lectures.

Professor Chui is definitely one of the best math teachers I have ever had. She truly cares about everyone understanding the concepts and goes into good depth during lectures. She is really good also at properly preparing us for the exams and always devotes a lecture to review. She always helps and is especially great during her office hours. 10/10

Dr. Chui was a very good lecturer, she always put the concepts into easy to understand terms. She was very accessible and was always clear about expectations and what to do next. She also offered many resources for extra help. There was a lot of homework however, usually requiring at least an hour or two everyday.

Dr. Chui is great at explaining difficult topics, and speaks not like a professor but like a tutor, straying away from using jargon to confuse you more. There is A LOT of work however, including studying; I probably put in three to four hours of work per day. Exams are manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Chui is the absolute best calc teacher I've ever had. Calc 2 can be pretty difficult, but she really does make it a lot easier. The online course is pretty well structured, and she'll always answer your questions in office hours or on canvas. Plus, you get a lot of resources from earlier years, it's all on Canvas.

Actually cannot say worse things about this professor. She is the least understanding professor and redirects ANY questions to TA even if she needs to answer them. Problems on quizzes are way different than the homework/lectures. Super hard even with a tutor and study edge.

I had to do homework everyday and it was just so demanding. I felt like I did not have much instruction on how to do some of the work especially since it was an online course. I think it would have been better in person. She did reach out for help, but I felt like it is a class you need to do in real life to understand.
I liked Professor Chui and the way she set up her online Calc 2 course to make it reasonable because it's already a difficult subject. I just personally didn't like her lecture videos.
GOAT

Calc 2 is hard. Chui makes good lectures. My recommendation is to go in person. Its annoying and time-consuming but trust me you are going to understand the material. It s a lot of content (a lot more than there should be in my opinion). But shes amazing and sweet and you really do get the material. If you dont shes really answers your questions.

There is a lot of work, but she never fails to guarantee your understanding of the material. The exams are very easy and cover the same types of problems you will do for homework or quizzes, and sometimes the same questions are used. This class may be hard for those who never took MAC2311, as a lot of this content is different from calc AB and BC.

Dr. Chui was a great professor for a very hard class. This is the worst class I've ever taken over my schooling career, not because she's a poor teacher but because there's too much material to cover. Tests are designed to be hard and intricate. I wouldn't take more than 16 credits with this class.

Professor Chui wasn't the worst math professor I've ever had but she wasn't the best. She offered help whenever possible and was very available. In my opinion professor Manly is the better lecturer and professor, and I often ended up watching his lectures.

She is an amazing professor and made it very easy to understand everything! I also highly recommend using Study Edge for this class because it was extremely helpful for extra practice and their Exam Reviews are great to watch before each exam.
Good teacher, but it's much better to attend her classes in person rather than relying on the recording afterward.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She's really nice and approachable, and her lectures are engaging and explain the problems well. She went very quickly on some of the later lectures, though

Professor Chui teaching style didnt work for me and I stopped going to her lectures after doing very poorly on the first exam to watch Professor Manlys lectures and I did much better on the next exam. The exams are very difficult and even when I studied and went to tutoring I didnt do great. Everything was online and it made it very challenging.

Professor Chui's demeanor is just so likeable, and she really cares about her students. The pace of the class is quite fast, but if you take the time to go to office hours she will gladly try to help you understand. Calc II was very digestible due to her efforts.

The online course is significantly more work than the in-person. Her lectures are quick to the point and really helpful. Test material actually reflects what you do in class. Homework is on Xronos so it's easy to do but those questions are significantly harder than what's given on the test/gone over during the lecture. Previous exams were helpful.

Prof. Chui has been the best calculus professor I have had the opportunity to study with. She is a really nice person, very easily accessible through the class discussions or office hours. Calculus II is a hard class but she makes sure the lectures and homework are clear to you, and will never leave you with an unanswered question.

Professor Chui is very nice but an awful professor. She explains things poorly and provides no resources to study for midterms and the final. She would often give hard problems in the lecture and say she "didn't want to do it" and would never go back to it. The exams were nothing like the lectures or homework.

Chui is a great lecturer and keeps you engaged. Lectures consist her going through a packet you can buy or download. There are about 3 lecture quizzes and a homework assignment each week, and 4 exams. The exams are the bulk of your grade. A few extra credit opportunities. Watch the lectures and do all the problems assigned and you should be golden.

reviews.comment: Chui is such a sweetheart. She really cares about her students and the material and it shows. The course material is hard and the exams are stressful, but you have access to another professor's recordings as well in case you need different explanations.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Chui is a literal queen! For the countless times I approached her with a problem I was stuck on, she always patiently explained where I went wrong. Her lectures are quick, but thorough. Use her office hours (both her online and in-person OH), website, the extra problems at the end of lecture notes for practice and you'll do great on the exams!

The class is hard, but she is not bad. The lectures are very fun, given the subject, and she is very willing to help if you go to office hours or stay after class. The grading is through canvas so she is not a tough grader, it is just math, you have to be correct to get the points. This also means no partial credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Chui herself is not that bad of a teacher but the amount of homework she assigns is honestly outrageous. I find myself not having enough time to learn in classes that actually pertain to my major to the extent I would like to because I am always stuck doing an assignment for this class. Very hard, would not take again.

Dr. Chui is an amazing lecturer who provides clear explanations and examples. All content will be covered. The class is incredibly fast paced, but just make sure to do the homework to get in enough practice and stay on top of the content, and you'll be just fine!

A lot of people will say that calc 2 is one of the worst classes to take at UF but Chui makes this class really doable. Her lectures are great and really thorough. She also gives out lots of extra credit and will respond to any questions you have on the homework and quizzes on her discussion posts if someone else already hasn't.

I am absolutely not a Cal person, let alone Cal 2. But my major does require it. It is hard for me but Chui made it sooooo much better. I passed my exams each time with Bs and I couldnt believe it. She is a gifted professor and makes such hard material seem so approachable. She gives tons of resources to take advantage of and the exams are fair.

I kept an A all the way up until the final. The hardest part of this class are the exams, which make up a significant portion of your grade. Loads of resources and prior exams are given as supplement and I HIGHLY suggest you utilize them. I'm certain that my bad grade on my final was because I neglected the resources. Exams generously curved.

Dr Chui's exams are much more fair than other professors. Chui gives a lot of extra credit, and while the homeworks and quizzes are hard, they were open note and unlimited time, as well as closely corresponding to the test material. You're at a big disadvantage if you don't take her.
She is the best professor I've had at UF! Super helpful, and always willing to answer questions!!
Maybe one of the best calc professors, very easy to reach and exams were very fair compared to other professors. I would recommend.
Calc 2 is real rough but Chui is a sweetheart who actually cares about everyone's understanding. The class takes work but she will make your life easier if you need help.

Amazing professor! She really cares about her students. Calc 2 is really hard but she makes it a lot easier. Lots of chances for extra credit too. Her lectures are amazing and makes things easy to understand. Exams are pretty difficult though

Calc 3 isn't impossible but definitely needs focus. Class required work daily. Chui was easily the best lecturer, beating Demas and Huang. Went above and beyond by going off the normal lecture notes and making her own to explain things. Lectures often took longer than usual but she'd also stay to help with any questions. Study for tests and pass!

I've never had as an amazing of a math professor as Chui. Her pre-recorded lectures are fantastic, she provides extra credit opportunities, and goes out of her way to make sure students are getting the most out of the class. If you have the option to take Chui for anything, please take her!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: While Prof. Chui wasn't my assigned lecturer, I chose to attend her lectures because the class was online. Chui definitely has a gift for teaching and can explain difficult topics in simple terms. She consistently went out of her way to teach in a variety of methods that were catered to different styles of learning.

Calc 3 is rough but professor Chui made it great. She will stay after class to help you understand the material better. There is a lot of work but if you stay on top of it and put effort into the class, you should easily be able to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I took MAC2312 summer 2018 fully online and thought it was doable- I am NOT a math person and was able to receive an A in this course with a combination of watching her lectures and using Study Edge- Jordan made the information super simple and understandable! Study Edge's short concept videos and exam solutions were super helpful as well.

I've only taken the course for a bit more than a month and I can say Professor Chui is a great professor. Even though her english isn't the best, she manages to teach her lectures clearly and without any issues. She also cares for the students.
Doesn't go in depth on content, pace is too fast to fully understand the concepts, and the homework does not correspond to the lecture

I cannot express how amazing of a professor Chui is. It's clear that she genuinely cares about her students and really wants you to succeed. She does everything she can to make lectures as easy to understand as possible. There is no doubt that calc 2 is very difficult but if there's one person to get you through it, it's Chui.

Great professor! Very knowledgeable and you can tell she cares a lot about her students' learning. She will explain something to you if you don't understand or even if you have questions unrelated to the class. Her lectures are great and her exams are very fair. Overall though, Calc 2 is an extremely tough class, especially the second half.

She is an amazing professor. Very kind and cares about her students. She provides all the resources you need to succeed in the class. Whenever you need help, just ask and she will do anything to help you. I'm happy to have been in her class. My best advice for exams is to make sure you understand the content in the practice exams she provides.

Chui is by far the most caring professor I have ever met at my time at UF. If you are having difficulties, either with course content, or just in life, she will do her best to accommodate you . That being said, Calc 2 is a very difficult class, but you are given all of the resources you need. If you put in the effort (homeworks), you will do well.

I took calc 2 online with her after not knowing ANYTHING about calculus and getting a C in calc 1. She is one of the few teachers at UF that I would say actually gives a crap about her students and legitimately wants you to pass. Posted lectures are very clear and concise. If you have to take calc 2 (fyi please don't if you don't have to) pick her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Calc 2 sucks, and it's going to suck no matter who you take it with. That being said, Chui was pretty good. She doesn't pull any punches but her exams were fair. If you're good at calculus your grade will reflect it.

Calc 2 is a hard class to begin with. Chui explained the concepts well despite the huge 300 person lecture class. I was never able to go to her office hours bc it conflicted with my schedule, but I heard they were helpful. I recommend Broward tutoring if you can make a private appt. I didn't have study edge. Buy lecture shell!!

reviews.comment: I dont think she couldve made Calc 2 any easier. People who give her bad ratings probably did poorly in the class but thats not on Chui. She makes all the resources you need easily accessible so if you want an A you can get one with some effort.
Dr. Chui is the best there is. Class is still pretty hard tho
Rough and tough class.

reviews.comment: Best calc professor I've ever had; super clear and easy to understand; clickers are annoying, but it all evens out at the end of the semester; tests are fair and using her exam reviews, past exams, and NYTI's is the best way to study; HW's help too; discussion isn't helpful; office hours/discussion board also super helpful; easy to pass

Professor Chui was such a good teacher. She was easy to understand and made sure to go slow enough and work through multiple problems during lecture. The class itself was very difficult and math is not my best subject but she made it less scary than I expected. She also gives plenty of material to study which was very helpful.
Definitely take her for calc 2.

Best professor Ive had so far. Professor Chui is really flexible with students when it comes to office hours and answers questions through email over a reasonable timeframe. She cares about her students and helps ensure success. The class material can get difficult at times but studying and practice problems as well as office hours help.

Chui is by far one of the best professors you could ask for for Calculus. Her lectures are very clear and she knows where students have trouble and makes sure to explain it well. With that said, the material ramps up fast and is definitely harder as you go. But she is SUPER accessible and will even stay extra for office hours to ensure success.
Enthusiastic
Lectures move quickly but are easy to follow. She is one of my favorite math professors so far. Class is tough with lots of homework but if you put in the effort you'll pass.

Had another professor for this class but I watched her lecture videos instead, got a 100 in this class. If you do the practice problems and go to her office hours to clear up your confusion, you'll do well.

reviews.comment: Best professor for Calc 2. She does everything in her ability to help you out. Has extended office hours and even answers questions over email. She teaches very well and it is understandable. Hands down best professor for calc I've had!
really nice professor and cares a lot about her students. hard class though and some of the tests are a bit unfair but she curves if need be. very fair professor
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Took it online. Great lecturer, honestly an easy class with all the extra credit

Chui's is the best calc 2 professor hands down. I'd definitely recommend the online course if you don't procrastinate. She provides a lot of extra credit opportunities (6-12% of the final grade). She's very accessible outside of class and really cares about her students.
Very good lectures. Do that and some practice problems, should be fine.

reviews.comment: Chui is amazing! Best calc 2 prof at UF. Take her if you can. She's very fair, and she writes the exams so sometimes she tells you about weird wording and stuff like that ahead of time.

Chui explains everything very clearly and writes out all the math as she's speaking in class so it's pretty easy to follow along. She's very helpful during office hours and explains specific problems in depth . She posts lots of practice exams. You definitely have to work for an A, but if you do all the homework and practice exams you'll be fine.

Doesn't understand that not everyone gets concepts on the first problem.

I took Chui over the summer and she was awesome! She was so nice and willing to help students through in-person and online office hours. Very sweet professor who does great with her lectures. If you ask for help, she'll make sure you understand something fully.

Dont miss classes, study through the now you trys and the exam reviews, and you wont have to use study edge.

reviews.comment: Great professor! she really cares about the class and gives out a lot of extra credit. Calc 2 can be pretty hard study edge helps a lottt.

Absolutely the sweetest professor I've ever had. She cares about students passing and will help in anyway possible. Gives lots of extra credit. I had her for a flipped section and it did have alot of homework but well worth it because I feel like I understood the material better than most of the regular calc students. She has amazing notes too.

Chui is a very caring and kind human being, and while I think people may easily take her gently personality for granted, for me it adds an inspirational element to the class. She wants you to succeed, and is good at answering questions both in and out of class during office hours. Her exams are reasonable and identical to material in class.
Great professor and willing to work with the students during office hours.

reviews.comment: She makes sure everyone gets the material. She's funny and very nice. She also gives a lot of extra credit; you just have to be willing to do it from the very start.

She's by far the best professor I've ever had. Really cares about students and is always willing to help. Her exams are fairly easy. No trick questions. very fair. If you do the homework and pay attention in class, it's an easy A.

Calc is tough but she is a great enthusiastic professor  and really wants her students to do well in her class and you can tell that she loves the material and teaching it. I have heard a few students changed their major to mathematics after taking this class. But again its calc so be ready to work. It is definitely  manageable tho. EC is offered

Honestly, if you studied hard and did well in Calc-1, then Calc-2 will seem much easier for you! While Calc-1 throws a lot of stuff at you, Calc2 is more focused, it has less homework (however still A LOT compared to other classes) and Chui was incredibly nice and helpful. Calc 2 IS NOT harder than Calc-1. In fact for me it was easier.

Dr. Chui is a beautiful person. She really cares about the student and wants you to do well. Calc 2 is known to be notoriously difficult, but put in the work and do the homework and you'll get through it. It's  not that bad and Chui makes it a lot less painful.

Chui is the BEST possible choice for Calc 2! She's very understanding and easy to talk to when you need help. Class material is difficult but lectures are excellent. Lots of homework and clicker questions in class. Exams were difficult but if you study and use office hours and practice tests you will be fine. Recommend having a strong study group

reviews.comment: Chui understands the intricacies of knowing how to teach. I would be more relieved for future classes if all professors taught like her.

If you have the option for Chui, take it!! She is by far one of the best teachers I've ever had! She is enthusiastic and tries to make the class as interesting as possible. Her lectures move fast, but are still easy to follow. There is also a lot of homework, but it is really helps with grasping the material, and its not unreasonable.
She's an amazing professor and she gives a ton of extra credit! Do well on the quizzes and get all your clicker point and you can make up for any losses on the exams!

reviews.comment: DEFINITELY MAKES YOU WORK FOR IT, BUT REALLY DOES CARE ABOUT YOUR GRADE.  THE WAY THE COURSE IS DESIGNED HELPS YOU SUCCEED- DOESNT LET YOU SLACK OFF.  BE PREPARED TO DO WORK EVERY SINGLE DAY FOR THIS CLASS, BUT THAT WORK WILL PAY OFF

reviews.comment: Chui was great. There is a lot of WebAssign homework but it prepares you well. She is much better than Mahoney (he subbed one day and was terrible). You must study to do well though as is expected.

As someone mentioned below, I really don't know what's up with all the Chui hype. I've never had such a difficult time in a class before. reviews.comment: Great lectures. She is the definition of a teacher. Cares about her students and knows how to teach the topic well. The class itself is really hard but she helps the students by giving a lot to extra credit.

Professor Chui is extremely good at teaching Calc 2, but this class is no walk in the park.  I did manage to scrape an A, but I was only over the margin by 1.5 points in a 400 point class.  Professor Chui is funny, kind, and endearing in person, but her exams can be brutal if you are not prepared.  Recommended, but don't slack off.

reviews.comment: Chui is a great professor. Calc 2 is not an easy class, and therefore takes a lot of practice at home. However, Chui does a great job at making it feasible and is super sweet.

Prof Chui is so knowledgeable and knows the ins and outs of Calc 2, but still knows how to simplify topics into basic english to be able to teach them to just about anyone. She has such a great personality  she's absolutely adorable and never fails to make her students laugh. Never skip class, lots of extra credit opportunities. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

I took Calc BC in highschool and then took this class. Even though Chui's class was harder than AP Calc, I still didn't have to struggle as much. As long as you watch the lectures online and review webassign questions, you'll do well.  Also, she's ready to help outside class.

Chui is one of the most caring professors I have ever had. She wants to make sure everybody understands what is happening and never goes too fast. She is very thoughtful in the way she posts plenty of additional problems online for help. Also, she's kind of funny sometimes which is nice.

Chui's class was fairly tough in my opinion. Lot of busy work through webassign, but I used Study Edge to help me get through this class. Chui's lectures were fine, the material itself is just difficult. My recommendation is to go to class still, but let Study Edge help you.

Chui is amazing, I would take her class again, it is a lot of work, but nothing impossible. Make sure you do as much practice problems as you can. Chui really cares about her students and you can tell she loves to teach this subject, you can't go wrong with that.

Chui is nice, and really knows her stuff, but the lectures can be hard to follow. It's easy to fall behind in this class, and the tests are very difficult. I managed to get an A, using Study Edge, which I found to be way more useful than the lectures.
Chui is an excellent teacher, but the material is fairly difficult. As long as you go to class and do well on the homework, one should easily pass this course.
I have few words for Dr. Chui's class. It is perfection. Don't even think about taking this class if you don't have Chui. Chui is love, Chui is life.

Chui is a great teacher but her tests are EXTREMELY hard. Even with her practice tests I found that I felt unprepared come test time. I would definitely recommend getting study edge, it simplified her class and helped me get an A!

As put by a many students Chui will "fail you with a smile." She's a short sweet woman who has a manageable accent and definitely is very knowledgeable in her field, but oh lord her tests are rough. The best way to study is to get study edge, because her practice tests were hit or miss for the exams.

I took AP calc AB in hs and passed and everyone told me to take Calc 1 here anyways but I am so glad I went straight to Calc 2.  It was a tough class and I spent a lot of time studying and doing hw.  Tests are difficult, I got a high C average on tests and ended up with an A-.  Do extra credit, every point counts.  Chui is always there to help.

She is really really nice and caring even though tests are insanely hard. Best calc 2 teacher but still hard. Lots of extra points available so you can still pass even if you do awful on the tests. Make sure to get those easy points from hw, quizzes, and clicker questions!

Fantastic teacher. You have to master the material. Just do it so you don't have to repeat the class and realize how easy it was . 3 exams. Don't believe the rumors. The first exam is the easiest. The second is the hardest. The third is alright. The final is difficult. Do the webassign on paper as you do them each week.

Chui is an angel  I loved being in her class and she really and truly makes it feel like even though you're one of 1000 kids that you're worth her attention.  I wont lie the course is very difficult and you need to work, but the lectures are engaging and she makes a scary weed out class enjoyable

Chui is always there when you need help. Don't be afraid to ask questions. She will do anything in her ability to help you. For example, she give out one  bonus homework for extra credit. If you put in the effort for the class, you will get the "A"

I'm happy that I had the chance to work with Chui! She is very helpful and character-driven during lectures and office hours and wants you to do well. LOTS of effort is required to get the desired grade, but her office hours were very beneficial. Had solid AB+BC scores coming in, didn't use StudyEdge and succeeded all thanks to her.

The course material is difficult. I took Calc AB in hs and was worried about skipping Calc 1. I'm happy I did. Requires a lot of work, but this professor is extremely caring and wants you to succeed. Someone else and I probably wouldn't have gotten the A. Her lectures were phenomenal.

The class in all honesty is very difficult.  I was failing behind and needed some help to bring my grade up.  She offered extra office hours to advise students like ourselves and give us advice on how to study for her exams and such.  It has been my hardest class at UF.  If you took AP calc AB I would not recommend skipping calc 1
Superhelpful.

She's helpful and interested in the subject. You think she's incredibly nice and caring up until the first exam, where she absolutely butchers you. Hardest tests I've ever taken. Every question has at least one trick to it, so you're not fine even if you know exactly how the math works. Incredibly hard class, but Chui is sweet and a good lecturer.

She is amazing, I had already taken calc 2 in high school but her teaching skills made calc 2 an easy refresher. The content isn't always easy but she utilizes her time efficiently and is completely prepared with sticky notes for the lectures and other helpful analogies.
Moves very quickly  Must show up
Chui knew what she was talking about. Very concerned for her students success and well-being.

To be honest i'm fairly disappointed with how easy this class was. Tests are much easier than homeworks and there are more bonus points in this class than you'll ever need. I was hoping for a challenging course that would push me to learn but instead all I got was a simple class that left me with an easy A and zero feelings of accomplishment.

She is one of the best calculus professors I've had. She explains the material very well,  where if you just follow her and whatever is going on in class ,you will do well. Pretty easy class overall with a quite nice, well-rounded,  and clear grading criteria as well.....

She really wants you to pass and is helpful in office hours. She ended up doing some of the homework problems for me. This being said, the class is decently difficult and takes some time if you're not already really smart.
Easy class and chui is good teacher. Her lecture so good you don't even need a textbook

I took AP Calc in hs so I already knew most material. Her lectures are pretty straight-forward, and she's actually pretty entertaining. Her exams were easy with lots of multiple choice and some EC; just do homework and pay attention to pass. There were points though where if I didn't know the stuff already, her explanations wouldn't have helped me.

She is the best teacher I have had in my life!! Her lecture is very clear and straightforward. She care all her students and want to see everyone succeed in the course. She puts so much of her efforts to her students and tries to remember everyone, even though, the class is huge. I love her and want to have her for all my Math classes.

Chui is such an enthusiastic teacher. She really wants to see everyone succeed and tries to engage the whole class.  The exams are pretty straightforward as long as you've been keeping up with the material! Just make sure you show up to class to get your clicker points

Chui is the best! Her lectures are very helpful, informative & clear & she is so cute.  She is VERY fair in regards to her class grade.  Her whole class is technically curved because she takes 80% of your grade for credit & she always has bonus questions on her exams, which are not hard btw.  If you go to class & discussion, you'll get an easy A!

Chui is a fantastic professor with a lot of energy and excitement.  Even though her classes are 300+ students, she truly cares about the success of each individual.  She gives extra credit all the time and makes sure she is available and can change her schedule to accommodate office hours or additional help for anyone who needs it.

She is an amazing teacher. I would definitely take her again. Go to her office hours and come with questions. She's always there to help you, she doesn't want to see any of her students fail. Professor Chui is also funny in her own way. Extra credit is given on every exam and by taking classself evaluations.
Talented teacher. Her lectures are enjoyable, but highly informative!

Chui is one of the best math teachers I have ever had. Calc 2 is not a walk in the park but she tries to make it as simple as possible. She is always available if you need help and has a lot of opportunities to go to office hours. She genuinely cares about her students and wants them to succeed.

Her lectures are clear, and she tries her best to help you understand the material. Best math teacher I've ever had. If you come to her office hours, she explains even more in-depth and is not very condescending. The exams are fair, but you really have to study for them to ace them. Lots of online homework. The website makes it tedious and hard.
Honestly, she is the best teacher I ever had. I love how she makes everything so clear. I've learnt so much with her.
She is the best math teacher I have had at UF. Really wants everyone to do well and understand everything. Her tests are very fair besides the final. If you put in the work you will get an A.
Her office hours are very helpful. She will stay after her alotted time if you really need the help. She was by far the best calc professor out of the math department.

Dr. Chui is extremely helpful. Her lectures are clear and focused. Homework, quiz, and exam problems are all similar. Her office hours were incredibly helpful, she structures them like a small classroom, which I found very beneficial. I would recommend her to anyone taking Calc 2 at UF.

Chui is nice, but she seems to be able to make simple concepts very confusing and convoluted. I find her reviews for tests to be only marginally helpful. If you make a simple mistake on the free response portion of her tests, prepare to have some points taken; not much in the way of 'carry error forward' grading. Other than these, she's not too bad

VERY helpful.  She explains things very simply, and will go over anything multiple times so that you understand it.  The exams are half MC/half FR. I found the MC to be a bit tricky at times but she ALWAYS gives similar problems in class, not only that, but she gives tons of chances for extra credit.  I definitely recommend her

Chui may be a sweet lady, but I find her tests to be somewhat random, and the practice problems do not exactly follow what tends to be on the exams. Also, it's easy to mess your grade up over minor mistakes on the exams; there is very little partial credit awarded. Not too difficult if you are good at math, but it could definitely be easier.
Calculus Two is very tough but Chui makes it about as easy as she can.

Chui is literally the best. She doesn't have much of an accent, is very concise, and makes calculus simpler. I would even say she makes calculus fun; she tells jokes all the time in class. She genuinely cares for her students and is very kind and friendly.
Awesome Calc 2 teacher. Explains everything clearly.
Awesome teacher! The class can be difficult, but she provides lots of opportunities to help you succeed, especially extra credit! Just go to class and do the homework and you'll do fine.
Excellent. Easy class and great teacher.

Great teacher and lecturer. Calc  2 is no cakewalk but she makes it interesting and understandable most of the time. The exams are very fair in regards to MC questions but the free response is graded leniently or not depending on your TA. In the end you get what you put out in this class.

She is an excellent lecturer, but as a lecture style class goes, the exams are difficult and are designed in a way that you can't get many questions wrong for an A. Small amount of extra credit on each exam. Happy to have had her as a teacher

The class is really hard no doubt, but Chui does her best to make you successful. Her lectures are great, because she has a way to keep her students interested. She's always available in her office hours and have where she work more problems.

Very helpful outside of class, very patient and always makes sure you understand the material. She tries to help you in any way you can and makes calc as easy as it could be with her fantastic lectures. definitely recommend her
She is a very sweet lady, and she teaches well. She is motherly. If you have any questions, she'll answer them with a smile. I thought she was really good at teaching. There is extra credit also.
Very helpful! Its better if you attend her lectures and get help during office hours. The material is hard but manageable through practice and homework. Definitely recommend her.
Chui is very helpful and clear.  Her exams are usually straightforward, and she almost always says what is on it.

I was glad that I switched out of Keeran - Chui's a great professor who jokes and the lecture notes that you can printout/buy are helpful. If you are familiar with the material then just look@ notes,if not I suggest doing some book problems and look@ webassign and you should be fine.Final exam (was a bit on the diff side but youll be okay)> exam123

I thought she was a great teacher! She always was super interested in making sure everyone understood the material despite the fact that the class was so large. I definitely recommend her. She explains things very well, but the online HW is hard.

Chui knows her stuff, and she is very thorough with her lectures. If you understand the online homework you will pass her tests without a sweat. Take her class you will love her! She would be the greatest Grandmother.
Pretty good teacher. Made Calc 2 bearable.  Much better than it could have been.
She's an awesome teacher. Come to class, do the webassign, and you'll understand the material perfectly.

Very helpful! She explains everything very clear and gives you many opportunities to get help, whether through office hours or at the local teaching center. Her questions are rather difficult, but through studying and tutoring, an A is definitely possible.

TAKE HER CLASS! Any type of evaluation problem comes straight from the lecture or the homework. She makes the subject interesting and grades leniently. You'll hear Calc 2 is a nightmare, but don't expect this at all if she's your professor.

When I started this class, I was really unsure about the grade I would be receiving. I honestly hoped I would even get a C. I made an A. This is coming from someone who dropped Mac1147 the previous semester. Keys to doing well: study, do HER reviews (tutoring zone actually didn't help as much, if at all, like hers did), go to class,study w/ friends

Class was easy. Exams were easy. Usually got 100% on the Multiple choice exams, but the free response questions brings down the overall exam grade...but only by a little bit. She gives a lot of extra credit and drops a lot of quizzes and online hw. She is nice and helpful. Easy class!

Prof Chui does a good job explaining the material in lecture, however the exams are much harder than the homework and review material. A lot of studying and hard work is required to be successful in this class, as the discussion sessions are not too helpful (some TAs are hard to understand, in terms of communication that is).

Ms. Chui was supposedly my professor, but she never actually taught my class; the TA taught every single class of the semester. The TA was okay, but kind of hard to understand. I heard that Chui was a good professor and I was excited to have her, but I never saw her once! I probably could have gotten an A in this class if she had been there!

There is no doubt that Chui is nice. Its absolutely essential to print out the notes and go to every class. There is an attendance quiz every day. Class covers too much material too quickly; a section in the text a day. She doesn't explain the topics that great and often elicits exclamations of confusion. Its been described as a weeding-out class.

If you are a decent math student, then this class will be easy for you.  The tests are pretty easy. She collects all of your HW right before tests so that can help your grade too. There are also weekly quizzes in your TA section but your TA will review everything right before.  I would reccommend this class!

I LOVE CHUI! She is hilarious. She used to just end class if we told her it was time (even if it wasnt). If you go to her she will really help you. I would recommend her over the other MAC teachers,  And go to class for the pop quizzes..chui doesnt object to "helping" each other on the quizzes
Chui has a unique sense of humor...  it's very subtle, but if you pay attention to her, she's hilarious!
