reviews.comment: Good professor, but i dont recomend him for EVR2001. The class was oddly difficult for an online 2000-level class. The quiz questions were based on tiny details mentioned once in one of the 11 lecture videos for the module. He probably is a great professor for in-person lectures, but I don't recommend him for this class specifically.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Coenen is knowledgeable and entertaining. I definitely agree that his exam questions being very niche and specific. It's great that he allows you a one-pager, but it ends up being not super helpful as his super specific questions tend to account for that. If you're used to exams that ask about the big picture concepts, you're going to struggle.

Very knowledgeable professor! He is always willing to help and responsive. The textbook is not required; some online videos; attendance is really a must. The exam questions are overly specific and papers can be difficult. Overall, a helpful class!

Took environmental science online, each week had a reading, lecture videos, and assignment.  Content was clear and lectures were engaging and relevant.  Quizzes a tad difficult, but nothing crazy and you could use a cheat sheet for them all.  Take it online, though, if you have the choice.

This was an online class but I still feel I got to know the professor well as he always answers his emails and is super accessible via office hours. He gives lots of EC. Know your APA 7. If you follow rubrics for all of the writing assignments, it is easy to get an A. Textbook assignments I just skimmed, not quizzed on.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Caring professor with clear grading. Expect a heavy workload: 12 Playposits, 12 textbook annotations, 6 quizzes (drop one), 2 projects, and 3 reflections. Assignments are time-consuming and graded harshly. Offers about 30+ points of EC. Know APA 7. Quizzes can be random—study the PlayPosits religiously as he never asks anything from the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Kind professor. Reflection assignments are very easy to get 100s on, and extra credit is easy to complete fast. If you are unfamiliar with APA citations, this course does a great job helping you. Only thing is exam questions are a bit unpredictable. I reccomend watching each video and reading each chapter repeatedly before taking the exam.

It is clear Dr. Coenen is passionate about environmental science. The course content was very interesting and enjoyable to learn about. Weekly lectures and reflections that are manageable. 3 exams + optional final; all easy if you review the lectures (especially obscure topics as he tends to quiz on little facts mentioned). Plenty of EC

I don't recommend EVS3500. There's way less material than EVS3000 and I don't feel like I got out of it what I should've. There's a literature review paper that's graded extremely harshly from the start. Don't approach the topic proposal like you would for other classes—they will nitpick. The exams also had a lot of unreasonable questions imo.

Definitely passionate about environmental science and wants to interact with students. 2 or 3 written assignments, a group project, and 3 exams. You can make your own 1-sided 'cheat sheet' to use on each exam, and exams are not cumulative. I was able to study only the day before and get As. Go to class (required), you'll fall behind if not.

Make sure to brush up on APA citation skills. This is vital. The tests may not be like the study guide. Thus, you should take every note from the lectures study accordingly. There are so many extra credit opportunities which I didn't even need to use.

Dr. Coenen has a passion for teaching & good teaching methods, but dang, gives a ton of assignments, mostly easy but some are time-consuming & can't be completed last minute. Good news--he offers lots of extra-credit opportunities to boost your grade. Of all the required general ed intro-science courses, take this one for best chance to grade well.

He's really a good teacher and cares about his students. You should study for the exams because they matter but it's not too hard to get a good grade. You get three free absences and the longer class counts for double attendance. The TA we had was a tough grader but most assignments are easy.

Easy gen-ed online class. You can tell through online lectures that he's interested in the topic. Most of the reflection assignments are graded by the TAs. Tests can make or break your grade. He offers a lot of extra credit, gives study guide, offers cheat sheets for tests. Compared to the other GE science options, this one is the best.

This class is a great Gen ED class. The grading is very lenient and straightforward. Just learn how to write in APA (very easy) and you'll be set. The tests aren't bad, just pay attention to the lectures. There is a bunch of extra credit on the test and he gives extra points and removes most missed questions on the exams to boost our grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The subject matter is very interesting, but if you are looking to take a class that you don't need to pay much attention to, I wouldn't recommend EVR2001. If you can afford to put time into it though, I 100% recommend! The exams can be tough but with extra credit I made it out with an 100.38. Also, there are short essays due every week.

A lot of work for a Gen Ed, but if you keep up, you should be fine. Barely touched the textbook and exams are based on specific points from lecture, so I got best test scores from marathoning lectures right before I took the test. Dr. Coenen was very kind and gave extra credit, but definitely not a free A. Allows you to have page of notes on exams!

If you took AP Enviro this course is an easy A especially since you are allowed one page of notes on exams. Exams can have a few weirdly specific questions but I never got below a 90% and I studied the morning of the exam. Class could be a little work heavy at times and TA's grade weirdly but assignments were interesting at least.
Dr. Coenen was a great professor. He cares about his students and wants only what is best for them. He does make the course difficult. You have to earn your grade; it is not handed to you.
Awful Class. A few lectures each week with interactive questions; 400 words discussion twice per week; one hour reading each week, and all of them are just for a general education course
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: He taught pretty well and seemed passionate about what he was talking about. The online class is extremely well organized and the grades were pretty well graded. I think the exams ask a lot of things we only hear in class and are not on the slides, so be careful of that. Besides this, awesome teacher.
His exams are very specific to details and does not reflect the topics learned in class. no access to right answers on past exams so you never know what you got wrong.

Dont take this course. It is not an easy A! Never taken an introduction course that required so much content and assignments. This course is extremely difficult. Need new TAs, mine was passive aggressive. I dont feel confident in my writing anymore. They take APA formatting very serious. I see myself spending more time on this class than my others
Took this online. Lowkey tough grading but depends on your TA. There are a lot of random essays and discussion posts so it is a lot of writing.

I would 100% recommend this class! Very organized, 100% online, and you're allowed 1 page of notes for every exam. Consists of module prep assignments, discussion posts, and 3 exams. Lots of opportunity for extra credit and the topics were really interesting to learn about! If you skim over textbook and watch the lecture videos you should be good!

Took this class thinking it would be an easy A as it is for GEN ED CREDIT but I was mistaken I ended psychology with an A and this with a B. The TA I had was a harsh grader and quizzes were not the easiest for me. I would only take if you are interested but definitely not an easy class.

It is not an easy A class by any means, there is a weekly chapter preparation homework plus a discussion post and they both tend to take a lot of time. His quizzes and exams are quite difficult too and go into details. Overall, he is a good professor but requires a lot for a class that is supposed to be an introductory class.

solid class and very sweet and helpful professor. grading was clear and not too harsh. lots of writing and was a bit time-consuming, but nothing crazy. Dr. Coenen gives lots of extra credit opportunities which was nice too
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Coenen is a great professor with really interesting lectures. Assignments arent anything crazy. Its quite a bit of writing for a course with no word requirement. Tests are easy if you do the study guide. Theres one big paper at the end but it wasnt graded harshly. Hardly touched the textbook, just watch the lectures and youll be fine.

Solid class if you are looking for an easy Gen Ed credit. Each week consists of a 500 word module prep assignment and a 300 word discussion with 2 replies. Nothing crazy, quizzes are a bit hard because they are only 11 questions but overall a decent class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: If you're not into science and need a credit, I 100% recommend taking EVR2001 online with Dr. Coenen. His exams are non cumulative and relatively easy if you watch the lectures and take notes. Same with the quizzes. He gives A LOT of extra credit at the end of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Coenen was always really enthusiastic about the material, and his lectures were really informational. He teaches you about steps you can take to reduce your footprint, and the class in general was really insightful. All of the material on exams and quizzes is covered in the lectures, and theres two pretty easy assignments due each week.

Watched his recorded videos and had weekly assignments. The assignments were tedious but easy. I didn't enjoy the class just because the topic wasn't explained in an interesting way. I dreaded how long the videos were, and he often tested on small details from external youtube videos. Easy A as long as you put in effort, but boring.

Grades based on 5 quizzes (he drops the lowest score), 3 exams, 1 essay, 10 discussion boards, and 10 other mini assignments. Easy quizzes/exams, make sure you review lectures. Discussion boards and the mini assignments are easy but they can pile up so make sure you are on track. Professor is passionate and willing to help you. Loved this class!

I really enjoyed the way Dr. Coenen presented his lectures, and his voice is really soothing. You can tell that he's passionate about the subject. The expectations for assignments are straightforward and explained in the rubric. I didn't find him or the TA's to be particularly harsh graders if you paid attention to what they were asking for.

Great professor and very passionate about this field. Lecture attendance is mandatory. Take lots of notes and you'll be 100% fine on the exams. Study guides are given before each test and reflect 90% of the questions that will be on the exam. Highly recommend to anyone who needs a biological/physical science gen ed.

Professor Conenen is very passionate about science. 500 word essays for homework each week but relatively easy. Study guides before tests which cover exactly what is on test. Lots of extra credit throughout the year to raise your grade a lot. The grade is based on homework assignments, two major essays, and two exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Nice professor... easy class... good class
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Danny Coenen is a great professor. He knows what he's talking about and he's passionate. Too passionate, actually, because he had the tendency to make the lectures in class boring and long-winded, but he did give a TON of useful info, both for the class material and real life. That's why I wouldn't take the class again, but others definitely should

Course: Pros - Easy class, easy quizzes, easy exams, very informative presentations Cons - Weekly essay-style homework (400-500 words), 2 major essays (800+ words) Professor: Pros - Good presenter, funny, very knowledgeable, passionate Cons - Grades some assignments such as the international presentation harder than one would expect

He is a great lecturer, speaks clearly, no ums etc.. The material is a lot to do with climate change and science of environment, so can be boring if you're not into it. Weekly papers, two tests 4 quizzes, and like 4 big essays, so heavyish load, but easily graded. They are so nice and you will have a fun time laughing in class. Great science credit

Probably the best professor I've had at UF. Dr. Coenen is knowledgeable about environmental science and his lectures always included anecdotes that I found super interesting. I genuinely looked forward to going to his class! You need to work hard for a good grade, but you are able to pick your own topic for the big research paper.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He's funny and nice and the workload is pretty light and easy to do.

I understand wanting to have a vast array of topics to go over, but Coenen made it so that anything he had on PowerPoints (which is what we went over every class with a lecture), or anything that he said was fair game for a test or pop quiz. Tests are extremely specific and I bombed all of them. Essays are easy, and there are pop quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I hated this class so much. I wouldn't personally blame it on Professor Coenen, but please do yourself a favor and do not take this course unless it is absolutely mandatory for your major!

Professor Coenen is an interesting and kind guy full of knowledge. His lectures can be quiet information heavy, but you can tell the man is passionate about the topic. You will have to do several time taking assignments, but the work isn't difficult. As long as you engage in the lecture and ask questions, the class can be fun.

Took this to fill a missing transfer credit. Mistake. I'm a junior and struggling with a 2000 level class. Quizzes and exams are very specific and difficult. Make sure to do the weekly assignments. I wouldn't take this class unless absolutely required.
He's so funny and nice and makes it very clear what is expected of us. His tests are not too challenging.

Dr. Coenen gave awesome lectures. He puts his notes online and does a good job of emphasizing the points he will be testing you on. The tests are hard but if you study you should get a decent grade. The hardest part of this class are the papers, I strongly recommend you do them ahead of time and get feedback from him or the TA.

There definitely is a ton of writing in this class (it really should count for words), and the tests are very difficult. However, Dr. Coenen is a nice person who cares about his students, and there are a lot of opportunities for points in the class. If you work hard and are interested in environmental science, you'll do fine in the class.

In this class, you have weekly assignments along with 4 essays in the semester. There are also 2 quizzes, 1 project, 2 exams and 1 final essay. Make sure to do well on the weekly assignments because the grades add up.  Very tough grader, sometimes unclear on instructions.  Attend class because you earn points and its a free 100. Only take it if req

Weekly homework along with 4 2-pg essays (not too bad). Instructions aren't always clear and grades as if you should all follow one particular model. He would grade harshly on OPINION based assignments. There is also a group project which actually boosts your grade and you get points for attendance which helps. Only take as a state core requirement

Best professor I've met on campus yet. The class is not easy, but he is extreamly helpful. In class lectures, activities, group projects, online lectures, writing papers and tests are all used. You write apa format, and he will help and prepare you to turn in a perfect paper.  Take notes! Tests are tricky so read the book and review his slides.
Really good! Kind, easy, and interesting!
He was a very real professor. I loved the way he addressed students via email. I love how human he presented himself as.

Tremendously easy class! I would highly recommend this as a psych elective. A very easy discussion, easy writing prompt (a paragraph), and a quiz with answers online everywhere each week. No final at all! Lectures interesting, making the class as interesting as it can be online. Loved the professor.
Best teacher ever. His teaching style could singlehandedly fix our education system honestly lol. Take his class, you'll learn so much and you wont regret it.

Social psych with Dr. Smith is the easiest thing ever. Just discussions, short writing prompts, and quizzes. The textbook is necessary but you can find it for free online. Never had to watch lectures and finished all the work each week in a matter of two days. He's also the nicest and coolest prof I've had! You won't regret taking his class

This was SUCH an easy class to take as an elective. No tests and quizzes are only timed (answers are accessible online). Textbook reading is required for some assignments, but you don't need to read everything unless you're interested. Never watched the lectures either. Take this class y'all.. I wish more classes were like this one.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Respected

reviews.comment: The only prof I've had so far that truly made learning the material as easy and straightforward as possible. If you need a psych elective or just really enjoy social psych, 100% recommend

Dr. Smith is the best of the best. If you want a great upper-level psych elective, this is your course/man. I wish all of my psych courses were taught by him. One pretest (easy), discussion (easy), a writing prompt (easy), quiz (easy) per mod for 13 mods. This guy is a gem! Take him and you will not regret it, he is one of the best at UF. PERIOD!!!

Dr. Smith is one of the best professors I've had at UF. His class was extremely straightforward. If you read the lecture slides before exams you'll easily get an A. His grading is very fair and he truly wants to see you succeed. He gives great feedback and extra credit. His lectures were very engaging. If I could take it again I would.

Dr. Smith is a great professor who cares about his students. The exams weren't very difficult, but you did need to study the lectures' content well (there is no textbook). The readings and lectures were interesting. Papers were fun and easy. I loved the class and would highly recommend taking any course with Dr. Smith! If you can, take this class!

Amazing professor and has great online lectures. One of the most respectable professors I've encountered, and really glad I took this class. This quizzes are hard if you studied, just make sure you watch his lectures and read at least a little bit of the book

Great professor! He genuinely cares about the needs and well-being of his students. The material is also pretty easy to understand, some people didn't need to read the textbook a lot because he covers a lot of material during his lectures.
Amazing prof and great video lectures, always watch the lectures do not just read the book. But amazing and kind prof and so glad I took this class

Professor Smith is phenomenal, despite the online course setup. He genuinely cares about his students and sets up the course to encourage that you are learning the content. Lectures are interesting and easy to understand and they never total more than 45 minutes per week. Easy and fun assignments and super nice TAs. Overall, great course! 10000/10
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: What an amazing man!! He really is a gem. Very funny and sweet. The lectures can be somewhat boring, but he makes them fun and engaging. He is a very easy grader; if you do the work, you'll get an A. The exams can be somewhat confusing (some answer choices can be very similar) but they aren't too bad. Would definitely recommend this professor!!!!

Super adorable/funny professor! Great lecturer knows his stuff really well, grades are mainly small writing assignments, group project, and tests. Doesn't require a textbook and attendance isn't mandatory but tests are based on lectures/assigned article readings. He made the content really enjoyable and was always willing to answer any questions.

Dr. Smith is awesome. He's an absolute sweetheart and really tries his best to do well by his students. His lectures can drag on a little, but he is hands-down the best professor I've had at UF simply because he cares so much about his materials, students, and research.
average class. kind of hard. Pay attention in class and take as many notes as possible
When asking questions for midterm review he told the lecture to google it because he did not know...

He was an amazing professor.  His powerpoints were interesting and had cutefunny pictures or comics.  He was very interesting to listen to and could be funny.  Attendance was not mandatory, but since we didn't really use the textbook, it was helpful to attend class since it made his powerpoints more clear. Only 4 tests, weekly online hw, no final.
Just an all around good guy and a good teacher. You can tell he is very smart and cares about his students.

I really enjoyed this class. Dr. Smith is really funny and that's my favorite part about the class! Interesting material and in my opinion it's worth it to go to class, because he helps you learn it but it's not really required to go if you read the book on your own. He makes his lecture slides himself with funny or cute pictures. 100% recommend!

This is a smaller lecture class that is actually interesting and held my attention.  His lectures were informative and he showed a lot of videos that were relevant.  He was clear about how he graded everything.  He was a very funny professor and very approachable if you needed to talk to him about anything. 1010 would recommend.
He grades strictly and expects a high level of writing. However, he allows revisions until the end of the semester. Just don't do it.

i think he is a very tough grader when it comes to the papers but he is very easy to reach if you want better critcs because he will be very nic picking but not explain it in the notes. If you pace yourself in this class you will be fine. Also, you can always ask for resubmitting major papers until the end of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor. Very smart. If you try at all in this class you will do well.

He grades every paper like it's a doctoral-level thesis. He marked me down because I used words that were linguistically and grammatically correct, but different from the words he would have used. He does allow resubmissions if you make corrections based on his feedback, but be prepared for multiple rounds of corrections. Avoid him if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I would disregard the other ratings. You definitely have to put in work in his course to get an A, but it is not anything crazy. I dedicated a reasonable amount of time a week to this course and ended up getting a 99. Communicate with him consistently throughout the semester because he is very responsive and provides stellar feedback.
DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH HIM!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He seemed like a nice person but he's such an annoying grader. Took points off for literally anything. For a gen-ed or "freshman-level" class this was definitely one of the hardest and time consuming courses I've taken and his feedback was useless. I definitely had to put in A LOT of hard work to get an A. Take this course in-person and AVOID HIM.

Graded me 0s on everything, would not reply to any emails on why. Made racial remarks on my ability to speak English, only graded my work poorly with no rzn. Did not reply to any emails, told me my work was terrible. 
gave me no feedback, I compared my work to others and it was day and night.

Switched to an online class where I got graded all As.
Very interesting and relevant material. Heavy focus on implications. Very fair grading.

Dr. Conklin teaches dynamics in a clear and organized way. He breaks all problems into 7 easy steps, which made challenging topics easier to understand and apply on exams/hw. His lectures were engaging and well structured, and he was always helpful during office hours. He genuinely cares about his students, is the best professor I've had at UF.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Conklin is so great for dynamics I wish I could take him for another class. His exams are very fair and was very open to giving points back if any issues were brought to him. He makes the content digestible and easy to follow. He gives you access to past recorded lectures and has one big homework every two weeks or so. Overall amazing professor
Really wholesome guy that has genuine care for student success and understanding of material. Great lectures, long homework assignments, moderate difficulty

There is a textbook but it is available online. You are graded on 2 quizzes (basically exams), 6 homework assignments, and a final exam. The homework is long but is 2-3 times a month and graded VERY leniently (i should have like a low C if graded by correctness but my hw avg is a 91 right now). He goes over what is on exams, doesn't try to trick u

His lectures are very straightforward and he is extremely transparent about what will be expected  on exams. His is very approachable to ask questions and he does some of the homework problems in office hours!

By far the easiest class I've taken under MAE. Conklin makes it super simple through his lectures and universal problem solving process. There were a few quirks in the homework that weren't fully explained but once you get it it's pretty simple. One thing I will say is that the homework tends to be harder and more tedious than the quizzes.

Legend. I would go to class and have no idea what was going on, and then pull an all nighter 2 days before, watch all the lectures and get a 97 on the exam.
The homework can be turned in late, I always did. 
Certified legend, best professor I've had here.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: A quality professor that genuinely cares about the students... a rare occurrence in the MAE dept. Straightforward exams but very time consuming homework.

This guy is honestly amazing, best course I have ever taken at UF. He explains everything incredibly well and the exams feel easy as long as you pay attention and do the HW. No other dynamics teachers make the course as simple as he does, take this class with him at all costs. Be sure to budget enough time to do the HW though lol

Dr. Conklin is one of the best professors I've had. His lectures are very well put together and he teaches them the exact same every year. So he has them all pre recorded so you can watch them if you have to miss. The majority of the class attends even though its not required and I think that says alot about how great of a professor he is.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easily the best lecturer I've ever had. Your grade comes from a handful of homeworks and a few exams. He never tries to trick you and gives you the resources you need to succeed

The best professor I've ever had at UF. Such a genuine guy who just wants to make sure you know the material. The exams are just like homework or class example problems. He spends a lot of time in class deriving equations which can get pretty boring, but he explains everything very clearly and makes the class bearable.
Probably one of the best professors at Florida. Great lectures and straightforward exams.
Great professor, unproblematic, caring and his lectures are structured well.
Amazing professor! Really loved the class & his lectures. He really cared about the class and was always ready to help with questions. The homework is a lot harder than the quizzes.

TAKE CONKLIN FOR DYNAMICS! He is kind, and his lectures are very clear and thorough. Amazing office hours, and gives good feedback. All lectures are prerecorded, so you don't have to attend class unless you want to, and you can go at your own pace. I learned so much in this class, and thoroughly enjoyed having him as a prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: His lectures are super clear and concise and allow students to easily understand and learn dynamics

Conklin is really a phenomenal professor. I took him for dynamics, which had some difficult concepts and topics, but his lectures made it all extremely clear and doable. Additionally, he had clear expectations for homeworks and quizzes, and ensured that both were never harder than they needed to be. Always had the students' best interests at heart.
Definitely underrated , best Dynamics prof at UF. Every semester I check what classes Conklin is teaching to see if I can have him again.

One of the best professors. Super great in every way. The only thing I didn't approve of was the final exam he gave us. I got A's on all the other exams, and probably a 50% on the final. The final was much much more difficult than any of the other exams and we had very little exposure to material as difficult as the final. C'mon Conklin.
Very underrated for Dynamics. Would totally recommend.

Great professor. I could not imagine a better lecturer in the subject. His lectures prepare you for the homework, his homework prepares you for the exam. He is also a very caring professor who wants you to learn and succeed.
Awesome guy. Super reasonable. Fantastic teacher. One of the best at UF without a doubt.

(During the lockdown of Fall 2020) Dr. Conklin made Dynamics suuuuper easy, especially compared to the other professors. He'll also give homework extensions out like candy if you actually need them. His grading setup is great, and his quizzes are insanely easy us you understand 75% of the homework. Would completely recommend.
He's such an angel and legitimately cares for the well being and success of his students. Definitely one of the best professors at UF.

He gives great lectures as long as you pay attention and try to follow along. If you actually try on the homework then you should have no problem with the quizzes and exams. The homework questions really test your abilities, but quiz and exam questions are nowhere near their difficulty. I really enjoyed his lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Conklin is one of the most brilliant professors I've had. It is a real gift to be able to explain such hard concepts in a way that gets so many people to understand. Overall, his exams are pretty straightforward as long as you understand the homework. The homeworks can be kinda long, but thats just the nature of the types of problems we are solving

Conklin is one of the best professors at UF. His lectures are a little bit dull, but they get the information across and he tries to make a dry subject entertaining. His tests are technically on the material covered, but they always have an element of critical thinking, so take that for what you will. He is so helpful and office hours are great.

Dr. Conklin really cares about his students being successful. He is a great teacher and very clear in his examples. The Homework is MUCH harder than the exams. If you work hard on the homework, and really try to understand the material (TA Office Hours!), you will do very well in the class. His exams are VERY reasonable if you study hard. No tricks

A great lecturer who actually wants his students to understand the material. He covers the material slowly and does lots of example problems. My only critique for him is that he gives a lot of homework, in which one problem takes about an hour to figure out and finish. If you can master the homework (he doesn't give out solutions), you're golden.

Judy was always willing to interact with her students to make their day better as well as making class fun. I feel like I learned so much while having fun and enjoying the class. Not too hard, just a short discussion post before each class on a reading and then a few projects/assignments that aren't too hard. Would highly recommend.
Judy is a hoot! Like jumbo shrimp! Awesome readings and some big beautiful books!

Ms Judy is funny and easy to connect to! She's so funny n makes you want to go to class. The readings she assigns are so intriguing n good. Only abt 3 papers(none over1000), other grades come from discussion posts, where all she wants is to see your reaction to whatever the reading was. If you have the opportunity to take a class w her, take it!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Judy is the best! She supports everyone throughout the entire semester, and you will never worry about getting behind or being confused. Just dedicate a few minutes to reading before class and the discussion post, and the rest is guided by her. She makes sure to assign work that is doable and will not overload you. I enjoyed class every day!

Judy is absolutely amazing, made me actually want to go to class. While some of the novels are confusing, everything makes sense by the end in terms of the course's overarching ideas. She also helped me learn to actually write college level papers and was always there to support me in any way I needed. Would heavily recommend :)

Judy is the best teacher I had this semester! She is so kind and funny and you can tell she really cares about her students.  She provides a good mix of reading material (poetry, novels, graphic novels) for class so you don't get burned out.  Even though this class is fun and laid back you still learn a lot! 10/10 would take again

Live, laugh, love Judy! Super caring and funny, classes are super fun and also extremely interesting. Judy cares about what she teaches and it shows. There's a daily reading assignment and discussion post, it's not that difficult as long as you get it done before class and follow the instructions. Take this class with Judy, you won't regret it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Hilarious

reviews.comment: You can tell she really cares about her students and even though there is lots of reading (given its a literature class) she makes participating in class really easy. I am a more reserved person but she makes me feel comfortable enough to speak up in class discussions quite often. She is also very real definitely take any class possible with her.

Judy cares deeply about her student's well-being and wants all of her students to have a deep understanding of the course content. The required texts were very interesting, and the syllabus was very well structured. There is a decent amount of reading but nothing unmanageable. If you have to take AML2070 take her!

Honestly love this teacher. She is on the younger side but that makes her more interesting and real. This class is really interesting and I liked it a lot. You will read but its a mix of poems, short stories, and books so if you don't like one thing you will like another. Def would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I cannot believe that she is able to represent FYCS, much less the University of Florida with the way she treats students. She made me question my major and my purpose at UF.

Ms. Tisby was always accessible outside of class and never hesitated to answer any questions I had about any assignment. All her assignments have clear instructions in the rubric. As long as you complete all the assignments on time and participate during lecture, you will do well in the class. The feedback from the mock interview helped a lot!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Tisby was one of the best teachers I had at UF. She is nothing but caring and wants all of her students to succeed. All of the assignments fully prepared me for practicum and future professional interviews. Be prepared to engage and learn about essential topics that you will use for the rest of your life in whatever career you pursue.

Tisby didn't seem to have a clear set of standards for assignments and graded in contrast with the rubric. Spent the semester on a mock interview and completing resumes. Didn't mention final assignments (30% of grade) until the last few weeks. Most assignments were fairly simply. Strict on deadlines. I did not gain what I hoped to from the course

Absolute sweetheart of a professor! The man LOVES to teach! Even after 40+ years of lecturing experience, it's awesome to see that he is still so passionate about the material to this very day. Make sure to watch the lecture videos to really understand how everything is derived. Exams can be a bit tricky but he gives you plenty of resources for it.

Easily the worst class I've taken. Instructions are vague on homework, rubrics are inconsistent, and the grading is excessively harsh. Save yourself the stress, this course is not worth risking your GPA

Dr. Crane is a great professor and super helpful during office hours. The class is challenging and does require a good amount of effort. The TAs are also super helpful, but take forever to grade. He's probably the best prof for this class.
Bro is lit

This professor is awesome and super understanding. He's always available if you need help and really wants his class to be your favorite at UF. The workload is super manageable, just one assignment a week. A small part of the grade is passing the SolidWorks certification. Definitely take him for EML2023 over other professors—you won't regret it!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Crane is absolutely amazing. You can tell he is really passionate about what he teaches, which carries over into the lecture videos he makes. Since I had never used a CAD system before, I sent him a lot of questions throughout the semester. He always answered so quickly and was very helpful. Study past GDT quizzes and CSWA exam questions!

This is a solid works class so get ready to learn how to read blue prints of things and make it 3d. Teacher is good and with his teaching assistants help students do their work. There isn't a final but need to pass the solid-works exam. The only thing I didn't like was the GDT assignments cause I didn't understood. Watch videos and do assignments.

Super nice guy and makes the class really easy. The homework assignments really help you to learn the software and he's super helpful in helping you learn the material. Also super accessible outside of class and will get back to you really quick.

Does an excellent job of teaching solidworks, especially if you have previous CAD experience, the first 3/4 of the class are very easy. GDT at the end is difficult, but the quiz mirrored the practice. Crane is super responsive and always offers help on homework, overall a great professor.

It's a reversed classroom, but it makes sense once you get used to it. Clear schedule is nice. The SW certification test is one thing you have to worry about. Definitely pay attention throughout the first half of the course and learn how to use SW so you dont have to go back. GDT quiz on last day is important for grade, but he does practice for it
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: As long as you do the homework and watch the lectures before class, you will be fine. He is also very accessible to help on the homework.

The GDT exam for this class is very heavily weighted so prepare a ton. However, the professor is very knowledgable and caring. Based on what I have heard he is better than Kumar and much much much better than Rubiano. Overall not too hard to do good, just watch all videos and study, it is a reverse classroom.

Crane is very nice and understanding as long as you show that you care about the class. The homework and GDT quiz are worth a lot of points so make sure to do your best on those, and go to office hours so he can help point out little mistakes in your work if you aren't sure.

Dr. Crane teaches Solidworks very well and prepares you for the certification exam; however, after the certification exam the class goes from a 1 to a 5 in difficulty. The homework assignments are pretty hard and time consuming. Then the final part of the class (GDT) isn't taught super well and the quiz at the end is difficult but doable.

It's ridiculous how much your grade can change in the last week of this class. You can be solid with CAD and pass the CSWA exam, but do poorly on the GDT quiz and watch your grade fall from an A in the last week of the class. The last homework assignments are also very difficult and your grade depends on how nice the TA grading your assignment is.

Professor Crane is a very chill teacher and he really enjoys what he does. He is extremely smart and loves to try and explain upper-level concepts to his students. He doesn't have a lot of homework (for this class specifically) and grades pretty easily. An overall cool and funny guy.

An easy class, but he is just not a great prof. He doesn't explain stuff well, and closer to the end of the semester, it felt like he gave up on the teaching. Rude, angry, and not interesting. A class has the potential to be fun but just isn't. You can take him, you won't suffer, just won't enjoy the time.

He was very irritable in class and often embarrassed students in front of everyone. He was very harsh with grading and stopped sending out the rubrics. Emailing him is useless because he never responds. Once he said that he would rather do anything else on a Friday besides teach us. He was a complete different person from what I heard. Awful man.

This class started off super interesting and easy but by the end of the semester, Dr. Crane lost his will to teach and was in a terrible mood 99% of the time. I will say, he did admit once he should have been nicer, but the rest was just completely unnecessary attitude. Also, be aware of the final project and GDT assignments.

absolutely terrible human being. Did I pass the cert exam, sure, but hes still a POS. this semester, he was incredibly condescending to everyone and embarrassed people in front of the entire class. He also formally accused almost 15% of his 120 student class of plagiarism for HW assignments. Hes also very boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Awesome class! Everything is easy as long as you watch recorded lectures and go to class to practice and ask him questions. Once you get to the GDT topic at the end is where there could be some improvement because it is a difficult topic and he expects you to fully understand it after watching his recorded lectures but it is a very difficult topic

I had Dr. Crane last semester for EML2023, and I absolutely loved the class and having him as a professor. He is patient and always stays after class to make sure he answers everyone's questions, and you can tell how passionate he is about the course and teaching. 100% recommend having him as a professor.

Dr. Crane was a good professor, but you definitely have to try to get an A. It's a flipped classroom, so you need to watch the lectures to understand the concepts you review in class. He's usually pretty understanding. In the last half of the semester, the material is less interesting and he doesn't explain as well. Large weekly HW assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Extremely nice guy, answers every question you'll ever ask, and always wants to help. The content isn't always the most entertaining but he tries his best to keep you engaged. Loved the class, definitely would take it again. The class isn't difficult but you'll have to work a decent amount for an A.

Professor Crane wants you to know how to use Solidworks above all else. He is very fair and caring and if you put in the time and respect for the class, he will 100% reciprocate that back to you. For one of the most important courses you could take in engineering, definitely try to take it with him.

Dr. Crane is the best teacher I've ever had. He literally wrote the book on the material. He gives exactly the amount of work that it would take to really learn the material and this is one of the few topics I feel like I could apply at a job tomorrow. If you don't do the work, you won't get an A, but he'll make sure you can do the work.

Really easy class. Usually 2 hours of videos to watch a week, video quizzes/in class activities on Monday/Wednesdays (free 100s). Most Fridays are for office hours for the homework assignments, which are also easy. Study for for the GDT quiz because it ends up having an average of 55-65 and ruining grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: not good for lectures. homework requires a lot of independent study to complete. the material is easy but he really can't explain it well. people only go to class because its hybrid and required. better luck learning solidworks through youtube
Good Class. The contents might be hard, but he answered every questions from students, so studying this course was not that hard.

Dr. Crane is a great professor and teaches the material very well. His lectures were helpful and he's very approachable for all types of questions. The Solidworks portion of the class is not difficult at all, however the GDT quiz at the end will hurt your grade if you do not prepare for it (my class had a 55% average).
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Crane did a great job at preparing us for the Solidworks exam but not at all for the GDT Quiz, which had about a 60 average. He did curve the class at the end, which might not be normal though since I took it in the summer. Definitely take him if you want to learn how to use the Solidworks program well.

You watch the lectures before class and do an activity in class. Dr. Crane makes it an enjoyable class and does a good job preparing students for certification. Despite other reviews, he devoted over 2 weeks of the semester to GDT quiz preparation and provided plenty of practice opportunities. My only complaint is being in groups for the project.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Great professor and a great guy. He doesn't have the ego typical P.h.D's have. He is humble and no question is a dumb question to him. He understands what the real world is like and teaches his class in that mind set.
Very well explained lectures, he teaches the material logically and takes you step by step through it all. Really wants you to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: You watch videos for homework, go to class and do assignments, and then have more homework. Don't wait to study for the certification test since it is insanely hard. Study for GDT test early on since it is 15% of grade and bites a lot of people from getting an A or B. Make sure everything is fully defined. TAs love taking off hw points. Great guy.

This was the one class I looked forward to this semester. He teaches SW really well; pay attention to lecture/videos and the homework/classwork is easy. The GDT section is really not difficult if you put in a little review. Final group project is time-consuming but just follow the rubric! Really rewarding class

This was one of the flipped classroom styles where you watch lecture videos at home and then go to class to do a quiz and/or a class activity about the video. The class is somewhat time consuming with having to watch some videos at home that are an hour long. My recommendation is to download them and speed them up. Start the group project early!

The class is easy right up until the end, where he talks about GDT for one class period and then gives you a "quiz" that counts for about 15% of your grade. It ruined a lot of people's grades, and I know I would've gotten an A without it. There's also a group design project. Divorce deadweight ASAP and don't wait until the last minute to finish it.

Dr. Crane is one of the few professors who REALLy cares about the material that he is teaching and his students. Although the HW and lectures are tedious, he wants his students to learn and enjoy using SW, his class, and the overall design project. He is very helpful and caring in his office hours, especially for the design project! Love Dr. Crane!

He is one of my favorite professors. He was always willing and excited to help his students, and while he taught, his goal was to prepare us for the real world. I learned valuable skills in this class and enjoyed it a lot.
Easy on the grading system (Very easy to get an A). Does a lot of examples so you understand everything

Super nice and funny guy but his class is rather difficult because of how harshly he grades. BEWARE of the final project and quiz; I had an A the whole semester and thought I did well on the project but nope…ending up with a D on the project and C-  in the class. Good teacher but make sure you have done every assignment perfectly!! he doesn't curve
e-z class. Easiest class you will have in engineering. Crane thinks his final quiz and project are something you have to try hard on but the whole class is a joke.

This class is really easy untill you get to the final project and quiz. I had a solid A+ the whole semster and failed the quiz and final project ( which i put 80 hours into) and ended up failing the class. and losing my scholarship, thanks crane.

Fun and fairly easy class. I was the only non-engineering major in the class, but that did not seem to matter. He will give help if asked, the TAs are very helpful. He doesn't like e-mail, but staying after class (if you can) is helpful. Funny guy that likes Solidworks, he makes it fun like a game almost. Other than that, go to class!!!
Professor Crane is a great teacher with a good sense of humor. He is very easygoing and always willing to help his students. I wish he taught other undergrad courses.

If you're considering engineering, take this class. You'll either love it or switch out like I am. He was a laid back professor that didn't try to torture us, but just told some stories and had us make things happen. I personally found Solidworks/GDT tedious, but the only thing that took a substantial amount of work was the project. Great professor
Avoid.

Dr. Crane really loves this class. He went over by a few minutes almost every class--which can be annoying if you have to rush to another class afterward. The class itself is not bad. Dr. Crane follows the book pretty precisely since he wrote it. He has a great way of making the book come alive using his touch pen to draw on his laptop.

Pretty straightforward class. Starts out very simple--just geometry. Reverse analysis is when it becomes a bit overwhelming. A lot of notation to learn, but it's all very easy if you understand where the notation is coming from and why it's being used. Just stay on top of going to class and everything should be fine.

Great professor, I would highly recommend him. He makes solidworks easy to understand and he can even be funny at times. The class was also very interesting as well, fairly easy as long as you do the work on time.

What a cool professor! This class was really really challenging for me. But I went to office hours and Prof Crane is very helpful and nice. Pretty sure I was borderline A/A- and Crane bumped me up. Very nice and funny guy. The final project was deathly and took forever but now it's something I'm really proud of!

Homework is super easy. The project is a BEAST though-do NOT leave it to the last minute. He doesn't give great instructions, so I say dive into the project at least two weeks in advance and just go to office hours if you need help. Helpful in office hours. The tolerance quiz had an average of about 70 this semester-so not necessarily all that easy

He is a really cool professor that looks out for his students. This class is by far the best class I have ever taken simply because it is interesting and Prof. Crane makes it a really nice environment. Can get an A without going to class, but I still did because I enjoyed it so much.
Great guy. Doesn't beat around the bush much. Recommend.

Dr. Crane is the MAN!!! He is great at teaching you want you need to know out of Solid Works. Also, weekly homework is at max 1.5 hours a week. Tolerance quiz is easy if you study (I got a perfect 100). Just don't leave the Final design project until the last day, It takes about 30 hours of work to do it. Overall Great Professor and easy A.

Awesome professor ! Totally enjoyed learning about Robots in his class ! Really wants to help you and is so easy to understand. Probably because he's so good at understanding what the student is asking or where the student is probably messing up the concepts. Totally recommend him.

Overall his class is easy as he practically does the homework assignments in class but besides that he isn't really helpful. He lectures as if he's confused, doesn't respond to emails and doesn't give advice for the final project. Doesn't do a good job of explaining tolerancing thus the quiz on it is difficult. No need for any of the textbooks.

I took him for EML 2023 in Fall. The homework is somewhat challenging (making a part in Solidworks usually), but he goes over lots of examples to help you complete it, and you get 90 percent of the homework done in class.

Great professor.  He goes through all the homework projects in class so you can follow along.  He also recorded all his lectures so that you could watch them online for additional project help.  GDT is a little difficult.  The quizzes put a lot of weight on the course, so don't take them lightly.  Great class.

Great professor. Come to class and you will understand how to do the projects and homework. Very understanding of the fact that computers do weird things sometimes. The class is easy if you listen, plus he speaks well.  Take Crane if you can (at least for SolidWorks).
Really funny guy. Helps you to understand the design process pretty well. I enjoy his class.

Not a great professor. He is not clear with instructions (if he gives any) and does not have a defined grading scale. Likes to use "whatever" and "I don't know" which makes his teaching very vague and confusing. Good luck with the final project as he gives little advice but the class in general is pretty easy.
Fun Class... Hes a pretty funny professor

His assignments can be really easy or confusing. He has a random name generator that calls you in a large lecture hall. He wants to punish those that he calls and aren't there but I don't think he follows through. His syllabus is vague and you never know the grading scale. The HW is weighted randomly so one bad grade could lower your grade 10 pts.

Class is not that hard I got a B+ with little effort, but the teacher sucks he is not clear on what he wants, doesn?t give you specifics on projects, like grading scales. I liked what the class was teaching and found myself bored in class he is not interesting, and is for the most part a bad teacher I would avoid him if you can.

Great professor. Dr Crane teaches EML2023 (Solidworks) well, mostly through powerpoint. Assignments and quizzes are fair and are designed to help engineers farther down the road. Dr Crane himself goes out of his way to answer questions and help students. Overall a great professor, if only he TAs would grade things...

In my opinion, not a very good professor. He doesnt have any pre-determined grading scale, so he basically weights everything as he pleases. I.E.-- I missed ONE day of class, and my grade dropped 7 full points. assumes everyone understands the material as well as him. Also, assignments are usually either very easy, or ridiculously hard.
A serious professor that makes a hard topic very friendly. The best professor I ever had.

An okay professor. He teaches by Powerpoints without really doing many practice problems on the board. He doesn't explain everything very clearly and makes it difficult to understand. In my opinion a course like Dynamics should not be taught using Powerpoint. The quizzes can get very bad, sometimes not having anything to do with homework.

Has a program that chooses a student at random. Missed a few classes, but posted up videos. Uses powerpoint, with few errors. Problem is that he doesnt update the website before an exam, like the homework solutions.

Loved her! She is very passionate and loves her students. Quizzes are straight from notes and you are given exam questions beforehand. The only thing that is a bit hard are the projects, but nothing too bad.

If you have the opportunity, take this class 100%. Attendance isn't mandatory but the lectures won't be posted so make sure to go or get the notes from a friend. With the notes every quiz is super easy. She is really passionate and made the lectures entertaining by incorporating her experiences in the field. There's also a bit of extra credit.

Rayven is absolutely amazing! You don't have to be in class, but she does not post the slides, so find a friend! She is great at providing feedback and is clear on grading expectations. Quizzes are very easy if you take good notes, and she always will look over your projects to give input before the final submission. I highly recommend this class!

Rayven is an amazing professor! Her class is comprised of open note weekly(ish) quizzes, about 5 projects, and 2 exams. Do not let the projects scare you. The projects vary in size and are not very hard. She gives you everything you need to succeed and is always available to give you feedback. You also can either work independently or in a group.

Attendance is not technically mandatory, but she won't post the lectures so you should just go. I didn't need the textbook, and she really tries to make a connection with her students and genuinely wants to know what/how they're doing. She has her own company and will ask for volunteers if you want some event experience too.

Rayven is fantastic! She's super down to earth and funny, but possesses so much knowledge and passion for the industry. Her lectures are always interesting and digestible, and it's so evident how much she cares about helping students succeed. Cannot recommend her enough and can't wait to take more of her classes!

TAKE THIS CLASS! Rayven is an amazing professor. She is caring and extremely passionate about the topic. The workload is light, only one quiz a week and a few projects. For the projects, ask her for help! She will look over your work and give awesome feedback before you submit it. She is a fantastic teacher and person, I highly recommend her.

She is the most amazing professor you'll meet. She actually cares about what she is teaching you and provides opportunities for you to experience the Event Industry. The class itself is fairly straightforward and organized in a way that helps you understand rather than memorize. HIGHLY recommend!!!

Loved this class. If you're interested in the topic, you'll do amazing. Her study guides make exams super easy to study for. Work with someone for the project, it makes being creative easier. But totally doable on your own. 10/10 I loveddd her.

Rayven is awesome and so knowledgeable about the events industry! Attendance is not mandatory, but you have to go to lectures in order to get the notes for quizzes and exams as she does not post slides. Some assignments took a long time to complete but were not difficult, however they were graded harshly. Extra credit assignments also help!

Rayven was awesome. She is super nice. Attendance wasnt required but going to class was enjoyable enough. She goes over the exams the class prior, and if you pay attention then you will do well. This class had almost no homework. Super super easy

I really enjoyed this class. Although the lectures are not mandatory, you have to attend class to get the notes. The quizzes and exams are based off of the notes. Her study guides tell you exactly what is going to be asked on the exam. As long as you put in the work you'll do good in this class. She also provides lots of volunteer opportunities.

Rayven is super nice and obviously cares about what she is teaching. However, she flies through the material and you'll end up with hundreds of pages of notes. She is a very hard grader but lets you resubmit and get full credit. She's funny and helpful but this class is made harder than it should be. Never takes attendance and does Win Wednesday's!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Rayven is very passionate about the topic of event management and is very friendly in her email correspondence. I got an A because of all the extra credit she offered, but her assignment instructions were often super unclear and would result in harsh grades reducing points for somewhat mysterious reasons. Very nice lady, but not the class for me.

You can tell she is very passionate and wants all of her students to succeed  Many opportunities to get involved in the industry with her. Lectures are not posted so attendance is necessary but she is a pretty engaging speaker. Exams are pretty straightforward.

The bigger projects were group optional. She is really nice and wants you to succeed, but I think the online class got left behind. The grades took a long time to post, and she was a bit difficult in grading, with little feedback. I know I can reach out to her in the future for help or advice. Great lectures with examples from her experience.

This professor is very knowledgeable as well as an active industry leader. The lecture videos are 2-5 hours per module with reading and other resources links. The book is required but as her lectures/slides provide a great baseline. Stay on top on work and it won't feel like a crushing semester load. Not a course to stress about if taken with her.
Great energetic lectures, open note quizzes, and group projects make this class fun and interesting

Professor Rayven showed an expansive knowledge of all things event related. All of the assignments were easy enough if you gave yourself enough time. Make sure you attend the lectures bc the slides are not posted but good notes are essential in this course. If you have questions, be proactive because she does not always answer emails quickly.

Prof. Crisafulli is awesome! She is very energetic and always prepares fun lectures. There are group projects and 3 exams (including finals) but they are pretty interesting to do and not that difficult. She also shares her experiences as an event planner which is very inspiring.

The best professor I've ever had at UF! Try not to miss class. Her exams come straight from her presentations during lecture, so make sure you take notes on exactly what's on the slides. She also had extra credit for helping volunteer at events and they're super fun. Wish I could take this class again.

She is truly passionate about the material, loves answering questions, and had a good amount of work that related to what we were learning in class so you can apply your knowledge. Although, the only way to get the notes that you NEED for the exam is by going to class, however she doesn't count attendance so that's good. Amazing person!

Rayven is the best. She cares so much, treats students like human beings and really interacts with students on a personal level. She always makes herself available for anything even if you want advice with things unrelated to her class. I wish I could take her again. Class is super enjoyable and her assignments are useful. Very fair and sets you up

This class is really easy. It's lecture heavy but they are interesting. She has a ton of experience in the industry and shares so much resources and advice. Quiz and Discussion every week but they are pretty easy. Exams aren't too hard either.

You have to watch the lectures, but I don't mind because sometimes she is pretty entertaining. I've tried to just skip the lectures and skim through the video while taking the quiz and sometimes it works, sometimes it doesn't. So might as well watch the lectures from the start so you'll be prepared for the honorlock exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Exams cover both lectures and the textbook, with several chapters included. Focus on applying concepts rather than memorizing definitions. Exam questions are often scenario-based. Completing the extra credit is recommended. The professor is very passionate about the topic, but the amount of content makes it challenging.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Cooke doesn't care about student success and he genuinely tries to make things harder for no reason. Exam reviews are worthless because he's lazy and only goes over the formulas. 7-8 chapters is too much for him to review but expects students to remember the HUNDREDS of definitions on the exams. Insanity. Avoid him, he doesnt want you to succeed.

The prof is passionate about the subject and cares about students learning. Class is very time consuming, especially if taking notes on both lectures and textbook. Lots of reading and McGraw-Hill Connect assignments. Class is fast paced, starting up to 2 segments of non-included material (Graded) before non-cumulative exams. Do the extra credit!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: he really cares about his students! Also i did not study for one minute and still passed. most of the content is common sense.

Content heavy class but everything is super digestible. You can tell Prof Cooke cares and his lectures are engaging so try going!! I used Smokin Notes for all exams and studied max 5 hours for each and did super well - highly recommend investing. Also do the extra credit before the end of the semester it helps!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The exams are most of the grade and are not super hard but very content heavy. Don't just do the smartbook assignments, actually read the textbook and take notes. 50% of the exam is from the text and not mentioned in lecture. Smokin notes helped a lot to combine lecture and text material. He has the past 5 years of exams on canvas, do all of them.

The material is not particularly difficult, but because you HAVE to stay on top of work or you will get lost. Do not put off lectures/ readings in the class. Professor Cooke is an AMAZING professor and the reason I could remain interested during the class. Tests weight HEAVY. But study hard and it will pay off (and do the extra credit).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: Nice guy but the exams are weighted too heavy in comparison to the amount of effort other assignments require. 3ish mcgraw hill assignments every week with much reading, but they're not weighted enough in your grade. The extra credit helps. Lectures cover important stuff and textbook chapters has so many unneeded topics, so know the lectures.

Enthusiastic professor, but A LOT of material. Exams cover lectures + Textbook, I suggest make flashcards as you read!! Study vocab for exams and do practice exams (he offers plenty). You don't NEED Smokin notes, but prepare to put in a lot of work(I did not use smokin notes). Professor's lecturers are interesting + math reviews before exams.

Professor Cooke did an amazing job and the class is quite frankly super easy as long as you take the time to actually do the homework and study well for the exams. Some advice I would give is to make sure that you read the text and if you are struggling, DO THE EXTRA CREDIT. Overall, Professor Cooke is great and his lectures are very fun.

Professor Alan is a great professor, you can definitively learn a lot from him. 
He makes the lectures enjoyable and you can feel the passion he has for marketing, be prepared to study and if you understand the subjects you will easily pass.

Went into the class thinking it would be easy. Exams are pretty tough but smokin notes really helps. A lot of memorizing definitions. I studied a lot to get an A. Assignments are time consuming but not bad. Do the extra credit it raises your grade A LOT. Not a horrible class if you put in the effort

Overall a nice guy, but his exams are difficult. Even for a marketing class, I found this class very tough. He pulls questions from lectures/textbook, and has an appeal process as his questions can be worded poorly. He doesn't let you appeal if you take a makeup exam. Do his practice exams. Easy to get a B, but tough to get an A. Get smokin notes!

Weighs HEAVY on 3 tests, where wording was confusing/convoluted. I attended EVERY live lecture, paid for Smokin' Notes and paid for professor's printed note packet as he recommended. HW scored 100s, tests 60s (class avg 70s). Final grade 71% which is "C". Professor submitted "C-". I didn't pass "C or higher" pre-requisite. I have to retake course.

The past reviews give a good ideas what the prof is like. If you love analytics and don't mind 5-6 hours of lectures &1-3 hours of homework every week take this class. This class is labeled as a marketing class but only focuses on analytics & statistics. I haven't taken the exam yet but I can't imagine i'll do great. Great dude just a bland class
Professor Cooke's class is challenging, but engaging. The exams are tough, so use resources like Smokin Notes and unstuckstudy to prep. Do the extra credit - it can really boost your grade.

I love Dr. Cooke! Watching his lectures was such a treat because he is so passionate about what he teaches. I studied a lot for this class to get an A because the exams are around 80% of your grade. The material is not hard as long as you study, just make sure to study! I made quizlets for each chapter and used his note shells for lectures!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class is very heavy on reading, but it is manageable. Additionally, Dr. Cooke is a very engaging lecturer and is obviously enthusiastic about the subject. Personally, I didn't find the exams too hard since there are a large number of practice tests from previous years that are provided. The professor also responds quickly to emails.

Lots of reading, but the lectures are amazing! He is clearly excited about what he teaches, and wants to get the students as enthusiastic about marketing as he is! He is quick to respond when you email him with questions. He made me wish I was taking the class in person!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He was a great professor and was great at explaining things, but the exams were so hard for no reason. I would say to make sure to keep up with the lectures and to do the smokin notes before the exams. The sim's were hard and the assignments took a lot of time. Overall. not a bad class though, and hes a good professor.

Dr. Cooke was very consistent and thorough through the semester. He was really good at answering the questions and pairing his lectures with smokin notes got me an A. He is kind and genuinely cares about his students and he is readily available to help out. His lectures can be long but the information is interesting and watching them was important
Dr. Cooke was a good professor. He offered up to five points ec and had interesting real world examples in his lectures. I found smokin notes was helpful to study for exams.

Reading and watching the lectures are going to be your best friend. He offers extra credit at the research lab which is so helpful for your grades. If I hadn't fallen behind on my readings and lectures I would have done better so it's my fault I didn't get a good grade. I would take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very test heavy but as long as you study the material is not hard, there's just a lot of it. Dr. Cooke's lectures were engaging and I love  the real world examples he gives, they really help in understanding the material. Smokin Notes is not needed in my opinion. I haven't taken the last exam but based off previous performance, I'll end with an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor, gives lots of clear information about the class and is easy to listen and understand lecture. The only thing I will say is if you are a bad test taker (like myself) be prepared to study wayyyy more than normal and pray, because if you do bad on the tests it doesn't matter if you have 100%'s in all other assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He offers lots of practice exams, extra credit, and an appeal system for exam questions. I didn't think the workload was insane, even when I took this last summer with other classes too. Overall, Dr. Cooke is an awesome instructor and funny too.

I had a great time in the class and appreciated that Professor Cooke took the time to provide real world examples in the lectures instead of just repeating the textbook verbatim. There were quite a few hours of lectures, but the course moved at a faster pace due to the summer semester. The test questions were similar to the practice exams given.

The class is very lecture-heavy, and not all content is relevant for the exams. It is difficult to know what to study since half his exam content is taken from the textbook and half from his lectures, however, if you put in the effort to do both it is possible to succeed in the class.

Very long lectures make sure u watch them. He is selfish because he wants to finish things on time for his convenience; even when the school sent out an announcement to cancel all exams due to a tropical storm he did not want to, until he was forced to but he took away our option to appeal questions in the exam as if it was our fault.. do not take
This was hard so hard for NO reason. The tests were very difficult compared to practice problems and honestly I studied very very hard for them. I would not take him again

His lectures and examples were not bad, he is just not a nice professor. When the university cancelled all exams because of a tropical storm, he tried to say we still had to take the exam during the tropical storm. Additionally, test are like 80% of your grade and other assignments are worth barely anything.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I enjoyed this class. Though exams were a significant portion of the final grade, I felt sufficiently prepared by the lectures, assignments, and practice exams. The class overall wasn't too hard, and watching the lectures was not a chore at all.

If you put in effort, you can easily get an A. Read the textbook + make sure you watch the lectures: he includes things (not in the textbook) that will be on the test. Extra credit will also boost you tons, so make sure you do it (the surveys are super easy). There are tons of practice exams you can do to prep before exams, which are very helpful.

The professor is knowledgeable but there are at home 1 hour+ lectures (graded for 2 points!!) that you then discuss. His homework assignments are vague and you're left to figure it out on your own. The 2 tests are the cushion for the group assignments which are tough. The class is very analytical with a lot of math so get ready to use excel.

Quite possibly the worst class I have ever taken. This class was disorganized, difficult, and lacked information. The course load required about 30 hours per week to complete. The topics were challenging, but not well-explained. I have learned more from YouTube tutorials! Most students dropped the course halfway through the semester.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS! Unless you have an in depth knowledge of programming and R, you will struggle with this course. Professor Cooke is very knowledgable but does not offer sufficient help to succeed in the course.

Professor Cooke was a great professor with good lectures and great real-world examples, but the course was very difficult. The class is based on three exams worth 56 points and the assignments are worth 1, so you have to do good on exams to do okay in this class. Which is nearly impossible with how much material is on each exam.

In my opinion this class is way harder than it should be. The exams are not easy and they cover a lot of content from both lectures and the textbook. Do the extra credit and get SmokinNotes. Cooke is enthusiastic about the content and provides interesting real life examples but the exams cover so much material without SmokinNotes it's impossible.

There are 3 major exams in this class and they weigh very heavily towards the final grade. Other assignments through McGraw Hill takes time but it is guaranteed that you will get points as long as you finish them in time. However, if you fail one exam it is quite difficult to get your grades up so make sure to do the extra credits just in case.

Dr Cooke is very passionate about marketing and his lectures are actually very interesting. He gives extra credit that can boost your grade up a whole letter, so please do them. The exams are not that bad if you study using smokin notes. Vocab is very important so study with flashcards provided by Smokin Notes or you can create one on your own.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: 3 exams make up a majority of your grade, readings and quizzes only counted for 1 point each. Exams were pretty difficult but he allows appeals for questions. Invest in smokin notes and do the extra credit if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was tough! The 3 exams are based on concepts and not straight forward questions and answers and is 80% of your grade.
